channel.title: Bil-Quran: Word-by-Word Qur'an
channel.description: A Qur'an app with interlinear word-by-word and verse-by-verse translations, helping readers understand the meaning of the Qur'an beyond recitation alone.

item.title: bil-Quran: Word-by-Word Quran
item.description: A Qur'an app with interlinear word-by-word and verse-by-verse translations, helping readers understand the meaning of the Qur'an beyond recitation alone.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Alif, Lām, Mīm.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the faithless, neither their wealth nor their children shall avail them anything against Allah; it is they who will be fuel for the Fire;

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:100 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith, if you obey a part of those who were given the Book, they will turn you back, after your faith, into faithless ones.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:101 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And how would you be faithless while the signs of Allah are recited to you and His Apostle is in your midst? And whoever takes recourse in Allah is certainly guided to a straight path.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:102 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Be wary of Allah with the wariness due to Him and do not die except as muslims.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:103 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Hold fast, all together, to Allah's cord, and do not be divided [into sects]. And remember Allah's blessing upon you when you were enemies, then He brought your hearts together, so you became brothers with His blessing. And you were on the brink of a pit of Fire, whereat He saved you from it. Thus does Allah clarify His signs for you so that you may be guided.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:104 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There has to be a nation among you summoning to the good, bidding what is right, and forbidding what is wrong. It is they who are the felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:105 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not be like those who became divided [into sects] and differed after manifest signs had come to them. For such there will be a great punishment,

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:106 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: on the day when [some] faces will turn white and [some] faces will turn black. As for those whose faces turn black [it will be said to them], 'Did you disbelieve after your faith? So taste the punishment because of what you used to disbelieve.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:107 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But as for those whose faces become white, they shall dwell in Allah's mercy, and they will remain in it [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:108 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These are the signs of Allah which We recite to you in truth, and Allah does not desire any wrong for the creatures.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:109 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and to Allah all matters are returned.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: as in the case of Pharaoh's clan and those who were before them, who denied Our signs. So Allah seized them for their sins, and Allah is severe in retribution.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:110 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You are the best nation [ever] brought forth for mankind: you bid what is right and forbid what is wrong, and have faith in Allah. And if the People of the Book had believed, it would have been better for them. Among them [some] are faithful, but most of them are transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:111 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They1 will never do you any harm, except for some hurt; and if they fight you, they will turn their backs [to flee], then they will not be helped.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:112 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Abasement has been stamped upon them wherever they are confronted, except for an asylum from Allah and an asylum from the people; and they earned the wrath of Allah, and poverty was stamped upon them. That, because they would defy the signs of Allah and kill the prophets unjustly. That, because they would disobey and used to commit transgression.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:113 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yet they are not all alike. Among the People of the Book is an upright nation; they recite Allah's signs in the watches of the night and prostrate.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:114 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They have faith in Allah and the Last Day, and bid what is right and forbid what is wrong, and are active in [performing] good deeds. They are among the righteous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:115 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And whatever good they do, they will not go unappreciated for it, and Allah knows best the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:116 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the faithless, neither their wealth nor their children will avail them anything against Allah. They shall be the inmates of the Fire, and they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:117 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The parable of what they spend in the life of this world is that of a cold wind that strikes the tillage of a people who wronged themselves, destroying it. Allah does not wrong them, but they wrong themselves.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:118 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not take your confidants from others than yourselves; they will spare nothing to ruin you. They are eager to see you in distress. Hatred has already shown itself from their mouths, and what their breasts hide [within] is yet worse. We have certainly made the signs clear for you, should you apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:119 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ah! You are the ones who bear love towards them, while they do not love you, though you believe in all the Books; and when they meet you, they say, 'We believe,' but when they are alone, they bite their fingertips out of rage at you. Say, 'Die of your rage!' Indeed Allah knows best what is in the breasts.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say to the faithless, 'You shall be overcome and mustered toward hell, and it is an evil resting place.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:120 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If some good should befall you, it upsets them, but if some ill should befall you, they rejoice at it. Yet if you are patient and Godwary, their guile will not harm you in any way. Indeed Allah comprehends what they do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:121 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you left your family at dawn to settle the faithful in their positions for battle —and Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:122 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When two groups among you were about to lose courage, —though Allah is their guardian, and in Allah let all the faithful put their trust.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:123 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly Allah helped you at Badr, when you were abased [in the enemy's eyes]. So be wary of Allah so that you may give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:124 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you were saying to the faithful, 'Is it not enough for you that your Lord should aid you with three thousand angels sent down?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:125 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yes, if you are steadfast and Godwary, and should they come at you suddenly, your Lord will aid you with five thousand marked angels.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:126 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah did not appoint it but as a good news for you, and to reassure with it your hearts, and victory1 comes only from Allah, the All-mighty, the All-wise,

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:127 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that He may cut down a section of the faithless, or subdue them, so that they retreat disappointed.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:128 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You have no hand in the matter, whether He accepts their repentance or punishes them, for they are indeed wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:129 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth: He forgives whomever He wishes and punishes whomever He wishes, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There was certainly a sign for you in the two hosts that met: one host fighting in the way of Allah and the other faithless, who saw them visibly twice as many.1 Allah strengthens with His help whomever He wishes. There is indeed a moral in that for those who have insight.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:130 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not exact usury, twofold and severalfold, and be wary of Allah so that you may be felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:131 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And beware of the Fire which has been prepared for the faithless,

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:132 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and obey Allah and the Apostle so that you may be granted [His] mercy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:133 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And hasten towards your Lord's forgiveness and a paradise as vast as the heavens and the earth, prepared for the Godwary

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:134 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those who spend in ease and adversity, and suppress their anger, and excuse [the faults of] the people, and Allah loves the virtuous;

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:135 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and those who, when they commit an indecent act or wrong themselves, remember Allah, and plead [Allah's] forgiveness for their sins —and who forgives sins except Allah?— and who do not persist in what they have committed while they know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:136 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Their reward is forgiveness from their Lord, and gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them [forever]. How excellent is the reward of the workers!

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:137 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certain [Divine] precedents have passed before you. So travel over the land and then observe how was the fate of the deniers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:138 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is an explanation for mankind, and a guidance and advice for the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:139 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not weaken or grieve: you shall have the upper hand, should you be faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To mankind has been made to seem decorous the love of [worldly] desires, including women and children, accumulated piles of gold and silver, horses of mark, livestock, and farms. Those are the wares of the life of this world; but Allah—with Him is a good destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:140 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If a wound afflicts you, a like wound has already afflicted those people; and We make such vicissitudes rotate among mankind, so that Allah may ascertain those who have faith, and that He may take martyrs1 from among you, and Allah does not like the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:141 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And so that Allah may purge those who have faith and that He may wipe out the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:142 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you suppose that you would enter paradise, while Allah has not yet ascertained those of you who have waged jihād and not ascertained the steadfast?

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:143 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly you were longing for death before you had encountered it. Then certainly you saw it, as you looked on.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:144 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Muḥammad is but an apostle; [other] apostles have passed before him. If he dies or is slain, will you turn back on your heels? Anyone who turns back on his heels will not harm Allah in the least, and soon Allah will reward the grateful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:145 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No soul may die except by Allah's leave, at an appointed time. Whoever desires the reward of this world, We will give him of it; and whoever desires the reward of the Hereafter, We will give him of it; and soon We will reward the grateful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:146 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How many a prophet there has been with whom a multitude of godly men fought. They did not falter for what befell them in the way of Allah, neither did they weaken, nor did they abase themselves; and Allah loves the steadfast.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:147 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: All that they said was, 'Our Lord, forgive us our sins, and our excesses in our affairs, and make our feet steady, and help us against the faithless lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:148 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So Allah gave them the reward of this world and the fair reward of the Hereafter; and Allah loves the virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:149 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! If you obey the faithless, they will turn you back on your heels, and you will become losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Shall I inform you of something better than that? For those who are Godwary there will be gardens near their Lord, with streams running in them, to remain in them [forever], and chaste mates, and Allah's pleasure.' And Allah sees best the servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:150 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather Allah is your Master, and He is the best of helpers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:151 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We shall cast terror into the hearts of the faithless because of their ascribing to Allah partners, for which He has not sent down any authority, and their refuge shall be the Fire, and evil is the [final] abode of the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:152 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah certainly fulfilled His promise to you when you were slaying them with His leave, until you lost courage, disputed about the matter, and disobeyed after He showed you what you loved.1 Some of you desire this world, and some of you desire the Hereafter. Then He turned you away from them so that He might test you. Certainly He has excused you, for Allah is gracious to the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:153 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you were fleeing without paying any attention to anyone, while the Apostle was calling you from your rear, He requited you with grief upon grief, so that you may not grieve for what you lose nor for what befalls you, and Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:154 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then He sent down to you safety after grief —a drowsiness that came over a group of you— while another group, anxious only about themselves, entertained false notions about Allah, notions of [pagan] ignorance. They say, 'Do we have any role in the matter?' Say, 'Indeed the matter belongs totally to Allah.' They hide in their hearts what they do not disclose to you. They say, 'Had we any role in the matter, we would not have been slain here.' Say, 'Even if you had remained in your houses, those destined to be slain would have set out toward the places where they were laid to rest, so that Allah may test what is in your breasts, and that He may purge what is in your hearts, and Allah knows best what is in the breasts.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:155 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those of you who fled on the day when the two hosts met, only Satan had made them stumble because of some of their deeds. Certainly Allah has excused them, for Allah is all-forgiving, all-forbearing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:156 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not be like the faithless who say of their brethren, when they travel in the land or go into battle, 'Had they stayed with us they would not have died or been killed,' so that Allah may make it a regret in their hearts. But Allah gives life and brings death, and Allah sees best what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:157 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you are slain in the way of Allah, or die, surely forgiveness and mercy from Allah are better than what they amass.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:158 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if you die or are slain, you will surely be mustered toward Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:159 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is by Allah's mercy that you are gentle to them; and had you been harsh and hardhearted, surely they would have scattered from around you. So excuse them, and plead for forgiveness for them, and consult them in the affairs, and once you are resolved, put your trust in Allah. Indeed Allah loves those who trust in Him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who say, 'Our Lord! Indeed we have faith. So forgive us our sins, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:160 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If Allah helps you, no one can overcome you, but if He forsakes you, who will help you after Him? So in Allah let all the faithful put their trust.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:161 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A prophet may not breach his trust, and whoever breaches his trust will bring his breaches on the Day of Resurrection; then every soul shall be recompensed fully for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:162 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is he who follows [the course of] Allah's pleasure like him who earns Allah's displeasure and whose refuge is hell, an evil destination?

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:163 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They have ranks with Allah, and Allah sees best what they do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:164 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah certainly favoured the faithful when He raised up among them an apostle from among themselves to recite to them His signs and to purify them, and to teach them the Book and wisdom, and earlier they had indeed been in manifest error.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:165 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What, when an affliction visits you —while you have inflicted twice as much— do you say, 'How is this?'! Say, 'This is from your own souls.' Indeed Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:166 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What befell you on the day when the two hosts met, was by Allah's permission, so that He may ascertain the faithful,

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:167 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and ascertain the hypocrites. [When] they were told: 'Come, fight in the way of Allah, or defend [yourselves], they said, 'If we knew any fighting, surely we would have followed you.' That day they were nearer to unfaith than to faith. They say with their mouths what is not in their hearts, and Allah knows best whatever they conceal.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:168 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who said of their brethren, while they themselves sat back: 'Had they obeyed us, they would not have been killed.' Say, 'Then keep death off from yourselves, should you be truthful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:169 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not suppose those who were slain in the way of Allah to be dead; rather they are living and provided for near their Lord,

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Patient and truthful, obedient and charitable, and pleading [Allah's] forgiveness at dawns.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:170 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: exulting in what Allah has given them out of His grace, and rejoicing for those who have not yet joined them from [those left] behind them that they will have no fear, nor will they grieve.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:171 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They rejoice in Allah's blessing and grace, and that Allah does not waste the reward of the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:172 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who responded to Allah and the Apostle [even] after they had been wounded —for those of them who have been virtuous and Godwary there shall be a great reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:173 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those to whom the people said, 'All the people have gathered against you; so fear them.' That only increased them in faith, and they said, 'Allah is sufficient for us, and He is an excellent trustee.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:174 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So they returned with Allah's blessing and grace, untouched by any evil. They pursued the pleasure of Allah, and Allah is dispenser of a great grace.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:175 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is only Satan frightening his followers! So fear them not, and fear Me, should you be faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:176 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not grieve for those who are active in unfaith; they will not hurt Allah in the least: Allah desires to give them no share in the Hereafter, and there is a great punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:177 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who have bought unfaith for faith will not hurt Allah in the least, and there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:178 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Let the faithless not suppose that the respite that We grant them is good for their souls: We give them respite only that they may increase in sin, and there is a humiliating punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:179 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah will not leave the faithful in your present state, until He has separated the bad ones from the good. Allah will not acquaint you with the Unseen, but Allah chooses from His apostles whomever He wishes. So have faith in Allah and His apostles; and if you are faithful and Godwary, there shall be a great reward for you.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah bears witness that there is no god except Him —and [so do] the angels and those who possess knowledge— maintainer of justice, there is no god but Him, the Almighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:180 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Let the stingy not suppose that [their grudging] what Allah has given them out of His grace is good for them; rather it is bad for them. They will be collared with what they grudge on the Day of Resurrection. To Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:181 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has certainly heard the remark of those who said, 'Allah is poor and we are rich.' We will record what they have said, and their killing of the prophets unjustly,1 and We shall say, 'Taste the punishment of the burning.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:182 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is because of what your hands have sent ahead, and because Allah is not tyrannical to the servants.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:183 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [To] those who say, 'Allah has pledged us not to believe in any apostle unless he brings us an offering consumed by fire,' say, 'Apostles before me certainly brought you manifest signs and what you speak of. Then why did you kill them, should you be truthful?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:184 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they deny you, then before you [other] apostles have been denied, who came with manifest signs, holy writs, and an illuminating scripture.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:185 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Every soul shall taste death, and you will indeed be paid your full rewards on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever is delivered from the Fire and admitted to paradise has certainly succeeded. The life of this world is nothing but the wares of delusion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:186 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You will surely be tested in your possessions and your souls, and you will surely hear from those who were given the Book before you and from the polytheists much affront; but if you are patient and Godwary, that is indeed the steadiest of courses.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:187 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Allah made a covenant with those who were given the Book: 'You shall explain it for the people, and you shall not conceal it,' they cast it behind their backs and sold it for a paltry gain. How evil is what they buy!

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:188 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not suppose those who exult in what they have done, and love to be praised for what they have not done —do not suppose them saved from punishment, and there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:189 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed, with Allah religion is Islām,1 and those who were given the Book did not differ except after knowledge had come to them, out of envy among themselves. And whoever defies Allah's signs [should know that] Allah is swift at reckoning.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:190 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of night and day, there are signs for those who possess intellects.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:191 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who remember Allah standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth [and say], 'Our Lord, You have not created this in vain! Immaculate are You! Save us from the punishment of the Fire.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:192 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Our Lord, whoever that You make enter the Fire will surely have been disgraced by You, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:193 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Our Lord, we have indeed heard a summoner calling to faith, declaring, "Have faith in your Lord!" So we believed. Our Lord, forgive us our sins and absolve us of our misdeeds, and make us die with the pious.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:194 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Our Lord, give us what You have promised us through Your apostles, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed You do not break Your promise.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:195 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then their Lord answered them, 'I do not waste the work of any worker among you, whether male or female; you are all on the same footing. So those who migrated and were expelled from their homes, and were tormented in My way, and those who fought and were killed —I will surely absolve them of their misdeeds and I will admit them into gardens with streams running in them, as a reward from Allah, and Allah—with Him is the best of rewards.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:196 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Never be misled by the bustle of the faithless in the towns.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:197 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is a trivial enjoyment; then their refuge is hell, and it is an evil resting place.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:198 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But those who are wary of their Lord —for them shall be gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them [forever], a hospitality from Allah; and what is with Allah is better for the pious.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:199 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed among the People of the Book there are surely some who have faith in Allah, and in what has been sent down to you, and in what has been sent down to them. Humble toward Allah, they do not sell the signs of Allah for a paltry gain. They shall have their reward near their Lord; indeed Allah is swift at reckoning.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah—there is no god except Him— is the Living One, the All-sustainer.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So if they argue with you, say, 'I have submitted my will to Allah, and [so has] he who follows me.' And say to those who were given the Book and the uninstructed ones,1 'Do you submit?' If they submit, they will certainly be guided; but if they turn away, then your duty is only to communicate; and Allah sees best the servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:200 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Be patient, stand firm, and close [your] ranks, and be wary of Allah so that you may be felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who defy Allah's signs and kill the prophets unjustly,1 and kill those who call for justice from among the people, inform them of a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are the ones whose works have failed in this world and the Hereafter, and they will have no helpers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded those who were given a share of the Book, who are summoned to the Book of Allah in order that it may judge between them, whereat a part of them refuse to comply and they are disregardful?

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is because they say, 'The Fire shall not touch us except for a number of days,' and they have been misled in their religion by what they used to fabricate.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But how will it be [with them] when We gather them on a day in which there is no doubt, and every soul shall be recompensed fully for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged?

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'O Allah, Master of all sovereignty! You give sovereignty to whomever You wish, and strip of sovereignty whomever You wish; You make mighty whomever You wish, and You abase whomever You wish; all good is in Your hand. Indeed You have power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You make the night pass into the day and You make the day pass into the night. You bring forth the living from the dead and You bring forth the dead from the living, and You provide for whomever You wish without any reckoning.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithful should not take the faithless for allies instead of the faithful, and whoever does that Allah will have nothing to do with him, except when you are wary of them out of caution. Allah warns you to beware of [disobeying] Him, and toward Allah is the return.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Whether you hide what is in your hearts, or disclose it, Allah knows it, and He knows whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth; and Allah has power over all things.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He has sent down to you the Book with the truth confirming what was [revealed] before it, and He had sent down the Torah and the Evangel

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day when every soul will find present whatever good it has done; and as to whatever evil it has done it will wish there were a far distance between it and itself. Allah warns you to beware of [disobeying] Him, and Allah is most kind to [His] servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'If you love Allah, then follow me; Allah will love you and forgive you your sins, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Obey Allah and the Apostle.' But if they turn away, indeed Allah does not like the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah chose Adam and Noah, and the progeny of Abraham and the progeny of Imran above all the nations;

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: some of them are descendants of the others, and Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the wife of Imran said, 'My Lord, I dedicate to You what is in my belly, in consecration. Accept it from me; indeed You are the All-hearing, the All-knowing.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when she bore her,1 she said, 'My Lord, I have borne a female [child]' —and Allah knew better what she had borne— 'and the female is not like the male. I have named her Mary, and I commend her and her offspring to Your care against [the evil of] the outcast Satan.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thereupon her Lord accepted her with a gracious acceptance, and made her grow up in a worthy fashion, and He charged Zechariah with her care. Whenever Zechariah visited her in the sanctuary, he would find provisions with her. He said, 'O Mary, from where does this come for you?' She said, 'It comes from Allah. Allah provides whomever He wishes without any reckoning.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thereat Zechariah supplicated his Lord. He said, 'My Lord! Grant me a good offspring from You! Indeed You hear all supplications.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then the angels called out to him, as he stood praying in the sanctuary: 'Allah gives you the good news of John, as a confirmer of a Word of Allah,1 eminent and chaste, a prophet, among the righteous.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: before as guidance for mankind, and He has sent down the Criterion.1 Indeed those who defy the signs of Allah, there is a severe punishment for them; and Allah is all-mighty, avenger.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord, how shall I have a son while old age has overtaken me and my wife is barren?' He said, 'So it is that Allah does whatever He wishes.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord, grant me a sign.' He said, 'Your sign is that you will not speak to people for three days except in gestures. And remember Your Lord greatly, and glorify Him morning and evening.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when the angels said, 'O Mary, Allah has chosen you and purified you, and He has chosen you above the world's women.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Mary, be obedient to your Lord, and prostrate and bow down with those who bow [in worship].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These accounts are from the Unseen, which We reveal to you, and you were not with them when they were casting lots [to see] which of them would take charge of Mary's care, nor were you with them when they were contending.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the angels said, 'O Mary, Allah gives you the good news of a Word from Him whose name is Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, distinguished in the world and the Hereafter, and one of those brought near [to Allah].

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He will speak to people in the cradle and in adulthood, and will be one of the righteous.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: She said, 'My Lord, how shall I have a child seeing that no human has ever touched me?' He said, 'So it is that Allah creates whatever He wishes. When He decides on a matter He just says to it "Be!" and it is.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And He will teach him the Book and wisdom, the Torah and the Evangel,

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and [he will be] an apostle to the Children of Israel, [and he will declare,] 'I have certainly brought you a sign from your Lord: I will create for you out of clay the form of a bird, then I will breathe into it, and it will become a bird by Allah's leave. And I heal the blind and the leper and I revive the dead by Allah's leave. And I will tell you what you have eaten and what you have stored in your houses. There is indeed a sign in that for you, should you be faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Nothing is indeed hidden from Allah in the earth or in the sky.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And [I come] to confirm [the truth of] that which is before me of the Torah, and to make lawful for you some of the things that were forbidden you. I have brought you a sign from your Lord; so be wary of Allah and obey me.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah is my Lord and your Lord; so worship Him. This is a straight path.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when Jesus sensed their faithlessness, he said, 'Who will be my helpers toward Allah?' The Disciples said, 'We will be helpers of Allah. We have faith in Allah, and bear witness that we are muslims.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Our Lord, we believe in what You have sent down, and we follow the apostle, so write us among the witnesses.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then they1 plotted [against Jesus], and Allah also devised, and Allah is the best of devisers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Allah said, 'O Jesus, I shall take you[r soul],1 and I shall raise you up toward Myself, and I shall clear you of [the calumnies of] the faithless, and I shall set those who follow you above the faithless until the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me will be your return, whereat I will judge between you concerning that about which you used to differ.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the faithless, I will punish them with a severe punishment in the world and the Hereafter; and they will have no helpers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But as for those who have faith and do righteous deeds, He will pay them in full their rewards, and Allah does not like the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These that We recite to you are from the signs and the Wise Reminder.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the case of Jesus with Allah is like the case of Adam: He created him from dust, then said to him, 'Be,' and he was.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who forms you in the wombs however He wishes. There is no god except Him, the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is the truth from your Lord, so do not be among the skeptics.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Should anyone argue with you concerning him, after the knowledge that has come to you, say, 'Come! Let us call our sons and your sons, our women and your women, our souls and your souls, then let us pray earnestly and call down Allah's curse upon the liars.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is indeed the true account, for sure. There is no god but Allah, and indeed Allah is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they turn away, indeed Allah knows best the agents of corruption.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'O People of the Book! Come to a word common between us and you: that we will worship no one but Allah, and that we will not ascribe any partner to Him, and that we will not take each other as lords besides Allah.' But if they turn away, say, 'Be witnesses that we are muslims.' 1

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O People of the Book! Why do you argue concerning Abraham? Neither the Torah nor the Evangel were sent down until [long] after him. Do you not apply reason?

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ah! You are the very ones who argue about that of which you have knowledge. Why then do you argue about that of which you have no knowledge? And Allah knows and you do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian. Rather he was a ḥanīf, a muslim, and he was not one of the polytheists.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the nearest of all people to Abraham are those who follow him, and this prophet and those who have faith, and Allah is the guardian of the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A group of the People of the Book were eager to lead you astray; yet they lead no one astray except themselves, but they are not aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who has sent down to you the Book. Parts of it are definitive verses, which are the mother of the Book, while others are metaphorical.1 As for those in whose hearts is deviance, they pursue what is metaphorical in it, courting temptation and courting its interpretation. But no one knows its interpretation except Allah and those firmly grounded in knowledge; they say, 'We believe in it; all of it is from our Lord.' And none takes admonition except those who possess intellect.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O People of the Book! Why do you defy Allah's signs while you testify [to their truth]?

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O People of the Book! Why do you mix the truth with falsehood, and conceal the truth while you know [it]?

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A group of the People of the Book say, 'Believe in what has been sent down to the faithful at the beginning of the day, and disbelieve at its end, so that they may turn back [from their religion].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'And do not believe anyone except him who follows your religion.' Say, 'Indeed [true] guidance is the guidance of Allah.' '[And do not believe] that anyone may be given the like of what you were given, or that he may argue with you before your Lord.'1 Say, 'Indeed all grace is in Allah's hand; He grants it to whomever He wishes, and Allah is all-bounteous, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He singles out for His mercy whomever He wishes, and Allah is dispenser of a great grace.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And among the People of the Book is he who if you entrust him with a quintal1 will repay it to you, and among them is he who, if you entrust him with a dinar will not repay it to you unless you stand persistently over him. That is because they say, 'We have no obligation to the non-Jews.' But they attribute lies to Allah, and they know [it].

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yes, whoever fulfills his commitments and is wary of Allah —Allah indeed loves the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who sell Allah's covenant and their oaths for a paltry gain— there shall be no share for them in the Hereafter and Allah will not speak to them nor will He [so much as] look at them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them, and there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is indeed a group of them who twist their tongues to mimic the Book, that you may suppose that it is from the Book, though it is not from the Book, and they say, 'It is from Allah,' though it is not from Allah, and they attribute lies to Allah, and they know [it].

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It does not behoove any human that Allah should give him the Book, judgement and prophethood, and then he should say to the people, 'Be my servants instead of Allah.' Rather [he would say], 'Be a godly people, because of your teaching the Book and because of your studying it.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [They say,] 'Our Lord! Do not make our hearts swerve after You have guided us, and bestow Your mercy on us. Indeed You are the All-munificent.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And he would not command you to take the angels and the prophets for lords. Would he call you to unfaith after you have been muslims?

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Allah took a compact concerning the prophets, [He said,] 'Inasmuch as I have given you of the Book and wisdom,1 should an apostle come to you thereafter confirming what is with you, you shall believe in him and help him.' He said, 'Do you pledge and accept My covenant on this condition?' They said, 'We pledge.' He said, 'Then be witnesses, and I am also among the witnesses along with you.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then whoever turns away after that —it is they who are the transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they, then, seek a religion other than Allah's, while to Him submits whoever there is in the heavens and the earth, willingly or unwillingly, and to Him they will be brought back?

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'We have faith in Allah, and in what has been sent down to us, and what was sent down to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob and the Tribes, and that which Moses and Jesus were given, and the prophets, from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and to Him do we submit.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Should anyone follow a religion other than Islam, it shall never be accepted from him, and he will be among the losers in the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How shall Allah guide a people who have disbelieved after their faith and [after] bearing witness that the Apostle is true, and [after] manifest proofs had come to them? Allah does not guide the wrongdoing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Their requital is that there shall be upon them the curse of Allah, the angels, and all mankind.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will remain in it [forever], and their punishment shall not be lightened, nor will they be granted any respite,

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except such as repent after that and make amends, for Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Our Lord! You will indeed gather mankind on a day in which there is no doubt. Indeed Allah does not break His promise.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who turn faithless after their faith, and then advance in faithlessness, their repentance will never be accepted, and it is they who are the astray.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who turn faithless, and die while they are faithless, a world of gold will not be accepted from any of them should he offer it for ransom. For such there will be a painful punishment, and they will have no helpers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You will never attain piety until you spend out of what you hold dear, and whatever you may spend of anything, Allah indeed knows it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: All food was lawful to the Children of Israel except what Israel1 had forbidden himself before the Torah was sent down. Say, 'Bring the Torah, and read it, should you be truthful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So whoever fabricates a lie against Allah after that —it is they who are the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Allah has spoken the truth; so follow the creed of Abraham, a ḥanīf, and he was not one of the polytheists.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the first house to be set up for mankind is the one at Bakkah,1 blessed and a guidance for all nations.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: In it are manifest signs [and] Abraham's Station, and whoever enters it shall be secure. And it is the duty of mankind toward Allah to make pilgrimage to the House —for those who can afford the journey to it— and should anyone renege [on his obligation], Allah is indeed without need of the creatures.

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'O People of the Book! Why do you defy the signs of Allah, while Allah is witness to what you do?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Aal-i-Imraan:99 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'O People of the Book! why do you bar the faithful from the way of Allah, seeking to make it crooked, while you are witnesses [to its truthfulness]? And Allah is not oblivious of what you do.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He frowned and turned away

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: you are neglectful of him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! These [verses of the Qur'ān] are a reminder

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —so let anyone who wishes remember it—

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: in honoured scriptures,

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: exalted and purified,

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: in the hands of envoys,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: noble and pious.

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Perish man! How ungrateful is he!

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: From what has He created him?

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He has created him from a drop of [seminal] fluid, and then proportioned him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when the blind man approached him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then He made the way easy for him;

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then He made him die and buried him;

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and then, when He wished, resurrected him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! He has not yet carried out what He had commanded him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So let man observe1 his food:

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We poured down water plenteously,

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then We split the earth into fissures

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and made the grain grow in it,

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and vines and vegetables,

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: olives and date palms,

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And how do you know, maybe he would purify himself,

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and densely-planted gardens,

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: fruits and pastures,

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: as a sustenance for you and your livestock.

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when the deafening Cry comes

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —the day when a man will evade his brother,

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: his mother and his father,

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: his spouse and his sons—

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that day each of them will have a task to keep him preoccupied.

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That day some faces will be bright,

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: laughing and joyous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: or take admonition, and the admonition would benefit him!

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And some faces on that day will be covered with dust,

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: overcast with gloom.

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is they who are the faithless, the vicious.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But as for someone who is self-complacent,

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: you attend to him,

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: though you are not liable if he does not purify himself.

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But he who comes hurrying to you,

item.title: bil-Quran: Abasa:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: while he fears [Allah],

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dhuhaa:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the morning brightness,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dhuhaa:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and as for the beggar, do not chide him;

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dhuhaa:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and as for your Lord's blessing, proclaim it!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dhuhaa:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the night when it is calm!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dhuhaa:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your Lord has neither forsaken you nor is He displeased with you,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dhuhaa:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the Hereafter shall be better for you than the world.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dhuhaa:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Soon your Lord will give you [that with which] you will be pleased.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dhuhaa:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did He not find you an orphan, and shelter you?

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dhuhaa:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did He not find you astray, and guide you?

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dhuhaa:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did He not find you needy, and enrich you?

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dhuhaa:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So, as for the orphan, do not oppress him;

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ḥā, Mīm.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So watch out for the day when the sky brings on a manifest smoke,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: enveloping the people. [They will cry out:] 'This is a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Our Lord! Remove from us this punishment. Indeed we have believed!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What will the admonition avail them, when a manifest apostle had already come to them,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: but they turned away from him, and said, 'A tutored madman?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We will withdraw the punishment a little; but you will indeed revert [to your earlier ways].

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day We shall strike with the most terrible striking, We will indeed take vengeance [on them].

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We tried the people of Pharaoh before them, when a noble apostle came to them,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [saying,] 'Give over the servants of Allah1 to me; indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not defy Allah. Indeed I bring you a manifest authority.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the Manifest Book!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I seek the protection of my Lord and your Lord, lest you should stone me.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if you do not believe me, keep out of my way.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he invoked his Lord, [saying,] 'These are indeed a guilty lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [Allah told him,] 'Set out with My servants by night; for you will indeed be pursued.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And leave the sea calmly; they will indeed be a drowned host.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How many gardens and springs did they leave behind!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Fields and splendid places,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the bounties wherein they rejoiced!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So it was; and We bequeathed them to another people.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So neither the sky wept for them, nor the earth; nor were they granted any respite.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We sent it down on a blessed night, and indeed We have been warning [mankind].

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We delivered the Children of Israel from a humiliating torment,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: from Pharaoh. Indeed he was a tyrant among the profligates.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We chose them knowingly above all the nations.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We gave them some signs in which there was a manifest test.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed these ones say,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'It will be just our first death, and we shall not be resurrected.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Bring our fathers back [to life], should you be truthful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Are they better, or the people of Tubba',1 and those who were before them? We destroyed them; indeed they were guilty.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not create the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them for play.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not create them except with reason; but most of them do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Every definitive matter is resolved in it,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the Day of Judgement is the tryst for them all,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the day when a friend will not avail a friend in any way, nor will they be helped,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except for him on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed He is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the tree of Zaqqūm

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: will be the food of the sinful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Like molten copper it will boil in the bellies,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: boiling like boiling water.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Seize him and drag him to the middle of hell,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then pour over his head the punishment of boiling water.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Taste! Indeed you are the [self-styled] mighty and noble!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: as an ordinance1 from Us. Indeed We have been sending [apostles],

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is indeed what you used to doubt!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the Godwary will be in a secure place,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: amid gardens and springs,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: dressed in fine silk and brocade, sitting face to face.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So shall it be, and We shall wed them to black-eyed houris.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There they will call for every fruit, in safety.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There they will not taste death except the first death, and He will save them from the punishment of hell

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —a grace from your Lord. That is the great success.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have made it simple in your language, so that they may take admonition.
