item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So wait! Indeed they [too] are waiting.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: as a mercy from your Lord —indeed He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing—

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and whatever is between them, should you have conviction.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is no god except Him: He gives life and brings death, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ad-Dukhaan:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather they play around in doubt.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the scattering [winds] that scatter [the clouds];

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Perish the liars,

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who are heedless in a stupor!

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They ask, 'When will be the Day of Retribution?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is the day when they will be tormented in the Fire,

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [and will be told]: 'Taste your torment. This is what you used to hasten.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and springs,

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: receiving what their Lord has given them, for they had been virtuous aforetime.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They used to sleep a little during the night,

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and at dawns they would plead for forgiveness,

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and there was a share in their wealth for the beggar and the deprived.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the [rain] bearing [clouds] laden [with water];

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: In the earth are signs for those who have conviction,

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and in your souls [as well]. Will you not then perceive?

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And in the sky is your provision and what you are promised.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the Lord of the sky and the earth, it is indeed the truth, just as [it is a fact that] you speak.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did you receive the story of Abraham's honoured guests?

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they entered into his presence, they said, 'Peace!' 'Peace!' He answered, '[You are] an unfamiliar folk.'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he retired to his family and brought a fat [roasted] calf,

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and put it near them. He said, 'Will you not eat?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he felt a fear of them. They said, 'Do not be afraid!' and they gave him the good news of a wise son.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then his wife came forward crying [with joy]. She beat her face, and said, 'A barren old woman!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by [the ships] which move gently [on the sea];

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'So has your Lord said. Indeed He is the All-wise, the All-knowing.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'O messengers, what is now your errand?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'We have been sent toward a guilty people,

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that We may rain upon them stones of clay,

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: marked with your Lord for the profligate.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We picked out those who were in it of the faithful,

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: but We did not find there other than one house of muslims,

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and We have left therein a sign for those who fear a painful punishment.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And in Moses [too there is a sign] when We sent him to Pharaoh with a manifest authority.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But he turned away assured of his might, and said, 'A magician or a crazy man!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by [the angels] who dispense [livelihood] by [His] command:

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We seized him and his hosts, and cast them into the sea, while he was blameworthy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And in 'Ād when We unleashed upon them a barren wind.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It left nothing that it came upon without making it like decayed bones.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And in Thamūd, when they were told, 'Enjoy for a while.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then they defied the command of their Lord; so the thunderbolt seized them as they looked on.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So they were neither able to rise up, nor to come to one another's aid.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And the people of Noah aforetime. Indeed they were a transgressing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have built the sky with might, and indeed it is We who are its expanders.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And the earth We have spread it out, so how excellent spreaders We have been!

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: In all things We have created pairs so that you may take admonition.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: indeed what you are promised is true,

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [Say,] 'So flee toward Allah. Indeed I am a manifest warner to you from Him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not set up another god besides Allah. Indeed I am a manifest warner to you from Him.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So it was that there did not come to those who were before them any apostle but they said, 'A magician,' or 'A crazy man!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did they enjoin this upon one another?! Rather they were a rebellious lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So turn away from them, for you will not be blameworthy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And admonish, for admonition indeed benefits the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I did not create the jinn and the humans except that they may worship Me.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I desire no provision from them, nor do I desire that they should feed Me.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it is Allah who is the All-provider, Powerful, All-strong.

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the lot of those who do wrong [now] will be like the lot of their [earlier] counterparts. So let them not ask Me to hasten on [that fate].

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and indeed the retribution1 will surely come to pass!

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Woe to the faithless for the day they are promised!

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the sky full of adornment [with stars],1

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: indeed you are of different opinions!

item.title: bil-Quran: Adh-Dhaariyat:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He is turned away from it1 who has been turned away [from the truth].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Aadiyaat:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the snorting chargers,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Aadiyaat:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and what is in the breasts is divulged,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Aadiyaat:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: indeed their Lord will be best aware of them on that day?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Aadiyaat:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the strikers of sparks [with their hoofs],

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Aadiyaat:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the raiders at dawn,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Aadiyaat:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: raising therein a trail of dust,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Aadiyaat:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and cleaving therein a host!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Aadiyaat:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed man is ungrateful to his Lord,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Aadiyaat:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and indeed he is [himself] witness to that!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Aadiyaat:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He is indeed avid in the love of wealth.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Aadiyaat:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Does he not know, when what is in the graves is turned over,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ḥā, Mīm.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Tell me, if it is from Allah and you disbelieve in it, and a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to its like and believed [in it], while you are disdainful [of it]?'1 Indeed Allah does not guide the wrongdoing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithless say about the faithful, 'Had it been [anything] good, they would not have taken the lead over us toward [accepting] it.' And since they could not find the way to it, they will say, 'It is an ancient lie.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yet before it the Book of Moses was a guide and a mercy, and this is a Book which confirms it, in the Arabic language, to warn those who do wrong, and is a [bearer of] good news for the virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who say, 'Our Lord is Allah,' and then remain steadfast, they will have no fear, nor will they grieve.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They shall be the inhabitants of paradise, remaining in it [forever] —a reward for what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have enjoined man to be kind to his parents. His mother has carried him in travail, and bore him in travail, and his gestation and weaning take thirty months. When he comes of age and reaches forty years, he says, 'My Lord! Inspire me to give thanks for Your blessing with which You have blessed me and my parents, and that I may do righteous deeds which may please You, and invest my descendants with righteousness. Indeed I have turned to you in penitence, and I am one of the muslims.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Such are the ones from whom We accept the best of what they do, and overlook their misdeeds, [who will be] among the inhabitants of paradise —a true promise which they had been given.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for him who says to his parents, 'Fie on you! Do you promise me that I shall be raised [from the dead] when generations have passed away before me?' And they invoke Allah's help [and say]: 'Woe to you! Believe! Indeed Allah's promise is true.' But he says, 'These are nothing but myths of the ancients.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Such are the ones against whom the word became due concerning the nations that have passed away before them of jinn and humans. They were indeed the losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For each [person] there will be degrees [of merit] pertaining to what he has done, that He may recompense them fully for their works, and they will not be wronged.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The [gradual] sending down of the Book is from Allah, the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day when the faithless are exposed to the Fire, [they will be told,] 'You have exhausted your good things in the life of the world and enjoyed them. So today you will be requited with a humiliating punishment for your acting arrogantly in the earth unduly, and because you used to transgress.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And mention [Hūd] the brother of 'Ād, when he warned his people at Aḥqāf —and warners have passed away before and after him— saying, 'Do not worship anyone but Allah. Indeed I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous day.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Have you come to turn us away from our gods? Then bring us what you threaten us with, should you be truthful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'The knowledge is with Allah alone. I communicate to you what I have been sent with. But I see that you are a senseless lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they saw it as a cloud advancing toward their valleys, they said, 'This cloud brings us rain.' 'Rather it is what you sought to hasten: a hurricane carrying a painful punishment,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: destroying everything by its Lord's command.' So they became such that nothing could be seen except their dwellings. Thus do We requite the guilty lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We had granted them power in respects that We have not granted you, and We had vested them with hearing and sight and hearts. But neither their hearing availed them nor did their sight, nor their hearts, in any way when they used to impugn the signs of Allah. So they were besieged by what they used to deride.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We destroyed towns that were around you, and We have paraphrased the signs so that they may come back.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So why did not those [false gods] help them whom they had taken, besides Allah, as gods, as means of nearness [to Him]? Rather they forsook them; and that was their lie and what they used to fabricate.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When We dispatched toward you a team of jinn listening to the Qur'ān, when they were in its presence, they said, 'Be silent!' When it was finished, they went back to their people as warners.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not create the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them except with reason and for a specified term. Yet the faithless are disregardful of what they are warned.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'O our people! Indeed we have heard a Book which has been sent down after Moses, confirming what was before it. It guides to the truth and to a straight path.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O our people! Respond to Allah's summoner and have faith in Him. He will forgive you some of your sins and shelter you from a painful punishment.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who do not respond to Allah's summoner cannot thwart [Allah] on the earth, and they will not find any protectors besides Him. They are in manifest error.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and the earth and [who] was not exhausted by their creation, is able to revive the dead? Yes, indeed He has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day when the faithless are exposed to the Fire, [He will say,] 'Is this not a fact?' They will say, 'Yes, by our Lord!' He will say, 'So taste the punishment because of what you used to disbelieve.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So be patient just as the resolute among the apostles were patient, and do not seek to hasten [the punishment] for them. The day when they see what they are promised, [it will be] as though they had remained only an hour of a day. This is a proclamation. So shall anyone be destroyed except the transgressing lot?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Tell me about what you invoke besides Allah. Show me what [part] of the earth have they created. Do they have any share in the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this, or some vestige of [divine] knowledge, should you be truthful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Who is more astray than him who invokes besides Allah such as would not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection, and who are oblivious of their invocation?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When mankind are mustered [on Judgement's Day] they will be their enemies, and they will disavow their worship.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Our manifest signs are recited to them, the faithless say of the truth when it comes to them: 'This is plain magic.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they say, 'He has fabricated it?' Say, 'Should I have fabricated it, you would not avail me anything against Allah. He best knows what you gossip concerning it. He suffices as a witness between me and you, and He is the All-forgiving, the All-merciful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahqaf:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I am not a novelty among the apostles, nor do I know what will be done with me, or with you. I just follow whatever is revealed to me, and I am just a manifest warner.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Prophet! Be wary of Allah and do not obey the faithless and the hypocrites. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they came at you from above and below you,1 and when the eyes rolled [with fear] and the hearts leapt to the throats, and you entertained misgivings about Allah,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: it was there that the faithful were tested and jolted with a severe agitation.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when the hypocrites were saying, as well as those in whose hearts is a sickness, 'Allah and His Apostle did not promise us [anything] except delusion.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when a group of them said, 'O people of Yathrib! [This is] not a place for you,1 so go back!'2 And a group of them sought the Prophet's permission, saying, 'Our homes lie exposed3 [to the enemy],' although they were not exposed. They only sought to flee.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had they been invaded from its flanks1 and had they been asked to apostatize, they would have done so with only a mild hesitation,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: though they had certainly pledged to Allah before that they would not turn their backs [to flee], and pledges given to Allah are accountable.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Flight will not avail you should you flee from death or from being killed, and then you will be let to enjoy only for a little while.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Who is it that can protect you from Allah should He desire to cause you ill, or desire to grant you mercy?' They will not find for themselves any protector or helper besides Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah knows those of you who discourage others, and those who say to their brethren, 'Come to us!' and they take little part in the battle,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: grudging you [their help]. So when there is panic, you see them observing you, their eyes rolling, like someone fainting at death. Then, when the panic is over, they scald you with [their] sharp tongues in their greed for riches. They never have had faith. So Allah has made their works fail, and that is easy for Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Indeed Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They suppose the confederates have not left yet, and were the confederates to come [again], they would wish they were in the desert with the Bedouins asking about your news, and if they were with you they would fight but a little.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: In the Apostle of Allah there is certainly for you a good exemplar, for those who look forward to Allah and the Last Day, and remember Allah greatly.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But when the faithful saw the confederates, they said, 'This is what Allah and His Apostle had promised us, and Allah and His Apostle were true.' And it only increased them in faith and submission.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among the faithful are men who fulfill what they have pledged to Allah. Of them are some who have fulfilled their pledge, and of them are some who still wait, and they have not changed in the least,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that Allah may reward the true for their truthfulness, and punish the hypocrites, if He wishes, or accept their repentance. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah sent back the faithless in their rage, without their attaining any advantage, and Allah spared the faithful of fighting, and Allah is all-strong, all-mighty.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And He dragged down those who had backed them from among the People of the Book from their strongholds, and He cast terror into their hearts, [so that] you killed a part of them, and took captive [another] part of them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And He bequeathed you their land, their houses and their possessions, and a territory you had not trodden, and Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Prophet! Say to your wives, 'If you desire the life of the world and its glitter, come, I will provide for you and release you in a graceful manner.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if you desire Allah and His Apostle and the abode of the Hereafter, then Allah has indeed prepared for the virtuous among you a great reward.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And put your trust in Allah; Allah suffices as trustee.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O wives of the Prophet! Whoever of you commits a gross indecency, her punishment shall be doubled, and that is easy for Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But whoever of you is obedient to Allah and His Apostle and acts righteously, We shall give her a twofold reward, and We hold a noble provision in store for her.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O wives of the Prophet! You are not like any other women: if you are wary [of Allah], then do not be complaisant in your speech, lest he in whose heart is a sickness should aspire, and speak honourable words.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Stay in your houses and do not display your finery with the display of the former [days of] ignorance. Maintain the prayer and pay the zakāt and obey Allah and His Apostle. Indeed Allah desires to repel all impurity from you, O People of the Household, and purify you with a thorough purification.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And remember what is recited in your homes of the signs of Allah and wisdom. Indeed Allah is all-attentive, all-aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the muslim men and the muslim women, the faithful men and the faithful women, the obedient men and the obedient women, the truthful men and the truthful women, the patient men and the patient women, the humble1 men and the humble women, the charitable men and the charitable women, the men who fast and the women who fast, the men who guard their private parts and the women who guard, the men who remember Allah greatly and the women who remember [Allah greatly] —Allah holds in store for them forgiveness and a great reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A faithful man or woman may not, when Allah and His Apostle have decided on a matter, have any option in their matter, and whoever disobeys Allah and His Apostle has certainly strayed into manifest error.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you said to him whom Allah had blessed, and whom you [too] had blessed, 'Retain your wife for yourself, and be wary of Allah,' and you had hidden in your heart what Allah was to divulge, and you feared the people though Allah is worthier that you should fear Him, so when Zayd had got through with her, We wedded her to you, so that there may be no blame on the faithful in respect of the wives of their adopted sons, when the latter have got through with them, and Allah's command is bound to be fulfilled.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is no blame on the Prophet in respect of that which Allah has made lawful for him:1 Allah's precedent with those who passed away earlier —and Allah's commands are ordained by a precise ordaining—

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: such as deliver the messages of Allah and fear Him, and fear no one except Allah, and Allah suffices as reckoner.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has not put two hearts within any man, nor has He made your wives whom you repudiate by ẓihār1 your mothers, nor has he made your adopted sons your sons. These are mere utterances of your mouths. But Allah speaks the truth and He guides to the way.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Muḥammad is not the father of any man among you, but he is the Apostle of Allah and the Seal of the Prophets, and Allah has knowledge of all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Remember Allah with frequent remembrance,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and glorify Him morning and evening.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who blesses you, and so do His angels, that He may bring you out from darkness into light, and He is most merciful to the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day they encounter Him, their greeting will be, 'Peace,' and He holds in store for them a noble reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Prophet! Indeed We have sent you as a witness, as a bearer of good news and as a warner

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and as a summoner to Allah by His permission, and as a radiant lamp.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Announce to the faithful the good news that there will be for them a great grace from Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And do not obey the faithless and the hypocrites, and disregard their torments, and put your trust in Allah, and Allah suffices as trustee.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! When you marry faithful women and then divorce them before you touch them, there shall be no period for you to reckon. But provide for them and release them in a graceful manner.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Call them after their fathers. That is more just with Allah. And if you do not know their fathers, then they are your brethren in the faith and your kinsmen. There will be no sin upon you for any mistake that you may make therein, barring what your hearts may premeditate. And Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Prophet! Indeed We have made lawful to you your wives whom you have given their dowries, and those whom your right hand owns,1 of those whom Allah gave you as spoils of war, and the daughters of your paternal uncle, and the daughters of your paternal aunts, and the daughters of your maternal uncle, and the daughters of your maternal aunts who migrated with you, and a faithful woman if she offers herself to the Prophet and the Prophet desires to take her in marriage, (a privilege exclusively for you, not for [the rest of] the faithful; We know what We have made lawful for them with respect to their wives and those whom their right hands own so that there may be no blame on you,) and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You may put off whichever of them you wish and consort with whichever of them you wish, and as for any whom you may seek [to consort with] from among those you have set aside [earlier], there is no sin upon you [in receiving her again]. That makes it likelier that they will be comforted and not feel unhappy, all of them being pleased with what you give them. Allah knows what is in your hearts, and Allah is all-knowing, all-forbearing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Beyond that, women are not lawful for you, nor that you should change them for other wives even though their beauty should impress you, except those whom your right hand owns. And Allah is watchful over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not enter the Prophet's houses unless permission is granted you for a meal, without waiting for it to be readied. But enter when you are invited, and disperse when you have taken your meal, without settling down to chat. Indeed such conduct torments the Prophet, and he is ashamed of [asking] you [to leave]; but Allah is not ashamed of [expressing] the truth. And when you ask anything of [his] womenfolk, ask it from them from behind a curtain. That is more chaste for your hearts and their hearts. You may not torment the Apostle of Allah, nor may you ever marry his wives after him. Indeed that would be a grave [matter] with Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whether you disclose anything or hide it, Allah indeed knows all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is no sin on them1 [in socializing freely] with their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or their brothers' sons, or the sons of their sisters, or their own womenfolk,2 or what their right hands own.3 Be wary of Allah. Indeed Allah is witness to all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah and His angels bless the Prophet; O you who have faith! Invoke blessings on him and invoke Peace upon him in a worthy manner.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who torment Allah and His Apostle are cursed by Allah in the world and the Hereafter, and He has prepared a humiliating punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who torment faithful men and women undeservedly, certainly bear the guilt of slander and flagrant sin.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Prophet! Tell your wives and your daughters and the women of the faithful to draw closely over themselves their chadors [when going out]. That makes it likely for them to be recognized and not be troubled, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Prophet is closer to the faithful than their own souls,1 and his wives are their mothers. The blood relatives are more entitled to inherit from one another in the Book of Allah2 than the [other] faithful and Emigrants,3 barring any favour you may do your comrades.4 This has been written in the Book.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If the hypocrites do not relinquish and [also] those in whose hearts is a sickness, and the rumourmongers in the city [do not give up], We will surely urge you [to take action] against them, then they will not be your neighbours in it except for a little [while].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Accursed, they will be seized wherever they are confronted and slain violently:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah's precedent with those who passed away before, and you will never find any change in Allah's precedent.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The people question you concerning the Hour. Say, 'Its knowledge is only with Allah.' What do you know, maybe the Hour is near.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah has cursed the faithless and prepared for them a blaze,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: in which they will remain forever. They will not find any guardian or helper.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day when their faces are turned about in the Fire, they will say, 'We wish we had obeyed Allah and obeyed the Apostle!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they will say, 'Our Lord! We obeyed our leaders and elders, and they led us astray from the way.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Our Lord! Give them a double punishment and curse them with a mighty curse.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not be like those who tormented Moses, whereat Allah absolved him of what they alleged, and he was distinguished in Allah's sight.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [Recall] when We took a pledge from the prophets, and from you and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus son of Mary, and We took from them a solemn pledge,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Be wary of Allah, and speak upright words.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He shall rectify your conduct for you and He shall forgive you your sins. Whoever obeys Allah and His Apostle has certainly achieved a great success.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We presented the Trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, but they refused to bear it, and were apprehensive of it; but man undertook it. Indeed he is most unfair and senseless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah will surely punish the hypocrites, men and women, and the polytheists, men and women, and Allah will turn clemently to the faithful, men and women, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so that He may question the truthful concerning their truthfulness. And He has prepared for the faithless a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ahzaab:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Remember Allah's blessing upon you when the hosts came at you, and We sent against them a gale and hosts whom you did not see. And Allah sees best what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Celebrate the Name of your Lord, the Most Exalted,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: he who fears will take admonition,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the most wretched will shun it

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —he who will enter the Great Fire,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then neither live in it, nor die.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Felicitous is he who purifies himself,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: celebrates the Name of his Lord, and prays.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather you prefer the life of this world,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: while the Hereafter is better and more lasting.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is indeed in the former scriptures,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who created and proportioned,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who determined and guided,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who brought forth the pasture,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then turned it into a black scum.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We shall have you recite [the Qur'ān], then you will not forget [any of it]

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except what Allah may wish. Indeed He knows the overt and what is hidden.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We shall smooth your way to [preach] the easiest [canon].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-A'laa:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So admonish, for admonition is indeed beneficial:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Read in the Name of your Lord who created;

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: a servant when he prays,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: tell me, should he be on [true] guidance,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: or bid [others] to Godwariness,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: tell me, should he call him a liar and turn away

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —does he not know that Allah sees?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! If he does not stop, We shall seize him by the forelock,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: a lying, sinful forelock!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then let him call out his gang!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We [too] shall call the keepers of hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! Do not obey him, but prostrate and draw near [to Allah]!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: created man from a clinging mass.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Read, and your Lord is the most generous,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who taught by the pen,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: taught man what he did not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed man becomes rebellious

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when he considers himself without need.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed to your Lord is the return.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Alaq:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Tell me, he who forbids

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: All praise belongs to Allah who created the heavens and the earth and made the darknesses and the light. Yet the faithless equate [others] with their Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Apostles were certainly derided before you. Then those who ridiculed them were besieged by what they used to deride.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:100 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They make the jinn partners of Allah, though He has created them, and carve out sons and daughters for Him, without any knowledge. Immaculate is He and exalted above what they allege [concerning Him]!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:101 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The originator of the heavens and the earth —how could He have a son when He has had no spouse? He created all things and He has knowledge of all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:102 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is Allah, your Lord, there is no god except Him, the creator of all things; so worship Him. He watches over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:103 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The sights do not apprehend Him, yet He apprehends the sights, and He is the All-attentive,1 the All-aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:104 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [Say,] 'Certainly insights have come to you from your Lord. So whoever sees, it is to the benefit of his own soul, and whoever remains blind, it is to its detriment, and I am not a keeper over you.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:105 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus do We paraphrase the signs variously, lest they should say, 'You have received instruction,' and so that We may make it clear for a people who have knowledge.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:106 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Follow that which has been revealed to you from your Lord, there is no god except Him, and turn away from the polytheists.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:107 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had Allah wished they would not have ascribed partners [to Him]. We have not made you a caretaker for them, nor is it your duty to watch over them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:108 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not abuse those whom they invoke besides Allah, lest they should abuse Allah out of hostility,1 without any knowledge. That is how to every people We have made their conduct seem decorous. Then their return will be to their Lord and He will inform them concerning what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:109 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They swear by Allah with solemn oaths that were a sign to come to them they would surely believe in it. Say, 'The signs are only with Allah,' and what will bring home to you1 that they will not believe even if they came?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Travel over the land, and then observe how was the fate of the deniers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:110 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We transform their hearts and their visions as they did not believe in it the first time, and We leave them bewildered in their rebellion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:111 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Even if We had sent down angels to them, and the dead had spoken to them, and We had gathered before them all things manifestly,1 they would [still] not believe unless Allah wished. But most of them are ignorant.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:112 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is how for every prophet We appointed as enemy the devils from among humans and jinn, who inspire each other with flashy words, deceptively. Had your Lord wished, they would not have done it. So leave them with what they fabricate,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:113 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so that toward it may incline the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter, and so that they may be pleased with it and commit what they commit.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:114 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [Say,] 'Shall I seek a judge other than Allah, while it is He who has sent down to you the Book, well-elaborated?' Those whom We have given the Book know that it has been sent down from your Lord with the truth; so do not be one of the skeptics.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:115 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The word of your Lord has been fulfilled in truth and justice. Nothing can change His words, and He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:116 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you obey most of those on the earth, they will lead you astray from the way of Allah. They follow nothing but conjectures and they do nothing but surmise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:117 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed your Lord knows best those who stray from His way; and He knows best those who are guided.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:118 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Eat from that over which Allah's Name has been mentioned, if you are believers in His signs.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:119 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Why should you not eat that over which Allah's Name has been mentioned, while He has already elaborated for you whatever He has forbidden you, excepting what you may be compelled to [eat]? Indeed many mislead [others] by their fancies, without any knowledge. Indeed your Lord knows best the transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'To whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth?' Say, 'To Allah. He has made mercy incumbent upon Himself. He will surely gather you on the Day of Resurrection, in which there is no doubt. Those who have ruined their souls1 will not have faith.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:120 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Renounce outward sins and the inward ones. Indeed those who commit sins shall be requited for what they used to commit.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:121 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not eat [anything] of that over which Allah's Name has not been mentioned, and that is indeed transgression. Indeed the satans inspire their friends to dispute with you; and if you obey them, you will indeed be polytheists.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:122 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is he who was lifeless, then We gave him life and provided him with a light by which he walks among the people, like one who dwells in a manifold darkness which he cannot leave? To the faithless is thus presented as decorous what they have been doing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:123 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus have We installed in every town its major criminals that they may plot therein. Yet they do not plot except against their own souls, but they are not aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:124 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when a sign comes to them, they say, 'We will not believe until we are given the like of what was given to Allah's apostles.' Allah knows best where to place His apostleship! Soon the guilty will be visited by a degradation before Allah and a severe punishment because of the plots they used to devise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:125 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whomever Allah desires to guide, He opens his breast to Islam, and whomever He desires to lead astray, He makes his breast narrow and straitened as if he were climbing to a height.1 Thus does Allah lay [spiritual] defilement on those who do not have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:126 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is the straight path of your Lord. We have already elaborated the signs for a people who take admonition.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:127 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For them shall be the abode of peace near their Lord and He will be their guardian because of what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:128 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On the day He will gather them all together, [He will say], 'O company of jinn! You claimed many of the humans.' Their friends from among the humans will say, 'Our Lord, we used each other, and we completed our term which You had appointed for us.' He will say, 'The Fire is your abode, to remain in it [forever], except what Allah may wish.' Indeed your Lord is all-wise, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:129 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is how We make the wrongdoers one another's friends because of what they used to earn.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Him belongs whatever abides in the night and the day, and He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:130 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'O company of jinn and humans! Did there not come to you apostles from yourselves, recounting to you My signs and warning you of the encounter of this Day?' They will say, 'We testify against ourselves.' The life of this world had deceived them, and they will testify against themselves that they had been faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:131 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is because your Lord would never destroy the towns unjustly while their people were unaware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:132 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For everyone there are ranks in accordance with what they have done; and your Lord is not oblivious of what they do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:133 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your Lord is the All-sufficient dispenser of mercy. If He wishes, He will take you away, and make whomever He wishes succeed you, just as He produced you from the descendants of another people.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:134 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed what you are promised will surely come, and you will not be able to thwart it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:135 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'O my people, Act according to your ability; I too am acting. Soon you will know in whose favour the outcome of that abode will be. Indeed the wrongdoers will not be felicitous.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:136 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They dedicate to Allah out of what He has created of the crops and cattle a portion, and say, 'This is for Allah,' so do they maintain, 'and this is for our partners.' But what is for their partners does not reach Allah, and what is for Allah reaches their partners. Evil is the judgement that they make.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:137 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is how to most of the polytheists is presented as decorous the slaying of their children by those whom they ascribe as partners [to Allah], that they may ruin them and confound their religion for them. Had Allah wished, they would not have done it. So leave them with what they fabricate.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:138 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they say, 'These cattle and tillage are a taboo: none may eat them except whom we please,' so they maintain, and there are cattle whose backs are forbidden and cattle over which they do not mention Allah's Name, fabricating a lie against Him. Soon He will requite them for what they used to fabricate.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:139 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they say, 'That which is in the bellies of these cattle is exclusively for our males and forbidden to our wives. But if it be still-born, they will all share it.' Soon He will requite them for their allegations. Indeed He is all-wise, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Shall I take for guardian [anyone] other than Allah, the originator of the heavens and the earth, who feeds and is not fed?' Say, 'I have been commanded to be the first of those who submit [to Allah],' and never be one of the polytheists.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:140 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are certainly losers who slay their children foolishly without knowledge, and forbid what Allah has provided them, fabricating a lie against Allah. Certainly, they have gone astray and are not guided.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:141 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who produces gardens trellised and without trellises, and palm-trees and crops of diverse produce, olives and pomegranates, similar and dissimilar. Eat of its fruits when it fructifies, and give its due on the day of harvest, and do not be wasteful; indeed He does not like the wasteful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:142 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Of the cattle [some] are for burden and [some] for slaughter. Eat of what Allah has provided you and do not follow in Satan's footsteps; he is indeed your manifest enemy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:143 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Eight mates:1 two of sheep, and two of goats. Say, 'Is it the two males that He has forbidden or the two females, or what is contained in the wombs of the two females? Inform me with knowledge, should you be truthful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:144 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And two of camels and two of oxen. Say, 'Is it the two males that He has forbidden or the two females, or what is contained in the wombs of the two females? Were you witnesses when Allah enjoined this upon you?' So who is a greater wrongdoer than him who fabricates a lie against Allah to mislead the people without any knowledge? Indeed Allah does not guide the wrongdoing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:145 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I do not find in what has been revealed to me that anyone be forbidden to eat anything except carrion or spilt blood, or the flesh of swine —for that is indeed unclean— or an impiety offered to other than Allah.' But should someone be compelled, without being rebellious or aggressive, indeed your Lord is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:146 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To the Jews We forbade every animal having an undivided hoof, and of oxen and sheep We forbade them their fat, except what is borne by their backs or the entrails or what is attached to the bones. We requited them with that for their rebelliousness, and We indeed speak the truth.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:147 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they deny you, say, 'Your Lord is dispenser of an all-embracing mercy, but His punishment will not be averted from the guilty lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:148 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The polytheists will say, 'Had Allah wished we would not have ascribed any partner [to Him], nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden anything.' Those who were before them had denied1 likewise until they tasted Our punishment. Say, 'Do you have any [revealed] knowledge that you can produce before us? You follow nothing but conjectures, and you do nothing but surmise.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:149 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'To Allah belongs the conclusive argument. Had He wished, He would have surely guided you all.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Indeed, should I disobey my Lord, I fear the punishment of a tremendous day.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:150 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Bring your witnesses who may testify that Allah has forbidden this.' So if they testify, do not testify with them, and do not follow the desires of those who deny Our signs, and those who do not believe in the Hereafter and equate [others] with their Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:151 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Come, I will recount what your Lord has forbidden you from. That you shall not ascribe any partners to Him, and you shall be good to the parents, you shall not kill your children due to penury —We will provide for you and for them— you shall not approach indecencies, the outward among them and the inward ones, and you shall not kill a soul [whose life] Allah has made inviolable, except with due cause. This is what He has enjoined upon you so that you may apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:152 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not approach the orphan's property, except in the best [possible] manner, until he comes of age. And observe fully the measure and the balance1 with justice.' We task no soul except according to its capacity. 'And when you speak, be fair, even if it were a relative; and fulfill Allah's covenant. This is what He enjoins upon you so that you may take admonition.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:153 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'This indeed is my straight path, so follow it, and do not follow [other] ways, for they will separate you from His way. This is what He enjoins upon you so that you may be Godwary.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:154 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We gave Moses the Book, completing [Our blessing] on him who is virtuous, and as an elaboration1 of all things, and as a guidance and mercy, so that they may believe in the encounter with their Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:155 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And this Book that We have sent down is a blessed one; so follow it, and be Godwary so that you may receive [His] mercy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:156 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Lest you should say, 'The Book was sent down only to two communities before us,1 and we were indeed unaware of their studies,'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:157 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: or [lest] you should say, 'If the Book had been sent down to us, surely we would have been better-guided than them.' There has already come to you a manifest proof from your Lord and a guidance and mercy. So who is a greater wrongdoer than him who denies the signs of Allah, and turns away from them? Soon We shall requite those who turn away from Our signs with a terrible punishment because of what they used to evade.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:158 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they await anything but that the angels should come to them, or your Lord should come, or some of your Lord's signs should come? The day when some of your Lord's signs do come, faith shall not benefit any soul that had not believed beforehand and had not earned some goodness in its faith. Say, 'Wait! We too are waiting!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:159 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who split up their religion and became sects, you will not have anything to do with them. Their matter rests only with Allah; then He will inform them concerning what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever is spared of it on that day, He has certainly been merciful to him, and that is the manifest success.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:160 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever brings virtue shall receive ten times its like; but whoever brings vice shall not be requited except with its like, and they will not be wronged.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:161 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Indeed my Lord has guided me to a straight path, the upright religion, the creed of Abraham, a ḥanīf, and he was not one of the polytheists.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:162 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Indeed my prayer and my worship, my life and my death are for the sake of Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:163 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He has no partner, and this [creed] I have been commanded [to follow], and I am the first of those who submit [to Allah].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:164 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Shall I seek a Lord other than Allah, while He is the Lord of all things?' No soul does evil except against itself, and no bearer shall bear another's burden; then to your Lord will be your return, whereat He will inform you concerning that about which you used to differ.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:165 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who has made you successors on the earth, and raised some of you in rank above others so that He may test you in respect to what He has given you. Indeed your Lord is swift in retribution, and indeed He is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Should Allah visit you with some distress there is no one to remove it except Him; and should He bring you some good, then He has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And He is the All-dominant over His servants, and He is the All-wise, the All-aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'What thing is greatest as witness?' Say, 'Allah! [He is] witness between me and you, and this Qur'ān has been revealed to me that I may warn thereby you and whomever it may reach.' 'Do you indeed bear witness that there are other gods besides Allah?' Say, 'I do not bear witness [to any such thing].' Say, 'Indeed He is the One God, and I indeed disown what you associate [with Him].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who created you from clay, then ordained the term [of your life] —the specified term is with Him— and yet you are in doubt.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those whom We have given the Book recognize him just as they recognize their sons.1 Those who have ruined their souls will not have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Who is a greater wrongdoer than him who fabricates a lie against Allah, or denies His signs? Indeed the wrongdoers will not be felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On the day when We gather them all together, We shall say to those who ascribed partners [to Allah] 'Where are your partners that you used to claim?'
