item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then their only excuse will be to say, 'By Allah, our Lord, we were not polytheists.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Look, how they forswear themselves, and what they used to fabricate has forsaken them!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There are some of them who prick up their ears at you, but We have cast veils on their hearts lest they should understand it, and a deafness into their ears; and though they should see every sign, they will not believe in it. When they come to you, to dispute with you, the faithless say, 'These are nothing but myths of the ancients.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They dissuade [others] from [following] him, and [themselves] avoid him; yet they destroy no one except themselves, but they are not aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were you to see when they are brought to a halt by the Fire, whereupon they will say, 'If only we were sent back [into the world]! Then we will not deny the signs of our Lord, and we will be among the faithful!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather, now has become evident to them what they used to hide before. But were they to be sent back they would revert to what they were forbidden, and they are indeed liars.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'There is nothing but our life of this world, and we shall not be resurrected.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He is Allah in the heavens and on the earth: He knows your secret and your overt [matters], and He knows what you earn.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were you to see when they are stationed before their Lord. He will say, 'Is this not a fact?' They will say, 'Yes, by our Lord!' He will say, 'So taste the punishment because of what you used to disbelieve.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are certainly losers who deny the encounter with Allah. When the Hour overtakes them suddenly, they will say, 'Alas for us, for what we neglected in it!' And they will bear their burdens on their backs. Look! Evil is what they bear!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The life of the world is nothing but play and diversion, and the abode of the Hereafter is surely better for those who are Godwary. Do you not apply reason?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We certainly know that what they say grieves you. Yet it is not you that they deny, but it is Allah's signs that the wrongdoers impugn.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Apostles were certainly denied before you, yet they patiently bore being denied and tormented until Our help came to them. Nothing can change the words of Allah, and there have certainly come to you some of the accounts of the apostles.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And should their aversion be hard on you, find, if you can, a tunnel into the ground, or a ladder into sky, that you may bring them a sign. Had Allah wished, He would have brought them together on guidance. So do not be one of the ignorant.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Only those who listen will respond [to you]. As for the dead, Allah will resurrect them, then they will be brought back to Him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'Why has not a sign been sent down to him from his Lord?' Say, 'Allah is indeed able to send down a sign,' but most of them do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is no animal on land, nor a bird that flies with its wings, but they are communities like yourselves. We have not omitted anything from the Book. Then they will be mustered toward their Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who deny Our signs are deaf and dumb, in a manifold darkness. Allah leads astray whomever He wishes, and whomever He wishes He puts him on a straight path.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There did not come to them any sign from among the signs of their Lord, but that they used to disregard it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Tell me, should Allah's punishment overtake you, or should the Hour overtake you, will you supplicate anyone other than Allah, should you be truthful?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather, Him you will supplicate, and He will remove that for which you supplicated Him, if He wishes, and you will forget what you ascribe [to Him] as [His] partners.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have certainly sent [apostles] to nations before you, then We seized them with stress and distress so that they might entreat [Us].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Why did they not entreat when Our punishment overtook them! But their hearts had hardened, and Satan had made to seem decorous to them what they had been doing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when they forgot what they had been admonished of, We opened for them the gates of all [good] things. When they rejoiced in what they were given, We seized them suddenly, whereat, behold, they were despondent.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus the wrongdoing lot were rooted out, and all praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Tell me, should Allah take away your hearing and your sight and set a seal on your hearts, which god other than Allah can bring it [back] to you?' Look, how We paraphrase the signs variously; nevertheless they turn away.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Tell me, should Allah's punishment overtake you suddenly or visibly, will anyone be destroyed except the wrongdoing lot?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We do not send the apostles except as bearers of good news and warners. As for those who are faithful and righteous, they will have no fear, nor will they grieve.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But as for those who deny Our signs, the punishment shall befall them because of the transgressions they used to commit.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They certainly denied the truth when it came to them, but soon there will come to them the news of what they have been deriding.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I do not say to you that I possess the treasuries of Allah, nor do I know the Unseen, nor do I say to you that I am an angel. I follow only what is revealed to me.' Say, 'Are the blind one and the seer equal? So do you not reflect?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And warn by its1 means those who fear being mustered toward their Lord, besides whom they shall have neither any guardian nor any intercessor, so that they may be Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not drive away those who supplicate their Lord morning and evening desiring His face.1 Neither are you accountable for them in any way, nor are they accountable for you in any way, so that you may drive them away and thus become one of the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus do We test them by means of one another so that they should say, 'Are these the ones whom Allah has favoured from among us?!' Does not Allah know best the grateful?!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When those who have faith in Our signs come to you, say, 'Peace to you! Your Lord has made mercy incumbent upon Himself: whoever of you commits an evil [deed] out of ignorance and then repents after that and reforms, then He is indeed all-forgiving, all-merciful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus do We elaborate1 the signs, so that the way of the guilty may be exposed.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I have been forbidden to worship those whom you invoke besides Allah.' Say, 'I do not follow your desires, for then I will have gone astray, and I will not be among the [rightly] guided.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Indeed I stand on a manifest proof from my Lord and you have denied it. What you seek to hasten is not up to me. Judgement belongs only to Allah; He expounds the truth and He is the best of judges.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'If what you seek to hasten were with me, the matter would surely have been decided between you and me, and Allah knows best the wrongdoers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: With Him are the treasures of the Unseen;1 no one knows them except Him. He knows whatever there is in land and sea. No leaf falls without His knowing it, nor is there a grain in the darkness of the earth, nor anything fresh or withered but it is in a manifest Book.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not regarded how many a generation We have destroyed before them whom We had granted power in the land in respects that We did not grant you, and We sent abundant rains for them from the sky and made streams run for them. Then We destroyed them for their sins, and brought forth another generation after them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who takes your souls by night, and He knows what you do by day, then He reanimates you therein so that a specified term may be completed. Then to Him will be your return, whereat He will inform you concerning what you used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He is the All-dominant over His servants, and He sends guards to [protect] you. When death approaches anyone of you, Our messengers take him away and they do not neglect [their duty].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then they are returned to Allah, their real master. Look! All judgement belongs to Him, and He is the swiftest of reckoners.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Who delivers you from the darkness of land and sea, [when] You invoke Him suppliantly and secretly: "If He delivers us from this, we will surely be among the grateful"?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'It is Allah who delivers you from them and from every agony, [but] then you ascribe partners [to Him].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'He is able to send upon you a punishment from above you or from under your feet, or confound you as [hostile] factions, and make you taste one another's violence.' Look, how We paraphrase the signs variously so that they may understand!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your people have denied it, though it is the truth. Say, 'It is not my business to watch over you.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For every prophecy there is a [preordained] setting, and soon you will know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you see those who gossip impiously about Our signs, avoid them until they engage in some other discourse; but if Satan makes you forget, then, after remembering, do not sit with the wrongdoing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who are Godwary are in no way accountable for them,1 but this is merely for admonition's sake, so that they may beware.2

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had We sent down to you a Book on paper so they could touch it with their [own] hands, [still] the faithless would have said, 'This is nothing but plain magic.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Leave alone those who take their religion for play and diversion and whom the life of this world has deceived, and admonish with it, lest any soul should perish because of what it has earned: It shall not have any guardian besides Allah, nor any intercessor; and though it should offer every kind of ransom, it shall not be accepted from it. They are the ones who perish because of what they have earned; they shall have boiling water for drink and a painful punishment because of what they used to defy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Shall we invoke besides Allah that which can neither benefit us nor harm us, and turn back on our heels after Allah has guided us, like someone seduced by the devils and bewildered on the earth, who has companions that invite him to guidance, [saying,] "Come to us!"?' Say, 'Indeed it is the guidance of Allah which is [true] guidance. and we have been commanded to submit to the Lord of all the worlds,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and that "Maintain the prayer and be wary of Him, and it is He toward whom you will be gathered." '

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who created the heavens and the earth with reason, and the day He says [to something], 'Be!' it is. His word is the truth, and to Him belongs all sovereignty on the day when the Trumpet will be blown. Knower of the sensible and the Unseen, He is the All-wise, the All-aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Abraham said to Azar, his father, 'Do you take idols for gods? Indeed I see you and your people in manifest error.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus did We show Abraham the dominions of the heavens and the earth, that he might be of those who possess certitude.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When night darkened over him, he saw a star and said, 'This is my Lord!' But when it set, he said, 'I do not like those who set.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then, when he saw the moon rising, he said, 'This is my Lord!' But when it set, he said, 'Had my Lord not guided me, I would surely have been among the astray lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then, when he saw the sun rising, he said, 'This is my Lord! This is bigger!' But when it set, he said, 'O my people, indeed I disown what you take as [His] partners.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed I have turned my face toward Him who originated the heavens and the earth, as a ḥanīf, and I am not one of the polytheists.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they say, 'Why has not an angel been sent down to him?' Were We to send down an angel, the matter would surely be decided, and then they would not be granted any respite.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: His people argued with him. He said, 'Do you argue with me concerning Allah, while He has guided me for certain? I do not fear what you ascribe to Him as [His] partners, excepting anything that my Lord may wish. My Lord embraces all things in [His] knowledge. Will you not then take admonition?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How could I fear what you ascribe [to Him] as [His] partners, when you do not fear ascribing to Allah partners for which He has not sent down any authority to you? So [tell me,] which of the two sides has a greater right to safety, if you know?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who have faith and do not taint their faith with wrongdoing —for such there shall be safety, and they are the [rightly] guided.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This was Our argument that We gave to Abraham against his people. We raise in rank whomever We wish. Indeed your Lord is all-wise, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob and guided each of them. And Noah We had guided before, and from his offspring, David and Solomon, Job, Joseph, Moses and Aaron —thus do We reward the virtuous—

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and Zechariah, John, Jesus and Ilyās, —each of them among the righteous—

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and Ishmael, Elisha, Jonah and Lot —each We graced over all the nations—

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and from among their fathers, their descendants and brethren —We chose them and guided them to a straight path.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is Allah's guidance: with it He guides whomever He wishes of His servants. But were they to ascribe any partners [to Allah], what they used to do would not avail them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are the ones whom We gave the Book, the judgement and prophethood. So if these disbelieve in them, We have certainly entrusted them to a people who will never disbelieve in them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And had We made him1 an angel, We would have surely made him a man, and We would have surely confounded them in regard to [the truth] that they confound.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are the ones whom Allah has guided. So follow their guidance. Say, 'I do not ask you any recompense for it. It is just an admonition for all the nations.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They did not regard Allah with the regard due to Him when they said, 'Allah has not sent down anything to any human.' Say, 'Who had sent down the Book that was brought by Moses as a light and guidance for the people, which You make into parchments that you display, while you conceal much of it, and [by means of which] you were taught what you did not know, [neither] you nor your fathers?' Say, 'Allah!' Then leave them to play around in their impious gossip.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Blessed is this Book which We have sent down, confirming what was [revealed] before it, so that you may warn the Mother of Cities1 and those around it. Those who believe in the Hereafter believe in it, and they are watchful of their prayers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Who is a greater wrongdoer than him who fabricates a lie against Allah, or says, 'It has been revealed to me,' while nothing was revealed to him, and he who says, 'I will bring the like of what Allah has sent down?' Were you to see when the wrongdoers are in the throes of death, and the angels extend their hands [saying]: 'Give up your souls! Today you shall be requited with a humiliating punishment because of what you used to attribute to Allah untruly, and for your being disdainful towards His signs.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Certainly you have come to Us alone, just as We created you the first time, and left behind whatever We had bestowed on you. We do not see your intercessors with you —those whom you claimed to be [Our] partners in [deciding] you[r] [fate]. Certainly all links between you have been cut, and what you used to claim has forsaken you!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah is the splitter of the grain and the pit.1 He brings forth the living from the dead and He brings forth the dead from the living. That is Allah! Then where do you stray?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Splitter of the dawn, He has made the night for rest, and the sun and the moon for calculation.1 That is the ordaining of the All-mighty, the All-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who made the stars for you, so that you may be guided by them in the darkness of land and sea. We have certainly elaborated the signs for a people who have knowledge.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who created you from a single soul, then there is the [enduring] abode and the place of temporary lodging.1 We have certainly elaborated the signs for a people who understand.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-An'aam:99 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who sends down water from the sky, and brings forth with it every kind of growing thing. Then from it We bring forth vegetation from which We produce the grain, in clusters, and from the palm-tree, from the spathes of it, low-hanging clusters [of dates], and gardens of grapes, olives and pomegranates, similar and dissimilar. Look at its fruit as it fructifies and ripens. Indeed there are signs in that for a people who have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Mankind's reckoning has drawn near to them, yet they are disregardful in [their] obliviousness.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have sent down to you a Book in which there is an admonition for you. Do you not apply reason?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:100 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Their lot therein will be groaning, and they will not hear anything in it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:101 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those to whom there has gone beforehand [the promise of] the best reward from Us will be kept away from it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:102 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will not hear even its faint sound and they will remain [forever] in what their souls desire.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:103 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Great Terror will not upset them, and the angels will receive them [saying]: 'This is your day which you were promised.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:104 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day We shall roll up the sky, like the rolling of the scrolls for writings. We will bring it back as We began the first creation —a promise [binding] on Us. [That] indeed We will do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:105 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We wrote in the Psalms, after the Torah: 'Indeed My righteous servants shall inherit the earth.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:106 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is indeed in this a proclamation for a devout people.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:107 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not send you but as a mercy to all the nations.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:108 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'It has been revealed to me that your God is the One God. So will you submit?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:109 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they turn away, say, 'I have proclaimed to you all alike, and I do not know whether what you have been promised is far or near.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How many a town We have smashed that had been wrongdoing, and We brought forth another people after it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:110 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed He knows whatever is spoken aloud, and He knows whatever you conceal.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:111 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I do not know —maybe it is a trial for you and an enjoyment for a while.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:112 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said,1 'My Lord! Judge with justice.' 'Our Lord is the All-beneficent; [He is our] resort against what you allege.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when they sighted Our punishment, behold, they ran away from it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Do not run away! Return to the opulence you were given to enjoy and to your dwellings so that you may be questioned!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Woe to us! We have indeed been wrongdoers!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That remained their cry until We turned them into a mown field, stilled [like burnt ashes].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not create the sky and the earth and whatever is between them for play.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had We desired to take up some diversion We would have surely taken it up with Ourselves, were We to do [so].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather We hurl the truth against falsehood, and it crushes its head, and behold, falsehood vanishes! And woe to you for what you allege [about Allah].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and those who are near Him do not disdain to worship Him, nor do they become weary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There does not come to them any new reminder from their Lord but they listen to it as they play around,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They glorify [Him] night and day, and they do not flag.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they taken gods from the earth who raise [the dead]?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had there been gods in them1 other than Allah, they would surely have fallen apart. Clear is Allah, the Lord of the Throne, of what they allege [concerning Him].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He is not questioned concerning what He does, but they are questioned.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they taken gods besides Him? Say, 'Produce your evidence! This is a precept of those who are with me, and a precept of those [who went] before me.' Rather most of them do not know the truth, and so they are disregardful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not send any apostle before you but We revealed to him that 'There is no god except Me; so worship Me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'The All-beneficent has taken offsprings.' Immaculate is He! Rather they are [His] honoured servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They do not venture to speak ahead of Him, and they act by His command.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He knows that which is before them and that which is behind them, and they do not intercede except for someone He approves of, and they are apprehensive for the fear of Him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Should any of them say, 'I am a god besides Him,' We will requite him with hell. Thus do We requite the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: their hearts set on diversions. The wrongdoers secretly whisper together, [saying], 'Is not this [man] just a human being like yourselves? Will you give in to magic with open eyes?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have the faithless not regarded that the heavens and the earth were interwoven and We unravelled them, and We made every living thing out of water? Will they not then have faith?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We set firm mountains in the earth lest it should shake with them, and We made broad ways in them so that they may be guided [to their destinations].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We made the sky a preserved roof and yet they are disregardful of its signs.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who created the night and the day, the sun and the moon, each swimming in an orbit.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not give immortality to any human before you. If you are fated to die, will they live on forever?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Every soul shall taste death, and We will test you with good and ill by way of test, and to Us you will be brought back.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whenever the faithless see you they only take you in derision: 'Is this the one who speaks ill of your gods?' And they defy the remembrance of the All-beneficent.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Man is a creature of haste. Soon I will show you My signs. So do not ask Me to hasten.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they say, 'When will this promise be fulfilled, should you be truthful?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If only the faithless knew of the time when they will not be able to keep the Fire off their faces and their backs, nor will they be helped!1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord knows every word [spoken] in the sky and the earth, and He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather it will overtake them suddenly, dumbfounding them. So neither will they be able to avert it, nor will they be granted any respite.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Apostles were certainly derided before you; but those who ridiculed them were besieged by what they had been deriding.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Who can guard you, day and night, from [the punishment of] the All-beneficent?' Rather they are disregardful of their Lord's remembrance.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they have gods besides Us to defend them? Neither can they help themselves, nor can they provide them with an escort against Us.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather We have provided for them and their fathers until they lived on for long years. Do they not see how We visit the land diminishing it at its edges?1 Are they the ones who will prevail?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I indeed warn you by the means of revelation.' But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Should a whiff of your Lord's punishment touch them, they will surely say, 'Woe to us! We have indeed been wrongdoers!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We shall set up the scales of justice on the Day of Resurrection, and no soul will be wronged in the least. Even if it be the weight of a mustard seed We shall produce it and We suffice as reckoners.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion, a light and reminder for the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who fear their Lord in secret, and who are apprehensive of the Hour.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather they said, '[They are] confused nightmares!' 'Rather he has fabricated it!' 'Rather he is a poet!' 'Let him bring us a sign, like those sent to the ancients.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is a blessed reminder which We have sent down. Will you then deny it?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We had given Abraham his rectitude before, and We knew him

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when he said to his father and his people, 'What are these images to which you keep on clinging?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'We found our fathers worshipping them.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Certainly you and your fathers have been in manifest error.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Are you telling the truth,1 or are you [just] kidding?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Rather your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, who originated them, and I am a witness to this.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By Allah, I will devise a stratagem against your idols after you have gone away.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So he broke them into pieces, —all except the biggest of them— so that they might come back to it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Whoever has done this to Our gods?! He is indeed a wrongdoer!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No town that We destroyed before them believed.1 Will these then have faith [if they are sent signs]?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'We heard a young man speaking ill of them. He is called "Abraham." '

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Bring him before the people's eyes so that they may bear witness [against him].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Was it you who did this to our gods, O Abraham?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Rather it was this biggest of them who did it! Ask them, if they can speak.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thereat they came to themselves and said [to one another], 'Indeed it is you who are the wrongdoers!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then they hung their heads. [They said], 'You certainly know that they cannot speak.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Do you then worship, besides Allah, that which cannot cause you any benefit or harm?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Fie on you and what you worship besides Allah! Do you not apply reason?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Burn him, and help your gods, if you are to do anything!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We said, 'O fire! Be cool and safe for Abraham!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not send [any apostles] before you except as men, to whom We revealed. Ask the People of the Reminder1 if you do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They sought to outmaneuver him, but We made them the biggest losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We delivered him and Lot toward the land which We have blessed for all nations.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We gave him Isaac, and Jacob as well for a grandson,1 and each of them We made righteous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We made them _imam_s, guiding by Our command, and We revealed to them the performance of good deeds, the maintenance of prayers, and the giving of zakāt, and they used to worship Us.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We gave judgement and knowledge to Lot, and We delivered him from the town which used to commit vicious acts. Indeed they were an evil and profligate lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed he was one of the righteous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And before that Noah, when he called out, We responded to him and delivered him and his family from the great agony.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We helped him against the people who denied Our signs. They were indeed an evil lot; so We drowned them all.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And David and Solomon when they gave judgement concerning the tillage when the sheep of some people strayed into it by night, and We were witness to their judgement.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We gave its understanding to Solomon, and to each We gave judgement and knowledge. And We disposed the mountains and the birds to glorify [Us] with David, and We have been the doer [of such things].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not make them bodies that did not eat food, and they were not immortal.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We taught him the making of coats of mail for you, to protect you from your [own] violence. Will you then be grateful?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And for Solomon [We disposed] the tempestuous wind which blew by his command toward the land which We have blessed, and We have knowledge of all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among the devils were some who dived for him and performed tasks other than that, and We were watchful over them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And Job, when he called out to his Lord, 'Indeed distress has befallen me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We answered his prayer and removed his distress, and We gave him [back] his family along with others like them, as a mercy from Us, and an admonition for the devout.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And Ishmael, Idris, and Dhul-Kifl —each of them was among the patient.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed they were among the righteous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And the Man of the Fish, when he left in a rage, thinking that We would not put him to hardship. Then he cried out in the darkness, 'There is no god except You! You are immaculate! I have indeed been among the wrongdoers!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We answered his prayer and delivered him from the agony; and thus do We deliver the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And Zechariah, when he cried out to his Lord, 'My Lord! Do not leave me without an heir, and You are the best of inheritors.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We fulfilled Our promise to them, and We delivered them and whomever We wished, and We destroyed the profligates.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We answered his prayer, and gave him John, and remedied his wife['s infertility] for him. Indeed they were active in [performing] good works, and they would supplicate Us with eagerness and awe and were humble before Us.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And her who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her Our spirit,1 and made her and her son a sign for all the nations.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed this community of yours is one community, and I am your Lord. So worship Me.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They1 have fragmented their religion among themselves. Everyone of them will return to Us.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever does righteous deeds, should he be faithful, his endeavour shall not go unappreciated, and We will indeed write it for him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is forbidden for [the people of] any town that We have destroyed [to return to the world]: they shall not return.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Gog and Magog are let loose, and they race down from every slope,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the true promise draws near [to its fulfillment], behold, the faithless will look on with a fixed gaze: 'Woe to us! We have certainly been oblivious of this! Rather we have been wrongdoers!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed you and what you worship besides Allah shall be fuel for hell, and you will come to it

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anbiyaa:99 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —had they been gods, they would not have come to it— and they will all remain in it [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They ask you concerning the anfāl.1 Say, 'The anfāl belong to Allah and the Apostle.' So be wary of Allah and settle your differences, and obey Allah and His Apostle, should you be faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah did not appoint it but as a good news, and to reassure your hearts. Victory1 comes only from Allah. Indeed Allah is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When He covered you with a trance as a [sense of] security from Him, and He sent down water from the sky to purify you with it, and to repel from you the defilement of Satan, and to fortify your hearts, and to make [your] feet steady with it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then your Lord signaled to the angels: 'I am indeed with you; so steady the faithful. I will cast terror into the hearts of the faithless. So strike their necks, and strike each of their fingertips!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That, because they defied Allah and His Apostle. And whoever defies Allah and His Apostle, Allah is indeed severe in retribution.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Taste this, and [know] that for the faithless is the punishment of the Fire.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! When you encounter the faithless advancing [for battle], do not turn your backs [to flee] from them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever turns his back [to flee] from them that day —unless [he is] diverting to fight or retiring towards another troop— shall certainly earn Allah's wrath, and his refuge shall be hell, an evil destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You did not kill them; rather it was Allah who killed them; and you did not throw when you threw,1 rather it was Allah who threw, that He might test the faithful with a good test from Himself.2 Indeed Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Such is the case, and [know] that Allah undermines the stratagems of the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you sought a verdict, the verdict has certainly come to you;1 and if you relinquish [faithlessness], it is better for you, but if you revert, We [too] shall return and your troops will never avail you though they should be ever so many, and [know] that Allah is with the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithful are only those whose hearts tremble [with awe] when Allah is mentioned, and when His signs are recited to them, they1 increase their faith, and who put their trust in their Lord,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Obey Allah and His Apostle, and do not turn away from him while you hear [him].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not be like those who say, 'We hear,' though they do not hear.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the worst of beasts in Allah's sight are the deaf and the dumb who do not apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had Allah known any good in them, surely He would have made them hear, and were He to make them hear, surely they would turn away, being disregardful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Answer Allah and the Apostle when he summons you to that which will give you life. Know that Allah intervenes between a man and his heart and that toward Him you will be mustered.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And beware of a punishment which shall not visit the wrongdoers among you exclusively, and know that Allah is severe in retribution.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Remember when you were few, abased in the land, and feared lest the people should despoil you, and He gave you refuge, and strengthened you with His help, and provided you with all the good things so that you may give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not betray Allah and the Apostle, and do not betray your trusts knowingly.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Know that your possessions and children are only a test, and that Allah—with Him is a great reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! If you are wary of Allah, He shall appoint a criterion1 for you, and absolve you of your misdeeds, and forgive you, for Allah is dispenser of a great grace.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: maintain the prayer and spend out of what We have provided them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the faithless plotted against you to take you captive, or to kill or expel you. They plotted and Allah devised, and Allah is the best of devisers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Our signs are recited to them, they say, 'We have heard already. If we want, we [too] can say like this. These are nothing but myths of the ancients.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when they said, 'O Allah, if this be the truth from You, rain down upon us stones from the sky, or bring us a painful punishment.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But Allah will not punish them while you are in their midst, nor will Allah punish them while they plead for forgiveness.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What [excuse] have they that Allah should not punish them, when they bar [the faithful] from the Holy Mosque, and they are not its custodians? Its custodians are only the Godwary, but most of them do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Their prayer at the House is nothing but whistling and clapping. So taste the punishment because of what you used to defy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the faithless spend their wealth to bar from the way of Allah. Soon they will have spent it, then it will be a cause of regret to them, then they will be overcome, and the faithless will be gathered toward Hell,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so that Allah may separate the bad ones from the good, and place the bad on one another, and pile them up together, and cast them into hell. It is they who are the losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say to the faithless, if they relinquish [faithlessness], what is already past shall be forgiven them. But if they revert [to faithlessness], then the precedent of the ancients has already passed.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Fight them until faithlessness1 is no more, and religion becomes exclusively for Allah. But if they relinquish, Allah indeed sees best what they do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is they who are truly the faithful. They shall have ranks near their Lord, forgiveness and a noble provision.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if they turn away, then know that Allah is your master: an excellent master and an excellent helper!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Know that whatever thing you may come by, a fifth of it is for Allah and the Apostle, for the relatives and the orphans, for the needy and the traveller, if you have faith in Allah and what We sent down to Our servant on the Day of Separation,1 the day when the two hosts met; and Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you were on the nearer side,1 and they2 on the farther side, while the caravan was below you, and had you agreed together on an encounter, you would have certainly failed to keep the tryst,3 but in order that Allah may carry through a matter that was bound to be fulfilled, so that he who perishes might perish by a manifest proof, and he who lives may live on by a manifest proof, and Allah is indeed all-hearing, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Allah showed them1 to you as few in your dream, and had He shown them as many, you would have lost heart, and disputed about the matter. But Allah spared you. Indeed He knows well what is in the breasts.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when He showed them to you —when you met them [on the battlefield]— as few in your eyes, and He made you [appear] few in their eyes in order that Allah may carry through a matter that was bound to be fulfilled, and to Allah all matters are returned.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! When you meet a host [in battle], then stand firm, and remember Allah greatly so that you may be felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And obey Allah and His Apostle, and do not dispute, or you will lose heart and your power will be gone. And be patient; indeed Allah is with the patient.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not be like those who left their homes vainly and to show off to the people, and to bar [other people] from the way of Allah, and Allah comprehends what they do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Satan made their deeds seem decorous to them, and said, 'No one shall overcome you today from among all mankind, and I will stand by you.' But when the two hosts sighted each other, he took to his heels, saying, 'Indeed I am quit of you. I see what you do not see. Indeed I fear Allah, and Allah is severe in retribution.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the hypocrites said, and [also] those in whose hearts is a sickness, 'Their religion has deceived them.' But whoever puts his trust in Allah, then Allah is indeed all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As your Lord brought you out from your home with a just cause, a part of the faithful were indeed reluctant.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were you to see when the angels take away the faithless, striking their faces and their backs, [saying], 'Taste the punishment of the burning.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is because of what your hands have sent ahead, and because Allah is not tyrannical to the servants.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Like the precedent of Pharaoh's clan and those who were before them, who defied Allah's signs, so Allah seized them for their sins. Indeed Allah is all-strong, severe in retribution.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is because Allah never changes a blessing that He has bestowed on a people unless they change what is in their own souls, and Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Like the precedent of Pharaoh's clan and those who were before them, who denied the signs of their Lord; so We destroyed them for their sins, and We drowned Pharaoh's clan; and they were all wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the worst of beasts in Allah's sight are those who are faithless; so they will not have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —Those with whom you made a treaty, and who violated their treaty every time, and who are not Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So if you confront them in battle, treat them [in such a wise] as to disperse those who are behind them, so that they may take admonition.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if you fear treachery from a people, break off [the treaty] with them in a like manner. Indeed Allah does not like the treacherous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Let the faithless not suppose that they have outmaneuvered [Allah]. Indeed they cannot thwart [His power].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They disputed with you concerning the truth after it had become clear, as if they were being driven towards death as they looked on.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Prepare against them whatever you can of [military] power and war-horses, awing thereby the enemy of Allah, and your enemy, and others besides them, whom you do not know, but Allah knows them. And whatever you spend in the way of Allah will be repaid to you in full, and you will not be wronged.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if they incline toward peace, then you [too] incline toward it, and put your trust in Allah. Indeed He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they desire to deceive you, Allah is indeed sufficient for you. It is He who strengthened you with His help and with the means of the faithful,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and united their hearts. Had you spent all that is in the earth, you could not have united their hearts, but Allah united them together. Indeed He is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Prophet! Sufficient for you is Allah and those of the faithful who follow you.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Prophet! Urge on the faithful to fight: If there be twenty patient men among you, they shall overcome two hundred; and if there be a hundred of you, they shall overcome a thousand of the faithless, for they are a lot who do not understand.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Now Allah has lightened your burden, knowing that there is weakness in you. So if there be a hundred patient men among you, they shall overcome two hundred; and if there be a thousand, they shall overcome two thousand, by Allah's leave; and Allah is with the patient.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A prophet may not take captives until he has thoroughly decimated [the enemy] in the land. You desire the transitory gains of this world, while Allah desires [for you] [the reward of] the Hereafter, and Allah is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had it not been for a prior decree of Allah, surely there would have befallen you a great punishment for what you took.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Avail yourselves of the spoils you have taken as lawful and good, and be wary of Allah. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Allah promised you [victory over] one of the two companies, [saying], 'It is for you,' you were eager that it should be the one that was unarmed.1 But Allah desires to confirm the truth with His words, and to root out the faithless,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Prophet! Say to the captives who are in your hands, 'If Allah finds any good in your hearts, He will give you [something which is] better than what has been taken away from you, and He will forgive you, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they seek to betray you, then they have already betrayed Allah earlier, and He gave [you] power over them; and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who have believed and migrated and waged jihād with their possessions and persons in the way of Allah, and those who gave [them] shelter and help —they are heirs of one another. As for those who have believed but did not migrate, you have no heirdom in relation to them whatsoever until they migrate. Yet if they ask your help for the sake of religion, it is incumbent on you to help them, excepting against a people with whom you have a treaty; and Allah sees best what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the faithless, they are allies of one another. Unless you do the same, there will be turmoil on the earth and great corruption.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who have believed, migrated, and waged jihād in the way of Allah, and those who gave them shelter and help, it is they who are truly the faithful. For them shall be forgiveness and a noble provision.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And those who believed afterwards and migrated, and waged jihād along with you, they belong to you; but the blood relatives are more entitled to inherit from one another in the Book of Allah.1 Indeed Allah has knowledge of all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so that He may confirm the truth and bring falsehood to naught, though the guilty should be averse.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Anfaal:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you appealed to your Lord for help, He answered you: 'I will aid you with a thousand angels in a file.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Alif, Lām, Mīm.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among the people there are those who say, 'We have faith in Allah,' but if such a one is tormented in Allah's cause, he takes persecution by the people for Allah's punishment. Yet if there comes any help1 from your Lord, they will say for sure, 'We were indeed with you.' Does not Allah know best what is in the breasts of the creatures?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah shall surely ascertain those who have faith, and He shall surely ascertain the hypocrites.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithless say to the faithful, 'Follow our way and we will bear [responsibility for] your iniquities.' They will not bear anything of their iniquities. They are indeed liars.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But surely they will carry their own burdens and other burdens along with their own burdens, and they will surely be questioned on the Day of Resurrection concerning that which they used to fabricate.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We sent Noah to his people, and he remained with them for a thousand-less-fifty years. Then the flood overtook them while they were wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We delivered him and the occupants of the Ark, and made it a sign for all the nations.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And Abraham, when he said to his people, 'Worship Allah and be wary of Him. That is better for you, should you know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: In fact, instead of Allah you worship idols, and you invent a lie. Indeed those whom you worship besides Allah have no control over your provision. So seek all [your] provision from Allah, and worship Him and thank Him, and to Him you shall be brought back.'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if you impugn [the Apostle's teaching], then [other] nations have impugned [likewise] before you, and the Apostle's duty is only to communicate in clear terms.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not regarded how Allah originates the creation? Then He will bring it back. That is indeed easy for Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do the people suppose that they will be let off because they say, 'We have faith,' and they will not be tested?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Travel over the land and then observe how He has originated the creation.' Then Allah shall bring about the genesis of the Hereafter. Indeed Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He will punish whomever He wishes and have mercy on whomever He wishes, and to Him you will be returned.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You cannot thwart Him on the earth or in the sky, nor do you have besides Allah any guardian or any helper.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who deny the signs of Allah and the encounter with Him, they have despaired of My mercy, and for such there is a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But the only answer of his people was that they said, 'Kill him, or burn him.' Then Allah delivered him from the fire. There are indeed signs in that for a people who have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'You have taken idols [for worship] besides Allah for the sake of [mutual] affection amongst yourselves in the life of the world. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will disown one another and curse one another,1 and the Fire will be your abode, and you will not have any helpers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thereupon Lot believed in him, and he said, 'Indeed I am migrating toward my Lord. Indeed He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ankaboot:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
