But they would learn from those two that with which they would cause a split between man and his wife —though they could not harm anyone with it except with Allah's leave. And they would learn that which would harm them and bring them no benefit; though they certainly knew that anyone who buys it has no share in the Hereafter. Surely, evil is that for which they sold their souls; had they known!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:103 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had they been faithful and Godwary, the reward from Allah would have been better; had they known!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:104 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not say Ra'inā, but say Unzurnā, and listen!1 And there is a painful punishment for the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:105 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Neither the faithless from among the People of the Book, nor the idolaters, like that any good be showered on you from your Lord; but Allah singles out for His mercy whomever He wishes, and Allah is dispenser of a mighty grace.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:106 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For any verse that We abrogate or remove from memories, We bring another which is better than it, or similar to it. Do you not know that Allah has power over all things?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:107 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you not know that to Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth? And besides Allah you do not have any guardian or any helper.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:108 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Would you question your Apostle as Moses was questioned formerly? Whoever changes faith for unfaith certainly strays from the right way.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:109 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Many of the People of the Book are eager to turn you into unbelievers after your faith, out of their inner envy, [and] after the truth had become manifest to them. Yet excuse [them] and forbear until Allah issues His edict. Indeed Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they are told, 'Do not cause corruption on the earth,' they say, 'We are only reformers!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:110 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And maintain the prayer and give the zakāt. Any good that you send ahead for your souls, you shall find it with Allah. Indeed Allah sees best what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:111 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they say, 'No one shall enter paradise except one who is a Jew or a Christian.' Those are their [false] hopes! Say, 'Produce your evidence, should you be truthful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:112 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly whoever submits his will to Allah and is virtuous, he shall have his reward near his Lord, and they shall have no fear, nor shall they grieve.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:113 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Jews say, 'The Christians stand on nothing,' and the Christians say, 'The Jews stand on nothing,' though they follow the [same] Book. So said those who had no knowledge, [words] similar to what they say. Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that about which they used to differ.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:114 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Who is a greater wrongdoer than him who denies access to the mosques of Allah lest His Name be celebrated therein, and tries to ruin them? Such ones may not enter them, except in fear. There is disgrace for them in this world, and there is for them a great punishment in the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:115 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belong the east and the west: so whichever way you turn, there is the face of Allah! Allah is indeed all-bounteous, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:116 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they say, 'Allah has taken a son.' Immaculate is He! Rather to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. All are obedient to Him,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:117 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the Originator of the heavens and the earth; and when He decides on a matter, He just says to it, 'Be!' and it is.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:118 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who have no knowledge say, 'Why does not Allah speak to us, or come to us a sign?' So said those who were before them, [words] similar to what they say. Alike are their hearts. We have certainly made the signs clear for a people who have certainty.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:119 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have sent you with the truth, as a bearer of good news and as a warner, and you will not be questioned concerning the inmates of hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Look! They are themselves the agents of corruption, but they are not aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:120 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Never will the Jews be pleased with you, nor the Christians, unless you followed their creed. Say, 'Indeed it is the guidance of Allah which is the [true] guidance.' And should you follow their desires after the knowledge that has come to you, you will not have against Allah any guardian nor any helper.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:121 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those to whom We have given the Book follow it as it ought to be followed: they have faith in it. As for those who defy it —it is they who are the losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:122 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Children of Israel, remember My blessing which I bestowed upon you, and that I gave you an advantage over all the nations.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:123 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And beware of the Day when no soul shall compensate for another, neither shall any ransom be accepted from it, nor shall any intercession benefit it, nor will they be helped.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:124 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when his Lord tested Abraham with certain words, and he fulfilled them, He said, 'I am making you the Imam1 of mankind.' Said he, 'And from among my descendants?' He said, 'My pledge does not extend to the unjust.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:125 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And [remember] when We made the House a place of reward1 for mankind and a sanctuary, [declaring], 'Take the venue of prayer from Abraham's Station.'2 We charged Abraham and Ishmael [with its upkeep, saying], 'Purify My House for those who go around it, [for] those who make it a retreat and [for] those who bow and prostrate.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:126 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when Abraham said, 'My Lord, make this a secure town, and provide its people with fruits —such of them as have faith in Allah and the Last Day,' He said, 'As for him who is faithless, I will provide for him [too] for a short time, then I will shove him toward the punishment of the Fire, and it is an evil destination.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:127 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As Abraham raised the foundations of the House with Ishmael, [they prayed]: 'Our Lord, accept it from us! Indeed You are the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:128 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Our Lord, make us submissive to You, and [raise] from our progeny a nation submissive to You, and show us our rites [of worship], and turn to us clemently. Indeed You are the All-clement, the All-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:129 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Our Lord, raise amongst them an apostle from among them, who should recite to them Your signs, and teach them the Book and wisdom, and purify them. Indeed You are the All-mighty, the All-wise.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when they are told, 'Believe like the people who have believed,' they say, 'Shall we believe like the fools who have believed?' Look! They are themselves the fools, but they do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:130 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And who will [ever] renounce Abraham's creed except one who fools himself? We certainly chose him in the [present] world, and in the Hereafter he will indeed be among the Righteous.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:131 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When his Lord said to him, 'Submit,' he said, 'I submit to the Lord of all the worlds.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:132 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Abraham enjoined this [creed] upon his children, and [so did] Jacob, [saying], 'My children! Allah has indeed chosen this religion for you; so never die except as muslims.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:133 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were you witnesses when death approached Jacob, when he said to his children, 'What will you worship after me?' They said, 'We will worship your God, and the God of your fathers, Abraham, Ishmael, and Isaac, the One God, and to Him do we submit.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:134 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That was a nation that has passed: for it there will be what it has earned, and for you there will be what you have earned, and you will not be questioned about what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:135 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they say, 'Be either Jews or Christians, that you may be [rightly] guided.' Say, 'Rather [we will follow] the creed of Abraham, a ḥanīf, and he was not one of the polytheists.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:136 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'We have faith in Allah, and that which has been sent down to us, and that which was sent down to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob and the Tribes,1 and that which Moses and Jesus were given, and that which the prophets were given from their Lord; we make no distinction between any of them, and to Him do we submit.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:137 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So if they believe in the like of what you believe in, then they are certainly guided; and if they turn away, then they are only [steeped] in defiance. Allah shall suffice you against them, and He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:138 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The baptism of Allah, and who baptizes better than Allah? And Him do we worship.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:139 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Will you argue with us concerning Allah, while He is our Lord and your Lord, and our deeds belong to us, and your deeds belong to you, and we worship Him dedicatedly?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they meet the faithful, they say, 'We believe,' but when they are alone with their devils, they say, 'We are with you; we were only deriding [them].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:140 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you say that Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, and the Tribes were Jews or Christians? Say, 'Is it you who know better, or Allah?' And who is a greater wrongdoer than him who conceals a testimony that is with him from Allah? And Allah is not oblivious of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:141 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That was a nation that has passed: for it there will be what it has earned, and for you there will be what you have earned, and you will not be questioned about what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:142 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The foolish among the people1 will say, 'What has turned them away from the qiblah they were following?'2 Say, 'To Allah belong the east and the west. He guides whomever He wishes to a straight path.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:143 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus We have made you a middle nation that you may be witnesses to the people, and that the Apostle may be a witness to you.And We did not appoint the qiblah you were following but that We may ascertain those who follow the Apostle from those who turn back on their heels. It was indeed a hard thing except for those whom Allah has guided. And Allah would not let your prayers go to waste.1 Indeed Allah is most kind and merciful to mankind.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:144 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We certainly see you turning your face about in the sky. We will surely turn you to a qiblah of your liking: so turn your face towards the Holy Mosque, and wherever you may be, turn your faces towards it! Indeed those who were given the Book surely know that it is the truth from their Lord. And Allah is not oblivious of what they do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:145 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Even if you bring those who were given the Book every [kind of] sign,1 they will not follow your qiblah. Nor shall you follow their qiblah, nor will any of them follow the qiblah of the other. And if you follow their desires, after the knowledge that has come to you, you will indeed be one of the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:146 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those whom We have given the Book recognize him just as they recognize their sons,1 but a part of them indeed conceal the truth while they know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:147 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is the truth from your Lord; so do not be among the skeptics.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:148 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Everyone has a cynosure to which he turns; so take the lead in all good works. Wherever you may be, Allah will bring you all together. Indeed Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:149 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whencesoever you may go out, turn your face towards the Holy Mosque. Indeed it is the truth from your Lord, and Allah is not oblivious of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is Allah who derides them,1 and leaves them bewildered in their rebellion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:150 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And whencesoever you may go out, turn your face towards the Holy Mosque, and wherever you may be, turn your faces towards it, so that the people may have no argument against you, neither those of them who are wrongdoers.1 So do not fear them, but fear Me, that I may complete My blessing on you and so that you may be guided.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:151 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As We sent to you an Apostle from among yourselves, who recites to you Our signs, and purifies you, and teaches you the Book and wisdom, and teaches you what you did not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:152 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Remember Me, and I will remember you, and thank Me, and do not be ungrateful to Me.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:153 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Take recourse in patience and prayer; indeed Allah is with the patient.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:154 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And do not call those who were slain in Allah's way 'dead.' Rather they are living, but you are not aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:155 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We will surely test you with a measure of fear and hunger and a loss of wealth, lives, and fruits; and give good news to the patient

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:156 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those who, when an affliction visits them, say, 'Indeed we belong to Allah, and to Him do we indeed return.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:157 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is they who receive the blessings of their Lord and [His] mercy, and it is they who are the [rightly] guided.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:158 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Safa and Marwah are among Allah's sacraments. So whoever makes ḥajj to the House, or performs the 'umrah, there is no sin upon him to circuit between them. Should anyone do good of his own accord, then Allah is indeed appreciative, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:159 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who conceal what We have sent down of manifest proofs and guidance, after We have clarified it in the Book for mankind, —they shall be cursed by Allah and cursed by the cursers,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are the ones who bought error for guidance, so their trade did not profit them, nor were they guided.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:160 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except such as repent, make amends, and clarify, —those I shall pardon, and I am the All-clement, the All-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:161 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who turn faithless and die while they are faithless, —it is they on whom shall be the curse of Allah, the angels and all mankind.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:162 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will remain in it [forever], and their punishment shall not be lightened, nor will they be granted any respite.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:163 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your god is the One God, there is no god except Him, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:164 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed in the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the alternation of night and day, and the ships that sail at sea with profit to men, and the water that Allah sends down from the sky —with which He revives the earth after its death, and scatters therein every kind of animal— and the changing of the winds, and the clouds disposed between the sky and the earth, are surely signs for a people who apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:165 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among the people are those who set up compeers besides Allah, loving them as if loving Allah —but the faithful have a more ardent love for Allah— though the wrongdoers will see, when they sight the punishment, that power, altogether, belongs to Allah, and that Allah is severe in punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:166 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When those who were followed will disown the followers, and they will sight the punishment while all their means of recourse will be cut off,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:167 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and when the followers will say, 'Had there been another turn for us, we would disown them as they disown us [now]!' Thus shall Allah show them their deeds as regrets for themselves, and they shall not leave the Fire.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:168 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O mankind! Eat of what is lawful and pure in the earth, and do not follow in Satan's steps. Indeed he is your manifest enemy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:169 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He only prompts you to [commit] evil and indecent acts, and that you attribute to Allah what you do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Their parable is that of one who lighted a torch, and when it had lit up all around him, Allah took away their light, and left them sightless in a manifold darkness.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:170 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they are told, 'Follow what Allah has sent down,' they say, 'We will rather follow what we have found our fathers following.' What, even if their fathers neither applied any reason nor were guided?!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:171 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The parable of the faithless is that of someone who shouts after that which does not hear [anything] except a call and cry: deaf, dumb, and blind, they do not apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:172 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Eat of the good things We have provided you, and thank Allah, if it is Him that you worship.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:173 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He has forbidden you only carrion, blood, the flesh of the swine, and that which has been offered to other than Allah. But should someone be compelled, without being rebellious or aggressive,1 there shall be no sin upon him. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:174 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who conceal what Allah has sent down of the Book and sell it for a paltry gain —they do not take in, into their bellies, [anything] except fire, and Allah shall not speak to them on the Day of Resurrection, nor shall He purify them, and there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:175 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are the ones who bought error for guidance, and punishment for pardon: how patient of them to face the Fire!1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:176 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is so because Allah has sent down the Book with the truth, and those who differ about the Book are surely in extreme defiance.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:177 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Piety is not to turn your faces to the east or the west; rather, piety is [personified by] those who have faith in Allah and the Last Day, the angels, the Book, and the prophets, and who give their wealth, for the love of Him,1 to relatives, orphans, the needy, the traveller and the beggar, and for [the freeing of] the slaves, and maintain the prayer and give the zakāt, and those who fulfill their covenants, when they pledge themselves, and those who are patient in stress and distress,2 and in the heat of battle. They are the ones who are true [to their covenant], and it is they who are the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:178 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Retribution is prescribed for you regarding the slain: freeman for freeman, slave for slave, and female for female. But if one is granted any extenuation by his brother,1 let the follow up [for the blood-money] be honourable, and let the payment to him be with kindness. That is a remission from your Lord and a mercy; and should anyone transgress after that, there shall be a painful punishment for him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:179 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is life for you in retribution, O you who possess intellects! Maybe you will be Godwary!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Deaf, dumb, and blind, they will not come back.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:180 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Prescribed for you, when death approaches any of you and he leaves behind any property, is that he make a bequest for his parents and relatives, in an honourable manner, —an obligation on the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:181 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And should anyone alter it after hearing it, its sin shall indeed lie on those who alter it. Indeed Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:182 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But should someone, fearing deviance or sin on the testator's behalf, set things right between them, there is no sin upon him. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:183 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Prescribed for you is fasting as it was prescribed for those who were before you, so that you may be Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:184 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That for known days. But should any of you be sick or on a journey, let it be a [similar] number of other days. Those who find it straining shall be liable to atonement by feeding a needy person. Should anyone do good of his own accord, that is better for him, and to fast is better for you, should you know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:185 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The month of Ramaḍān is one in which the Qur'ān was sent down as guidance to mankind, with manifest proofs of guidance and the Criterion.1 So let those of you who witness it fast [in] it, and as for someone who is sick or on a journey, let it be a [similar] number of other days. Allah desires ease for you, and He does not desire hardship for you, and so that you may complete the number, and magnify Allah for guiding you, and that you may give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:186 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When My servants ask you about Me, [tell them that] I am indeed nearmost. I answer the supplicant's call when he calls Me. So let them respond to Me, and let them have faith in Me, so that they may fare rightly.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:187 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You are permitted, on the night of the fast, to go into your wives: they are a garment for you, and you are a garment for them. Allah knew that you used to betray yourselves, so He pardoned you and excused you. So now consort with them, and seek what Allah has ordained for you, and eat and drink until the white streak becomes manifest to you from the dark streak at the crack of dawn.1 Then complete the fast until nightfall, and do not consort with them while you dwell in confinement in the mosques. These are Allah's bounds, so do not approach them. Thus does Allah clarify His signs for mankind so that they may be Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:188 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not eat up your wealth among yourselves wrongfully, nor proffer it to the judges in order to eat up a part of the people's wealth sinfully, while you know [that it is immoral to do so].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:189 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They question you concerning the new moons. Say, 'They are timekeeping signs for the people and [for the sake of] ḥajj.' It is not piety that you come into houses from their rear; rather piety is [personified by] one who is Godwary, and come into houses from their doors, and be wary of Allah, so that you may be felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Or that of a rainstorm from the sky, wherein is darkness, thunder, and lightning: they put their fingers in their ears due to the thunderclaps, apprehensive of death; and Allah besieges the faithless.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:190 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Fight in the way of Allah those who fight you, but do not transgress. Indeed Allah does not like transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:191 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And kill them wherever you confront them, and expel them from where they expelled you, for faithlessness1 is graver than killing. But do not fight them near the Holy Mosque unless they fight you therein; but if they fight you, kill them; such is the requital of the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:192 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they relinquish,1 then Allah is indeed all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:193 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Fight them until faithlessness1 is no more, and religion becomes [exclusively] for Allah. Then if they relinquish, there shall be no reprisal except against the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:194 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A sacred month for a sacred month, and all sanctities require retribution. So should anyone aggress against you, assail him in the manner he assailed you,1 and be wary of Allah, and know that Allah is with the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:195 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Spend in the way of Allah, and do not cast yourselves with your own hands into destruction; and be virtuous. Indeed Allah loves the virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:196 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Complete the ḥajj and the 'umrah for Allah's sake, and if you are prevented, then [make] such [sacrificial] offering as is feasible. And do not shave your heads until the offering reaches its [assigned] place. But should any of you be sick, or have a hurt in his head,1 let the atonement be by fasting, or charity, or sacrifice. And when you have security —for those who enjoy [release from the restrictions] by virtue of the 'umrah until the ḥajj— let the offering be such as is feasible. As for someone who cannot afford [the offering], let him fast three days during the ḥajj and seven when you return; that is [a period of] ten complete [days]. That is for someone whose family does not dwell by the Holy Mosque. And be wary of Allah, and know that Allah is…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:197 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The ḥajj [season] is in months well-known; so whoever decides on ḥajj [pilgrimage] therein, [should know that] there is to be no sexual contact, vicious talk, or disputing during the ḥajj. And whatever good you do, Allah knows it. And take provision, for indeed the best provision is Godwariness. So be wary of Me, O you who possess intellects!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:198 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is no sin upon you in seeking your Lord's grace [during the ḥajj season]. Then when you stream out of 'Arafāt remember Allah at the Holy Mash'ar, and remember Him as He has guided you, and earlier you were indeed among the astray.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:199 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then stream out from where the people stream out, and plead to Allah for forgiveness; indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is the Book,1 there is no doubt in it, a guidance to the Godwary,2

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The lightning almost snatches away their sight: whenever it shines for them, they walk in it, and when the darkness falls upon them, they stand. Had Allah willed, He would have taken away their hearing and their sight. Indeed Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:200 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when you finish your rites, then remember Allah as you would remember your fathers, or with a more ardent remembrance. Among the people there are those who say, 'Our Lord, give us in this world,' but for such there is no share in the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:201 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And among them there are those who say, 'Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:202 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Such shall partake of what they have earned, and Allah is swift at reckoning.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:203 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Remember Allah in the appointed days. Then whoever hastens off in a couple of days, there is no sin upon him, and whoever delays, there is no sin upon him —that for one who has been Godwary— and be wary of Allah, and know that toward Him you will be mustered.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:204 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among the people is he whose talk about worldly life impresses you, and he holds Allah witness to what is in his heart, though he is the staunchest of enemies.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:205 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if he were to wield authority, he would try to cause corruption in the land, and to ruin the crop and the stock, and Allah does not like corruption.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:206 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when he is told, 'Be wary of Allah,' conceit seizes him sinfully; so let hell suffice him, and it is surely an evil resting place!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:207 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And among the people is he who sells his soul1 seeking the pleasure of Allah, and Allah is most kind to [His] servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:208 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Enter into submission, all together, and do not follow in Satan's steps; he is indeed your manifest enemy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:209 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And should you stumble after the manifest proofs that have come to you, know that Allah is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O mankind! Worship your Lord, who created you and those who were before you, so that you may be Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:210 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they await anything but that Allah['s command] should come to them in the shades of the clouds, with the angels, and the matter be decided [once for all]? And to Allah all matters are returned.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:211 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ask the Children of Israel how many a manifest sign We had given them. And whoever changes Allah's blessing after it has come to him, indeed Allah is severe in retribution.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:212 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Worldly life has been glamorized for the faithless, and they ridicule the faithful. But those who are Godwary shall be above them on the Day of Resurrection, and Allah provides for whomever He wishes without any reckoning.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:213 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Mankind were a single community; then Allah sent the prophets as bearers of good news and as warners, and He sent down with them the Book with the truth, that it1 may judge between the people concerning that about which they differed, and none differed in it except those who had been given it, after the manifest proofs had come to them, out of envy among themselves. Then Allah guided those who had faith to the truth of what they differed in, by His will, and Allah guides whomever He wishes to a straight path.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:214 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you suppose that you shall enter paradise though there has not yet come to you the like of [what befell]those who went before you? Stress and distress befell them and they were convulsed until the apostle and the faithful who were with him said, 'When will Allah's help [come]?' Look! Allah's help is indeed near!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:215 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They ask you as to what they should spend. Say, 'Whatever wealth you spend, let it be for parents, relatives, orphans, the needy, and the traveller.' And whatever good that you may do, Allah indeed knows it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:216 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Warfare has been prescribed for you, though it is repulsive to you. Yet it may be that you dislike something while it is good for you, and it may be that you love something while it is bad for you, and Allah knows and you do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:217 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They ask you concerning warfare in the holy month. Say, 'It is an outrageous thing to fight in it, but to keep [people] from Allah's way, and to be unfaithful to Him, and [to keep people from] the Holy Mosque, and to expel its people from it are more outrageous with Allah. And faithlessness is graver than killing. And they will not cease fighting you until they turn you away from your religion, if they can. And whoever of you turns away from his religion and dies faithless —they are the ones whose works have failed in this world and the Hereafter. They shall be the inmates of the Fire, and they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:218 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who have become faithful and those who have migrated and waged jihād in the way of Allah —it is they who expect Allah's mercy, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:219 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They ask you concerning wine and gambling. Say, 'There is a great sin in both of them, and some profits for the people, but their sinfulness outweighs their profit.' And they ask you as to what they should spend. Say, 'All that is surplus.' Thus does Allah clarify His signs for you so that you may reflect

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He who made the earth a place of repose for you, and the sky a canopy, and He sends down water from the sky, and with it He brings forth crops for your sustenance. So do not set up equals to Allah, while you know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:220 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: about the world and the Hereafter. And they ask you concerning the orphans. Say, 'It is better to set right their affairs,1 and if you intermingle with them, they are of course your brothers: Allah knows the one who causes corruption from the one who brings about reform, and had Allah wished He would have put you to hardship.' Indeed Allah is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:221 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not marry idolatresses until they embrace faith. A faithful slave girl is better than an idolatress, though she should impress you. And do not marry [your daughters] to idolaters until they embrace faith. A faithful slave is better than an idolater, though he should impress you. Those invite [others] to the Fire, but Allah invites to paradise and pardon, by His will, and He clarifies His signs for the people so that they may take admonition.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:222 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They ask you concerning [intercourse during] menses. Say, 'It is hurtful.'1 So keep away from wives during the menses,2 and do not approach them till they are clean. And when they become clean, go into them as Allah has commanded you. Indeed Allah loves the penitent and He loves those who keep clean.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:223 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your women are a tillage for you, so come to your tillage whenever you like, and send ahead for your souls, and be Godwary, and know that you will encounter Him; and give good news to the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:224 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not make Allah an obstacle, through your oaths, to being pious and Godwary, and to bringing about concord between people. And Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:225 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah shall not take you to task for what is unconsidered in your oaths, but He shall take you to task for what your hearts have incurred, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-forbearing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:226 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For those who forswear their wives1 shall be a waiting for four months. And if they recant, Allah is indeed all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:227 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they resolve on divorce, Allah is indeed all-hearing, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:228 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Divorced women shall wait by themselves for three periods of purity [after menses], and it is not lawful for them to conceal what Allah has created in their wombs if they believe in Allah and the Last Day; and their husbands have a greater right to restore them during this [duration], if they desire reconcilement. The wives have rights similar to the obligations upon them, in accordance with honourable norms; and men have a degree above them, and Allah is all-mighty and all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:229 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [Revocable] divorce may be only twice; then [let there be] either an honourable retention, or a kindly release. And it is not lawful for you to take back anything from what you have given them,1 unless the couple fear that they may not maintain Allah's bounds. So if you fear they would not maintain Allah's bounds, there is no sin upon them2 in what she may give to secure her release. These are Allah's bounds, so do not transgress them, and whoever transgresses the bounds of Allah —it is they who are the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if you are in doubt concerning what We have sent down to Our servant, then bring a sūrah like it, and invoke your helpers besides Allah, should you be truthful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:230 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if he divorces her, she will not be lawful for him until she marries a husband other than him, and if he divorces her,1 there is no sin upon them to remarry if they think that they can maintain Allah's bounds. These are Allah's bounds, which He clarifies for a people who have knowledge.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:231 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you divorce women and they complete their term, then either retain them honourably or release them honourably, and do not retain them maliciously in order that you may transgress; and whoever does that certainly wrongs himself. Do not take the signs of Allah in derision, and remember Allah's blessing upon you, and what He has sent down to you of the Book and wisdom, to advise you therewith. Be wary of Allah, and know that Allah has knowledge of all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:232 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you divorce women and they complete their term, do not thwart them lest they should [re]marry their husbands, when they honourably reach mutual consent. Herewith are advised those of you who believe in Allah and the Last Day. That will be more decent and purer for you, and Allah knows and you do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:233 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Mothers shall suckle their children for two full years, —that for such as desire to complete the suckling— and on the father shall be their maintenance and clothing, in accordance with honourable norms. No soul is to be tasked except according to its capacity: neither the mother shall be made to suffer harm on her child's account, nor the father on account of his child, and on the [father's] heir devolve [duties and rights] similar to that. And if the couple desire to wean, with mutual consent and consultation, there will be no sin upon them. And if you want to have your children wet-nursed, there will be no sin upon you so long as you pay what you give in accordance with honourable norms, and be wary of Allah, and know that Allah sees best what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:234 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those of you who die leaving wives, they shall wait by themselves four months and ten days, and when they complete their term, there will be no sin upon you in respect of what they may do with themselves in accordance with honourable norms. And Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:235 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is no sin upon you in what you may hint in proposing to [recently widowed] women, or what you may secretly cherish within your hearts. Allah knows that you will be thinking of them, but do not make troth with them secretly, unless you say honourable words, and do not resolve on a marriage tie until the prescribed term is complete.1 Know that Allah knows what is in your hearts, so beware of Him; and know that Allah is all-forgiving, all-forbearing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:236 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is no sin upon you if you divorce women while you have not yet touched them or settled a dowry for them. Yet provide for them —the well-off according to his capacity, and the poorly-off according to his capacity— with a sustenance that is honourable, an obligation on the virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:237 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if you divorce them before you touch them, and you have already settled a dowry for them, then [pay them] half of what you have settled, unless they forgo it, or someone in whose hand is the marriage tie forgoes it.1 And to forgo is nearer to Godwariness; so do not forget graciousness among yourselves. Indeed Allah sees best what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:238 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Be watchful of your prayers, and [especially] the middle prayer,1 and stand in obedience2 to Allah;

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:239 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and should you fear [a danger], then [pray] on foot or mounted, and when you are safe, remember Allah, as He taught you what you did not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if you do not—and you will not— then beware the Fire whose fuel will be humans and stones, prepared for the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:240 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those of you who die leaving wives shall bequeath for their wives providing for a year, without turning them out; but if they leave, there is no sin upon you in respect of what they may do with themselves observing honourable norms. And Allah is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:241 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For the divorced women there shall be a provision, in accordance with honourable norms —an obligation on the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:242 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus does Allah clarify His signs to you so that you may apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:243 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded those who left their homes in thousands, apprehensive of death, whereupon Allah said to them, 'Die,' then He revived them? Indeed Allah is gracious to mankind, but most people do not give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:244 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Fight in the way of Allah, and know that Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:245 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Who is it that will lend Allah a good loan that He may multiply it for him severalfold? And Allah tightens and expands [the means of life], and to Him you shall be brought back.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:246 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded the elite of the Israelites after Moses, when they said to their prophet, 'Appoint for us a king, that we may fight in the way of Allah.' He said, 'May it not be that you will not fight if fighting were prescribed for you?' They said, 'Why should we not fight in the way of Allah, when we have been expelled from our homes and [separated from] our children?' So when fighting was prescribed for them, they turned back except a few of them, and Allah knows best the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:247 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Their prophet said to them, 'Allah has appointed Saul as king for you.' They said, 'How can he have kingship over us, when we have a greater right to kingship than him, as he has not been given ample wealth?' He said, 'Indeed Allah has chosen him over you, and enhanced him vastly in knowledge and physique, and Allah gives His kingdom to whomever He wishes, and Allah is all-bounteous, all-knowing.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:248 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Their prophet said to them, 'Indeed the sign of his kingship shall be that the Ark will come to you, bearing tranquillity from your Lord and the relics left behind by the House of Moses and the House of Aaron, borne by the angels. There is indeed a sign in that for you, should you be faithful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:249 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As Saul set out with the troops, he said, 'Allah will test you with a stream: anyone who drinks from it will not belong to me, but those who do not drink from it will belong to me, barring someone who draws a scoop with his hand.' But they drank from it, [all] except a few of them. So when he crossed it along with the faithful who were with him, they said, 'We have no strength today against Goliath and his troops.' Those who were certain they will encounter Allah said, 'How many a small party has overcome a larger party by Allah's will! And Allah is with the patient.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And give good news to those who have faith and do righteous deeds, that for them shall be gardens with streams running in them: whenever they are provided with their fruit for nourishment, they will say, 'This is what we were provided before,' and they were given something resembling it. In it there will be chaste mates for them, and they will remain in it [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:250 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when they marched out for [encounter with] Goliath and his troops, they said, 'Our Lord, pour patience upon us, make our feet steady, and assist us against the faithless lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:251 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus they routed them with Allah's will, and David killed Goliath, and Allah gave him the kingdom and wisdom, and taught him whatever He liked. Were it not for Allah's repelling the people by means of one another, the earth would surely have been corrupted; but Allah is gracious to the world's creatures.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:252 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These are the signs of Allah which We recite for you in truth, and you are indeed one of the apostles.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:253 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These are the apostles, some of whom We gave an advantage over others: of them are those to whom Allah spoke, and some of them He raised in rank, and We gave Jesus, son of Mary, manifest proofs and strengthened him with the Holy Spirit. Had Allah wished, those who succeeded them would not have fought each other after the manifest proofs had come to them. But they differed. So there were among them those who had faith and there were among them those who were faithless, and had Allah wished, they would not have fought one another; but Allah does whatever He desires.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:254 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Spend out of what We have provided you before there comes a day on which there will be no bargaining, neither friendship, nor intercession. And the faithless—they are the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:255 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah—there is no god except Him— is the Living One, the All-sustainer. Neither drowsiness befalls Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that may intercede with Him except with His permission? He knows that which is before them and that which is behind them, and they do not comprehend anything of His knowledge except what He wishes. His seat embraces the heavens and the earth, and He is not wearied by their preservation, and He is the All-exalted, the All-supreme.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:256 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is no compulsion in religion: rectitude has become distinct from error. So one who disavows the Rebels1 and has faith in Allah has held fast to the firmest handle for which there is no breaking; and Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:257 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah is the Guardian of the faithful: He brings them out of darkness into light. As for the faithless, their patrons are the Rebels, who drive them out of light into darkness. They shall be the inmates of the Fire, and they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:258 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded him1 who argued with Abraham about his Lord, because Allah had given him kingdom? When Abraham said, 'My Lord is He who gives life and brings death,' he replied, 'I [too] give life and bring death.' Abraham said, 'Indeed Allah brings the sun from the east; now you bring it from the west.' Thereat the faithless one was dumbfounded. And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:259 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Or him1 who came upon a township as it lay fallen on its trellises. He said, 'How will Allah revive this after its death?!' So Allah made him die for a hundred years, then He resurrected him. He said, 'How long have you remained?' Said he, 'I have remained a day or part of a day.' He said, 'Rather you have remained a hundred years. Now look at your food and drink which have not rotted! Then look at your ass! [This was done] that We may make you a sign for mankind. And look at the bones, how We arrange them and then clothe them with flesh!' When it became evident to him, he said, 'I know that Allah has power over all things.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah is not ashamed to draw a parable whether it is that of a gnat or something above it. As for those who have faith, they know it is the truth from their Lord; and as for the faithless, they say, 'What did Allah mean by this parable?' Thereby He leads many astray, and thereby He guides many; and He leads no one astray thereby except the transgressors

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:260 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when Abraham said, 'My Lord! Show me how You revive the dead,' He said, 'Do you not believe?' He said, 'Yes indeed, but in order that my heart may be at rest.' He said, 'Take four of the birds. Then cut them into pieces, and place a part of them on every mountain, then call them; they will come to you hastening. And know that Allah is all-mighty and all-wise.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:261 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The parable of those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah is that of a grain which grows seven ears, in every ear a hundred grains. Allah enhances severalfold whomever He wishes, and Allah is all-bounteous, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:262 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah and then do not follow up what they have spent with reproaches1 and affronts, they shall have their reward near their Lord, and they will have no fear, nor will they grieve.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:263 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: An honourable word with pardon is better than a charity followed by affront. Allah is all-sufficient, most forbearing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:264 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not render your charities void by reproaches and affronts, like those who spend their wealth to be seen by people and have no faith in Allah and the Last Day. Their parable1 is that of a rock covered with soil: a downpour strikes it, leaving it bare. They have no power over anything of what they have earned, and Allah does not guide the faithless lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:265 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The parable of those who spend their wealth seeking Allah's pleasure and to confirm themselves, is that of a garden on a hillside: the downpour strikes it, whereupon it brings forth its fruit twofold; and if it is not a downpour that strikes it, then a shower, and Allah sees best what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:266 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Would any of you like to have a garden of palm trees and vines, with streams running in it, with all kinds of fruit for him therein, and old age were to strike him while he has weakly offspring; whereupon a fiery hurricane were to hit it, whereat it lies burnt? Thus does Allah clarify His signs for you so that you may reflect.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:267 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Spend of the good things you have earned, and of what We bring forth for you from the earth, and do not be of the mind to give the bad part of it, for you yourselves would not take it, unless you overlook it. And know that Allah is all-sufficient, all-laudable.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:268 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Satan frightens you of poverty and prompts you to [commit] indecent acts. But Allah promises you His forgiveness and grace, and Allah is all-bounteous, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:269 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He gives wisdom to whomever He wishes, and he who is given wisdom, is certainly given an abundant good. But none takes admonition except those who possess intellect.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those who break the covenant made with Allah after having pledged it solemnly, and sever what Allah has commanded to be joined, and cause corruption on the earth— it is they who are the losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:270 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whatever charity you may give, or vows that you may vow, Allah indeed knows it, and the wrongdoers have no helpers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:271 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you disclose your charities, that is well, but if you hide them and give them to the poor, that is better for you, and it will atone for some of your misdeeds, and Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:272 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is not up to you to guide them; rather it is Allah who guides whomever He wishes. And whatever wealth you spend, it is for your own benefit, as you do not spend but to seek Allah's pleasure, and whatever wealth you spend will be repaid to you in full, and you will not be wronged.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:273 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [The charities are] for the poor who are straitened in the way of Allah,1 not capable of moving about in the land [for trade]. The unaware suppose them to be well-off because of their reserve. You recognize them by their mark; they do not ask the people importunately. And whatever wealth you may spend, Allah indeed knows it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:274 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who give their wealth by night and day, secretly and openly, they shall have their reward near their Lord, and they will have no fear, nor will they grieve.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:275 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who exact usury will not stand but like one deranged by the Devil's touch. That is because they say, 'Trade is just like usury.' While Allah has allowed trade and forbidden usury. Whoever, on receiving advice from his Lord, relinquishes [usury], shall keep [the gains of] what is past, and his matter shall rest with Allah. As for those who resume, they shall be the inmates of the Fire and they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:276 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah brings usury to naught, but He makes charities flourish. Allah does not like any sinful ingrate.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:277 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who have faith, do righteous deeds, maintain the prayer and give the zakāt, they shall have their reward near their Lord, and they will have no fear, nor will they grieve.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:278 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Be wary of Allah, and abandon [all claims to] what remains of usury, should you be faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:279 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if you do not, then be informed of a war from Allah and His apostle. And if you repent, then you will have your principal, neither harming others, nor suffering harm.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How can you be unfaithful to Allah, [seeing that] you were lifeless and He gave you life, then He will make you die, and then He shall bring you to life, and then you will be brought back to Him?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:280 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if [the debtor] is in straits, let there be a respite until the time of ease; and if you remit [the debt] as charity, it will be better for you, should you know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:281 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And beware of a day in which you will be brought back to Allah. Then every soul shall be recompensed fully for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:282 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! When you contract a loan for a specified term, write it down. Let a writer write between you with honesty, and let not the writer refuse to write as Allah has taught him. So let him write, and let the one who incurs the debt dictate, and let him be wary of Allah, his Lord, and not diminish anything from it. But if the debtor be feeble-minded, or weak, or incapable of dictating himself, then let his guardian dictate with honesty, and take as witness two witnesses from your men, and if there are not two men, then a man and two women —from those whom you approve as witnesses— so that if one of the two defaults the other will remind her. The witnesses must not refuse when they are called, and do not…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:283 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you are on a journey and cannot find a writer, then a retained pledge [shall suffice]. And if one of you entrusts to another, let him who is trusted deliver his trust, and let him be wary of Allah, his Lord. And do not conceal testimony; anyone who conceals it, his heart will indeed be sinful. And Allah knows best what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:284 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth; and whether you disclose what is in your hearts or hide it, Allah will bring you to account for it. Then He will forgive whomever He wishes and punish whomever He wishes, and Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:285 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Apostle has faith in what has been sent down to him from his Lord, and all the faithful. Each [of them] has faith in Allah, His angels, His scriptures and His apostles. [They declare,] 'We make no distinction between any of His apostles.' And they say, 'We hear and obey. Our Lord, forgive us, and toward You is the return.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:286 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah does not task any soul beyond its capacity. Whatever [good] it earns is to its benefit, and whatever [evil] it incurs is to its harm.'Our Lord! Take us not to task if we forget or make mistakes! Our Lord! Place not upon us a burden as You placed on those who were before us! Our Lord! Lay not upon us what we have no strength to bear! Excuse us and forgive us, and be merciful to us! You are our Master, so help us against the faithless lot!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who created for you all that is in the earth, then He turned to the heaven, and fashioned it into seven heavens, and He has knowledge of all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who believe in the Unseen, and maintain the prayer, and spend1 out of what We have provided for them;

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When your Lord said to the angels, 'Indeed I am going to set a viceroy on the earth,' they said, 'Will You set in it someone who will cause corruption in it, and shed blood, while we celebrate Your praise and proclaim Your sanctity?' He said, 'Indeed I know what you do not know.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And He taught Adam the Names, all of them;1 then presented them2 to the angels and said, 'Tell me the names of these, if you are truthful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Immaculate are You! We have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed You are the All-knowing, the All-wise.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'O Adam, inform them1 of their names,' and when he had informed them of their names, He said, 'Did I not tell you that I indeed know the Unseen in the heavens and the earth, and that I know whatever you disclose and whatever you were concealing?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when We said to the angels, 'Prostrate before Adam,' they prostrated, but not Iblis: he refused and acted arrogantly, and he was one of the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We said, 'O Adam, dwell with your mate in paradise, and eat thereof freely whencesoever you wish; but do not approach this tree, lest you should be among the wrongdoers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then Satan caused them to stumble from it, and he dislodged them from what they were in; and We said, 'Get down, being enemies of one another! On the earth shall be your abode and sustenance for a time.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then Adam received certain words from his Lord, and He turned to him clemently. Indeed He is the All-clement, the All-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We said, 'Get down from it, all together! Yet, should any guidance come to you from Me, those who follow My guidance shall have no fear, nor shall they grieve.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But those who are faithless and deny Our signs, they shall be the inmates of the Fire and they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and who believe in what has been sent down to you1 and what was sent down before you, and are certain of the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Children of Israel, remember My blessing which I bestowed upon you, and fulfill My covenant that I may fulfill your covenant, and be in awe of Me [alone].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And believe in that which I have sent down confirming that which is with you, and do not be the first ones to defy it, and do not sell My signs for a paltry gain, and be wary of Me [alone].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And do not mix the truth with falsehood, nor conceal the truth while you know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And maintain the prayer, and give the zakāt, and bow along with those who bow [in prayer].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Will you bid others to piety and forget yourselves, while you recite the Book? Do you not apply reason?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And take recourse in patience and prayer, and it1 is indeed hard except for the humble

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those who are certain that they will encounter their Lord, and that they will return to Him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Children of Israel, remember My blessing which I bestowed upon you, and that I gave you an advantage over all the nations.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Beware of the day when no soul shall compensate for another, neither any intercession shall be accepted from it, nor any ransom shall be received from it, nor will they be helped.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when We delivered you from Pharaoh's clan who inflicted a terrible torment on you, and slaughtered your sons and spared your women, and in that there was a great test from your Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those follow their Lord's guidance, and it is they who are the felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when We parted the sea with you,1 and We delivered you and drowned Pharaoh's clan as you looked on.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when We made an appointment with Moses for forty nights, you took up the Calf [for worship] in his absence, and you were wrongdoers.
