item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We excused you after that so that you might give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when We gave Moses the Book and the Criterion1 so that you might be guided.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, 'O my people! You have indeed wronged yourselves by taking up the Calf [for worship]. Now turn penitently to your Maker, and slay [the guilty among] your folks. That will be better for you with your Maker.' Then He turned to you clemently. Indeed He is the All-clement, the All-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when you said, 'O Moses, we will not believe you until we see Allah visibly.' Thereupon a thunderbolt seized you as you looked on.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We raised you up after your death so that you might give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We shaded you with clouds, and We sent down to you manna and quails: 'Eat of the good things We have provided for you.' And they did not wrong Us, but they used to wrong [only] themselves.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when We said, 'Enter this town,1 and eat thereof freely whencesoever you wish, and enter prostrating at the gate, and say, "Relieve [us of the burden of our sins],"2 that We may forgive your iniquities, and soon We will enhance the virtuous.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But the wrongdoers changed the saying with other than what they were told. So We sent down on those who were wrongdoers a plague from the sky because of the transgressions they used to commit.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the faithless, it is the same to them whether you warn them or do not warn them, they will not have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when Moses prayed for water for his people, We said, 'Strike the rock with your staff.' Thereat twelve fountains gushed forth from it; every tribe came to know its drinking-place. 'Eat and drink of Allah's provision, and do not act wickedly on the earth, causing corruption.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when you said, 'O Moses, 'We will not put up with one kind of food. So invoke your Lord for us, that He may bring forth for us of that which the earth grows —its greens and its cucumbers, its garlic, its lentils, and its onions.' He said, 'Do you seek to replace what is superior with that which is inferior? Go down to any town and you will indeed get what you ask for!' So they were struck with abasement and poverty, and they earned Allah's wrath. That, because they would defy the signs of Allah and kill the prophets unjustly. That, because they would disobey and used to commit transgression.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the faithful, the Jews, the Christians, and the Sabaeans —those of them who have faith in Allah and the Last Day and act righteously— they shall have their reward near their Lord, and they will have no fear, nor will they grieve.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when We took a pledge from you, and raised the Mount above you [declaring], 'Hold on with power to what We have given you, and remember that which is in it, so that you may be Godwary.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then after that you turned away; and were it not for Allah's grace on you and His mercy, you would surely have been among the losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And certainly you know those of you who violated the Sabbath, whereupon We said to them, 'Be you spurned apes.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We made it an exemplary punishment for the present and the succeeding [generations], and an advice to the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when Moses said to his people, 'Indeed Allah commands you to slaughter a cow,' they said, 'Do you take us in derision?' He said, 'I seek Allah's protection lest I should be one of the senseless!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Invoke your Lord for us, that He may clarify for us what she may be.' He said, 'He says, She is a cow, neither old nor young, of a middle age. Now do what you are commanded.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Invoke your Lord for us, that He may clarify for us what her colour may be.' He said, 'He says, She is a cow that is yellow, of a bright hue, pleasing to the onlookers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has set a seal on their hearts and their hearing, and there is a blindfold on their sight,1 and there is a great punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Invoke your Lord for us, that He may clarify for us what she may be. Indeed all cows are much alike to us, and, if Allah wishes, we will surely be guided.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'He says, She is a cow not broken to till the earth or to water the tillage, sound and without blemish.' They said, 'Now have you come up with the truth!' And they slaughtered it, though they were about not to do it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when you killed a soul, and accused one another about it —and Allah was to expose whatever you were concealing—

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We said, 'Strike him with a piece of it:' thus does Allah revive the dead, and He shows you His signs so that you may apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then your hearts hardened after that; so they are like stones, or even harder. For indeed there are some stones from which streams gush forth, and indeed there are some of them that split, and water issues from them, and indeed there are some of them that fall for the fear of Allah. And Allah is not oblivious of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Are you then eager that they should believe you,1 though a part of them would hear the word of Allah and then they would distort it2 after they had understood it, and they knew [what they were doing]?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they meet the faithful, they say, 'We believe,' and when they are alone with one another, they say, 'Do you recount to them what Allah has revealed to you, so that they may argue with you therewith before your Lord? Do you not apply reason?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they not know that Allah knows whatever they hide and whatever they disclose?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And among them are the illiterate who know nothing of the Book except hearsay,1 and they only make conjectures.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So woe to those who write the Book with their hands and then say, 'This is from Allah,' that they may sell it for a paltry gain. So woe to them for what their hands have written, and woe to them for what they earn!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And among the people are those who say, 'We have faith in Allah and the Last Day,' but they have no faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they say, 'The Fire shall not touch us except for a number of days.' Say, 'Have you taken a promise from Allah? If so, Allah shall never break His promise. Or do you ascribe to Allah what you do not know?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly whoever commits misdeeds and is besieged by his iniquity —such shall be the inmates of the Fire, and they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And those who have faith and do righteous deeds, —they shall be the inhabitants of paradise; they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when We took a pledge from the Children of Israel: 'Worship no one but Allah, do good to parents, relatives, orphans, and the needy, and speak kindly to people, and maintain the prayer, and give the zakāt,' you turned away, except a few of you, and you were disregardful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when We took a pledge from you: 'You shall not shed your [own people's] blood, and you shall not expel your folks from your homes,' you pledged, and you testify1 [to this pledge of your ancestors].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then there you were, killing your folks and expelling a part of your folks from their homes, backing one another against them in sin and aggression! And if they came to you as captives, you would ransom them, though their expulsion itself was forbidden you. What! Do you believe in part of the Book and defy another part? So what is the requital of those of you who do that except disgrace in the life of this world? And on the Day of Resurrection, they shall be consigned to the severest punishment. And Allah is not oblivious of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are the ones who bought the life of this world for the Hereafter; so their punishment shall not be lightened, nor will they be helped.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We gave Moses the Book, and followed him with the apostles, and We gave Jesus, the son of Mary, manifest proofs, and confirmed him with the Holy Spirit. Is it not that whenever an apostle brought you1 that which was not to your liking, you would act arrogantly; so you would impugn a part [of them], and slay a[nother] part?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they say, 'Our hearts are uncircumcised.'1 Rather Allah has cursed them for their unfaith, so few of them have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when there came to them a Book from Allah, confirming that which is with them —and earlier they would pray for victory over the pagans— so when there came to them what they recognized, they defied it. So may the curse of Allah be on the faithless!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They seek to deceive Allah and those who have faith, yet they deceive no one but themselves, but they are not aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Evil is that for which they have sold their souls, by defying what Allah has sent down, out of envy, that Allah should bestow His grace on any of His servants that He wishes. Thus they earned wrath upon wrath, and there is a humiliating punishment for the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when they are told, 'Believe in what Allah has sent down,' they say, 'We believe in what was sent down to us,' and they disbelieve what is besides it, though it is the truth confirming what is with them. Say, 'Then why would you kill the prophets of Allah formerly, should you be faithful?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly Moses brought you manifest proofs, but then you took up the Calf in his absence, and you were wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when We took covenant with you and raised the Mount above you [declaring], 'Hold on with power to what We have given you, and listen!' They said, 'We hear, and disobey,' and their hearts had been imbued with [the love of] the Calf, due to their faithlessness. Say, 'Evil is that to which your faith prompts you, should you be faithful!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'If the abode of the Hereafter with Allah were exclusively for you, and not for other people, then long for death, should you be truthful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But they will not long for it ever because of what their hands have sent ahead,1 and Allah knows best the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Surely, you will find them the greediest for life, of all people ⎯even the idolaters. Each of them is eager to live a thousand years, though it would not deliver him from the punishment, were he to live [that long]. And Allah sees best what they do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Whoever is an enemy of Gabriel [should know that] it is he who has brought it down on your heart with the will of Allah, confirming what has been [revealed] before it, and as a guidance and good news to the faithful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [Say,] 'Whoever is an enemy of Allah, His angels and His apostles, and Gabriel and Michael, [let him know that] Allah is indeed the enemy of the faithless.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Baqara:99 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have certainly sent down manifest signs to you, and no one defies them except transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Bayyina:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithless from among the People of the Book and the polytheists were not set apart until the proof had come to them:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Bayyina:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: an apostle from Allah reciting impeccable scriptures,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Bayyina:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: wherein are upright writings.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Bayyina:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And those who were given the Book did not divide, except after the proof had come to them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Bayyina:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yet they were not commanded except to worship Allah, dedicating their faith to Him as men of pure faith, and to maintain the prayer and pay the zakāt. That is the upright religion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Bayyina:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the faithless from among the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the fire of hell, to remain in it [forever]. It is they who are the worst of creatures.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Bayyina:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who have faith and do righteous deeds —it is they who are the best of creatures.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Bayyina:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Their reward, near their Lord, is the Gardens of Eden, with streams running in them, to remain in them forever. Allah is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. That is for those who fear their Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the sky with its houses,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who persecute the faithful men and women, and then do not repent, for them there is the punishment of hell, and for them there is the punishment of burning.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who have faith and do righteous deeds, —for them will be gardens with streams running in them. That is the supreme success.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed your Lord's striking is severe.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is indeed He who originates and brings back again,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and He is the All-forgiving, the All-affectionate,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Lord of the Throne, the All-glorious,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: doer of what He desires.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did you receive the story of the hosts

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: of Pharaoh and Thamūd?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather the faithless dwell in denial,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the Promised Day,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and Allah besieges them from all around.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather it is a glorious Qur'ān,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: in a preserved tablet.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the Witness1 and the Witnessed:2

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: perish the Men of the Ditch!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The fire, abounding in fuel,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: above which they sat

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: as they were themselves witnesses to what they did to the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They were vindictive towards them only because they had faith in Allah, the All-mighty, the All-laudable,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Burooj:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is witness to all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Faatiha:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Faatiha:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: All praise belongs to Allah,1 Lord of all the worlds,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Faatiha:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the All-beneficent, the All-merciful,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Faatiha:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Master1 of the Day of Retribution.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Faatiha:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You [alone] do we worship, and to You [alone] do we turn for help.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Faatiha:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Guide us on the straight path,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Faatiha:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the path of those whom You have blessed1 —such as2 have not incurred Your wrath,3 nor are astray.4

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the Dawn,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and Pharaoh, the impaler,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those who rebelled [against Allah] in their cities

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and caused much corruption in them,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so your Lord poured on them lashes of punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed your Lord is in ambush.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for man, whenever his Lord tests him and grants him honour and blesses him, he says, 'My Lord has honoured me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But when He tests him and tightens for him his provision, he says, 'My Lord has humiliated me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! Rather you do not honour the orphan,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and do not urge the feeding of the needy,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and you eat the inheritance rapaciously,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the ten nights,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and you love wealth with much fondness.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! When the earth is levelled1 to a plain,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and your Lord and the angels arrive in ranks,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the day when hell is brought [near], on that day man will take admonition but what will the admonition avail him?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He will say, 'Alas, had I sent ahead for my life!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On that day none shall punish as He punishes,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and none shall bind as He binds.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'O soul at peace!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Return to your Lord, pleased, pleasing!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then enter among My servants!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the Even and the Odd,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And enter My paradise!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the night when it departs!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is there an oath in that for one possessing intellect?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded how your Lord dealt with [the people of] 'Ād,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [and] Iram, [the city] of the pillars,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the like of which was not created among cities,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fajr:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and [the people of] Thamūd, who hollowed out the rocks in the valley,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Falaq:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I seek the protection of the Lord of the daybreak

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Falaq:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: from the evil of what He has created,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Falaq:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and from the evil of the dark night when it settles,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Falaq:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and from the evil of the witches who blow on knots,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Falaq:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and from the evil of the envious one when he envies.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have inaugurated for you a clear victory,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who swear allegiance to you, swear allegiance only to Allah: the hand of Allah is above their hands. So whosoever breaks his oath, breaks it only to his own detriment, and whoever fulfills the covenant he has made with Allah, He will give him a great reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Bedouins who were left behind will tell you, 'Our possessions and our families kept us occupied. So plead [to Allah] for our forgiveness!' They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say, 'Who can be of any avail to you against Allah, should He desire to cause you harm or desire to bring you benefit? Rather Allah is well aware of what you do.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather you thought that the Apostle and the faithful will not return to their folk ever, and that was made to seem decorous to your hearts, and you entertained evil thoughts, and you were a ruined lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who have no faith in Allah and His Apostle, We have prepared a blaze for the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth: He forgives whomever He wishes, and punishes whomever He wishes, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who were left to stay behind will say, when you set out to capture booty: 'Let us follow you.' They desire to change the word of Allah. Say, 'You shall never follow us! Thus has Allah said beforehand.' Then they will say, 'You are envious of us.' Rather they do not understand but a little.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say to the Bedouins who were left to stay behind, 'You will be called against a people of a great might: they will embrace Islam, or you will fight them. So if you obey, Allah will give you a good reward; but if you turn away like you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is no blame on the blind, nor is there any blame on the lame, nor is there blame on the sick; and whoever obeys Allah and His Apostle, He will admit him into gardens with streams running in them, and whoever refuses to comply, He will punish him with a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah was certainly pleased with the faithful when they swore allegiance to you under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down composure on them, and requited them with a victory near at hand

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and abundant spoils that they will capture, and Allah is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that Allah may forgive you what is past of your sin and what is to come, and that He may perfect His blessing upon you and guide you on a straight path,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has promised you abundant spoils which you will capture. He has expedited this one for you, and withheld men's hands from you, so that it may be a sign for the faithful, and that He may guide you to a straight path.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And other [spoils] which you have not yet captured: Allah has comprehended them, and Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If the faithless fight you, they will turn their backs [to flee]. Then they will not find any protector or helper.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [It is] Allah's precedent that has passed before, and you will never find in Allah's precedent any change.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who withheld their hands from you, and your hands from them, in the valley of Makkah, after He had given you victory over them, and Allah sees best what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are the ones who disbelieved and barred you from the Sacred Mosque, and kept the offering from reaching its destination. And were it not for [certain] faithful men and faithful women, whom you did not know —lest you should trample them, and thus blame for [killing] them should fall on you unawares;1 [He held you back] so that Allah may admit into His mercy whomever He wishes. And had they been separate, We would have surely punished the faithless among them with a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the faithless nourished bigotry in their hearts, the bigotry of pagan ignorance, Allah sent down His composure upon His Apostle and upon the faithful, and made them abide by the word of Godwariness, for they were the worthiest of it and deserved it, and Allah has knowledge of all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly Allah has fulfilled His Apostle's vision in all truth: You will surely enter the Sacred Mosque, God willing, in safety, with your heads shaven or hair cropped, without any fear. So He knew what you did not know, and He assigned [you] besides that a victory near at hand.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who has sent His Apostle with guidance and the true religion, that He may make it prevail over all religions, and Allah suffices as witness.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Muḥammad, the Apostle of Allah, and those who are with him are hard against the faithless and merciful amongst themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in worship], seeking Allah's grace and [His] pleasure. Their mark is [visible] on their faces, from the effect of prostration. Such is their description in the Torah and their description in the Evangel. Like a tillage that sends out its shoots and builds them up, and they grow stout and settle on their stalks, impressing the sowers, so that He may enrage the faithless by them. Allah has promised those of them who have faith and do righteous deeds forgiveness and a great reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and Allah will help you with a mighty help.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who sent down composure into the hearts of the faithful that they might enhance their faith. To Allah belong the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That He may admit the faithful, men and women, into gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them [forever], and that He may absolve them of their misdeeds. That is a great success with Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That He may punish the hypocrites, men and women, and the polytheists, men and women, who entertain a bad opinion of Allah. For them shall be an adverse turn of fortune: Allah is wrathful with them and He has cursed them, and prepared for them hell, and it is an evil destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belong the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have sent you as a witness, and as a bearer of good news and warner,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fath:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that you may have faith in Allah and His Apostle, and that you may support him and revere him, and that you may glorify Him morning and evening.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fil:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded how your Lord dealt with the Men of the Elephant?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fil:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did He not make their stratagems go awry,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fil:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and send against them flocks of birds

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fil:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: pelting them with stones of shale,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Fil:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: thus making them like chewed-up straw?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion to His servant that he may be a warner to all the nations.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Blessed is He who will grant you better than that if He wishes —gardens with streams running in them, and He will make for you palaces.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather they deny the Hour, and We have prepared a Blaze for those who deny the Hour.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When it1 sights them from a distant place, they will hear it raging and roaring.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when they are cast into a narrow place in it, bound together [in chains], they will pray for [their own] annihilation.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [They will be told:] 'Do not pray for a single annihilation today, but pray for many annihilations!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Is that better, or the everlasting paradise promised to the Godwary, which will be their reward and destination?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There they will have whatever they wish, abiding [forever], a promise [much] besought, [binding] on your Lord.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On the day that He will muster them and those whom they worship besides Allah, He will say, 'Was it you who led astray these servants of Mine, or did they themselves stray from the way?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, 'Immaculate are You! It does not behoove us to take any guardians in Your stead! But You provided for them and their fathers until they forgot the Reminder, and they were a ruined lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So they will certainly impugn you in what you say, and you will neither be able to circumvent [punishment] nor find help, and whoever of you does wrong, We shall make him taste a terrible punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He, to whom belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and who did not take a son, nor has He any partner in sovereignty, and He created everything and determined it in a precise measure.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not send any apostles before you but that they indeed ate food and walked in marketplaces. We have made you a trial for one another, [to see] if you will be patient, and your Lord is all-seeing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who do not expect to encounter Us say, 'Why have angels not been sent down to us, or why do we not see our Lord?' Certainly they are full of arrogance within their souls and have become terribly defiant.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day when they see the angels, there will be no good news for the guilty that day, and they1 will say, 'Keep off [from paradise]!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We shall attend to the works they have done and then turn them into scattered dust.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On that day the inhabitants of paradise will be in the best abode and an excellent resting place.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day when the sky with its clouds will split open, and the angels will be sent down [in a majestic] descent,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: on that day true sovereignty will belong to the All-beneficent, and it will be a hard day for the faithless.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A day when the wrongdoer will bite his hands, saying, 'I wish I had followed the Apostle's way!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Woe to me! I wish I had not taken so and so as a friend!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly he led me astray from the Reminder after it had come to me, and Satan is a deserter of man.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yet they have taken gods besides Him who create nothing and have themselves been created, and who have no control over their own harm or benefit and have no control over [their own] death, or life, or resurrection.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And the Apostle will say, 'O my Lord! Indeed my people consigned this Qur'ān to oblivion.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is how for every prophet We assigned an enemy from among the guilty, and your Lord suffices as helper and guide.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithless say, 'Why has not the Qur'ān been sent down to him all at once?' So it is, that We may strengthen your heart with it, and We have recited it [to you] in a measured tone.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They do not bring you any poser but that We bring you the truth [in reply to them] and the best exposition.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who will be mustered on their faces toward hell, they are the worse situated and further astray from the [right] way.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We gave Moses the Book and We made Aaron, his brother, accompany him as a minister.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We said, 'Let the two of you go to the people who have denied Our signs.' Then We destroyed them utterly.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And Noah's people, We drowned them when they impugned the apostles, and We made them a sign for mankind, and We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And 'Ād and Thamūd, and the inhabitants of Rass, and many generations between them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For each of them We drew examples, and each We destroyed utterly.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithless say, 'This is nothing but a lie that he has fabricated, and other people have abetted him in it.' Thus they have certainly come out with wrongdoing and falsehood.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly they must have passed the town on which an evil shower was rained. Have they not seen it? Rather they did not expect resurrection.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they see you they just take you in derision: 'Is this the one whom Allah has sent as an apostle!?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed he was about to lead us astray from our gods, had we not stood by them.' Soon they will know, when they sight the punishment, who is further astray from the [right] way.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you seen him who has taken his desire to be his god? Is it your duty to watch over him?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you suppose that most of them listen or apply reason? They are just like cattle; rather they are further astray from the way.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded how your Lord spreads the twilight?1 (Had He wished He would have made it still.) Then We made the sun a beacon for it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We retract it toward Ourselves, with a gentle retracting.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who made for you the night as a covering and sleep for rest and He made the day a recall to life.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And it is He who sends the winds as harbingers of His mercy, and We send down from the sky purifying water,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: with which We revive a dead country and provide water to many of the cattle and humans We have created.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'He has taken down myths of the ancients, and they are dictated to him morning and evening.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We distribute it among them so that they may take admonition. But most people are only intent on ingratitude.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had We wished, We would have sent a warner to every town.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So do not obey the faithless, but wage against them a great jihād with it.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who merged the two seas: this one sweet and agreeable, and that one briny and bitter, and between the two He set a barrier and a forbidding hindrance.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who created the human being from water, then invested him with ties of blood and marriage, and your Lord is all-powerful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They worship besides Allah that which neither brings them any benefit nor causes them any harm, and the faithless one is ever an abettor against his Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not send you except as a bearer of good news and as a warner.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I do not ask you any reward for it, except that anyone who wishes should take the way to his Lord.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Put your trust in the Living One who does not die, and celebrate His praise. He suffices as one all-aware of the sins of His servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He, who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days, and then settled on the Throne, the All-beneficent; so ask someone who is well aware about Him.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'It has been sent down by Him who knows the hidden in the heavens and the earth. Indeed He is all-forgiving, all-merciful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they are told: 'Prostrate yourselves before the All-beneficent,' they say, 'What is "the All-beneficent"? Shall we prostrate ourselves before whatever you bid us?' And it increases their aversion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Blessed is He who appointed houses in the sky and set in it a lamp and a shining moon.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who made the night and the day alternate for one who desires to take admonition, or desires to give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The servants of the All-beneficent are those who walk humbly on the earth, and when the ignorant address them, say, 'Peace!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who spend the night for their Lord, prostrating and standing [in worship].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who say, 'Our Lord! Turn away from us the punishment of hell. Indeed its punishment is enduring.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it is an evil abode and place.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who, when spending, are neither wasteful nor tightfisted, and moderation lies between these [extremes].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who do not invoke another god besides Allah, and do not kill a soul [whose life] Allah has made inviolable, except with due cause, and do not commit fornication. (Whoever does that shall encounter its retribution,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the punishment being doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection. In it he will abide in humiliation forever,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they say, 'What sort of apostle is this who eats food and walks in the marketplaces? Why has not an angel been sent down to him so as to be a warner along with him?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: excepting those who repent, attain faith, and act righteously. For such, Allah will replace their misdeeds with good deeds,1 and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And whoever repents and acts righteously indeed turns to Allah with due penitence).

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who do not give false testimony,1 and when they come upon vain talk, pass by nobly.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who, when reminded of the signs of their Lord, do not turn a deaf ear and a blind eye to them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And those who say, 'Our Lord! Grant us comfort in our spouses and descendants, and make us _imam_s of the Godwary.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those shall be rewarded with sublime abodes for their patience, and they shall be met there with greetings and 'Peace,'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: to abide in them [forever], an excellent abode and place.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'What store my Lord would set by you were it not for your supplication?1 But you impugned [me and my advice], so that will continue to haunt you.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Or, '[Why is not] a treasure thrown to him, or [why does] he [not] have a garden from which he may eat?' And the wrongdoers say, 'You are just following a bewitched man.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Furqaan:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Look, how they draw comparisons for you; so they go astray, and cannot find the way.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ḥā, Mīm:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it will be proclaimed to the faithless: 'Surely Allah's outrage [towards you] is greater than your outrage towards yourselves, as you were invited to faith, but you disbelieved.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, 'Our Lord! Twice did You make us die, and twice did You give us life. We admit our sins. Is there any way out [from this plight]?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This [plight of yours] is because, when Allah was invoked alone, you would disbelieve, but if partners were ascribed to Him you would believe. So the judgment belongs to Allah, the All-exalted, the All-great.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who shows you His signs and sends down for you provision from the sky. Yet no one takes admonition except him who returns penitently [to Allah].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So supplicate Allah, putting exclusive faith in Him, though the faithless should be averse.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Raiser of ranks, Lord of the Throne, He casts the Spirit of His command upon whomever of His servants that He wishes, that he may warn [people] of the Day of Encounter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day when they will emerge [from their graves], nothing about them will be hidden from Allah. 'To whom does the sovereignty belong today?' 'To Allah, the One, the All-paramount!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Today every soul shall be requited for what it has earned. There will be no injustice today. Indeed Allah is swift at reckoning.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Warn them of the Imminent Day1 when the hearts will be at the throats, choking with suppressed agony, [and] the wrongdoers will have no sympathizer, nor any intercessor who might be heard.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He knows the treachery of the eyes,1 and what the breasts hide.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The [gradual] sending down of the Book is from Allah, the All-mighty, the All-knowing,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah judges with justice,1 while those whom they invoke besides Him do not judge by anything. Indeed it is Allah who is the All-hearing, the All-seeing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not traveled over the land so that they may observe how was the fate of those who were before them? They were greater than them in might and with respect to the effects [they left] in the land. But then Allah seized them for their sins, and they had no defender against Allah['s punishment].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That was because their apostles used to bring them manifest proofs, but they defied [them]. So Allah seized them. Indeed He is all-strong, severe in retribution.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We sent Moses with Our signs and a manifest authority

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: to Pharaoh, Hāmān and Korah, but they said, 'A magician, a mendacious liar.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, 'Kill the sons of the faithful who are with him, and spare their women.' But the stratagems1 of the faithless only go awry.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And Pharaoh said, 'Let me slay Moses, and let him invoke his Lord. Indeed I fear that he will change your religion, or bring forth corruption in the land.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Moses said, 'Indeed I seek the protection of my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Said a man of faith from Pharaoh's clan, who concealed his faith, 'Will you kill a man for saying, "My Lord is Allah," while he has already brought you manifest proofs from your Lord? Should he be lying, his falsehood will be to his own detriment; but if he is truthful, there shall visit you some of what he promises you. Indeed Allah does not guide someone who is a profligate, a liar.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O my people! Today sovereignty belongs to you,1 and you are dominant in the land. But who will save us from Allah's punishment should it overtake us?' Pharaoh said, 'I just point out to you what I see [to be advisable for you], and I guide you only to the way of rectitude.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: forgiver of sins and acceptor of repentance, severe in retribution, [yet] all-bountiful, there is no god except Him, [and] toward Him is the destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And he who had faith said, 'O my people! Indeed I fear for you [a day] like the day of the [heathen] factions;

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: like the case of the people of Noah, of 'Ād and Thamūd, and those who were after them, and Allah does not desire any wrong for [His] servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O my people! Indeed I fear for you a day of mutual distress calls,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: a day when you will turn back [to flee], not having anyone to protect you from Allah, and whomever Allah leads astray has no guide.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly Joseph brought you manifest proofs earlier, but you continued to remain in doubt concerning what he had brought you. When he died, you said, "Allah will never send any apostle after him." That is how Allah leads astray those who are profligate, skeptical.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who dispute the signs of Allah without any authority that may have come to them —[that is] greatly outrageous to Allah and to those who have faith. That is how Allah seals the heart of every arrogant tyrant.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And Pharaoh said, 'O Hāmān! Build me a tower so that I may reach the routes1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —the routes of the heavens— and take a look at the God of Moses, and indeed I consider him a liar.' To Pharaoh was thus presented as decorous the evil of his conduct, and he was kept from the way [of Allah], and Pharaoh's stratagems1 only led him into ruin.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And he who had faith said, 'O my people! Follow me, I will guide you to the way of rectitude.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O my people! This life of the world is only a [passing] enjoyment, and indeed the Hereafter is the abiding home.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No one disputes the signs of Allah except the faithless. So do not be misled by their bustle in the towns.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever commits a misdeed shall not be requited except with its like, but whoever acts righteously, whether male or female, should he be faithful —such shall enter paradise, provided therein without any reckoning.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O my people! [Think,] what makes me invite you to deliverance while you invite me toward the Fire?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You invite me to defy Allah and to ascribe to Him partners of which I have no knowledge, while I call you to the All-mighty, the All-forgiver.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Undoubtedly, that to which you invite me has no invitation in the world nor in the Hereafter, and indeed our return will be to Allah, and indeed it is the profligates who will be inmates of the Fire.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Soon you will remember what I tell you, and I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed Allah sees best the servants.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then Allah saved him from their evil schemes, while a terrible punishment besieged Pharaoh's clan:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the Fire, to which they are exposed morning and evening. And on the day when the Hour sets in Pharaoh's clan will enter the severest punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they argue in the Fire, the weak will say to those who were arrogant, 'Indeed we used to follow you; so will you avail us against any portion of the Fire?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who were arrogant will say, 'Indeed we are all [together] in it. Indeed Allah has judged between [His] servants.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those in the Fire will say to the keepers of hell, 'Supplicate your Lord to lighten for us [at least] a day's punishment.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The people of Noah denied before them and the [heathen] factions [who came] after them. Every nation attempted to lay hands on their apostle, and disputed erroneously to refute the truth. Then I seized them; so how was My retribution?!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, 'Did not your apostles use to bring you manifest proofs?' They will say, 'Yes.' They will say, 'Then supplicate [Him] yourselves.' But the supplications of the faithless only go awry.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We shall help Our apostles and those who have faith in the life of the world and on the day when the witnesses rise up

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —the day when the excuses of the wrongdoers will not benefit them, and the curse will lie on them, and for them will be the ills of the [ultimate] abode.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We gave Moses the guidance and We made the Children of Israel heirs to the Book,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: as a guidance and an admonition for those who possess intellect.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So be patient! Allah's promise is indeed true. And plead for [Allah's] forgiveness for your sin, and celebrate the praise of your Lord morning and evening.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who dispute the signs of Allah without any authority that may have come to them —there is only vanity in their breasts, which they will never satisfy. So seek the protection of Allah; indeed He is the All-hearing, the All-seeing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Surely the creation of the heavens and the earth is more prodigious than the creation of mankind,1 but most people do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The blind one and the seer are not equal, neither are those who have faith and do righteous deeds and the evildoing. Little is the admonition that you take!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the Hour is bound to come; there is no doubt in it. But most people do not believe.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is how the word of your Lord became due concerning the faithless, that they shall be inmates of the Fire.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your Lord has said, 'Call Me, and I will hear you!' Indeed those who are disdainful of My worship will enter hell in utter humility.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is Allah who made the night for you, that you may rest in it, and the day to provide visibility. Indeed Allah is gracious to mankind, but most people do not give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is Allah, your Lord, the creator of all things, there is no god except Him. Then where do you stray?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus are made to stray those who are used to impugning the signs of Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is Allah who made the earth an abode for you, and the sky a canopy, and He formed you and perfected your forms, and provided you with all the good things. That is Allah, your Lord! Blessed is Allah, Lord of all the worlds!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He is the Living One, there is no god except Him. So supplicate Him, putting exclusive faith in Him. All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I have been forbidden to worship those whom you invoke besides Allah, since there have come to me manifest proofs from my Lord, and I have been commanded to submit to the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who created you from dust, then from a drop of [seminal] fluid, then from a clinging mass, then He brings you forth as infants, then [He nourishes you] so that you may come of age, then that you may become aged —though there are some of you who die earlier— and that you may complete a specified term, and so that you may apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who gives life and brings death. So when He decides on a matter, He just says to it, 'Be!' and it is.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded those who dispute the signs of Allah, where they are being led away [from Allah's way]?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who bear the Throne, and those around it, celebrate the praise of their Lord and have faith in Him, and they plead for forgiveness for the faithful: 'Our Lord! You comprehend all things in mercy and knowledge. So forgive those who repent and follow Your way and save them from the punishment of hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —Those who deny the Book and what we have sent with Our apostles. Soon they will know

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when, [with] iron collars around their necks and chains, they are dragged

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: into scalding waters and then set aflame in the Fire.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then they will be told, 'Where are those you used to take as partners

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: besides Allah?' They will say, 'They have forsaken us. Rather, we did not invoke anything before.' That is how Allah leads astray the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'That is because you used to exult unduly on the earth and because you used to walk exultantly.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Enter the gates of hell, to remain in it [forever].' Evil is the [final] abode of the arrogant.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So be patient! Allah's promise is indeed true. Whether We show you a part of what We promise them, or take you away [before that], [in any case] they will be brought back to Us.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have sent apostles before you. Of them are those We have recounted to you, and of them are those We have not recounted to you. An apostle may not bring any sign except by Allah's permission. Hence when Allah's edict comes, judgment is made with justice, and it is thence that the falsifiers become losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is Allah who created the cattle for you that you may ride some of them, and some of them you eat;

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
