item.description: Our Lord! Admit them into the Gardens of Eden, which You have promised them, along with whoever is righteous among their forebears, their spouses and their descendants.1 Indeed You are the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and there are [numerous] uses in them for you, and that over them1 you may satisfy any need that is in your breasts, and you are carried on them and on ships.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He shows you His signs. So which of the signs of Allah do you deny?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not travelled over the land so that they may observe how was the fate of those who were before them? They were more numerous than them and were greater [than them] in power and with respect to the effects [they left] in the land. But what they used to earn did not avail them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When their apostles brought them manifest proofs, they exulted in the knowledge they possessed, and they were besieged by what they used to deride.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then, when they sighted Our punishment, they said, 'We believe in Allah alone, and disavow what we used to take as His partners.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But their faith was of no benefit to them when they sighted Our punishment —Allah's precedent which has passed among His servants, and it is thence that the faithless will be losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Save them from the ills; and whomever You save from the ills that day,1 You will have had mercy upon him, and that is the great success.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did you receive the account of the Enveloper?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: in a lofty paradise,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: wherein they will not hear any vain talk.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: In it there is a flowing spring

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and in it there are raised couches,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and goblets set,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and cushions laid out in an array,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and carpets spread out.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they not observe1 the camel, [to see] how she has been created?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the sky, how it has been raised?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the mountains, how they have been set?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Some faces on that day will be humbled,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the earth, how it has been surfaced?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So admonish—for you are only an admonisher,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and not a taskmaster over them—

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except him who turns back and disbelieves.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Him Allah will punish with the greatest punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed to Us will be their return.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then, indeed, their reckoning will lie with Us.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: wrought-up and weary:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: they will enter a scorching fire,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and made to drink from a boiling spring.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will have no food except cactus,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: neither nourishing, nor availing against hunger.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Some faces on that day will be joyous,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: pleased with their endeavour;

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Besieger!1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then they disobeyed the apostle of their Lord, so He seized them with a terrible seizing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed when the Flood rose high, We carried you in a floating ark,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that We might make it a reminder for you, and that receptive ears might remember it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the Trumpet is blown with a single blast

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the earth and the mountains are lifted and levelled with a single leveling,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then, on that day, will the Imminent [Hour] befall1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the sky will be split open —for it will be frail that day—

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the angels will be all over it, and the Throne of your Lord will be borne that day by eight [angels].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That day you will be exposed: none of your secrets will remain hidden.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for him who is given his book in his right hand, he will say, 'Here, take and read my book!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What is the Besieger?!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed I knew that I shall encounter my account.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So he will have a pleasant life,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: in an elevated garden,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: whose clusters [of fruits] will be within easy reach.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [He will be told]: 'Enjoy your food and drink, for what you had sent in advance in past days.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But as for him who is given his book in his left hand, he will say, 'I wish I had not been given my book,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: nor had I ever known what my account is!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I wish death had been the end of it all!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: My wealth did not avail me.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: My authority has departed from me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What will show you what is the Besieger?!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [The angels will be told:] 'Seize him, and fetter him!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then put him into hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then, in a chain whose length is seventy cubits, bind him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed he had no faith in Allah, the All-supreme,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and he did not urge the feeding of the needy,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so he has no friend here today,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: nor any food except pus,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: which no one shall eat except the iniquitous.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I swear by what you see

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and what you do not see:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thamūd and 'Ād denied the Catastrophe.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: it is indeed the speech of a noble apostle,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and it is not the speech of a poet. Little is the faith that you have!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Nor is it the speech of a soothsayer. Little is the admonition that you take!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Gradually sent down from the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had he faked any sayings in Our name,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We would have surely seized him by the right hand

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and then cut off his aorta,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and none of you could have held Us off from him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it is a reminder for the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We know that there are some among you who deny [it].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the Cry.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And indeed it will be a [matter of] regret for the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is indeed certain truth.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So celebrate the Name of your Lord, the All-supreme.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And as for 'Ād, they were destroyed by a fierce icy gale,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: which He disposed against them for seven grueling1 nights and eight days, so that you could have seen the people lying about therein prostrate as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So do you see any trace of them?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then brought Pharaoh and those who were before him, and the towns that were overturned, iniquity.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whatever there is in the heavens glorifies Allah and [whatever there is on] the earth and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Why should you not spend in the way of Allah, while to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal [to others] are those of you who spent and fought before the victory.1 They are greater in rank than those who have spent and fought afterwards. Yet Allah has promised the best reward to each and Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Who is it that will lend Allah a good loan, that He may multiply it for him and [that] there may be a noble reward for him?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day you will see the faithful, men and women, with their light moving swiftly before them and on their right, [and greeted with the words:] 'There is good news for you today! Gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them [forever]. That is the great success.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day the hypocrites, men and women, will say to the faithful, 'Please let up on us, that we may glean something from your light!' They will be told: 'Go back and grope for light!'1 Then there will be set up between them a wall with a gate, with mercy on its interior and punishment toward its exterior.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will call out to them, 'Did we not use to be with you?' They will say, 'Yes! But you cast yourselves into temptation, and you awaited1 and were doubtful, and [false] hopes deceived you until the edict of Allah2 arrived, and the Deceiver deceived you concerning Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So today no ransom shall be taken from you, nor from the faithless. The Fire will be your abode: it is your [ultimate] refuge and an evil destination.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is it not time yet for those who have faith that their hearts should be humbled for Allah's remembrance and to the truth which has come down [to them], and to be not like those who were given the Book before?1 Time took its toll on them and so their hearts were hardened, and many of them are transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Know that Allah revives the earth after its death. We have certainly made the signs clear for you so that you may apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the charitable men and charitable women, and those who lend Allah a good loan —it shall be multiplied for them, and there is a noble reward for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who have faith in Allah and His apostles —it is they who are the truthful and the witnesses1 with their Lord; they shall have their reward and their light. But as for those who are faithless and deny Our signs, they shall be the inmates of hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth: He gives life and brings death, and He has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Know that the life of this world is just play and diversion, and glitter, and mutual vainglory among you and covetousness1 for wealth and children —like the rain whose vegetation impresses the farmer; then it withers and you see it turn yellow, then it becomes chaff, while in the Hereafter there is a severe punishment and forgiveness from Allah and His pleasure; and the life of this world is nothing but the wares of delusion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Take the lead towards forgiveness from your Lord and a paradise as vast as the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who have faith in Allah and His apostles. That is Allah's grace, which He grants to whomever He wishes, and Allah is dispenser of a great grace.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No affliction visits the earth or yourselves but it is in a Book before We bring it about —that is indeed easy for Allah—

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so that you may not grieve for what escapes you, nor exult for what comes your way, and Allah does not like any swaggering braggart.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Such as are [themselves] stingy and bid [other] people to be stingy. And whoever refuses to comply [should know that] indeed Allah is the All-sufficient, the All-laudable.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We sent Our apostles with manifest proofs, and We sent down with them the Book and the Balance, so that mankind may maintain justice; and We sent down1 iron, in which there is great might and uses for mankind, and so that Allah may know those who help Him and His apostles in [their] absence. Indeed Allah is all-strong, all-mighty.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We sent Noah and Abraham and We ordained among their descendants prophethood and the Book. Some of them are [rightly] guided, and many of them are transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We followed them up with Our apostles and We followed [them] with Jesus son of Mary, and We gave him the Evangel, and We put in the hearts of those who followed him kindness and mercy. But as for monasticism, they innovated it —We had not prescribed it for them— only seeking Allah's pleasure. Yet they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave to the faithful among them their [due] reward, but many of them are transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Be wary of Allah and have faith in His Apostle. He will grant you a double share of His mercy and give you a light to walk by, and forgive you, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful;

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so that the People of the Book may know that they have no power over anything of Allah's grace, and that all grace is in Allah's hand which He grants to whomever He wishes and Allah is dispenser of a great grace.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, and He has knowledge of all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days; then settled on the Throne. He knows whatever enters the earth and whatever emerges from it and whatever descends from the sky and whatever ascends to it, and He is with you wherever you may be, and Allah sees best what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah all matters are returned.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He makes the night pass into the day and makes the day pass into the night, and He knows best what is in the breasts.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have faith in Allah and His Apostle, and spend out of that wherein He has made you successors.1 Those of you who have faith and spend [in Allah's way] —there is a great reward for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Why should you not have faith in Allah while the Apostle invites you to have faith in your Lord, and He has certainly made a covenant with you, should you be faithful?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who sends down manifest signs to His servant that He may bring you out of darkness into light, and indeed Allah is most kind and merciful to you.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O mankind! Be wary of your Lord! Indeed the quake of the Hour is a terrible thing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'That is because of what your hands have sent ahead,1 and because Allah is not tyrannical to the servants.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And among the people are those who worship Allah on the [very] fringe: if good fortune befalls him, he is content with it; but if an ordeal visits him he makes a turnabout, to become a loser in the world and the Hereafter. That is the manifest loss.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He invokes besides Allah that which can bring him neither benefit nor harm. That is extreme error.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He invokes someone whose harm is surely likelier than his benefit. Surely an evil ally and an evil companion!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah will indeed admit those who have faith and do righteous deeds into gardens with streams running in them. Indeed Allah does whatever He desires.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever thinks that Allah will not help him in this world and the Hereafter, let him extend a rope to the ceiling and hang himself, and see if his artifice would remove his rage.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus have We sent it down as manifest signs, and indeed Allah guides whomever He desires.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the faithful, the Jews, the Sabaeans, the Christians, the Magians and the polytheists —Allah will indeed judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah is witness to all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded that to Allah prostrates whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth, and the sun, the moon, and the stars, the mountains, the trees, and the animals and many of mankind? And for many the punishment has become due. Whomever Allah humiliates will find no one who may bring him honour. Indeed Allah does whatever He wishes.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These two contenders contend concerning their Lord. As for those who are faithless, cloaks of fire will be cut out for them, and boiling water will be poured over their heads,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day that you will see it, every suckling female will neglect what she suckled, and every pregnant female will deliver her burden, and you will see the people drunk, yet they will not be drunken, but Allah's punishment is severe.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: with which their skins and entrails will be fused,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and there will be clubs of iron for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whenever they desire to leave it out of anguish, they will be turned back into it [and told]: 'Taste the punishment of the burning!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah will admit those who have faith and do righteous deeds into gardens with streams running in them, adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearl, and their dress therein will be silk.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They shall be guided to the purest speech, and guided to the path of the All-laudable.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who are faithless and who bar from the way of Allah and the Sacred Mosque, which We have assigned for all the people, the native and the visitor being equal therein —whoever seeks to commit therein sacrilege with the intent of wrongdoing, We shall make him taste a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When We settled for Abraham the site of the House [saying], Do not ascribe any partners to Me, and purify My House for those who go around it, and those who stand [in it for prayer], and those who bow and prostrate.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And proclaim the ḥajj to people: they shall come to you on foot and on lean camels coming from distant places,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that they may witness the benefits for them, and mention Allah's Name during the known days over the livestock He has provided them. So eat thereof, and feed the destitute.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then let them do away with their untidiness,1 and fulfill their vows, and go around the Ancient House.2

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among the people are those who dispute about Allah without any knowledge, and follow every froward devil,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That. And whoever venerates the sacraments of Allah, that is better for him with his Lord. You are permitted [animals of] grazing livestock except for what will be recited to you. So avoid the abomination of idols, and avoid false speech,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: as persons having pure faith in Allah, not ascribing partners to Him. Whoever ascribes partners to Allah is as though he had fallen from a height to be devoured by vultures, or to be blown away by the wind far and wide.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That. And whoever venerates the sacraments of Allah —indeed that arises from the Godwariness of hearts.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You may benefit from them until a specified time.1 Then their place of sacrifice is by the Ancient House.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For every nation We have appointed a rite that they might mention Allah's Name over the livestock He has provided them. Your God is the One God. So submit to Him. And give good news to the humble

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those whose hearts tremble with awe when Allah is mentioned, and who are patient through whatever visits them, and who maintain the prayer and spend out of what We have provided them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have appointed for you the [sacrificial] camels as one of Allah's sacraments. There is good for you in them. So mention the Name of Allah over them as they stand. And when they have fallen on their flanks, eat from them, and feed the self-contained needy and the mendicant. Thus have We disposed them for your benefit so that you may give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is not their flesh or their blood that reaches Allah. Rather it is your Godwariness that reaches Him. Thus has He disposed them for your benefit so that you may magnify Allah for His guiding you. And give good news to the virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah indeed defends those who have faith. Indeed Allah does not like any ingrate traitor.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who are fought against are permitted [to fight] because they have been wronged, and Allah is indeed able to help them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: about whom it has been decreed that should anyone take him for a friend, he will lead him astray, and conduct him toward the punishment of the Blaze.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —Those who were expelled from their homes unjustly, only because they said, 'Allah is our Lord.' Had not Allah repulsed the people from one another, ruin would have befallen the monasteries, churches, synagogues and mosques in which Allah's Name is mentioned greatly. Allah will surely help those who help Him. Indeed Allah is all-strong, all-mighty.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who, if We granted them power in the land, maintain the prayer, give the zakāt, and bid what is right and forbid what is wrong. And with Allah rests the outcome of all matters.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If they impugn you, the people of Noah have impugned before them and 'Ād and Thamūd

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [as well as] the people of Abraham and the people of Lot,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the inhabitants of Midian, and Moses was also impugned. But I gave the faithless a respite, then I seized them and how was My rebuttal!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How many towns We have destroyed while they were wrongdoers! So they lie fallen on their trellises, their wells neglected and their lofty palaces [desolate]!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not traveled over the land so that they may have hearts by which they may apply reason, or ears by which they may hear? Indeed it is not the eyes that turn blind, but the hearts turn blind —those that are in the breasts!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They ask you to hasten the punishment, though Allah shall never break His promise. Indeed a day with your Lord is like a thousand years of your reckoning.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To how many a town did I give respite while it was wrongdoing! Then I seized it, and toward Me is the destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'O mankind! I am only a manifest warner to you!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O people! If you are in doubt about the resurrection, [consider that] We indeed created you from dust, then from a drop of [seminal] fluid, then from a clinging mass,1 then from a fleshy tissue,2 partly formed and partly unformed, so that We may manifest [Our power] to you. We establish in the wombs whatever We wish for a specified term, then We bring you forth as infants, then [We rear you] so that you may come of age. [Then] there are some of you who are taken away, and there are some of you who are relegated to the nethermost age, so that he knows nothing after [having possessed] some knowledge. And you see the earth torpid, yet when We send down water upon it, it stirs and swells, and grows every delightful kind [of plant].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds, for them is forgiveness and a noble provision.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But as for those who contend with Our signs, seeking to thwart [their purpose], they shall be the inmates of hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not send before you any apostle or prophet but that when he recited [the scripture] Satan interjected [something] in his recitation. Thereat Allah nullifies whatever Satan has interjected, [and] then Allah confirms His signs, and Allah is All-knowing, All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That He may make what Satan has thrown in a trial for those in whose hearts is a sickness and those whose hearts have hardened. Indeed the wrongdoers are steeped in extreme defiance.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That those who have been given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord, and so they may have faith in it, and their hearts may be humbled before Him. Indeed Allah guides those who have faith to a straight path.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who are faithless persist in their doubt about it, until the Hour overtakes them suddenly, or they are overtaken by the punishment of an inauspicious day.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On that day all sovereignty will belong to Allah: He will judge between them. Then those who have faith and do righteous deeds will be in gardens of bliss,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and those who are faithless and who deny Our signs —for such there will be a humiliating punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who migrate in the way of Allah and then are slain, or die, Allah will surely provide them with a good provision. Allah is indeed the best of providers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He will admit them into an abode they are pleased with. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-forbearing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is because Allah is the Reality and it is He who revives the dead, and He has power over all things,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That; and whoever retaliates with the like of what he has been made to suffer, and then is [again] aggressed against, Allah will surely help him. Indeed Allah is all-excusing, all-forgiving.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is because Allah makes the night pass into the day and makes the day pass into the night, and because Allah is all-hearing, all-seeing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is because Allah is the Reality, and what they invoke besides Him is nullity, and because Allah is the All-exalted, the All-great.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded that Allah sends down water from the sky, whereupon the earth turns green? Indeed Allah is all-attentive, all-aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, Indeed Allah is the All-sufficient, the All-laudable.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded that Allah has disposed for you[r benefit] whatever there is in the earth, and [that] the ships sail at sea by His command, and He sustains the sky lest it should fall on the earth, excepting [when it does so] by His leave? Indeed Allah is most kind and merciful to mankind.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who gave you life then He makes you die, then He brings you to life. Indeed man is very ungrateful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For every nation We had appointed a rite [of worship] which they used to observe; so let them not dispute with you about the matter.1 And invite to your Lord. Indeed you are on a straight guidance.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if they dispute with you, say, 'Allah knows best what you are doing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that about which you used to differ.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the Hour is bound to come, there is no doubt in it, and Allah will resurrect those who are in the graves.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you not know that Allah knows whatever there is in the sky and the earth? That is indeed in a Book. That is indeed easy for Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They worship besides Allah that for which He has not sent down any authority, and of which they have no knowledge. And the wrongdoers shall have no helper.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Our manifest signs are recited to them, you perceive denial on the faces of the faithless: they would almost pounce upon those who recite Our signs to them. Say, 'Shall I inform you about something worse than that? The Fire which Allah has promised the faithless. And it is an evil destination.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O mankind! Listen to a parable that is being drawn: Indeed those whom you invoke besides Allah will never create [even] a fly even if they all rallied to do so! And if a fly should take away something from them, they can not recover that from it. Feeble is the seeker and the sought!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They do not regard Allah with the regard due to Him. Indeed Allah is all-strong, all-mighty.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah chooses messengers from angels and from mankind. Indeed Allah is all-hearing, all-seeing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He knows that which is before them and that which is behind them, and to Allah all matters are returned.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Bow down and prostrate yourselves, and worship your Lord, and do good, so that you may be felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And wage jihād for the sake of Allah, a jihād which is worthy of Him. He has chosen you and has not placed for you any obstacle in the religion, the faith of your father, Abraham. He named you 'muslims' before, and in this,1 so that the Apostle may be a witness to you, and that you may be witnesses to mankind. So maintain the prayer, give the zakāt, and hold fast to Allah. He is your master —an excellent master and an excellent helper.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among the people are those who dispute concerning Allah without any knowledge or guidance, or an enlightening Book,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: turning aside disdainfully to lead [others] astray from the way of Allah. For such there is disgrace in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection We will make him taste the punishment of the burning:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whatever there is in the heavens glorifies Allah and whatever there is in the earth, and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And [also for] those who came in after them, who say, 'Our Lord, forgive us and our brethren who were our forerunners in the faith, and do not put any rancour in our hearts toward the faithful. Our Lord, You are indeed most kind and merciful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded the hypocrites who say to their brethren, the faithless from among the People of the Book: 'If you are expelled, we will surely go out with you, and we will never obey anyone against you, and if you are fought against we will surely help you,' and Allah bears witness that they are indeed liars.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Surely, if they were expelled they would not go out with them, and if they were fought against they would not help them, and were they to help them they would surely turn their backs [to flee] and then1 they would not be helped.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed they have a greater awe of you in their hearts than of Allah. That is because they are a lot who do not understand.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will not fight against you in a body except in fortified townships or from behind walls. Their might is great among themselves. You suppose them to be a body, but their hearts are disunited. That is because they are a lot who do not apply reason,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: like those who, recently before them, tasted the evil consequences of their conduct, and there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [Or] like Satan, when he prompts man to renounce faith, then, when he renounces faith, he says, 'Indeed I am absolved of you. Indeed I fear Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So the fate of both is that they will be in the Fire, to remain in it [forever]. Such is the requital of the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Be wary of Allah, and let every soul consider what it sends ahead1 for tomorrow, and be wary of Allah. Allah is indeed well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And do not be like those who forget Allah, so He makes them forget their own souls. It is they who are the transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who expelled the faithless belonging to the People of the Book from their homes at the outset of [their] en masse banishment. You did not think that they would go out, and they thought their fortresses would protect them from Allah. But Allah came at them from whence they did not reckon and He cast terror into their hearts. They demolish their houses with their own hands and the hands of the faithful. So take lesson, O you who have insight!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Not equal are the inmates of the Fire and the inhabitants of paradise. It is the inhabitants of paradise who are the successful ones.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had We sent down this Qur'ān upon a mountain, you would have surely seen it humbled [and] go to pieces with the fear of Allah. We draw such comparisons for mankind, so that they may reflect.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He is Allah—there is no god except Him— Knower of the sensible and the Unseen, He is the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He is Allah—there is no god except Him— the Sovereign, the All-holy, the All-benign,1 the Securer, the All-conserver, the All-mighty, the All-compeller, the All-magnanimous. Clear is Allah of any partners that they may ascribe [to Him]!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He is Allah, the Creator, the Maker, the Former. To Him belong the Best Names. Whatever there is in the heavens glorifies Him and [whatever there is in] the earth, and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If Allah had not ordained banishment for them, He would have surely punished them in this world, and in the Hereafter there is for them the punishment of the Fire.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is because they defied Allah and His Apostle; and whoever defies Allah, indeed Allah is severe in retribution.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whatever palm trees you cut down or left standing on their roots, it was by Allah's will, and in order that He may disgrace the transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The spoils that Allah gave to His Apostle from them, you did not spur any horse for its sake, nor any riding camel, but Allah makes His apostles prevail over whomever He wishes, and Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The spoils that Allah gave to His Apostle from the people of the townships, are for Allah and the Apostle, the relatives1 and the orphans, the needy and the traveller, so that they do not circulate among the rich among you. Take whatever the Apostle gives you, and relinquish whatever he forbids you, and be wary of Allah. Indeed Allah is severe in retribution.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [They are also] for the poor Emigrants who have been expelled from their homes and [wrested of] their possessions, who seek grace from Allah and [His] pleasure and help Allah and His Apostle. It is they who are the truthful.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hashr:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [They are as well] for those who were settled in the land1 and [abided] in faith before them, who love those who migrate toward them, and do not find in their breasts any need for that which is given to them,2 but prefer [the Immigrants] to themselves, though poverty be their own lot. And those who are saved from their own greed —it is they who are the felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Alif, Lām, Rā. These are the signs of the Book and a manifest Qur'ān.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We sent [apostles] before you to former communities,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and there did not come to them any apostle but that they used to deride him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is how We let it pass through the hearts of the guilty:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: they do not believe in it, and the precedent of the ancients has already passed.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were We to open for them a gate of the sky, so that they could go on ascending through it,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: they would surely say, 'Indeed a spell has been cast on our eyes; rather we are a bewitched lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have appointed houses1 in the sky and adorned them for the onlookers,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and We have guarded them from every outcast Satan,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except someone who may eavesdrop, whereat there pursues him a manifest flame.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We spread out the earth, and cast in it firm mountains, and We grew in it every kind of balanced thing,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Much will the faithless wish that they had been muslims.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and made in it [various] means of livelihood for you and for those whom you do not provide for.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is not a thing but that its sources are with Us, and We do not send it down except in a known measure.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We send the fertilizing winds and send down water from the sky providing it for you to drink and you are not maintainers of its resources.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it is We who give life and bring death and We are the inheritors.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We know the predecessors among you and certainly We know the successors,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and indeed it is your Lord who will resurrect them. Indeed He is all-wise, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We created man out of a dry clay1 [drawn] from an aging mud,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and We created the jinn earlier out of a piercing fire.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When your Lord said to the angels, 'Indeed I am going to create a human out of a dry clay [drawn] from an aging mud.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My spirit, then fall down in prostration before him.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Leave them to eat and enjoy and to be diverted by longings. Soon they will know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thereat the angels prostrated, all of them together,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: but not Iblis: he refused to be among those who prostrated.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'O Iblis! What kept you from being among those who have prostrated?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Said he, 'I will not prostrate before a human whom You have created out of a dry clay [drawn] from an aging mud.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Begone hence, for you are indeed an outcast,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and indeed the curse shall lie on you until the Day of Retribution.'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord! Respite me till the day they will be resurrected.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Said He, 'You are indeed among the reprieved

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: until the day of the known time.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord! As You have consigned me to perversity, I will surely glamorize [evil] for them on the earth, and I will surely pervert them, all

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not destroy any town but that it had a known term.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except Your exclusive servants among them.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'This is the path [leading] straight to Me.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed as for My servants you do not have any authority over them, except the perverse who follow you,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and indeed hell is the tryst of them all.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It has seven gates, and to each gate belongs a separate portion of them.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and springs.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: "Enter it in peace and safety!"

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We will remove whatever rancour there is in their breasts; [intimate like] brothers, [they will be reclining] on couches, facing one another.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Therein neither weariness shall touch them, nor will they [ever] be expelled from it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Inform my servants that I am indeed the All-forgiving, the All-merciful,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No nation can advance its time nor can it defer it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and that My punishment is a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when they entered into his presence and said, 'Peace!' He said, 'We are indeed afraid of you.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Do not be afraid. Indeed we give you the good news of a wise son.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Do you give me good news though old age has befallen me? What is the good news that you bring me?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'We bring you good news in truth; so do not be among the despondent.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Who despairs of his Lord's mercy except those who are astray?!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'O messengers, what is now your errand?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'We have been sent toward a guilty people,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [who shall perish] except the family of Lot. We will indeed deliver all of them,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'O you, to whom the Reminder has been sent down, you are indeed crazy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except his wife, [who], We have ordained, will indeed be among those who remain behind.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when the messengers came to Lot's family,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: he said, 'You are indeed strangers [to me].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Rather we bring you what they used to doubt.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We bring you the truth, and indeed we speak truly.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Take your family in a watch of the night; and follow in their rear, and none of you should turn round, and proceed as you are bidden.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We apprised him of the matter that these1 will be rooted out by dawn.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The people of the city came, rejoicing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'These are indeed my guests. Do not bring dishonour on me.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Be wary of Allah and do not humiliate me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Why do you not bring us the angels should you be truthful?!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Did we not forbid you from [defending1] strangers?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'These are my daughters, [marry them] if you should do anything.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By your life, they were bewildered in their drunkenness.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So the Cry seized them at sunrise,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and We made its1 topmost part its nethermost, and rained on them stones of shale.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There are indeed signs in that for the percipient.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it is on a standing road,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and there is indeed a sign in that for the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the inhabitants of Aykah1 were wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We took vengeance on them, and indeed the two of them1 are on an open highway.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We do not send down the angels except with due reason, and then they will not be granted any respite.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly the inhabitants of Ḥijr denied the apostles.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We had given them Our signs but they disregarded them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They used to hew out dwellings from mountains feeling secure.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So the Cry seized them at dawn,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and what they used to earn did not avail them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not create the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them except with reason, and indeed the Hour is bound to come. So forbear with a graceful forbearance.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed your Lord is the All-creator, the All-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have given you [the sūrah of] the seven oft-repeated verses1 and the great Qur'ān.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not extend your glance toward what We have provided to certain groups of them, and do not grieve for them, and lower your wing to the faithful,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and say, 'I am indeed a manifest warner.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have sent down the Reminder,1 and indeed We will preserve it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Even as We sent down on the dividers,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who reduced the Qur'ān into pieces,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by your Lord, We will question them all

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: concerning what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So proclaim what you have been commanded, and turn away from the polytheists.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We will suffice you against the deriders

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those who set up besides Allah another god. Soon they will know!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We know that you become upset because of what they say.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So celebrate the praise of your Lord and be among those who prostrate,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hijr:99 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and worship your Lord until certainty1 comes to you.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not venture ahead of Allah and His Apostle, and be wary of Allah. Indeed Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithful are indeed brothers. Therefore make peace between your brothers and be wary of Allah, so that you may receive [His] mercy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Let not any people ridicule another people: it may be that they are better than they are; nor let women [ridicule] women: it may be that they are better than they are. And do not defame one another, nor insult one another by [calling] nicknames. How evil are profane names subsequent to faith! And whoever is not penitent —such are the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Avoid much suspicion. Indeed some suspicions are sins. And do not spy on or backbite one another. Will any of you love to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would hate it. And be wary of Allah; indeed Allah is all-clement, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O mankind! Indeed We created you from a male and a female, and made you nations and tribes that you may identify yourselves with one another. Indeed the noblest1 of you in the sight of Allah is the most Godwary among you. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Bedouins say, 'We have faith.' Say, 'You do not have faith yet; rather say, "We have embraced Islam,"1 for faith has not yet entered into your hearts. Yet if you obey Allah and His Apostle, He will not stint anything of [the reward of] your works. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithful are only those who have attained faith in Allah and His Apostle and then have never doubted, and who wage jihād with their possessions and their persons in the way of Allah. It is they who are the truthful.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Will you inform Allah about your faith while Allah knows whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth, and Allah has knowledge of all things?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They count it as a favour to you that they have embraced Islam. Say, 'Do not count it as a favour to me your embracing of Islam. Rather it is Allah who has done you a favour in that He has guided you to faith, should you be truthful.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah knows the Unseen of the heavens and the earth, and Allah sees best what you do.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet, and do not speak aloud to him as you shout to one another, lest your works should fail without your being aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who lower their voices in the presence of the Apostle of Allah —they are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for Godwariness. For them will be forgiveness and a great reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who call you from behind the apartments, most of them do not apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had they been patient until you came out for them, it would have been better for them, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! If a profligate [person] should bring you some news, verify it, lest you should visit [harm] on some people out of ignorance, and then become regretful for what you have done.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Know that the Apostle of Allah is among you. Should he obey you in many matters, you would surely suffer. But Allah has endeared faith to you and made it appealing in your hearts, and He has made hateful to you faithlessness, transgression and disobedience. It is such who are the right-minded

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
