item.description: —a grace and blessing from Allah, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hujuraat:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If two groups of the faithful fight one another, make peace between them. But if one party of them aggresses against the other, fight the one which aggresses until it returns to Allah's ordinance. Then, if it returns, make peace between them fairly, and do justice. Indeed Allah loves the just.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Humaza:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Woe to every scandal-monger and slanderer,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Humaza:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who amasses wealth and counts it over.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Humaza:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He supposes his wealth will make him immortal!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Humaza:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! He will surely be cast into the Crusher.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Humaza:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And what will show you what is the Crusher?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Humaza:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [It is] the fire of Allah, set ablaze,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Humaza:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: which will overspread the hearts.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Humaza:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it will close in upon them

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Humaza:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: in outstretched columns.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ikhlaas:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'He is Allah, the One.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ikhlaas:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah is the All-embracing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ikhlaas:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He neither begat, nor was begotten,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ikhlaas:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: nor has He any equal.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the sky is rent apart,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed, there are over you watchers,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: noble writers

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who know whatever you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the pious shall be amid bliss,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and indeed the vicious shall be in hell

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: entering it on the Day of Retribution,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and they shall not be absent from it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And what will show you what is the Day of Retribution?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Again, what will show you what is the Day of Retribution?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is a day when no soul will be of any avail to another soul and all command that day will belong to Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when the stars are scattered,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when the seas are merged,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when the graves are overturned,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then a soul shall know what it has sent ahead and left behind.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O man! What has deceived you about your generous1 Lord,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who created you and proportioned you, and gave you an upright nature,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and composed you in any form that He wished?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Infitaar:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! Rather you deny the Retribution.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Has there been for man a period of time when he was not anything worthy of mention?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed we fear from our Lord a day, frowning and fateful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So Allah saved them from the ills of that day, and granted them freshness and joy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And He rewarded them for their patience with a garden and [garments of] silk,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: reclining therein on couches. They will find in it neither any [scorching] sun, nor any [biting] cold.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Its shades will be close over them and its clusters [of fruits] will be hanging low.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will be served around with vessels of silver and goblets of crystal

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —crystal of silver—1 [from] which they dispense in a precise measure.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will be served therein with a cup of a drink seasoned with Zanjabīl,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: a spring in it, named Salsabīl.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will be waited upon by immortal youths, whom, when you see them, you will suppose them to be scattered pearls.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We created man from the drop of a mixed fluid1 so that We may test him. So We made him endowed with hearing and sight.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As you look, you will see there bliss and a great kingdom.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Upon them will be cloaks of green silk and brocade and they will be adorned with bracelets of silver. Their Lord will give them to drink a pure drink.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [They will be told]: 'This is indeed your reward, and your endeavour has been well-appreciated.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have sent down to you the Qur'ān in a gradual descent.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord, and do not obey any sinner or ingrate among them,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and celebrate the Name of your Lord morning and evening,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and worship Him for a watch of the night and glorify Him the night long.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed they love this transitory life, and disregard a weighty day ahead of them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We created them and made their joints firm, and whenever We like We will replace them with others like them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is indeed a reminder. So let anyone who wishes take the way toward his Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have guided him to the way, be he grateful or ungrateful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But you do not wish unless it is wished by Allah. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He admits whomever He wishes into His mercy, and as for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have prepared for the faithless chains, iron collars, and a blaze.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the pious will drink from a cup seasoned with Kāfūr,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: a spring where the servants of Allah drink, which they make to gush forth as they please.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They fulfill their vows and fear a day whose ill will be widespread.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They give food, for the love of Him, to the needy, the orphan and the prisoner,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Insaan:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [saying,] 'We feed you only for the sake of Allah. We do not want any reward from you nor any thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the sky is split open

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But as for him who is given his record from behind his back,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: he will pray for annihilation,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and he will enter the Blaze.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed he used to be joyful among his folk,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and indeed he thought he would never return.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yes indeed, his Lord sees him best.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So I swear by the evening glow,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the night and what it is fraught with,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the moon when it blooms full:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: you will surely fare from stage to stage.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and gives ear to its Lord as it should.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So what is the matter with them that they will not believe?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when the Qur'ān is recited to them they will not prostrate?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather the faithless deny,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and Allah knows best what they keep to themselves.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So warn them of a painful punishment,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except such as are faithful and do righteous deeds: there will be an everlasting reward for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the earth is spread out

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and throws out what is in it, emptying itself,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and gives ear to its Lord as it should.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O man! You are labouring toward your Lord laboriously, and you will encounter Him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then as for him who is given his record in his right hand,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: he shall soon receive an easy reckoning,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Inshiqaaq:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and he will return to his folks joyfully.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Immaculate is He who carried His servant on a journey by night from the Sacred Mosque to the Farthest Mosque whose environs We have blessed, that We might show him some of Our signs. Indeed He is the All-hearing, the All-seeing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have prepared a painful punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:100 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Even if you possessed the treasuries of my Lord's mercy, you would withhold them for the fear of being spent, and man is very niggardly.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:101 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We gave Moses nine manifest signs. So ask the Children of Israel. When he came to them, Pharaoh said to him, 'O Moses, indeed I think you are bewitched.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:102 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'You certainly know that no one has sent these [signs] except the Lord of the heavens and the earth as eye-openers, and I, O Pharaoh, indeed think you are doomed.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:103 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He desired to exterminate them from the land, so We drowned him and all those who were with him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:104 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: After him We said to the Children of Israel, 'Take up residence in the land, and when the occasion of the other [promise] comes,1 We shall gather you in mixed company.'2

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:105 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: With the truth did We send it down, and with the truth did it descend, and We did not send you except as a bearer of good news and as a warner.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:106 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have sent the Qur'ān in [discrete] parts so that you may read it to the people a little at a time, and We have sent it down piecemeal.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:107 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Whether you believe in it, or do not believe in it, indeed those who were given knowledge before it when it is recited to them, fall down in prostration on their faces,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:108 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and say, "Immaculate is our Lord! Indeed Our Lord's promise is bound to be fulfilled."

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:109 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Weeping, they fall down on their faces, and it increases them in humility.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Man prays for ill as [avidly as] he prays for good, and man is overhasty.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:110 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Invoke "Allah" or invoke "the All-beneficent." Whichever [of His Names] you may invoke, to Him belong the Best Names.' Be neither loud in your prayer, nor murmur it, but follow a middle course between these,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:111 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and say, 'All praise belongs to Allah, who has neither taken any son, nor has He any partner in sovereignty, nor has He [taken] any ally out of weakness,' and magnify Him with a magnification [worthy of Him].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We made the night and the day two signs. Then We effaced the sign of the night, and made the sign of the day lightsome that you may seek grace from your Lord and that you may know the number of years and the calculation [of time], and We have elaborated everything in detail.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have attached every person's omen to his neck, and We shall bring it out for him on the Day of Resurrection as a wide open book that he will encounter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Read your book! Today your soul suffices as your own reckoner.'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever is guided is guided only for [the good of] his own soul, and whoever goes astray, goes astray only to its detriment. No bearer shall bear another's burden. We do not punish [any community] until We have sent [it] an apostle.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when We desire to destroy a town We command its affluent ones [to obey Allah]. But they commit transgression in it, and so the word becomes due against it, and We destroy it utterly.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How many generations We have destroyed since Noah! Your Lord suffices as one well aware and percipient of His servants' sins.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever desires this transitory life, We expedite for him therein whatever We wish, for whomever We desire. Then We appoint hell for him, to enter it, blameful and spurned.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever desires the Hereafter and strives for it with an endeavour worthy of it, should he be faithful —the endeavour of such will be well-appreciated.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We gave Moses the Book, and made it a guide for the Children of Israel —[saying,] 'Do not take any trustee besides Me'—

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To these and to those—to all We extend the bounty of your Lord, and the bounty of your Lord is not confined.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Observe how We have given some of them an advantage over some others; yet the Hereafter is surely greater in respect of ranks and greater in respect of relative merit.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not set up another god besides Allah, or you will sit blameworthy, forsaken.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your Lord has decreed that you shall not worship anyone except Him, and [He has enjoined] kindness to parents. Should they reach old age at your side —one of them or both— do not say to them, 'Fie!'1 And do not chide them, but speak to them noble words.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Lower the wing of humility to them, out of mercy, and say, 'My Lord! Have mercy on them, just as they reared me when I was [a] small [child]!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your Lord knows best what is in your hearts. Should you be righteous, He is indeed most forgiving toward penitents.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Give the relatives their [due] right, and the needy and the traveller [as well], but do not squander wastefully.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the wasteful are brothers of satans, and Satan is ungrateful to his Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if you have to overlook them [for now], seeking the mercy of your Lord which you expect [in the future], speak to them gentle words.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not keep your hand chained to your neck, nor open it altogether,1 or you will sit blameworthy, regretful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: descendants of those whom We carried [in the ark] with Noah. Indeed he was a grateful servant.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed your Lord expands the provision for whomever He wishes, and tightens it. Indeed He is well aware and percipient of His servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not kill your children for the fear of penury: We will provide for them and for you. Killing them is indeed a great iniquity.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not approach fornication. It is indeed an indecency and an evil way.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not kill a soul [whose life] Allah has made inviolable, except with due cause, and whoever is killed wrongfully, We have certainly given his heir an authority. But let him not commit any excess in killing,1 for he enjoys the support [of law].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not approach the orphan's property except in the best manner until he comes of age. And fulfill the covenants; indeed all covenants are accountable.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you measure, observe fully the measure, [and] weigh with an even balance. That is better and fairer in outcome.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not follow that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed the hearing, the eyesight, and the heart —all of these are accountable.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not walk exultantly on the earth. Indeed you will neither pierce the earth, nor reach the mountains in height.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The evil of all these is detestable to your Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These are among [precepts] that your Lord has revealed to you of wisdom. Do not set up another god besides Allah, or you will be cast into hell, blameworthy, banished.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We revealed to the Children of Israel in the Book: 'Twice you will cause corruption on the earth, and you will perpetrate great tyranny.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did your Lord prefer you for sons, and [Himself] adopt females from among the angels?1 Indeed you say a monstrous word!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have paraphrased [the principles of guidance] in this Qur'ān so that they may take admonition, but it increases them only in aversion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Were there [other] gods besides Him, as they say, they would surely encroach on the Lord of the Throne.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Immaculate is He, and greatly exalted above what they say!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The seven heavens glorify Him, and the earth [too], and whoever is in them. There is not a thing but celebrates His praise, but you do not understand their glorification. Indeed He is all-forbearing, all-forgiving.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you recite the Qur'ān, We draw between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a hidden curtain,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and We cast veils on their hearts, lest they should understand it, and a deafness into their ears. When you mention your Lord alone in the Qur'ān, they turn their backs in aversion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We know best what they listen for, when they listen to you, and when they hold secret talks, when the wrongdoers say, '[If you follow him] You will be following just a bewitched man.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Look, how they coin epithets for you; so they go astray, and cannot find a way.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'What, when we have become bones and dust, shall we really be raised in a new creation?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when the first occasion of the two [prophecies] came, We aroused against you Our servants possessing great might, and they ransacked [your] habitations, and the promise was bound to be fulfilled.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Should you be stones, or iron,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: or a creature more fantastic to your minds!' They will say, 'Who will bring us back?' Say, 'He who originated you the first time.' They will nod their heads at you, and say, 'When will that be?' Say, 'Maybe it is near!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day He calls you, you will respond to Him, praising Him, and you will think you remained only a little.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Tell My servants to speak in a manner which is the best. Indeed Satan incites ill feeling between them, and Satan is indeed man's manifest enemy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your Lord knows you best. He will have mercy on you, if He wishes, or punish you, if He wishes, and We did not send you to watch over them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your Lord knows best whoever is in the heavens and the earth. Certainly We gave some prophets an advantage over others, and We gave David the Psalms.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Invoke those whom you claim [to be gods] besides Him. They have no power to remove your distress nor to bring about any change [in your state].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They [themselves] are the ones who supplicate, seeking a recourse to their Lord,1 whoever is nearer [to Him], expecting His mercy and fearing His punishment.' Indeed your Lord's punishment is a thing to beware of.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is not a town but We will destroy it before the Day of Resurrection, or punish it with a severe punishment. That has been written in the Book.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Nothing keeps Us from sending signs except that the ancients denied them. We gave Thamūd the she-camel as an eye-opener, but they wronged her. We do not send the signs except for deterrence.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We gave you back the turn [to prevail] over them, and We aided you with children and wealth, and made you greater in number,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When We said to you, 'Indeed your Lord comprehends all mankind,' We did not appoint the vision that We showed you except as a test for the people and the tree cursed in the Qur'ān. We deter them, but it only increases them in great rebellion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When We said to the angels, 'Prostrate before Adam,' they [all] prostrated, but not Iblis: he said, 'Shall I prostrate before someone whom You have created from clay?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Said he, 'Do You see this one whom You have honoured above me? If You respite me until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his progeny, [all] except a few.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Said He, 'Begone! Whoever of them follows you, indeed the hell shall be your requital, an ample reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Instigate whomever of them you can with your voice;1 and rally against them your cavalry and your infantry, and share with them in wealth and children, and make promises to them!' But Satan promises them nothing but delusion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'As for My servants, you shall have no authority over them.' And your Lord suffices as trustee.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your Lord is He who drives for you the ships in the sea, that you may seek His grace. Indeed He is most merciful to you.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when distress befalls you at sea, those whom you invoke besides Him are forsaken. But when He delivers you to land, you are disregardful [of Him]. And man is very ungrateful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you feel secure that He will not make the coastland swallow you, or He will not unleash upon you a rain of stones? Then you will not find any defender for yourselves.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you feel secure that He will not send you back into it another time and unleash against you a shattering gale and drown you because of your unfaith? Then you will not find for yourselves any redresser against Us.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [saying,] 'If you do good, you will do good to your [own] souls, and if you do evil, it will be [evil] for them.' So when the occasion for the other [prophecy] comes, they will make your faces1 wretched, and enter the Temple just as they entered it the first time, and utterly destroy whatever they come upon.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have honoured the Children of Adam, and carried them over land and sea, and provided them with all the good things, and given them an advantage over many of those We have created with a complete preference.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day We shall summon every group of people with their imam,1 then whoever is given his book in his right hand —they will read it, and they will not be wronged so much as a single date-thread.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But whoever has been blind in this [world], will be blind in the Hereafter, and [even] more astray from the [right] way.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They were about to beguile you from what Allah has revealed to you so that you may fabricate against Us something other than that, whereat they would have befriended you.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had We not fortified you, certainly you might have inclined toward them a bit.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We would have surely made you taste a double [punishment] in this life and a double [punishment] after death, and then you would have not found for yourself any helper against Us.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They were about to hound you out of the land, to expel you from it, but then they would not have stayed after you but a little.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A precedent of those We have sent from among Our apostles before you, and you will not find any change in Our precedent.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Maintain the prayer from the sun's decline1 till the darkness of the night, and [observe particularly] the dawn recital. Indeed the dawn recital is attended [by angels].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And keep vigil for a part of the night, as a supererogatory [devotion] for you. It may be that your Lord will raise you to a praiseworthy station.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Maybe your Lord will have mercy on you, but if you revert, We [too] will revert, and We have made hell a prison for the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And say, 'My Lord! 'Admit me with a worthy entrance, and bring me out with a worthy departure, and render me a favourable authority from Yourself.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And say, 'The truth has come, and falsehood has vanished. Indeed falsehood is bound to vanish.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We send down in the Qur'ān that which is a cure and mercy for the faithful; and it increases the wrongdoers only in loss.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When We bless man, he is disregardful and turns aside; but when an ill befalls him, he is despondent.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Everyone acts according to his character. Your Lord knows best who is better guided with regard to the way.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They question you concerning the Spirit. Say, 'The Spirit is of the command of my Lord,1 and you have not been given of the knowledge except a few [of you].'2

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If We wish, We would take away what We have revealed to you. Then you would not find for yourself any defender against Us,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except a mercy from your Lord. Indeed His grace has been great upon you.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Should all humans and jinn rally to bring the like of this Qur'ān, they will not bring the like of it, even if they assisted one another.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have certainly interspersed for the people this Qur'ān with every [kind of] parable, but most people are only intent on ingratitude.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed this Qur'ān guides to what is most upright, and gives the good news to the faithful who do righteous deeds that there is a great reward for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'We will not believe you until you make a spring gush forth for us from the ground.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Or until you have a garden of date palms and vines and you make streams gush through it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Or until you cause the sky to fall in fragments upon us, just as you would aver. Or until you bring Allah and the angels [right] in front of us.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Or until you have a house of gold, or you ascend into the sky. And we will not believe your ascension until you bring down for us a book that we may read.' Say, 'Immaculate is my Lord! Am I anything but a human, an apostle?!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Nothing kept the people from believing when guidance came to them, but their saying, 'Has Allah sent a human as an apostle?!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Had there been angels in the earth, walking around and residing [in it like humans do], We would have sent down to them from the heaven an angel as apostle.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Allah suffices as a witness between me and you. Indeed He is well aware and percipient of His servants.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whomever Allah guides is rightly guided, and whomever He leads astray you will never find them any guardians besides Him. On the Day of Resurrection, We shall muster them [scrambling] on their faces,1 blind, dumb, and deaf. Their refuge shall be hell. Whenever it subsides, We shall intensify the blaze for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is their requital because they defied Our signs and said, 'What, when we have become bones and dust, shall we really be raised in a new creation?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Israa:99 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and the earth, is able to create the like of them? He has appointed for them a term, in which there is no doubt; yet the wrongdoers are only intent on ingratitude.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ḥā, Mīm.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ahead of them is hell and what they have earned will not avail them in any way, nor what they had taken as guardians besides Allah, and there is a great punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is a guidance, and as for those who defy the signs of their Lord, for them is a painful punishment due to defilement.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is Allah who disposed the sea for you[r benefit] so that the ships may sail in it by His command, and that you may seek of His grace, and that you may give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And He has disposed for you[r benefit] whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth; all is from Him. There are indeed signs in that for a people who reflect.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say to the faithful to forgive those who do not expect Allah's days, that He may [Himself] requite a people for what they used to earn.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever acts righteously, it is for his own soul, and whoever does evil, it is to its own detriment, then you will be brought back to your Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We gave the Children of Israel the Book, judgement and prophethood and We provided them with all the good things, and We gave them an advantage over all the nations,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and We gave them manifest precepts. But they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them, out of envy among themselves. Indeed your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that about which they used to differ.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We set you upon a clear course of the Law; so follow it, and do not follow the desires of those who do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed they will not avail you in any way against Allah. Indeed the wrongdoers are allies of one another, but Allah is the guardian1 of the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The [gradual] sending down of the Book is from Allah, the All-mighty, All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These are eye-openers for mankind, and guidance and mercy for a people who have certainty.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do those who have perpetrated misdeeds suppose that We shall treat them as those who have faith and do righteous deeds, their life and death being equal? Evil is the judgement that they make!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah created the heavens and the earth with reason, so that every soul may be requited for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you seen him who has taken his desire to be his god and whom Allah has led astray knowingly, and set a seal upon his hearing and his heart, and put a blindfold on his sight? So who will guide him after Allah? Will you not then take admonition?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'There is nothing but the life of this world: we live and we die, and nothing but time destroys us.' But they do not have any knowledge of that, and they only make conjectures.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when Our manifest signs are recited to them, their only argument is to say, 'Bring our fathers back [to life], should you be truthful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'It is Allah who gives you life, then He makes you die. Then He will gather you on the Day of Resurrection, in which there is no doubt. But most people do not know.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and when the Hour sets in, the falsifiers will be losers on that day.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And you will see every nation fallen on its knees. Every nation will be summoned to its book: 'Today you will be requited for what you used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is Our book, which speaks truly against you. Indeed We used to record what you used to do.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed in the heavens and the earth there are signs for the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is the manifest success!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But as for the faithless, [they will be asked,] 'Were not My signs recited to you? But you were disdainful, and you were a guilty lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when it was said, "Allah's promise is indeed true, and there is no doubt about the Hour," you said, "We do not know what the Hour is. We know nothing beyond conjectures, and we do not possess any certainty." '

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The evils of what they had done will appear to them, and they will be besieged by what they used to deride.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And it will be said, 'Today We will forget you, just as you forgot the encounter of this day of yours. The Fire will be your abode, and you will not have any helpers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is because you took the signs of Allah in derision, and the life of the world had deceived you.' So today they will not be brought out of it, nor will they be asked to propitiate [Allah].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So all praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of the heavens and the Lord of the earth, the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Him belongs all supremacy in the heavens and the earth, and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And in your creation [too], and whatever animals that He scatters abroad, there are signs for a people who have certainty.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And in the alternation of night and day and what Allah sends down from the sky of [His] provision with which He revives the earth after its death, and in the changing of the winds there are signs for a people who apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These are the signs of Allah that We recite for you in truth. So what discourse will they believe after Allah and His signs?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Woe to every sinful liar,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who hears the signs of Allah being recited to him, yet persists disdainfully, as if he had not heard them. So inform him of a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jaathiya:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Should he learn anything about Our signs, he takes them in derision. For such there is a humiliating punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'It has been revealed to me that a team of the jinn listened [to the Qur'ān].' and they said, "Indeed we heard a wounderful qur'ān,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We do not know whether ill is intended for those who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intends good for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among us some are righteous and some of us are otherwise: we are multifarious sects.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We know that we cannot thwart Allah on the earth, nor can we thwart Him by fleeing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When we heard the [message of] guidance, we believed in it. Whoever that has faith in his Lord shall neither fear any detraction nor oppression.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among us some are muslims and some of us are perverse.1 Yet those who submit [to Allah] —it is they who pursue rectitude.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the perverse, they will be firewood for hell." '

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If they are steadfast on the path [of Allah], We shall provide them with abundant water,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so that We may test them therein, and whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will let him into an escalating punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The places of worship belong to Allah, so do not invoke anyone along with Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the servant of Allah1 rose to pray to Him, they almost crowded around him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: which guides to rectitude. Hence we have believed in it and we will never ascribe any partner to our Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I pray only to my Lord, and I do not ascribe any partner to Him.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I have no power to bring you any harm or good [of my own accord].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Neither can anyone shelter me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge besides Him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [I have no duty] except to transmit from Allah, and [to communicate] His messages; and whoever disobeys Allah and His apostle, indeed there will be for him the fire of hell, to remain in it forever.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they see what they are promised, they will then know who is weaker in supporters and fewer in numbers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I do not know if what you are promised is near, or if my Lord has set a term for it.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Knower of the Unseen, He does not disclose His Unseen to anyone,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except to an apostle He approves of. Then He dispatches a sentinel before and behind him

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so that He may ascertain that they have communicated the messages of their Lord, and He comprehends all that is with them, and He keeps count of all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Exalted be the majesty of our Lord, He has taken neither any spouse nor son.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the foolish ones among us used to utter atrocious lies concerning Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed we thought that humans and jinn would never utter any falsehood concerning Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed some persons from the humans would seek the protection of some persons from the jinn, thus only adding to their rebellion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They1 thought, just as you think, that Allah will not raise anyone from the dead.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We made for the heaven and found it full of mighty sentries and flames.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jinn:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We used to sit in its positions to eavesdrop, but anyone listening now finds a flame waiting for him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jumu'a:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whatever there is in the heavens glorifies Allah and whatever there is in the earth, the Sovereign, the All-holy, the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jumu'a:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when the prayer is finished disperse through the land and seek Allah's grace, and remember Allah greatly so that you may be felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jumu'a:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they sight a deal or a diversion, they scatter off towards it and leave you standing! Say, 'What is with Allah is better than diversion and dealing, and Allah is the best of providers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jumu'a:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who sent to the unlettered [people] an apostle from among themselves, to recite to them His signs, to purify them, and to teach them the Book and wisdom, and earlier they had indeed been in manifest error.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jumu'a:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And to others from among them [as well] who have not yet joined them. And He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jumu'a:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is Allah's grace which He grants to whomever He wishes, and Allah is dispenser of a great grace.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jumu'a:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The example of those who were charged with the Torah, then failed to carry it, is that of an ass carrying books. Evil is the example of the people who deny Allah's signs, and Allah does not guide the wrongdoing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jumu'a:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'O Jews! If you claim that you are Allah's favourites, to the exclusion of other people, then long for death, should you be truthful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jumu'a:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yet they will never long for it, because of what their hands have sent ahead, and Allah knows best the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jumu'a:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Indeed the death that you flee will indeed encounter you. Then you will be returned to the Knower of the sensible and the Unseen, and He will inform you about what you used to do.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Jumu'a:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! When the call is made for prayer on Friday, hurry toward the remembrance of Allah, and leave all business. That is better for you, should you know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kaafiroon:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'O faithless ones!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kaafiroon:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I do not worship what you worship,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kaafiroon:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: nor do you worship what I worship;

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kaafiroon:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: nor will I worship what you have worshiped

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kaafiroon:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: nor will you worship what I worship.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kaafiroon:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To you your religion, and to me my religion.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: All praise belongs to Allah, who has sent down the Book to His servant and did not let any crookedness be in it,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the youths took refuge in the Cave, they said, 'Our Lord! Grant us a mercy from Yourself, and help us on to rectitude in our affair.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:100 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and that day We shall bring hell into view visibly for the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:101 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —Those whose eyes were blindfolded to My remembrance and who could not hear.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:102 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do the faithless suppose that they have taken My servants for guardians in My stead? Indeed We have prepared hell for the hospitality of the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:103 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Shall we inform you about the biggest losers in regard to works?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:104 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those whose endeavour goes awry in the life of the world, while they suppose they are doing good.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:105 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are the ones who deny the signs of their Lord and the encounter with Him. So their works have failed. On the Day of Resurrection We will not set for them any weight.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:106 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is their requital—hell— because of their faithlessness and taking My signs and My apostles in derision.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:107 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds they shall have the gardens of Firdaws1 for abode,2

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:108 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: to remain [forever]in them, from where they will not seek to shift.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:109 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'If the sea were ink for the words of my Lord, the sea would be spent before the words of my Lord are spent, though We brought another like it for replenishment.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We put them to sleep1 in the Cave for several years.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:110 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I am just a human being like you. It has been revealed to me that your God is the One God. So whoever expects to encounter his Lord —let him act righteously, and not associate anyone with the worship of his Lord.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We aroused them that We might know which of the two groups better reckoned the period they had stayed.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We relate to you their account in truth. They were indeed youths who had faith in their Lord, and We had enhanced them in guidance,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and fortified their hearts, when they stood up and said, 'Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. We will never invoke any god besides Him, for then we shall certainly have said an atrocious lie.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These—our people— have taken gods besides Him. Why do they not bring any clear authority touching them? So who is a greater wrongdoer than he who fabricates a lie against Allah?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you have dissociated yourselves from them and from what they worship except Allah, then take refuge in the Cave. Your Lord will unfold His mercy for you, and He will help you on to ease in your affair.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You may see the sun, when it rises, slanting toward the right of their cave, and, when it sets, cut across them towards the left, while they are in a cavern within it. That is one of Allah's signs. Whomever Allah guides is rightly guided, and whomever He leads astray, you will never find for him any guardian or guide.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You will suppose them to be awake, although they are asleep. We turn them to the right and to the left, and their dog [lies] stretching its forelegs at the threshold. If you come upon them, you will surely turn to flee from them, and you will surely be filled with a terror of them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So it was that We aroused them [from sleep] so that they might question one another. One of them said, 'How long have you stayed [here]?' They said, 'We have stayed a day, or part of a day.' They said, 'Your Lord knows best how long you have stayed. Send one of you to the city with this money. Let him observe which of them has the purest food, and bring you provisions from there. Let him be attentive,1 and let him not make anyone aware of you.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [a Book] upright, to warn of a severe punishment from Him, and to give good news to the faithful who do righteous deeds, that there shall be for them a good reward,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed should they prevail over you, they will [either] stone you [to death], or force you back into their creed, and then you will never be saved.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So it was that We let them come upon them,1 that they might know that Allah's promise is true, and that there is no doubt in the Hour. As they were disputing among themselves about their matter, they said, 'Build a building over them. Their Lord knows them best.' Those who had the say in their matter said, 'We will set up a place of worship over them.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, '[They are] three; their dog is the fourth of them. They will say, '[They are] five, their dog is the sixth of them,' taking a shot at the invisible.1 They will say, '[They are] seven, their dog is the eighth of them.' Say, 'My Lord knows best their number, and none knows them except a few.' So do not dispute concerning them, except for a seeming dispute, and do not question about them any of them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not say about anything, 'I will indeed do it tomorrow,'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: without [adding], 'if Allah wishes.' And when you forget, remember your Lord, and say, 'Maybe my Lord will guide me to [something] more akin to rectitude than this.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They remained in the Cave for three hundred years, and added nine more [to that number].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Allah knows best how long they remained. To Him belongs the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. How well does He see! How well does He hear! They have no guardian besides Him, and none shares with Him in His judgement.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Recite what has been revealed to you from your Lord's Book. Nothing can change His words, and you will never find any refuge besides Him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Content yourself with the company of those who supplicate their Lord morning and evening, desiring His Face, and do not loose sight of them, desiring the glitter of the life of this world.1 And Do not obey him whose heart We have made oblivious to Our remembrance, and who follows his own desires, and whose conduct is [mere] profligacy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And say, '[This is] the truth from your Lord: let anyone who wishes believe it, and let anyone who wishes disbelieve it.' Indeed We have prepared for the wrongdoers a Fire whose curtains will surround them [on all sides]. If they cry out for help, they will be helped with a water like molten copper which will scald the faces. What an evil drink, and how ill a resting place!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: to abide in it forever,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds —indeed We do not waste the reward of those who are good in deeds.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For such there will be the Gardens of Eden with streams running in them. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and wear green garments of silk and brocade, reclining therein on couches. How excellent a reward, and how good a resting place!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Draw for them the parable of two men for each of whom We had made two gardens of vines, and We had surrounded them with date palms, and placed crops between them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Both gardens yielded their produce without stinting anything of it. And We had set a stream gushing through them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He had abundant fruits, so he said to his companion, as he conversed with him: 'I have more wealth than you, and am stronger with respect to numbers.'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He entered his garden while he wronged himself. He said, 'I do not think that this will ever perish,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and I do not think that the Hour will ever set in. And even if I am returned to my Lord I will surely find a resort better than this.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: His companion said to him, as he conversed with him: 'Do you disbelieve in Him who created you from dust, then from a drop of [seminal] fluid, then fashioned you as a man?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But I [say], "He is Allah, my Lord," and I do not ascribe any partner to my Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Why did you not say, when you entered your garden, "[This is] as Allah has wished! There is no power except by Allah!" If you see that I have lesser wealth than you and children,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and to warn those who say, 'Allah has taken a son.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: maybe my Lord will give me [something] better than your garden, and He will unleash upon it bolts from the sky, so that it becomes a bare plain.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Or its water will sink down, so that you cannot obtain it.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And ruin closed in on his produce, and he began to wring his hands for what he had spent on it, as it lay fallen on its trellises. He was saying, 'I wish I had not ascribed any partner to my Lord.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
