item.description: He had no party to help him, besides Allah, nor could he help himself.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There, all authority belongs to Allah, the Real. He is best in rewarding, and best in requiting.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Draw for them the parable of the life of this world: [It is] like the water We send down from the sky. Then the earth's vegetation mingles with it. Then it becomes chaff, scattered by the wind. And Allah is omnipotent over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Wealth and children are an adornment of the life of the world, but lasting righteous deeds are better with your Lord in reward and better in hope.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day We shall set the mountains moving and you will see the earth in full view, We shall muster them, and We will not leave out anyone of them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will be presented before your Lord in ranks: 'Certainly you have come to Us just as We created you the first time. Rather you maintained that We shall not appoint a tryst for you.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Book will be set up. Then you will see the guilty apprehensive of what is in it. They will say, 'Woe to us! What a book is this! It omits nothing, big or small, without enumerating it.' They will find present whatever they had done, and your Lord does not wrong anyone.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They do not have any knowledge of that, nor did their fathers. Monstrous is the utterance that comes out of their mouths, and they say nothing but a lie.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When We said to the angels, 'Prostrate before Adam,' they prostrated, but not Iblis. He was one of the jinn, so he transgressed against his Lord's command. Will you then take him and his offspring for guardians in My stead, though they are your enemies? How evil a substitute for the wrongdoers!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I did not make them a witness to the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor to their own creation, nor do I take those who mislead as assistants.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day He will say, 'Call those whom you maintained to be My partners,' they will call them, but they will not respond to them, for We shall place an abyss between them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The guilty will sight the Fire and know that they will fall into it, for they will find no means to circumvent it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have made this Qur'ān interspersed with every kind of parable for mankind. But man is the most disputatious of creatures.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: People do not refuse to have faith when guidance comes to them and to plead to their Lord for forgiveness, without being overtaken by the precedent of the ancients, or confronting the punishment.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We do not send the apostles except as bearers of good news and as warners, but those who are faithless dispute fallaciously to refute thereby the truth, having taken My signs and what they are warned of in derision.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Who is a greater wrongdoer than he who is reminded of the signs of his Lord, whereat he disregards them and forgets what his hands have sent ahead? Indeed We have cast veils on their hearts lest they should understand it, and a deafness into their ears; and if you invite them to guidance they will never [let themselves] be guided.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your Lord is the All-forgiving dispenser of mercy. Were He to take them to task because of what they have committed, He would have surely hastened their punishment. But they have a tryst, [when] they will not find a refuge besides Him.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those are the towns that We destroyed when they were wrongdoers, and We appointed a tryst for their destruction.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You are liable to imperil your life for their sake, if they should not believe this discourse,1 out of grief.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Moses said to his lad, 'I will go on [journeying] until I have reached the confluence of the two seas, or have spent a long time [travelling].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when they reached the confluence between them, they forgot their fish, which found its way into the sea, sneaking away.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when they had passed on, he said to his lad, 'Bring us our meal. We have certainly encountered much fatigue on this journey of ours.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Did you see?! When we took shelter at the rock, indeed I forgot about the fish —and none but Satan made me forget to mention it!— and it made its way into the sea in an amazing manner!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'That is what we were after!' So they returned, retracing their footsteps.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [There] they found one of Our servants whom We had granted a mercy from Ourselves, and taught him a knowledge from Our own.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Moses said to him, 'May I follow you for the purpose that you teach me some of the probity you have been taught?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Indeed you cannot have patience with me!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And how can you have patience about something you are not in the know of?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'You will find me, God willing, to be patient, and I will not disobey you in any matter.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have made whatever is on the earth an adornment for it that We may test them [to see] which of them is best in conduct.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'If you follow me, do not question me concerning anything until I [myself] make a mention of it to you.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So they went on. When they boarded the boat, he made a hole in it. He said, 'Did you make a hole in it to drown its people? You have certainly done a monstrous thing!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Did I not say, indeed you cannot have patience with me?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Do not take me to task for my forgetting, and do not be hard upon me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So they went on. When they encountered a boy, he slew him. He said, 'Did you slay an innocent soul, without [his having slain] anyone? You have certainly done a dire thing!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Did I not tell you, indeed you cannot have patience with me?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'If I question you about anything after this, do not keep me in your company. You have already got sufficient excuse on my part.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So they went on. When they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to extend them any hospitality. There they found a wall which was about to collapse, so he erected it. He said, 'Had you wished, you could have taken a wage for it.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'This is where you and I shall part. I will inform you about the interpretation of that over which you could not maintain patience.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the boat, it belonged to some poor people who work on the sea. I wanted to make it defective, for behind them was a king seizing every ship usurpingly.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And indeed We will turn whatever is on it into a barren plain.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the boy, his parents were faithful [persons], and We feared he would overwhelm them with rebellion and unfaith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We desired that their Lord should give them in exchange one better than him in respect of purity and closer in mercy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the wall, it belonged to two boy orphans in the city. Under it there was a treasure belonging to them. Their father had been a righteous man. So your Lord desired that they should come of age and take out their treasure —as a mercy from your Lord. I did not do that out of my own accord. This is the interpretation of that over which you could not maintain patience.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They question you concerning Dhul Qarnayn. Say, 'I will relate to you an account of him.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We had granted him power in the land and given him the means to all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So he followed a means.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When he reached the place where the sun sets, he found it setting in a muddy spring, and by it he found a people. We said, 'O Dhul Qarnayn! You may either punish them, or treat them with kindness.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'As for him who is a wrongdoer, we will punish him. Then he shall be returned to his Lord and He will punish him with a dire punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But as for him who has faith and acts righteously, he shall have the best reward, and we will speak to him gently of our command.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he followed a means.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you suppose that the Companions of the Cave and the Inscription were among Our wonderful signs?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When he reached the place where the sun rises, he found it rising on a people for whom We had not provided any shield against it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So it was, and We comprehended whatever pertained to him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he followed a means.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When he reached [the place] between the two barriers, he found between them a people who could hardly understand a word.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'O Dhul Qarnayn! Indeed Gog and Magog are causing corruption in the land. Shall we pay you a tribute on condition that you build a barrier between them and us?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'What my Lord has furnished me is better. Yet help me with some power, and I will make a bulwark between you and them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Bring me pieces of iron!' When he had levelled up between the flanks, he said, 'Blow!' When he had turned it into fire, he said, 'Bring me molten copper to pour over it.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So they could neither scale it, nor could they make a hole in it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'This is a mercy from my Lord. But when the promise of my Lord is fulfilled, He will level it;1 and my Lord's promise is true.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kahf:99 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That day We shall let them surge over one another, and the Trumpet will be blown, and We shall gather them all,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kawthar:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have given you abundance.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kawthar:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So pray to your Lord, and sacrifice [the sacrificial camel].1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Kawthar:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it is your enemy who is without posterity.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the night when it envelops,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We shall surely ease him into hardship.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: His wealth shall not avail him when he perishes.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed with Us rests guidance,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and indeed to Us belong the world and the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So I warn you of a blazing fire,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: which none shall enter except the most wretched

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —he who denies and turns back.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Godwary shall be spared it

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —he who gives his wealth to purify himself

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and does not expect any reward from anyone,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the day when it brightens,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: but seeks only the pleasure of his Lord, the Most Exalted,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and, surely, soon he will be well-pleased.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by Him who created the male and the female:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: your endeavours are indeed unlike.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for him who gives and is Godwary

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and confirms the best promise,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We shall surely ease him into facility.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But as for him who is stingy and self-complacent,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Lail:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and denies the best promise,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: An asker asked for a punishment bound to befall

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and no friend will inquire about [the welfare of his] friend,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [though] they will be placed within each other's sight. The guilty one will wish he could ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: his spouse and his brother,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: his kin which had sheltered him

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and all those who are upon the earth, if that might deliver him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Never! Indeed it is a blazing fire,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: which strips away the scalp.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It invites him who has turned back [from the truth] and forsaken [it],

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: amassing [wealth] and hoarding [it].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed man has been created covetous:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —which none can avert from the faithless—1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: anxious when an ill befalls him

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and grudging when good comes his way

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —[all are such] except the prayerful,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: those who are persevering in their prayers

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and in whose wealth there is a known right

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: for the beggar and the deprived,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and who affirm the Day of Retribution,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and those who are apprehensive of the punishment of their Lord

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: (there is indeed no security from the punishment of their Lord)

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and those who guard their private parts

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: from Allah, Lord of the lofty stations.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: (except from their spouses and their slave women, for then they are not blameworthy;

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: but whoever seeks beyond that —it is they who are the transgressors)

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and those who keep their trusts and covenants,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and those who are observant of their testimonies,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and those who are watchful of their prayers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will be in gardens, held in honour.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What is the matter with the faithless that they scramble toward you

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: from the left and the right in batches?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Does each man among them hope to enter the garden of bliss?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Never! Indeed We created them from what they know.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The angels and the Spirit ascend to Him in a day whose span is fifty thousand years.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So I swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests that We are able

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: to replace them by [others] better than them and We are not to be outmaneuvered.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So leave them to gossip and play until they encounter their day, which they are promised:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the day when they emerge from the graves, hastening, as if racing toward a target,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: with a humbled look [in their eyes], overcast by abasement. That is the day they had been promised.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So be patient, with a patience that is graceful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed they see it to be far off,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and We see it to be near.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day when the sky will be like molten copper,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ma'aarij:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the mountains like [tufts of] dyed wool,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Keep your agreements. You are permitted animals of grazing livestock, disallowing game while you are in pilgrim sanctity.1 Indeed Allah decrees whatever He desires.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who are faithless and deny Our signs, they shall be the inmates of hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:100 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'The good and the bad are not equal, though the abundance of the bad should amaze you.' So be wary of Allah, O you who possess intellect, so that you may be felicitous!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:101 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not ask about things which, if they are disclosed to you, will upset you. Yet if you ask about them while the Qur'ān is being sent down, they shall be disclosed to you. Allah has excused it, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-forbearing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:102 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly some people asked about them before you and then came to disbelieve in them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:103 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has not prescribed any such thing as Baḥīrah, Sā'ibah, Waṣīlah, or Hām;1 but those who are faithless fabricate lies against Allah, and most of them do not apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:104 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when they are told, 'Come to what Allah has sent down and [come] to the Apostle,' they say, 'Sufficient for us is what we have found our fathers following.' What, even if their fathers did not know anything and were not guided?!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:105 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Take care of your own souls. He who strays cannot hurt you if you are guided. To Allah will be the return of you all, whereat He will inform you concerning what you used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:106 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! The witness between you, when death approaches any of you, while making a bequest, shall be two fair men from among yourselves —or two from among others,1 if you are journeying in the land and the affliction of death visits you. You shall detain the two of them after the prayer, and, if you have any doubt, they shall vow by Allah, 'We will not sell it for any gain, even if it were a relative, nor will we conceal the testimony of Allah, for then we would indeed be among the sinners.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:107 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if it is found that both of them were guilty of a sin,1 then two others shall stand up in their place from among those nearest in kinship to the claimants and swear by Allah: 'Our testimony is surely truer than their testimony, and we have not transgressed, for then we would indeed be among the wrongdoers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:108 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That makes it likelier that they give the testimony in its genuine form, or fear that other oaths will be taken after their oaths. Be wary of Allah and listen, and Allah does not guide the transgressing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:109 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day Allah will gather the apostles and say, 'What was the response to you?' They will say, 'We have no knowledge. Indeed You are knower of all that is Unseen.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Remember Allah's blessing upon you when a people set out to extend their hands against you, but He withheld their hands from you, and be wary of Allah, and in Allah let all the faithful put their trust.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:110 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Allah will say, O Jesus son of Mary, remember My blessing upon you and upon your mother, when I strengthened you with the Holy Spirit, so you would speak to the people in the cradle and in adulthood, and when I taught you the Book and wisdom, the Torah and the Evangel, and when you would create from clay the form of a bird, with My leave, and you would breathe into it and it would become a bird, with My leave; and you would heal the blind and the leper, with My leave, and you would raise the dead, with My leave; and when I held off [the evil of] the Children of Israel from you when you brought them manifest proofs, whereat the faithless among them said, 'This is nothing but plain magic.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:111 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when I inspired the Disciples, [saying], 'Have faith in Me and My apostle,' they said, 'We have faith. Bear witness that we are muslims.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:112 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the Disciples said, 'O Jesus son of Mary! Can your Lord send down to us a table1 from the sky?' Said he, 'Be wary of Allah, should you be faithful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:113 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'We desire to eat from it, and our hearts will be at rest: we shall know that you have told us the truth, and we shall be among the witnesses to it.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:114 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Said Jesus son of Mary, 'O Allah! Our Lord! Send down to us a table from the sky, to be a festival for us, for the first ones and the last ones among us and as a sign from You, and provide for us; for You are the best of providers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:115 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah said, 'I will indeed send it down to you. But should any of you disbelieve after this, I will indeed punish him with a punishment such as I do not punish anyone in all creation.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:116 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when Allah will say, 'O Jesus son of Mary! Was it you who said to the people, "Take me and my mother for gods besides Allah"?' He will say, 'Immaculate are You! It does not behoove me to say what I have no right to [say]. Had I said it, You would certainly have known it: You know whatever is in my self, and I do not know what is in Your Self. Indeed You are knower of all that is Unseen.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:117 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I did not say to them [anything] except what You had commanded me [to say]: "Worship Allah, my Lord and your Lord." And I was a witness to them so long as I was among them. But when You had taken me away, You Yourself were watchful over them, and You are witness to all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:118 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If You punish them, they are indeed Your creatures; but if You forgive them, You are indeed the All-mighty, the All-wise.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:119 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah will say, 'This day truthfulness shall benefit the truthful. For them there will be gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them forever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. That is the great success.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly Allah took a pledge from the Children of Israel, and We raised among them twelve chiefs. And Allah said, 'I am with you! Surely, if you maintain the prayer and give the zakāt and have faith in My apostles and support them and lend Allah a good loan, I will surely absolve you of your misdeeds, and I will surely admit you into gardens with streams running in them. But whoever of you disbelieves after that has certainly strayed from the right way.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:120 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatever there is in them, and He has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then, because of their breaking their covenant We cursed them and made their hearts hard: they pervert words from their meanings, and have forgotten a part of what they were reminded. You will not cease to learn of some of their treachery, excepting a few of them. Yet excuse them and forbear. Indeed Allah loves the virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Also from those who say, 'We are Christians,' We took their pledge; but they forgot a part of what they were reminded. So We stirred up enmity and hatred among them until the Day of Resurrection, and soon Allah will inform them concerning what they had been doing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O People of the Book! Certainly Our Apostle has come to you, clarifying for you much of what you used to hide of the Book, and excusing many [an offense of yours]. Certainly there has come to you a light from Allah, and a manifest Book.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: With it Allah guides those who follow [the course of] His pleasure to the ways of peace, and brings them out from darkness into light by His will, and guides them to a straight path.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are certainly faithless who say, 'Allah is the Messiah, son of Mary.' Say, 'Who can avail anything against Allah should He wish to destroy the Messiah, son of Mary, and his mother, and everyone upon the earth?' To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and whatever is between them. He creates whatever He wishes, and Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Jews and the Christians say, 'We are Allah's children and His beloved ones.' Say, 'Then why does He punish you for your sins?' Rather you are humans from among His creatures. He forgives whomever He wishes, and punishes whomever He wishes, and to Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and whatever is between them, and toward Him is the return.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O People of the Book! Certainly Our Apostle has come to you, clarifying [the Divine teachings] for you after a gap in [the appearance of] the apostles, lest you should say, 'There did not come to us any bearer of good news nor any warner.' Certainly there has come to you a bearer of good news and a warner. And Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not violate Allah's sacraments, neither the sacred month,1 nor the offering,2 nor the necklaces, nor those bound3 for the Sacred House who seek their Lord's grace and [His] pleasure. But when you emerge from pilgrim sanctity you may hunt for game. Ill feeling for a people should not lead you, because they barred you from [entering] the Sacred Mosque, to transgress. Cooperate in piety and Godwariness, but do not cooperate in sin and aggression, and be wary of Allah. Indeed Allah is severe in retribution.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Moses said to his people, 'O my people, remember Allah's blessing upon you when He appointed prophets among you, and made you kings, and gave you what none of the nations were given.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O my people, enter the Holy Land which Allah has ordained for you, and do not turn your backs or you will become losers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'O Moses, there are a tyrannical people in it. We will not enter it until they leave it. But once they leave it, we will go in.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Said two men from among those who were Godfearing and whom Allah had blessed: 'Go at them by the gate! For once you have entered it, you will be victors. Put your trust in Allah, should you be faithful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'O Moses, we will never enter it so long as they remain in it. Go ahead, you and your Lord, and fight! We will be sitting right here.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord! I have no power over [anyone] except myself and my brother, so part us from the transgressing lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'It shall be forbidden them for forty years: they shall wander about in the earth. So do not grieve for the transgressing lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Relate to them truly the account of Adam's two sons. When the two of them offered an offering, it was accepted from one of them and not accepted from the other. [One of them] said, 'Surely I will kill you.' [The other one] said, 'Allah accepts only from the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Even if you extend your hand toward me to kill me, I will not extend my hand toward you to kill you. Indeed I fear Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I desire that you earn [the burden of] my sin1 and your sin, to become one of the inmates of the Fire, and such is the requital of the wrongdoers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You are prohibited carrion, blood, the flesh of swine, and what has been offered to other than Allah, and the animal strangled or beaten to death, and that which dies by falling or is gored to death, and that which is mangled by a beast of prey —barring that which you may purify1— and what is sacrificed on stone altars [to idols], and that you should divide by raffling with arrows. All that is transgression. Today the faithless have despaired of your religion. So do not fear them, but fear Me. Today I have perfected your religion for you, and I have completed My blessing upon you, and I have approved Islam as your religion. But should anyone be compelled by hunger, without inclining to sin, then Allah is indeed all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So his soul prompted him to kill his brother, and he killed him, and thus became one of the losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then Allah sent a crow, exploring in the ground, to show him how to bury the corpse of his brother. He said, 'Woe to me! Am I unable to be [even] like this crow and bury my brother's corpse?' Thus he became regretful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is why We decreed for the Children of Israel that whoever kills a soul,1 without [its being guilty of] manslaughter or corruption on the earth, is as though he had killed all mankind, and whoever saves a life is as though he had saved all mankind. Our apostles certainly brought them manifest signs, yet even after that many of them commit excesses on the earth.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the requital of those who wage war against Allah and His Apostle, and try to cause corruption on the earth, is that they shall be slain or crucified, or have their hands and feet cut off from opposite sides or be banished from the land. That is a disgrace for them in this world, and in the Hereafter there is a great punishment for them,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: excepting those who repent before you capture them, and know that Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Be wary of Allah, and seek the means of recourse to Him, and wage jihād in His way, so that you may be felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed if the faithless possessed all that is on the earth and as much of it besides to redeem themselves with it from the punishment of the Day of Resurrection, it shall not be accepted from them,1 and there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They would long to leave the Fire, but they shall never leave it, and there is a lasting punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the thief, man or woman, cut off their hands as a requital for what they have earned. [That is] an exemplary punishment from Allah, and Allah is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But whoever repents after his wrongdoing, and reforms, then Allah shall accept his repentance. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They ask you as to what is lawful to them. Say, 'All the good things are lawful to you.' As for what you have taught hunting dogs [to catch], teaching them out of what Allah has taught you, eat of what they catch for you and mention Allah's Name over it, and be wary of Allah. Indeed Allah is swift at reckoning.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you not know that to Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth? He punishes whomever He wishes, and forgives whomever He wishes, and Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Apostle! Do not grieve for those who are active in [promoting] unfaith, such as those who say, 'We believe' with their mouths, but whose hearts have no faith, and the Jews who eavesdrop with the aim of [telling] lies [against you] and eavesdrop for other people who do not come to you. They pervert words from their meanings, [and] say, 'If you are given this, take it, but if you are not given this, beware!' Yet whomever Allah wishes to mislead,1 you cannot avail him anything against Allah. They are the ones whose hearts Allah did not desire to purify. For them is disgrace in this world, and there is a great punishment for them in the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Eavesdroppers with the aim of [telling] lies, eaters of the unlawful —if they come to you, judge between them, or disregard them. If you disregard them, they will not harm you in any way. But if you judge, judge between them with justice. Indeed Allah loves the just.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And how should they make you a judge, while with them is the Torah, in which is Allah's judgement? Yet in spite of that they turn their backs [on Him] and they are not believers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We sent down the Torah containing guidance and light. The prophets, who had submitted,1 judged by it for the Jews, and so did the rabbis and the scribes, as they were charged to preserve the Book of Allah and were witnesses to it. So do not fear the people, but fear Me, and do not sell My signs for a paltry gain. Those who do not judge by what Allah has sent down —it is they who are the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And in it We prescribed for them: a life for a life, an eye for an eye, a nose for a nose, and an ear for an ear, a tooth for a tooth, and retaliation for wounds. Yet whoever remits it out of charity, that shall be an atonement for him. Those who do not judge by what Allah has sent down —it is they who are the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We followed them with Jesus son of Mary, to confirm that which was before him of the Torah, and We gave him the Evangel containing guidance and light, confirming what was before it of the Torah, and as guidance and advice for the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Let the people of the Evangel judge by what Allah has sent down in it. Those who do not judge by what Allah has sent down —it is they who are the transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have sent down to you the Book with the truth, confirming what was before it of the Book and as a guardian over it. So judge between them by what Allah has sent down, and do not follow their desires against the truth that has come to you. For each [community] among you We had appointed a code [of law] and a path,1 and had Allah wished He would have made you one community, but [His purposes required] that He should test you in respect to what He has given you. So take the lead in all good works. To Allah shall be the return of you all, whereat He will inform you concerning that about which you used to differ.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Judge between them by what Allah has sent down, and do not follow their desires. Beware of them lest they should beguile you from part of what Allah has sent down to you. But if they turn their backs [on you], then know that Allah desires to punish them for some of their sins, and indeed many of the people are transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Today all the good things have been made lawful to you: —the food of those who were given the Book is lawful to you, and your food is lawful to them— and the chaste ones from among faithful women, and chaste women of those who were given the Book before you, when you have given them their dowries, in wedlock, not in license, nor taking paramours. Should anyone renounce his faith, his work shall fail and he will be among the losers in the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they seek the judgement of [pagan] ignorance? But who is better than Allah in judgement for a people who have certainty?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not take the Jews and the Christians for allies: they are allies of each other. Any of you who allies with them is indeed one of them. Indeed Allah does not guide the wrongdoing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yet you see those in whose hearts is a sickness rushing to them, saying, 'We fear lest a turn of fortune should visit us.' Maybe Allah will bring about a victory, or a command from Him, and then they will be regretful for what they kept secret in their hearts,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the faithful will say, 'Are these the ones who swore by Allah with solemn oaths that they were with you?!' Their works have failed, and they have become losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Should any of you desert his religion, Allah will soon bring a people whom He loves and who love Him, [who will be] humble towards the faithful, stern towards the faithless, waging jihād in the way of Allah, not fearing the blame of any blamer. That is Allah's grace which He grants to whomever He wishes, and Allah is all-bounteous, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your guardian is only Allah, His Apostle, and the faithful who maintain the prayer and give the zakāt while bowing down.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever takes for his guardians Allah, His Apostle and the faithful [should know that] the confederates of Allah are indeed the victorious.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not take those who take your religion in derision and play, from among those who were given the Book before you, and the infidels, as friends, and be wary of Allah, should you be faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you call to prayer, they take it in derision and play. That is because they are a people who do not apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'O People of the Book! Are you vindictive toward us1 for any reason except that we have faith in Allah and in what has been sent down to us, and in what was sent down before, and that most of you are transgressors?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! When you stand up for prayer, wash your faces and your hands up to the elbows, and wipe a part of your heads and your feet, up to the ankles. If you are junub, purify yourselves. But if you are sick, or on a journey, or any of you has come from the toilet, or you have touched women, and you cannot find water, then make tayammum with clean ground and wipe a part of your faces and your hands with it. Allah does not desire to put you to hardship, but He desires to purify you, and to complete His blessing upon you so that you may give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Shall I inform you concerning something worse than that as a requital from Allah? Those whom Allah has cursed and with whom He is wrathful, and turned some of whom into apes and swine, and worshippers1 of the Rebel! Such are in a worse situation, and more astray from the right way.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they come to you, they say, 'We believe.' Certainly they enter with disbelief and leave with it, and Allah knows best as to what they have been concealing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You see many of them actively engaged in sin and aggression, and consuming illicit gains. Surely, evil is what they have been doing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Why do not the rabbis and the scribes forbid them from sinful speech and consuming illicit gains? Surely, evil is what they have been working.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Jews say, 'Allah's hand is tied up.' Tied up be their hands, and cursed be they for what they say! Rather, His hands are wide open: He bestows as He wishes. Surely many of them will be increased by what has been sent to you from your Lord in rebellion and unfaith, and We have cast enmity and hatred amongst them until the Day of Resurrection. Every time they ignite the flames of war, Allah puts them out. They seek to cause corruption on the earth, and Allah does not like the agents of corruption.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had the People of the Book believed and been Godwary, We would surely have absolved them of their misdeeds and admitted them into gardens of bliss.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had they observed the Torah and the Evangel, and what was sent down to them from their Lord, they would surely have drawn nourishment from above them and from beneath their feet. There is an upright group among them, but evil is what many of them do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Apostle! Communicate that which has been sent down to you from your Lord, and if you do not, you will not have communicated His message, and Allah shall protect you from the people. Indeed Allah does not guide the faithless lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'O People of the Book! You do not stand on anything until you observe the Torah and the Evangel and what was sent down to you from your Lord.' Surely many of them will be increased by what has been sent down to you from your Lord in rebellion and unfaith. So do not grieve for the faithless lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the faithful, the Jews, the Sabaeans, and the Christians —those who have faith in Allah and the Last Day and act righteously— they will have no fear, nor will they grieve.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Remember Allah's blessing upon you and His covenant with which He has bound you when you said, 'We hear and obey.' And be wary of Allah. Indeed Allah knows best what is in the breasts.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We took a pledge from the Children of Israel, and We sent apostles to them. Whenever an apostle brought them that which was not to their liking, they would impugn a part of them, and a part they would slay.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They supposed there would be no testing, so they became blind and deaf. Thereafter Allah accepted their repentance, yet [again] many of them became blind and deaf, and Allah sees best what they do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are certainly faithless who say, 'Allah is the Messiah, son of Mary.' But the Messiah had said, 'O Children of Israel! Worship Allah, my Lord and your Lord. Indeed whoever ascribes partners to Allah, Allah shall forbid him [entry into] paradise, and his refuge shall be the Fire, and the wrongdoers will not have any helpers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are certainly faithless who say, 'Allah is the third [person] of a trinity,' while there is no god except the One God. If they do not relinquish what they say, there shall befall the faithless among them a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Will they not repent to Allah and plead to Him for forgiveness? Yet Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Messiah, son of Mary, is but an apostle. Certainly [other] apostles have passed before him, and his mother was a truthful one. Both of them would eat food. Look how We clarify the signs for them, and yet, look, how they go astray!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Do you worship, besides Allah, what has no power to bring you any benefit or harm, while Allah—He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing?!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'O People of the Book! Do not unduly exceed the bounds in your religion and do not follow the fancies of a people who went astray in the past, and led many astray, and [themselves] strayed from the right path.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithless among the Children of Israel were cursed on the tongue of David and Jesus son of Mary. That, because they would disobey and they used to commit transgression.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They would not forbid one another from the wrongs that they committed. Surely, evil is what they had been doing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Be maintainers, as witnesses for the sake of Allah, of justice,1 and ill feeling for a people should never lead you to be unfair. Be fair; that is nearer to Godwariness, and be wary of Allah. Allah is indeed well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You see many of them fraternizing with the faithless. Surely evil is what they have sent ahead for their souls, as Allah is displeased with them and they shall remain in punishment [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had they believed in Allah and the Prophet and what has been sent down to him, they would not have taken them for allies. But most of them are transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Surely You will find the most hostile of all people towards the faithful to be the Jews and the polytheists, and surely you will find the nearest of them in affection to the faithful to be those who say 'We are Christians.' That is because there are priests and monks among them, and because they are not arrogant.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they hear what has been revealed to the Apostle, you see their eyes fill with tears because of the truth that they recognize. They say, 'Our Lord, we believe; so write us down among the witnesses.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Why should we not believe in Allah and the truth that has come to us, eager as we are that our Lord should admit us among the righteous people?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So, for what they said, Allah requited them with gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them [forever], and that is the reward of the virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But those who are faithless and deny Our signs —they shall be the inmates of hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not prohibit the good things that Allah has made lawful to you, and do not transgress. Indeed Allah does not like the transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Eat the lawful and good things Allah has provided you, and be wary of Allah in whom you have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah shall not take you to task for what is frivolous in your oaths; but He shall take you to task for what you pledge in earnest. The atonement for it is to feed ten needy persons with the average food you give to your families, or their clothing, or the freeing of a slave. He who cannot afford [any of these] shall fast for three days. That is the atonement for your oaths when you vow. But keep your oaths. Thus does Allah clarify His signs for you so that you may give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has promised those who have faith and do righteous deeds forgiveness and a great reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Indeed wine, gambling, idols and the divining arrows are abominations of Satan's doing, so avoid them, so that you may be felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Satan seeks to cast enmity and hatred among you through wine and gambling, and to hinder you from the remembrance of Allah and from prayer. Will you, then, relinquish?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And obey Allah and obey the Apostle, and beware; but if you turn your backs, then know that Our Apostle's duty is only to communicate in clear terms.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There will be no sin upon those who have faith and do righteous deeds in regard to what they have eaten [in the past] so long as they are Godwary and faithful and do righteous deeds, and are further Godwary and faithful, and are further Godwary and virtuous. And Allah loves the virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Allah will surely test you with some of the game within the reach of your hands and spears, so that Allah may know those who fear Him in secret. So whoever transgresses after that, there is a painful punishment for him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not kill any game when you are in pilgrim sanctity. Should any of you kill it intentionally, its atonement, the counterpart from cattle of what he has killed, as judged by two fair men among you, will be an offering brought to the Ka'bah, or an atonement by feeding needy persons, or its equivalent in fasting, that he may taste the untoward consequences of his conduct. Allah has excused what is already past; but should anyone resume, Allah shall take vengeance on him, for Allah is all-mighty, avenger.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You are permitted the game of the sea and its food, a provision for you and for the caravans, but you are forbidden the game of the land so long as you remain in pilgrim sanctity, and be wary of Allah toward whom you will be gathered.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has made the Ka'bah, the Sacred House, a [means of] sustentation for mankind, and [also] the sacred month, the offering and the garlands, so that you may know that Allah knows whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth, and that Allah has knowledge of all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Know that Allah is severe in retribution, and that Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maaida:99 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Apostle's duty is only to communicate and Allah knows whatever you disclose and whatever you conceal.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maa'un:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did you see him who denies the Retribution?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maa'un:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is the one who drives away the orphan,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maa'un:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and does not urge the feeding of the needy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maa'un:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Woe to them who pray,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maa'un:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those who are heedless of their prayers,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maa'un:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: those who show off

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Maa'un:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: but deny aid.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Masad:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Perish the hands of Abu Lahab, and perish he!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Masad:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Neither his wealth availed him, nor what he had earned.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Masad:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Soon he will enter the blazing fire,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Masad:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and his wife [too], the firewood carrier,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Masad:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: with a rope of palm fibre around her neck.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you wrapped up in your mantle!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: not at all easy for the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Leave Me [to deal] with him whom I created alone,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and then furnished him with extensive means,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and [gave him] sons to be at his side,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and facilitated [all matters] for him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Still he is eager that I should give him more.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! He is an obstinate opponent of Our signs.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Soon I will overwhelm him with hardship.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed he reflected and decided.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Perish he, how he decided!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rise up and warn!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Again, perish he, how he decided!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he looked;

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then he frowned and scowled.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he went away disdainfully,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: saying, 'It1 is nothing but magic handed down.2

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is nothing but the speech of a human being.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Soon I shall cast him into Saqar.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And what will show you what is Saqar?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It neither spares nor leaves [anything].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It burns the skin.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Magnify your Lord,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There are nineteen [keepers] over it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have assigned only angels as keepers of the Fire, and We have made their number merely a stumbling block for the faithless, and that those given the Book may be reassured, and the faithful may increase in [their] faith, and that those given the Book may not doubt and the faithful [as well], and that those in whose hearts is a sickness may say, and the faithless [along with them], 'What did Allah mean by this description?' Thus does Allah lead astray whomever He wishes, and guides whomever He wishes. No one knows the hosts of your Lord except Him, and it1 is just an admonition for all humans.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! By the Moon!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the night when it recedes!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the dawn when it brightens!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it is one of the greatest [signs]

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —a warner to all humans,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [alike] for those of you who like to advance ahead and those who would linger behind.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Every soul is hostage to what it has earned,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except the People of the Right Hand.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and purify your cloak,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [They will be] in gardens, questioning

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: concerning the guilty:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'What drew you into Hell?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will answer, 'We were not among those who prayed.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Nor did we feed the poor.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
