item.description: We used to gossip along with the gossipers,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and we used to deny the Day of Retribution,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: until death came to us.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So the intercession of the intercessors will not avail them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What is the matter with them that they evade the Reminder

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and keep away from all impurity!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: as if they were terrified asses

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: fleeing from a lion?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather everyone of them desires to be given unrolled scriptures [from Allah].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! Rather they do not fear the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! It is indeed a reminder.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So let anyone who wishes remember it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they will not remember unless Allah wishes. He is worthy of [your] being wary [of Him] and He is worthy to forgive.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not grant a favour seeking a greater gain,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and be patient for the sake of your Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the Trumpet will be sounded,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that day will be a day of hardship,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has certainly heard the speech of her who pleads with you about her husband and complains to Allah. Allah hears the conversation between the two of you. Indeed Allah is all-hearing, all-seeing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed [malicious] secret talks are from Satan, that he may upset the faithful, but he cannot harm them in any way except by Allah's leave, and in Allah let all the faithful put their trust.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! When you are told, 'Make room,' in sittings, then do make room; Allah will make room for you. And when you are told, 'Rise up!' Do rise up. Allah will raise those of you who have faith and those who have been given knowledge in rank, and Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! When you talk secretly to the Apostle, offer a charity before your secret talk. That is better for you and purer. But if you cannot afford [to make the offering], then Allah is indeed all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were you apprehensive of offering charities before your secret talks? So, as you did not do it, and Allah was clement to you, maintain the prayer and pay the zakāt, and obey Allah and His Apostle. And Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded those who befriend a people1 at whom Allah is wrathful? They neither belong to you, nor to them, and they swear false oaths [that they are with you] and they know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has prepared a severe punishment for them. Evil indeed is what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They make a shield of their oaths and bar [people] from the way of Allah; so there is a humiliating punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Their possessions and children will not avail them in any way against Allah. They shall be the inmates of the Fire and they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day when Allah will raise them all together, they will swear to Him, just like they swear to you [now], supposing that they stand on something. Look! They are indeed liars!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Satan has prevailed upon them, so he has caused them to forget the remembrance of Allah. They are Satan's confederates. Look! Indeed it is Satan's confederates who are the losers!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those of you who repudiate their wives by ẓihār,1 they are not their mothers; their mothers are only those who bore them, and indeed they utter an outrageous utterance and a lie. Indeed Allah is all-excusing, all-forgiving.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who oppose Allah and His Apostle —they will be among the most abased.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has ordained: 'I shall surely prevail, I and My apostles.' Indeed Allah is all-strong, all-mighty.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You will not find a people believing in Allah and the Last Day endearing those who oppose Allah and His Apostle even though they were their own parents, or children, or brothers, or kinsfolk. [For] such, He has written faith into their hearts and strengthened them with a spirit from Him. He will admit them into gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them [forever], Allah is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. They are Allah's confederates. Look! The confederates of Allah are indeed felicitous!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who repudiate their wives by ẓihār and then retract what they have said, shall set free a slave before they may touch each other. This you are advised [to carry out], and Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He who can not afford [to free a slave] shall fast for two successive months before they may touch each other. If he cannot [do so], he shall feed sixty needy persons. This, that you may have faith in Allah and His Apostle. These are Allah's bounds, and there is a painful punishment for the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who oppose Allah and His Apostle will be subdued just as were subdued those before them. We have certainly sent down manifest signs, and there is a humiliating punishment for the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day when Allah will raise them all together, He will inform them about what they have done. Allah has kept account of it, while they forgot it, and Allah is witness to all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded that Allah knows whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth? There is no secret talk among three, but He is their fourth [companion], nor among five but He is their sixth, nor less than that, nor more, but He is with them wherever they may be. Then He will inform them about what they have done on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah has knowledge of all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded those who were forbidden from secret talks1 but again resumed what they had been forbidden from, and hold secret talks [imbued] with sin and transgression and disobedience to the Apostle? And when they2 come to you they greet you with that with which Allah never greeted you, and they say to themselves,3 'Why does not Allah punish us for what we say?!' Let hell suffice them: they shall enter it; and it is an evil destination!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! When you talk secretly, do not hold secret talks [imbued] with sin and aggression and disobedience to the Apostle, but talk secretly in [a spirit of] piety and Godfearing, and be wary of Allah toward whom you will be mustered.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Blessed is He in whose hands is all sovereignty, and He has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they will say, 'Had we listened or applied reason, we would not have been among inmates of the Blaze.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus they will admit their sin. So away with the inmates of the Blaze!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed for those who fear their Lord in secret there will be forgiveness and a great reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Speak secretly, or do so loudly, indeed He knows well what is in the breasts.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Would He who has created not know? And He is the All-attentive, the All-aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who made the earth tractable for you; so walk on its flanks and eat of His provision, and towards Him is the resurrection.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Are you secure that He who is in the sky will not make the earth swallow you while it quakes?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Are you secure that He who is in the sky will not unleash upon you a rain of stones? Soon you will know how My warning has been!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly those who were before them had denied; but then how was My rebuttal!1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not regarded the birds above them spreading and closing their wings? No one sustains them except the All-beneficent. Indeed He sees best all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He, who created death and life that He may test you [to see] which of you is best in conduct. And He is the All-mighty, the All-forgiving.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Who is it that is your host who may help you, besides the All-beneficent? The faithless only dwell in delusion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Who is it that may provide for you if He withholds His provision? Rather they persist in defiance and aversion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is he who walks prone on his face better guided, or he who walks upright on a straight path?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'It is He who created you, and made for you hearing, eyesight, and hearts. Little do you thank.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'It is He who created you on the earth, and toward Him you will be mustered.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'When will this promise be fulfilled, should you be truthful?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Its knowledge is only with Allah; I am only a manifest warner.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they see it brought near, the countenances of the faithless will be distorted, and [they will be] told, 'This is what you asked for!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Tell me, whether Allah destroys me and those with me, or He has mercy on us, who will shelter the faithless from a painful punishment?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'He is the All-beneficent; we have faith in Him, and in Him do we trust. Soon you will know who is in manifest error.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He created seven heavens in layers. You do not see any discordance in the creation of the All-beneficent. Look again! Do you see any flaw?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Tell me, should your water sink down [into the ground], who will bring you running water?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Look again, once more. Your look will return to you humbled and weary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have certainly adorned the lowest heaven with lamps, and made them missiles against the devils, and We have prepared for them punishment of the Blaze.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For those who defy their Lord is the punishment of hell, and it is an evil destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they are thrown in it, they hear it blaring, as it seethes,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: almost exploding with rage. Whenever a group is thrown in it, its keepers will ask them, 'Did there not come to you any warner?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, 'Yes, a warner did come to us, but we impugned [him] and said, 'Allah did not send down anything; you are only in great error.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly, the faithful have attained salvation

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is they who will be the inheritors,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:100 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that I may act righteously in what I have left behind.' 'By no means! These are mere words that he says.' And ahead of them is a barrier until the day they will be resurrected

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:101 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no ties between them on that day, nor will they ask [about] each other.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:102 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then those whose deeds weigh heavy in the scales —it is they who are the felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:103 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those whose deeds weigh light in the scales, —they will be the ones who have ruined their souls, [and] they will remain in hell [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:104 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Fire will scorch their faces, and they will be morose in it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:105 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Was it not that My signs were recited to you but you would deny them?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:106 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, 'Our Lord! Our wretchedness overcame us, and we were an astray lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:107 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Our Lord! Bring us out of this! Then, if we revert, we will indeed be wrongdoers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:108 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He will say, 'Begone in it, and do not speak to Me!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:109 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed there was a part of My servants who would say, "Our Lord! We have believed. So forgive us, and have mercy on us, and You are the best of the merciful."

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who shall inherit paradise, and will remain in it [forever].1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:110 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But then you took them by ridicule until they made you forget My remembrance,1 and you used to laugh at them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:111 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed I have rewarded them today for their patience. They are indeed the triumphant.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:112 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He will say, 'How many years did you remain on earth?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:113 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, 'We remained for a day, or part of a day; yet ask those who keep the count.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:114 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He will say, 'You only remained a little; if only you had known.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:115 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did you suppose that We created you aimlessly, and that you will not be brought back to Us?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:116 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So exalted is Allah, the True Sovereign, there is no god except Him, the Lord of the Noble Throne.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:117 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever invokes besides Allah another god of which he has no proof, his reckoning will indeed rest with his Lord. Indeed the faithless will not be felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:118 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We created man from an extract of clay.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We made him a drop of [seminal] fluid [lodged] in a secure abode.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We created the drop of fluid as a clinging mass. Then We created the clinging mass as a fleshy tissue. Then We created the fleshy tissue as bones. Then We clothed the bones with flesh. Then We produced him as [yet] another creature. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then indeed you die after that.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then you will indeed be raised up on the Day of Resurrection.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We created above you the seven tiers1 and We have not been oblivious of creation.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We sent down water from the sky in a measured manner, and We lodged it within the ground, and We are indeed able to take it away.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then with it We produced for you gardens of date palms and vines. There are abundant fruits in them for you, and you eat from them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those who are humble in their prayers,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And a tree that grows on Mount Sinai which produces oil and a seasoning for those who eat.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is indeed a moral for you in the cattle: We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, and you have many uses in them, and you eat some of them,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and you are carried on them and on ships.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We sent Noah to his people, and he said, 'O my people! Worship Allah! You have no other god besides Him. Will you not then be wary [of Him]?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But the elite of the faithless from among his people said, 'This is just a human being like you, who seeks to dominate you. Had Allah wished, He would have sent down angels. We never heard of such a thing among our forefathers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He is just a man possessed by madness. So bear with him for a while.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord! Help me, as they impugn me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We revealed to him: 'Build the ark before Our eyes and by Our revelation. When Our edict comes and the oven gushes [a stream of water], bring into it a pair of every kind1 [of animal], and your family, except those of them against whom the decree has gone beforehand, and do not plead with Me for those who are wrongdoers: they shall indeed be drowned.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'When you, and those who are with you, are settled in the ark, say, "All praise belongs to Allah, who has delivered us from the wrongdoing lot."

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And say, "My Lord! Land me with a blessed landing, for You are the best of those who bring ashore." '

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who avoid vain talk,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There are indeed signs in this; and indeed We have been testing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then after them We brought forth another generation,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and We sent them an apostle from among themselves, saying, 'Worship Allah! You have no other god besides Him. Will you not then be wary [of Him]?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Said the elite of his people, who were faithless and who denied the encounter of the Hereafter and whom We had given affluence in the life of the world: 'This is just a human being like you: he eats what you eat, and drinks what you drink.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you obey a human being like yourselves, you will indeed be losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones you will indeed be raised [from the dead]?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Far-fetched, far-fetched is what you are promised!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is nothing but the life of this world: we live and we die, and we shall not be resurrected.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He is just a man who has fabricated a lie against Allah, and we will not believe in him.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord! Help me, as they impugn me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who carry out their [duty of] zakāt,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'In a little while they will become regretful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So the Cry seized them justifiably and We turned them into a scum. So away with the wrongdoing lot!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then after them We brought forth other generations.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No nation can advance its time nor can it defer it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We sent Our apostles successively. Whenever there came to a nation its apostle, they impugned him, so We made them follow one another [to extinction] and We turned them into folktales. So away with the faithless lot!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We sent Moses and Aaron, his brother, with Our signs and a manifest authority,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: to Pharaoh and his elites; but they acted arrogantly and they were a tyrannical lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Shall we believe two humans like ourselves, while their people are our slaves?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So they impugned the two of them, whereat they were among those who were destroyed.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We gave Moses the Book so that they might be guided,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who guard their private parts1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and sheltered them in a highland, level and watered by a stream.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O apostles! Eat of the good things and act righteously. Indeed I know best what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed this community of yours is one community, and I am your Lord, so be wary of Me.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But they fragmented their religion among themselves, each party exulting in what it had.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So leave them in their stupor for a while.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they suppose that whatever aid We provide them in regard to wealth and children [is because]

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We are eager to bring them good? Rather they are not aware!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who are apprehensive for the fear of their Lord,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and who believe in the signs of their Lord,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and who do not ascribe partners to their Lord;

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: (except from their spouses or their slave women, for then they are not blameworthy;

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and who give whatever they give while their hearts tremble with awe that they are going to return to their Lord

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —it is they who are zealous in [performing] good works, and take the lead in them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We task no soul except according to its capacity, and with Us is a book that speaks the truth, and they will not be wronged.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather their hearts are in a stupor in regard to this, and there are their other deeds besides which they perpetrate.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When We seize their affluent ones with punishment, behold, they make entreaties [to Us].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Do not make entreaties today! Indeed you will not receive any help from Us.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly My signs used to be recited to you, but you used to take to your heels,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: being disdainful of it,1 talking nonsense in your nightly sessions.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not contemplated the discourse,1 or has anything come to them [in it] that did not come to their forefathers?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is it that they do not recognize their apostle,1 and so they deny him?2

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: but whoever seeks [anything] beyond that —it is they who are transgressors)

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they say, 'There is madness in him'? Rather he has brought them the truth, and most of them are averse to the truth.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had the Truth followed their desires, the heavens and the earth would have surely fallen apart [along] with those who are in them. Rather We have brought them their reminder, but they are disregardful of their reminder.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you ask a recompense from them? Yet your Lord's recompense is better, and He is the best of providers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed you invite them to a straight path,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and indeed those who do not believe in the Hereafter surely deviate from the path.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Should We have mercy upon them and remove their distress from them, they would surely persist, bewildered in their rebellion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have seized them with punishment, yet they neither humbled themselves to their Lord, nor did they entreat [Him for mercy].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When We opened on them the door of a severe punishment, behold, they are despondent in it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who made for you hearing, eyesight, and hearts. Little do you thank.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who created you on the earth, and you will be mustered toward Him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and those who keep their trusts and covenants,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And it is He who gives life and brings death and due to Him is the alternation of day and night. Do you not apply reason?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather they say just like what the ancients said.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'What, when we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly we and our fathers were promised this before. [But] these are nothing but myths of the ancients.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'To whom does the earth belong and whoever it contains, if you know?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, 'To Allah.' Say, 'Will you not then take admonition?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Great Throne?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, '[They belong] to Allah.' Say, 'Will you not then be wary [of Him]?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'In whose hand is the dominion of all things, and who shelters and no shelter can be provided from Him, if you know?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, '[They all belong] to Allah.' Say, 'Then how are you being deluded?'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and who are watchful of their prayers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather We have brought them the truth, and they are indeed liars.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has not taken any offspring, neither is there any god besides Him, for then each god would take away what he created, and some of them would surely rise up against others. Clear is Allah of what they allege!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Knower of the sensible and the Unseen, He is above having any partners that they ascribe [to Him].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'My Lord! If You should show me what they are promised,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then do not put me, my Lord, among the wrongdoing lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We are indeed able to show you what We promise them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Repel ill [conduct] with that which is the best. We know best whatever they allege.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And say, 'My Lord! I seek Your protection from the promptings of devils;

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and I seek Your protection, my Lord, from their presence near me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:99 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When death comes to one of them, he says, 'My Lord! Take me back,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not take My enemy and your enemy for friends, [secretly] offering them affection (for they have certainly defied whatever has come to you of the truth, expelling the Apostle and you, because you have faith in Allah, your Lord) if you have set out for jihād in My way and to seek My pleasure. You secretly nourish affection for them, while I know well whatever you hide and whatever you disclose, and whoever among you does that has certainly strayed from the right way.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! When faithful women come to you as immigrants,1 test them. Allah knows best [the state of] their faith. Then, if you ascertain them to be faithful women, do not send them back to the faithless. They2 are not lawful for them,3 nor are they4 lawful for them.5 And give them6 what they have spent [for them].7 There is no sin upon you in marrying them when you have given them their dowries. Do not hold on to [conjugal] ties with faithless women. Ask [the infidels] for what you have spent, and let the faithless ask for what they have spent.8 That is the judgment of Allah; He judges between you; and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If anything pertaining to your wives is not reclaimed from the faithless1 and then you have your turn, then give to those whose wives have left the like of what they have spent, and be wary of Allah in whom you have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Prophet! If faithful women come to you, to take the oath of allegiance to you, [pledging] that they shall not ascribe any partners to Allah, that they shall not steal, nor commit adultery, nor kill their children, nor utter any slander that they may have intentionally fabricated, nor disobey you in what is right, then accept their allegiance, and plead for them to Allah for forgiveness. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not befriend a people at whom Allah is wrathful: they have despaired of the Hereafter, just as the faithless have despaired of the occupants of the graves.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If they were to confront you they would be your enemies, and would stretch out against you their hands and their tongues with evil [intentions], and they are eager that you should be faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your relatives and your children will not avail you on the Day of Resurrection: He will separate you [from one another], and Allah sees best what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is certainly a good exemplar for you in Abraham and those who were with him, when they said to their own people, 'Indeed we repudiate you and whatever you worship besides Allah. We disavow you, and between you and us there has appeared enmity and hate for ever, unless you come to have faith in Allah alone,' except for Abraham's saying to his father, 'I will surely plead forgiveness for you, though I cannot avail you anything against Allah.' 'Our Lord! In You do we put our trust, and to You do we turn penitently, and toward You is the destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Our Lord! Do not make us a trial for the faithless, and forgive us. Our Lord! Indeed You are the All-mighty, the All-wise.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is certainly a good exemplar for you in them —for those who look forward to Allah and the Last Day— and anyone who refuses to comply [should know that] indeed Allah is the All-sufficient, the All-laudable.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It may be that Allah will bring about between you and those with whom you are at enmity affection, and Allah is all-powerful, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah does not forbid you in regard to those who did not make war against you on account of religion and did not expel you from your homes, that you deal with them with kindness and justice. Indeed Allah loves the just.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah forbids you only in regard to those who made war against you on account of religion and expelled you from your homes and supported [others] in your expulsion, that you make friends with them, and whoever makes friends with them —it is they who are the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the hypocrites come to you they say, 'We bear witness that you are indeed the apostle of Allah.' Allah knows that you are indeed His Apostle, and Allah bears witness that the hypocrites are indeed liars.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Spend from what We have provided you before death comes to any of you, whereat he will say, 'My Lord, why did You not respite me for a short time so that I might have given charity and become one of the righteous!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But Allah shall never respite a soul when its time has come, and Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They make a shield of their oaths, and bar from the way of Allah. Evil indeed is what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is because they believed and then disbelieved, so their hearts were sealed. Hence they do not understand.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you see them, their bodies impress you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. Yet they are like dry logs set reclining [against a wall]. They suppose every cry is directed against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allah assail them, where do they stray?!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they are told, 'Come, that Allah's Apostle may plead for forgiveness for you,' they twist their heads, and you see them turn away while they are disdainful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is the same for them whether you plead for forgiveness for them, or do not plead for forgiveness for them: Allah will never forgive them. Indeed Allah does not guide the transgressing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are the ones who say, 'Do not spend on those who are with the Apostle of Allah until they scatter off.' Yet to Allah belong the treasuries of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'When we return to the city, the mighty will surely expel the abased from it.'1 Yet all might belongs to Allah and His Apostle, and the faithful, but the hypocrites do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not let your possessions and children distract you from the remembrance of Allah, and whoever does that —it is they who are the losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the successive emissaries,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and when the mountains are scattered1 [like dust],

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and when the time is set for the apostles [to witness]

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —for what day has [all] that been set [to occur]?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For the Day of Judgement!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And what will show you what is the Day of Judgement!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did We not destroy the ancients,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [and] then made the latter ones follow them?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is how We deal with the guilty.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the raging hurricanes,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have We not created you from a base fluid,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [and] then lodged it in a secure abode

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: until a known span [of time]?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We designed; so how excellent designers We are!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have We not made the earth a receptacle

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: for the living and the dead,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and set in it lofty [and] firm mountains, and given you agreeable water to drink?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [They will be told]: 'Get off toward what you used to deny!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the sweeping spreaders,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Get off toward the triple-forked shadow,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: which is neither shady nor is of any avail against the flame.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it throws up sparks [huge] like palaces,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [bright] as if they were yellow camels.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is a day wherein they will not speak,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: nor will they be permitted to offer excuses.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'This is the Day of Judgement. We have brought together you and the ancients.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you have any stratagems [left], try out your stratagems against Me!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the decisive separators,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the Godwary will be amid shades and springs,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and fruits, such as they desire.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [They will be told:] 'Enjoy your food and drink, [as a reward] for what you used to do.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Eat and enjoy a little! You are indeed guilty.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they are told, 'Bow down,' they do not bow down!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Woe to the deniers on that day!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the inspirers of remembrance,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So what discourse will they believe after this?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: to excuse or to warn:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: indeed what you are promised will surely befall.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when the stars are blotted out,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and when the sky is split,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Woe to the defrauders who use short measures,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Woe to the deniers on that day,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who deny the Day of Retribution;

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and none denies it except every sinful transgressor.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Our signs are recited to him, he says, 'Myths of the ancients!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! Rather their hearts have been sullied1 by what they have been earning.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! They will be alienated from their Lord on that day.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then they will indeed enter hell,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then told, 'This is what you used to deny!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! The record of the pious is indeed in Illīyūn.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And what will show you what is Illīyūn?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who, when they measure [a commodity bought] from the people, take the full measure,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is a written record,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the pious shall be amid bliss,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: observing, [as they recline] on couches.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You will perceive in their faces the freshness of bliss

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: as they are served with a sealed wine,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: whose seal is musk —for such let the viers vie—

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and whose seasoning is from Tasnīm,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: a spring where those brought near [to Allah] drink.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the guilty used to laugh at the faithful,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: but diminish when they measure or weigh for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and when they passed them by they would wink at each other,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and when they returned to their folks they would return rejoicing,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and when they saw them they would say, 'Indeed those are the astray!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Though they were not sent to watch over them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So today the faithful will laugh at the faithless,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: observing from couches:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have the faithless been requited for what they used to do?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they not know that they will be resurrected

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: on a tremendous day,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: a day when mankind will stand before the Lord of all the worlds?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! The record of the vicious is indeed in Sijjīn.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And what will show you what is Sijjīn?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is a written record.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you wrapped up in your mantle!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and be patient over what they say, and keep away from them in a graceful manner.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Leave Me [to deal] with the deniers, the opulent, and give them a little respite.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed with Us are heavy fetters and a fierce fire,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and a food that chokes [those who gulp it], and a painful punishment [prepared for]

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the day when the earth and the mountains will quake, and the mountains will be like dunes of shifting sand.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have sent to you an apostle, to be a witness to you, just as We sent an apostle to Pharaoh.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But Pharaoh disobeyed the apostle; so We seized him with a terrible seizing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So, if you disbelieve, how will you avoid the day which will make children white-headed,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and wherein the sky will be rent apart? His promise is bound to be fulfilled.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is indeed a reminder. So let anyone who wishes take the way toward his Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Stand vigil through the night, except a little,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed your Lord knows that you stand vigil nearly two thirds of the night —or [at times] a half or a third of it— along with a group of those who are with you. Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you cannot calculate it [exactly], and so He was lenient toward you. So recite as much of the Qur'ān as is feasible. He knows that some of you will be sick, while others will travel in the land seeking Allah's grace, and yet others will fight in the way of Allah. So recite as much of it as is feasible, and maintain the prayer and pay the zakāt and lend Allah a good loan. Whatever good you send ahead for your souls you will find it with Allah [in a form] that is better and greater…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: a half, or reduce a little from that

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: or add to it, and recite the Qur'ān in a measured tone.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed soon We shall cast on you a weighty word.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the watch of the night is firmer in tread and more upright in respect to speech,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: for indeed during the day you have drawn-out engagements.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So celebrate the Name of your Lord and dedicate yourself to Him with total dedication.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Lord of the east and the west, there is no god except Him, so take Him for your trustee,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qaari'a:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Catastrophe!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qaari'a:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And what will show you what it is?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qaari'a:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is a scorching fire!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qaari'a:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What is the Catastrophe?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qaari'a:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What will show you what is the Catastrophe?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qaari'a:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day mankind will be like scattered moths,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qaari'a:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the mountains will be like carded wool.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qaari'a:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for him whose deeds weigh heavy in the scales,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qaari'a:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: he will have a pleasing life.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qaari'a:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But as for him whose deeds weigh light in the scales,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qaari'a:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: his home will be the Abyss.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qadr:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We sent it1 down on the Night of Ordainment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qadr:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What will show you what is the Night of Ordainment?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qadr:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Night of Ordainment is better than a thousand months.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qadr:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: In it the angels and the Spirit descend, by the leave of their Lord, with every command.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qadr:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is peaceful until the rising of the dawn.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Nūn. By the Pen and what they write:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And do not obey any vile swearer,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: scandal-monger, talebearer,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: hinderer of all good, sinful transgressor,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: callous and, on top of that, baseborn,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —[only] because he has wealth and children.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Our signs are recited to him, he says, 'Myths of the ancients!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Soon We shall brand him on the snout.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed we have tested them1 just as We tested the People of the Garden when they vowed they would gather its fruit at dawn,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and they did not make any exception.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then a visitation from your Lord visited it1 while they were asleep.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: you are not, by your Lord's blessing, crazy,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So by the dawn it was like a harvested field.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: At dawn they called out to one another,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Get off early to your field if you have to gather [the fruits].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So off they went, murmuring to one another:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Today no needy man shall come to you in it.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They set out early morning, [considering themselves] able to grudge.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But when they saw it, they said, 'We have indeed lost our way!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'No, we are deprived!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The most moderate among them said, 'Did I not tell you, "Why do you not glorify [Allah]?" '

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Immaculate is our Lord! We have indeed been wrongdoers!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and yours indeed will be an everlasting reward,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then they turned to one another, blaming each other.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Woe to us! Indeed we have been rebellious.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Maybe our Lord will give us a better one in its place. Indeed we turn earnestly to our Lord.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Such was the punishment; and the punishment of the Hereafter is surely greater, had they known.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed for the Godwary there will be gardens of bliss near their Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Shall We, then, treat those who submit [to Us] as [We treat] the guilty?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What is the matter with you? How do you judge!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you possess a scripture in which you read

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that you shall indeed have in it1 whatever you would like?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you have a pledge binding on Us until the Day of Resurrection, that you shall indeed have whatever you decide?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and indeed you possess a great character.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ask them, which of them will aver [any of] that!
