item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they have any partners [they ascribe to Allah]? Then let them produce their partners, if they are truthful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day when the catastrophe occurs,1 and they are summoned to prostrate themselves, they will not be able [to do it].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: With a humbled look [in their eyes], they will be overcast by abasement. Certainly they were summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet sound.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So leave Me with those who deny this discourse. We will draw them imperceptibly [into ruin], whence they do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I will grant them respite, for My devising is indeed sure.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you ask them for a reward, so that they are weighed down with debt?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they possess [access to] the Unseen so that they write it down?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord, and do not be like the Man of the Fish1 who called out as he choked with grief.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had it not been for a blessing that came to his rescue from his Lord, he would surely have been cast on a bare shore while he were blameworthy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You will see and they will see,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So his Lord chose him and made him one of the righteous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the faithless almost devour you with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say, 'He is indeed crazy.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yet it is just a reminder for all the nations.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: which one of you is crazy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed your Lord knows best those who stray from His way, and He knows best those who are guided.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So do not obey the deniers,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qalam:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who are eager that you should be pliable, so that they may be pliable [towards you].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Hour has drawn near and the moon is split.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thereat he invoked his Lord, [saying,] 'I have been overcome, so help [me].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We opened the gates of the sky with pouring waters,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and We made the earth burst forth with springs, and the waters met for a preordained purpose.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We bore him on a vessel made of planks and nails,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: which sailed [over the flood waters] in Our sight, as a retribution for him who was repudiated.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have left it as a sign; so is there anyone who will be admonished?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So how were My punishment and My warnings?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have made the Qur'ān simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [The people of] 'Ād impugned [their apostle]. So how were My punishment and My warnings?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We unleashed upon them an icy gale on an incessantly ill-fated day,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If they see a sign, they turn away, and say, 'An incessant1 magic!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: knocking down people as if they were trunks of uprooted palm trees.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So how were My punishment and My warnings?!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have made the Qur'ān simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [The people of] Thamūd denied the warnings,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and they said, 'Are we to follow a lone human from ourselves?! Indeed then we would be in error and madness.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Has the Reminder been cast upon him from among us? Rather he is a self-conceited1 liar.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Tomorrow they will know who is a self-conceited liar.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We are sending the She-camel as a trial for them; so watch them and be steadfast.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Inform them that the water is to be dispensed between them; every drinking will be attended.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But they called their companion, and he took [a knife] and hamstrung [her].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They denied, and followed their own desires, and every matter has a setting [appropriate to it].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So how were My punishment and My warnings?!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We sent against them a single Cry, and they became like the dry sticks of a corral builder.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have made the Qur'ān simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And the people of Lot denied the warnings.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We unleashed a rain of stones upon them, excepting the family of Lot, whom We delivered at dawn,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: as a blessing from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He had certainly warned them of Our punishment, but they disputed the warnings.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly they even solicited of him his guests, whereat We blotted out their eyes, [saying,] 'Taste My punishment and My warnings!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly early at dawn there visited them an abiding punishment:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Taste My punishment and My warnings!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There have already come to them reports containing admonishment,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have made the Qur'ān simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly the warnings came to Pharaoh's clan

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who denied all of Our signs. So We seized them with the seizing of One [who is] all-mighty, Omnipotent.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Are your faithless better than those, or have you [been granted] some immunity in the scriptures?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they say, 'We are a confederate league'?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The league will be routed and turn its back [to flee].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather the Hour is their tryst; and the Hour will be most calamitous and bitter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the guilty are in error and madness.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day when they are dragged into the Fire on their faces, [it will be said to them,] 'Taste the touch of hell!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have created everything in a measure,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [and representing] far-reaching wisdom; but warnings are of no avail!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and Our command is but a single [word], like the twinkling of an eye.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have destroyed your likes. So is there anyone who will be admonished?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Everything they have done is in the books,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and everything big and small, is committed to writing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and streams,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: in the abode of truthfulness1 with an omnipotent King.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So turn away from them! The day when the Caller calls to a dire thing,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: with a humbled look [in their eyes], they will emerge from the graves as if they were scattered locusts,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: scrambling toward the summoner. The faithless will say, 'This is a hard day!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qamar:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The people of Noah impugned before them. So they impugned Our servant and said, 'A crazy man,' and he was reviled.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ṭā, Sīn, Mīm.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The heart of Moses' mother became desolate, and indeed she was about to divulge it had We not fortified her heart so that she might have faith [in Allah's promise].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: She said to his sister, 'Follow him.' So she watched him from a distance, while they were not aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We had forbidden him to be suckled by any nurse since before. So she1 said, 'Shall I show you a household that will take care of him for you and will be his well-wishers?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus We restored him to his mother so that she might be comforted and not grieve, and that she might know that Allah's promise is true, but most of them do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When he came of age and became fully matured, We gave him judgement and knowledge, and thus do We reward the virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [One day] he entered the city at a time when its people dwelt in distraction. He found there two men fighting, this one from among his followers, and that one from his enemies. The one who was from his followers sought his help against him who was from his enemies. So Moses hit him with his fist, whereupon he expired. He said, 'This is of Satan's doing. Indeed he is an enemy, manifestly misguiding.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord! I have wronged myself. Forgive me!' So He forgave him. Indeed He is the All-forgiving, the All-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord! As You have blessed me, I will never be a supporter of the guilty.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He rose at dawn in the city, fearful and vigilant, when behold, the one who had sought his help the day before, shouted for his help [once again]. Moses said to him, 'You are indeed manifestly perverse!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But when he wanted to strike him who was an enemy of both of them, he said, 'Moses, do you want to kill me, just like the one you killed yesterday? You just want to be a tyrant in the land, and you do not desire to be of those who bring about reform.'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These are the signs of the Manifest Book.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And there came a man from the city outskirts, hurrying. He said, 'Moses! The elite are indeed conspiring to kill you. So leave. I am indeed your well-wisher.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So he left the city, fearful and vigilant. He said, 'My Lord! Deliver me from the wrongdoing lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when he turned his face toward Midian, he said, 'Maybe my Lord will show me the right way.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When he arrived at the well of Midian, he found there a throng of people watering [their flocks], and he found, besides them, two women holding back [their flock]. He said, 'What is your business?' They said, 'We do not water [our flock] until the shepherds have driven out [their flocks], and our father is an aged man.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So he watered [their flock] for them. Then he withdrew toward the shade and said, 'My Lord! I am indeed in need of any good You may send down to me!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then one of the two women approached him, walking bashfully. She said, 'Indeed my father invites you to pay you the wages for watering [our flock] for us.' So when he came to him and recounted the story to him, he said, 'Do not be afraid. You have been delivered from the wrongdoing lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: One of the two women said, 'Father, hire him. Indeed the best you can hire is a powerful and trustworthy man.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Indeed I desire to marry you to one of these two daughters of mine, on condition that you hire yourself to me for eight years. And if you complete ten, that will be up to you, and I do not want to be hard on you. God willing, you will find me to be one of the righteous.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'This will be [by consent] between you and me. Whichever of the two terms I complete, there shall be no reprisal against me,1 and Allah is witness over what we say.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when Moses completed the term and set out with his family, he descried a fire on the side of the mountain. He said to his family, 'Wait! Indeed I descry a fire! Maybe I will bring you some news from it, or a brand of fire so that you may warm yourselves.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We relate to you truly some of the account of Moses and Pharaoh for a people who have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When he approached it, he was called from the right bank of the valley at the blessed spot from the tree: 'Moses! Indeed I am Allah, the Lord of all the worlds!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And: 'Throw down your staff!' And when he saw it wriggling as if it were a snake, he turned his back [to flee], without looking back. 'Moses! Come forward, and do not be afraid. Indeed you are safe.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Insert your hand into your bosom. It will emerge white, without any fault, and keep your arms drawn in awe to your sides. These shall be two proofs from your Lord to Pharaoh and his elite. They are indeed a transgressing lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord! Indeed I have killed one of their men, so I fear they will kill me.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Aaron, my brother —he is more eloquent than me in speech. So send him with me as a helper to confirm me, for I fear that they will impugn me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'We will strengthen your arm by means of your brother, and invest both of you with such authority that they will not touch you. With the help of Our signs, you two, and those who follow the two of you, shall be the victors.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Moses brought them Our manifest signs, they said, 'This is nothing but concocted magic. We never heard of such a thing among our forefathers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Moses said, 'My Lord knows best who brings guidance from Him, and in whose favour the outcome of that abode will be. The wrongdoers will not be felicitous.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Pharaoh said, 'O [members of the] elite! I do not know of any god that you may have other than me. Hāmān, light for me a fire over clay,1 and build me a tower so that I may take a look at Moses' god, and indeed I consider him to be a liar!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He and his hosts acted arrogantly in the land unduly, and thought they would not be brought back to Us.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Pharaoh tyrannized over the land, reducing its people to factions, abasing one group of them, slaughtering their sons and sparing their women. Indeed He was one of the agents of corruption.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We seized him and his hosts, and threw them into the sea. So observe how was the fate of the wrongdoers!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We made them leaders who invite to the Fire, and on the Day of Resurrection they will not receive any help.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We made a curse pursue them in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be among the disfigured.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We gave Moses the Book, after We had destroyed the former generations, as [a set of] eye-openers for mankind, and as guidance and mercy so that they may take admonition.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You were not on the western side1 when We revealed the commandments2 to Moses, nor were you among the witnesses.3

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But We brought forth other generations and time took its toll on them. And you did not dwell among the people of Midian reciting to them Our signs, but it is We who are the senders [of the apostles].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And you were not on the side of the Mount when We called out [to Moses], but [We have sent you as] a mercy from your Lord that you may warn a people to whom there did not come any warner before you, so that they may take admonition.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And lest —should an affliction visit them because of what their hands have sent ahead1— they should say, 'Our Lord! Why did You not send us an apostle so that we might have followed Your signs and been among the faithful?'2

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But when there came to them the truth from Us, they said, 'Why has he not been given the like of what Moses was given?' Did they not disbelieve what Moses was given before, and said, 'Two magicians abetting each other,' and said, 'Indeed we disbelieve both of them'?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Then bring some Book from Allah better in guidance than the two1 so that I may follow it, should you be truthful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We desired to show favour to those who were abased in the land, and to make them _imam_s, and to make them the heirs,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then if they do not respond to you[r] [summons] know that they only follow their desires. And who is more astray than him who follows his desires without any guidance from Allah? Indeed Allah does not guide the wrongdoing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have concatenated the Word1 for them so that they may take admonition.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those to whom We gave the Book before it are the ones who believe in it,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and when it is recited to them, they say, 'We believe in it. It is indeed the truth from our Lord. Indeed we were muslims [even] before it [came].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those will be given their reward two times for their patience. They repel evil [conduct] with good, and spend out of what We have provided them,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and when they hear vain talk, they avoid it and say, 'Our deeds belong to us, and your deeds belong to you. Peace be to you. We do not court the ignorant.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You cannot guide whomever you wish, but [it is] Allah [who] guides whomever He wishes, and He knows best those who are guided.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'Should we follow the guidance with you, we will be dispossessed of our territory.' Did We not establish a secure sanctuary1 for them where fruits of all kinds are brought as a provision from Us? But most of them do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How many a town We have destroyed that transgressed in its lifestyle! There lie their dwellings, uninhabited after them except by a few, and We were the [sole] inheritors.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your Lord would not destroy the towns until He had raised an apostle in their mother city to recite to them Our signs. We would never destroy the towns except when their people were wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and to establish them in the land, and to show Pharaoh and Hāmān and their hosts from them1 that of which they were apprehensive.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whatever things you have been given are only the wares of the life of this world and its glitter, and what is with Allah is better and more lasting. Will you not apply reason?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is he to whom We have given a good promise, which he will receive, like him whom We have provided the wares of the life of this world, but who will be arraigned on the Day of Resurrection?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day He will call out to them and say, 'Where are My partners that you used to claim?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those against whom the word had become due will say, 'Our Lord! These are the ones whom we have perverted. We perverted them as we were perverse ourselves. We plead for non-liability before You: it was not us that they worshipped.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It will be said, 'Invoke your partners!' So they will invoke them, but they will not respond to them, and they will sight the punishment, wishing they had followed guidance.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day He will call out to them and say, 'What response did you give to the apostles?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The news that day shall be blacked out for them, so they will not question one another.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for him who repents and develops faith and acts righteously, maybe he will be among the felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your Lord creates whatever He wishes and chooses. They have no choice. Immaculate is Allah and exalted above [having] any partners they ascribe [to Him].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your Lord knows whatever their breasts conceal, and whatever they disclose.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We revealed to Moses' mother, [saying], 'Nurse him; then, when you fear for him, cast him into the river, and do not fear or grieve, for We will restore him to you and make him one of the apostles.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He is Allah, there is no god except Him. All praise belongs to Him in this world and the Hereafter. All judgement belongs to Him, and to Him you will be brought back.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Tell me, if Allah were to make the night perpetual over you until the Day of Resurrection, what god other than Allah could bring you light? Will you not then listen?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Tell me, if Allah were to make the day perpetual over you until the Day of Resurrection, what god other than Allah could bring you night wherein you could rest? Will you not then perceive?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Out of His mercy He has made for you the night and the day, that you may rest therein and that you may seek from His grace and so that you may give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day He will call out to them and say, 'Where are My partners that you used to claim?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We shall draw from every nation a witness and say, 'Produce your evidence.' Then they will know that all reality belongs to Allah and what they used to fabricate will forsake them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Korah indeed belonged to the people of Moses, but he bullied them. We had given him so much treasures that their keys indeed proved heavy for a band of stalwarts. When his people said to him, 'Do not exult! Indeed Allah does not like the exultant.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the means of what Allah has given you, seek the abode of the Hereafter, while not forgetting your share of this world. Be good [to others] just as Allah has been good to you, and do not try to cause corruption in the land. Indeed Allah does not like the agents of corruption.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'I have indeed been given [all] this because of the knowledge that I have.' Did he not know that Allah had already destroyed before him some of the generations who were more powerful than him and greater in amassing [wealth]?1 The guilty will not be questioned about their sins.2

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So he emerged before his people in his finery. Those who desired the life of the world said, 'We wish we had like what Korah has been given! Indeed he is greatly fortunate.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then Pharaoh's kinsmen picked him up that he might be to them an enemy and a cause of grief. Indeed Pharaoh and Hāmān and their hosts were iniquitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who were given knowledge said, 'Woe to you! Allah's reward is better for someone who has faith and acts righteously, and no one will receive it except the patient.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his house, and he had no party that might protect him from Allah, nor could he rescue himself.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By dawn those who longed to be in his place the day before were saying, 'Don't you see that Allah expands the provision for whomever He wishes of His servants, and tightens it? Had Allah not shown us favour, He might have made the earth swallow us too. Don't you see that the faithless do not prosper.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is the abode of the Hereafter which We shall grant to those who do not desire to domineer in the earth nor to cause corruption, and the outcome will be in favour of the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever brings virtue shall receive [a reward] better than it, but whoever brings vice —those who commit misdeeds shall not be requited except for what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed He who has revealed to you the Qur'ān1 will surely restore you to the place of return. Say, 'My Lord knows best him who brings guidance and him who is in manifest error.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You did not expect that the Book would be delivered to you; but it was a mercy from your Lord. So do not be ever an advocate of the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not ever let them bar you from Allah's signs after they have been sent down to you. Invite to your Lord, and never be one of the polytheists.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And do not invoke another god besides Allah; there is no god except Him. Everything is to perish except His Face. All judgement belongs to Him, and to Him you will be brought back.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qasas:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Pharaoh's wife said [to Pharaoh], '[This infant will be] a [source of] comfort to me and to you. Do not kill him. Maybe he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son.' And they were not aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I swear by the Day of Resurrection!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that day man will say, 'Where is the escape?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! There is no refuge!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That day the abode will be toward your Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That day man will be informed about what he has sent ahead and left behind.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather man is a witness to himself,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: though he should offer his excuses.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not move your tongue with it to hasten it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it is up to Us to put it together and to recite it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when We have recited it, follow its recitation.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then, its exposition indeed [also] lies with Us.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And I swear by the self-blaming soul!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No Indeed! Rather you love this transitory life

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and forsake the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Some faces will be fresh on that day,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: looking at their Lord,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and some faces will be scowling on that day,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: knowing that they will be dealt out a punishment breaking the spine.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! When the soul reaches up to the collar bones,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and it is said, 'Who will take him up?'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and he knows that it is the [time of] parting,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and each shank clasps the other shank,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Does man suppose that We shall not put together his bones?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that day he shall be driven toward your Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He neither confirmed [the truth], nor prayed,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: but denied [it] and turned away,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and went swaggering to his family.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So woe to you! Woe to you!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Again, woe to you! Woe to you!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Does man suppose that he would be abandoned to futility?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Was he not a drop of emitted semen?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he became a clinging mass; then He created [him] and proportioned [him],

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and made of him the two sexes, the male and the female.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yes indeed, We are able to proportion [even] his fingertips!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is not such a one able to revive the dead?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather man desires to go on living viciously.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He asks, 'When is this day of resurrection?!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But when the eyes are dazzled,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the moon is eclipsed,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qiyaama:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the sun and the moon are brought together,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the Imminent1 [Hour] befalls

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And the Foremost Ones are the foremost ones:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: they are the ones brought near [to Allah],

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [who will reside] in the gardens of bliss.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A multitude from the former [generations]1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and a few from the latter ones.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On brocaded couches

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: reclining on them, face to face.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will be waited upon by immortal youths,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: with goblets and ewers and a cup of a clear wine,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: which neither causes them headache nor stupefaction,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —there is no denying that it will befall—

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and such fruits as they prefer

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and such flesh of fowls as they desire,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and big-eyed houris

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: like guarded pearls,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: a reward for what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will not hear therein any vain talk or sinful speech,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: but only the watchword, 'Peace!' 'Peace!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And the People of the Right Hand —what are the People of the Right Hand?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Amid thornless lote trees

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and clustered spathes1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [it will be] lowering, exalting.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and extended shade,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and ever-flowing water

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and abundant fruits,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: neither inaccessible, nor forbidden,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and noble spouses.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have created them with a special creation,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and made them virgins,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: loving, of a like age,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: for the People of the Right Hand.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A multitude from the former [generations]

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the earth is shaken violently,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and a multitude from the latter [ones].

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And the People of the Left Hand —what are the People of the Left Hand?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Amid infernal miasma and boiling water

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the shadow of a dense black smoke,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: neither cool nor beneficial.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed they had been affluent before this,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and they used to persist in the great sin.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they used to say, 'What! When we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And our forefathers too?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Indeed the former and latter generations

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the mountains are shattered into bits

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: will all be gathered for the tryst of a known day.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then indeed, you, astray deniers,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: will surely eat from the Zaqqūm tree

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and stuff your bellies with it,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and drink boiling water on top of it,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: drinking like thirsty camels.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Such will be the hospitality they receive on the Day of Retribution.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We created you. Then why do you not acknowledge it?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you considered the sperm that you emit?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is it you who create it, or are We the creator?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and become scattered dust,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have ordained death among you, and We are not to be outmaneuvered

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: from replacing you with your likes and recreating you in [a realm] you do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly you have known the first genesis, then why do you not take admonition?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you considered what you sow?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is it you who make it grow, or are We the grower?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If We wish, We surely turn it into chaff, whereat you are left stunned1 [saying to yourselves,]

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Indeed we have suffered loss!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather we are deprived!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you considered the water that you drink?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is it you who bring it down from the rain cloud, or is it We who bring [it] down?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: you will be three groups:

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If We wish We can make it bitter. Then why do you not give thanks?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you considered the fire that you kindle?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Was it you who caused its tree to grow, or were We the grower?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It was We who made it a reminder and a boon for the desert-dwellers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So celebrate the Name of your Lord, the All-supreme.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So I swear1 by the places where2 the stars set!3

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And indeed it is a great oath, should you know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is indeed a noble Qur'ān,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: in a guarded Book,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —no one touches it except the pure ones—

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The People of the Right Hand —and what are the People of the Right Hand?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: gradually sent down from the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What! Do you take lightly this discourse?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And make your denial of it your vocation?1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when it1 reaches the throat [of the dying person]

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and at that moment you are looking on

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —and We are nearer to him1 than you are, though you do not perceive—

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then why do you not, if you are not subject1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [to the Divine dispensation], restore it, should you be truthful?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then, if he be of those brought near,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then ease, abundance, and a garden of bliss.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And the People of the Left Hand —and what are the People of the Left Hand?

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if he be of the People of the Right Hand,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then 'Peace be on you,' [a greeting] from the People of the Right Hand!

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if he be of the impugners, the astray ones,

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then a treat of boiling water

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and entry into hell.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed this is certain truth.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Waaqia:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So celebrate the Name of your Lord, the All-supreme!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naas:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I seek the protection of the Lord of humans,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naas:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Sovereign of humans,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naas:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: God of humans,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naas:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: from the evil of the sneaky tempter

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naas:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who puts temptations into the breasts of humans,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naas:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: from among the jinn and humans.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By those [angels] who wrest [the soul] violently,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, 'Are we being returned to our earlier state?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What, when we have been decayed bones?!'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, 'This, then, is a ruinous return!'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yet it will be only a single shout,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and behold, they will be awake.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did you receive the story of Moses,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when his Lord called out to him in the holy valley of Ṭuwā?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [And said,] 'Go to Pharaoh, for indeed he has rebelled,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and say, "Would you purify yourself?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I will guide you to your Lord, that you may fear [Him]?" '

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by those who draw [it] out gently,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he showed him the greatest sign.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But he denied, and disobeyed.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he turned back, walking swiftly,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and mustered [the people] and proclaimed,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: saying, 'I am your exalted lord!'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So Allah seized him with the punishment of this life and the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is indeed a moral in that for someone who fears!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is it you whose creation is more prodigious or the sky which He has built?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He raised its vault, and fashioned it,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and darkened its night, and brought forth its day;

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by those who swim smoothly,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and after that He spread out the earth,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and brought forth from it its water and pastures,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and set firm the mountains,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: as a [place of] sustenance for you and your livestock.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the Greatest Catastrophe befalls,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the day when man will remember his endeavours,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and hell is brought into view for one who sees,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: as for him who was rebellious

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and preferred the life of this world,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: his refuge will indeed be hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by those who take the lead, racing,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But as for him who is awed to stand before his Lord and forbids the soul from [following] desire,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: his refuge will indeed be paradise.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They ask you concerning the Hour, "When will it set in,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: considering your frequent mention of it?"

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Its outcome is with your Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day they see it, it shall be as if they had not stayed [in the world] except for an evening or forenoon.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by those who direct the affairs [of creatures]:

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the day when the Quaker quakes

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and is followed by the Successor,1

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: hearts will be trembling on that day,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naazi'aat:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: bearing a humbled look.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What is it about which they question each other?!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and make the night a covering?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and make the day for livelihood?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and build above you the seven mighty heavens?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and make [the sun for] a radiant lamp?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and send down water pouring from the rain-clouds,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that with it We may bring forth grains and plants,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and luxuriant gardens?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the Day of Judgement is the tryst,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will come in groups,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the sky will be opened and become gates,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [Is it] about the great tiding,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the mountains will be set moving and become a mirage.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed hell is an ambush,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: a resort for the rebels,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: to reside therein for ages,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: tasting in it neither any coolness nor drink,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except boiling water and pus

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —a fitting requital.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed they did not expect any reckoning,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and they denied Our signs mendaciously,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and We have figured everything in a Book.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the one about which they differ?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So [now] taste! We shall increase you in nothing but punishment!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed a triumph awaits the Godwary:

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: gardens and vineyards,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and buxom maidens of a like age,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and brimming cups.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Therein they shall hear neither vain talk nor lies

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —a reward from your Lord, a bounty sufficing,1

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the All-beneficent, whom they will not be able to address

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: on the day when the Spirit and the angels stand in an array. None shall speak except whom the All-beneficent permits and who says what is right.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is the day of truth. So let anyone who wishes take resort with his Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! They will soon know!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have warned you of a punishment near at hand —the day when a person will observe1 what his hands have sent ahead and the faithless one will say, 'I wish I were dust!'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Again, no indeed! They will soon know!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did We not make the earth a resting place?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the mountains stakes?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and create you in pairs?1

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naba:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and make your sleep for rest?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah's edict is coming! So do not seek to hasten it. Immaculate is He and exalted above [having] any partners that they ascribe [to Him].

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who sends down water from the sky: from it you get your drink and from it are [sustained] the plants wherein you pasture your herds.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:100 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: His authority is only over those who befriend him and those who make him a partner [of Allah].

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:101 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When We change a sign with another in its place —and Allah knows best what He sends down— they say, 'You are just a fabricator.' Rather most of them do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:102 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, the Holy Spirit has brought it down duly from your Lord to fortify those who have faith and as a guidance and good news for the muslims.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:103 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We certainly know that they say, 'It is only a human that instructs him.' The language of him to whom they refer is non-Arabic, while this is a clear Arabic language.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:104 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who do not believe in the signs of Allah —Allah shall not guide them and there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:105 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Only those fabricate lies who do not believe in the signs of Allah, and it is they who are the liars.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:106 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
