item.description: Whoever renounces faith in Allah after [affirming] his faith —barring someone who is compelled while his heart is at rest in faith— but those who open up their breasts to unfaith, upon such shall be Allah's wrath, and there is a great punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:107 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That, because they preferred the life of the world to the Hereafter and that Allah does not guide the faithless lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:108 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are the ones on whose hearts Allah has set a seal, and on their hearing and their sight [as well], and it is they who are the heedless.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:109 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Undoubtedly, they are the ones who will be the losers in the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: With it He makes the crops grow for you and olives, date palms, vines, and fruits of all kinds. There is indeed a sign in that for a people who reflect.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:110 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then indeed your Lord, to those who migrated, after they were persecuted, and waged jihād and were patient —indeed, after that, your Lord will surely be all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:111 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day when every soul will come pleading for itself and every soul will be recompensed fully for what it has done, and they will not be wronged.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:112 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah draws a parable: A town secure and peaceful. Its provision came abundantly from every place. But it was ungrateful toward Allah's blessings. So Allah made it taste hunger and fear because of what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:113 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There had certainly come to them an apostle from among themselves, but they impugned him, so the punishment seized them while they were wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:114 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So eat out of what Allah has provided you as lawful and good, and give thanks for Allah's blessing, if it is Him that you worship.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:115 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He has forbidden you only carrion, blood, the flesh of the swine, and that which has been offered to other than Allah. But should someone be compelled, without being rebellious or aggressive, indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.1

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:116 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not say, asserting falsely with your tongues, 'This is lawful, and this is unlawful,' to fabricate lies against Allah. Indeed those who fabricate lies against Allah will not be felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:117 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A trifling enjoyment, and there will be a painful punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:118 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We forbade to the Jews what We have recounted to you earlier, and We did not wrong them, but they used to wrong themselves.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:119 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then indeed your Lord, to those who commit evil out of ignorance and then repent after that, and reform —indeed, after that, your Lord will surely be all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He disposed the night and the day for you, and the sun, the moon and the stars are disposed by His command. There are indeed signs in that for a people who apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:120 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Abraham was a nation obedient to Allah, a ḥanīf, and he was not one of the polytheists.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:121 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Grateful [as he was] for His blessings, He chose him and guided him to a straight path.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:122 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We gave him good in this world, and in the Hereafter he will indeed be among the Righteous.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:123 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We revealed to you [saying], 'Follow the creed of Abraham, a ḥanīf, and he was not one of the polytheists.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:124 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Sabbath was only prescribed for those who differed about it. Your Lord will indeed judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that about which they used to differ.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:125 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good advice and dispute with them in a manner that is best. Indeed your Lord knows best those who stray from His way, and He knows best those who are guided.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:126 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if you retaliate, retaliate with the like of what you have been made to suffer, but if you are patient that is surely better for the patient.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:127 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So be patient, and you cannot be patient except with Allah['s help]. And do not grieve for them, nor be upset by their guile.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:128 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah is with those who are Godwary and those who are virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And whatever He has created for you in the earth of diverse hues —there is indeed a sign in that for a people who take admonition.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who disposed the sea [for your benefit] that you may eat from it fresh meat, and obtain from it ornaments, which you wear —and you see the ships plowing through it— and that you may seek of His grace, and that you may give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He cast in the earth firm mountains lest it should shake with you, and [made] streams and ways, so that you may be guided

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —and the landmarks [as well], and by the stars they are guided.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is He who creates like one who does not create? Will you not then take admonition?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you enumerate Allah's blessings, you will not be able to count them. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah knows whatever you hide and whatever you disclose.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He sends down the angels with the Spirit of His command1 to whomever He wishes of His servants: 'Warn [the people] that there is no god except Me; so be wary of Me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those whom they invoke besides Allah do not create anything and are themselves created.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are dead, not living, and are not aware when they will be resurrected.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your God is the One God. Those who do not believe in the Hereafter, their hearts are amiss,1 and they are arrogant.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Undoubtedly, Allah knows whatever they hide and whatever they disclose. Indeed He does not like the arrogant.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they are told, 'What is it that your Lord has sent down?' They say, 'Myths of the ancients,'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that they may bear their entire burdens on the Day of Resurrection, along with some of the burdens of those whom they lead astray without any knowledge. Look! Evil is what they bear!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who were before them [had also] schemed. Then Allah razed their edifice from the foundations and the roof collapsed upon them from above and the punishment overtook them whence they were not aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then He will disgrace them on the Day of Resurrection, and say, 'Where are My partners for whose sake you used to defy [Allah]?' Those who were given knowledge will say, 'Indeed today disgrace and distress pursue the faithless.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —Those whom the angels take away while they are wronging themselves. Thereat they submit: 'We were not doing any evil!' 'Yes, indeed Allah knows best what you used to do!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Enter the gates of hell to remain in it [forever]. Evil is the [final] abode of the arrogant.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He created the heavens and the earth with reason. He is above having any partners that they ascribe [to Him].

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But to those who were Godwary it will be said, 'What is it that your Lord has sent down?' They will say, 'Good.' For those who do good in this world there will be a good [reward], and the abode of the Hereafter is better, and the abode of the Godwary is surely excellent:

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the Gardens of Eden, which they will enter, with streams running in them. There they will have whatever they wish, and thus does Allah reward the Godwary

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those whom the angels take away while they are pure. They say [to them], 'Peace be to you! Enter paradise because of what you used to do.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they await anything but that the angels should come to them, or your Lord's edict should come? Those who were before them had acted likewise; Allah did not wrong them, but they used to wrong themselves.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So the evils of what they had earned visited them, and they were besieged by what they used to deride.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The polytheists say, 'Had Allah wished, we would not have worshiped anything besides Him —neither we, nor our fathers— nor would we have held anything holy besides Him.'1 Those who were before them had acted likewise. Is the apostles' duty anything but to communicate in clear terms?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We raised an apostle in every nation [to preach:] 'Worship Allah, and keep away from the Rebels.' Then among them were some whom Allah guided, and among them were some who deserved to be in error. So travel over the land and then observe how was the fate of the deniers.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you are eager for them to be guided, indeed Allah does not guide those who mislead [others], and they will have no helpers.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They swear by Allah with solemn oaths that Allah will not resurrect those who die. Yes indeed, it is a promise binding upon Him, but most people do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That He may clarify for them what they differ about, and that the faithless may know that they were liars.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He created man from a drop of [seminal] fluid,1 and, behold, he is an open contender!2

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: All that We say to a thing, when We will it, is to say to it 'Be!' and it is.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who migrate for the sake of Allah after they have been wronged, We will surely settle them in a good place in the world, and the reward of the Hereafter is surely greater, had they known.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —Those who are patient and put their trust in their Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not send [any apostles] before you except as men to whom We revealed —ask the People of the Reminder if you do not know—

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [and sent them] with manifest proofs and scriptures. We have sent down the reminder to you so that you may clarify for the people that which has been sent down to them, so that they may reflect.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do those who make evil schemes feel secure that Allah will not make the earth swallow them, or the punishment will not overtake them whence they are not aware?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Or that He will not seize them in the midst of their bustle, whereupon they will not be able to thwart [Him]?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Or that He will not visit them with attrition?1 Indeed your Lord is most kind and merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not regarded that whatever thing Allah has created casts its shadow to the right and to the left, prostrating to Allah in utter humility?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, including animals and angels, and they are not arrogant.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He created the cattle, in which there is warmth1 for you and [other] uses and some of them you eat.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They fear their Lord above them, and do what they are commanded.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And Allah has said, 'Do not worship two gods. Indeed He is the One God, so be in awe of Me [alone].'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him belongs the enduring religion. Will you, then, be wary of other than Allah?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whatever blessing you have is from Allah, then when a distress befalls you, you make entreaties to Him.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then when He removes the distress from you, behold, a part of them ascribe partners to their Lord,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: being unthankful for what We have given them. So let them enjoy. Soon they shall know!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To what they do not know, they attribute a share of what We have provided them. By Allah, you will surely be questioned concerning what you used to fabricate.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they attribute daughters to Allah —immaculate is He— while they will have what they desire!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When one of them is brought the news of a female [newborn], his face becomes darkened and he chokes with suppressed agony.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He hides from the people out of distress at the news he has been brought: shall he retain it in humiliation, or bury it in the ground!1 Look! Evil is the judgement that they make.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is in them a beauty for you when you bring them home for rest and when you drive them forth to pasture.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter there is an evil description, and the loftiest description belongs to Allah, and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were Allah to take mankind to task for their wrongdoing, He would not leave any living being upon it.1 But He respites them until a specified time; so when their time comes they shall not defer it by a single hour nor shall they advance it.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They attribute to Allah what they dislike [for themselves], and their tongues assert the lie that the best reward will be theirs. Undoubtedly, the Fire shall be their lot and they will be foremost [in entering it].1

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By Allah, We have certainly sent [apostles] to nations before you. But Satan made their deeds seem decorous to them. So he is their master1 today and there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not send down the Book to you except [for the purpose] that you may clarify for them what they differ about, and as a guidance and mercy for a people who have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah sends down water from the sky with which He revives the earth after its death. There is indeed a sign in that for a people who listen.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is indeed a moral for you in the cattle: We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies from between [intestinal] waste and blood, as pure milk, pleasant to those who drink.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And of the fruits of date palms and vines, from which you draw wine and goodly provision. There are indeed signs in that for a people who apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And your Lord inspired the bee [saying]: 'Make your home in the mountains, and on the trees and the trellises that they erect.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then eat from every [kind of] fruit and follow meekly the ways of your Lord.' There issues from its belly a juice of diverse hues in which there is a cure for the people. There is indeed a sign in that for a people who reflect.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they bear your burdens to towns which you could not reach except by straining yourselves. Indeed your Lord is most kind and merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has created you, then He takes you away, and there are some among you who are relegated to the nethermost age so that he knows nothing after [having possessed] some knowledge. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-powerful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has granted some of you an advantage over others in [respect of] provision. Those who have been granted an advantage do not give over their provision to their slaves so that they become equal in its respect. What, will they dispute the blessing of Allah?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah made for you mates from your own selves and appointed for you, from your mates, children and grandchildren, and We provided you with all the good things. What, will they believe in falsehood while they deny the blessing of Allah?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They worship besides Allah what has no power to provide them with anything from the heavens and the earth, nor are they capable [of doing that].

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So do not draw comparisons for Allah: indeed Allah knows and you do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah draws a parable: a chattel who has no power over anything, and one whom We have provided a goodly provision and who spends out of it secretly and openly. Are they equal? All praise belongs to Allah. But most of them do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah draws [another] parable: Two men, one of whom is dumb, having no power over anything and who is a liability to his master: wherever he directs him he does not bring any good. Is he equal to someone who enjoins justice and is [steady] on a straight path?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belongs the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. The matter of the Hour1 is just like the twinkling of an eye, or [even] swifter. Indeed Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has brought you forth from the bellies of your mothers while you did not know anything. He made for you hearing, eyesight, and hearts so that you may give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not regarded the birds disposed in the air of the sky: no one sustains them except Allah. There are indeed signs in that for a people who have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And horses, mules and asses, for you to ride them, and for adornment, and He creates what you do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is Allah who has made for you your homes as a place of rest and He made for you homes out of the skins of the cattle which you find portable on the day of your shifting and on the day of your halt, and out of their wool, their fur and hair furniture and wares [enduring] for a while.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is Allah who has made for you shade from what He created, and made for you retreats in the mountains, and made for you garments that protect you from heat and garments that protect you from your [mutual] violence. That is how He completes His blessing upon you so that you may submit [to Him].

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they turn their backs [on you], your duty is only to communicate in clear terms.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They recognize the blessing of Allah and then deny it, and most of them are faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day We shall raise a witness from every nation, then the faithless will not be permitted [to speak],1 nor will they be asked to propitiate [Allah].

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when the wrongdoers sight the punishment, it shall not be lightened for them, nor will they be granted any respite.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the polytheists sight their partners, they will say, 'Our Lord! These are our partners whom we used to invoke besides You.' But they will retort to them, 'You are indeed liars!'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will submit to Allah on that day, and what they used to fabricate will forsake them.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who are faithless and bar from the way of Allah —We shall add punishment to their punishment because of the corruption they used to cause.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day We raise in every nation a witness against them from among themselves, We shall bring you as a witness against these. We have sent down the Book to you as a clarification of all things and as a guidance and mercy and good news for the muslims.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: With Allah rests guidance to the straight path,1 and some of them2 are devious, and had He wished He would have guided you all.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah enjoins justice and kindness and generosity towards relatives, and He forbids indecency, wrong, and aggression. He advises you, so that you may take admonition.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Fulfill Allah's covenant when you pledge, and do not break [your] oaths after pledging them solemnly and having made Allah a witness over yourselves. Indeed Allah knows what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not be like her who would undo her yarn, breaking it up after [spinning it to] strength, by making your oaths a means of [mutual] deceit among yourselves, so that one community may become more affluent than another community.1 Allah only tests you thereby, and He will surely clarify for you on the Day of Resurrection what you used to differ about.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had Allah wished, He would have made you one community, but He leads astray whomever He wishes and guides whomever He wishes, and you will surely be questioned concerning what you used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not make your oaths a means of [mutual] deceit among yourselves lest feet should stumble after being steady and [lest] you suffer ill for barring from the way of Allah and there be a great punishment for you.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not sell Allah's covenant for a paltry gain. Indeed what is with Allah is better for you, should you know.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That which is with you will be spent but what is with Allah shall last, and We will surely pay the patient their reward by the best of what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever acts righteously, [whether] male or female, should he be faithful, —We shall revive him with a good life and pay them their reward by the best of what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you recite the Qur'ān, seek the protection of Allah against the outcast Satan.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nahl:99 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed he does not have any authority over those who have faith and put their trust in their Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the star when it sets:1

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: whereat He revealed to His servant whatever He revealed.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The heart did not deny what it saw.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Will you then dispute with him about what he saw?!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly he saw it1 yet another time,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the Lote Tree of the Ultimate Boundary,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: near which is the Garden of the Abode,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when there covered the Lote Tree what covered it.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The gaze did not swerve, nor did it overstep the bounds.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly he saw some of the greatest signs of his Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you considered Lāt and 'Uzzā?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: your companion1 has neither gone astray, nor gone amiss.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and Manāt, the third one?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Are you to have males and He females?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That, then, will be an unfair division!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These are but names which you have coined —you and your fathers— for which Allah has not sent down any authority. They follow nothing but conjectures and the desires of the [lower] soul, while there has already come to them the guidance from their Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Shall man have whatever he yearns for?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yet to Allah belong this world and the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How many an angel there is in the heavens whose intercession is of no avail in any way except after Allah grants permission to whomever He wishes and approves of!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who do not believe in the Hereafter give female names to the angels.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They do not have any knowledge of that. They follow nothing but conjectures, and indeed conjecture is no substitute for the truth.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So avoid those who turn away from Our remembrance and desire nothing but the life of the world.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Nor does he speak out of [his own] desire:

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is the ultimate reach of their knowledge. Indeed your Lord knows best those who stray from His way, and He knows best those who are [rightly] guided.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, that He may requite those who do evil for what they have done, and reward those who do good with the best [of rewards].

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who avoid major sins and indecencies, excepting [minor and occasional] lapses. Indeed your Lord is expansive in [His] forgiveness. He knows you best since [the time] He produced you from the earth, and since you were fetuses in the bellies of your mothers. So do not flaunt your piety: He knows best those who are Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did you see him who turned away,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: gave a little and held off?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Does he have the knowledge of the Unseen so that he sees?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Has he not been informed of what is in the scriptures of Moses,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and of Abraham, who fulfilled [his summons]:

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that no bearer shall bear another's burden,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and that nothing belongs to man except what he strives for,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: it is just a revelation that is revealed [to him],

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and that he will soon be shown his endeavour,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then he will be rewarded for it with the fullest reward;

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and that the terminus is toward your Lord,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and that it is He who makes [men] laugh, and makes [them] weep,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and that it is He who brings death and gives life,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and that it is He who created the mates,1 the male and the female,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: from a drop of [seminal] fluid when emitted;

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and that with Him lies the second genesis,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and that it is He who enriches and grants possessions,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius;

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: taught him by One of great powers,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and that it is He who destroyed the former 'Ād,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and Thamud, sparing none [of them];

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the people of Noah before that; indeed they were more unjust and rebellious;

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and He overthrew the town that was overturned,1

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: covering it with what covered it.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then which of the bounties of your Lord will you dispute?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is a warner, [in the tradition] of the warners of old.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Imminent [Hour] is near at hand.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is none that may unveil it besides Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you then wonder at this discourse,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: possessed of sound judgement.1 He2 settled,3

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and laugh and not weep,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: while you remain heedless?!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So prostrate yourselves to Allah and worship Him!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: while he was on the highest horizon.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he drew nearer and nearer

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Najm:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: until he was within two bows' length or even nearer,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ṭā, Sīn. These are the signs of the Qur'ān and a manifest Book,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Throw down your staff!' And when he saw it wriggling, as if it were a snake, he turned his back [to flee], without looking back. 'O Moses! 'Do not be afraid. Indeed the apostles are not afraid before Me,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: barring someone who does wrong and then makes up with goodness for [his] fault, for indeed I am all-forgiving, all-merciful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Insert your hand into your bosom. It will emerge white, without any fault, —among nine signs for Pharaoh and his people. Indeed they are a transgressing lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But when Our signs came to them, as eye-openers, they said, 'This is plain magic.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They impugned them —though they were convinced in their hearts— wrongfully and defiantly. So observe how was the fate of the agents of corruption!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We gave David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, 'All praise belongs to Allah, who granted us an advantage over many of His faithful servants.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Solomon inherited from David, and he said, 'O people! We have been taught the speech of the birds, and we have been given out of everything. Indeed this is a manifest advantage.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [Once] Solomon's hosts were marched out for him, comprising jinn, humans, and birds, and they were held in check.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they came to the Valley of Ants, an ant said, 'O ants! Enter your dwellings, lest Solomon and his hosts should trample on you while they are unaware.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whereat he smiled, amused at its words, and he said, 'My Lord! Inspire me to give thanks for Your blessing with which You have blessed me and my parents, and that I may do righteous deeds which may please You, and admit me, by Your mercy, among Your righteous servants.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: a guidance and good news for the faithful

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [One day] he reviewed the birds, and said, 'Why do I not see the hoopoe? Or is he absent?'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'I will surely punish him with a severe punishment, or I will surely behead him, unless he brings a clear-cut excuse.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He did not stay for long [before he turned up] and said, 'I have alighted on something which you have not alighted on, and I have brought you from Sheba a definite report.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I found a woman ruling over them, and she has been given everything, and she has a great throne.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah, and Satan has made their deeds seem decorous to them —thus he has barred them from the way [of Allah], so they are not guided—

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so that they do not prostrate themselves to Allah, who brings out the hidden in the heavens and the earth, and He knows whatever you hide and whatever you disclose.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah—there is no god except Him— is the Lord of the Great Throne.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'We shall see whether you are truthful, or if you are one of the liars.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then draw away from them and observe what [response] they return.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: She said, 'O [members of the] elite! Indeed a noble letter has been delivered to me.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those who maintain the prayer and pay the zakāt, and who are certain of the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is from Solomon, and it begins in the name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [It states,] "Do not defy me, and come to me in submission." '

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: She said, 'O [members of the] elite! Give me your opinion concerning my matter. I do not decide any matter until you are present.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'We are powerful and possess a great might. But it is up to you to command. So see what you will command.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: She said, 'Indeed when kings enter a town, they devastate it, and reduce the mightiest of its people to the most abased. That is how they act.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I will send them a gift, and I shall see what the envoys bring back.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when he1 came to Solomon, he said, 'Are you aiding me with wealth? What Allah has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather you are exultant over your gift!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Go back to them, for we will come at them with hosts which they cannot face, and we will expel them from it, abased, and they shall be degraded.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'O [members of the] elite! Which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: An afreet1 from among the jinn said, 'I will bring it to you before you rise from your place. Indeed I have the power for it and am trustworthy.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds seem decorous to them, and so they are bewildered.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The one who had knowledge of the Book1 said, 'I will bring it to you in the twinkling of an eye.' So when he saw it set near him, he said, 'This is by the grace of my Lord, to test me if I will give thanks or be ungrateful. And whoever gives thanks, gives thanks only for his own sake. And whoever is ungrateful [should know that] my Lord is indeed all-sufficient, all-generous.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Disguise her throne for her, so that we may see whether she is discerning or if she is one of the undiscerning ones.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when she came, it was said [to her], 'Is your throne like this one?' She said, 'It seems to be the same, and we were informed before it,1 and we had submitted.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: She had been barred [from the way of Allah] by what she used to worship besides Allah, for she belonged to a faithless people.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It was said to her, 'Enter the palace.' So when she saw it, she supposed it to be a pool of water, and she bared her shanks. He said, 'It is a palace paved with crystal.' She said, 'My Lord! Indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We sent to Thamūd Ṣāliḥ, their brother, [with the summons:] 'Worship Allah!' But thereat they became two groups contending with each other.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'O My people! Why do you press for evil sooner than for good? Why do you not plead to Allah for forgiveness so that you may receive His mercy?'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'We take for a bad omen you and those who are with you.' He said, 'Your bad omens are with Allah. Rather you are a people being tested.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There were nine persons1 in the city who caused corruption in the land, and did not bring about any reform.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, '[Let us] swear together by Allah that we will attack him and his family by night. Then we will surely tell his heir that we were not present at the murder of his family and we indeed speak the truth.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are the ones for whom there is a terrible punishment, and they are the ones who will be the biggest losers in the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They devised a plot, and We [too] devised a plan, but they were not aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So observe how was the outcome of their plotting, as We destroyed them and all their people.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So there lay their houses, fallen in ruin, because of their wrongdoing. There is indeed a sign in that for a people who have knowledge.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We delivered those who had faith and were Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And Lot, when he said to his people, 'What! Do you commit this indecency while you see [with your own eyes]?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you approach men with [sexual] desire instead of women?! Rather you are a senseless lot!'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But the only answer of his people was that they said, 'Expel Lot's family from your town! They are indeed a puritanical lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We delivered him and his family, except his wife. We ordained her to be among those who remained behind.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We poured down upon them a rain [of stones]. So evil was the rain of those who were warned!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'All praise belongs to Allah, and Peace be to His servants whom He has chosen.' Is Allah better, or the partners they ascribe [to Him]?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed you receive the Qur'ān from One who is all-wise, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is He who created the heavens and the earth, and sends down for you water from the sky, whereby We grow delightful gardens, whose trees you could never cause to grow…?1 What! Is there a god besides Allah? Rather they are a lot who equate [others with Allah].

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is He who made the earth an abode [for you], and made rivers [flowing] through it, and set firm mountains for it, and set a barrier between the two seas…? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Rather most of them do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is He who answers the call of the distressed [person] when he invokes Him and removes his distress, and makes you the earth's successors…? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Little is the admonition that you take.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is He who guides you in the darkness of land and sea and who sends the winds as harbingers of His mercy…? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Exalted is Allah above [having] any partners they ascribe [to Him].

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is He who originates the creation, then He will bring it back, and who provides for you from the sky and the earth…? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Say, 'Produce your evidence, should you be truthful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'No one in the heavens or the earth knows the Unseen except Allah, and they are not aware when they will be resurrected.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they comprehend the knowledge of the Hereafter? No, they are in doubt about it. Rather they are blind to it.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithless say, 'What! When we and our fathers have become dust shall we indeed be raised [from the dead]?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly we and our fathers were promised this before. [But] these are just myths of the ancients.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Travel over the land and then observe how was the fate of the guilty.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Moses said to his family, 'Indeed I descry a fire! I will bring you some news from it, or bring you a firebrand so that you may warm yourselves.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not grieve for them, and do not be upset by their guile.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'When will this promise be fulfilled, should you be truthful?'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Perhaps right behind you there is some of what you seek to hasten.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed your Lord is gracious to mankind, but most of them do not give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your Lord indeed knows whatever their breasts conceal, and whatever they disclose.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is no invisible thing in the heaven and the earth but it is in a manifest Book.1

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed this Qur'ān recounts to the Children of Israel most of what they differ about,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and it is indeed a guidance and mercy for the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed your Lord will decide between them by His judgement, and He is the All-mighty, the All-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So put your trust in Allah, for you indeed stand on the manifest truth.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when he came to it, he was called: 'Blessed is He who is in the fire and who is [as well] around it, and immaculate is Allah, the Lord of all the worlds!'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed you cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs [upon you],

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: nor can you lead the blind out of their error. You can make only those hear who believe in Our signs and who have submitted.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when the word [of judgement] falls upon them, We shall bring out for them an Animal1 from the earth who shall speak to them that the people had no faith in Our signs.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day We shall resurrect1 from every nation a group of those who denied Our signs, and they shall be held in check.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they come, He will say, 'Did you deny My signs without comprehending them in knowledge? What was it that you used to do?'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And the word [of judgement] shall fall upon them for their wrongdoing, and they will not speak.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest in it, and the day to provide visibility. There are indeed signs in that for a people who have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day when the trumpet will be blown, whoever is in the heavens will be terrified and whoever is on the earth, except whomever Allah may wish, and all will come to Him in utter humility.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And you see the mountains, which you suppose to be stationary, while they drift like passing clouds —the handiwork of Allah who has made everything faultless. He is indeed well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever brings virtue shall receive [a reward] better than it; and they shall be secure from terror on that day.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'O Moses! Indeed I am Allah, the All-mighty, the All-wise.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And whoever brings vice —they shall be cast on their faces into the Fire [and told:] 'Shall you be requited except with what you used to do?'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Indeed I have been commanded to worship the Lord of this city1 who has made it inviolable2 and to whom all things belong, and I have been commanded to be among those who submit [to Allah],

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and to recite the Qur'ān.' So whoever is guided is guided only for his own sake, and as for him who goes astray, say, 'I am just one of the warners.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Naml:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And say, 'All praise belongs to Allah. Soon He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them.' And your Lord is not oblivious of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nasr:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Allah's help comes with victory,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nasr:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and you see the people entering Allah's religion in throngs,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nasr:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then celebrate the praise of your Lord, and plead to Him for forgiveness. Indeed He is all-clement.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O mankind! Be wary of your Lord who created you from a single soul, and created its mate from it, and from the two of them, scattered numerous men and women. Be wary of Allah, in whose Name you adjure one another, and the wombs.1 Indeed Allah is watchful over you.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who consume the property of orphans wrongfully, only ingest fire into their bellies, and soon they will enter the Blaze.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:100 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever migrates in the way of Allah will find many havens and plenitude in the earth. And whoever leaves his home migrating toward Allah and His Apostle, and is then overtaken by death, his reward shall certainly fall on Allah, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:101 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you journey in the land, there is no sin upon you in shortening the prayers, if you fear that the faithless may trouble you; indeed the faithless are your manifest enemies.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:102 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you are among them, leading them in prayers, let a group of them stand with you carrying their weapons. And when they have done the prostrations, let them withdraw to the rear, then let the other group which has not prayed come and pray with you, taking their precautions and [bearing] their weapons. The faithless are eager that you should be oblivious of your weapons and your baggage, so that they could assault you all at once. But there is no sin upon you, if you are troubled by rain or are sick, to set aside your weapons; but take your precautions. Indeed Allah has prepared for the faithless a humiliating punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:103 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you have finished the prayers, remember Allah, standing, sitting and lying down, and when you feel secure, perform the [complete] prayers, for the prayer is indeed a timed prescription for the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:104 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not slacken in the pursuit of these people.1 If you are suffering, they are also suffering like you, but you expect from Allah what they do not expect, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:105 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have sent down to you the Book with the truth, so that you may judge between the people by what Allah has shown you; do not be an advocate for the traitors,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:106 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and plead to Allah for forgiveness; indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:107 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And do not plead for those who betray themselves; indeed Allah does not like someone who is treacherous and sinful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:108 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They try to hide [their real character] from people, but they do not try to hide from Allah, though He is with them when they conspire overnight with a discourse that He does not approve of. And Allah comprehends whatever they do.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:109 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Aha! There you are, pleading for them in the life of this world! But who will plead for them with Allah on the Day of Resurrection, or will be their defender?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah enjoins you concerning your children: for the male shall be the like of the share of two females, and if there be [two or] more than two females, then for them shall be two-thirds of what he1 leaves; but if she be alone, then for her shall be a half; and for each of his parents a sixth of what he leaves, if he has children; but if he has no children, and his parents are his [sole] heirs, then it shall be a third for his mother; but if he has brothers, then a sixth for his mother, after [paying off] any bequest he may have made or any debt [he may have incurred]. Your parents and your children —you do not know which of them is likelier to be beneficial for you. This is an ordinance from…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:110 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever commits evil or wrongs himself and then pleads to Allah for forgiveness, will find Allah all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:111 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And whoever commits a sin, commits it only against himself; and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:112 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But someone who commits an iniquity or sin and then accuses an innocent person of it, is indeed guilty of calumny and a flagrant sin.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:113 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were it not for Allah's grace and His mercy on you, a group of them were bent on leading you astray; but they do not mislead anyone except themselves, and they cannot do you any harm. Allah has sent down to you the Book and wisdom, and He has taught you what you did not know, and great is Allah's grace upon you.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:114 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is no good in much of their secret talks, excepting him who enjoins charity or what is right or reconciliation between people, and whoever does that, seeking Allah's pleasure, soon We shall give him a great reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:115 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But whoever defies the Apostle, after the guidance has become manifest to him, and follows a way other than that of the faithful, We shall abandon him to his devices and We shall make him enter hell, and it is an evil destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:116 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah does not forgive that any partner should be ascribed to Him, but He forgives anything besides that to whomever He wishes. And whoever ascribes partners to Allah has certainly strayed into far error.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:117 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They invoke none but females1 besides Him, and invoke none but a froward Satan,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:118 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: whom Allah has cursed, and who said, 'I will surely take of Your servants a settled share,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:119 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and I will lead them astray and give them [false] hopes, and prompt them to slit the ears of cattle,1 and I will prompt them to alter Allah's creation.' Whoever takes Satan as a guardian instead of Allah has certainly incurred a manifest loss.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For you shall be a half of what your wives leave, if they have no children; but if they have children, then for you shall be a fourth of what they leave, after [paying off] any bequest they may have made or any debt [they may have incurred]. And for them [it shall be] a fourth of what you leave, if you have no children; but if you have children, then for them shall be an eighth of what you leave, after [paying off] any bequest you may have made or any debt [you may have incurred]. If a man or woman is inherited by siblings1 and has a brother or a sister, then each of them shall receive a sixth; but if they are more than that, then they shall share in one third, after [paying off] any bequest…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:120 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He makes them promises and gives them [false] hopes, yet Satan does not promise them anything but delusion.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:121 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The refuge of such shall be hell, and they will not find any escape from it.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:122 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But those who have faith and do righteous deeds, We will admit them into gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them forever —a true promise of Allah, and who is truer in speech than Allah?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:123 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It will be neither after your hopes nor the hopes of the People of the Book: whoever commits evil shall be requited for it, and he will not find for himself any guardian or helper besides Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:124 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And whoever does righteous deeds, whether male or female, should he be faithful —such shall enter paradise and they will not be wronged [so much as] the speck on a date-stone.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:125 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And who has a better religion than him who submits his will to Allah, being virtuous, and follows the creed of Abraham, a ḥanīf? And Allah took Abraham for a dedicated friend.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:126 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allah comprehends all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:127 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They seek your ruling concerning women. Say, 'Allah gives you a ruling concerning them and what is announced to you in the Book concerning girl orphans —whom you do not give what has been prescribed for them, and yet you desire to marry them— and about the weak among children: that you should maintain the orphans with justice, and whatever good you do, indeed Allah knows it well.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:128 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If a woman fears from her husband misconduct or desertion, there is no sin upon the couple if they reach a reconciliation between themselves; and reconcilement is better. The souls are prone to greed; but if you are virtuous and Godwary, Allah is indeed well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:129 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You will not be able to be fair between wives, even if you are eager to do so. Yet do not turn away from one altogether, leaving her as if in a suspense. But if you are conciliatory and Godwary, Allah is indeed all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
