item.description: These are Allah's bounds, and whoever obeys Allah and His Apostle, He shall admit him to gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them [forever]. That is the great success.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:130 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they separate, Allah will suffice each of them out of His bounty, and Allah is all-bounteous, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:131 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. We have certainly enjoined those who were given the Book before you, and you, that you should be wary of Allah. But if you are faithless, [you should know that] to Allah indeed belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allah is all-sufficient, all-laudable.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:132 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allah suffices as trustee.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:133 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If He wishes, He will take you away, O mankind, and bring others [in your place]; Allah has the power to do that.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:134 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever desires the reward of this world, [should know that] with Allah is the reward of this world and the Hereafter, and Allah is all-hearing, all-seeing.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:135 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Be maintainers of justice and witnesses for the sake of Allah, even if it should be against yourselves or [your] parents and near relatives, and whether it be [someone] rich or poor, for Allah has a greater right over them. So do not follow [your] desires, lest you should be unfair, and if you distort [the testimony] or disregard [it], Allah is indeed well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:136 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Have faith in Allah and His Apostle and the Book that He has sent down to His Apostle and the Book He had sent down earlier. Whoever disbelieves in Allah and His angels, His Books and His apostles and the Last Day, has certainly strayed into far error.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:137 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who believe and then disbelieve, then believe [again] and then disbelieve and then increase in disbelief, Allah shall never forgive them, nor shall He guide them to any way.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:138 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Inform the hypocrites that there is a painful punishment for them

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:139 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those who take the faithless for allies instead of the faithful. Do they seek honour with them? [If so,] indeed all honour belongs to Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But whoever disobeys Allah and His Apostle, and transgresses the bounds set by Allah, He shall make him enter a Fire, to remain in it [forever], and there will be a humiliating punishment for him.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:140 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly He has sent down to you in the Book that when you hear Allah's signs being disbelieved and derided, do not sit with them until they engage in some other discourse, or else you [too] will be like them. Indeed Allah will gather the hypocrites and the faithless in hell all together.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:141 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —Those who lie in wait for you: if there is a victory for you from Allah, they say, 'Were we not with you?' But if the faithless get a share [of victory], they say, 'Did we not prevail upon you and defend you against the faithful?' Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection, and Allah will never provide the faithless any way [to prevail] over the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:142 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The hypocrites indeed seek to deceive Allah, but it is He who outwits them. When they stand up for prayer, they stand up lazily, showing off to the people and not remembering Allah except a little,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:143 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: wavering in between: neither with these nor with those. And whomever Allah leads astray, you will never find any way for him.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:144 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not take the faithless for friends instead of the faithful. Do you wish to give Allah a clear sanction against yourselves?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:145 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the hypocrites will be in the lowest reach of the Fire, and you will never find any helper for them,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:146 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except for those who repent and reform, and hold fast to Allah and dedicate their religion [exclusively] to Allah. Those are with the faithful, and soon Allah will give the faithful a great reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:147 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Why should Allah punish you if you give thanks and be faithful? And Allah is appreciative, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:148 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah does not like the disclosure of [anyone's] evil [conduct] in speech except by someone who has been wronged, and Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:149 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whether you disclose a good [deed that you do] or hide it, or excuse an evil [deed], Allah is indeed all-excusing, all-powerful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Should any of your women commit an indecent act,1 produce against them four witness from yourselves, and if they testify, detain them2 in [their] houses until death finishes them, or Allah decrees a course for them.3

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:150 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who disbelieve in Allah and His apostles and seek to separate Allah from His apostles, and say, 'We believe in some and disbelieve in some' and seek to take a way in between

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:151 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —it is they who are truly faithless, and We have prepared for the faithless a humiliating punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:152 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But those who have faith in Allah and His apostles and make no distinction between any of them —them He will soon give their rewards, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:153 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The People of the Book ask you to bring down for them a Book from the sky. Certainly they asked Moses for [something] greater than that, for they said, 'Show us Allah visibly,' whereat a thunderbolt seized them for their wrongdoing. Then they took up the Calf [for worship], after all the manifest proofs that had come to them. Yet We excused that, and We gave Moses a manifest authority.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:154 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We raised the Mount above them for the sake of their covenant, and We said to them, 'Enter the gate prostrating' and We said to them, 'Do not violate the Sabbath,' and We took from them a solemn covenant.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:155 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then because of their breaking their covenant, their defiance of Allah's signs, their killing of the prophets unjustly and for their saying, 'Our hearts are uncircumcised.'1 Rather Allah has set a seal on them2 for their unfaith, so they do not have faith except a few.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:156 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And for their faithlessness, and their uttering a monstrous calumny against Mary,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:157 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and for their saying, 'We killed the Messiah, Jesus son of Mary, the apostle of Allah' —though they did not kill him nor did they crucify him, but so it was made to appear to them. Indeed those who differ concerning him1 are surely in doubt about him:2 they do not have any knowledge of that beyond following conjectures, and certainly they did not kill him.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:158 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather Allah raised him up toward Himself, and Allah is all-mighty, all-wise.1

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:159 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is none among the People of the Book but will surely believe in him before his death; and on the Day of Resurrection he will be a witness against them.1

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Should two among you commit it,1 chastise them both; but if they repent and reform, let them alone. Indeed Allah is all-clement, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:160 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Due to the wrongdoing of the Jews, We prohibited them certain good things that were permitted to them[earlier], and for their barring many [people] from the way of Allah,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:161 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and for their taking usury —though they had been forbidden from it— and for eating up the wealth of the people wrongfully. And We have prepared for the faithless among them a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:162 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But as for those who are firmly grounded in knowledge from among them, and the faithful, they believe in what has been sent down to you, and what was sent down before you —those who maintain the prayer, give the zakāt, and believe in Allah and the Last Day —them We shall give a great reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:163 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have indeed revealed to you as We revealed to Noah and the prophets after him, and [as] We revealed to Abraham and Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, and the Tribes, Jesus and Job, Jonah, Aaron, and Solomon, —and We gave David the Psalms—

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:164 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and apostles We have recounted to you earlier and apostles We have not recounted to you, —and to Moses Allah spoke directly—

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:165 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: apostles, as bearers of good news and warners, so that mankind may not have any argument against Allah, after the [sending of the] apostles; and Allah is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:166 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But Allah bears witness to what He has sent down to you —He sent it down with His knowledge— and the angels bear witness [too], and Allah quite suffices as a witness.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:167 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who are faithless and bar [others] from the way of Allah, have certainly strayed into far error.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:168 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who are faithless and do wrong, Allah shall never forgive them, nor shall He guide them to any way,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:169 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except the way to hell, to remain in it forever, and that is easy for Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [Acceptance of] repentance by Allah is only for those who commit evil out of ignorance, then repent promptly. It is such whose repentance Allah will accept, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:170 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O mankind! The Apostle has certainly brought you the truth from your Lord. So have faith! That is better for you. And if you are faithless, [you should know that] to Allah indeed belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:171 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O People of the Book! Do not exceed the bounds in your religion, and do not attribute anything to Allah except the truth. The Messiah, Jesus son of Mary, was only an apostle of Allah, and His Word that He cast toward Mary and a spirit from Him. So have faith in Allah and His apostles, and do not say, '[God is] a trinity.' Relinquish [such a creed]! That is better for you. Allah is but the One God. He is far too immaculate to have any son. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allah suffices as trustee.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:172 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Messiah would never disdain being a servant of Allah, nor would the angels brought near [to Him]. And whoever disdains His worship and is arrogant, He will gather them all toward Him.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:173 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds, He will pay them in full their rewards, and He will enhance them out of His grace. But those who are disdainful and arrogant, He will punish them with a painful punishment, and they will not find besides Allah any guardian or helper.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:174 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O mankind! Certainly a proof1 has come to you from your Lord, and We have sent down to you a manifest light.2

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:175 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who have faith in Allah, and hold fast to Him, He will admit them to His mercy and grace, and He will guide them on a straight path to Him.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:176 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They ask you for a ruling. Say, 'Allah gives you a ruling concerning the kalālah:1 If a man dies and he has no children [or parents], but has a sister, for her shall be a half of what he leaves, and he shall inherit from her if she has no children. If there be two sisters, then they shall receive two-thirds of what he leaves. But if there be [several] brothers and sisters, then for the male shall be the like of the share of two females. Allah explains [the laws] for you lest you should go astray, and Allah has knowledge of all things.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But [acceptance of] repentance is not for those who go on committing misdeeds: when death approaches any of them, he says, 'I repent now.' Nor is it for those who die while they are faithless. For such We have prepared a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! It is not lawful for you to inherit women forcibly, and do not press them to take away part of what you have given them, unless they commit a gross indecency.1 Consort with them in an honourable manner; and should you dislike them, maybe you dislike something while Allah invests it with an abundant good.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Give the orphans their property, and do not replace the good with the bad, and do not eat up their property [by mingling it] with your own property, for that is indeed a great sin.1

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you desire to take a wife in place of another, and you have given one of them a quintal [of gold], do not take anything away from it. Would you take it by way of calumny and flagrant sin?!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How could you take it back, when you have known1 each other, and they have taken from you a solemn covenant?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not marry any of the women whom your fathers had married, excluding what is already past. That is indeed an indecency, an outrage and an evil course.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Forbidden to you are your mothers, your daughters and your sisters, your paternal aunts and your maternal aunts, your brother's daughters and your sister's daughters, your [foster-]mothers who have suckled you1 and your sisters through fosterage, your wives' mothers, and your stepdaughters who are under your care [born] of the wives whom you have gone into —but if you have not gone into them there is no sin upon you— and the wives of your sons who are from your own loins, and that you should marry two sisters at one time —excluding what is already past; indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful—

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and married women excepting your slave-women. This is Allah's ordinance for you. As to others than these, it is lawful for you to seek [union with them] with your wealth, in wedlock, not in license. For the enjoyment you have had from them thereby, give them their dowries, by way of settlement, and there is no sin upon you in what you may agree upon after the settlement. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those of you who cannot afford to marry faithful free women, then [let them marry] from what you own, from among your faithful slave-women. Your faith is best known [only] to Allah; you are all [on a] similar [footing]. So marry them with their masters' permission, and give them their dowries in an honourable manner —[such of them] as are chaste women, not licentious ones or those who take paramours. But on marrying, should they commit an indecent act, then there shall be for them [only] half the punishment for free women. This is for those of you who fear falling into fornication; but it is better that you be continent,1 and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah desires to explain [the laws] to you, and to guide you to the customs of those who were before you,1 and to turn toward you clemently, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah desires to turn toward you clemently, but those who pursue their [base] appetites desire that you fall into gross waywardness.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah desires to lighten your burden, for man was created weak.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not eat up your wealth among yourselves unrightfully,1 but it should be trade by mutual consent. And do not kill yourselves.2 Indeed Allah is most merciful to you.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you fear that you may not deal justly with the orphans,1 then marry [other] women that you like, two, three, or four. But if you fear that you may not treat them fairly, then [marry only] one, or [marry from among] your slave-women. That makes it likelier that you will not be unfair.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And whoever does that in aggression and injustice, We will soon make him enter the Fire, and that is easy for Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you avoid the major sins that you are forbidden, We will absolve you of your misdeeds, and admit you to a noble abode.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not covet the advantage which Allah has given some of you over others. To men belongs a share of what they have earned, and to women a share of what they have earned. And ask Allah for His grace. Indeed Allah has knowledge of all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For everyone We have appointed heirs to what the parents and near relatives leave, as well as those with whom you have made a compact; so give them their share [of the heritage]. Indeed Allah is witness to all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Men are the managers of women, because of the advantage Allah has granted some of them over others, and by virtue of their spending out of their wealth. So righteous women are obedient, care-taking in the absence [of their husbands] of what Allah has enjoined [them] to guard. As for those [wives] whose misconduct you fear, [first] advise them, and [if ineffective] keep away from them in the bed, and [as the last resort] beat them. Then if they obey you, do not seek any course [of action] against them. Indeed Allah is all-exalted, all-great.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if you fear a split between the two of them, then appoint an arbiter from his relatives and an arbiter from her relatives. If they desire reconcilement, Allah shall reconcile them.1 Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Worship Allah and do not ascribe any partners to Him, and be good to parents, the relatives, the orphans, the needy, the near neighbour and the distant neighbour, the companion at your side, the traveller, and your slaves. Indeed Allah does not like anyone who is a swaggering braggart.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who are stingy and bid [other] people to be stingy, and conceal whatever Allah has given them out of His grace; and We have prepared for the faithless a humiliating punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And those who spend their wealth to be seen by people, and believe neither in Allah nor in the Last Day. As for him who has Satan for his companion —an evil companion is he!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What harm would it have done them had they believed in Allah and the Last Day, and spent out of what Allah has provided them? Allah knows them well.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Give women their dowries as an obligation; but if they remit anything of it of their own accord, then consume it as [something] lawful and wholesome.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah does not wrong [anyone] [even to the extent of] an atom's weight, and if it be a good deed He doubles it[s reward], and gives from Himself a great reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So how shall it be, when We bring from every nation a witness and We bring you as a witness to them?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On that day those who were faithless and [who] disobeyed the Apostle will wish the earth were levelled with them, and they will not conceal any matter from Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not approach prayer when you are intoxicated, [not] until you know what you are saying, nor [enter mosques] in the state of ritual impurity —except while passing through— until you have washed yourselves. But if you are sick or on a journey, or any of you has come from the toilet, or you have touched women,1 and you cannot find water, then make your ablution on clean ground and wipe a part of your faces and your hands. Indeed Allah is all-excusing, all-forgiving.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded those who were given a share of the Book, who purchase error and desire that you [too] should lose the way?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But Allah knows your enemies better, and Allah suffices as guardian, and Allah suffices as helper.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among the Jews are those who pervert words from their meanings and say, 'We hear and disobey' and 'Hear without listening!' and 'Rā'inā,' twisting their tongues and reviling the faith. But had they said, 'We hear and obey' and 'Listen' and 'Unẓurnā,' it would have been better for them, and more upright.1 But Allah has cursed them for their faithlessness, so they will not believe except a few.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who were given the Book! Believe in what We have sent down confirming what is with you, before We blot out the faces and turn them backwards, or curse them as We cursed the People of the Sabbath, and Allah's command is bound to be fulfilled.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah does not forgive that any partner should be ascribed to Him, but He forgives anything besides that to whomever He wishes. And whoever ascribes partners to Allah has indeed fabricated [a lie] in great sinfulness.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded those who style themselves as pure? Rather it is Allah who purifies whomever He wishes, and they will not be wronged [so much as] a single date-thread.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not give the feeble-minded your property which Allah has assigned you to manage: provide for them out of it, and clothe them, and speak to them honourable words.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Look, how they fabricate lies against Allah! That suffices for a flagrant sin.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded those who were given a share of the Book1 believing in idols and the Rebels2 and saying of the pagans: 'These are better guided on the way than the faithful'?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are the ones whom Allah has cursed, and whomever Allah curses, you will never find any helper for him.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Or do they have a share in sovereignty?1 If so, they will not give the people [so much as] a speck on a date-stone!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Or do they envy the people for what Allah has given them out of His grace? We have certainly given the progeny of Abraham the Book and wisdom, and We have given them a great sovereignty.1

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Of them1 are some who believe in him, and of them are some who deter [others] from him; and hell suffices for a blaze!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who defy Our signs, We shall soon make them enter a Fire: as often as their skins become scorched, We shall replace them with other skins, so that they may taste the punishment. Indeed Allah is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds, We shall admit them into gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them forever. In it there will be chaste mates for them, and We shall admit them into a deep shade.1

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah commands you to deliver the trusts to their [rightful] owners, and, when you judge between people, to judge with fairness. Excellent indeed is what Allah advises you. Indeed Allah is all-hearing, all-seeing.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Obey Allah and obey the Apostle and those vested with authority among you.1 And if you dispute concerning anything, refer it to Allah and the Apostle, if you have faith in Allah and the Last Day. That is better and more favourable in outcome.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Test the orphans when they reach the age of marriage. Then if you discern in them maturity, deliver to them their property. And do not consume it lavishly and hastily lest they should grow up. As for him who is well-off, let him be abstemious, and as for him who is poor, let him eat in an honourable manner. And when you deliver to them their property, take witnesses over them, and Allah suffices as reckoner.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded those who claim that they believe in what has been sent down to you, and what was sent down before you? They desire to seek the judgment of the Rebel,1 though they were commanded to defy it, and Satan desires to lead them astray into far error.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when they are told, 'Come to what Allah has sent down and [come] to the Apostle,' you see the hypocrites keep away from you aversely.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But how will it be when an affliction visits them because of what their hands have sent ahead? Then they will come to you, swearing by Allah: 'We desired nothing but benevolence and comity.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are the ones whom Allah knows as to what is in their hearts. So let them alone, and advise them, and speak to them concerning themselves far-reaching words.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not send any apostle but to be obeyed by Allah's leave. Had they, when they wronged themselves, come to you and pleaded to Allah for forgiveness, and the Apostle had pleaded for forgiveness for them, they would have surely found Allah all-clement, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But no, by your Lord! They will not believe until they make you a judge in their disputes, then do not find within their hearts any dissent to your verdict and submit in full submission.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had We prescribed for them, [commanding]: 'Slay [the guilty among] your folks1 or leave your habitations,' they would not have done it, except a few of them. And if they had done as they were advised it would have been better for them, and firmer in confirming [their faith].

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We would surely have given them a great reward from Us,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and We would have surely guided them to a straight path.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever obeys Allah and the Apostle —they are with those whom Allah has blessed, including the prophets and the truthful, the martyrs and the righteous, and excellent companions are they!

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Men have a share in the heritage left by parents and near relatives, and women have a share in the heritage left by parents and near relatives, whether it be little or much, a share ordained [by Allah].

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is the grace of Allah, and Allah suffices as knower [of His creatures].

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Take your precautions, then go forth in companies, or go forth en masse.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among you is indeed he who drags his feet, and should an affliction visit you, he says, 'It was certainly Allah's blessing that I did not accompany them!'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But should a grace from Allah come to you, he will surely say, as if there were no affection between you and him, 'I wish I were with them so that I had achieved a great success!'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Let those fight in the way of Allah who sell the life of this world for the Hereafter; and whoever fights in the way of Allah, and then is slain, or he subdues [the enemy], soon We shall give him a great reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Why should you not fight in the way of Allah and the abased men, women, and children, who say, 'Our Lord, bring us out of this town whose people are wrongdoers, and appoint for us a guardian from You, and appoint for us a helper from You'?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who have faith fight in the way of Allah, and those who are faithless fight in the way of the Rebel. So fight the friends of Satan; indeed the stratagems of Satan are always flimsy.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded those who were told, 'Keep your hands off [from warfare], and maintain the prayer, and give the zakāt'? But when fighting was prescribed for them, behold, a part of them were afraid of people as if fearing Allah, or were even more afraid, and they said, 'Our Lord! Why did You prescribe fighting for us? Why did You not respite us for a short time?!'1 Say, 'The enjoyment of this world is little and the Hereafter is better for the Godwary, and you will not be wronged so much as a single date-thread.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Wherever you may be, death shall overtake you, even if you were in fortified towers.' And if any good befalls them, they say, 'This is from Allah;' and when an ill befalls them, they say, 'This is from you.' Say, 'All is from Allah.' What is the matter with these people that they would not understand any matter?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whatever good befalls you is from Allah; and whatever ill befalls you is from yourself. We sent you as an apostle to mankind, and Allah suffices as a witness.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when the division is attended by relatives, the orphans and the needy, provide for them out of it, and speak to them honourable words.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever obeys the Apostle certainly obeys Allah; and as for those who turn their backs [on you], We have not sent you to keep watch over them.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They profess obedience [to you], but when they go out from your presence, a group of them conspire overnight [to do] something other than what you say. But Allah records what they conspire overnight. So disregard them and put your trust in Allah, for Allah suffices as trustee.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they not contemplate the Qur'ān? Had it been from [someone] other than Allah, they would have surely found much discrepancy in it.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When a report of safety or alarm comes to them, they immediately broadcast it; but had they referred it to the Apostle or to those vested with authority among them, those of them who investigate would have ascertained it. And were it not for Allah's grace upon you and His mercy, you would have surely followed Satan, [all] except a few.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So fight in the way of Allah: you are responsible only for yourself, but urge on the faithful [to fight]. Maybe Allah will curb the might of the faithless, for Allah is greatest in might and severest in punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever intercedes for a good cause shall receive a share of it, and whoever intercedes for an evil cause shall share its burden, and Allah is prepotent over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you are greeted with a salute, greet with a better one than it, or return it; indeed Allah takes account of all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah—there is no god except Him— will surely gather you on the Day of Resurrection, in which there is no doubt; and who is more truthful in speech than Allah?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Why should you be two groups concerning the hypocrites,1 while Allah has made them relapse because of their deeds? Do you desire to guide someone Allah has led astray? Whomever Allah leads astray, you will never find any way for him.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are eager that you should disbelieve like they have disbelieved, so that you all become alike. So do not make friends [with anyone] from among them, until they migrate in the way of Allah. But if they turn their backs, seize them and kill them wherever you find them, and do not take from among them friends or helpers,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Let those fear [the result of mistreating orphans] who, were they to leave behind weak offspring, would be concerned on their account. So let them be wary of Allah, and let them speak upright words.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: excepting those who join a people between whom and you there is a treaty, or such as come to you with hearts reluctant to fight you or to fight their own people. Had Allah wished, He would have imposed them upon you, and then they would have surely fought you. So if they keep out of your way and do not fight you, and offer you peace, then Allah does not allow you any course [of action] against them.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You will find others desiring to be secure from you, and secure from their own people; yet whenever they are called back to polytheism, they relapse into it. So if they do not keep out of your way, nor offer you peace, nor keep their hands off [from fighting], then seize them and kill them wherever you confront them, and it is such against whom We have given you a clear sanction.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A believer may not kill another believer, unless it is by mistake. Anyone who kills a believer by mistake should set free a believing slave, and pay blood-money to his family,1 unless they remit it in charity. If he2 belongs to a people that are hostile to you but is a believer, then a believing slave is to be set free. And if he belongs to a people with whom you have a treaty, the blood-money is to be paid to his family and a believing slave is to be set free. He who cannot afford [to pay the blood-money], must fast two successive months as a penance from Allah, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Should anyone kill a believer intentionally, his requital shall be hell, to remain in it [forever]; Allah shall be wrathful at him and curse him and He shall prepare for him a great punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! When you issue forth in the way of Allah, try to ascertain: do not say to someone who offers you peace, 'You are not a believer,' seeking the transitory wares of the life of this world. Yet with Allah are plenteous gains. You too were such earlier, but Allah did you a favour. Therefore, do ascertain. Allah is indeed well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Not equal are those of the faithful who sit back —excepting those who suffer from some disability— and those who wage jihād in the way of Allah with their possession and their persons. Allah has graced those who wage jihād with their possessions and their persons by a degree over those who sit back; yet to each Allah has promised the best reward, and Allah has graced those who wage jihād over those who sit back with a great reward:

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: ranks from Him, forgiveness, and mercy, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed, those whom the angels take away while they are wronging themselves, they1 ask, 'What state were you in?' They reply, 'We were abased in the land.' They say, 'Was not Allah's earth vast enough so that you might migrate in it?' The refuge of such shall be hell, and it is an evil destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Except the abased among men, women and children, who have neither access to any means nor are guided to any way.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Nisaa:99 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Maybe Allah will excuse them, for Allah is all-excusing, all-forgiving.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [This is] a sūrah which We have sent down, and prescribed it, and We have sent down in it manifest signs so that you may take admonition.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were it not for Allah's grace and His mercy upon you, and that Allah is all-clement, all-wise….1

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who initiated the calumny are a band from among yourselves. Do not suppose it is bad for you. Rather it is for your good. Each man among them bears [the onus for] his share in the sin, and as for him who assumed its major burden from among them there is a great punishment for him.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you [first] heard about it, why did not the faithful, men and women, think well of their folks, and say, 'This is an obvious calumny'?

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Why did they1 not bring four witnesses to it? So when they could not bring the witnesses, they are liars in Allah's sight.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were it not for Allah's grace and His mercy upon you in this world and the Hereafter, there would have befallen you a great punishment for what you ventured into,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when you were receiving it on your tongues, and were mouthing something of which you had no knowledge, supposing it to be a light matter, while it was a grave [matter] with Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And why did you not, when you heard it, say, 'It is not for us to say such a thing. [O Allah!] You are immaculate! This is a monstrous calumny!'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah advises you lest you should ever repeat the like of it, should you be faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah clarifies the signs for you, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who want indecency to spread among the faithful —there is a painful punishment for them in the world and the Hereafter, and Allah knows and you do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the fornicatress and the fornicator, strike each of them a hundred lashes, and let not pity for them overcome you in Allah's law, if you believe in Allah and the Last Day, and let their punishment be witnessed by a group of the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were it not for Allah's grace and His mercy upon you, and that Allah is all-kind, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not follow in Satan's steps. Whoever follows in Satan's steps [should know that] he indeed prompts [you to commit] indecent acts and wrong. Were it not for Allah's grace and His mercy upon you, not one of you would ever be pure. But Allah purifies whomever He wishes, and Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Let the well-off and the opulent among you not vow1 not to give to the relatives and the needy, and to those who have migrated in the way of Allah, and let them excuse and forbear. Do you not love that Allah should forgive you? And Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who accuse honourable and unwary faithful women shall be cursed in this world and the Hereafter, and there shall be a great punishment for them

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: on the day when witness shall be given against them by their tongues, their hands, and their feet concerning what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On that day Allah will pay them in full their due recompense, and they shall know that Allah is the Manifest Reality.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Vicious women are for vicious men, and vicious men for vicious women. Good women are for good men, and good men for good women.1 These are absolved of what they say [about them].2 For them is forgiveness and a noble provision.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not enter houses other than your own until you have announced [your arrival] and greeted their occupants. That is better for you. Maybe you will take admonition.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if you do not find anyone in them, do not enter them until you are given permission, and if you are told: 'Turn back,' then do turn back. That is more decent for you. And Allah knows best what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There will be no sin upon you in entering [without announcing] uninhabited houses wherein you have goods belonging to you. And Allah knows whatever you disclose and whatever you conceal.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The fornicator shall not marry anyone but a fornicatress or an idolatress, and the fornicatress shall be married by none except a fornicator or an idolater, and that is forbidden to the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Tell the faithful men to cast down their looks and to guard their private parts. That is more decent for them. Allah is indeed well aware of what they do.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And tell the faithful women to cast down their looks and to guard their private parts, and not to display their charms, except for what is outward, and let them draw their scarfs over their bosoms, and not display their charms except to their husbands, or their fathers, or their husband's fathers, or their sons, or their husband's sons, or their brothers, or their brothers' sons, or their sisters' sons, or their women,1 or their slave girls, or male dependants lacking [sexual] desire, or children uninitiated to women's parts.2 And let them not thump their feet to make known their hidden ornaments. Rally to Allah in repentance, O faithful, so that you may be felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Marry off those who are single among you and the upright1 among your male slaves and your female slaves. If they are poor, Allah will enrich them out of His grace, and Allah is all-bounteous, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who cannot afford marriage should be continent until Allah enriches them out of His grace. As for those who seek an emancipation deal from among your slaves, make such a deal with them if you know any good in them, and give them out of the wealth of Allah which He has given you. Do not compel your female slaves to prostitution when they desire to be chaste, seeking the transitory wares of the life of this world. Should anyone compel them, then after their compulsion Allah is indeed all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have sent down to you manifest signs and a description of those who passed before you, and an advice for the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The parable of His Light is a niche wherein is a lamp —the lamp is in a glass, the glass as it were a glittering star— lit from a blessed olive tree, neither eastern nor western, whose oil almost lights up, though fire should not touch it. Light upon light. Allah guides to His Light whomever He wishes. Allah draws parables for mankind, and Allah has knowledge of all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: In houses Allah has allowed to be raised and wherein His Name is celebrated, He is glorified therein, morning and evening,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by men whom neither trading nor bargaining distracts from the remembrance of Allah, and the maintenance of prayer and the giving of zakāt. They are fearful of a day wherein the heart and the sight will be transformed,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so that Allah may reward them by the best of what they have done, and enhance them out of His grace, and Allah provides for whomever He wishes without any reckoning.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the faithless, their works are like a mirage in a plain, which the thirsty man supposes to be water. When he comes to it, he finds it to be nothing; but there he finds Allah, who will pay him his full account, and Allah is swift at reckoning.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who accuse honourable women and do not bring four witnesses, strike them eighty lashes, and never accept any testimony from them after that, and they are transgressors,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Or like the manifold darkness in a deep sea, covered by billow upon billow, overcast by clouds, manifold [layers of] darkness, one on top of another: when he brings out his hand, he can hardly see it, and one whom Allah has not granted any light has no light.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded that Allah is glorified by everyone in the heavens and the earth, and the birds spreading their wings. Each knows his prayer and glorification, and Allah knows best what they do.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and toward Allah is the destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded that Allah drives the clouds, then He composes them, then He piles them up, whereat you see the rain issuing from its midst? And He sends down from the sky hail, out of the mountains1 that are in it, and He strikes with it whomever He wishes, and turns it away from whomever He wishes. The brilliance of its lightening almost takes away the sight.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah alternates the night and the day. There is indeed a moral in that for those who have insight.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah created every animal from water. Among them are some that creep upon their bellies, and among them are some that walk on two feet, and among them are some that walk on four. Allah creates whatever He wishes. Indeed Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have sent down manifest signs, and Allah guides whomever He wishes to a straight path.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'We have faith in Allah and His Apostle, and we obey.' Then after that a part of them refuse to comply, and they do not have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they are summoned to Allah and His Apostle that He may judge between them, behold, a part of them turn aside.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if justice be on their side, they come compliantly to him.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: excepting those who repent after that and reform, for Allah is indeed all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is there a sickness in their hearts? Or do they have doubts or fear that Allah and His Apostle will be unjust to them? Rather it is they who are the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: All the response of the faithful, when they are summoned to Allah and His Apostle that He may judge between them, is to say, 'We hear and obey.' It is they who are the felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever obeys Allah and His Apostle, and fears Allah and is wary of Him —it is they who will be the triumphant.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They swear by Allah with solemn oaths that if you order them they will surely go forth. Say, 'Do not swear! Honourable obedience [is all that is expected of you]. Allah is indeed well aware of what you do.'

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Obey Allah, and obey the Apostle.' But if you turn your backs, [you should know that] he is only responsible for his burden and you are responsible for your burden, and if you obey him, you shall be guided, and the Apostle's duty is only to communicate in clear terms.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has promised those of you who have faith and do righteous deeds that He will surely make them successors in the earth, just as He made those who were before them successors, and He will surely establish for them their religion which He has approved for them, and that He will surely change their state to security after their fear, while they worship Me, not ascribing any partners to Me. And whoever is ungrateful after that —it is they who are the transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Maintain the prayer and give the zakāt, and obey the Apostle so that you may receive [Allah's] mercy.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not suppose that those who are faithless can thwart [Allah] on the earth. Their refuge shall be the Fire, and it is surely an evil destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Let your permission be sought by your slaves and those of you who have not reached puberty three times: before the dawn prayer, and when you put off your garments at noon, and after the night prayer. These are three times of privacy for you. Apart from these, it is not sinful of you or them to frequent one another [freely]. Thus does Allah clarify the signs for you, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When your children reach puberty, let them ask permission [at all times] just as those who asked permission before them. Thus does Allah clarify His signs for you, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who accuse their wives, but have no witnesses except themselves, then the testimony of one of them shall be a fourfold testimony [sworn] by Allah that he is indeed stating the truth,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for women advanced in years who do not expect to marry, there will be no sin upon them if they put off their cloaks, without displaying their adornment. But it is better for them to be continent, and Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is no blame upon the blind, nor any blame upon the lame, nor any blame upon the sick, nor upon yourselves if you eat from your own houses, or your fathers' houses, or your mothers' houses, or your brothers' houses, or your sisters' houses, or the houses of your paternal uncles, or the houses of your paternal aunts, or the houses of your maternal uncles, or the houses of your maternal aunts, or those whose keys are in your possession, or those of your friends. There will be no blame on you whether you eat together or separately. So when you enter houses, greet yourselves1 with a salutation from Allah, blessed and good. Thus does Allah clarify His signs for you so that you may apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the faithful are those who have faith in Allah and His Apostle, and when they are with him in a collective affair, they do not leave until they have sought his permission. Indeed those who seek your permission —it is they who have faith in Allah and His Apostle. So when they seek your permission for some work of theirs, give permission to whomever of them you wish and plead with Allah to forgive them. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not consider the Apostle's summons amongst you to be like your summoning one another. Allah certainly knows those of you who slip away under cover. So let those who disobey his orders beware lest an ordeal should visit them or a painful punishment should befall them.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Look! To Allah indeed belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. He certainly knows what you are up to, and the day they are brought back to Him He will inform them about what they have done, and Allah has knowledge of all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and a fifth [oath] that Allah's wrath shall be upon him if he were lying.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The punishment shall be averted from her by her testifying with four oaths [sworn] by Allah that he is indeed lying,

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and a fifth [oath] that Allah's wrath shall be upon her if he were stating the truth.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Alif, Lām, Mīm, Rā. These are the signs of the Book. That which has been sent down to you from your Lord is the truth, but most people do not believe [in it].

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is the same [to Him] whether any of you speaks secretly, or does so loudly, or whether he lurks in the night, or is open to view in daytime.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He has guardian angels, to his front and his rear, who guard him by Allah's command. Indeed Allah does not change a people's lot, unless they change what is in their souls. And when Allah wishes to visit ill on a people, there is nothing that can avert it, and they have no protector besides Him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who shows you the lightning, inspiring fear and hope, and He produces the clouds heavy [with rain].

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Thunder celebrates His praise, and the angels [too], in awe of Him, and He releases the thunderbolts and strikes with them whomever He wishes. Yet they dispute concerning Allah, though He is great in might.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [Only] to Him belongs the true invocation;1 and those whom they invoke besides Him do not answer them in any wise— like someone who stretches his hands towards water [desiring] that it should reach his mouth, but it does not reach it— and the invocations of the faithless only go awry.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah prostrates whoever there is in the heavens and the earth, willingly or unwillingly, and their shadows at sunrise and sunset.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Who is the Lord of the heavens and the earth?' Say, 'Allah!' Say, 'Have you then taken others besides Him for guardians, who have no control over their own benefit or harm?' Say, 'Are the blind one and the seer equal? Or are the darkness and the light equal?' Have they set up for Allah partners who have created like His creation, so that the creations seemed confusable to them? Say, 'Allah is the creator of all things, and He is the One, the All-paramount.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He sends down water from the sky whereat the valleys are flooded to [the extent of] their capacity, and the flood carries along a swelling scum. And from what they smelt in the fire for the purpose of [making] ornaments or wares, [there arises] a similar scum. That is how Allah compares the truth and falsehood. As for the scum, it leaves as dross, and that which profits the people remains in the earth. That is how Allah draws comparisons.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For those who answer [the summons of] their Lord there shall be the best [of rewards]. But those who do not answer Him, even if they possessed all that is on the earth and as much of it besides, they would surely offer it to redeem themselves with it.1 For such there shall be an adverse reckoning, and their refuge shall be hell, and it is an evil resting place.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is someone who knows that what has been sent down to you from your Lord is the truth, like someone who is blind? Only those who possess intellect take admonition

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is Allah who raised the heavens without any pillars that you see, and then presided over the Throne. He disposed the sun and the moon, each moving for a specified term.1 He directs the command, [and] elaborates2 the signs that you may be certain of encountering your Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those who fulfill Allah's covenant and do not break the pledge solemnly made,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and those who join what Allah has commanded to be joined, and fear their Lord, and are afraid of an adverse reckoning

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those who are patient for the sake of their Lord's pleasure, maintain the prayer, and spend out of what We have provided them, secretly and openly, and repel evil [conduct] with good. For such will be the reward of the [ultimate] abode:

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the Gardens of Eden, which they will enter along with whoever is righteous from among their forebears, their spouses, and their descendants, and the angels will call on them from every door:

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Peace be to you, for your patience.' How excellent is the reward of the [ultimate] abode!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But as for those who break Allah's compact after having pledged it solemnly, and sever what Allah has commanded to be joined, and cause corruption in the earth —it is such on whom the curse will lie, and for them will be the ills of the [ultimate] abode.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah expands the provision for whomever He wishes, and tightens it. They exult in the life of this world, but compared with the Hereafter the life of this world is but a [trifling] enjoyment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithless say, 'Why has not some sign been sent down to him from his Lord?' Say, 'Indeed Allah leads astray whomever He wishes, and guides to Himself those who turn penitently [to Him]

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those who have faith, and whose hearts find rest in the remembrance of Allah.' Look! The hearts find rest in Allah's remembrance!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who have faith and do righteous deeds —happy are they and good is their [ultimate] destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who has spread out the earth and set in it firm mountains and streams, and of every fruit He has made in it two kinds.1 He draws the night's cover over the day. There are indeed signs in that for a people who reflect.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus have We sent you to a nation before which many nations have passed away, that you may recite to them what We have revealed to you. Yet they defy the All-beneficent. Say, 'He is my Lord; there is no god except Him; in Him I have put my trust, and to Him will be my return.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If only it were a Qur'ān1 whereby the mountains could be moved, or the earth could be toured,2 or the dead could be spoken to ….3 Rather all dispensation belongs to Allah. Have not the faithful yet realised that had Allah wished He would have guided mankind all together? The faithless will continue to be visited by catastrophes because of their doings —or they4 will land near their habitations— until Allah's promise comes to pass. Indeed Allah does not break His promise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Apostles were certainly derided before you. But then I gave respite to those who were faithless, then I seized them; so how was My retribution?

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is He who sustains every soul1 in spite of what it earns [comparable to the idols]? And yet they ascribe partners to Allah! Say, 'Name them!' Will you inform Him of something He does not know about on the earth, or of [what are] mere words? Rather their scheming is presented as decorous to the faithless, and they have been barred from the [right] way; and whomever Allah leads astray, has no guide.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is a punishment for them in the life of this world, and the punishment of the Hereafter will surely be harder, and they have no defender against Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A description of the paradise promised to the Godwary: streams run in it, its fruits and shade are everlasting. Such is the requital of those who are Godwary; and the requital of the faithless is the Fire.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those whom We have given the Book1 rejoice in what has been sent down to you. Among the factions2 are those who deny a part of it. Say, 'Indeed I have been commanded to worship Allah and not to ascribe any partner to Him. To Him do I summon [all mankind] and to Him will be my return.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus We have sent it down as a dispensation in Arabic; and should you follow their desires after the knowledge that has come to you, you shall have against Allah neither any guardian nor any defender.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have sent apostles before you, and We appointed for them wives and descendants; and an apostle may not bring a sign except by Allah's leave. There is a written [schedule] for every term:
