item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah effaces and confirms whatever He wishes and with Him is the Mother Book.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: In the earth are neighbouring terrains [of diverse kinds] and vineyards, farms, and date palms growing from the same root and from diverse roots, [all] irrigated by the same water, and We give some of them an advantage over others in flavour. There are indeed signs in that for a people who apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whether We show you a part of what We promise them,1 or take you away [before that], your duty is only to communicate, and it is for Us to do the reckoning.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not seen how We visit the land diminishing it at its edges? Allah judges, and there is none who may repeal His judgement, and He is swift at reckoning.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who were before them [also] schemed;1 yet all devising belongs to Allah. He knows what every soul earns. Soon the faithless will know in whose favour the outcome of that abode will be.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithless say, 'You have not been sent [by Allah].' Say, 'Allah suffices as a witness between me and you, and he who possesses the knowledge of the Book.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you are to wonder [at anything], then wonderful1 is their remark, 'When we have become dust, shall we be [ushered] into a new creation?' They are the ones who defy their Lord; they shall have iron collars around their necks, they shall be the inhabitants of the Fire, and they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They would press you for evil sooner than for good,1 though there have already gone by before them exemplary punishments. Indeed your Lord is forgiving to mankind despite their wrongdoing, and indeed your Lord is severe in retribution.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithless say, 'Why has not some sign been sent down to him from his Lord?' You are only a warner, and there is a guide for every people.

item.description: Allah knows what every female carries [in her womb], and what the wombs reduce and what they increase,1 and everything is by [precise] measure with Him,

item.description: Byzantium has been vanquished

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And of His signs is that He created for you mates from your own selves that you may take comfort in them, and He ordained affection and mercy between you. There are indeed signs in that for a people who reflect.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the difference of your languages and colours. There are indeed signs in that for those who know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And of His signs is your sleep by night and day, and your pursuit of His grace. There are indeed signs in that for a people who listen.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And of His signs is that He shows you the lightning, arousing fear and hope, and He sends down water from the sky, and with it revives the earth after its death. There are indeed signs in that for a people who apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And of His signs is that the sky and the earth stand by His command, and then, when He calls you forth from the earth, behold, you will come forth.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. All are obedient to Him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who originates the creation, and then He will bring it back —and that is more simple for Him. His is the loftiest description in the heavens and the earth. And He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He draws for you an example from yourselves: Do you have among your slaves any partners [who may share] in what We have provided you, so that you are equal in its respect, and you revere them as you revere one another?1 Thus do We elaborate2 the signs for a people who apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather the wrongdoers follow their own desires without any knowledge. So who will guide those whom Allah has led astray? They will have no helpers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: in a nearby territory, but following their defeat they will be victors

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So set your heart on the religion as a people of pure faith, the origination of Allah according to which He originated mankind (There is no altering Allah's creation; that is the upright religion, but most people do not know.)

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —turning to Him in penitence, and be wary of Him, and maintain the prayer, and do not be among the polytheists

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —of those who split up their religion and became sects: each faction exulting in what it possessed.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When distress befalls people, they supplicate their Lord, turning to Him in penitence. Then, when He lets them taste His mercy, behold, a part of them ascribe partners to their Lord,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: being ungrateful toward what We have given them. So let them enjoy. Soon they will know!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have We sent down to them any authority which might speak of what they associate with Him?

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when We let people taste [Our] mercy, they exult in it; but should an ill visit them because of what their hands have sent ahead, behold, they become despondent!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they not see that Allah expands the provision for whomever He wishes, and tightens it? There are indeed signs in that for a people who have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Give the relative his right, and the needy and the traveller [as well]. That is better for those who seek Allah's pleasure, and it is they who are the felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That which you give in usury in order that it may increase people's wealth does not increase with Allah. But what you pay as zakāt seeking Allah's pleasure —it is they who will be given a manifold increase.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: in a few years. All command belongs to Allah, before and after, and on that day the faithful will rejoice

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is Allah who created you and then He provided for you, then He makes you die, then He will bring you to life. Is there anyone among your partners who does anything of that kind? Immaculate is He and exalted above [having] any partners that they ascribe [to Him]!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Corruption has appeared in land and sea because of the doings of the people's hands, that He may make them taste something of what they have done, so that they may come back.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Travel over the land and then observe how was the fate of those who were before [you], most of whom were polytheists.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So set your heart on the upright religion, before there comes a day irrevocable from Allah. On that day they shall be split [into various groups].1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever is faithless shall face the consequences of his faithlessness, and those who act righteously only prepare for their own souls,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that He may reward those who have faith and do righteous deeds out of His grace. Indeed He does not like the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And of His signs is that He sends the winds as bearers of good news and to let you taste of His mercy, and that the ships may sail by His command, and that you may seek of His grace, and so that you may give [Him] thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We sent apostles to their people before you, and they brought them manifest proofs. Then We took vengeance upon those who were guilty, and it was a must for Us to help the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is Allah who sends the winds. Then they raise a cloud, then He spreads it as He wishes in the sky, and forms it into fragments, whereat you see the rain issuing from its midst. Then, when He strikes with it whomever of His servants that He wishes, behold, they rejoice;

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and indeed they had, before it was sent down upon them, been despondent earlier.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: at Allah's help. He helps whomever He wishes, and He is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So observe the effects of Allah's mercy: how He revives the earth after its death! Indeed He is the reviver of the dead, and He has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if We send a wind and they see it1 turn yellow, they will surely become ungrateful after that.2

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed you cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs [upon you],

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: nor can you lead the blind out of their error. You can make hear only those who have faith in Our signs, and thus have submitted.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is Allah who created you from [a state of] weakness, then He gave you power after weakness. Then, after power, He ordained weakness and old age: He creates whatever He wishes, and He is the All-knowing, the All-powerful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And on the day when the Hour sets in the guilty will swear that they had remained only for an hour. That is how they were used to lying [in the world].

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, 'Certainly you remained in Allah's Book1 until the Day of Resurrection. This is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not know.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On that day the excuses of the wrongdoers will not benefit them, nor will they be asked to propitiate [Allah].

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly we have drawn for mankind in this Qur'ān every [kind of] parable. Indeed if you bring them a sign,1 the faithless will surely say, 'You are nothing but fabricators!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus does Allah seal the hearts of those who do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [This is] a promise of Allah: Allah does not break His promise, but most people do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So be patient! Allah's promise is indeed true. And do not let yourself be upset by those who have no conviction.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They know just an outward aspect of the life of the world, but they are oblivious of the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not reflected in their own souls? Allah did not create the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them except with reason and for a specified term. Indeed many of the people disbelieve in the encounter with their Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not traveled in the land so that they may observe how was the fate of those who were before them? They were more powerful than them, and they plowed the earth and developed it more than they have developed it. Their apostles brought them manifest proofs. So it was not Allah who wronged them, but it was they who used to wrong themselves.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the [angels] ranged in ranks,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except him who snatches a snatch,1 whereat there pursues him a piercing flame.2

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:100 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'My Lord! Give me [an heir], one of the righteous.'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:101 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We gave him the good news of a forbearing son.1

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:102 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When he was old enough to assist in his endeavour, he said, 'My son! I see in a dream that I am sacrificing you. See what you think.' He said, 'Father! Do whatever you have been commanded. If Allah wishes, you will find me to be patient.'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:103 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when they had both submitted [to Allah's will], and he had laid him down on his forehead,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:104 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We called out to him, 'O Abraham!

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:105 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You have indeed fulfilled the vision!1 Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous!

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:106 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This was indeed a manifest test.'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:107 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:108 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and left for him a good name in posterity:

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:109 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Peace be to Abraham!'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ask them, is their creation more prodigious1 or [that of other creatures] that We have created? Indeed We created them from a viscous clay.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:110 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus do We reward the virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:111 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He is indeed one of Our faithful servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:112 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We gave him the good news of [the birth of] Isaac, a prophet, one of the righteous.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:113 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We blessed him and Isaac. Among their descendants [some] are virtuous, and [some] who manifestly wrong themselves.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:114 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We favoured Moses and Aaron,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:115 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and delivered them and their people from the great agony,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:116 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and We helped them so that they became the victors.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:117 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We gave them the illuminating scripture

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:118 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and guided them to the straight path,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:119 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and left for them a good name in posterity.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed you wonder, while they engage in ridicule,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:120 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Peace be to Moses and Aaron!'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:121 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:122 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are indeed among Our faithful servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:123 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And indeed Ilyās was one of the apostles,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:124 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when he said to his people, 'Will you not be Godwary?

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:125 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you invoke Baal and abandon the best of creators,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:126 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers?'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:127 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But they impugned him. So they will indeed be arraigned [before Him]

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:128 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —[all] except Allah's exclusive servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:129 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We left for him a good name in posterity.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and [even] when admonished do not take admonition,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:130 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Peace be to Ilyās!'1

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:131 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:132 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He is indeed one of Our faithful servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:133 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And indeed Lot was one of the apostles,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:134 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when We delivered him and all his family,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:135 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except an old woman among those who remained behind.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:136 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We destroyed [all] the others.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:137 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And indeed you pass by them at dawn

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:138 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and at night. So do you not apply reason?

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:139 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And indeed Jonah was one of the apostles,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and when they see a sign they make it an object of ridicule,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:140 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when he absconded toward the laden ship.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:141 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he drew lots with them and he was the one to be refuted.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:142 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:143 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And had he not been one of those who celebrate Allah's glory,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:144 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: he would have surely remained in its belly till the day they will be resurrected.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:145 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We cast him on a bare shore, and he was sick.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:146 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We made a gourd plant grow above him.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:147 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We sent him to a [community of] hundred thousand or more,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:148 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and they believed [in him]. So We provided for them for a while.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:149 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ask them, are daughters to be for your Lord while sons are to be for them?1

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and say, 'This is nothing but plain magic!'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:150 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did We create the angels females while they were present?1

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:151 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Look! It is indeed out of their mendacity that they say,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:152 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Allah has begotten,' and they indeed speak a falsehood.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:153 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Has he preferred daughters to sons?

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:154 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:155 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Will you not then take admonition?

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:156 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you have a manifest authority?1

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:157 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then produce your scripture, should you be truthful.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:158 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they have set up a kinship between Him and the jinn, while the jinn certainly know that they will indeed be presented [before Him].

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:159 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Clear is Allah of whatever they allege [about Him],

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'What! When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected?

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:160 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —[all] except Allah's exclusive servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:161 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed you and what you worship

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:162 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —you cannot mislead [anyone] about Him,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:163 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except someone who is bound for hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:164 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'There is none among us but has a known place.1

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:165 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it is we who are the ranged ones.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:166 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it is we who are those who celebrate Allah's glory.'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:167 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed they1 used to say,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:168 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Had we possessed a reminder from the ancients,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:169 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: we would surely have been Allah's exclusive servants.'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And our forefathers too?!'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:170 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But they disbelieved it [when it came to them]. Soon they will know.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:171 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly Our decree has gone beforehand in favour of Our servants, the apostles,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:172 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that they will indeed receive [Allah's] help,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:173 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and indeed Our hosts will be the victors.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:174 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So leave them alone for a while,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:175 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and watch them; soon they will see [the truth of the matter].

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:176 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they seek to hasten Our punishment?

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:177 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But when it descends in their courtyard it will be a dismal dawn for those who had been warned.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:178 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So leave them alone for a while,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:179 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and watch; soon they will see.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Yes! And you will be utterly humble.'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:180 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Clear is your Lord, the Lord of Might, of whatever they allege [concerning Him].

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:181 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Peace be to the apostles!

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:182 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It will be only a single shout and, behold, they will look on,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the ones who drive vigorously,1

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and say, 'Woe to us! This is the Day of Retribution!'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'This is the Day of Judgement that you used to deny!'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Muster the wrongdoers and their mates1 and what they used to worship

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: besides Allah, and show them the way to hell!

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [But first] stop them! For they must be questioned.'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Why is it that you do not support1 one another [today]?'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather today they are [meek and] submissive!

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Some of them will turn to others, questioning each other.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, 'Indeed you used to accost us peremptorily.'1

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will answer, 'Rather you [yourselves] had no faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the ones who recite the reminder:1

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We had no authority over you. Rather you [yourselves] were a rebellious lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So our Lord's word became due against us that we shall indeed taste [the punishment].

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So we perverted you, for we were perverse [ourselves].'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So that day they will share in the punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed that is how We deal with the guilty.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it was they who, when they were told, 'There is no god except Allah,' used to be disdainful,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and [they would] say, 'Shall we abandon our gods for a crazy poet?'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather he has brought [them] the truth, and confirmed the [earlier] apostles.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed you will taste the painful punishment,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and you will be requited only for what you used to do

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: indeed your God is certainly One,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —[all] except Allah's exclusive servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For such there is a known1 provision

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —fruits—and they will be held in honour,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: in the gardens of bliss,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [reclining] on couches, facing one another,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: served around with a cup from a clear fountain,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: snow-white, delicious to the drinkers,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: wherein there will be neither headache nor will it cause them stupefaction,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and with them will be maidens of restrained glances with big [beautiful] eyes,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: as if they were hidden1 ostrich eggs.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and the Lord of the easts.1

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Some of them will turn to others, questioning each other.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: One of them will say, 'Indeed I had a companion

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who used to say, "Are you really among those who affirm

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [that] when we are dead and have become dust and bones, we shall indeed be brought to retribution?" '

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He1 will say, 'Will you have a look?'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he will take a look and sight him in the middle of hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He will say, 'By Allah, you had almost ruined me!

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And had it not been for my Lord's blessing, I too would have been among the arraigned!'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Is it [true] that we shall not die [anymore],

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: aside from our first death, and that we shall not be punished?

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have adorned the lowest heaven1 with the finery of the stars,2

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is indeed the great success!

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Let all the workers work for the like of this!'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is this a better hospitality, or the Zaqqūm tree?

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have made it a punishment for the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it is a tree that emerges from the depths of hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Its spathes are as if they were devils' heads.1

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed they will eat from it and gorge with it their bellies.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed, on top of that they will take a solution of scalding water.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then indeed their retreat will be toward hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed they had found their fathers astray,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and to guard from any froward devil.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: yet they press on in their footsteps.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly most of the ancients went astray before them,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and certainly We had sent warners among them.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So observe how was the fate of those who were warned

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —[all] except Allah's exclusive servants!

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly Noah called out to Us, and how well We responded!

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We delivered him and his family from the great agony,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and made his descendants the survivors,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and left for him a good name among posterity:

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Peace to Noah, throughout the nations!'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They do not eavesdrop on the Supernal Elite but are shot at from every side,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He is indeed one of Our faithful servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We drowned the others.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Abraham was among his followers,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when he came to his Lord with a sound heart,1

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when he said to his father and his people, 'What is it that you are worshiping?

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is it a lie, gods other than Allah, that you desire?

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then what is your idea about the Lord of all the worlds?'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he made an observation of the stars1

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and said, 'Indeed I am sick!'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: to drive them away, and for them there is a constant mortification,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So they went away leaving him behind.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he stole away to their gods and said, 'Will you not eat?

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Why do you not speak?'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he attacked them, striking forcefully.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They came running towards him.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Do you worship what you have yourselves carved,

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when Allah has created you and whatever you make?'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Build a structure for him and cast him into a huge fire.'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So they sought to outwit him, but We made them the lowermost.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:99 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Indeed I am going toward my Lord, who will guide me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saff:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whatever there is in the heavens glorifies Allah and whatever there is in the earth, and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saff:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Shall I show you a deal that will deliver you from a painful punishment?

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saff:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have faith in Allah and His Apostle, and wage jihād in the way of Allah with your possessions and your persons. That is better for you, should you know.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saff:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He shall forgive you your sins and admit you into gardens with streams running in them, and into good dwellings in the Gardens of Eden. That is the great success.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saff:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And other [blessings] you love: help from Allah and a victory near at hand. And give good news to the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saff:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Be Allah's helpers, just as Jesus son of Mary said to the disciples, 'Who will be my helpers for Allah's sake?' The Disciples said, 'We will be Allah's helpers!' So a group of the Children of Israel believed, and a group disbelieved. Then We strengthened the faithful against their enemies, and they became the dominant ones.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saff:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Why do you say what you do not do?

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saff:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is greatly outrageous to Allah that you should say what you do not do.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saff:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah loves those who fight in His way in ranks, as if they were a compact structure.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saff:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Moses said to his people, 'O my people! Why do you torment me, when you certainly know that I am Allah's apostle to you?' So when they swerved [from the right path] Allah made their hearts swerve, and Allah does not guide the transgressing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saff:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when Jesus son of Mary said, 'O Children of Israel! Indeed I am the apostle of Allah to you, to confirm what is before me of the Torah, and to give the good news of an apostle who will come after me, whose name is Aḥmad.' Yet when he brought them manifest proofs, they said, 'This is plain magic.'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saff:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And who is a greater wrongdoer than him who fabricates falsehoods against Allah, while he is being summoned to Islam? And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saff:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They desire to put out the light of Allah with their mouths, but Allah shall perfect His light though the faithless should be averse.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saff:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who has sent His Apostle with the guidance and the religion of truth that He may make it prevail over all religions though the polytheists should be averse.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Alif, Lām, Mīm.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'When we have been lost in the dust,1 shall we be indeed created anew?' Rather they disbelieve in the encounter with their Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'You will be taken away by the angel of death, who has been charged with you. Then you will be brought back to your Lord.'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were you to see when the guilty hang their heads before their Lord [confessing], 'Our Lord! We have seen and heard. Send us back so that we may act righteously. Indeed we are [now] convinced.'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had We wished We would have given every soul its guidance, but My word became due [against the defiant]: 'Surely I will fill hell with all the [guilty] jinn and humans.'1

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So taste [the punishment] for your having forgotten the encounter of this day of yours. We [too] have forgotten you. Taste the everlasting punishment because of what you used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Only those believe in Our signs who, when they are reminded of them, fall down in prostration and celebrate the praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Their sides vacate their beds1 to supplicate their Lord in fear and hope, and they spend out of what We have provided them.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No one knows what has been kept hidden for them of comfort as a reward for what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is someone who is faithful like someone who is a transgressor? They are not equal.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds, for them are gardens of the Abode —a hospitality for what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The [gradual] sending down of the Book, there is no doubt in it, is from the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who have transgressed, their refuge is the Fire. Whenever they seek to leave it, they will be turned back into it, and they will be told: 'Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny.'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We shall surely make them taste the nearer punishment before the greater punishment,1 so that they may come back.2

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Who is a greater wrongdoer than him who is reminded of his Lord's signs, whereat he disregards them? Indeed We shall take vengeance upon the guilty.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We gave Moses the Book, [declaring], 'Do not be in doubt about the encounter with Him,' and We made it a [source of] guidance for the Children of Israel.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And amongst them We appointed _imam_s to guide [the people] by Our command, when they had been patient and had conviction in Our signs.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that about which they used to differ.

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Does it not dawn upon them how many generations We have destroyed before them, amid [the ruins of] whose dwellings they walk? There are indeed signs in that. Will they not then listen?

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they not see that We carry water to the parched earth and with it We bring forth crops of which they eat, themselves and their cattle? Will they not then see?

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they say, 'When will this judgement be, should you be truthful?'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'On the day of judgement their [newly found] faith shall not avail the faithless, nor will they be granted any respite.'

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Sajda:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:191 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:192 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is indeed [a Book] sent down by the Lord of all the worlds,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:193 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: brought down by the Trustworthy Spirit

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:194 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: upon your heart (so that you may be one of the warners),

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:195 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: in a clear Arabic language.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:196 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is indeed [foretold] in the scriptures of the ancients.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:197 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is it not a sign for them that the learned of the Children of Israel recognize it?

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:198 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had We sent it down upon some non-Arab

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:199 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and had he recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These are the signs of the Manifest Book.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'I did that when I was astray.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:200 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is how We let it pass through the hearts of the guilty:

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:201 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: they do not believe in it until they sight the painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:202 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It will overtake them suddenly while they are unaware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:203 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thereupon they will say, 'Shall we be granted any respite?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:204 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So do they seek to hasten on Our punishment?

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:205 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you see, should We let them enjoy for some years,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:206 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then there comes to them what they have been promised,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:207 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: of what avail to them will be that which they were given to enjoy?

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:208 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have not destroyed any town without its having warners,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:209 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: for the sake of admonition, and We were not unjust.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So I fled from you, as I was afraid of you. Then my Lord gave me judgement and made me one of the apostles.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:210 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It1 has not been brought down by the devils.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:211 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Neither does it behoove them, nor are they capable [of doing that].

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:212 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed they are kept at bay [even] from hearing it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:213 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So do not invoke any god besides Allah, lest you should be among the punished.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:214 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Warn the nearest of your kinsfolk,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:215 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and lower your wing to the faithful who follow you.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:216 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they disobey you, say, 'I am absolved of what you do.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:217 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And put your trust in the All-mighty, the All-merciful,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:218 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who sees you when you stand [for prayer],

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:219 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and your going about among those who prostrate.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for that favour, you remind me of it reproachfully because you have enslaved the Children of Israel.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:220 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:221 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Should I inform you on whom the devils descend?

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:222 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They descend on every sinful liar.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:223 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They eavesdrop, and most of them are liars.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:224 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the poets, [only] the perverse follow them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:225 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded that they rove in every valley,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:226 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and that they say what they do not do?

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:227 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Barring those who have faith and do righteous deeds and remember Allah greatly, and aid each other after they have been wronged. And the wrongdoers will soon know at what goal they will end up.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'And what is "the Lord of all the worlds?" '

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'The Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, —should you have conviction.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said to those who were around him, 'Don't you hear?!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Indeed your messenger, who has been sent to you, is surely crazy!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'The Lord of the east and the west and whatever is between them —should you apply reason.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'If you take up any god other than me, I will surely make you a prisoner!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You are liable to imperil your life [out of distress] that they will not have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'What if I bring you something manifest?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Then bring it, should you be truthful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thereat he threw down his staff, and behold, it was a manifest python.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white to the onlookers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said to the elite [who stood] around him, 'This is indeed an expert magician

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who seeks to expel you from your land with his magic. So what do you advise?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Put him and his brother off for a while, and send heralds to the cities

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: to bring you every expert magician.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So the magicians were gathered for the tryst of a known day,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the people were told: 'Will you gather?!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If We wish We will send down to them a sign from the sky before which their heads will remain bowed in humility.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Maybe we will follow the magicians, should they be the victors!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when the magicians came, they said to Pharaoh, 'Shall we indeed have a reward if we were to be the victors?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, ' Of course; and indeed you shall be among those near [to me].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Moses said to them, 'Throw down what you have to throw!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So they threw down their sticks and ropes, and said, 'By the might of Pharaoh, we shall surely be the victors!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thereat Moses threw down his staff, and behold, it was swallowing what they had faked.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thereat the magicians fell down prostrating.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'We believe in the Lord of all the worlds,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Do you profess faith in Him before I permit you? He is indeed your chief who has taught you magic! Soon you will surely know! Surely I will cut off your hands and feet from opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There would not come to them any new reminder from the All-beneficent but that they used to disregard it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, '[There is] no harm [in that]! Indeed we shall return to our Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed we hope our Lord will forgive us our iniquities for being the first to believe.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We revealed to Moses, [saying], 'Take My servants on a journey by night, for you will be pursued.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [announcing:] 'These1 are indeed a small gang.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They have surely aroused our wrath,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and indeed we are all on our guard.'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We expelled them from gardens and springs,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and [from] treasures and splendid places.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So it was; and We bequeathed them to the Children of Israel.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They have certainly denied [the truth], but soon there will come to them the news of what they have been deriding.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then they pursued them at sunrise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the two hosts sighted each other, the companions of Moses said, 'Indeed we have been caught up.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Certainly not! Indeed my Lord is with me. He will guide me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thereupon We revealed to Moses: 'Strike the sea with your staff!' Whereupon it parted, and each part was as if it were a great mountain.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There, We brought the others near.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We delivered Moses and all those who were with him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We drowned the others.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is indeed a sign in that, but most of them do not have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Relate to them the account of Abraham

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not regarded the earth, how many We have caused to grow in it of every splendid kind [of vegetation]?

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when he said to his father and his people, 'What is it that you are worshiping?!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'We worship idols, and we will go on clinging to them.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Do they hear you when you call them?

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Or do they bring you any benefit, or cause you any harm?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Rather we found our fathers acting likewise.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Have you regarded what you have been worshipping,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: you and your ancestors?

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are indeed hateful to me, but the Lord of all the worlds,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who created me, it is He who guides me,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and provides me with food and drink,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and when I get sick, it is He who cures me;

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who will make me die, then He will bring me to life,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and who, I hope, will forgive me my iniquities on the Day of Retribution.'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'My Lord! Grant me [unerring] judgement, and unite me with the Righteous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Confer on me a worthy repute among the posterity,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and make me one of the heirs to the paradise of bliss.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Forgive my father, for he is one of those who are astray.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not disgrace me on the day that they will be resurrected,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the day when neither wealth nor children will avail,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except him who comes to Allah with a sound heart,'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
