item.description: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and paradise will be brought near for the Godwary,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and hell will be brought into view for the perverse,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and they shall be told: 'Where is that which you used to worship

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: besides Allah? Do they help you, or do they help each other?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then they will be cast into it on their faces —they and the perverse,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the hosts of Iblis all together.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, as they wrangle in it [together],

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'By Allah, we had indeed been in manifest error,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when we equated you with the Lord of all the worlds!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shu'araa:99 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And no one led us astray except the guilty.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ḥā, Mīm,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whatever thing you may differ about, its judgement is with Allah. That is Allah, my Lord. In Him I have put my trust, and to Him I turn penitently.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The originator of the heavens and the earth, He made for you mates from your own selves, and mates of the cattle, by which means He multiplies you. Nothing is like Him,1 and He is the All-hearing, the All-seeing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth: He expands the provision for whomever He wishes, and tightens it [for whomever He wishes]. Indeed He has knowledge of all things.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He has prescribed for you the religion which He had enjoined upon Noah and which We have [also] revealed to you, and which We had enjoined upon Abraham, Moses and Jesus, declaring, 'Maintain the religion, and do not be divided in it.' Hard on the polytheists is that to which you summon them. Allah chooses for it1 whomever He wishes and He guides to it2 whomever returns penitently.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They did not divide [into sects] except after the knowledge had come to them, out of envy among themselves; and were it not for a prior decree of your Lord [granting them reprieve] until a specified time, decision would have been made between them. Indeed those who were made heirs to the Book after them are surely in grave doubt concerning it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So summon to this [unity of religion], and be steadfast, just as you have been commanded, and do not follow their desires, and say, 'I believe in whatever Book Allah has sent down. I have been commanded to do justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. Our deeds belong to us and your deeds belong to you. There is no argument between us and you. Allah will bring us together and toward Him is the destination.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who argue concerning Allah, after His call has been answered, their argument stands refuted with their Lord, and upon them shall be [His] wrath, and there is a severe punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is Allah who has sent down the Book with the truth and [He has sent down] the Balance. What do you know —maybe the Hour is near!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who do not believe in it ask [you] to hasten it, but those who have faith are apprehensive of it, and know that it is true. Look! Indeed those who are in doubt about the Hour1 are surely in extreme error!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah is all-attentive to His servants. He provides for whomever He wishes, and He is the All-strong, the All-mighty.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Ayn, Sīn, Qāf.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever desires the tillage of the Hereafter, We will enhance for him his tillage, and whoever desires the tillage of the world, We will give it to him, but he will have no share in the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they have partners [besides Allah] who have ordained for them a religion which has not been permitted by Allah? Had it not been for the conclusive word,1 decision would have been made between them. For the wrongdoers there is indeed a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You will see the wrongdoers apprehensive because of what they have earned, while it is about to befall them; but those who have faith and do righteous deeds will be in the gardens of paradise: they will have whatever they wish near their Lord. That is the greatest grace.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is the good news Allah gives to His servants who have faith and do righteous deeds! Say, 'I do not ask you any reward for it except love of [my] relatives.' Whoever performs a good deed, We shall enhance for him its goodness. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-appreciative.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they say, 'He has fabricated a lie against Allah'? If so, should Allah wish He would set a seal on your heart, and Allah will efface the falsehood and confirm the truth with His words. Indeed He knows well what is in the breasts.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who accepts the repentance of His servants, and excuses their misdeeds and knows what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And He answers those who have faith and do righteous deeds and enhances them out of His grace. But as for the faithless, there is a severe punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were Allah to expand the provision for His servants, they would surely create havoc on the earth. But He sends down in a [precise] measure whatever He wishes. Indeed He is all-aware, all-seeing about His servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who sends down the rain after they have been despondent, and unfolds His mercy, and He is the Guardian, the All-laudable.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and whatever creatures He has scattered in them, and He is able to gather them whenever He wishes.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus does He reveal to you and to those who were before you, Allah, the All-mighty, the All-wise:

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whatever affliction that may visit you is because of what your hands have earned, and He excuses many [an offense].

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You cannot thwart [Allah] on the earth, and you do not have besides Allah any guardian or helper.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among His signs are the ships [that run] on the sea [appearing] like landmarks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If He wishes He stills the wind, whereat they remain standstill on its surface. There are indeed signs in that for every patient and grateful [servant].

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Or He wrecks them because of what they have earned, and He excuses many [an offense].

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Let those who dispute Our signs know that there is no escape for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whatever you have been given are the wares of the life of this world, but what is with Allah is better and more lasting for those who have faith and who put their trust in their Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —Those who avoid major sins and indecencies, and forgive when angered;

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: those who answer their Lord, maintain the prayer, and their affairs are by counsel among themselves, and they spend out of what We have provided them with;

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: those who, when visited by aggression, come to each other's aid.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the All-exalted, the All-supreme.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The requital of evil is an evil like it. So whoever excuses and conciliates, his reward lies with Allah. Indeed He does not like the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who retaliate after being wronged, there is no blame upon them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The blame lies only upon those who wrong the people and commit aggression in the land unduly. For such there is a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for him who endures patiently and forgives —that is indeed the steadiest of courses.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whomever Allah leads astray has no guardian apart from Him. You will see the wrongdoers, when they sight the punishment, saying, 'Is there any way for a retreat?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You will see them being exposed to it, humbled by abasement, looking askance secretly. And the faithful will say, 'Indeed the losers are those who have ruined themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Look! The wrongdoers are indeed in lasting punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They have no guardians to help them besides Allah. Whomever Allah leads astray has no way out.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Answer your Lord before there comes a day for which there is no revoking from Allah. On that day you will have no refuge, neither will you have [any chance for] denial.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they disregard [your warnings], We have not sent you as a keeper over them. Your duty is only to communicate. Indeed when We let man taste Our mercy, he exults in it; but should an ill visit them because of what their hands have sent ahead, then man is indeed very ungrateful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He creates whatever He wishes; He gives females to whomever He wishes, and gives males to whomever He wishes,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The heavens are about to be rent apart from above them, while the angels celebrate the praise of their Lord and plead for forgiveness for those on the earth. Look! Allah is indeed the All-forgiving, the All-merciful!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: or He combines them males and females, and makes sterile whomever He wishes. Indeed He is all-knowing, all-powerful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is not [possible] for any human that Allah should speak to him1 except through revelation or from behind a curtain,2 or send a messenger3 who reveals by His permission whatever He wishes. Indeed He is all-exalted, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus have We revealed to you the Spirit of Our dispensation. You did not know what the Book is, nor what is faith; but We made it a light that We may guide by its means whomever We wish of Our servants. And indeed you guide to a straight path,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the path of Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. Look! To Allah do all matters return!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who have taken guardians besides Him, Allah is watchful over them, and it is not your duty to watch over them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus have We revealed to you an Arabic Qur'ān that you may warn [the people of] the Mother of the Towns1 and those around it, and warn [them] of the Day of Gathering,2 in which there is no doubt, [whereupon] a part [of mankind] will be in paradise and a part will be in the Blaze.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had Allah wished, He would have surely made them one community; but He admits whomever He wishes into His mercy, and the wrongdoers do not have any guardian or helper.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they taken guardians besides Him? [Say,] 'It is Allah who is the Guardian, and He revives the dead, and He has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the sky, by the nightly visitor,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and he shall have neither power nor helper.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the resurgent sky,1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the furrowed earth:

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: it is indeed a decisive word,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and it is not a jest.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed they are devising a stratagem,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and I [too] am devising a plan.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So respite the faithless; give them a gentle respite.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: (and what will show you what is the nightly visitor?

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is the brilliant star):

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: there is a guard1 over every soul.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So let man consider from what he was created.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He was created from an effusing fluid

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: which issues from between the loins and the breast-bones.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed He is able to bring him back [after death],

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: on the day when the secrets are examined,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whatever there is in the heavens glorifies Allah and whatever there is in the earth. To Him belongs all sovereignty and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But as for those who are faithless and deny Our signs, —they shall be the inmates of the Fire, to remain in it [forever], and it is an evil destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No affliction visits [anyone] except by Allah's leave. Whoever has faith in Allah, He guides his heart, and Allah has knowledge of all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Obey Allah and obey the Apostle; but if you turn away, then Our Apostle's duty is only to communicate in clear terms.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah—there is no god except Him— in Allah let all the faithful put their trust.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Indeed among your spouses and children you have enemies; so beware of them. And if you excuse, forbear and forgive, then Allah is indeed all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather your possessions and children are a trial, and Allah—with Him is a great reward!

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So be wary of Allah, as far as you can, and listen and obey, and spend [in the way of Allah]; that is better for yourselves. Those who are saved from their own greed —it is they who are the felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you lend Allah a good loan, He shall multiply it for you and forgive you, and Allah is all-appreciative, all-forbearing,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Knower of the sensible and the Unseen, the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who created you. Then some of you are faithless and some of you are faithful, and Allah sees best what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He created the heavens and the earth with reason, and He formed you and perfected your forms, and toward Him is the destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He knows whatever there is in the heavens and the earth, and He knows whatever you hide and whatever you disclose, and Allah knows best what is in the breasts.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Has there not come to you the account of those who were faithless before? They tasted the evil consequences of their conduct, and there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That was because their apostles used to bring them manifest proofs, but they said, 'Shall humans be our guides?!' So they disbelieved and turned away, and Allah was in no need [of their faith] and Allah is all-sufficient, all-laudable.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithless claim that they will not be resurrected. Say, 'Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did, and that is easy for Allah.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So have faith in Allah and His Apostle and the light which We have sent down, and Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day when He will gather you for the Day of Gathering, that will be a day of dispossession.1 And whoever has faith in Allah and acts righteously, He shall absolve him of his misdeeds and admit him into gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them forever. That is the great success.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Prophet! Why do you prohibit [yourself] what Allah has made lawful for you, seeking to please your wives? And Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah draws an example for the faithless: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of our righteous servants, yet they betrayed them. So they1 did not avail them2 in any way against Allah, and it was said [to them], 'Enter the Fire, along with those who enter [it].'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah draws an[other] example for those who have faith: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, 'My Lord! Build me a home near You in paradise, and deliver me from Pharaoh and his conduct, and deliver me from the wrongdoing lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And Mary, daughter of Imran, who guarded the chastity of her womb, so We breathed into it of Our spirit. She confirmed the words of her Lord and His Books, and she was one of the obedient.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has certainly made lawful for you the dissolution of your oaths,1 and Allah is your master and He is the All-knowing, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the Prophet confided to one of his wives a matter, but when she divulged it, and Allah apprised him about it, he announced [to her] part of it and disregarded part of it. So when he told her about it, she said, 'Who informed you about it?' He said, 'The All-knowing and the All-aware informed me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If the two of you1 repent to Allah …2 for your hearts have certainly swerved, and if you back each other against him, then [know that] Allah is indeed his guardian, and Gabriel, the righteous among the faithful, and, thereafter, the angels are his supporters.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It may be that if he divorces you his Lord will give him, in [your] stead, wives better than you: [such as are] muslim, faithful, obedient, penitent, devout and given to fasting, virgins and non-virgins.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Save yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are [assigned] angels, severe and mighty, who do not disobey whatever Allah has commanded them, and carry out what they are commanded.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [They will call out to the faithless:] 'O faithless ones! Do not make any excuses today. You are only being requited for what you used to do.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Repent to Allah with sincere repentance! Maybe your Lord will absolve you of your misdeeds and admit you into gardens with streams running in them, on the day when Allah will not let the Prophet down and the faithful who are with him. Their light will move swiftly before them and on their right. They will say, 'Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us! Indeed You have power over all things.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Prophet! Wage jihād against the faithless and the hypocrites, and be severe with them. Their refuge shall be hell, and it is an evil destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takaathur:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rivalry [and vainglory] distracted you

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takaathur:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: until you visited [even] the graves.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takaathur:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! Soon you will know!

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takaathur:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Again, no indeed! Soon you will know!

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takaathur:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! Were you to know with certain knowledge,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takaathur:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: you would surely see hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takaathur:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Again, you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takaathur:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then, that day, you will surely be questioned concerning the blessing.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the sun is wound up,1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the records [of deeds] are unfolded,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when the sky is stripped off,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when hell is set ablaze,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when paradise is brought near,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then a soul shall know what it has readied [for itself].

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So I swear by the stars that return,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the planets that hide,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the night as it approaches,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the dawn as it breathes,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: it is indeed the speech of a noble apostle,1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when the stars scatter,1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: powerful and eminent with the Lord of the Throne,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: one who is heard and trustworthy as well.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your companion is not crazy:

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: certainly he saw him on the manifest horizon,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and he is not miserly concerning the Unseen.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And it is not the speech of an outcast Satan.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So where are you going?

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is just a reminder for all the nations,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: for those of you who wish to be steadfast;1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: but you do not wish unless it is wished by Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when the mountains are set moving,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when the pregnant camels are neglected,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when the wild beasts are mustered,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when the seas are set afire,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when the souls are assorted,1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when the girl buried-alive will be asked

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: for what sin she was killed.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Prophet! When you1 divorce women, divorce them at [the conclusion of] their term2 and calculate the term, and be wary of Allah, your Lord. Do not turn them out from their houses, nor shall they go out, unless they commit a gross3 indecency.4 These are Allah's bounds, and whoever transgresses the bounds of Allah certainly wrongs himself. You never know maybe Allah will bring off something new later on.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment. So be wary of Allah, O you who possess intellect and have faith! Allah has already sent down to you a reminder,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: an apostle reciting to you the manifest signs of Allah that He may bring out those who have faith and do righteous deeds from darkness into light. And whoever has faith in Allah and does righteous deeds, He shall admit him into gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them forever. Allah has certainly granted him an excellent provision.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is Allah who has created seven heavens, and of the earth [a number] similar to them. The command gradually descends through them, that you may know that Allah has power over all things, and that Allah comprehends all things in knowledge.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then, when they have completed their term, either retain them honourably or separate from them honourably, and take the witness of two fair men from among yourselves, and bear witness for the sake of Allah. To [comply with] this is advised whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day. And whoever is wary of Allah, He shall make a way out for him,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and provide for him from whence he does not reckon. And whoever puts his trust in Allah, He will suffice him. Indeed Allah carries through His command. Certainly Allah has set a measure for everything.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those of your wives who do not hope to have menses, should you have any doubts, their term shall be three months, and for those [as well] who have not yet had menses. As for those who are pregnant, their term shall be until they deliver. And whoever is wary of Allah, He shall grant him ease in his affairs.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is the ordinance of Allah which He has sent down to you, and whoever is wary of Allah, He shall absolve him of his misdeeds and give him a great reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: House them where you live,1 in accordance with your means, and do not harass them to put them in straits, and should they be pregnant, maintain them until they deliver. Then, if they suckle [the baby] for you, give them their wages and consult together honourably; but if you make things difficult for each other, then another woman will suckle [the baby] for him.2

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Let the affluent man spend out of his affluence, and let he whose provision has been tightened spend out of what Allah has given him. Allah does not task any soul except [according to] what He has given it. Allah will bring about ease after hardship.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How many a town defied the command of its Lord and His apostles, then We called it to a severe account and punished it with a dire punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So it tasted the evil consequences of its conduct, and the outcome of its conduct was ruin.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [This is] a [declaration of] repudiation by Allah and His Apostle [addressed] to the polytheists with whom you had made a treaty:

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They observe toward a believer neither kinship nor covenant, and it is they who are the transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:100 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The early vanguard of the Emigrants and the Helpers and those who followed them in virtue, —Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him, and He has prepared for them gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them forever. That is the great success.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:101 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There are hypocrites among the Bedouins around you and among the townspeople of Madinah, steeped in hypocrisy. You do not know them; We know them, and We will punish them twice, then they shall be consigned to a great punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:102 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [There are] others who have confessed to their sins, having mixed up righteous conduct with other that was evil. Maybe Allah will accept their repentance. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:103 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Take charity from their possessions to cleanse them and purify them thereby, and bless them. Indeed your blessing is a comfort to them, and Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:104 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they not know that it is Allah who accepts the repentance of His servants and receives the charities, and that it is Allah who is the All-clement, the All-merciful?

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:105 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And say, 'Go on working: Allah will see your conduct, and His Apostle and the faithful [as well], and you will be returned to the Knower of the sensible and the Unseen, and He will inform you concerning what you used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:106 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [There are] others waiting Allah's edict: either He shall punish them, or turn to them clemently, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:107 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who took to a mosque for sabotage and for defiance, and to cause division among the faithful, and for the purpose of ambush [used] by those who have fought Allah and His Apostle before —they will surely swear: 'We desired nothing but good,' and Allah bears witness that they are indeed liars.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:108 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not stand in it ever! A mosque founded on Godwariness from the [very] first day is worthier that you stand in it [for prayer]. Therein are men who love to keep pure, and Allah loves those who keep pure.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:109 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is he who founds his building on Godwariness and [the pursuit of Allah's] pleasure better-off or he who founds his building on the brink of a collapsing bank which collapses with him into the fire of hell? And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yet if they repent and maintain the prayer and give the zakāt, then they are your brethren in faith. We elaborate the signs for a people who have knowledge.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:110 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The building they have built will never cease to be [a source of] disquiet in their hearts until their hearts are cut into pieces, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:111 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah has bought from the faithful their souls and their possessions for paradise to be theirs: they fight in the way of Allah, kill, and are killed. A promise binding upon Him in the Torah and the Evangel and the Qur'ān. And who is truer to his promise than Allah? So rejoice in the bargain you have made with Him, and that is the great success.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:112 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [The faithful are] penitent, devout, celebrators of Allah's praise, wayfarers,1 who bow [and] prostrate [in prayer], bid what is right and forbid what is wrong, and keep Allah's bounds —and give good news to the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:113 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Prophet and the faithful may not plead for the forgiveness of the polytheists, even if they should be [their] relatives, after it has become clear to them that they will be the inmates of hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:114 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Abraham's pleading forgiveness for his father was only to fulfill a promise he had made him.1 So when it became manifest to him that he was an enemy of God, he repudiated him. Indeed Abraham was most plaintive and forbearing.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:115 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah does not lead any people astray after He has guided them until He has made clear to them what they should beware of. Indeed Allah has knowledge of all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:116 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed to Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He gives life and brings death. And besides Allah you do not have any guardian or helper.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:117 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly Allah turned clemently to the Prophet and the Emigrants and the Helpers, who followed him in the hour of difficulty, after the hearts of a part of them were about to swerve. Then He turned clemently to them —indeed He is most kind and merciful to them—

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:118 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and to the three who were left behind. When the earth became narrow for them with [all] its expanse, and their own souls weighed heavily on them,1 and they knew that there was no refuge from Allah except in Him, then He turned clemently toward them so that they might be penitent. Indeed Allah is the All-clement, the All-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:119 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Be wary of Allah, and be with the Truthful.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they break their pledges after their having made a treaty and revile your religion, then fight the leaders of unfaith —indeed they have no [commitment to] pledges— maybe they will relinquish.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:120 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is not fitting for the people of Madinah and the Bedouins around them to hang back behind the Apostle of Allah1 and prefer their own lives to his life. That is because they neither experience any thirst, nor fatigue, nor hunger, in the way of Allah, nor do they tread any ground enraging the faithless, nor do they gain any ground against an enemy but a righteous deed is written for them on its account. Indeed Allah does not waste the reward of the virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:121 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And neither do they incur any expense, big or small, nor do they cross any valley, but it is written to their account, so that Allah may reward them by the best of what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:122 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yet it is not for the faithful to go forth en masse.1 But why should not there go forth a group from each of their sections to become learned in religion, and to warn their people when they return to them, so that they may beware?

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:123 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Fight the faithless who are in your vicinity, and let them find severity in you, and know that Allah is with the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:124 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whenever a sūrah is sent down, there are some of them1 who say, 'Which of you did it increase in faith?' As for those who have faith, it increases them in faith, and they rejoice.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:125 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But as for those in whose heart is a sickness, it only adds defilement to their defilement, and they die while they are faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:126 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they not see that they are tried once or twice every year? Yet they neither repent, nor do they take admonition.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:127 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And whenever a sūrah is sent down, they look at one another: 'Is anybody observing you?' Then they slip away. Allah has turned aside their hearts, for they are a people who do not understand.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:128 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There has certainly come to you an apostle from among yourselves. Grievous to him is your distress; he has deep concern for you, and is most kind and merciful to the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:129 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they turn their backs [on you], say, 'Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god except Him. In Him I have put my trust and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Will you not make war on a people who broke their pledges and resolved to expel the Apostle, and opened [hostilities] against you initially? Do you fear them? But Allah is worthier of being feared by you, should you be faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Make war on them so that Allah may punish them by your hands and humiliate them, and help you against them, and heal the hearts of a faithful folk,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and remove rage from their hearts, and Allah turns clemently to whomever He wishes, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you suppose that you will be let off while Allah has not yet ascertained those of you who wage jihād and those who do not take, besides Allah and His Apostle and the faithful, anyone as [their] confidant? Allah is well aware of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The polytheists may not maintain Allah's mosques while they are witness to their own unfaith. Their works have failed, and they shall remain in the Fire [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Only those shall maintain Allah's mosques who believe in Allah and the Last Day, and maintain the prayer and give the zakāt, and fear no one except Allah. They, hopefully, will be among the guided.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you regard the providing of water to ḥajj pilgrims and the maintenance of the Holy Mosque as similar [in worth] to someone who has faith in Allah and [believes in] the Last Day and wages jihād in the way of Allah? They are not equal with Allah, and Allah does not guide the wrongdoing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Travel [unmolested] in the land for four months, but know that you cannot thwart Allah, and that Allah shall disgrace the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who have believed and migrated, and waged jihād in the way of Allah with their possessions and persons have a greater rank near Allah, and it is they who are the triumphant.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Their Lord gives them the good news of His mercy and [His] pleasure, and for them there will be gardens with lasting bliss,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: to remain in them forever. With Allah indeed is a great reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Do not befriend your fathers and brothers1 if they prefer faithlessness to faith. Those of you who befriend them —it is they who are the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'If your fathers and your sons, your brethren, your spouses, and your kinsfolk, the possessions that you have acquired, the business you fear may suffer, and the dwellings you are fond of, are dearer to you than Allah and His Apostle and to waging jihād in His way, then wait until Allah issues His edict, and Allah does not guide the transgressing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has certainly helped you in many situations, and on the day of Ḥunayn, when your great number impressed you, but it did not avail you in any way, and the earth became narrow for you in spite of its expanse,1 whereupon you turned your backs [to flee].

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then Allah sent down His composure upon His Apostle and upon the faithful, and He sent down hosts you did not see, and He punished the faithless, and that is the requital of the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then Allah shall turn clemently after that to whomever He wishes. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! The polytheists are indeed unclean: so let them not approach the Holy Mosque after this year. Should you fear poverty, Allah will enrich you out of His grace, if He wishes. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Fight those who do not have faith in Allah nor [believe] in the Last Day, nor forbid what Allah and His Apostle have forbidden, nor practise the true religion, from among those who were given the Book, until they pay the tribute out of hand, degraded.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [This is] an announcement from Allah and His Apostle to all the people on the day of the greater ḥajj:1 that Allah and His Apostle repudiate the polytheists: If you repent2 that is better for you; but if you turn your backs [on Allah], know that you cannot thwart Allah, and inform the faithless of a painful punishment

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Jews say, 'Ezra is the son of Allah,' and the Christians say, 'Christ is the son of Allah.' That is an opinion that they mouth, imitating the opinions of the faithless of former times. May Allah assail them, where do they stray?!

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They have taken their scribes and their monks as lords besides Allah, and also Christ, Mary's son; though they were commanded to worship only the One God, there is no god except Him; He is far too immaculate to have any partners that they ascribe [to Him]!

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They desire to put out the light of Allah with their mouths, but Allah is intent on perfecting His light though the faithless should be averse.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who has sent His Apostle with the guidance and the religion of truth, that He may make it prevail over all religions, though the polytheists should be averse.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Indeed many of the scribes and monks wrongfully eat up the people's wealth, and bar [them] from the way of Allah. Those who treasure up gold and silver, and do not spend it in the way of Allah, inform them of a painful punishment

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: on the day when these shall be heated in hellfire and therewith branded on their foreheads, their sides and their backs [and told]: 'This is what you treasured up for yourselves! So taste what you have treasured!'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the number of months with Allah is twelve months in Allah's Book, the day when He created the heavens and the earth. Of these, four are sacred. That is the upright religion. So do not wrong yourselves during them.1 Fight all the polytheists, just as they fight you all, and know that Allah is with the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed nasī1 is an increase in unfaith, whereby the faithless are led [further] astray. They allow it in one year and forbid it another year, so as to fit in with the number which Allah has made inviolable, thus permitting what Allah has forbidden. Their evil deeds appear to them as decorous, and Allah does not guide the faithless lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! What is the matter with you that when you are told: 'Go forth in the way of Allah,' you sink heavily to the ground? Are you pleased with the life of this world instead of the Hereafter? But the wares of the life of this world compared with the Hereafter are but insignificant.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you do not go forth, He will punish you with a painful punishment, and replace you with another people, and you will not hurt Him in the least, and Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: (barring the polytheists with whom you have made a treaty, and who did not violate any [of its terms] with you, nor backed anyone against you. So fulfill the treaty with them until [the end of] its term. Indeed Allah loves the Godwary).

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you do not help him,1 then Allah has already helped him when the faithless expelled him, as one of two [refugees], when the two of them were in the cave, he said to his companion, 'Do not grieve; Allah is indeed with us.' Then Allah sent down His composure upon him, and strengthened him with hosts you did not see, and He made the word of the faithless the lowest; and the word of Allah is the highest; and Allah is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Go forth, whether [armed] lightly or heavily, and wage jihād with your possessions and persons in the way of Allah. That is better for you, should you know.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were it an accessible gain or a short journey, they would have surely followed you; but the distance seemed too far to them. Yet they will swear by Allah: 'If we could, we would have surely gone forth with you.' They [merely] destroy themselves. Allah knows that they are indeed liars.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: May Allah excuse you! Why did you grant them leave [to stay behind] before those who told the truth were evident to you and you had ascertained the liars?

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who believe in Allah and the Last Day do not ask you for leave [exempting them] from waging jihād with their possessions and their persons, and Allah knows best the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Only those seek a leave [of exemption] from you who do not believe in Allah and the Last Day, and whose hearts are in doubt, so they waver in their doubt.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had they desired to go forth, they would have surely made some preparations for it; but Allah was averse to arouse them, so He held them back, and it was said [to them], 'Be seated with those who sit back.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had they gone forth with you, they would have only added to your troubles, and they would have surely spread rumours in your midst, seeking to cause sedition among you. They have some spies among you, and Allah knows best the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They certainly sought to cause sedition earlier, and upset the matters for you, until the truth came and Allah's command prevailed, much as they were averse.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among them there are some who say, 'Give me leave, and do not put me to temptation.'1 Look! They have already fallen into temptation2 and indeed hell besieges the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then, when the sacred months have passed, kill the polytheists wherever you find them, capture them and besiege them, and lie in wait for them at every ambush. But if they repent, and maintain the prayer and give the zakāt, then let them alone. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If some good should befall you, it upsets them; but if an adversity befalls you, they say, 'We had already taken our precautions in advance,' and they go away exulting.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Nothing will befall us except what Allah has ordained for us. He is our master, and in Allah let all the faithful put their trust.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Do you await anything to befall us except one of the two excellences?1 But we await that Allah shall visit on you a punishment, from Him, or by our hands. So wait! We too are waiting along with you.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Spend willingly or unwillingly, it shall never be accepted from you; for you are indeed a transgressing lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Nothing stops their charities from being accepted except that they have no faith in Allah and His Apostle and do not perform the prayer but lazily, and do not spend but reluctantly.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So let not their wealth and children impress you: Allah only desires to punish them with these in the life of this world, and that their souls may depart while they are faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They swear by Allah that they belong to you,1 but they do not belong to you. Rather they are a frightened lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If they could find a refuge, or a hideout, or a hole [to creep into], they would turn to it in frantic haste.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There are some of them who blame you regarding [the distribution of] the charities: if they are given from them, they are pleased, but if they are not given from them, behold, they are displeased.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [It would have been better] if they had been pleased with what Allah and His Apostle gave them, and had said, 'Allah is sufficient for us; Allah will give to us out of His grace, and His Apostle. Indeed to Allah do we eagerly turn.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If any of the polytheists seeks asylum from you, grant him asylum until he hears the Word of Allah. Then convey him to his place of safety. That is because they are a people who do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Charities are only for the poor and the needy, and those employed to collect them, and those whose hearts are to be reconciled, and for [the freedom of] the slaves and the debtors, and in the way of Allah, and for the traveller. [This is] an ordinance from Allah, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among them are those who torment the Prophet, and say, 'He is an ear.'1 Say, 'An ear that is good for you. He has faith in Allah and trusts the faithful, and is a mercy for those of you who have faith.' As for those who torment the Apostle of Allah, there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They swear to you by Allah, to please you; but Allah and His Apostle are worthier that they should please Him, should they be faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they not know that whoever opposes Allah and His Apostle, there awaits him the Fire of hell, to remain in it [forever]? That is the great disgrace.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The hypocrites are apprehensive lest a sūrah should be sent down against them, informing them about what is in their hearts. Say, 'Go on deriding. Allah will indeed bring out what you are apprehensive of.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you question them [regarding their conduct], they will surely say, 'We were just gossiping and amusing ourselves.' Say, 'Were you deriding Allah, His signs, and His apostles?

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not make excuses. You have disbelieved after your faith.' If We forgive a group among you, We will punish another group, for they have been guilty.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The hypocrites, men and women, are all alike: they bid what is wrong and forbid what is right; and are tight-fisted.1 They have forgotten Allah, so He has forgotten them. The hypocrites are indeed the transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has promised the hypocrites, men and women, and the faithless, the Fire of hell, to remain in it [forever]. That suffices them. Allah has cursed them, and there is a lasting punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [Hypocrites! Your case is] similar to those who were before you, who were more powerful than you and more abounding in wealth and children: they enjoyed their share [of worldly existence]; you too enjoy your share, just like those who were before you enjoyed their share, and you have gossiped [impiously] as they gossiped. They are the ones whose works have failed in this world and the Hereafter; and it is they who are the losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How shall the polytheists have any [valid] treaty with Allah and His Apostle?! (Barring those with whom you made a treaty at the Holy Mosque; so long as they are steadfast with you, be steadfast with them. Indeed Allah loves the Godwary.)

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Has there not come to them the account of those who were before them —the people of Noah, 'Ād, and Thamūd, and the people of Abraham, the inhabitants of Midian, and the towns that were overturned?1 Their apostles brought them manifest proofs. So it was not Allah who wronged them, but it was they who used to wrong themselves.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But the faithful, men and women, are comrades of one another: they bid what is right and forbid what is wrong and maintain the prayer, give the zakāt, and obey Allah and His Apostle. It is they to whom Allah will soon grant His mercy. Indeed Allah is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has promised the faithful, men and women, gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them [forever], and good dwellings in the Gardens of Eden.1 Yet Allah's pleasure is greater [than all these]; that is the great success.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Prophet! Wage jihād against the faithless and the hypocrites, and be severe with them. Their refuge shall be hell, and it is an evil destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They swear by Allah that they did not say it. But they certainly did utter the word of unfaith and renounced faith after their islām. They contemplated what they could not achieve, and they were vindictive only because Allah and His Apostle had enriched them out of His grace. Yet if they repent, it will be better for them; but if they turn away, Allah shall punish them with a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter, and they shall not find on the earth any guardian or helper.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among them are those who made a pledge with Allah: 'If He gives us out of His grace, we will surely give the zakāt and we will surely be among the righteous.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But when He gave them out of His grace, they begrudged it and turned away, being disregardful.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So He caused hypocrisy to ensue in their hearts until the day they will encounter Him, because of their going back on what they had promised Allah and because of the lies they used to tell.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they not know that Allah knows their secret [thoughts] and [hears] their secret talks, and that Allah is knower of all that is Unseen?

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who blame the voluntary donors from among the faithful concerning the charities— and as for those who do not find [anything] except [what] their means [permit], they ridicule them— Allah shall put them to ridicule, and there is a painful punishment for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How? For if they get the better of you, they will observe toward you neither kinship nor covenant. They please you with their mouths while their hearts spurn you; and most of them are transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whether you plead forgiveness for them or do not plead forgiveness for them, even if you plead forgiveness for them seventy times, Allah shall never forgive them because they defied Allah and His Apostle; and Allah does not guide the transgressing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who were left behind1 exulted for their sitting back against [the command of] the Apostle of Allah,2 and were reluctant to wage jihād with their possessions and persons in the way of Allah, and they said, 'Do not go forth in this heat.' Say, The fire of hell is severer in heat, should they understand.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So let them laugh a little; much will they weep as a requital for what they used to earn.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If Allah brings you back [from the battlefront] to a group of them and they seek your permission to go forth, say, 'You shall never go forth with me, and you shall not fight with me against any enemy. You were indeed pleased to sit back the first time, so sit back with those who stay behind.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And never pray over any of them when he dies, nor stand at his graveside. They indeed defied Allah and His Apostle and died as transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Let not their possessions or their children impress you. Allah only desires to punish them with these in this world, and that their souls may depart while they are faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When a sūrah is sent down [declaring]: 'Have faith in Allah, and wage jihād along with His Apostle, the affluent among them ask you for leave, and say, 'Let us remain with those who sit back.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are pleased to be with those who stay back,1 and their hearts have been sealed. So they do not understand.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But the Apostle and the faithful who are with him wage jihād with their possessions and persons, and to such belong all the blessings, and it is they who are the felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has prepared for them gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them [forever]. That is the great success.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They have sold the signs of Allah for a paltry gain, and have barred [the people] from His way. Evil indeed is what they have been doing.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Some of the Bedouins who sought to be excused came so that they may be granted leave [to stay back]; while those who lied to Allah and His Apostle sat back. Soon there shall visit the faithless among them a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is no blame on the weak, nor on the sick, nor on those who do not find anything to spend, so long as they are sincere to Allah and His Apostle. There is no [cause for] blaming the virtuous, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Nor [is there any blame] on those to whom, when they came to you to provide them with a mount, you said, 'I do not find any mount for you,' and they turned back, their eyes flowing with tears, grieved because they did not find any means to spend.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
