item.description: The blame lies only on those who ask leave of you [to stay behind] though they are well-off. They are pleased to be with those who stay back; Allah has set a seal on their hearts, so they do not know [the outcome of their conduct].

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will offer you excuses when you return to them. Say, 'Do not make excuses; we will never believe you. Allah has informed us of your state of affairs. Allah and His Apostle will observe your conduct, then you will be returned to the Knower of the sensible and the Unseen, and He will inform you concerning what you used to do.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will swear to you by Allah, when you return to them, that you may leave them alone. So leave them alone. They are indeed filth, and their refuge shall be hell, a requital for what they used to earn.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They swear to you that you may be reconciled to them. But even if you are reconciled to them Allah shall not be reconciled to the transgressing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Bedouins are more obdurate in unfaith and hypocrisy, and more apt to be ignorant of the precepts that Allah has sent down to His Apostle, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among the Bedouins are those who regard what they spend as a loss, and they watch for a reversal of your fortunes. Theirs shall be an adverse turn of fortune, and Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:99 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yet among the Bedouins are [also] those who believe in Allah and the Last Day, and regard what they spend as [a means of attaining] nearness to Allah and the blessings of the Apostle. Look! It shall indeed bring them nearness, and Allah will admit them into His mercy. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tin:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the fig and the olive,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tin:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by Mount Sinai,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tin:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by this secure town:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tin:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We certainly created man in the best of forms;

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tin:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: then We relegated him to the lowest of the low,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tin:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except those who have faith and do righteous deeds. There will be an everlasting reward for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tin:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So what makes you deny the Retribution?

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tin:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is not Allah the fairest of all judges?

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the Mount [Sinai],

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the mountains move with an awful motion:

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: woe to the deniers on that day

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those who play around in vain talk,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the day when they will be shoved toward the fire of hell forcibly,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [and told:] 'This is the Fire which you used to deny!'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is this then magic, or is it you who do not perceive?

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Enter it, and whether you are patient or impatient it will be the same for you. You are only being requited for what you used to do.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and bliss,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: rejoicing because of what their Lord has given them, and that their Lord has saved them from the punishment of hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [They will be told:] 'Enjoy your food and drink, [as a reward] for what you used to do.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the Book inscribed

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will be reclining on arrayed couches, and We will wed them to big-eyed houris.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithful and their descendants who followed them in faith —We will make their descendants join them, and We will not stint anything from [the reward of] their deeds. Every man is a hostage to what he has earned.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We will provide them with fruits and meat, such as they desire.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There they will pass from hand to hand a cup wherein there will be neither any vain talk nor sinful speech.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will be waited upon by youths, their own, as if they were guarded pearls.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will turn to one another, questioning each other.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, 'Indeed, aforetime, we used to be apprehensive about our families.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But Allah showed us favour and He saved us from the punishment of the [infernal] miasma;

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: indeed we used to supplicate Him aforetime. Indeed He is the All-benign, the All-merciful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So admonish. By your Lord's blessing, you are not a soothsayer, nor mad.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: on an unrolled parchment;

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they say, '[He is] a poet, for whom we await a fatal accident'?

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Wait! I too am waiting along with you.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is it their intellect which prompts them to [say] this, or are they a rebellious lot?

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they say, 'He has improvised it [himself]?' Rather they have no faith!

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Let them bring a discourse like it, if they are truthful.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were they created from nothing? Or are they [their own] creators?

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather they have no certainty!

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they possess the treasuries of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of their dispensation]?

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they have a ladder [leading up to heaven] whereby they eavesdrop?1 If so let their eavesdropper produce a manifest authority.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Does He have daughters while you have sons?1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the House greatly frequented;1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you ask them for a reward, so that they are weighed down with debt?

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they have [access to] the Unseen, which they write down?

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they seek to outmaneuver [Allah]? But it is the faithless who are the outmaneuvered ones!

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they have any god other than Allah? Clear is Allah of any partners that they may ascribe [to Him]!

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were they to see a fragment falling from the sky, they would say, 'A cumulous cloud.'

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So leave them until they encounter their day on which they will be thunderstruck;

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the day when their guile will not avail them in any way, nor will they be helped.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed for those who do wrong, there is a punishment besides that, but most of them do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord, for indeed you fare before Our eyes. And celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise [at dawn],

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and also glorify Him during the night and at the receding of the stars.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the vault raised high,

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: by the surging sea:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: indeed your Lord's punishment will surely befall.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is none who can avert it.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On the day when the sky whirls violently,

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zalzala:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the earth is rocked with a terrible quake

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zalzala:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the earth discharges her burdens,

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zalzala:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and man says, 'What is the matter with her?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zalzala:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On that day she will relate her chronicles

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zalzala:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: for her Lord will have inspired her.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zalzala:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On that day, mankind will issue forth in various groups1 to be shown their deeds.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zalzala:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zalzala:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ḥā, Mīm.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He, who made the earth a cradle for you and made in it ways for you, so that you may be guided [to your destinations],

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and who sent down water from the sky in a measured manner, and We revived with it a dead country. (Likewise you [too] shall be raised [from the dead].)

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And who created all the kinds1 and made for you the ships and the cattle such as you ride,

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that you may sit on their backs, then remember the blessing of your Lord when you are settled on them, and say, 'Immaculate is He who has disposed this for us, and we [by ourselves] were no match for it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed we shall return to our Lord.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They ascribe to Him offspring1 from among His servants! Man is indeed a manifest ingrate.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did He adopt daughters from what He creates while He preferred you with sons?

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When one of them is brought the news of what he ascribes to the All-beneficent, his face becomes darkened1 and he chokes with suppressed agony, [and says]

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'What! One who is brought up amid ornaments and is inconspicuous in contests?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they have made the angels —who are servants of the All-beneficent— females. Were they witness to their creation? Their testimony will be written down and they shall be questioned.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the Manifest Book:

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'Had the All-beneficent wished, we would not have worshipped them.'1 They do not have any knowledge of that, and they do nothing but surmise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did We give them a Book before this, so that they are holding fast to it?

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather they say, 'We found our fathers following a creed, and we are indeed guided in their footsteps.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And so it has been that We did not send any warner to a town before you, without its affluent ones saying, 'We found our fathers following a creed and we are indeed following in their footsteps.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He would say, 'What! Even if I bring you a better guidance than what you found your fathers following?!' They would say, 'We indeed disbelieve in what you are sent with.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thereupon We took vengeance on them; so observe how was the fate of the deniers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Abraham said to his father and his people, 'I repudiate what you worship,

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: excepting Him who originated me; indeed He will guide me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And He made it1 a lasting word among his posterity so that they may come back [to the right path].

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather I provided for these1 and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a manifest apostle.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have made it an Arabic Qur'ān so that you may apply reason,

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But when the truth came to them, they said, 'This is magic, and we indeed disbelieve in it.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they said, 'Why was not this Qur'ān sent down to some great man from the two cities?'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is it they who dispense the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have dispensed among them their livelihood in the present life, and raised some of them above others in rank, so that some may take others into service, and your Lord's mercy is better than what they amass.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were it not [for the danger] that mankind would be one community,1 We would have surely made for those who defy the All-beneficent, silver roofs for their houses and [silver] stairways by which they ascend;

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and [silver] doors for their houses and [silver] couches on which they recline;

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and ornaments of gold;1 yet all that would be nothing but the wares of the life of this world, and the Hereafter near your Lord is for the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever turns a blind eye to1 the remembrance of the All-beneficent, We assign him a devil who remains his companion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed they1 bar them from the way while they suppose that they are [rightly] guided.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When he comes to Us, he will say, 'I wish there had been between me and you the distance between east and west! What an evil companion [are you]!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Today that1 will be of no avail to you. As you did wrong, so will you share in the punishment.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and indeed it is with Us in the Mother Book [and it is] surely sublime and wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Can you, then, make the deaf hear or guide the blind and someone who is in manifest error?

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Either We shall take you away —for We will indeed take vengeance on them—

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: or We shall show you what We have promised them, for indeed We hold them in Our power.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So hold fast to what has been revealed to you. Indeed you are on a straight path.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it is a reminder for you and for your people, and soon you will be questioned.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ask those of Our apostles We have sent before you:1 Did We set up any gods besides the All-beneficent to be worshipped?

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his elite. He said, 'I am indeed an apostle of the Lord of all the worlds.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But when he brought them Our signs, behold, they laughed at them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We did not show them a sign but it was greater than the other, and We seized them with punishment so that they might come back.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They would say, 'O magician! Invoke your Lord for us by the covenant He has made with you. We will indeed be guided.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Shall We withhold the Reminder from you unconcernedly, because you are a profligate lot?

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But when We lifted the punishment from them, behold, they would break their pledge.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And Pharaoh proclaimed amongst his people. He said, 'O my people! Does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me and these rivers that run at my feet? Do you not perceive?

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Am I not better than this humble1 one who cannot even speak clearly?

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Why have no bracelets of gold been cast upon him, nor have the angels come with him as escorts?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So he misled his people and they obeyed him. Indeed they were a transgressing lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when they roused Our wrath, We took vengeance on them and drowned them all.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus We made them the vanguard1 and an example for posterity.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the Son of Mary was cited as an example, behold, your people raise an outcry.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'Are our gods better or he?' They only cite him to you for the sake of contention. Rather they are a contentious lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He was just a servant whom We had blessed and made an exemplar for the Children of Israel.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How many a prophet We have sent to the ancients!

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had We wished We would have set in your stead angels to be [your] successors on the earth.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed he1 is a portent of the Hour; so do not doubt it and follow Me. This is a straight path.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not let Satan bar you [from the way of Allah]. Indeed he is your manifest enemy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Jesus brought the manifest proofs, he said, 'I have certainly brought you wisdom, and [I have come] to make clear to you some of the things that you differ about. So be wary of Allah and obey me.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah is my Lord and your Lord; so worship Him. This is a straight path.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But the factions differed among themselves. So woe to the wrongdoers for the punishment of a painful day.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they await anything but that the Hour should overtake them suddenly, while they are unaware?

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On that day, friends will be one another's enemies, except for the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [They will be told,] 'O My servants! Today you will have no fear, nor will you grieve.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who believed in Our signs and had been muslims.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There did not come to them any prophet but that they used to deride him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Enter paradise, you and your spouses, rejoicing'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: (they will be served around with golden dishes and goblets, and therein1 will be whatever the souls desire and eyes delight in) 'and you will remain in it [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is the paradise you have been given to inherit for what you used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Therein are abundant fruits for you from which you will eat.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the guilty will remain [forever] in the punishment of hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It will not be lightened for them and they will be despondent in it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not wrong them, but they themselves were wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will call out, 'O Mālik!1 Let your Lord finish us off!' He will say, 'Indeed you will stay on.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'We certainly brought you the truth, but most of you were averse to the truth.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they settled on some [devious] plan? Indeed We too are settling [on Our plans].

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We destroyed those who were stronger than these,1 and the example of the ancients has passed.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they suppose that We do not hear their secret thoughts and their secret talks? Yes indeed! And with them are Our messengers, writing down.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'If the All-beneficent had a son, I would have been the first to worship [him].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Clear is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, of whatever they allege [concerning Him]!

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So leave them to gossip and play until they encounter their day which they are promised.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who is God in the sky, and God on the earth; and He is the All-Wise, the All-Knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Blessed is He to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and with Him is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Him you will be brought back.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those whom they invoke besides Him have no power of intercession, except those who are witness to the truth and who know [for whom to intercede].

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you ask them, 'Who created them?' they will surely say, 'Allah.' Then where do they stray?

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And his1 plaint: 'My Lord! Indeed these are a people who will not have faith!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So disregard them, and say, 'Peace!' Soon they will know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you ask them, 'Who created the heavens and the earth?' they will surely say, 'The All-mighty, the All-knowing created them.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The [gradual] sending down of the Book is from Allah, the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, '[Allah declares:] "O My servants who have faith! Be wary of your Lord. For those who do good in this world there will be a good [reward], and Allah's earth is vast. Indeed the patient will be paid in full their reward without any reckoning." '

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Indeed I have been commanded to worship Allah with exclusive faith in Him,

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and I have been commanded to be the first of those who submit [to Him].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Indeed, should I disobey my Lord, I fear the punishment of a tremendous day.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, '[Only] Allah do I worship, putting my exclusive faith in Him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You worship whatever you wish besides Him.' Say, 'Indeed the losers are those who ruin themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection.' Look! That is a manifest loss!

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There will be canopies of fire above them, and [similar] canopies beneath them. With that Allah deters His servants. So, My servants, be wary of Me!

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who stay clear of the worship of the Rebel and turn penitently to Allah, there is good news for them. So give good news to My servants

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who listen to the word [of Allah] and follow the best [sense] of it. They are the ones whom Allah has guided, and it is they who possess intellect.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Can he against whom the word of punishment has become due?1 Can you rescue someone who is in the Fire?

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have sent down the Book to you with the truth; so worship Allah, putting exclusive faith1 in Him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But as for those who are wary of their Lord, for them there will be lofty abodes with [other] lofty abodes built above them, with streams running beneath them —a promise of Allah. Allah does not break His promise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not seen that Allah sends down water from the sky, then He conducts it through the ground as springs. Then with it He brings forth crops of diverse hues. Then they wither and you see them turn yellow. Then He turns them into chaff. There is indeed an admonition in that for those who possess intellect.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is someone whose breast Allah has opened to Islam so that he follows a light from His Lord?1 So woe to those whose hearts have been hardened to the remembrance of Allah. They are in manifest error.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has sent down the best of discourses, a scripture [composed] of similar1 motifs, whereat quiver the skins of those who fear their Lord, then their skins and hearts soften to Allah's remembrance. That is Allah's guidance, by which He guides whomever He wishes; and whomever Allah leads astray, has no guide.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What! Is someone who fends off with his face the terrible punishment [meted out to him] on the Day of Resurrection?1 And the wrongdoers will be told, 'Taste what you used to earn.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who were before them impugned [the apostles], whereat the punishment overtook them whence they were not aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So Allah made them taste disgrace in the life of the world, and the punishment of the Hereafter will surely be greater, had they known.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly we have drawn for mankind in this Qur'ān every [kind of] example, so that they may take admonition

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —an Arabic Qur'ān, without any deviousness, so that they may be Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah draws an example: a man jointly owned by several contending masters, and a man belonging entirely to one man: are the two equal in comparison?1 All praise belongs to Allah! But most of them do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Look! [Only] exclusive faith is worthy of Allah, and those who take guardians besides Him [claiming,] 'We only worship them so that they may bring us near to Allah,' Allah will indeed judge between them concerning that about which they differ. Indeed Allah does not guide someone who is a liar and an ingrate.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You will indeed die, and they [too] will die indeed.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then on the Day of Resurrection you will indeed contend before your Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So who is a greater wrongdoer than him who attributes a falsehood to Allah, and denies the truth when it reaches him? Is not the [final] abode of the faithless in hell?

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He who brings the truth and he who confirms it —it is they who are the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will have whatever they wish near their Lord. That is the reward of the virtuous,

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so that Allah may absolve them of the worst of what they did, and pay them their reward by the best of what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Does not Allah suffice [to defend] His servant? They1 would frighten you of others than Him. Yet whomever Allah leads astray, has no guide,

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and whomever Allah guides, there is no one who can lead him astray. Is not Allah an all-mighty avenger?

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you ask them, 'Who created the heavens and the earth?' they will surely say, 'Allah.' Say, 'Have you considered what you invoke besides Allah? Should Allah desire some distress for me, can they remove the distress visited by Him? Or should He desire some mercy for me, can they withhold His mercy?' Say, 'Allah is sufficient for me. In Him let all the trusting put their trust.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'O my people! Act according to your ability. I too am acting. Soon you will know

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had Allah intended to take a son, He could have chosen from those He has created whatever He wished. Immaculate is He! He is Allah, the One, the All-paramount.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who will be overtaken by a punishment that will disgrace him, and on whom a lasting punishment will descend.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have sent down the Book to you for [the deliverance of] mankind with the truth. So whoever is guided is guided for his own sake, and whoever goes astray, goes astray to his own detriment, and it is not your duty to watch over them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those who have not died in their sleep. Then He retains those for whom He has ordained death and releases the others until a specified time. There are indeed signs in that for a people who reflect.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they taken intercessors besides Allah? Say, 'What! Even though they have no control over anything and cannot apply reason?!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'All intercession rests with Allah. To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; then you will be brought back to Him.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Allah is mentioned alone, [thereat] shrink away the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter, but when others are mentioned besides Him, behold, they rejoice!

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'O Allah! Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the sensible and the Unseen, You will judge between Your servants concerning that about which they used to differ.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Even if the wrongdoers possessed all that is on the earth, and as much of it besides, they would surely offer it to redeem themselves with it from a terrible punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and there will appear to them from Allah what they had never reckoned.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The evils of what they had earned will appear to them, and they will be besieged by what they used to deride.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When distress befalls man, he supplicates Us. Then, when We grant him a blessing from Us, he says, 'I was given it by virtue of [my] knowledge.' Rather it is a test, but most of them do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He created the heavens and the earth with reason. He winds the night over the day, and winds the day over the night, and He has disposed the sun and the moon, each moving for a specified term.1 Look! He is the All-mighty, the All-forgiver!

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who were before them [also] said that, but what they used to earn did not avail them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So the evils of what they had earned visited them, and as for the wrongdoers among these, the evils of what they earn shall be visited on them and they will not thwart [Allah's might].

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they not know that Allah expands the provision for whomever He wishes and tightens it [for whomever He wishes]? There are indeed signs in that for a people who have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say [that Allah declares,] 'O My servants who have committed excesses against their own souls, do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed Allah will forgive all sins. Indeed He is the All-forgiving, the All-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Turn penitently to Him and submit to Him before the punishment overtakes you, whereupon you will not be helped.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And follow the best of what has been sent down to you from your Lord, before the punishment overtakes you suddenly while you are unaware.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Lest anyone should say, 'Alas for my negligence in the vicinage of Allah! Indeed I was among those who ridiculed.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Or say, 'Had Allah guided me I would have surely been among the Godwary!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Or say, when he sights the punishment, 'If only there had been a second chance for me I would be among the virtuous!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Yes, My signs certainly came to you, but you denied them and acted arrogantly and you were among the faithless.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He created you from a single soul, then made from it its mate, and He has sent down for you eight mates of the cattle.1 He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, in a threefold darkness. That is Allah, your Lord! To Him belongs all sovereignty. There is no god except Him. Then where are you being led away?

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On the Day of Resurrection you will see those who attributed lies to Allah with their faces blackened. Is not the [final] abode of the arrogant in hell?

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah will deliver those who were Godwary with their salvation. No ill shall touch them, nor will they grieve.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah is creator of all things, and He watches over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth, and those who disbelieve in the signs of Allah —it is they who are the losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Will you, then, bid me to worship other than Allah, O you senseless ones?!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly it has been revealed to you and to those [who have been] before you: 'If you ascribe a partner to Allah your works shall fail and you shall surely be among the losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather, worship Allah, and be among the grateful!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They do not regard Allah with the regard due to Him, yet the entire earth will be in His fist on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens, scrolled, in His right hand. Immaculate is He and exalted above [having] any partners that they ascribe [to Him].

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And the Trumpet will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens will swoon and whoever is on the earth, except whomever Allah wishes. Then it will be blown a second time, behold, they will rise up, looking on!

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And the earth will glow with the light of her Lord, and the Book1 will be set up, and the prophets and the martyrs2 will be brought, and judgment will be made between them with justice, and they will not be wronged.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you are ungrateful,1 indeed Allah has no need of you, though He does not approve ingratitude for His servants; and if you give thanks He approves that for you. No bearer shall bear another's burden; then to your Lord will be your return, whereat He will inform you concerning what you used to do. Indeed He knows best what is in the breasts.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Every soul will be recompensed fully for what it has done, and He is best aware of what they do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithless will be driven to hell in throngs. When they reach it, and its gates are opened, its keepers will say to them, 'Did there not come to you [any] apostles from among yourselves, reciting to you the signs of your Lord and warning you of the encounter of this day of yours?' They will say, 'Yes, but the word of punishment became due against the faithless.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It will be said, 'Enter the gates of hell to remain in it [forever]. Evil is the [ultimate] abode of the arrogant.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who are wary of their Lord will be led to paradise in throngs. When they reach it, and its gates are opened, its keepers will say to them, 'Peace be to you! You are welcome!1 Enter it to remain [forever].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, 'All praise belongs to Allah, who has fulfilled His promise to us and made us heirs to the earth, that we may settle in paradise wherever we may wish!' How excellent is the reward of the workers [of righteousness]!

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne, celebrating the praise of their Lord, and judgment will be made between them with justice, and it will be said, 'All praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When distress befalls man, he supplicates his Lord, turning to Him penitently. Then, when He grants him a blessing from Himself, he forgets that for which he had supplicated Him before,1 and sets up equals to Allah that he may lead [people] astray from His way. Say, 'Revel in your ingratitude2 for a while. Indeed you are among the inmates of the Fire.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is he who supplicates1 in the watches of the night, prostrating and standing, apprehensive of the Hereafter and expecting the mercy of his Lord …?2 Say, 'Are those who know equal to those who do not know?' Only those who possess intellect take admonition.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: All praise belongs to Allah, originator of the heavens and the earth, maker of the angels [His] messengers, possessing wings, two, three or four [of them]. He adds to the creation whatever He wishes. Indeed Allah has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever seeks honour1 [should know that] honour entirely belongs to Allah. To Him ascends the good word, and He elevates righteous conduct;2 as for those who devise evil schemes, there is a severe punishment for them, and their plotting shall come to naught.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah created you from dust, then from a drop of [seminal] fluid, then He made you mates.1 No female conceives or delivers except with His knowledge, and no elderly person advances in years, nor is anything diminished of his life, but it is [recorded] in a Book. That is indeed easy for Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Not alike are the two seas:1 this one sweet and agreeable, pleasant to drink, and that one briny and bitter, and from each you eat fresh meat and obtain ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through them, that you may seek of His grace, and so that you may give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He makes the night pass into the day and makes the day pass into the night, and He has disposed the sun and the moon, each moving for a specified term. That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs all sovereignty. As for those whom you invoke besides Him, they do not control so much as the husk of a date stone.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you invoke them they will not hear your invocation, and even if they heard they cannot respond to you, and on the Day of Resurrection they will forswear your polytheism, and none can inform you like the One who is all-aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O mankind! You are the ones who stand in need of Allah, and Allah—He is the All-sufficient, the All-laudable.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If He wishes, He will take you away, and bring about a new creation;

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and that is not a hard thing for Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No bearer shall bear another's burden, and should one heavily burdened call [another] to carry it, nothing of it will be carried, even if he were a near relative. You can only warn those who fear their Lord in secret and maintain the prayer. Whoever purifies himself, purifies only for his own sake, and to Allah is the return.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The blind one and the seer are not equal,

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whatever mercy Allah unfolds for the people, no one can withhold it; and whatever He withholds no one can release it after Him,1 and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: nor darkness and light;

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: nor shade and torrid heat;

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: nor are the living equal to the dead. Indeed Allah makes whomever He wishes to hear, and you cannot make those who are in the graves hear.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You are but a warner.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have sent you with the truth as a bearer of good news and as a warner; and there is not a nation but a warner has passed in it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If they impugn you, those before them have impugned [likewise]: their apostles brought them manifest proofs, [holy] writs, and illuminating scriptures.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then I seized the faithless. So how was My rebuttal!

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded that Allah sends down water from the sky, with which We produce fruits of diverse hues; and in the mountains are stripes white and red, of diverse hues, and [others] pitch black?

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And of humans and beasts and cattle there are likewise diverse hues. Only those of Allah's servants having knowledge fear Him. Indeed Allah is all-mighty, all-forgiving.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who recite the Book of Allah and maintain the prayer, and spend out of what We have provided them, secretly and openly, expect a commerce that will never go bankrupt,

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O mankind! Remember Allah's blessing upon you! Is there any creator other than Allah who provides for you from the sky and the earth? There is no god except Him. So where do you stray?

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so that He may pay them their reward in full and enhance them out of His grace. Indeed He is all-forgiving, all-appreciative.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That which We have revealed to you of the Book is the truth, confirming what was [revealed] before it. Indeed Allah is all-aware, all-seeing about His servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We made heirs to the Book1 those whom We chose from Our servants. Yet some of them are those who wrong themselves, and some of them are average, and some of them are those who take the lead in all the good works by Allah's will. That is the greatest grace [of Allah]!

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Gardens of Eden, which they will enter, adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearl, and their garments therein will be of silk.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, 'All praise belongs to Allah, who has removed all grief from us. Indeed Our Lord is all-forgiving, all-appreciative,

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who has settled us in the everlasting abode by His grace. In it we are untouched by toil, and untouched therein by fatigue.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the faithless there is for them the fire of hell: they will neither be done away with so that they may die, nor shall its punishment be lightened for them. Thus do We requite every ingrate.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They shall cry therein for help: 'Our Lord! Bring us out, so that we may act righteously —different from what we used to do!' 'Did We not give you a life long enough that one who is heedful might take admonition? And [moreover] the warner had [also] come to you. Now taste [the consequence of your deeds], for the wrongdoers have no helper.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah is the knower of the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. Indeed He knows well what is in the breasts.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who made you successors on the earth.1 So whoever is faithless, his unfaith is to his own detriment. And the unfaith of the faithless does not increase them with their Lord [in anything] except disfavour, and their unfaith increases the faithless in nothing except loss.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If they impugn you, certainly [other] apostles were impugned before you, and all matters are returned to Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Tell me about your partners [you ascribe to Allah] whom you invoke besides Allah? Show me what [part] of the earth have they created. Do they have any share in the heavens?' Have We given them a scripture so that they stand on a manifest proof thereof? Rather the wrongdoers do not promise one another [anything] except delusion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah sustains the heavens and the earth lest they should fall apart, and if they were to fall apart there is none who can sustain them except Him. Indeed He is all-forbearing, all-forgiving.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they1 swore by Allah with solemn oaths that if a warner were to come to them they would be better guided than any of the nations. But when a warner came to them it only increased them in aversion,

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: acting arrogantly in the land and devising evil schemes; and evil schemes beset only their authors. So do they await anything except the precedent of the ancients? Yet you will never find any change in Allah's precedent, and you will never find any revision in Allah's precedent.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not traveled over the land so that they may observe how was the fate of those who were before them? They were more powerful than them, and Allah is not to be thwarted by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed He is all-knowing, all-powerful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were Allah to take mankind to task because of what they have earned, He would not leave any living being on its back.1 But He respites them until a specified time, and when their time comes, Allah indeed sees best His servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O mankind! Allah's promise is indeed true. So do not let the life of the world deceive you, nor let the Deceiver deceive you concerning Allah.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Satan is indeed your enemy, so treat him as an enemy. He only invites his confederates so that they may be among the inmates of the Blaze.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is a severe punishment for the faithless, but for those who have faith and do righteous deeds there will be forgiveness and a great reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is someone the evil of whose conduct is presented as decorous to him, so he regards it as good….1 Indeed Allah leads astray whomever He wishes, and guides whomever He wishes. So do not fret yourself to death regretting for them. Indeed Allah knows best what they do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Faatir:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is Allah who sends the winds and they raise a cloud; then We drive it toward a dead land and with it revive the earth after its death. Likewise will be the resurrection [of the dead].

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ḥā, Mīm:

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He set in it firm mountains [rising] above it, and blessed it and ordained therein its [various] means of sustenance in four days, alike for all the seekers [of the means of sustenance].

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then He turned to the heaven, and it was smoke, and He said to it and to the earth, 'Come! Willingly or unwillingly!' They said, 'We come heartily.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then He set them up as seven heavens in two days, and revealed in each heaven its ordinance.1 We have adorned the lowest heaven with lamps, and guarded them.2 That is the ordaining of the All-mighty, the All-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they turn away, say, 'I warn you of a thunderbolt, like the thunderbolt of 'Ād and Thamūd.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the apostles came to them, before them and in their own time,1 saying, 'Worship no one except Allah!' They said, 'Had our Lord wished, He would certainly have sent down angels [to us]. We indeed disbelieve in what you have been sent with.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for [the people of] 'Ād, they acted arrogantly in the earth unduly, and they said, 'Who is more powerful than us?' Did they not see that Allah, who created them, is more powerful than them? They used to impugn Our signs;

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so We unleashed upon them an icy gale during ill-fated days, that We might make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the life of the world. Yet the punishment of the Hereafter is surely more disgraceful, and they will not be helped.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for [the people of] Thamūd, We guided them, but they preferred blindness to guidance. So the bolt of a humiliating punishment seized them because of what they used to earn.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We delivered those who had faith and were Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day when the enemies of Allah are marched out toward the Fire, and they shall be held in check.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A [gradually] sent down [revelation] from the All-beneficent, the All-merciful,

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they come to it, their hearing will bear witness against them and their sight and their skins concerning what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say to their skins, 'Why did you bear witness against us?' They will say, 'We were given speech by Allah, who gave speech to all things. He created you the first time, and to Him you are being brought back.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You did not use to conceal yourselves lest your hearing should bear witness against you, or [for that matter] your sight, or your skin, but you thought that Allah did not know most of what you did.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That misjudgment that you entertained about your Lord ruined you. So you became losers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Should they be patient, the Fire is their abode; and should they seek to propitiate, they will not be redeemed.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have assigned them companions who make to seem decorous to them whatever is before them1 and whatever is behind them,2 and the word became due against them,3 as it did against the nations that passed away before them of jinn and humans. They were indeed losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithless say, 'Do not listen to this Qur'ān and hoot it down so that you may prevail [over the Apostle].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We will surely make the faithless taste a severe punishment, and We will surely requite them by the worst of what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is the requital of the enemies of Allah —the Fire! In it they will have an everlasting abode, as a requital for their impugning Our signs.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithless will say, 'Our Lord! Show us those who led us astray from among jinn and humans so that we may trample them under our feet, so that they may be among the lowermost!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [this is] a Book whose signs have been elaborated, an Arabic Qur'ān, for a people who have knowledge,

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who say, 'Our Lord is Allah!' and then remain steadfast, the angels descend upon them, [saying,] 'Do not fear, nor be grieved! Receive the good news of the paradise which you have been promised.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We are your friends in the life of this world and in the Hereafter, and you will have in it whatever your souls desire, and you will have in it whatever you ask for,

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: as a hospitality from One all-forgiving, all-merciful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Who has a better call than him who summons to Allah and acts righteously and says, 'Indeed I am one of the muslims'?

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Good and evil [conduct] are not equal.1 Repel [evil] with what is best. [If you do so,] behold, he between whom and you was enmity, will be as though he were a sympathetic friend.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except the greatly endowed.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Should a temptation from Satan disturb you, seek the protection of Allah. Indeed He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among His signs are the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate to the sun, nor to the moon, but prostrate to Allah who created them, if it is Him that you worship.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they disdain [the worship of Allah], those who are near your Lord glorify Him night and day, and they are not wearied.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among His signs is that you see the earth desolate; but when We send down water upon it, it stirs and swells. Indeed He who revives it is the reviver of the dead. Indeed He has power over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: a bearer of good news and a warner. But most of them turn away [from it], [and] so they do not listen.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who commit sacrilege in Our signs are not hidden from Us. Is someone who is cast in the Fire better off, or someone who arrives safely on the Day of Resurrection? Act as you wish; indeed He sees best what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who defy the Reminder when it comes to them….1 Indeed it is an august Book:

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: falsehood cannot approach it, from before it nor from behind it, a [gradually] sent down [revelation] from One all-wise, all-laudable.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Nothing is said to you except what has already been said [earlier] to the apostles before you. Indeed your Lord is forgiving and One who metes out a painful retribution.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had We made it a non-Arabic1 Qur'ān, they2 would have surely said, 'Why have not its signs been articulated?' 'What! A non-Arabian [scripture]3 and an Arabian [prophet]!?'
