Say, 'For those who have faith, it is a guidance and healing; but as for those who are faithless, there is a deafness in their ears and it is lost to their sight.' They are [as if they were] called from a distant place.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We gave Moses the Book, but differences arose about it; and were it not for a prior decree of your Lord, judgement would have been made between them, for they are indeed in grave doubt concerning it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever acts righteously, it is for his own soul, and whoever does evil, it is to its detriment, and your Lord is not tyrannical to the servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On Him devolves the knowledge of the Hour, and no fruit emerges from its covering and no female conceives or delivers except with His knowledge. On the day when He will call out to them, 'Where are My partners?' They will say, 'We have apprised You that there is no witness amongst us.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What they used to invoke before has forsaken them, and they know there is no escape for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Man is never wearied of supplicating for good, and should any ill befall him, he becomes hopeless, despondent.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'Our hearts are in veils [which shut them off] from what you invite us to, and there is a deafness in our ears, and there is a curtain between us and you. So act [as your faith requires]; we too are acting [according to our own].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if We let him have a taste of Our mercy after distress has befallen him, he will surely say, 'This is my due! I do not think the Hour will ever set in, and in case I am returned to my Lord, I will indeed have the best [reward] with Him.' But We will surely inform the faithless about what they have done, and will surely make them taste a harsh punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When We bless man, he is disregardful and turns aside; but when an ill befalls him, he makes protracted supplications.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Tell me, if it is from Allah and you disbelieve in it, who will be more astray than someone who is in extreme defiance.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Soon We shall show them Our signs in the horizons and in their own souls until it becomes clear to them that He is the Real.1 Is it not sufficient that your Lord is witness to all things?

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Look! They are indeed in doubt about the encounter with their Lord! Look! He indeed comprehends all things!

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I am just a human being like you. It has been revealed to me that your God is the One God. So be steadfast toward Him and plead to Him for forgiveness.' And woe to the polytheists

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those who do not pay the zakāt and disbelieve in the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds, there will be an everlasting reward for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Fussilat:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Do you really disbelieve in Him who created the earth in two days,1 and ascribe partners to Him? That is the Lord of all the worlds!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Alif, Lām, Rā. [This is] a Book, whose signs have been made definitive1 and the elaborated2 from One [who is] all-wise, all-aware,

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if We let him have a taste of Our blessings after adversities have befallen him, he will surely say, 'All ills have left me.' Indeed he becomes an exultant braggart,

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:100 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These are from the accounts of the townships which We recount to you. Of them there are some that still stand, and some that have been mown down.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:101 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. Of no avail to them were their gods whom they would invoke besides Allah, in any wise, when your Lord's edict came, and they1 did not increase them in anything but ruin.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:102 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Such is the seizing of your Lord when He seizes the townships that are wrongdoing. Indeed His seizing is painful, severe.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:103 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is indeed a sign in that for him who fears the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a day on which all mankind will be gathered, and it is a day witnessed [by all creatures].

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:104 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We do not defer it but for a determinate term.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:105 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day it comes, no one shall speak except by His leave. [On that day,] some of them will be wretched and [some] felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:106 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the wretched, they shall be in the Fire: their lot therein will be groaning and wailing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:107 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They shall remain in it for as long as the heavens and the earth endure —except what your Lord may wish; indeed your Lord does whatever He desires.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:108 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the felicitous, they will be in paradise. They will remain in it for as long as the heavens and the earth endure —except what your Lord may wish— an endless bounty.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:109 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So do not be in doubt about what these1 worship: they worship just as their fathers worshiped before, and We shall surely pay them their full share, undiminished.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: excepting those who are patient and do righteous deeds. For such there will be forgiveness and a great reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:110 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We gave Moses the Book, but differences arose about it, and were it not for a prior decree of your Lord, a decision would have been made between them; indeed they are in grave doubt concerning it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:111 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your Lord will indeed recompense everyone fully for their works. Indeed He is well aware of what they do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:112 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So be steadfast, just as you have been commanded— [you] and whoever has turned [to Allah] with you— and do not overstep the bounds. Indeed He sees best what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:113 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And do not incline toward the wrongdoers, lest the Fire should touch you, and you will not have any friend besides Allah, then you will not be helped.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:114 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Maintain the prayer at the two ends of the day,1 and during the early hours of the night. Indeed good deeds efface misdeeds.2 That is an admonition for the mindful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:115 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And be patient; indeed Allah does not waste the reward of the virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:116 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Why were there not among the generations before you a remnant [of the wise] who might forbid corruption in the earth, except a few of those whom We delivered from among them? Those who were wrongdoers pursued that in which they had been granted affluence, and they were a guilty lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:117 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your Lord would never destroy the townships unjustly while their inhabitants were bringing about reform.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:118 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had your Lord wished, He would have made mankind one community; but they continue to differ,

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:119 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except those on whom your Lord has mercy —and that is why He created them— and the word of your Lord has been fulfilled: 'I will surely fill hell with jinn and humans, all together!'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [Look out] lest you should disregard aught of what has been revealed to you, and be upset because they say, 'Why has not a treasure been sent down to him, or [why does] not an angel accompany him?' You are only a warner, and Allah watches over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:120 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whatever We relate to you of the accounts of the apostles are those by which We strengthen your heart, and there has come to you in this [sūrah] the truth and an advice and admonition for the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:121 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And say to those who do not have faith, 'Act according to your ability; we too are acting.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:122 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And wait! We too are waiting.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:123 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belongs the Unseen of the heavens and the earth, and to Him all matters are returned. So worship Him and trust in Him. Your Lord is not oblivious of what you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they say, 'He has fabricated it?' Say, 'Then bring ten _sūrah_s like it, fabricated, and invoke whomever you can, besides Allah, should you be truthful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they do not respond to you, know that it has been sent down by Allah's knowledge, and that there is no god except Him. Will you, then, submit [to Allah]?

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who desire the life of this world and its glitter, We will recompense them fully for their works therein, and they shall not be underpaid in it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are the ones for whom there shall be nothing in the Hereafter but Fire: what they had accomplished in the world has failed, and their works have come to naught.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is he who stands on a manifest proof from his Lord, and whom a witness of his own [family] follows?1 And before him2 there was the Book of Moses, a guide and mercy. It is they who have faith in it, and whoever defies him from among the factions, the Fire is their tryst. So do not be in doubt about it; it is the truth from your Lord, but most people do not have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And who is a greater wrongdoer than him who fabricates a lie against Allah? They shall be presented before their Lord, and the witnesses will say, 'It is these who lied against their Lord.' Look! The curse of Allah is upon the wrongdoers

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those who bar [others] from the way of Allah, and seek to make it crooked, and disbelieve in the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: declaring: 'Worship no one but Allah. I am indeed a warner from Him to you and a bearer of good news.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They cannot thwart [Allah] on the earth, nor do they have besides Allah any guardian. For them the punishment shall be doubled, for they could neither listen, nor did they use to see.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are the ones who have ruined their souls, and what they used to fabricate has forsaken them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Undoubtedly, they are the ones who will be the biggest losers in the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who have faith and do righteous deeds and are humble before their Lord —they shall be the inhabitants of paradise, and they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The parable of the two parties is that of one who is blind and deaf and one who sees and hears. Are they equal in comparison? Will you not then take admonition?

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We sent Noah to his people [to declare]: 'Indeed I am a manifest warner to you,

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Worship none but Allah. Indeed I fear for you the punishment of a painful day.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But the elite of the faithless from among his people said, 'We do not see you to be anything but a human being like ourselves, and we do not see anyone following you except those who are simpleminded riffraff from our midst. Nor do we see that you have any merit over us. Rather we consider you to be liars.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'O my people! Tell me, should I stand on a manifest proof from my Lord, and He has granted me His own mercy —though it should be invisible to you— shall we force it upon you while you are averse to it?

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O my people! I do not ask you any material reward for it. My reward lies only with Allah. But I will not drive away those who have faith. Indeed they will encounter their Lord. But I see that you are an ignorant lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Plead with your Lord for forgiveness, then turn to Him penitently. He will provide you with a good provision for a specified term and grant His grace to every meritorious person. But if you turn your backs [on Him], indeed I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O my people! Who would come to my help against Allah were I to drive them away? Will you not then take admonition?

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I do not say to you that I possess the treasuries of Allah, neither do I know the Unseen. I do not claim to be an angel, neither do I say of those who are despicable in your eyes that Allah will not grant them any good —Allah knows best what is in their hearts— for then I would indeed be a wrongdoer.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'O Noah, you have disputed with us already, and you have disputed with us exceedingly. Now bring us what you threaten us with should you be truthful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Allah will indeed bring it on you if He wishes, and you cannot thwart [Him].

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: My exhorting will not benefit you, much as I may seek to exhort you, if Allah desires to consign you to perversity. He is your Lord, and to Him you shall be brought back.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they say, 'He has fabricated it?' Say, 'Should I have fabricated it, then my guilt will be upon me, and I am absolved of your guilty conduct.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It was revealed to Noah: 'None of your people will believe except those who already have faith; so do not sorrow for what they used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Build the ark before Our eyes and by Our revelation, and do not plead with Me for those who are wrongdoers: they shall indeed be drowned.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As he was building the ark, whenever the elders of his people passed by him, they would ridicule him. He said, 'If you ridicule us [today], we shall ridicule you [tomorrow] just as you ridicule us [now].

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Soon you will know whom a disgraceful punishment will overtake and on whom a lasting punishment will descend.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah will be your return, and He has power over all things.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Our edict came and the oven gushed [a stream of water], We said, 'Carry in it a pair1 of every kind [of animal], along with your family —except those [of them] against whom the edict has already been given— and those who have faith.' And none believed with him except a few.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Board it: In the Name of Allah it shall set sail and cast anchor. Indeed my Lord is all-forgiving, all-merciful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And it sailed along with them amid waves [rising] like mountains. Noah called out to his son, who stood aloof, 'O my son! 'Board with us, and do not be with the faithless!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'I shall take refuge on a mountain; it will protect me from the flood.' He said, 'There is none today who can protect from Allah's edict, except someone upon whom He has mercy.' Then the waves came between them, and he was among those who were drowned.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then it was said, 'O earth, swallow your water! O sky, leave off!' The waters receded; the edict was carried out, and it1 settled on [Mount] Judi. Then it was said, 'Away with the wrongdoing lot!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Noah called out to his Lord, and said, 'My Lord! My son is indeed from my family. Your promise is indeed true, and You are the fairest of all judges.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Said He, 'O Noah! Indeed He is not of your family. Indeed he is [personification of] unrighteous conduct. So do not ask Me [something] of which you have no knowledge. I advise you lest you should be among the ignorant.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord! I seek Your protection lest I should ask You something of which I have no knowledge. If You do not forgive me and have mercy upon me I shall be among the losers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It was said, 'O Noah! Disembark in peace from Us and with [Our] blessings upon you and upon nations [to descend] from those who are with you, and nations whom We shall provide for, then a painful punishment from Us shall befall them.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These are accounts of the Unseen which We reveal to you. Neither you nor your people used to know them before this. So be patient. Indeed the outcome will be in favour of the Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Look! They fold up their breasts1 to hide [their secret feelings] from Him. Look! When they draw their cloaks over their heads,2 He knows whatever they keep secret and whatever they disclose. Indeed He knows best whatever is in the breasts.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And to 'Ād [We sent] Hūd, their brother. He said, 'O my people! Worship Allah. You have no other god besides Him: you merely fabricate [the deities that you worship].

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'O my people! I do not ask you any reward for it. My reward lies only with Him who originated me. Do you not apply reason?

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'O my people! Plead with your Lord for forgiveness, then turn to Him penitently: He will send copious rains for you from the sky, and add power to your [present] power. So do not turn your backs [on Him] as guilty ones.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'O Hūd, you have not brought us any manifest proof. We are not going to abandon our gods for what you say, and we are not going to believe you.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: All we say is that some of our gods have visited you with some evil.' He said, 'I call Allah to witness —and you too be [my] witnesses— that I repudiate what you take as [His] partners

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: besides Him. Now try out your stratagems against me, together, without granting me any respite.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed I have put my trust in Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is no living being but He holds it by its forelock. Indeed my Lord is on a straight path.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if you turn your backs [on me], then [know that] I have communicated to you whatever I was sent to you with. My Lord will make another people succeed you, and you will not hurt Allah in the least. Indeed my Lord is watchful over all things.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when Our edict came, We delivered Hūd and the faithful who were with him, by a mercy from Us, and We delivered them from a harsh punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Such were [the people of] 'Ād: they impugned the signs of their Lord and disobeyed His apostles, and followed the dictates of every obdurate tyrant.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is no animal on the earth, but that its sustenance lies with Allah, and He knows its [enduring] abode and its temporary place of lodging. Everything is in a manifest Book.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So they were pursued by a curse in this world and on the Day of Resurrection. Look! Indeed 'Ād defied their Lord. Look! Away with 'Ād, the people of Hud!

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And to Thamūd [We sent] Ṣāliḥ, their brother. He said, 'O my people! Worship Allah. You have no other god besides Him. He brought you forth from the earth and made it your habitation. So plead with Him for forgiveness, then turn to Him penitently. My Lord is indeed nearmost [and] responsive.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'O Ṣāliḥ! You were a source of hope to us before this. Do you forbid us to worship what our fathers have been worshiping? Indeed we have grave doubts concerning that to which you invite us.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'O my people! Tell me, should I stand on a manifest proof from my Lord, and He has granted me His own mercy, who will protect me from Allah should I disobey Him? For then you will increase me in nothing but loss.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O my people! This she-camel of Allah is a sign for you. Let her graze [freely] in Allah's land, and do not cause her any harm, for then you shall be seized by a prompt punishment.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But they hamstrung her, whereupon he said, 'Enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days: that is a promise not to be belied!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when Our edict came, We delivered Ṣāliḥ and the faithful who were with him by a mercy from Us, and from the [punishment and] disgrace of that day. Your Lord is indeed the All-strong, the All-mighty.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Cry seized those who were wrongdoers, and they lay lifeless prostrate in their homes,

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: as if they had never lived there. Look! Indeed Thamūd defied their Lord. Look! Away with Thamūd!

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly Our messengers came to Abraham with the good news, and said, 'Peace!' 'Peace!' He replied. Presently he brought [for them] a roasted calf.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days —and His Throne was [then] upon the waters— that He may test you [to see] which of you is best in conduct. Yet if you say, 'You will indeed be raised up after death,' the faithless will surely say, 'This is nothing but plain magic.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But when he saw their hands not reaching for it, he took them amiss and felt a fear of them. They said, 'Do not be afraid. We have been sent to the people of Lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: His wife, standing by, laughed as We gave her the good news of [the birth of] Isaac, and of Jacob, after Isaac.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: She said, 'Oh, my! Shall I, an old woman, bear [children], and [while] this husband of mine is an old man?! That is indeed an odd thing!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Are you amazed at Allah's dispensation? [That is] Allah's mercy and His blessings upon you, members of the household. Indeed He is all-laudable, all-glorious.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when the awe had left Abraham and the good news had reached him, he pleaded with Us concerning the people of Lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Abraham was indeed most forbearing, plaintive, [and] penitent.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'O Abraham, let this matter alone! Your Lord's edict has certainly come, and an irrevocable punishment shall overtake them.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Our messengers came to Lot, he was distressed on their account and in a predicament for their sake, and he said, 'This is a terrible day!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then his people came running toward him, and they had been committing vices aforetime. He said, 'O my people, these are my daughters: they are purer for you.1 Be wary of Allah and do not humiliate me with regard to my guests. Is there not a right-minded man among you?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'You certainly know that we have no interest in your daughters, and indeed you know what we want.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if We defer their punishment until a certain time, they will surely say, 'What holds it back?' Look! On the day it overtakes them it shall not be turned away from them, and they will be besieged by what they used to deride.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'If only I had the power to deter you, or could take refuge in a mighty support!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'O Lot, we are messengers of your Lord. They will never get at you. Set out with your family in a watch of the night; and none of you shall turn round, except your wife; indeed she will be struck by what strikes them. Indeed their tryst is the dawn. Is not the dawn [already] near?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when Our edict came, We made its1 topmost part its nethermost, and We rained on it stones of laminar shale,

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: marked1 with your Lord [for the profligate],2 never far from the wrongdoers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And to Midian [We sent] Shu'ayb, their brother. He said, 'O my people! Worship Allah. You have no other god besides Him. Do not diminish the measure or the balance. Indeed I see that you are faring well, but I fear for you the punishment of an all-embracing day.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'O my people! Observe fully the measure and the balance, with justice, and do not cheat the people of their goods,1 and do not act wickedly on the earth, causing corruption.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'What remains of Allah's provision1 is better for you, should you be faithful, and I am not a keeper over you.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'O Shu'ayb, does your worship require that we abandon what our fathers have been worshiping, or that we should not do with our wealth whatever we wish? You are indeed [a] gentle and sensible [person].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'O my people! Have you considered, should I stand on a manifest proof from my Lord, who has provided me a good provision from Himself?1 I do not wish to oppose you by what I forbid you. I only desire to put things in order, as far as I can, and my success lies only with Allah: in Him I have put my trust, and to Him I turn penitently.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O my people, do not let your defiance toward me lead you to be visited by the like of what was visited on the people of Noah, or the people of Hūd, or the people of Ṣāliḥ, and the people of Lot are not distant from you.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If We let man taste a mercy from Us, and then withdraw it from him, he becomes despondent, ungrateful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Plead with your Lord for forgiveness, then turn to Him penitently. My Lord is indeed all-merciful, all-affectionate.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'O Shu'ayb, we do not understand much of what you say. Indeed we see you are weak amongst us, and were it not for your tribe, we would have stoned you, and you are not venerable to us.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'O my people! Is my tribe more venerable in your sight than Allah, to whom you pay no regard? Indeed my Lord comprehends whatever you do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O my people! Act according to your ability; I too am acting. Soon you will know who will be overtaken by a punishment that will disgrace him, and who is a liar. So be on the watch; I too will be watching along with you.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when Our edict came, We delivered Shu'ayb and the faithful who were with him by a mercy from Us. And the Cry seized those who were wrongdoers, whereat they lay lifeless prostrate in their homes,

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: as if they had never lived there. Look! Away with Midian! —just as Thamūd was done away with!

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We sent Moses with Our signs and a manifest authority

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: to Pharaoh and his elite, but they followed Pharaoh's dictates, and Pharaoh's dictates were not right-minded.

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On the Day of Resurrection he will lead his people and conduct them into the Fire: an evil goal for the incoming!1

item.title: bil-Quran: Hud:99 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They were pursued by a curse in this [world], as well as on the Day of Resurrection; evil is the award conferred [upon them]!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Alif, Lām, Rā. [This is] a Book We have sent down to you that you may bring mankind out from darkness into light, by the command of their Lord, to the path of the All-mighty, the All-laudable

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Their apostles said, 'Is there any doubt about Allah, the originator of the heavens and the earth?! He calls you to forgive you a part of your sins, and grants you respite until a specified time.'1 They said, 'You are nothing but humans like us who desire to bar us from what our fathers used to worship. So bring us a manifest authority.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Their apostles said to them, 'Indeed we are just human beings like yourselves; but Allah favours whomever of His servants that He wishes. We may not bring you an authority except by Allah's leave, and in Allah let all the faithful put their trust.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And why should we not put our trust in Allah, seeing that He has guided us in our ways? Surely, we will put up patiently with whatever torment you may inflict upon us, and in Allah let all the trusting put their trust.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But the faithless said to their apostles, 'Surely we will expel you from our land, or you should revert to our creed.' Thereat their Lord revealed to them: 'We will surely destroy the wrongdoers,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and surely We will settle you in the land after them. This [promise] is for someone who is awed to stand before Me and fears My threat.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They1 prayed for victory2 [against the infidels], and every obdurate tyrant has failed,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: with hell lying ahead of him,1 [where] he shall be given to drink of a purulent fluid,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: gulping it down, but hardly swallowing it: death will assail him from every side, but he will not die, and there is [yet] a harsh punishment ahead of him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A parable of those who defy their Lord: their deeds are like ashes over which the wind blows hard on a tempestuous day: they have no power over anything they have earned. That is extreme error.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded that Allah created the heavens and the earth with reason? If He wishes, He will take you away, and bring about a new creation,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And woe to the faithless for a severe punishment

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and that is not a hard thing for Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Together they will be presented before Allah. Then those who were weak will say to those who were arrogant, 'Indeed we were your followers. So will you avail us against Allah's punishment in any wise?' They will say, 'Had Allah guided us, surely we would have guided you. It is the same to us whether we are restless or patient: there is no escape for us.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the matter is all over, Satan will say, 'Indeed Allah made you a promise that was true and I [too] made you a promise, but I failed you. I had no authority over you, except that I called you and you responded to me. So do not blame me, but blame yourselves. I cannot respond to your distress calls, neither can you respond to my distress calls. Indeed I disavow your taking me for [Allah's] partner aforetime. There is indeed a painful punishment for the wrongdoers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who have faith and do righteous deeds will be admitted into gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them [forever], by the leave of their Lord. Their greeting therein will be 'Peace!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded how Allah has drawn a parable? A good word is like a good tree: its roots are steady and its branches are in the sky.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It gives its fruit every season by the leave of its Lord. Allah draws these parables for mankind so that they may take admonition.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And the parable of a bad word is that of a bad tree: uprooted from the ground, it has no stability.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah fortifies those who have faith with an immutable word in the life of this world and in the Hereafter, and Allah leads astray the wrongdoers, and Allah does whatever He wishes.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded those who have changed Allah's blessing with ingratitude, and landed their people in the house of ruin?

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —hell, which they shall enter, and it is an evil abode!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —those who prefer the life of this world to the Hereafter, and bar [others] from the way of Allah, and seek to make it crooked. They are in extreme error.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They have set up equals to Allah, to lead [people] astray from His way. Say, 'Enjoy [for a while], for indeed your destination is hellfire!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Tell My servants who have faith to maintain the prayer and to spend out of what We have provided them with, secretly and openly, before there comes a day on which there will be neither any bargaining nor friendship.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is Allah who created the heavens and the earth, and He sends down water from the sky and with it He brings forth crops for your sustenance. And He disposed the ships for you[r benefit] so that they may sail at sea by His command, and He disposed the rivers for you.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He disposed the sun and the moon for you, constant [in their courses], and He disposed the night and the day,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and He gave you all that you had asked Him.1 If you enumerate Allah's blessings, you will not be able to count them. Indeed man is most unfair and ungrateful!

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Abraham said, 'My Lord! Make this city a sanctuary, and save me and my children from worshiping idols.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: My Lord! Indeed they have misled many people. So whoever follows me indeed belongs to me, and as for someone who disobeys me, well, You are indeed all-forgiving, all-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Our Lord! I have settled part of my descendants in a barren valley, by Your sacred House, our Lord, that they may maintain the prayer. So make the hearts of a part of the people fond of them, and provide them with fruits, so that they may give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Our Lord! Indeed You know whatever we hide and whatever we disclose, and nothing is hidden from Allah on the earth or in the sky.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: All praise belongs to Allah, who, despite [my] old age, gave me Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed my Lord hears all supplications.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not send any apostle except with the language of his people, so that he might make [Our messages] clear to them. Then Allah leads astray whomever He wishes, and He guides whomsoever He wishes, and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: My Lord! Make me a maintainer of the prayer, and my descendants [too]. Our Lord, accept my supplication.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents, and all the faithful, on the day when the reckoning is held.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not suppose that Allah is oblivious to what the wrongdoers are doing. He is only granting them respite until the day when the eyes will be glazed.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Scrambling with their heads upturned, there will be a fixed gaze in their eyes and their hearts will be vacant.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Warn the people of the day when the punishment will overtake them, whereat the wrongdoers will say, 'Our Lord! Respite us for a brief while so that we may respond to Your call, and follow the apostles.'1 [They will be told,] 'Did you not use to swear earlier that there would be no reverse for you,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: while you dwelt in the dwellings of those who had wronged themselves [before], and it had been made clear to you how We had dealt with them [before you], and We had [also] cited examples for you?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They certainly devised their schemes, but their schemes are known to Allah, and their schemes are not such as to dislodge the mountains.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So do not suppose that Allah will break His promise to His apostles. Indeed Allah is all-mighty, avenger.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day the earth is transformed into another earth and the heavens [as well], and they are presented before Allah, the One, the All-paramount.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On that day you will see the guilty bound together in chains,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We sent Moses with Our signs: 'Bring your people out from darkness into light and remind them of Allah's [holy] days. There are indeed signs in that for every patient and grateful [servant].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: their garments made of pitch,1 and the Fire covering their faces,

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so that Allah may reward every soul for what it has earned.1 Indeed Allah is swift at reckoning.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is a proclamation for mankind, so that they may be warned thereby and know that He is indeed the One God, and those who possess intellect may take admonition.

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Moses said to his people, 'Remember Allah's blessing upon you when He delivered you from Pharaoh's clan who inflicted a terrible torment on you, and slaughtered your sons and spared your women, and in that there was a great test from your Lord.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely enhance you [in blessing], but if you are ungrateful, My punishment is indeed severe.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And Moses said, 'Should you be faithless —you and everyone on the earth, all together— indeed Allah is all-sufficient, all-laudable.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Ibrahim:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Has there not come to you the account of those who were before you —the people of Noah, 'Ād and Thamūd, and those who were after them, whom no one knows [well] except Allah? Their apostles brought them manifest proofs, but they did not respond to them,1 and said, 'We disbelieve in what you have been sent with. Indeed we have grave doubts concerning that to which you invite us.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Alif, Lām, Mīm.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He created the heavens without any pillars that you may see, and cast firm mountains in the earth lest it should shake with you, and He has scattered in it every kind of animal. And We sent down water from the sky and caused every splendid kind [of plant] to grow in it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is the creation of Allah. Now show Me what others besides Him have created. Rather the wrongdoers are in manifest error!

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We gave Luqman wisdom, saying, 'Give thanks to Allah; and whoever gives thanks, gives thanks only for his own sake. And whoever is ungrateful, [let him know that] Allah is indeed all-sufficient, all-laudable.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Luqman said to his son, as he advised him: 'O my son! Do not ascribe any partners to Allah. Polytheism is indeed a great injustice.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have enjoined man concerning his parents: His mother carried him through weakness upon weakness, and his weaning takes two years. Give thanks to Me and to your parents. To Me is the return.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if they urge you to ascribe to Me as partner that of which you have no knowledge, then do not obey them. Keep their company honourably in this world and follow the way of him who turns to Me penitently. Then to Me will be your return, whereat I will inform you concerning what you used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'O my son! Even if it should be the weight of a mustard seed, and [even though] it should be in a rock, or in the heavens, or in the earth, Allah will produce it. Indeed Allah is all-attentive, all-aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O my son! Maintain the prayer and bid what is right and forbid what is wrong, and be patient through whatever may visit you. That is indeed the steadiest of courses.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not turn your cheek disdainfully from the people, and do not walk exultantly on the earth. Indeed Allah does not like any swaggering braggart.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Be modest in your bearing, and lower your voice. Indeed the ungainliest of voices is the donkey's voice.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These are the signs of the Definitive Book,

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do you not see that Allah has disposed for you whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth and He has showered upon you His blessings, the outward and the inward? Yet among the people are those who dispute concerning Allah without any knowledge or guidance or an illuminating scripture.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they are told, 'Follow what Allah has sent down,' they say, 'We will rather follow what we found our fathers following.' What! Even if Satan be calling them to the punishment of the Blaze?

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever surrenders his heart to Allah and is virtuous, has certainly held fast to the firmest handle, and with Allah lies the outcome of all matters.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who are faithless, let their faithlessness not grieve you. To Us will be their return, and We will inform them about what they have done. Indeed Allah knows best what is in the breasts.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We will provide for them for a short time, then We will shove them toward a harsh punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you ask them, 'Who created the heavens and the earth?' they will surely say, 'Allah.' Say, 'All praise belongs to Allah!' Yet most of them do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Indeed Allah is the All-sufficient, the All-laudable.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If all the trees on the earth were pens, and the sea replenished with seven more seas [were ink], the words of Allah would not be spent. Indeed Allah is all-mighty, all-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Your creation and your resurrection are not but as of a single soul. Indeed Allah is all-hearing, all-seeing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded that Allah makes the night pass into the day and makes the day pass into the night; and He has disposed the sun and the moon, each moving for a specified term, and that Allah is well aware of what you do?

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: a guidance and mercy for the virtuous,

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is because Allah is the Reality,1 and whatever they invoke besides Him is nullity,2 and because Allah is the All-exalted, the All-great.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded that the ships sail at sea by Allah's blessing, that He may show you some of His signs? There are indeed signs in that for every patient and grateful [servant].

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When waves cover them like awnings, they invoke Allah, putting exclusive faith in Him. But when He delivers them towards land, [only] some of them remain unswerving. And no one will impugn Our signs except an ungrateful traitor.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O mankind! Be wary of your Lord and fear the day when a father shall not atone for his child, nor the child shall atone for its father in any wise. Indeed Allah's promise is true. So do not let the life of the world deceive you, nor let the Deceiver1 deceive you concerning Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the knowledge of the Hour is with Allah. He sends down the rain, and He knows what is in the wombs. No soul knows what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul knows in what land it will die. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who maintain the prayer, and pay the zakāt, and are certain of the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those follow their Lord's guidance, and it is they who are the felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Among the people is he who buys diversionary talk that he may lead [people] astray from Allah's way without any knowledge, and he takes it in derision. For such there is a humiliating punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when Our signs are recited to him he turns away disdainfully as if he had not heard them [at all], as if there were a deafness in his ears. So inform him of a painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds, for them will be gardens of bliss,

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: to remain in them [forever] —a true promise of Allah, and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Kāf, Hā, Yā, 'Ayn, Ṣād.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord! Appoint a sign for me.' He said, 'Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three complete nights.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So he emerged before his people from the Temple, and signaled to them that they should glorify [Allah] morning and evening.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'O John!' [We said,] 'Hold on with power to the Book!' And We gave him judgement while still a child,

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and a compassion and purity from Us. He was Godwary,

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and good to his parents, and was not self-willed or disobedient.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Peace be to him, the day he was born, and the day he dies, and the day he is raised alive!

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And mention in the Book Mary, when she withdrew from her family to an easterly place.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus did she seclude herself from them, whereupon We sent to her Our Spirit1 and he became incarnate for her as a well-proportioned human.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: She said, 'I seek the protection of the All-beneficent from you, should you be Godwary!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'I am only a messenger of your Lord that I may give you a pure son.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [This is] an account1 of your Lord's mercy on His servant, Zechariah,

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: She said, 'How shall I have a child seeing that no human being has ever touched me, nor have I been unchaste?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'So shall it be. Your Lord says, "It is simple for Me." And so that We may make him a sign for mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is a matter [already] decided.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus she conceived him, then withdrew with him to a distant place.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The birth pangs brought her to the trunk of a date palm. She said, 'I wish I had died before this and become a forgotten thing, beyond recall.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thereupon he1 called her from below her [saying,] 'Do not grieve! Your Lord has made a spring to flow at your feet.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Shake the trunk of the palm tree, freshly picked dates will drop upon you.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Eat, drink, and be comforted. Then if you see any human, say, "Indeed I have vowed a fast to the All-beneficent, so I will not speak to any human today." '

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then carrying him she brought him to her people. They said, 'O Mary, you have certainly come up with an odd thing!

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O sister of Aaron['s lineage]! Your father was not an evil man, nor was your mother unchaste.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thereat she pointed to him. They said, 'How can we speak to one who is yet a baby in the cradle?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when he called out to his Lord with a secret cry.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Indeed I am a servant of Allah! He has given me the Book and made me a prophet.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He has made me blessed, wherever I may be, and He has enjoined me to [maintain] the prayer and to [pay] the zakāt as long as I live,

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and to be good to my mother, and He has not made me self-willed and wretched.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Peace is to me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I am raised alive.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is Jesus, son of Mary, a Word of the Real concerning whom they are in doubt.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is not for Allah to take a son. Immaculate is He! When He decides on a matter, He just says to it, 'Be!' and it is.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Indeed Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a straight path.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But the factions differed among themselves. So woe to the faithless at the scene of a tremendous day.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How well they will hear and how well they will see on the day when they come to Us! But today the wrongdoers are in manifest error.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Warn them of the Day of Regret,1 when the matter will be decided, while they are [yet] heedless and do not have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord! Indeed my bones have become feeble, and my head has turned white with age, yet never have I, my Lord, been disappointed in supplicating You!

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We shall inherit the earth and whoever there is on it, and to Us they shall be brought back.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And mention in the Book Abraham. Indeed he was a truthful one, a prophet.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When he said to his father, 'Father! Why do you worship that which neither hears nor sees, and is of no avail to you in any way?

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Father! Indeed a knowledge has already come to me which has not come to you. So follow me that I may guide you to a right path.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Father! Do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan is disobedient to the All-beneficent.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Father! I am indeed afraid that a punishment from the All-beneficent will befall you, and you will become Satan's accomplice.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Abraham! Are you renouncing my gods? If you do not relinquish, I will stone you. Keep away from me for a long while.'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Peace be to you! I shall plead with my Lord to forgive you. Indeed He is gracious to me.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I dissociate myself from you and whatever you invoke besides Allah. I will supplicate my Lord. Hopefully, I will not be disappointed in supplicating my Lord.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when he had left them and what they worshipped besides Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each We made a prophet.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed I fear my kinsmen, after me, and my wife is barren. So grant me from Yourself an heir

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We gave them out of Our mercy, and conferred on them a worthy and lofty repute.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And mention in the Book Moses. Indeed he was exclusively dedicated [to Allah], and an apostle and a prophet.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We called him from the right side of the Mount and We drew him near for confidential discourse.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron, a prophet.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And mention in the Book Ishmael. Indeed he was true to his promise, and an apostle and a prophet.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He used to bid his family to [maintain] the prayer and to [pay] the zakāt, and was pleasing to his Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And mention in the Book Idrīs. Indeed he was a truthful one, a prophet,

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and We raised him to a station exalted.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are the ones whom Allah has blessed from among the prophets of Adam's progeny, and from [the progeny of] those We carried with Noah, and from among the progeny of Abraham and Israel, and from among those We guided and chose. When the signs of the All-beneficent were recited to them, they would fall down weeping in prostration.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But they were succeeded by an evil posterity who neglected the prayer, and followed [their base] appetites. So they will soon encounter [the reward of] perversity,

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who may inherit from me and inherit from the House of Jacob, and make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: barring those who repent, believe, and act righteously. Such will enter paradise, and they will not be wronged in the least.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Gardens of Eden promised by the All-beneficent to His servants, [while they were still] unseen. Indeed His promise is bound to come to pass.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Therein they will not hear vain talk, but only 'Peace!' And therein they will have their provision morning and evening.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is the paradise We will give as inheritance to those of Our servants who are Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'We do not descend except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs whatever is before us and whatever is behind us and whatever is in between that, and your Lord is not forgetful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them. So worship Him and be steadfast in His worship. Do you know anyone who could be His namesake?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Man says, 'Shall I, when I have died, be brought forth alive?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Does not man remember that We created him before when he was nothing?

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will surely bring them up around hell [scrambling] on their knees.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then from every group We shall draw whichever of them was more defiant to the All-beneficent.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'O Zechariah! Indeed We give you the good news of a son, whose name is "John." Never before have We made anyone his namesake.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then surely We will know best those who deserve most to enter it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is none of you but will come to it:1 a [matter that is a] decided certainty with your Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We will deliver those who are Godwary, and leave the wrongdoers in it, fallen on their knees.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Our manifest signs are recited to them, the faithless say to the faithful, 'Which of the two sides is superior in station1 and better with respect to company?'2

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How many a generation We have destroyed before them, who were superior in furnishings and appearance!
