item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Whoever abides in error, the All-beneficent shall prolong his respite until they sight what they have been promised: either punishment, or the Hour.' Then they will know whose position is worse, and whose host is weaker.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah enhances in guidance those who are [rightly] guided, and lasting righteous deeds are better with your Lord in reward, and better at the return [to Allah].

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded him who defies Our signs, and says, 'I will surely be given wealth and children'?

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Has he come to know the Unseen, or taken a promise from the All-beneficent?

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No indeed! We will write down what he says, and We will prolong his punishment endlessly.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord! How shall I have a son, when my wife is barren, and I am already advanced in age?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We shall take over from him what he talks about,1 and he will come to Us alone.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They have taken gods besides Allah that they may be a [source of] might to them:

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No Indeed! Soon they will disown their worship, and they will be their opponents.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not regarded that We unleash the devils upon the faithless to urge them impetuously?

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So do not make haste against them; indeed We are counting1 for them, a counting [down].

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day We shall gather the Godwary toward the All-beneficent, on mounts,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and drive the guilty as a thirsty herd towards hell.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No one will have the power to intercede [with Allah], except for him who has taken a covenant with the All-beneficent.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'The All-beneficent has taken a son!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You have certainly advanced something hideous!

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'So shall it be. Your Lord has said, "It is simple for Me." Certainly I created you before when you were nothing.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The heavens are about to be rent apart at it, the earth to split open, and the mountains to collapse into bits,

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that they should ascribe a son to the All-beneficent!

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It does not behoove the All-beneficent to take a son.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is none in the heavens and the earth but he comes to the All-beneficent as a servant.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly He has counted them [all] and numbered them precisely,

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and each of them will come to Him alone on the Day of Resurrection.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who have faith and do righteous deeds —the All-beneficent will endear them [to His creation].

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have made it simple in your language so that you may give good news thereby to the Godwary and warn with it a disputatious lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How many a generation We have destroyed before them! Can you descry any one of them, or hear from them so much as a murmur?

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who are [themselves] faithless and bar [others] from the way of Allah —He has made their works go awry.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not travelled over the land so that they may observe how was the fate of those who were before them? Allah destroyed them, and a similar [fate] awaits the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is because Allah is the protector of the faithful, and because the faithless have no protector.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah will admit those who have faith and do righteous deeds into gardens with streams running in them. As for the faithless, they enjoy and eat just like the cattle eat, and the Fire will be their [final] abode.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How many a town there has been which was more powerful than your town which expelled you, which We have destroyed, and they had no helper.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is he who stands on a manifest proof from his Lord like someone to whom the evil of his conduct is made to seem decorous, and who follow their desires?

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A description of the paradise promised to the Godwary: therein are streams of unstaling water, and streams of milk unchanging in flavour, and streams of wine delicious to the drinkers, and streams of purified honey; there will be for them every kind of fruit in it, and forgiveness from their Lord. [Are such ones] like those who abide in the Fire and are given to drink boiling water which cuts up their bowels?

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There are some among them who prick up their ears at you. But when they go out from your presence, they say to those who have been given knowledge, 'What did he say just now?' They are the ones on whose hearts Allah has set a seal, and they follow their own desires.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who are [rightly] guided, He enhances their guidance, and invests them with their Godwariness.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they await anything except that the Hour should overtake them suddenly? Certainly its portents have come. Of what avail to them will their admonition be when it overtakes them?

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Know that there is no god except Allah, and plead [to Allah] for forgiveness of your sin and for the faithful, men and women. Allah knows your itinerary and your [final] abode.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But those who have faith and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down to Muḥammad —and it is the truth from their Lord— He shall absolve them of their misdeeds and set right their affairs.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithful say, 'If only a sūrah were sent down!' But when a definitive sūrah is sent down and war is mentioned in it, you see those in whose hearts is a sickness1 looking upon you with the look of someone fainting at death. So woe to them!

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Obedience and upright speech ….1 So when the matter has been resolved upon, if they remain true to Allah that will surely be better for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: May it not be that if you were to wield authority you would cause corruption in the land and ill-treat your blood relations?

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They are the ones whom Allah has cursed, so He made them deaf, and blinded their sight.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they not contemplate the Qur'ān, or are there locks on the hearts?

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who turned their backs after the guidance had become clear to them, it was Satan who had seduced them, and he had given them [far-flung] hopes.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is because they said to those who loathed what Allah had sent down: 'We shall obey you in some matters,' and Allah knows their secret dealings.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But how will it be [with them] when the angels take them away, striking their faces and their backs?!

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That, because they pursued what displeased Allah, and loathed His pleasure. So He has made their works fail.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do those in whose hearts is a sickness suppose that Allah will not expose their spite?

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is because the faithless follow falsehood, and because the faithful follow the truth from their Lord. That is how Allah draws comparisons for mankind.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If We wish, We will show them1 to you so that you recognize them by their mark. Yet you will recognize them by their tone of speech, and Allah knows your deeds.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We will surely test you until We ascertain those of you who wage jihād and those who are steadfast, and We shall appraise your record.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who are faithless and bar from the way of Allah and defy the Apostle after guidance has become clear to them, will not hurt Allah in the least, and He shall make their works fail.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! Obey Allah and obey the Apostle, and do not render your works void.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who are faithless and bar from the way of Allah and then die faithless, Allah will never forgive them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So do not slacken and [do not] call for peace when you have the upper hand and Allah is with you, and He will not stint [the reward of] your works.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The life of the world is just play and diversion, but if you are faithful and Godwary, He will give you your rewards, and will not ask your wealth [in return] from you.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Should He ask it from you, and press you, you will be stingy, and He will expose your spite.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ah! There you are, being invited to spend in the way of Allah; yet among you there are those who are stingy; and whoever is stingy is stingy only to himself. Allah is the All-sufficient, and you are all-needy, and if you turn away He will replace you with another people, and they will not be like you.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When you meet the faithless in battle, strike their necks. When you have thoroughly decimated them, bind the captives firmly. Thereafter either oblige them [by setting them free] or take ransom till the war lays down its burdens. That [is Allah's ordinance], and had Allah wished He could have taken vengeance on them,1 but that He may test some of you by means of others. As for those who were slain in the way of Allah, He will not let their works go awry.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He will guide them and set right their affairs,

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and admit them into paradise with which He has acquainted them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O you who have faith! If you help Allah, He will help you and make your feet steady.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the faithless, their lot will be to fall [into ruin],1 and He will make their works go awry.

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is because they loathed what Allah has sent down, so He made their works fail.

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We sent Noah to his people, [saying,] 'Warn your people before a painful punishment overtakes them.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: telling [them]: "Plead to your Lord for forgiveness. Indeed He is all-forgiver.

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He will send for you abundant rains from the sky,

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and aid you with wealth and sons, and provide you with gardens and provide you with streams.

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What is the matter with you that you do not look upon Allah with veneration,

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: though He has created you in [various] stages?

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have you not seen how Allah has created seven heavens in layers,

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and has made therein the moon for a light, and the sun for a lamp?

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah made you grow from the earth, with a [vegetable] growth.

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then He makes you return to it, and He will bring you forth [without fail].

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah has made the earth a vast expanse for you

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'O my people! Indeed I am a manifest warner to you.

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so that you may travel over its spacious ways." '

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Noah said, 'My Lord! They have disobeyed me, following someone whose wealth and children only add to his loss,

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and they have devised an outrageous plot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, "Do not abandon your gods. Do not abandon Wadd, nor Suwā, nor Yaghūth, Ya'ūq and Nasr,"1

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and already they have led many astray. Do not increase the wrongdoers in anything but error.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They were drowned because of their iniquities, then made to enter a Fire, and they did not find for themselves any helpers besides Allah.

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And Noah said, 'My Lord! 'Do not leave on the earth any inhabitant from among the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If You leave them, they will lead astray Your servants and will not beget except vicious ingrates.

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and the faithful men and women, and do not increase the wrongdoers in anything except ruin.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Worship Allah and be wary of Him, and obey me,

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that He may forgive you some of your sins and respite you until a specified time. Indeed when Allah's [appointed] time comes, it cannot be deferred, should you know.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord! Indeed I have summoned my people night and day

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: but my summons only increases their evasion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed whenever I have summoned them, so that You might forgive them, they would put their fingers into their ears and draw their cloaks over their heads, and they were persistent [in their unfaith], and disdainful in [their] arrogance.

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Again I summoned them aloud,

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and again appealed to them publicly and confided with them privately,

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Qāf. By the glorious Qur'ān.

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and tall date palms with regularly set spathes,

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: as a provision for servants; and with it We revive a dead country. Likewise will be the rising [from the dead].

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The people of Noah denied before them, and [so did] the inhabitants of Rass1 and Thamūd,

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and 'Ād, Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot,

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the inhabitants of Aykah and the people of Tubba'.1 Each [of them] impugned the apostles, and so My threat became due [against them].

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were We exhausted by the first creation? Rather they are in doubt about a new creation.

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We have created man and We know to what his soul tempts him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the twin recorders record [his deeds], seated on the right hand and on the left:

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: he says no word but that there is a ready observer beside him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then the agony of death brings the truth:1 'This is what you used to shun!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather they consider it odd that a warner should have come to them from among themselves. So the faithless say, 'This is an odd thing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then the Trumpet will be blown: 'This is the promised day.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then every soul will come accompanied by a driver and a witness:

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'You were certainly oblivious of this. We have removed your veil from you, and so your sight is acute today.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then his companion will say, 'This is what is ready with me [of testimony].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'The two of you cast every obdurate ingrate into hell,

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [every] hinderer of all good,1 transgressor, and skeptic,

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who has set up another god along with Allah! So the two of you cast him into the severe punishment.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: His companion1 will say, 'Our Lord! I did not make him a rebel, but he [himself] was in extreme error.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He will say, 'Do not wrangle in My presence, for I had already warned you in advance.

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The word [of judgement] is unalterable with Me, and I am not tyrannical to the servants.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What! When we are dead and have become dust [shall we be raised again]? That is a far-fetched return!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day when We shall say to hell, 'Are you full?' It will say, 'Is there any more?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And paradise will be brought near for the Godwary, not distant [any more]:

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'This is what you were promised. [It is] for every penitent and dutiful [servant]

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who fears the All-beneficent in secret and comes with a penitent heart.

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Enter it in peace! This is the day of immortality.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There they will have whatever they wish, and with Us there is yet more.

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How many generations We have destroyed before them, who were stronger than these, insomuch that they ransacked the towns?! Is there any escape [from Allah's punishment]?

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is indeed an admonition in that for one who has a heart, or gives ear, being attentive.

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We created the heavens and the earth, and whatever is between them, in six days, and any fatigue did not touch Us.

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So be patient over what they say, and celebrate the praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before the sunset,

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We know what the earth diminishes from them,1 and with Us is a preserving Book.

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and glorify Him through part of the night and after the prostrations.

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And be on the alert for the day when the caller calls from a close quarter,

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the day when they hear the Cry in all truth. That is the day of rising [from the dead].

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it is We who give life and bring death, and toward Us is the destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The day the earth is split open for [disentombing] them, [they will come out] hastening. That mustering1 is easy for Us [to carry out].

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We know best what they say, and you are not to be a tyrant over them. So admonish by the Qur'ān him who fears My threat.

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather they denied the truth when it came to them; so they are now in a perplexed state of affairs.

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have built it and adorned it, and that there are no cracks in it?

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We spread out the earth, and cast in it firm mountains, and caused every delightful kind to grow in it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [In this there is] an insight and admonition for every penitent servant.

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We send down from the sky salubrious water, with which We grow gardens and the grain which is harvested,

item.title: bil-Quran: Quraish:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [In gratitude] for solidarity1 among the Quraysh,

item.title: bil-Quran: Quraish:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: their solidarity during winter and summer journeys,

item.title: bil-Quran: Quraish:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: let them worship the Lord of this House,

item.title: bil-Quran: Quraish:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: who has fed them [and saved them] from hunger, and secured them from fear.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ṣād. By the Qur'ān bearing the Reminder!1

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they own the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them? [If so,] let them ascend [to the higher spheres] by the means1 [of ascension].

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [They are but] a routed host out there, from among the factions.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Before them Noah's people impugned [their apostle] and [so did the people of] 'Ād, and Pharaoh, the Impaler1 [of his victims],

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and Thamūd, and the people of Lot, and the inhabitants of Aykah:1 those were the factions.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Each of them did not but impugn the apostles; so My retribution became due [against them].

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These1 do not await but a single Cry which will not grant any respite.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'Our Lord! Hasten on for us our share1 before the Day of Reckoning.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Be patient over what they say, and remember Our servant, David, [the man] of strength. Indeed he was a penitent [soul].

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We disposed the mountains to glorify [Allah] with him at evening and dawn,

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the birds [as well], mustered [in flocks], all echoing him [in a chorus].

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yet the faithless dwell in conceit and defiance.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We made his kingdom firm and gave him wisdom and conclusive speech.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Has there not come to you the account of the contenders, when they scaled the wall into the sanctuary?1

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they entered into the presence of David, he was alarmed by them. They said, 'Do not be afraid. [We are only] two contenders: one of us has bullied the other. So judge justly between us, and do not exceed [the bounds of justice], and show us the right path.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Indeed this brother of mine has ninety-nine ewes, while I have only a single ewe, and [yet] he says, 'Commit it to my care,' and he browbeats me in speech.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'He has certainly wronged you by asking your ewe in addition to his ewes, and indeed many partners bully one another, except such as have faith and do righteous deeds, and few are they.' Then David knew that We had indeed tested him, whereat he pleaded with his Lord for forgiveness, and fell down prostrate and repented.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We forgave him that and indeed he has [a station of] nearness with Us and a good destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'O David! Indeed We have made you a vicegerent on the earth. So judge between people with justice, and do not follow desire, or it will lead you astray from the way of Allah. Indeed those who stray from the way of Allah —there is a severe punishment for them because of their forgetting the Day of Reckoning.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not create the sky and the earth and whatever is between them in vain. That is a conjecture of the faithless. So woe to the faithless for the Fire!

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Shall We treat those who have faith and do righteous deeds like those who cause corruption on the earth? Shall We treat the Godwary like the vicious?

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [It is] a blessed Book that We have sent down to you, so that they may contemplate its signs, and that those who possess intellect may take admonition.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How many a generation We have destroyed before them! They cried out [for help], but it was no more the time for escape.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And to David We gave Solomon —what an excellent servant! Indeed he was a penitent [soul].

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When one evening there were displayed before him prancing steeds,

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: he said, 'Indeed I have preferred the love of [worldly] niceties to the remembrance of my Lord until [the sun] disappeared behind the [night's] veil.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Bring it1 back for me!' Then he [and others] began to wipe [their] legs and necks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We tried Solomon, and cast a [lifeless] body on his throne. Thereupon he was penitent.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord! Forgive me, and grant me a kingdom that does not befit anyone except me.1 Indeed You are the All-munificent.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So We disposed the wind for him, blowing softly by his command wherever he intended,

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and the devils [as well as], every builder and diver,

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and others [too] bound together in chains.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'This is Our bounty: so give away or withhold, without any reckoning.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They consider it odd that there should come to them a warner from among themselves, and the faithless say, 'This is a magician, a mendacious liar.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed he has [a station of] nearness with Us and a good destination.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And remember Our servant Job [in the Qur'ān]. When he called out to his Lord, 'The devil has visited on me hardship and torment,'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [We told him:] 'Stamp your foot on the ground; this [ensuing spring] is a cooling bath and drink.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We gave [back] his family to him along with others like them, as a mercy from Us and an admonition for those who possess intellect.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [We told him:] 'Take a faggot in your hand and then strike [your wife] with it, but do not break [your] oath.' Indeed We found him to be patient. What an excellent servant! Indeed he was a penitent [soul].

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And remember Our servants Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, men of strength and insight.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We purified them with the exclusiveness of the remembrance of the abode [of the Hereafter].

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed with Us they are surely among the elect of the best.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhu'l-Kifl —each [of whom was] among the elect.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is a reminder, and indeed the Godwary have a good destination

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Has he reduced the gods to one god? This is indeed an odd thing!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —the Gardens of Eden, whose gates are flung open for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Reclining therein [on couches], therein they ask for abundant fruits and drinks,

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and with them will be maidens of restrained glances of a like age.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is what you are promised on the Day of Reckoning.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is indeed Our provision, which will never be exhausted.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This [is for the righteous], and as for the rebellious there will surely be a bad destination

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —hell, which they shall enter, an evil resting place.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This; let them taste it: scalding water and pus,

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and other kinds [of torments] resembling it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'This is a group plunging [into hell] along with you.'1 'May wretchedness be their lot! They will indeed enter the Fire.'2

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Their elite go about [urging others]: 'Go and stand by your gods! This is indeed the desirable thing [to do].

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They1 say, 'Rather, may wretchedness be your lot! You prepared this [hell] for us. What an evil abode!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'Our Lord! Whoever has prepared this for us, double his punishment in the Fire!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they say, 'What is the matter with us that we do not see [here] men whom we used to count among the bad ones?

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did we ridicule them [unduly in the world], or do [our] eyes miss them [here]?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That is indeed a truth: the contentions of the inmates of the Fire.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I am just a warner, and there is no god except Allah, the One, the All-paramount,

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the All-mighty, the All-forgiver.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'It is a great prophesy,

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: of which you are disregardful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I have no knowledge of the Supernal Elite when they contend.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not hear of this in the latter-day creed.1 This is nothing but a fabrication.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: All that is revealed to me is that I am just a manifest warner.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When your Lord said to the angels, 'Indeed I am about to create a human being out of clay.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My spirit, then fall down in prostration before him.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thereat the angels prostrated, all of them together,

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: but not Iblis; he acted arrogantly and he was one of the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'O Iblis! What keeps you from prostrating before that which I have created with My [own] two hands? Are you arrogant, or are you [one] of the exalted ones?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'I am better than him,' he said. 'You created me from fire and You created him from clay.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Begone hence, for you are indeed an outcast,

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and indeed My curse will be on you till the Day of Retribution.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord! Respite me till the day they will be resurrected.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Has the reminder been sent down to him out of [all of] us?' Rather they are in doubt concerning My reminder. Rather they have not yet tasted My punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Said He, 'You are indeed among the reprieved

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: until the day of the known time.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'By Your might, I will surely pervert them,

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: except Your exclusive servants among them.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'The truth is that —and I speak the truth—

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I will surely fill hell with you and all of those who follow you.'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I do not ask you any reward for it, and I am no impostor.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is just a reminder for all the nations,

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and you will surely learn its tidings in due time.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord, the All-mighty, the All-munificent?

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: All praise belongs to Allah to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. To Him belongs all praise in the Hereafter, and He is the All-wise, the All-aware.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We gave David a grace from Us: 'O mountains and birds, chime in with him!'1 And We made iron soft for him,

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: saying, 'Make easy coats of mail, and keep the measure in arranging [the links], and act righteously. Indeed I see best what you do.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And for Solomon [We subjected] the wind: its morning course was a month's journey and its evening course was a month's journey. We made a fount of [molten] copper flow for him, and [We placed at his service] some of the jinn who would work for him by the permission of his Lord, and if any of them swerved from Our command, We would make him taste the punishment of the Blaze.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They built for him as many temples as he wished, and figures, basins like cisterns, and caldrons fixed [in the ground]. 'O House of David, observe thanksgiving, and few of My servants are grateful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when We decreed death for him, nothing apprised them of his death except a worm which gnawed away at his staff. And when he fell down the jinn realized that had they known the Unseen, they would not have remained in a humiliating torment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There was certainly a sign for Sheba in their habitation: two gardens, to the right and to the left. 'Eat of the provision of your Lord and give Him thanks: a good land and an all-forgiving Lord!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But they disregarded [the path of Allah], so We unleashed upon them a violent flood and replaced their two gardens with two gardens bearing bitter fruit, tamarisk, and sparse lote trees.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We requited them with that for their ingratitude. Do We requite [so] anyone except ingrates?

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We had placed between them and the towns which We had blessed hamlets prominent [from the main route], and We had ordained the course through them: 'Travel through them in safety, night and day.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But they said, 'Our Lord! Make the stages between our journeys far apart,' and they wronged themselves. So We turned them into folktales and caused them to disintegrate totally. There are indeed signs in that for every patient and grateful [servant].

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He knows whatever enters into the earth and whatever emerges from it, and whatever descends from the sky and whatever ascends into it, and He is the All-merciful, the All-forgiving.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly Iblis had his conjecture come true about them. So they followed him —all except a part of the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He had no authority over them, but that We may ascertain those who believe in the Hereafter from those who are in doubt about it, and your Lord is watchful over all things.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Invoke them whom you claim [to be gods] besides Allah! They do not control [even] an atom's weight in the heavens or the earth, nor have they any share in [either of] them, nor is any of them1 His supporter.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Intercession is of no avail with Him except for those whom He permits.1 When fear is lifted from their hearts, they say, 'What did your Lord say?' They say, 'The truth, and He is the All-exalted, the All-great.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?' Say, 'Allah! Indeed either we or you are rightly guided or in manifest error.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'You will not be questioned about our guilt, nor shall we be questioned about what you do.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Our Lord will bring us together, then He will judge between us with justice, and He is the All-knowing Judge.'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Show me those whom you associate with Him as partners.' No indeed! [They can never show any such partner]. Rather He is Allah, the All-mighty, the All-wise.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not send you except as a bearer of good news and warner to all mankind, but most people do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they say, 'When will this promise be fulfilled, should you be truthful?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithless say, 'The Hour will not overtake us.' Say, 'Yes indeed, by my Lord, it will surely come to you.' —The Knower of the Unseen, not [even] an atom's weight escapes Him in the heavens or in the earth, nor [is there] anything smaller than that nor bigger, but it is in a manifest Book,

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Your promised hour is a day that you shall neither defer nor advance by an hour.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithless say, 'We will never believe in this Qur'ān, nor in what was [revealed] before it.' But if you were to see when the wrongdoers are made to stop before their Lord casting the blame on one another. Those who were abased will say to those who were arrogant, 'Had it not been for you, we would surely have been faithful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who were arrogant will say to those who were abased, 'Did we keep you from guidance after it had come to you? No, you were guilty [yourselves].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who were abased will say to those who were arrogant, 'Rather [it was your] night and day plotting, when you prompted us to forswear Allah and to set up equals to Him.' They will hide their remorse when they sight the punishment, and We will put iron collars around the necks of the faithless. Shall they be requited except for what they used to do?

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not send a warner to any town without its affluent ones saying, 'We indeed disbelieve in what you have been sent with.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they say, 'We have greater wealth and more children, and we will not be punished!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Indeed my Lord expands the provision for whomever He wishes and He tightens it, but most people do not know.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is not your wealth, nor your children, that will bring you close to Us in nearness, except those who have faith and act righteously. It is they for whom there will be a twofold reward for what they did, and they will be secure in lofty abodes.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for those who contend with Our signs seeking to thwart [their purpose], they will be brought to the punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Indeed my Lord expands the provision for whomever of His servants that He wishes and tightens it, and He will repay whatever you may spend, and He is the best of providers.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that He may reward those who have faith and do righteous deeds. For such there will be forgiveness and a noble provision.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On the day He will muster them all together, then He will say to the angels, 'Was it you that these used to worship?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, 'Immaculate are You! You are our intimate, not they! Rather they used to worship the jinn; most of them had faith in them.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Today you have no power to benefit or harm one another,' and We shall say to those who did wrong, 'Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Our manifest signs are recited to them, they say, 'This is just a man who desires to keep you from what your fathers used to worship.' And they say, 'This is nothing but a fabricated lie.' The faithless say of the truth when it comes to them: 'This is nothing but plain magic.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not give them1 any scriptures that they might have studied, nor did We send them any warner before you.2

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who were before them denied [the apostles], and these have not received one-tenth1 of what We had given them. But they denied My apostles, so how was My rebuttal!2

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I give you just a single advice: that you rise up for Allah's sake, in twos, or individually, and then reflect: there is no madness in your companion: he is just a warner to you before [the befalling of] a severe punishment.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Whatever reward I may have asked you is for your own good. My [true] reward lies only with Allah, and He is witness to all things.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Indeed my Lord hurls1 the truth. [He is] the knower of all that is Unseen.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'The truth has come, and falsehood neither originates [anything] not does it restore [anything].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But those who contend with Our signs seeking to thwart [their purpose], for such is a painful punishment due to defilement.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'If I go astray, my going astray is only to my own harm, and if I am rightly guided that is because of what my Lord has revealed to me. Indeed He is all-hearing, nearmost.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were you to see when they are stricken with terror, [and left] without an escape, and are seized from a close quarter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, 'We believe in it [now].' But how can they reach it from a far-off place,

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when they have already disbelieved it earlier? They shoot at the invisible from a far-off place!

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A barrier will be set up between them and what they long for, just as was done formerly with their counterparts. Indeed they used to be in grave doubt.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who have been given knowledge see that what has been sent down to you from your Lord is the truth and [that] it guides to the path of the All-mighty, the All-laudable.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The faithless say, 'Shall we show you a man who will inform you [that] when you have been totally rent to pieces you will indeed have a new creation?

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Has he fabricated a lie against Allah, or is there a madness in him?' Rather those who do not believe in the Hereafter languish in punishment and extreme error.

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not regarded that which is before them and that which is behind them of the sky and the earth? If We like, We can make the earth swallow them, or let fall on them a fragment from the sky. There is indeed a sign in that for every penitent servant.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Ṭā Hā!1

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: when he sighted a fire, and said to his family, 'Wait! Indeed I descry a fire! Maybe I will bring you a brand from it, or find some guidance at the fire.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:100 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever disregards it shall bear its onus on the Day of Resurrection,

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:101 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: remaining in it [forever]. Evil is their burden on the Day of Resurrection

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:102 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —the day the Trumpet will be blown— on that day We shall muster the guilty with blind eyes.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:103 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will whisper to one another: 'You have stayed only for ten [days].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:104 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We know best what they will say, when the best of them in conduct will say, 'You stayed only a day!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:105 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They question you concerning the mountains. Say, 'My Lord will scatter them [like dust].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:106 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then He will leave it1 a level plain.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:107 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You will not see any crookedness or unevenness in it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:108 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On that day they will follow a summoner in whom there will be no deviousness. The voices will be muted before the All-beneficent, and you will hear nothing but a murmur.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:109 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Intercession will not avail that day except from him whom the All-beneficent allows and approves of his word.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when he came to it, he was called, 'O Moses!

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:110 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He knows that which is before them and that which is behind them, but they cannot comprehend Him in their knowledge.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:111 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: All faces shall be humbled before the Living One, the All-sustainer, and he will fail who bears [the onus of] wrongdoing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:112 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But whoever does righteous deeds, should he be faithful, shall neither fear any wrong nor detraction.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:113 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'ān and We have paraphrased the threats in it so that they may be Godwary or it may evoke remembrance for them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:114 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So exalted is Allah, the True Sovereign. Do not hasten with the Qur'ān before its revelation is completed for you, and say, 'My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:115 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We had enjoined Adam earlier; but he forgot, and We did not find any resoluteness in him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:116 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When We said to the angels, 'Prostrate before Adam,' they prostrated, but not Iblis: he refused.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:117 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We said, 'O Adam! This is indeed an enemy of yours and your mate's. So do not let him expel you from paradise, or you will be miserable.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:118 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed you will neither be hungry in it nor naked.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:119 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed you will neither be thirsty in it, nor suffer from the sun.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed I am your Lord! So take off your sandals. You are indeed in the sacred valley of Ṭuwā.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:120 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then Satan tempted him. He said, 'O Adam! Shall I show you the tree of immortality, and an imperishable kingdom?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:121 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So they both ate of it, and their nakedness became evident to them, and they began to stitch over themselves with the leaves of paradise. Adam disobeyed his Lord, and went amiss.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:122 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then his Lord chose him, and turned to him clemently, and guided him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:123 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Get down both of you1 from it, all together, being enemies of one another! Yet, should any guidance come to you from Me, those who follow My guidance will not go astray, nor will they be miserable.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:124 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But whoever disregards My remembrance, his shall be a wretched life, and on the Day of Resurrection We shall raise him blind.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:125 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He will say, 'My Lord! Why have You raised me blind, though I used to see?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:126 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He will say: 'So it is. Our signs came to you, but you forgot them, and thus you will be forgotten today.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:127 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus do We requite him who is a profligate and does not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is severer and more lasting.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:128 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Does it not dawn upon them how many generations We have destroyed before them, amid [the ruins of] whose dwellings they walk? There are indeed signs in this for those who have reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:129 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And were it not for a prior decree of your Lord and a specified time, it was inevitable.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I have chosen you; so listen to what is revealed.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:130 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So be patient with what they say, and celebrate the praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before the sunset, and glorify Him in watches of the night and at the day's ends, that you may be pleased.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:131 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not extend your glance toward what We have provided certain groups of them as a glitter of the life of this world, so that We may test them thereby. And the provision of your Lord is better and more lasting.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:132 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And bid your family to prayer and be steadfast in its maintenance. We do not ask any provision of you. It is We who provide for you, and the outcome will be in favour of Godwariness.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:133 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?' Has there not come to them a manifest proof in that which is in the former scriptures?

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:134 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had We destroyed them with a punishment before it,1 they would have surely said, 'Our Lord! Why did You not send us an apostle so that we might follow Your signs before we were abased and disgraced?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:135 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Each [of us] is waiting. So wait! Soon you will know who are the people of the right path, and who is guided.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed I am Allah —there is no god except Me. So worship Me, and maintain the prayer for My remembrance.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed the Hour is bound to come: I will have it hidden, so that every soul may be rewarded for what it strives for.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So do not let yourself be distracted from it by those who do not believe in it and who follow their desires, lest you should perish.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Moses, what is that in your right hand?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'It is my staff. I lean upon it, and with it I beat down leaves for my sheep; and I have other uses for it.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Moses, throw it down.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not send down to you the Qur'ān that you should be miserable,

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So he threw it down, and behold, it was a snake, moving swiftly.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Take hold of it, and do not fear. We will restore it to its former state.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Now clasp your hand to your armpit: it will emerge white, without any fault. [This is yet] another sign,

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that We may show you some of Our great signs.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Go to Pharaoh. He has indeed rebelled.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord! Open my breast for me.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Make my affair easy for me.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Remove the hitch from my tongue,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [so that] they may understand my discourse.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Appoint for me a minister from my family,

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: but only as an admonition to him who fears [his Lord].

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Aaron, my brother.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Strengthen my back through him,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and make him my associate in my affair,

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so that we may glorify You greatly,

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and remember You greatly.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed You see us best.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Moses, your request has been granted!

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly, We have done you a favour another time,

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
