item.description: when We revealed to your mother whatever was revealed:

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: "Put him in the casket, and cast it into the river. Then the river will cast it on the bank, and he shall be picked up by an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his." And I cast upon you a love from Me,1 and that you might be reared under My eyes.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A sending down [of the Revelation] from Him who created the earth and the lofty heavens

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When your sister walked up [to Pharaoh's palace] saying, "Shall I show you someone who will take care of him?" Then We restored you to your mother, that she might be comforted and not grieve. Then you slew a soul, whereupon We delivered you from anguish, and We tried you with various ordeals. Then you stayed for several years among the people of Midian. Then you turned up as ordained, O Moses!

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And I chose you for Myself.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Go ahead, you and your brother, with My signs and do not flag in My remembrance.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Let the two of you go to Pharaoh. Indeed he has rebelled.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Speak to him in a soft manner; maybe he will take admonition or fear.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The two of them said, 'Our Lord! We are indeed afraid that he will forestall us or will overstep the bounds.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Do not be afraid, for I will be with the two of you, hearing and seeing [whatever happens].

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So approach him and say, "We are the apostles of your Lord. Let the Children of Israel go with us, and do not torture them! We certainly bring you a sign from your Lord, and may peace be upon him who follows guidance!

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it has been revealed to us that the punishment shall befall those who deny and turn their backs [on us]." '

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Who is your Lord, Moses?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —the All-beneficent, settled on the Throne.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Our Lord is He who gave everything its creation and then guided it.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'What about the former generations?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Their knowledge is with my Lord, in a Book. My Lord neither makes any error nor forgets.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He who made the earth for you a cradle, and in it threaded for you ways, and sent down water from the sky, and with it We brought forth various kinds of vegetation.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Eat and pasture your cattle.' There are indeed signs in that for those who have sense.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: From it did We create you, into it shall We return you, and from it shall We bring you forth another time.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We showed him all Our signs. But he denied [them] and refused [to believe them].

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Have you come to us, Moses, to expel us from our land with your magic?

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yet we [too] will bring you a magic like it! So fix a tryst between us and you, which neither we shall fail nor you, at a middle place.'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Your tryst shall be the Day of Adornment, and let the people be assembled in early forenoon.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and whatever is between them, and whatever is under the ground.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then Pharaoh withdrew [to consult privately], summoned up his guile, and then arrived [at the scene of the contest].

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Moses said to them, 'Woe to you! Do not fabricate a lie against Allah, lest He should annihilate you with a punishment. Whoever fabricates lies certainly fails.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So they disputed their matter among themselves, and kept their confidential talks secret.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'These two are indeed magicians who intend to expel you from your land with their magic, and to abolish your excellent tradition!1

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So summon up your ingenuity, then come in ranks. Today he who has the upper hand will be saved!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'O Moses! Either you will throw down, or we shall be the first to throw.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Rather you throw down first.' Behold, their ropes and staffs appeared to him by their magic to wriggle swiftly.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then Moses felt a fear within his heart.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We said, 'Do not be afraid. Indeed you will have the upper hand.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Throw down what is in your right hand, and it will swallow what they have conjured. What they have conjured is only a magician's trick, and the magician does not fare well wherever he may show up.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whether you speak loudly [or in secret tones] He indeed knows the secret and what is still more hidden.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thereat the magicians fell down prostrating. They said, 'We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Do you profess faith in Him before I may permit you? He is indeed your chief who has taught you magic! Surely I will cut off your hands and feet from opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees. So you will know which of us can inflict a punishment severer and more lasting.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'We will never prefer you to the manifest proofs which have come to us and [to] Him who originated us. Decide whatever you may. You can only decide about the life of this world.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We have indeed believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our iniquities and the magic you compelled us to perform. Allah is better and more lasting.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whoever comes to his Lord laden with guilt, indeed for him shall be hell where he will neither live nor die.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But whoever comes to Him with faith and he has done righteous deeds, for such shall be the highest ranks

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —the Gardens of Eden, with streams running in them, to abide in them [forever], and that is the reward of him who keeps pure.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We revealed to Moses, [saying], 'Take My servants on a journey by night. Then strike out for them a dry path through the sea. Do not be afraid of being overtaken, and have no fear [of getting drowned].

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then Pharaoh pursued them with his troops, whereat they were engulfed by what engulfed them of the sea.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah—there is no god except Him— to Him belong the Best Names.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O Children of Israel! We delivered you from your enemy, and We appointed with you a tryst on the right side of the Mount and We sent down to you manna and quails:

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Eat of the good things We have provided you, but do not overstep the bounds therein, lest My wrath should descend on you. And he on whom My wrath descends certainly perishes.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed I am all-forgiver toward him who repents, becomes faithful and acts righteously, and then follows guidance.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'What has hurried you from your people, O Moses?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'They are close upon my heels, and I hurried on to You, my Lord, that You may be pleased.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Indeed We tried your people in your absence, and the Sāmirī1 has led them astray.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thereupon Moses returned to his people, indignant and grieved. He said, 'O my people! Did not your Lord give you a true promise? Did the period [of my absence]seem too long to you? Or did you desire that your Lord's wrath should descend on you and so you failed your tryst with me?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'We did not fail our tryst with you of our own accord, but we were laden with the weight of the people's ornaments, and we cast them [into the fire] and so did the Sāmirī throw.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he produced for them a calf —a [lifeless] body with a low— and they said, This is your god and the god of Moses, so he1 forgot!

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did they not see that it did not answer them, nor could it bring them any benefit or harm?

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Did the story of Moses come to you,

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Aaron had certainly told them earlier, 'O my people! You are only being tested by it. Indeed your Lord is the All-beneficent. So follow me and obey my command!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They had said, 'We will keep on clinging to it until Moses returns to us.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'O Aaron! What kept you, when you saw them going astray,

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: from following me? Did you disobey my command?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'O son of my mother! Do not hold my beard or my head! I feared lest you should say, "You have caused a rift among the Children of Israel, and did not heed my word [of advice]." '

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'What is your business, O Sāmirī?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'I saw what they did not see. I took a handful [of dust] from the messenger's trail and threw it. That is how my soul prompted me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Begone! It shall be your [lot] throughout life to say, "Do not touch me!" Indeed there is a tryst for you which you will not fail to keep! Now look at your god to whom you went on clinging. We will burn it down and then scatter it[s ashes] into the sea.

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed your God is Allah. There is no god except Him. He embraces all things in [His] knowledge.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:99 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus do We relate to you some accounts of what is past. Certainly We have given you a Reminder from Ourselves.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yā Sīn!

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is the same to them whether you warn them or do not warn them, they will not have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You can only warn someone who follows the Reminder1 and fears the All-beneficent in secret; so give him the good news of forgiveness and a noble reward.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed it is We who revive the dead and write what they have sent ahead1 and their effects [which they left behind],2 and We have figured everything in a manifest Imam.3

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Cite for them the example of the inhabitants of the town when the apostles came to it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When We sent to them two [apostles], they impugned both of them. Then We reinforced them with a third, and they said, 'We have indeed been sent to you.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'You are nothing but humans like us, and the All-beneficent has not sent down anything, and you are only lying.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Our Lord knows that we have indeed been sent to you,

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and our duty is only to communicate in clear terms.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Indeed we take you for a bad omen. If you do not relinquish we will stone you, and surely a painful punishment will visit you from us.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Your bad omens attend you. What! If you are admonished ….1 Rather you are a profligate lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: By the Wise1 Qur'ān,

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There came a man from the city outskirts, hurrying. He said, 'O my people! Follow the apostles!

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Follow them who do not ask you any reward and they are rightly guided.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Why should I not worship Him who has originated me, and to whom you shall be brought back?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Shall I take gods besides Him? If the All-beneficent desired to cause me any distress their intercession will not avail me in any way, nor will they rescue me.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed then I would be in manifest error.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed I have faith in your Lord, so listen to me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He was told, 'Enter paradise!' He said, 'Alas! Had my people only known

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: for what my Lord forgave me and made me one of the honoured ones!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: After him We did not send down on his people a host from the sky, nor We would have sent down.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It was but a single Cry, and, behold, they were stilled [like burnt ashes]!

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: you are indeed one of the apostles,

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How regrettable of the servants! There did not come to them any apostle but that they used to deride him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not regarded how many generations We have destroyed before them who will not come back to them?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And all of them will indeed be presented before Us.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A sign for them is the dead earth, which We revive and out of it bring forth grain, so they eat of it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We make in it orchards of date palms and vines, and We cause springs to gush forth in it,

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so that they may eat of its fruit and what their hands have cultivated.1 Will they not then give thanks?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Immaculate is He who has created all the kinds1 of what the earth grows, and of themselves, and of what they do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And a sign for them is the night, which We strip of daylight, and, behold, they find themselves in the dark!

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And the sun runs on to its place of rest:1 That is the ordaining of the All-mighty, the All-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: As for the moon, We have ordained its phases, until it becomes like an old palm leaf.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: on a straight path.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Neither it behooves the sun to overtake the moon, nor may the night outrun the day, and each swims in an orbit.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: A sign for them is that We carried their progeny in the laden ship,1

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and We have created for them what is similar to it, which they ride.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And if We like We drown them, whereat they have no one to call for help, nor are they rescued

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: ⎯except by a mercy from Us and for an enjoyment until some time.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when they are told, 'Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you,1 so that you may receive [His] mercy.'2

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There did not come to them any sign from among the signs of their Lord but that they used to disregard it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When they are told, 'Spend out of what Allah has provided you,' the faithless say to the faithful, 'Shall we feed [someone] whom Allah would have fed, had He wished? You are only in manifest error.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they say, 'When will this promise be fulfilled, should you be truthful?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They do not await but a single Cry that would seize them as they wrangle.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [It is a scripture] sent down gradually from the All-mighty, the All-merciful

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then they will not be able to make any will, nor will they return to their folks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And when the Trumpet is blown, behold, there they will be, scrambling from their graves towards their Lord!

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They will say, 'Woe to us! Who raised us from our place of sleep?' 'This is what the All-beneficent had promised, and the apostles had spoken the truth!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It will be but a single Cry, and, behold, they will all be presented before Us!

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Today no soul will be wronged in the least, nor will you be requited except for what you used to do.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed today the inhabitants of paradise rejoice in their engagements

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —they and their mates, reclining on couches in the shades.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There they have fruits and they have whatever they want.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Peace!'—a watchword from the all-merciful Lord.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And 'Get apart today, you guilty ones!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: that you may warn a people whose fathers were not warned,1 so they are oblivious.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'Did I not exhort you, O children of Adam, saying, "Do not worship Satan. He is indeed your manifest enemy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Worship Me. That is a straight path"?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly he has led astray many of your generations. Did you not use to apply reason?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This is the hell you had been promised!

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Enter it today, because of what you used to defy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Today We shall seal their mouths, and their hands shall speak to Us, and their feet shall bear witness concerning what they used to earn.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Had We wished We would have blotted out their eyes:1 then, were they to advance towards the path, how would have they seen?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And had We wished We would have deformed them in their place;1 then they would have neither been able to go ahead nor to go back.2

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And whomever We give a long life, We cause him to regress in creation. Then will they not apply reason?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not teach him poetry, nor does it behoove him. This is just a reminder and a manifest Qur'ān,

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The word has certainly become due against most of them, so they will not have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: so that anyone who is alive may be warned, and that the word may come due against the faithless.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Have they not seen that We have created for them —of what Our hands have worked— cattle, so they have become their masters?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We made them tractable for them, so some of them make their mounts and some of them they eat.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There are other benefits for them therein, and drinks.1 Will they not then give thanks?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They have taken gods besides Allah [hoping] that they might be helped.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [Yet] they cannot help them, while they [themselves] are ready warriors for them.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So do not let their remarks grieve you. We indeed know whatever they hide and whatever they disclose.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Does not man see that We created him from a drop of [seminal] fluid, and, behold, he is an open contender!?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He draws comparisons for Us, and forgets his own creation. He says, 'Who shall revive the bones when they have decayed?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'He will revive them who produced them the first time, and He has knowledge of all creation.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have put iron collars around their necks, which are up to the chins, so their heads are upturned.1

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —He, who made for you fire out of the green tree, and, behold, you light fire from it!

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like of them? Yes indeed! He is the All-creator, the All-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: All His command, when He wills something, is to say to it 'Be,' and it is.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So immaculate is He in whose hand is the dominion of all things and to whom you shall be brought back.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yaseen:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And We have put a barrier before them and a barrier behind them, then We have blind-folded them, so they do not see.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Alif, Lām, Rā. These are the signs of the Wise1 Book.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Their call therein will be, 'O Allah! Immaculate are You!' and their greeting therein will be, 'Peace!' and their concluding call, 'All praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:100 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: No soul may have faith except by Allah's leave, and He lays defilement on those who do not apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:101 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Observe what is in the heavens and the earth.' But neither signs nor warnings avail a people who have no faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:102 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they await anything except the like of the days of those who passed away before them? Say, 'Then wait! I too am waiting along with you.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:103 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We shall deliver Our apostles and those who have faith. Thus it is a must for Us to deliver the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:104 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'O people! if you are in doubt about my religion, then [know that] I do not worship those whom you worship besides Allah. Rather I worship only Allah, who causes you to die, and I have been commanded to be among the faithful,

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:105 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and that: "Dedicate yourself to the religion, as a ḥanīf, and never be one of the polytheists.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:106 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Nor invoke besides Allah that which neither benefits you nor can do you any harm. For if you do so, then you will indeed be among the wrongdoers." '

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:107 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Should Allah visit you with some distress, there is no one to remove it except Him; and should He desire any good for you, none can stand in the way of His grace: He grants it to whomever He wishes of His servants, and He is the All-forgiving, the All-merciful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:108 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'O mankind! The truth has already come to you from your Lord. Whoever is guided, is guided only for [the good of] his own soul, and whoever goes astray, goes astray only to its detriment, and it is not my business to watch over you.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:109 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And follow that which is revealed to you, and be patient until Allah issues [His] judgement, and He is the best of judges.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were Allah to hasten ill1 for mankind with their haste for good, their term would have been over. But We leave those who do not expect to encounter Us bewildered in their rebellion.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When distress befalls man, he supplicates Us, [lying] on his side, sitting, or standing; but when We remove his distress, he passes on as if he had never supplicated Us concerning the distress that had befallen him. To the profligate is thus presented as decorous what they have been doing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We destroyed [several] generations before you when they perpetrated wrongs: their apostles brought them manifest proofs, but they would not have faith. Thus do We requite the guilty lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then We made you successors on the earth after them that We may observe how you will act.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Our manifest signs are recited to them, those who do not expect to encounter Us say, 'Bring a Qur'ān other than this, or alter it.' Say, 'I may not alter it of my own accord. I follow only what is revealed to me. Indeed should I disobey my Lord, I fear the punishment of a tremendous day.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Had Allah [so] wished, I would not have recited it to you, nor would He have made it known to you, for I have dwelled among you for a lifetime before it. Do you not apply reason?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So who is a greater wrongdoer than him who fabricates a lie against Allah, or denies His signs? Indeed the guilty will not be felicitous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They worship besides Allah that which neither causes them any harm, nor brings them any benefit, and they say, 'These are our intercessors with Allah.' Say, 'Will you inform Allah about something He does not know in the heavens or on the earth?' Immaculate is He and exalted above [having] any partners that they ascribe [to Him]!

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Mankind were but a single [religious] community; then they differed. And were it not for a prior decree of your Lord, decision would have been made between them concerning that about which they differ.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Does it seem odd to these people that We have revealed to a man from among themselves, [declaring], 'Warn mankind, and give good news to the faithful that they are in good standing with their Lord'? The faithless say, 'This is indeed a plain magician.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'Why has not some sign1 been sent down to him from his Lord?' Say, '[The knowledge of] the Unseen belongs only to Allah. So wait. I too am waiting along with you.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When We let people taste [Our] mercy after a distress that has befallen them, behold, they scheme against Our signs! Say, 'Allah is more swift at devising.' Indeed Our messengers write down what you scheme.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who carries you across land and sea. When you are in the ships, and they sail with them with a favourable wind, rejoicing in it, there comes upon them a tempestuous wind and waves assail them from every side, and they think that they are besieged, they invoke Allah putting exclusive faith in Him, 'If You deliver us from this, we will surely be among the grateful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But when He delivers them, behold, they commit violations on the earth unduly! O mankind! Your violations are only to your own detriment. [These are] the wares of the life of this world; then to Us will be your return, whereat We will inform you concerning what you used to do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The parable of the life of this world is that of water which We send down from the sky. It mingles with the earth's vegetation from which humans and cattle eat. When the earth puts on its luster and is adorned, and its inhabitants think they have power over it, Our edict comes to it, by night or day, whereat We turn it into a mown field, as if it did not flourish the day before. Thus do We elaborate the signs for a people who reflect.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah invites to the abode of peace, and He guides whomever He wishes to a straight path.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Those who are virtuous shall receive the best reward and an enhancement. Neither dust nor abasement shall overcast their faces. They shall be the inhabitants of paradise, and they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For those who have committed misdeeds, the requital of a misdeed shall be its like, and they shall be overcast by abasement. They shall have no one to protect [them] from Allah. [They will be] as if their faces were covered with dark patches of the night. They shall be the inmates of the Fire, and they shall remain in it [forever].

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On the day when We gather them all together, We shall say to those who ascribe partners [to Allah], 'Stay where you are —you and your partners!' Then We shall set them apart from one another, and their partners1 will say, 'It was not us that you worshipped.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah suffices as a witness between you and us. We were indeed unaware of your worship.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and the earth in six days, and then settled on the Throne, directing the command.1 There is no intercessor, except by His leave. That is Allah, your Lord! So worship Him. Will you not then take admonition?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There every soul will examine what it has sent in advance, and they will be returned to Allah, their real master, and what they used to fabricate will forsake them.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Who provides for you out of the sky and the earth? Who controls [your] hearing and sight, and who brings forth the living from the dead and brings forth the dead from the living, and who directs the command?' They will say, 'Allah.' Say, 'Will you not then be wary [of Him]?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: That, then, is Allah, your true Lord. So what is there after the truth except error? Then where are you being led away?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Thus the word of your Lord became due against those who transgress that they shall not have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Is there anyone among your partners who originates the creation and then brings it back?' Say, 'Allah originates the creation, then He will bring it back.' Then where do you stray?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Is there anyone among your partners who may guide to the truth?' Say, 'Allah guides to the truth. Is He who guides to the truth worthier to be followed, or he who is not guided unless he is shown the way? What is the matter with you? How do you judge?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Most of them just follow conjecture; indeed conjecture is no substitute for the truth. Indeed Allah knows best what they do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: This Qur'ān could not have been fabricated by anyone besides Allah; rather it is a confirmation of what was [revealed] before it, and an elaboration of the Book, there is no doubt in it, from the Lord of all the worlds.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they say, 'He has fabricated it?' Say, 'Then bring a sūrah like it, and invoke whomever you can, besides Allah, should you be truthful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Rather, they deny that whose knowledge they do not comprehend, and whose explanation has not yet come to them. Those who were before them denied likewise. So observe how was the fate of the wrongdoers!

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: To Him will be the return of you all —[that is] Allah's true promise. Indeed He originates the creation, then He will bring it back that He may reward those who have faith and do righteous deeds with justice. As for the faithless, they shall have boiling water for drink, and a painful punishment because of what they used to defy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Some of them believe in it, and some of them do not believe in it, and your Lord best knows the agents of corruption.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If they deny you, say, 'My deeds belong to me and your deeds belong to you: you are absolved of what I do and I am absolved of what you do.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There are some of them who prick up their ears at you. But can you make the deaf hear even if they do not apply reason?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And there are some of them who observe you. But can you guide the blind even if they do not perceive?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:44 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed Allah does not wrong people in the least; rather it is people who wrong themselves.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:45 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: On the day He will gather them [it will be] as if they had not remained [in the world] except for an hour of the day getting acquainted with one another. They are certainly losers who deny the encounter with Allah, and they are not guided.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:46 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whether We show you a part of what We promise them, or take you away [before that], [in any case] their return will be to Us. Then Allah will be witness to what they do.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:47 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is an apostle1 for every nation; so when their apostle comes, judgement is made between them with justice, and they are not wronged.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:48 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'When will this promise be fulfilled, should you be truthful?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:49 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'I have no control over any benefit for myself nor [over] any harm except what Allah may wish. There is a time for every nation: when their time comes, they shall not defer it by a single hour nor shall they advance it.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:5 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who made the sun a radiance and the moon a light, and ordained its phases that you might know the number of years and the calculation [of time]. Allah did not create all that except with reason. He elaborates the signs for a people who have knowledge.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:50 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Tell me, should His punishment overtake you by night or day, [you will not be able to avert it]; so what part of it do the guilty seek to hasten?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:51 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'What! Do you believe it when it has befallen? Now? While you would seek to hasten it [earlier]?!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:52 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then it will be said to those who were wrongdoers, 'Taste the everlasting punishment. Shall you be requited except for what you used to earn?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:53 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They inquire of you, 'Is it true?' Say, 'Yes! By my Lord, it is true, and you cannot thwart [Him].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:54 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Were any soul that has done wrong to possess whatever there is on the earth, it would surely offer it for ransom. They will hide their remorse when they sight the punishment; and judgement will be made between them with justice and they will not be wronged.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:55 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Look! To Allah indeed belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Look! Allah's promise is indeed true; but most of them do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:56 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who gives life and brings death, and to Him you shall be brought back.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:57 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O mankind! There has certainly come to you an advice from your Lord, and a cure for what is in the breasts, and a guidance and mercy for the faithful.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:58 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'In Allah's grace and His mercy— let them rejoice in that! It is better than what they amass.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:59 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Have you regarded what Allah has sent down for you of [His] provision, whereupon you made some of it unlawful and [some] lawful?' Say, 'Did Allah give you the sanction [to do so], or do you fabricate a lie against Allah?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:6 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed in the alternation of night and day, and whatever Allah has created in the heavens and the earth, there are surely signs for a people who are Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:60 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: What is the idea of those who fabricate lies against Allah [concerning their situation] on the Day of Resurrection? Indeed Allah is gracious to mankind, but most of them do not give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:61 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You do not engage in any work, neither do you recite any part of the Qur'ān, nor do you perform any deed without Our being witness over you when you are engaged therein. Not an atom's weight escapes your Lord in the earth or in the sky, nor [is there] anything smaller than that nor bigger, but it is in a manifest Book.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:62 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Look! The friends of Allah will indeed have no fear nor will they grieve.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:63 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —Those who have faith, and are Godwary.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:64 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: For them is good news in the life of this world and in the Hereafter. (There is no altering the words of Allah.) That is the great success.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:65 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do not grieve at their remarks; indeed all might belongs to Allah; He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:66 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Look! To Allah indeed belongs whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth. And what do they pursue who invoke partners besides Allah? They merely follow conjectures and they just make surmises.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:67 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: It is He who made the night for you, that you may rest in it, and the day to provide visibility. There are indeed signs in that for people who listen.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:68 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They say, 'Allah has taken a son!' Immaculate is He! He is the All-sufficient. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. You have no authority for this [statement]. Do you attribute to Allah what you do not know?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:69 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'Indeed those who fabricate lies against Allah will not be felicitous.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:7 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who do not expect to encounter Us and who are pleased with the life of this world and satisfied with it, and those who are oblivious of Our signs

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:70 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: An enjoyment in this world; then to Us shall be their return, then We shall make them taste the severe punishment because of what they used to defy.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:71 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Relate to them the account of Noah when he said to his people, 'O my people! If my stay [among you] be hard on you and [also] my reminding you of Allah's signs, [for my part] I have put my trust in Allah. So conspire together, along with your partners,1 leaving nothing vague in your plan, then carry it out against me without giving me any respite.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:72 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: If you turn your back [on me], I do not ask any reward from you; my reward lies only with Allah and I have been commanded to be of those who submit [to Allah].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:73 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But they impugned him. So We delivered him and those who were with him in the ark and We made them the successors,1 and We drowned those who denied Our signs. So observe how was the fate of those who were warned!

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:74 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then after him We sent [other] apostles to their people. They brought them manifest proofs, but they would not believe something they had denied before. Thus do We seal the hearts of the transgressors.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:75 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then, after them, We sent Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his elite with Our signs, but they acted arrogantly and they were a guilty lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:76 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the truth from Us came to them, they said, 'This is indeed plain magic!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:77 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Moses said, 'Do you say of the truth when it comes to you [that it is magic]? Is this magic? Magicians do not find salvation.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:78 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Have you come to us to turn us away from what we found our fathers following, so that supremacy may be yours in the land? We will not believe in the two of you.'1

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:79 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Pharaoh said, 'Bring me every expert magician.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:8 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: —it is they whose refuge shall be the Fire because of what they used to earn.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:80 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when the magicians came, Moses said to them, 'Throw down what you have to throw.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:81 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when they threw down [their sticks and ropes], Moses said, 'What you have produced is magic. Indeed Allah will bring it to naught presently. Indeed Allah does not foster the efforts of those who cause corruption.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:82 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Allah will confirm the truth with His words, though the guilty should be averse.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:83 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But none believed in Moses except some youths from among his people, for the fear of Pharaoh and his elite that he would persecute them. For Pharaoh was indeed a tyrant in the land, and indeed he was an unrestrained [despot].

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:84 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And Moses said, 'O my people! If you have faith in Allah, put your trust in Him, if you have submitted [to Him].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:85 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Whereat they said, 'In Allah we have put our trust.' 'Our Lord! Do not make us a [means of] test for the wrongdoing lot,

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:86 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: and deliver us by Your mercy from the faithless lot.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:87 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We revealed to Moses and his brother [saying], 'Settle your people in the city,1 and let your houses face each other,2 and maintain the prayer, and give good news to the faithful.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:88 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Moses said, 'Our Lord! You have given Pharaoh and his elite glamour and wealth in the life of this world, our Lord, that they may lead [people] astray from Your way! Our Lord! Blot out their wealth and harden their hearts so that they do not believe until they sight the painful punishment.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:89 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Said He, 'Your1 supplication has already been granted. So be steadfast, and do not follow the way of those who do not know.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:9 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those who have faith and do righteous deeds, their Lord guides them by the means of their faith. Streams will run for them in gardens of bliss.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:90 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We carried the Children of Israel across the sea, whereat Pharaoh and his troops pursued them out of defiance and aggression. When overtaken by drowning, he called out, 'I believe that there is no god except Him in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am one of those who submit [to Him]!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:91 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: [He was told,] 'What! Now? When you have been disobedient heretofore and were among the agents of corruption?!

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:92 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So today We shall deliver your body so that you may be a sign for those who come after you.' Indeed many of the people are oblivious to Our signs.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:93 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Certainly We settled the Children of Israel in a worthy settlement and We provided them with all the good things, and they did not differ until [after] the knowledge had come to them. Your Lord will indeed judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that about which they used to differ.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:94 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So if you are in doubt about what We have sent down to you, ask those who read the Book [revealed] before you. The truth has certainly come to you from your Lord; so do not be among the skeptics.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:95 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And do not be of those who deny the signs of Allah, [for] then you shall be among the losers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:96 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed those against whom your Lord's judgement has become due will not have faith,

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:97 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: even though every sign were to come to them, until they sight the painful punishment.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:98 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Why has there not been any town that might believe, so that its belief might benefit it, except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in the life of this world, and We provided for them for a while.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yunus:99 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And had your Lord wished, all those who are on earth would have believed. Would you then force people until they become faithful?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:1 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Alif, Lām, Rā. These are the signs of the Manifest Book.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:10 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: One of them said, 'Do not kill Joseph, but throw him into the recess of some well so that some caravan may pick him up, if you are to do [anything].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:100 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And he seated his parents high upon the throne, and they fell down prostrate before him. He said, 'Father! This is the fulfillment of my dream of long ago, which my Lord has made come true. He was certainly gracious to me when He brought me out of the prison and brought you over from the desert after that Satan had incited ill feeling between me and my brothers. Indeed my Lord is all-attentive in bringing about what He wishes. Indeed He is the All-knowing, the All-wise.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:101 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: 'My Lord! You have granted me a share in the kingdom, and taught me the interpretation of dreams. Originator of the heavens and earth! You are my guardian in this world and the Hereafter! Let my death be in submission [to You], and unite me with the Righteous.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:102 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: These are accounts of the Unseen which We reveal to you, and you were not with them when they conspired together and schemed.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:103 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Yet most people will not have faith, however eager you should be.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:104 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You do not ask them any reward for it: it1 is just a reminder for all the nations.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:105 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: How many a sign there is in the heavens and the earth that they pass by while they are disregardful of it!

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:106 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And most of them do not believe in Allah without ascribing partners to Him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:107 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Do they feel secure from being overtaken by a blanket punishment from Allah, or being overtaken by the Hour, suddenly, while they are unaware?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:108 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Say, 'This is my way. I summon to Allah with insight —I and he who follows me. Immaculate is Allah, and I am not one of the polytheists.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:109 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We did not send [any apostles] before you except as men to whom We revealed from among the people of the towns. Have they not traveled over the land so that they may observe how was the fate of those who were before them? And the abode of the Hereafter is surely better for those who are Godwary. Do you not apply reason?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:11 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Father! Why is it that you do not trust us with Joseph? We are indeed his well-wishers.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:110 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When the apostles lost hope1 and they thought that they had been told lies,2 Our help came to them, and We delivered whomever We wished, and Our punishment will not be averted from the guilty lot.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:111 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There is certainly a moral in their accounts for those who possess intellect. This [Qur'ān] is not a fabricated discourse; rather it is a confirmation of what was [revealed] before it, and an elaboration1 of all things, and a guidance and mercy for a people who have faith.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:12 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Let him go with us tomorrow so that he may eat lots of fruits and play, and we will indeed take [good] care of him.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:13 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'It really upsets me that you should take him away, and I fear the wolf may eat him while you are oblivious of him.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:14 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Should the wolf eat him while we are a hardy group, then we will indeed be losers!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:15 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when they took him away and conspired to put him into the recess of a well, We revealed to him, '[A day will come when] you will surely inform them about this affair of theirs while they are not aware [of your identity].'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:16 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: In the evening, they came weeping to their father.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:17 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They said, 'Father! We had gone racing and left Joseph with our things, whereat the wolf ate him. But you will not believe us even if we spoke truly.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:18 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they produced sham blood on his shirt. He said, 'Rather your souls have made a matter seem decorous to you. Yet patience is graceful, and Allah is my resort against what you allege.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:19 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And there came a caravan, and they sent their water-drawer, who let down his bucket. 'Good news!' he said. 'This is a young boy!' So they hid him as [a piece of] merchandise, and Allah knew best what they were doing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:2 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Indeed We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'ān so that you may apply reason.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:20 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: And they sold him for a cheap price, a few dirhams, for they set small store by him.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:21 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The man from Egypt who had bought him said to his wife, 'Give him an honourable place [in the household].1 Maybe he will be useful to us, or we may adopt him as a son.' Thus We established Joseph in the land and that We might teach him the interpretation of dreams. Allah has [full] command of His affairs, but most people do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:22 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When he came of age, We gave him judgement and [sacred] knowledge, and thus do We reward the virtuous.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:23 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: The woman in whose house he was solicited him. She closed the doors and said, 'Come!!' He said, 'God forbid! Indeed He is my Lord; He has given me a good abode.1 Indeed the wrongdoers are not felicitous.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:24 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: She certainly made for him; and he would have made for her [too] had he not beheld the proof of his Lord. So it was, that We might turn away from him all evil and indecency. He was indeed one of Our dedicated servants.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:25 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: They raced to the door, and she tore his shirt from behind, and they ran into her husband at the door. She said, 'What is to be the requital of him who has evil intentions for your wife except imprisonment or a painful punishment?'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:26 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'It was she who solicited me.' A witness of her own household testified: 'If his shirt is torn from the front, she tells the truth and he lies.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:27 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: But if his shirt is torn from behind, then she lies and he tells the truth.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:28 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So when he saw that his shirt was torn from behind, he said, 'This is [a case] of you women's guile! Your guile is great indeed!

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:29 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Joseph, let this matter alone, and you, woman, plead for forgiveness for your sin, for you have indeed been erring.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:3 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: We will recount to you the best of narratives1 in what We have revealed to you of this Qur'ān, and indeed prior to it you were among those who are unaware [of it].

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:30 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Some of the townswomen said, 'The chieftain's wife has solicited her slave boy! He has captivated her love. Indeed we see her to be in manifest error.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:31 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When she heard of their machinations, she sent for them and arranged a repast, and gave each of them a knife, and said [to Joseph], 'Come out before them.' So when they saw him, they marveled at him and cut their hands [absent-mindedly], and they said, 'Good heavens! This is not a human being! This is but a noble angel!'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:32 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: She said, 'He is the one on whose account you blamed me. Certainly I did solicit him, but he was continent, and if he does not do what I bid him, surely he shall be imprisoned and be among the abased.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:33 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'My Lord! The prison is dearer to me than to what they invite me. If You do not turn away their schemes from me, then I will incline towards them and become one of the senseless.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:34 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: So his Lord answered him and turned away their stratagems from him. Indeed He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:35 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then it appeared to them,1 after they had seen all the signs [of his innocence], that they should confine him for some time.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:36 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: There entered the prison two youths along with him. One of them said, 'I dreamt that I am pressing grapes.' The other said, 'I dreamt that I am carrying bread on my head from which the birds are eating.' 'Inform us of its interpretation,' [they said], 'for indeed we see you to be a virtuous man.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:37 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: He said, 'Before the meals you are served come to you I will inform you of its interpretation. That is among things my Lord has taught me. Indeed I renounce the creed of the people who have no faith in Allah and who [also] disbelieve in the Hereafter.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:38 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: I follow the creed of my fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. It is not for us to ascribe any partner to Allah. That is by virtue of Allah's grace upon us and upon all mankind, but most people do not give thanks.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:39 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O my prison mates! Are different masters better, or Allah, the One, the All-paramount?

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:4 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: When Joseph said to his father, 'Father! I saw eleven planets,1 and the sun and the moon: I saw them prostrating themselves before me.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:40 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: You do not worship besides Him but [mere] names that you and your fathers have coined, for which Allah has not sent down any authority. Sovereignty belongs only to Allah. He has commanded you to worship none except Him. That is the upright religion, but most people do not know.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:41 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: O my prison mates! As for one of you, he will serve wine to his master, and as for the other, he will be crucified, and vultures will eat from his head. The matter about which you inquire has been decided.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:42 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
item.description: Then he said to the one whom he knew would be delivered from among the two: 'Mention me to your master.' But Satan caused him to forget mentioning [it] to his master. So he remained in the prison for several years.

item.title: bil-Quran: Yusuf:43 with Tafsir The Qur'an With a Phrase-by-Phrase English Translation
