Thus has the Word of your Lord been justified against those who disbelieved, that they will be the dwellers of the Fire (40:6).One of the Attributes of the Disbelievers is That they dispute the Ayat of Allah - and The Consequences of thatAllah…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:40 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Whoever does an evil deed will not be recompensed except by the like thereof; but whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - those will enter Paradise, being given provision therein without account. See 40:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:41 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire? And O my people! How is it that I call you to salvation while you call me to the Fire! (40:41). "You invite me to disbelieve in Allah, and to join partners in worship with Him of which I have no knowledge; and I invite you to the Almighty, the Oft-Forgiving! (40:42). "'La Jarama', you call me to one that does not have a claim in this world or in the Hereafter. And our return will be to Allah, and the transgressors, they shall be the dwellers of the Fire! (40:43). "And you will remember what I am telling you, and my affair I leave it to Allah. Verily, Allah is the All-Seer of (His) servants (40:44). So, Allah saved…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:42 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: You invite me to disbelieve in Allah and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.1 See 40:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:43 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Assuredly, that to which you invite me has no (response to a) supplication in this world or in the Hereafter; and indeed, our return is to Allah, and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the Fire. See 40:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:44 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And you will remember what I (now) say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed, Allah is Seeing of (His) servants." See 40:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:45 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So Allah protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment. See 40:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:46 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening.1 And the Day the Hour appears (it will be said), "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment." See 40:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:47 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (mention) when they will argue within the Fire, and the weak will say to those who had been arrogant, "Indeed, we were (only) your followers, so will you relieve us of a share of the Fire?" And, when they will dispute in the Fire, the weak will say to those who were arrogant: "Verily, we followed you, can you then take from us some portion of the Fire? (40:47). Those who were arrogant will say: "We are all (together) in this (Fire)! Verily, Allah has judged between (His) servants! (40:48). And those in the Fire will say to the keepers (angels) of Hell: "Call upon your Lord to lighten for us the torment for a day! (40:49). They will say: "Did there not come to you, your Messengers with (clear) evidences" They will say: "Yes." They will reply: "Then…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:48 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Those who had been arrogant will say, "Indeed, all (of us) are in it. Indeed, Allah has judged between the servants." See 40:47

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:49 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, "Supplicate your Lord to lighten for us a day from the punishment." See 40:47

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The people of Nuh denied before them and the (disbelieving) factions after them, and every nation intended (a plot) for their messenger to seize him, and they disputed by (using) falsehood to (attempt to) invalidate thereby the truth. So I seized them, and how (terrible) was My penalty. See 40:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:50 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will say, "Did there not come to you your messengers with clear proofs?" They will say, "Yes." They will reply, "Then supplicate (yourselves), but the supplication of the disbelievers is not except in error (i.e., futility)." See 40:47

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:51 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, We will support Our messengers and those who believe during the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will stand. The Victory of the Messengers and the Believersإِنَّا لَنَنصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ فِى الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَاVerily, We will indeed make victorious Our Messengers and those who believe in this world's lifeAs-Suddi, "Allah never sends a Messenger to a people and they kill him or some of the believers who call them to the truth, then that generation passes away, but He then sends them someone who will support their call and will seek vengeance for their blood from those who did that to them in this world. So the Prophets and believers may be killed in this world, but their call will prevail in this world." Allah granted victory to His Prophet Muhammad SAW and his…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:52 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The Day their excuse will not benefit the wrongdoers, and they will have the curse, and they will have the worst home (i.e., Hell). See 40:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:53 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We had certainly given Musa guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture. See 40:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:54 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: As guidance and a reminder for those of understanding. See 40:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:55 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So be patient, (O Muḥammad). Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And ask forgiveness for your sin1 and exalt (Allah) with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning. See 40:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:56 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah without (any) evidence having come to them - there is not within their breasts except pride, (the extent of) which they cannot reach. So seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Seeing. See 40:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:57 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most of the people do not know. The creation of the heavens and the earth is indeed greater than the creation of mankind; yet, most of the people do not know (40:57). And not equal are the blind and those who see; nor those who believe, and do righteous good deeds, and those who do evil. Little do you remember (40:58). Verily, the Hour is surely coming, there is no doubt about it, yet most men believe not (40:59).Life after DeathAllah tells us that He will bring back His creation on the Day of Resurrection. That is very easy for Him, because He created the heavens and the earth, and creating them is greater than creating mankind, the first time and when He creates them…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:58 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And not equal are the blind and the seeing, nor are those who believe and do righteous deeds and the evildoer. Little do you remember. See 40:57

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:59 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - but most of the people do not believe. See 40:57

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And thus has the word (i.e., decree) of your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire. See 40:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:60 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And your Lord says, "Call upon Me; I will respond to you." Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell (rendered) contemptible. And your Lord said: "Call upon Me, I will answer you. Verily, those who scorn My worship they will surely enter Hell in humiliation! (40:60). The Command to call upon Allah By His grace and kindness, Allah encourages His servants to call upon Him, and He guarantees to respond. Sufyan Ath-Thawri used to say: "O You Who love most those who ask of You, and O You Who hate most those who do not ask of You, and there is no one like that apart from You, O Lord." This was recorded by Ibn Abi Hatim. Similarly; the poet said: "Allah hates not to be asked, and the son of Adam hates to be asked." Qatadah said…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:61 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is Allah who made for you the night that you may rest therein and the day giving sight.1 Indeed, Allah is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of them are not grateful. Allah, it is He Who has made the night for you that you may rest therein and the day for you to see. Truly, Allah is full of bounty to mankind; yet, most of mankind give no thanks (40:61). That is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of all things, La ilaha ila Huwa. How then are you turning away (40:62). Thus were turned away those who used to deny the Ayat of Allah (40:63). Allah, it is He Who has made for you the earth as a dwelling place and the sky as a canopy, and has given you shape and made your shapes…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:62 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That is Allah, your Lord, Creator of all things; there is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded? See 40:61

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:63 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Thus were those (before you) deluded who were rejecting the signs of Allah. See 40:61

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:64 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is Allah who made for you the earth a place of settlement and the sky a structure (i.e., ceiling) and formed you and perfected your forms and provided you with good things. That is Allah, your Lord; then blessed is Allah, Lord of the worlds. See 40:61

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:65 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He is the Ever-Living;1 there is no deity except Him, so call upon Him, (being) sincere to Him in religion. (All) praise is (due) to Allah, Lord of the worlds. See 40:61

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:66 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, (O Muḥammad), "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides Allah once the clear proofs have come to me from my Lord, and I have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds." Say: I have been forbidden to worship those whom you worship besides Allah, since there have come to me evidences from my Lord; and I am commanded to submit to the Lord of all that exists (40:66). It is He, Who has created you from dust, then from a Nutfah then from a clot (a piece of coagulated blood), then brings you forth as an infant, then (makes you grow) to reach the age of full strength, and afterwards to be old – though some among you die before – and that you reach an appointed term in order that…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:67 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is He who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot; then He brings you out as a child; then (He develops you) that you reach your (time of) maturity, then (further) that you become elders. And among you is he who is taken in death before (that), so that you reach a specified term;1 and perhaps you will use reason. See 40:66

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:68 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He it is who gives life and causes death; and when He decrees a matter, He but says to it, "Be," and it is. See 40:66

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:69 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do you not consider those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah - how are they averted? See you not those who dispute about the Ayat of Allah How are they turning away (40:69). Those who deny the Book, and that with which We sent Our Messengers they will come to know (40:70). When iron collars will be rounded over their necks, and the chains, they shall be dragged along (40:71). In the boiling water, then they will be burned in the Fire (40:72). Then it will be said to them: Where are (all) those whom you used to consider partners (40:73). "Besides Allah?" They will say: "They have vanished from us. Nay, we did not call upon anything before." Thus Allah leads astray the disbelievers (40:74). That was because you had been exulting in the earth without any right,…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Those (angels) who carry the Throne and those around it exalt (Allah) with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed, (saying), "Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire. Those (angels) who bear the Throne (of Allah) and those around it glorify the praises of their Lord, and believe in Him, and ask forgiveness for those who believe (saying): "Our Lord! You comprehend all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who repent and follow Your way, and save them from the torment of the blazing Fire (40:7). Our Lord! And make them enter the 'Adn (Eternal) Gardens which you have promised them – and to the righteous among…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:70 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Those who deny the Book (i.e., the Qur’ān) and that with which We sent Our messengers - they are going to know. See 40:69

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:71 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: When the shackles are around their necks and the chains; they will be dragged. See 40:69

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:72 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: In boiling water; then in the Fire they will be filled (with flame). See 40:69

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:73 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then it will be said to them, "Where is that which you used to associate (with Him in worship). See 40:69

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:74 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Other than Allah?" They will say, "They have departed from us; rather, we did not used to invoke previously anything." Thus does Allah put astray the disbelievers. See 40:69

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:75 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (The angels will say), "That was because you used to exult upon the earth without right and you used to behave insolently. See 40:69

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:76 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant." See 40:69

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:77 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So be patient, (O Muḥammad); indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And whether We show you some of what We have promised them or We take you in death, it is to Us they will be returned. So be patient, verily, the promise of Allah is true and whether We show you some part of what We have promised them, or We cause you to die, then still it is to Us they all shall be returned (40:77). And, indeed We have sent Messengers before you, of some of them We have related to you their story. And of some We have not related to you their story, and it was not given to any Messenger that he should bring a sign except by the leave of Allah. But, when comes the commandment of Allah, the matter will be…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:78 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We have already sent messengers before you. Among them are those (whose stories) We have related to you, and among them are those (whose stories) We have not related to you. And it was not for any messenger to bring a sign (or verse) except by permission of Allah. So when the command of Allah comes, it will be concluded (i.e., judged) in truth, and the falsifiers will thereupon lose (all). See 40:77

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:79 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is Allah who made for you the grazing animals upon which you ride, and some of them you eat. Allah, it is He Who has made cattle for you, that you may ride on some of them, and of some you eat (40:79). And you have (many other) benefits from them, and that you may reach by their means a desire that is in your breasts, and on them and on ships you are carried (40:80). And He shows you His Ayat. Which, then of the Ayat of Allah do you deny (40:81).The Cattle are Also a Blessing from Allah and a Sign from HimAllah reminds His servants of His blessing in that He created the cattle (Al-An'am) for them, which refers to camels, cows and sheep; some of them they ride and some of them they eat. Camels…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. See 40:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:80 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And for you therein are (other) benefits and that you may realize upon them a need which is in your breasts;1 and upon them and upon ships you are carried. See 40:79

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:81 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And He shows you His signs. So which of the signs of Allah do you deny? See 40:79

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:82 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? They were more numerous than themselves and greater in strength and in impression on the land, but they were not availed by what they used to earn. Have they not traveled through the earth and seen what was the end of those before them? They were more in number than them and mightier in strength, and in the traces in the land; yet all that they used to earn availed them not (40:82). Then when their Messengers came to them with clear proofs, they were glad (and proud) with that which they had of the knowledge (of worldly things). And that at which they used to mock, surrounded them (40:83). So when they saw Our punishment, they said: We believe in Allah Alone…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:83 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they (merely) rejoiced in what they had of knowledge, but they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule. See 40:82

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:84 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when they saw Our punishment, they said, "We believe in Allah alone and disbelieve in that which we used to associate with Him." See 40:82

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:85 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But never did their faith benefit them once they saw Our punishment. (It is) the established way of Allah which has preceded among His servants. And the disbelievers thereupon lost (all). See 40:82

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaafir:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And protect them from the evil consequences (of their deeds). And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment." See 40:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming (event)? لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِن جُوعٍWhich will neither nourish nor avail against hunger.This means that the intent in eating it will not be achieved, and nothing harmful will be repelled by it.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: In an elevated garden. See 88:8

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.1 See 88:8

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Within it is a flowing spring. See 88:8

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Within it are couches raised high. See 88:8

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And cups put in place. See 88:8

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And cushions lined up. See 88:8

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And carpets spread around. See 88:8

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created? Do they not look at the camels, how they are created (88:17). And at the heaven, how it is raised (88:18). And at the mountains, how they are rooted (88:19). And at the earth, how it is outspread (88:20). So remind them – you are only one who reminds (88:21). You are not a Musaytir over them (88:22). Save the one who turns away and disbelieves (88:23). Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment (88:24). Verily, to Us will be their return (88:25). Then verily, for Us will be their reckoning (88:26).The Exhortation to Look at the Creation of the Camel, the Heaven, the Mountains and the EarthAllah commands His servants to look at His creations that prove His power and greatness. He says:أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And at the sky - how it is raised? See 88:17

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And at the mountains - how they are erected? See 88:17

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Some) faces, that Day, will be humbled. See 88:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And at the earth - how it is spread out? See 88:17

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So remind, (O Muḥammad); you are only a reminder. See 88:17

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: You are not over them a controller. See 88:17

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: However, he who turns away and disbelieves. See 88:17

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment. See 88:17

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, to Us is their return. See 88:17

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then indeed, upon Us is their account. See 88:17

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Working (hard) and exhausted.1 See 88:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will (enter to) burn in an intensely hot Fire. See 88:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will be given drink from a boiling spring. See 88:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant. See 88:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger. See 88:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Other) faces, that Day, will show pleasure. Faces that Day will be joyful (88:8). Glad with their endeavor (88:9). In a lofty Paradise (88:10). Where they shall neither hear harmful speech nor falsehood (88:11). Therein will be a running spring (88:12). Therein will be thrones raised high (88:13). And cups set at hand (88:14). And Namariq, set in rows (88:15). And Zarabi, spread out (Mabthuthah) (88:16).The Condition of the People of Paradise on the Day of JudgementAfter mentioning the situation of the wretched people, Allah changes the discussion to mention those who will be happy. He says:وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍFaces that Day.Meaning: on the Day of Judgement.نَّاعِمَةٌwill be joyful,Meaning: pleasure will be noticeable in them (those faces). This will only occur due to their striving. Sufyan said:لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌGlad with their endeavor."They will be pleased with their deeds." Then Allah says:فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍIn…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Ghaashiya:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: With their effort (they are) satisfied. See 88:8

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The Inevitable Reality. لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةًThat We might make it an admonition for youThe pronoun "it" here refers to the species of the object (ships) due to the general meaning alluding to this. Thus, the meaning is, 'We caused its type of creation (ships) to remain (in the earth) for you, so that you ride upon the currents of the water in the seas. ' This is as Allah says:وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الْفُلْكِ وَالْأَنْعَامِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ - لِتَسْتَوُوا عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا اسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِand has appointed for you ships and cattle on which you ride; In order that you may mount on their backs, and then may remember the favor of your Lord when you mount thereon (43:12-13)And Allah said:وَآيَةٌ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ - وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِ مَا يَرْكَبُونَAnd an Ayah for…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding (in severity). See 69:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you (i.e., your ancestors) in the sailing ship.1 See 69:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That We might make it for you a reminder and (that) a conscious ear would be conscious of it. See 69:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast. Then when the Trumpet will be blown with one blowing (69:13). And the earth and the mountains shall be removed from their places, and crushed with a single crushing (69:14). Then on that Day shall the Event occur (69:15). And the heaven will be rent asunder, for that Day it will be frail and torn up (69:16). And the angels will be on its sides, and eight angels will, that Day, bear the Throne of your Lord above them (69:17). That Day shall you be brought to Judgement, not a secret of you will be hidden (69:18).A Mention of the Horrors of the Day of JudgementAllah informs of the horrors that will take place on the Day of Judgement. The first of these events is the blowing of fright (into the…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow (i.e., stroke). See 69:13

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then on that Day, the Occurrence (i.e., Resurrection) will occur. See 69:13

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the heaven will split (open), for that Day it is infirm.1 See 69:13

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight (of them). See 69:13

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That Day, you will be exhibited (for judgement); not hidden among you is anything concealed.1 See 69:13

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record! Then as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Here! read my Record! (69:19). "Surely, I did believe that I shall meet my account! (69:20). So, he shall be in a life, well-pleasing (69:21). In a lofty Paradise (69:22). The fruits in bunches whereof will be low and near at hand (69:23). Eat and drink at ease for that which you have sent on before you in days past (69:24).The Happiness of the Person Who will Receive His Book in His Right Hand and His Good SituationAllah informs of the happiness of those who receive their Book in the right hand on the Day of Judgement and being pleased with this. Out of…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: What is the Inevitable Reality? See 69:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account." See 69:19

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So he will be in a pleasant life. See 69:19

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: In an elevated garden. See 69:19

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Its (fruit) to be picked hanging near. See 69:19

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (They will be told), "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth1 in the days past." See 69:19

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record. But as for him who will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: I wish that I had not been given my Record!") (69:25). "And that I had never known how my account is! (69:26). "Would that it had been my end! (69:27). "My wealth has not availed me; (69:28). "My power has gone from me! (69:29). (It will be said): "Seize him and fetter him; (69:30). "Then throw him in the blazing Fire (69:31). "Then fasten him on a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits! (69:32). Verily, he used not to believe in Allah, the Most Great (69:33). And urged not the feeding of the poor (69:34). So, no…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And had not known what is my account. See 69:25

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: I wish it (i.e., my death) had been the decisive one.1 See 69:25

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: My wealth has not availed me. See 69:25

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Gone from me is my authority."1 See 69:25

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality? See 69:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Allah will say), "Seize him and shackle him. See 69:25

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then into Hellfire drive him. See 69:25

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him." See 69:25

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great. See 69:25

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor. See 69:25

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:35 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend. See 69:25

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds. See 69:25

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: None will eat it except the sinners. See 69:25

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:38 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So I swear by what you see. So, I swear by whatsoever you see (69:38). And by whatsoever you see not (69:39). That this is verily the word of an honored Messenger (69:40). It is not the word of a poet, little is that you believe (69:41). Nor is it the word of a soothsayer, little is that you remember (69:42). This is the revelation sent down from the Lord of all that exists (69:43).The Qur'an is the Speech of AllahAllah swears by His creation, in which some of His signs can be seen in His creatures. These also indicate the perfection of His Names and Attributes. He then swears by the hidden things that they cannot see. This is an oath swearing that the Qur'an is His Speech, His inspiration and His revelation to His servant and Messenger, whom…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:39 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And what you do not see. See 69:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Thamūd and ʿAad denied the Striking Calamity (i.e., the Resurrection). See 69:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:40 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (That) indeed, it (i.e., the Qur’ān) is the word of a noble Messenger. See 69:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:41 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe. See 69:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:42 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember. See 69:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:43 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (It is) a revelation from the Lord of the worlds. See 69:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:44 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if he (i.e., Muḥammad) had made up about Us some (false) sayings. And if he had forged a false saying concerning Us (69:44). We surely would have seized him by his right hand (69:45). And then We certainly would have cut off Al-Watin from him (69:46). And none of you could have prevented it from him (69:47). And verily, this is a Reminder for those who have Taqwa (69:48). And verily, We know that there are some among you that deny (69:49). And indeed it will be an anguish for the disbeliever (69:50). And verily, it (this Qur'an) is an absolute truth with certainty (69:51). So, glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most Great (69:52).If the Prophet SAW Forged Anything against Allah, Then Allah would Punish HimAllah says:وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَاAnd if he had forged a false saying concerning…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:45 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: We would have seized him by the right hand.1 See 69:44

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:46 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.1 See 69:44

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:47 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And there is no one of you who could prevent (Us) from him. See 69:44

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:48 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, it (i.e., the Qur’ān) is a reminder for the righteous. See 69:44

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:49 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers. See 69:44

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering (blast). See 69:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:50 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, it will be (a cause of) regret upon the disbelievers. See 69:44

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:51 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty. See 69:44

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:52 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great. See 69:44

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming,1 violent wind. See 69:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Which He (i.e., Allah) imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees. See 69:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then do you see of them any remains? See 69:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Haaqqa:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities1 with sin. See 69:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allah,1 and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌHe is Al-Awwal and Al-Akhir, Az-Zahir and Al-Batin. And He is the All-Knower of everything.There are about ten and some odd number of different sayings collected from the scholars of Tafsir regarding the explanation of this Ayah. Al-Bukhari said, "Yahya said, 'Az-Zahir: knowing all things, Al-Batin: knowing all things.'"Our Shaykh Al-Hafiz Al-Mizzi said, "Yahya is Ibn Ziyad Al-Farra', who authored a book entitled Ma'ani Al-Qur'an."There are Hadiths mentioned about this. Among them, Imam Ahmad recorded that Abu Hurayrah said that the Messenger of Allah SAW would recite this supplication while going to bed:اللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمٰوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، مُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَىٰ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And why do you not spend in the cause of Allah while to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest (of Makkah) and fought (and those who did so after it). Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought. But to all Allah has promised the best (reward). And Allah, of what you do, is Aware. See 57:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward? See 57:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, (it will be said), "Your good tidings today are (of) gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment. On the Day you shall see the believing men and the believing women – their light running forward before them and in their right hands. Glad tidings for you this Day! Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise), to dwell therein forever! Truly, this is the great success (57:12). On the Day when the hypocrites men and women will say to the believers: Wait for us! Let us get something from your light!" It will be said: "Go back to your rear! Then seek a light!" So, a wall will be put up between…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: On the (same) Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you1 and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment. See 57:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They (i.e., the hypocrites) will call to them (i.e., the believers), "Were we not with you?" They will say, "Yes, but you afflicted yourselves1 and awaited (misfortune for us) and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allah. And the Deceiver (i.e., Satan) deceived you concerning Allah. See 57:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination." See 57:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allah and what has come down of the truth? And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient. Has not the time yet come for the believers that their hearts should be humble for the remembrance of Allah? And that which has been revealed of the truth, lest they become as those who received the Scripture before, and the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened? And many of them were rebellious (57:16). Know that Allah gives life to the earth after its death! Indeed We have made clear the Ayat to you,…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Know that Allah gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. We have made clear to you the signs; perhaps you will understand.1 See 57:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and (they who) have loaned Allah a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward. Verily, those who give Sadaqat, men and women, and lend Allah handsome loan, it shall be increased manifold (to their credit), and theirs shall be an honorable good reward (57:18). And those who believe in Allah and His Messengers. they are the Siddiqun (true believers) and the martyrs with their Lord. They shall have their reward and their light. But those who disbelieve and deny Our Ayat – they shall be the dwellers of the blazing Fire (57:19).Reward for the Charitable, the True Believers and the Martyrs; and the Destination of the DisbelieversAllah the Exalted describes the reward that He will award to those who…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those who have believed in Allah and His messengers - those are (in the ranks of) the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light.1 But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire. See 57:18

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent. See 57:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose (resulting) plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes (scattered) debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allah and approval. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion. Know that the life of this world is only play and amusement, pomp and mutual boasting among you, and rivalry in respect of wealth and children. (It is) like a rain (Ghayth), thereof the growth is pleasing to the tiller; afterwards it dries up and you see it turning yellow; then it becomes straw. But in the Hereafter (there is) a…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Race (i.e., compete) toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah which He gives to whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty. See 57:20

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register1 before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allah, is easy. No calamity occurs in the earth nor in yourselves but it is inscribed in the Book of Decrees before We bring it into existence. Verily, that is easy for Allah (57:22). In order that you may not grieve at the things over that you fail to get, nor rejoice over that which has been given to you. And Allah likes not prideful boasters (57:23). Those who are misers and enjoin miserliness upon people. And whosoever turns away, then Allah is Rich, Worthy of all praise (57:24).Everything that Affects Mankind, is Duly Measured and DestinedAllah reminds of His measuring and deciding the destiny of all things before He created the creation:مَا أَصَابَ…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult (in pride) over what He has given you. And Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful. See 57:22

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Those) who are stingy and enjoin upon people stinginess. And whoever turns away1 - then indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy. See 57:22

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance that the people may maintain (their affairs) in justice. And We sent down iron, wherein is great military might and benefits for the people, and so that Allah may make evident those who support Him and His messengers unseen. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might. Indeed We have sent Our Messengers with clear proofs, and revealed with them the Scripture and the Mizan that mankind may keep up justice. And We brought forth iron wherein is mighty power, as well as many benefits for mankind, that Allah may test who it is that will help Him (His religion) and His Messengers in the unseen. Verily, Allah is Powerful, Almighty (57:25).The Prophets were Given Miracles and Sent with Truth and…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We have already sent Nuh and Ibrahim and placed in their descendants prophethood and scripture; and among them is he who is guided, but many of them are defiantly disobedient. And indeed, We sent Nuh and Ibrahim, and placed in their offspring prophethood and Scripture. And among them there are some who are guided; but many of them are rebellious (57:26). Then, We sent after them Our Messengers, and We sent Isa the son of Maryam, and gave him the Injil. And We ordained in the hearts of those who followed him, compassion and mercy. But the monasticism which they invented for themselves, We did not prescribe for them, but (they sought it) only to please Allah therewith, but that they did not observe it with the right observance. So, We gave those among them who believed, their (due)…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then We sent following their footsteps (i.e., traditions) Our messengers and followed (them) with Isa, the son of Maryam, and gave him the Gospel. And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except (that they did so) seeking the approval of Allah. But they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave the ones who believed among them their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient. See 57:26

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who have believed, fear Allah and believe in His Messenger; He will (then) give you a double portion of His mercy and make for you a light by which you will walk and forgive you; and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. O you who believe! Have Taqwa of Allah, and believe in His Messenger, He will give you a double portion of His mercy, and He will give you a light by which you shall walk (straight). And He will forgive you. And Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (57:28). So that the People of the Scriptures may know that they have no power whatsoever over the grace of Allah, and that (His) grace is in His Hand to bestow it on whomsoever He wills. And Allah is the Owner of great bounty (57:29).The Believers of the People of…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (This is) so that the People of the Scripture may know that they are not able (to obtain) anything from the bounty of Allah1 and that (all) bounty is in the hand2 of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills. And Allah is the possessor of great bounty. See 57:28

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He is the First1 and the Last,2 the Ascendant3 and the Intimate,4 and He is, of all things, Knowing. See 57:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne.1 He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you2 wherever you are. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing. He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days and then rose (Istawa) over the Throne. He knows what goes into the earth and what comes forth from it, and what descends from the heaven and what ascends thereto. And He is with you wheresoever you may be. And Allah is the All-Seer of what you do (57:4). His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And to Allah return all the matters (57:5). He merges night…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allah are returned (all) matters. See 57:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and He is Knowing of that within the breasts. See 57:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Believe in Allah and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successive inheritors. For those who have believed among you and spent,1 there will be a great reward. Believe in Allah and His Messenger, and spend of that whereof He has made you trustees. And such of you as believe and spend, theirs will be a great reward (57:7). And what is the matter with you that you believe not in Allah! While the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord; and He has indeed taken your covenant, if you are real believers (57:8). It is He Who sends down manifest Ayat to His servant that He may bring you out from darkness into light. And verily, Allah is to you full of kindness, Most Merciful (57:9). And what is the matter with…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And why do you not believe in Allah while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant, if you should (truly) be believers? See 57:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hadid:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is He who sends down upon His Servant (Muḥammad SAW) verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And indeed, Allah is to you Kind and Merciful. See 57:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the (final) Hour is a terrible thing. يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّا أَرْضَعَتْThe Day you shall see it, every nursing mother will forget her nursling,means, she will be distracted by the horror of what she is seeing, which will make her forget the one who is the dearest of all to her and to whom she shows the most compassion. Her shock will make her neglect her infant at the very moment of breastfeeding, Allah says:كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍevery nursing motherAnd He did not say a mother who has an infant of breastfeeding age.عَمَّا أَرْضَعَتْher nurslingmeans, her nursing infant that has not yet been weaned.وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَاand every pregnant one will drop her load,means, before the pregnancy has reached full term, because of the intensity of the horror.وَتَرَى النَّاسَ سُكَارَىٰand…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: "That is for what your hands have put forth and because Allah is not ever unjust to (His) servants." See 22:8

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And of the people is he who worships Allah on an edge.1 If he is touched by good, he is reassured by it; but if he is struck by trial, he turns on his face (to unbelief). He has lost (this) world and the Hereafter. That is what is the manifest loss. And among mankind is he who worships Allah as it were upon the edge: if good befalls him, he is content therewith; but if a Fitnah strikes him, he turns back on his face. He loses both this world and the Hereafter. That is the evident loss (22:11). He calls besides Allah unto that which can neither harm him nor profit him. That is a straying far away (22:12). He calls unto him whose harm is nearer than his profit; certainly an evil Mawla and certainly an evil…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He invokes instead of Allah that which neither harms him nor benefits him. That is what is the extreme error. See 22:11

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He invokes one whose harm is closer than his benefit - how wretched the protector and how wretched the associate. See 22:11

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, Allah will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. Indeed, Allah does what He intends. Truly, Allah will admit those who believe and do righteous good deeds to Gardens underneath which rivers flow. Verily, Allah does what He wills (22:14).The Reward of the RighteousThe mention of the misguided who are doomed is followed by mention of the righteous who are blessed. They are those who believe firmly in their hearts and confirm their faith by their actions, doing all kinds of righteous deeds and avoiding evil actions. Because of this, they will inherit dwellings in the lofty ranks of the gardens of Paradise. So Allah tells us that He sends those astray and guides these, and says:إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُVerily, Allah does what He wills.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Whoever should think that Allah will not support him (i.e., Prophet Muḥammad SAW) in this world and the Hereafter - let him extend a rope to the ceiling, then cut off (his breath),1 and let him see: will his effort remove that which enrages (him)? Whoever thinks that Allah will not help him in this world and in the Hereafter, let him stretch out a rope to the ceiling and let him strangle himself. Then let him see whether his plan will remove that whereat he rages (22:15). Thus have We sent it down as clear Ayat, and surely, Allah guides whom He wills (22:16).Allah will Definitely Help His Messenger SAWIbn 'Abbas said, "Whoever thinks that Allah will not help Muhammad SAW in this world and the Hereafter, let him stretch out a rope إِلَى السَّمَاءِ (to the ceiling) to…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And thus have We sent it (i.e., the Qur’ān) down as verses of clear evidence and because Allah guides whom He intends. See 22:15

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, those who have believed and those who were Jews and the Sabeans and the Christians and the Magians and those who associated with Allah - Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah is, over all things, Witness.1 Allah will Judge between the Sects on the Day of ResurrectionAllah tells us about the followers of these various religions, the believers (Muslims) and others such as the Jews and Sabians. We have already seen a definition of them in Surat Al-Baqarah and have noted how people differ over who they are. There are also the Christians, Majus and others who worship others alongside Allah. Allah will:يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِjudge between them on the Day of Resurrectionwith justice; He will admit those who believed in Him to Paradise and will send those who disbelieved in Him to…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do you not see (i.e., know) that to Allah prostrates whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth and the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the moving creatures and many of the people? But upon many the punishment has been justified.1 And he whom Allah humiliates - for him there is no bestower of honor. Indeed, Allah does what He wills. See you not that whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth, and the sun, and the moon, and the stars, and the mountains, and the trees, and Ad-Dawabb, and many of mankind prostrate themselves to Allah. But there are many (men) on whom the punishment is justified. And whomsoever Allah disgraces, none can honor him. Verily, Allah does what He wills (22:18).Everything Prostrates to AllahAllah tells us that…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: These1 are two adversaries who have disputed over their Lord. But those who disbelieved will have cut out for them garments of fire. Poured upon their heads will be scalding water. These two opponents dispute with each other about their Lord; then as for those who disbelieved, garments of fire will be cut out for them, boiling water will be poured down over their heads (22:19). With it will melt (or vanish away) what is within their bellies, as well as (their) skins (22:20). And for them are hooked rods of iron (22:21). Every time they seek to get away therefrom, from anguish, they will be driven back therein, and (it will be) said to them: Taste the torment of burning! (22:22).The Reason for RevelationIt was recorded in the Two Sahihs that Abu Dharr swore that this Ayah –هَٰذَانِ خَصْمَانِ…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: On the Day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that (child) she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people (appearing) intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of Allah is severe. See 22:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: By which is melted that within their bellies and (their) skins. See 22:19

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And for (striking) them are maces of iron. See 22:19

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Every time they want to get out of it (i.e., Hellfire) from anguish, they will be returned to it, and (it will be said), "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire!" See 22:19

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, Allah will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearl, and their garments therein will be silk. Truly, Allah will admit those who believe and do righteous good deeds, to Gardens underneath which rivers flow (in Paradise), wherein they will be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls and their garments therein will be of silk (22:23). And they are guided unto goodly speech and they are guided to the path of Him, Who is Worthy of all praises (22:24).The Reward of the BelieversWhen Allah tells us about the state of the people of Hell – we seek refuge with Allah from that state of punishment, vengeance, burning and chains – and the garments of fire that have been prepared for them,…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they had been guided (in worldly life) to good speech, and they were guided to the path of the Praiseworthy. See 22:23

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, those who have disbelieved and avert (people) from the way of Allah and (from) al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, which We made for the people - equal are the resident therein and one from outside - and (also) whoever intends (a deed) therein1 of deviation (in religion) by wrongdoing - We will make him taste of a painful punishment. Verily, those who disbelieved and hinder (men) from the path of Allah, and from Al-Masjid Al-Haram which We have made (open) to (all) men, the dweller in it and the visitor from the country are equal there, and whoever inclines to evil actions therein or to do wrong, him We shall cause to taste from a painful torment (22:25).A Warning to Those Who Hinder Others from the Path of Allah and from Al-Masjid Al-Haram and Who Seek to do Evil Actions ThereinAllah rebukes…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (mention, O Muḥammad), when We designated for Ibrahim the site of the House, (saying), "Do not associate anything with Me and purify My House for those who perform ṭawāf1 and those who stand (in prayer) and those who bow and prostrate. And (remember) when We showed Ibrahim the site of the House (saying): Associate not anything with Me, and sanctify My House for those who circumambulate it, and those who stand up (for prayer), and those who bow and make prostration (in prayer); (22:26). And proclaim to mankind the Hajj (pilgrimage). They will come to you on foot and on every lean camel, they will come from every Fajj 'Amiq (22:27).Building of the Ka'bah and the Proclamation of the HajjThis is a rebuke to those among Quraysh who worshipped others than Allah and joined partners with Him in the…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And proclaim to the people the ḥajj (pilgrimage); they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every distant pass. See 22:26

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That they may witness (i.e., attend) benefits for themselves and mention the name of Allah on known (i.e., specific) days over what He has provided for them of (sacrificial) animals.1 So eat of them and feed the miserable and poor. That they may witness things that are of benefit to them, and mention the Name of Allah on appointed days, over the beast of cattle that He has provided for them. Then eat thereof and feed therewith the poor having a hard time (22:28). Then let them complete their prescribed duties and perform their vows, and circumambulate the 'Atiq House (22:29).Hajj Brings Benefits in this World and in the Hereafterلِّيَشْهَدُوا مَنَافِعَ لَهُمْThat they may witness things that are of benefit to them,Ibn 'Abbas said, Benefits in this world and in the Hereafter." Benefits of the Hereafter includes Allah's pleasure. Material…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform ṭawāf around the ancient House." See 22:28

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge and follows every rebellious devil. And among mankind is he who disputes about Allah, without knowledge, and follows every rebellious Shaytan (22:3). For him (the devil) it is decreed that whosoever follows him, he will mislead him, and will drive him to the torment of the Fire (22:4).Condemnation of the Followers of the ShaytanAllah condemns those who deny the Resurrection and who deny that Allah is able to restore life to the dead, those who turn away from that which Allah has revealed to His Prophets and, in their views – denial and disbelief – follow every rebellious Shaytan among men and Jinn. This is the state of the followers of innovation and misguidance, who turn away from the truth and follow falsehood, following the words of the…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That (has been commanded), and whoever honors the sacred ordinances of Allah - it is best for him in the sight of his Lord. And permitted to you are the grazing livestock, except what is recited to you.1 So avoid the uncleanliness of idols and avoid false statement. That and whoever honors the sacred things of Allah, then that is better for him with his Lord. The cattle are lawful to you, except those (that will be) mentioned to you. So shun the Rijs of the idols, and shun false speech (22:30). Hunafa' Lillah, not associating partners unto Him; and whoever assigns partners to Alla (22:31).The Reward for Avoiding SinAllah says: 'This is what We have commanded you to do in the rituals (of Hajj), and this is the great reward that the person who does that will gain.'وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Inclining (only) to Allah, not associating (anything) with Him. And he who associates with Allah - it is as though he had fallen from the sky and was snatched by the birds or the wind carried him down into a remote place. See 22:30

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That (is so). And whoever honors the symbols (i.e., rites) of Allah - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts. Thus it is, and whosoever honors the Sha'a'ir of Allah, then it is truly from the Taqwa of the hearts (22:32). In them are benefits for you for an appointed term, and afterwards they are brought for sacrifice to the 'Atiq House (22:33).Explanation of the Udhiyyah and the Sha'a'ir of Allahوَمَن يُعَظِّمْ شَعَائِرَ اللَّهِand whosoever honors the Sha'a'ir of Allah,means, His commands.فَإِنَّهَا مِن تَقْوَى الْقُلُوبِthen it is truly from the Taqwa of the hearts.This also includes obeying His commands in the best way when it comes to offering sacrifices, as Al-Hakam said narrating from Miqsam, from Ibn 'Abbas: Honoring them means choosing fat, healthy animals (for sacrifice)." Abu Umamah bin Sahl said: "We used to fatten the Udhiyyah in…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: For you therein (i.e., the animals marked for sacrifice) are benefits for a specified term;1 then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient House.2 See 22:32

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And for every (religious) community We have appointed a rite (of sacrifice)1 that they may mention the name of Allah over what He has provided for them of (sacrificial) animals. For your god is one God, so to Him submit. And, (O Muḥammad), give good tidings to the humble (before their Lord). And for every nation We have appointed religious ceremonies, that they may mention the Name of Allah over the beast of cattle that He has given them for food. And your God is One God, so you must submit to Him Alone. And give glad tidings to the Mukhbitin (22:34). Whose hearts are filled with fear when Allah is mentioned, and the patient who bear whatever may befall them, and who perform the Salah, and who spend out of what We have provided for them (22:35).Rites of Sacrifice…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:35 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts are fearful, and (to) the patient over what has afflicted them, and the establishers of prayer and those who spend from what We have provided them. See 22:34

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the camels and cattle We have appointed for you as among the symbols (i.e., rites) of Allah; for you therein is good. So mention the name of Allah upon them when lined up (for sacrifice); and when they are (lifeless) on their sides, then eat from them and feed the needy (who does not seek aid) and the beggar. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may be grateful. And the Budn, We have made them for you as among the symbols of Allah, wherein you have much good. So mention the Name of Allah over them when they are drawn up in lines (for sacrifice). Then, when they are down on their sides (after slaughter), eat thereof, and feed the Qani' and the Mu'tarr. Thus have We made them subject to you that you may be…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Their meat will not reach Allah, nor will their blood, but what reaches Him is piety from you. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may glorify Allah for that (to) which He has guided you; and give good tidings to the doers of good. It is neither their meat nor their blood that reaches Allah, but it is Taqwa from you that reaches Him. Thus have We made them subject to you that you may proclaim Allah's greatness for His guidance to you. And give glad tidings to the doers of good (22:37).The Goal of the Udhiyyah (Sacrifice) According to Allah is the Sincerity and Taqwa of His ServantAllah says: this sacrifice is prescribed for you so that you will remember Him at the time of slaughter, for He is the Creator and Provider. Nothing of its…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:38 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, Allah defends those who have believed. Indeed, Allah does not like everyone treacherous and ungrateful. Truly, Allah defends those who believe. Verily, Allah likes not any treacherous ingrate (22:38).Good News of Allah's Defence for the BelieversHere Allah tells us that He defends His servants who put their trust in Him and turn to Him in repentance; He protects them from the the worst of evil people and the plots of the sinners; He protects them, guards them and supports them, as He tells us elsewhere:أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُIs not Allah sufficient for His servant? (39:36)وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًاAnd whosoever puts his trust in Allah, then He will suffice him. Verily, Allah will accomplish his purpose. Indeed Allah has set a measure for all things (65:3)إِنَّ…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:39 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Permission (to fight) has been given to those who are being fought,1 because they were wronged. And indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory. Permission (to fight) is given to those (believers) who are fought against, because they have been wronged; and surely, Allah is able to give them victory (22:39). Those who have been expelled from their homes unjustly only because they said: "Our Lord is Allah." For had it not been that Allah checks one set of people by means of another, Sawami', Biya', Salawat, and Masjids, wherein the Name of Allah is mentioned much, would surely have been pulled down. Verily, Allah will help those who help His (cause). Truly, Allah is All-Strong, All-Mighty (22:40).Permission to Fight; this is the First Ayah of JihadAl-'Awfi reported that Ibn 'Abbas said, This was revealed about Muhammad SAW and…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It has been decreed for him (i.e., every devil) that whoever turns to him - he will misguide him and will lead him to the punishment of the Blaze. See 22:3

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:40 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (They are) those who have been evicted from their homes without right - only because they say, "Our Lord is Allah." And were it not that Allah checks the people, some by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of Allah is much mentioned (i.e., praised). And Allah will surely support those who support Him (i.e., His cause). Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might. See 22:39

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:41 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (And they are) those who, if We give them authority in the land, establish prayer and give zakāh and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. And to Allah belongs the outcome of (all) matters. Those who, if We give them power in the land, establish the Salah, enforce the Zakah, and they enjoin the good and forbid the evil. And with Allah rests the end of (all) matters (22:41).The Duties of the Muslims When They Attain PowerIbn Abi Hatim recorded that Uthman bin 'Affan said, The Ayah:الَّذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّاهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتَوُا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَمَرُوا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْا عَنِ الْمُنكَرِThose who, if We give them power in the land, (they) establish the Salah, enforce the Zakah, and they enjoin the good and forbid the evil.was revealed concerning us, for we had been expelled from our homes unjustly…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:42 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if they deny you, (O Muḥammad) - so, before them, did the people of Nuh and ʿAad and Thamūd deny (their prophets). And if they deny you, so did deny before them the people of Nuh, 'Ad and Thamud (22:42). And the people of Ibrahim and the people of Lut (22:43). And the dwellers of Madyan; and denied was Musa. But I granted respite to the disbelievers for a while, then I seized them, and how (terrible) was My punishment (22:44). And many a township did We destroy while they were given to wrongdoing, so that it lie in ruins, and a deserted well and castle Mashid (22:45). Have they not traveled through the land, and have they hearts wherewith to understand and ears wherewith to hear Verily, it is not the eyes that grow blind, but it is…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:43 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the people of Ibrahim and the people of Lut. See 22:42

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:44 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the inhabitants of Madyan. And Musa was denied, so I prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how (terrible) was My reproach. See 22:42

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:45 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And how many a city did We destroy while it was committing wrong - so it is (now) fallen into ruin1 - and (how many) an abandoned well and (how many) a lofty palace.2 See 22:42

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:46 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So have they not traveled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? For indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts. See 22:42

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:47 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. But Allah will never fail in His promise. And indeed, a day with your Lord is like a thousand years of those which you count. And they ask you to hasten on the torment! And Allah fails not His promise. And verily a day with your Lord is as a thousand years of what you reckon (22:47). And many a township did I give respite while it was given to wrongdoing. Then I seized it (with punishment). And to Me is the (final) return (of all) (22:48).The Disbelievers Demand for the PunishmentAllah tells His Prophet SAW:وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِAnd they ask you to hasten on the torment!Meaning: these disbelievers who disbelieve in Allah and His Book and His Messenger SAW and the Last Day. This is like the Ayat:وَإِذْ قَالُوا اللَّهُمَّ إِن كَانَ هَٰذَا…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:48 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And for how many a city did I prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. Then I seized it, and to Me is the (final) destination. See 22:47

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:49 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "O people, I am only to you a clear warner." Say: O mankind! I am (sent) to you only as a plain warner (22:49). So those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them is forgiveness and Rizq Karim (22:50). But those who strive against Our Ayat to frustrate them, they will be dwellers of the Hellfire (22:51).The Recompense of the Righteous and the UnrighteousAllah said to His Prophet SAW, when the disbelievers asked him to hasten on the punishment for them:قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّمَا أَنَا لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌSay: "O mankind! I am (sent) to you only as a plain warner."Meaning: 'Allah has sent me to you to warn you ahead of the terrible punishment, but I have nothing to do with your reckoning. Your case rests with Allah: if He wills, He will hasten on the…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O people, if you should be in doubt about the Resurrection, then (consider that) indeed, We created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed1 - that We may show you.2 And We settle in the wombs whom We will for a specified term, then We bring you out as a child, and then (We develop you) that you may reach your (time of) maturity. And among you is he who is taken in (early) death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit (old) age so that he knows, after (once having) knowledge, nothing. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows (something) of every beautiful kind. O mankind!…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:50 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision. See 22:49

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:51 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But the ones who strove against Our verses, (seeking) to cause failure1 - those are the companions of Hellfire. See 22:49

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Hajj:52 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
