item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And said, "This is not but magic imitated (from others). See 74:11

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: This is not but the word of a human being." See 74:11

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: I will drive him into Saqar.1 See 74:11

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And what can make you know what is Saqar? See 74:11

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing (unburned). See 74:11

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Altering (i.e., blackening) the skins. See 74:11

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And your Lord glorify. See 74:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Over it are nineteen (angels). See 74:11

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease (i.e., hypocrisy) and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah send astray whom He wills and guide whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it (i.e., mention of the Fire) is not but a reminder to humanity. And We have set none but angels as guardians of the Fire. And We have fixed their number only…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: No! By the moon. See 74:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (by) the night when it departs. See 74:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (by) the morning when it brightens. See 74:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:35 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, it (i.e., the Fire) is of the greatest (afflictions). See 74:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: As a warning to humanity. See 74:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: To whoever wills among you to proceed1 or stay behind. See 74:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:38 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained.1 Every person is a pledge for what he has earned (74:38). Except those on the Right (74:39). In Gardens they will ask one another (74:40). About criminals (and they will say to them) (74:41). "What has caused you to enter Hell? (74:42). They will say: "We were not of those who used to offer the Salah, (74:43). "Nor did we feed the poor; (74:44). "And we used to speak falsehood with vain speakers (74:45). "And we used to deny the Day of Recompense, (74:46). "Until Al-Yaqin came to us (74:47). So no intercession of intercessors will be of any use to them (74:48). Then what is wrong with them that they turn away from admonition (74:49). As if they were wild donkeys (74:50). Fleeing from a Qaswarah (74:51). Nay, everyone…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:39 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Except the companions of the right,1. See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And your clothing purify. See 74:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:40 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Who will be) in gardens, questioning each other. See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:41 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: About the criminals. See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:42 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (And asking them), "What put you into Saqar?" See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:43 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed. See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:44 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Nor did we used to feed the poor. See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:45 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged (in it). See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:46 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense. See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:47 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Until there came to us the certainty (i.e., death)." See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:48 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So there will not benefit them the intercession of (any) intercessors. See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:49 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then what is (the matter) with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away. See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And uncleanliness1 avoid. See 74:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:50 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: As if they were alarmed donkeys. See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:51 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Fleeing from a lion? See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:52 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Rather, every person among them desires that he1 would be given scriptures spread about.2 See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:53 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter. See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:54 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: No! Indeed, it (i.e., the Qur’ān) is a reminder. See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:55 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then whoever wills will remember it. See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:56 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for (granting) forgiveness. See 74:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And do not confer favor to acquire more.1 See 74:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But for your Lord be patient. See 74:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when the trumpet is blown. See 74:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muddaththir:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That Day will be a difficult day. See 74:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Certainly has Allah heard the speech of the one who argues (i.e., pleads) with you, (O Muḥammad), concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allah. And Allah hears your dialogue; indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing. قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجَادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِهَاIndeed Allah has heard the statement of her that disputes with you concerning her husband,She added, "Her husband was Aws bin As-Samit."

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Private conversation is only from Satan that he may grieve those who have believed,1 but he will not harm them at all except by permission of Allah. And upon Allah let the believers rely. See 58:8

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who have believed, when you are told, "Space yourselves" in assemblies, then make space; Allah will make space for you.1 And when you are told, "Arise,"2 then arise; Allah will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees. And Allah is Aware of what you do. O you who believe! When you are told to make room in the assemblies, make room. Allah will give you room. And when you are told to rise up, then rise up. Allah will exalt in degress those of you who believe, and those who have been granted knowledge. And Allah is Well-Acquainted with what you do (58:11).Manners for AssembliesAllah teaches His servants good manners and orders them to be kind to each other when they are sitting together:يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who have believed, when you (wish to) privately consult the Messenger, present before your consultation a charity. That is better for you and purer. But if you find not (the means) - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. O you who believe! When you (want to) consult the Messenger in private, spend something in charity before your private consultation. That will be better and purer for you. But if you find not (the means for it), then verily, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (58:12). Are you afraid of spending in charity before your private consultation (with him)? If then you do it not, and Allah has forgiven you, then perform Salah and give Zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do (58:13).The Order to Give Charity before One Speaks to…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Have you feared to present before your consultation charities? Then when you do not and Allah has forgiven you, then (at least) establish prayer and give zakāh and obey Allah and His Messenger. And Allah is Aware of what you do. See 58:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Have you not considered those who make allies of a people with whom Allah has become angry? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to untruth while they know (they are lying). Have you not seen those who take as friends a people upon whom is the wrath of Allah? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to a lie while they know (58:14). Allah has prepared for them a severe torment. Evil indeed is that which they used to do (58:15). They have made their oaths a screen. Thus they hinder (others) from the path of Allah, so they shall have a humiliating torment (58:16). Their children and their wealth will avail them nothing against Allah. They will be the dwellers of the Fire to dwell therein forever (58:17). On the…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing. See 58:14

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They took their (false) oaths as a cover, so they averted (people) from the way of Allah, and for them is a humiliating punishment. See 58:14

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally. See 58:14

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: On the Day Allah will resurrect them all, and they will swear to Him as they swear to you and think that they are (standing) on something.1 Unquestionably, it is they who are the liars. See 58:14

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Satan has overcome them and made them forget the remembrance of Allah. Those are the party of Satan. Unquestionably, the party of Satan - they will be the losers. See 58:14

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Those who pronounce ẓihār1 among you (to separate) from their wives - they are not (consequently) their mothers. Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood. But indeed, Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving. Those among you who make their wives unlawful to them by Zihar they cannot be their mothers. None can be their mothers except those who gave them birth. And verily, they utter an ill word and a lie. And verily, Allah is Oft-Pardoning, Oft-Forgiving (58:2). And those who make unlawful to them (their wives) by Zihar and wish to free themselves from what they uttered, (the penalty) in that case is the freeing of a slave before they touch each other. That is an admonition to you. And Allah is All-Aware of what…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, the ones who oppose Allah and His Messenger - those will be among the most humbled. Those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, they will be among those most humiliated (58:20). Allah has decreed: "Verily, I and My Messengers shall be the victorious." Verily, Allah is All-Powerful, Almighty (58:21). You will not find any people who believe in Allah and the Last Day, making friendship with those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, even though they were their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred. For such He has written faith in their hearts, and strengthened them with Ruh from Himself. And He will admit them to Gardens under which rivers flow, to dwell therein (forever). Allah is well pleased with them, and they are well pleased with Him. They are the party of Allah. Verily,…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah has written (i.e., decreed), "I will surely overcome, I and My messengers." Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might. See 58:20

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: You will not find a people who believe in Allah and the Last Day having affection for those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, even if they were their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred. Those - He has decreed within their hearts faith and supported them with spirit1 from Him. And We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Allah is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him - those are the party of Allah. Unquestionably, the party of Allah - they are the successful. See 58:20

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those who pronounce ẓihār from their wives and then (wish to) go back on what they said - then (there must be) the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. That is what you are admonished thereby; and Allah is Aware of what you do. See 58:2

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And he who does not find (a slave) - then a fast for two months consecutively1 before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons. That is for you to believe (completely) in Allah and His Messenger; and those are the limits (set by) Allah. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment. See 58:2

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, those who oppose Allah and His Messenger are abased as those before them were abased. And We have certainly sent down verses of clear evidence. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment. Verily, those who oppose Allah and His Messenger will be disgraced as those before them were disgraced. And We have sent down clear Ayat. And for the disbelievers is a disgraceful torment (58:5). On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all together and inform them of what they did. Allah has kept account of it, while they have forgotten it. And Allah is Witness over all things (58:6). Have you not seen that Allah knows whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is on the earth? There is no Najwa of three but He is their fourth nor of five but He is their sixth…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did. Allah had enumerated it, while they forgot it; and Allah is, over all things, Witness.1 See 58:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Have you not considered that Allah knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth? There are not three in a private conversation but that He is the fourth of them,1 nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them (in knowledge) wherever they are. Then He will inform them of what they did on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah is, of all things, Knowing. See 58:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Have you not considered those who were forbidden from private conversation (i.e., ridicule and conspiracy) and then return to that which they were forbidden and converse among themselves about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger? And when they come to you, they greet you with that (word) by which Allah does not greet you1 and say among themselves, "Why does Allah not punish us for what we say?" Sufficient for them is Hell, which they will (enter to) burn, and wretched is the destination. Have you not seen those who were forbidden to hold secret counsels, and afterwards returned to that which they had been forbidden, and conspired together for sin and wrongdoing and disobedience to the Messenger. And when they come to you, they greet you with a greeting wherewith Allah greets you not, and say within…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mujaadila:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who have believed, when you converse privately, do not converse about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger but converse about righteousness and piety. And fear Allah, to whom you will be gathered. See 58:8

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent. وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَAnd indeed We have adorned the nearest heaven with lamps,This refers to the stars which have been placed in the heavens, some moving and some stationary. In Allah's statement:وَجَعَلْنَاهَا رُجُومًا لِلشَّيَاطِينِand We have made them (as) missiles to drive away the Shayatin,The pronoun 'them' in His statement, "and We have made them" is the same type of statement as the stars being referred to as lamps. This does not mean that they are actually missiles, because the stars in the sky are not thrown. Rather, it is the meteors beneath them that are thrown and they are taken from the stars. And Allah knows best. Concerning Allah's statement:وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِيرِand We have prepared for them the torment of the blazing…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze." See 67:6

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they will admit their sin, so (it is) alienation1 for the companions of the Blaze. See 67:6

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward. Verily, those who fear their Lord unseen, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward (67:12). And whether you keep your talk secret or disclose it, verily, He is the All-Knower of what is in the breasts (67:13). Should not He Who has created know? And He is the Most Kind and Courteous, All-Aware (67:14). He it is Who has made the earth subservient to you; so walk in the paths thereof and eat of His provision. And to Him will be the resurrection (67:15).The Reward of those Who Fear their Lord UnseenAllah informs of he who fears standing before his Lord, being frightened about matters between himself and Allah when he is not in the presence of other people. So he refrains from disobedience and he…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts. See 67:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Does He who created not know,1 while He is the Subtle, the Aware? See 67:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is He who made the earth tame1 for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection. See 67:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do you feel secure that He who is above1 would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?2 Do you feel secure that He, Who is over the heaven, will not cause the earth to sink with you, and then it should quake (67:16). Or do you feel secure that He, Who is over the heaven, will not send against you a Hasib? Then you shall know how has been My warning (67:17). And indeed those before them rejected, then how terrible was My reproach (67:18). Do they not see the birds above them, spreading out their wings and folding them in? None upholds them except the Most Gracious. Verily, He is the All-Seer of everything (67:19).How can You feel Secure against the Punishment of Allah while He is Able to seize You however He wills?This…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or do you feel secure that He who is above would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how (severe) was My warning. See 67:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And already had those before them denied, and how (terrible) was My reproach. See 67:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and (sometimes) folded in? None holds them (aloft) except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing. See 67:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (He) who created death and life to test you (as to) which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving. See 67:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion. Who is it besides the Most Gracious that can be an army to you to help you? The disbelievers are in nothing but delusion (67:20). Who is it that can provide for you if He should withhold His provision? Nay, but they continue to be in pride, and flee (67:21). Is he who walks prone on his face, more rightly guided, or he who walks upright on a straight path (67:22). Say: It is He Who has created you, and endowed you with hearing and seeing, and hearts. Little thanks you give (67:23). Say: "It is He Who has created you on the earth, and to Him shall you be gathered (67:24). They say:…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion. See 67:20

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path? See 67:20

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts (i.e., intellect); little are you grateful." See 67:20

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered." See 67:20

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?" See 67:20

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner." See 67:20

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But when they see it1 approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."2 See 67:20

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, (O Muḥammad), "Have you considered:1 whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?" Say: Tell me! If Allah destroys me, and those with me, or He bestows His mercy on us - who can save the disbelievers from a painful torment? (67:28). Say: "He is the Most Gracious, in Him we believe, and upon Him we rely. So, you will come to know who it is that is in manifest error (67:29). Say: "Tell me! If (all) your water were to sink away, who then can supply you with flowing water? (67:30). The Death of the Believer will not save the Disbeliever, so let Him reflect upon His Deliverance Allah says, قُلْ (say) 'O Muhammad to these idolators who are associating partners with…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will (come to) know who it is that is in clear error." See 67:28

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (And) who created seven heavens in layers.1 You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return (your) vision (to the sky); do you see any breaks? See 67:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken (into the earth), then who could bring you flowing water?" See 67:28

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then return (your) vision twice again.1 (Your) vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued. See 67:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with lamps (i.e., stars) and have made (from) them what is thrown at the devils1 and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze. See 67:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination. And for those who disbelieve in their Lord is the torment of Hell, and worst indeed is that destination (67:6). When they are cast therein, they will hear its Shahiq while it is simmering (67:7). It almost bursts up with fury. Every time a group is cast therein, its keepers will ask: Did no warner come to you? (67:8). They will say: "Yes, indeed a warner did come to us, but we rejected him and said: 'Allah never sent down anything; you are only in great error.' (67:9). And they will say: "Had we but listened or used our intelligence, we would not have been among the dwellers of the blazing Fire! (67:10). Then they will confess their sin. So, away with…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a (dreadful) inhaling while it boils up. See 67:6

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?" See 67:6

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mulk:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'" See 67:6

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Certainly will the believers have succeeded. وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَAnd those who strictly guard their Salawat.means, they persistently offer their prayers at their appointed times, as Ibn Mas'ud said: I asked the Messenger of Allah SAW, 'O Messenger of Allah, which deed is most beloved to Allah?' He said:الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى وَقْتِهَاPrayer at the appointed time.I said, 'Then what?' He said:بِرُّ الْوَالِدَيْنِKindness to one's parents.I said, 'Then what?' He said:الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِJihad in the way of Allah.It was recorded in the Two Sahihs. Qatadah said: "At the fixed times, with the proper bowing and prostration." Allah begins and ends this list of praiseworthy qualities with Salah, which is indicative of its virtue, as the Prophet SAW said:اسْتَقِيمُوا وَلَنْ تُحْصُوا، وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ خَيْرَ أَعْمَالِكُمُ الصَّلَاةُ، وَلَا يُحَافِظُ عَلَى الْوُضُوءِ إِلَّا مُؤْمِنٌAdhere to righteousness, you will never be able encompass it…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Those are the inheritors. See 23:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:100 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind."1 No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected. See 23:99

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:101 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another. Then, when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no kinship among them that Day, nor will they ask of one another (23:101). Then, those whose Scales (of good deeds) are heavy, these! they are the successful (23:102). And those whose Scales (of good deeds) are light, they are those who lose themselves, in Hell will they abide (23:103). The Fire will burn their faces, and therein they will grin, with displaced lips (disfigured) (23:104).The Sounding of the Trumpet and the Weighing of Deeds in the ScalesAllah says that when the Trumpet is blown for the Resurrection, and the people rise from their graves:فَلَا أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَا يَتَسَاءَلُونَthere will be no kinship among them that Day, nor…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:102 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those whose scales are heavy (with good deeds) - it is they who are the successful. See 23:101

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:103 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, (being) in Hell, abiding eternally. See 23:101

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:104 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.1 See 23:101

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:105 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (It will be said), "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?" Were not My Ayat recited to you, and then you used to deny them? (23:105). They will say: "Our Lord! Our wretchedness overcame us, and we were (an) erring people (23:106). "Our Lord! Bring us out of this. If ever we return (to evil), then indeed we shall be wrongdoers (23:107).Rebuking the People of Hell, Their Admission of Their Wretchedness and Their Request to Be Brought out of HellThis is a rebuke from Allah to the people of Hell for the disbelief, sins, unlawful deeds and evil actions that they committed, because of which they were doomed. Allah says:أَلَمْ تَكُنْ آيَاتِي تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ"Were not My Ayat recited to you, and then you used to deny them?"Meaning: 'I sent Messengers to…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:106 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray. See 23:105

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:107 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return (to evil), we would indeed be wrongdoers." See 23:105

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:108 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me. He (Allah) will say: "Remain you in it with ignominy! And speak you not to Me! (23:108). Verily, there was a party of My servants who used to say: "Our Lord! We believe, so forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the Best of all who show mercy! (23:109). But you took them for a laughing stock, so much so that they made you forget My remembrance while you used to laugh at them (23:110). Verily, I have rewarded them this Day for their patience; they are indeed the ones that are successful (23:111).Allah's Response and Rejection of the DisbelieversThis is the response of Allah to the disbelievers when they ask Him to bring them out of the Fire and send them back to this…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:109 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.' See 23:108

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Who will inherit al-Firdaus.1 They will abide therein eternally. See 23:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:110 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them. See 23:108

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:111 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers (of success)." See 23:108

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:112 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Allah) will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?" He will say: "What number of years did you stay on earth? (23:112). They will say: "We stayed a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep account (23:113). He will say: "You stayed not but a little, if you had only known! (23:114). "Did you think that We had created you in play, and that you would not be brought back to Us? (23:115). So Exalted be Allah, the True King: None has the right to be worshipped but He, the Lord of Al-'Arsh Al-Karim (23:116).Allah tells them how much they wasted in their short lives in this world by failing to obey Allah and worship Him Alone.If they had been patient during their short stay in this world, they would have…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:113 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate." See 23:112

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:114 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known. See 23:112

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:115 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?" See 23:112

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:116 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign,1 the Truth;2 there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne. See 23:112

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:117 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed. And whoever invokes besides Allah, any other god, of whom he has no proof; then his reckoning is only with his Lord. Surely, disbelievers will not be successful (23:117). And say : My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the Best of those who show mercy! (23:118).Shirk Is the Worst Form of Wrong, Its Practitioner Shall Never SucceedAllah threatens those who associate anything else with Him and worship anything with Him.He informs that those who associate others with Allah:لَا بُرْهَانَ لَهُof whom he has no proofMeaning no evidence for what he says. Then Allah says:وَمَنْ يَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا آخَرَ لَا بُرْهَانَ لَهُ بِهِAnd whoever invokes, besides Allah, any other…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:118 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And, (O Muḥammad), say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful." See 23:117

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay. And indeed We created man out of an extract of Tin (23:12). Thereafter We made him a Nutfah in a safe lodging (23:13). Then We made the Nutfah into a clot, then We made the clot into a little lump of flesh, then We made out of that little lump of flesh bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We brought it forth as another creation. So Blessed is Allah, the Best of creators (23:14). After that, surely you will die (23:15). Then (again), surely you will be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection (23:16).The Sign of Allah in the Progressive Creation of Man from Clay Then from Nutfah and ThereafterAllah tells us how He initially created man from an extract of Tin. This was Adam…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop1 in a firm lodging (i.e., the womb). See 23:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump (of flesh), and We made (from) the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.1 See 23:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then indeed, after that you are to die. See 23:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected. See 23:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of (Our) creation unaware. And indeed We have created above you seven Tara'iq, and We are never unaware of the creation (23:17).His Sign in the Creation of the HeavensAfter mentioning the creation of man, Allah then mentions the creation of the seven heavens. Allah often mentions the creation of the heavens and earth alongside the creation of man, as He says elsewhere:لَخَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ النَّاسِThe creation of the heavens and the earth is indeed greater than the creation of mankind (40:57)A similar Ayah appears at the beginning of Surat As-Sajdah, which the Messenger of Allah SAW used to recite on Friday mornings. At the beginning it mentions the creation of the heavens and earth, then it says how man was created from semen…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away. And We sent down from the sky water in measure, and We gave it lodging in the earth, and verily, We are able to take it away (23:18). Then We brought forth for you therewith gardens of date palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you, and whereof you eat (23:19). And a tree that springs forth from Tur Sinai, that grows oil, and relish for the eaters (23:20). And verily, in the cattle there is indeed a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies. And there are, in them, numerous benefits for you, and of them you eat (23:21). And on them,…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat. See 23:18

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They who are during their prayer humbly intent. See 23:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (We brought forth) a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food (i.e., olives) for those who eat. See 23:18

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat. See 23:18

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And upon them and on ships you are carried. See 23:18

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We had certainly sent Nuh to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?" And indeed We sent Nuh to his people, and he said: O my people! Worship Allah! You have no other God but Him. Will you not then have Taqwa? (23:23). But the chiefs of his people who disbelieved said: "He is no more than a human being like you, he seeks to make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels. Never did we hear such a thing among our fathers of old (23:24). "He is only a man in whom is madness, so wait for him a while (23:25).The Story of Nuh, Peace Be upon Him, and His PeopleAllah tells us about Nuh…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allah had willed (to send a messenger), He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers. See 23:23

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time." See 23:23

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Nuh) said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me." He said: "O my Lord! Help me because they deny me (23:26). So, We revealed to him: "Construct the ship under Our Eyes and under Our revelation. Then, when Our command comes, and (water) gushes forth from the oven, take on board of each kind two, and your family, except those thereof against whom the Word has already gone forth. And address Me not in favor of those who have done wrong. Verily, they are to be drowned (23:27). "And when you have embarked on the ship, you and whoever is with you, then say: 'All the praise be to Allah, Who has saved us from the people who are wrongdoers (23:28). "And say: 'My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing place, for You are the…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows,1 put into it (i.e., the ship) from each (creature) two mates and your family, except him for whom the decree (of destruction) has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned. See 23:26

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.' See 23:26

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate (us).'" See 23:26

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they who turn away from ill speech. See 23:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing (Our servants). See 23:26

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then We produced after them a generation of others. Then, after them, We created another generation (23:31). And We sent to them a Messenger from among themselves (saying): Worship Allah! You have no other God but Him. Will you not then have Taqwa? (23:32). And the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting in the Hereafter, and whom We had given the luxuries and comforts of worldly life, said: "He is no more than a human being like you, he eats of that which you eat, and drinks of what you drink (23:33). "If you were to obey a human being like yourselves, then verily, you indeed would be losers (23:34). "Does he promise you that when you have died and have become dust and bones, you shall come out alive? (23:35). "Far, very far is that…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We sent among them a messenger1 from themselves, (saying), "Worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?" See 23:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink. See 23:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers. See 23:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:35 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth (once more)? See 23:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.1 See 23:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It (i.e., life) is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected. See 23:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:38 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him." See 23:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:39 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me." See 23:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they who are observant of zakāh. See 23:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:40 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Allah) said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful." See 23:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:41 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So the shriek1 seized them in truth,2 and We made them as (plant) stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people. See 23:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:42 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then We produced after them other generations. Then, after them, We created other generations (23:42). No nation can advance their term, nor can they delay it (23:43). Then We sent Our Messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation their Messenger, they denied him; so, We made them follow one another, and We made them as Ahadith. So, away with a people who believe not (23:44).Mention of Other NationsAllah says:ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا آخَرِينَThen, after them, We created other generations.Meaning: nations and peoples.مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَNo nation can advance their term, nor can they delay it.means, they are taken at the appropriate time, as decreed by Allah in His Book that is preserved with Him, before they were created, nation after nation, century after century, generation after generation, successors after predecessors.ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَاThen…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:43 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: No nation will precede its time (of termination), nor will they remain (thereafter). See 23:42

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:44 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another (to destruction), and We made them narrations.1 So away with a people who do not believe. See 23:42

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:45 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then We sent Musa and his brother Harun with Our signs and a clear authority.1 Then We sent Musa and his brother Harun, with Our Ayat and manifest authority (23:45). To Fir'awn and his chiefs, but they behaved insolently and they were people self-exalting (by disobeying their Lord) (23:46). They said: Shall we believe in two men like ourselves, and their people are obedient to us with humility! (23:47). So, they denied them both and became of those who were destroyed (23:48). And indeed We gave Musa the Scripture, that they may be guided (23:49).The Story of Musa, Peace Be upon Him, And Fir'awnAllah tells us that He sent Musa (AS), and his brother Harun to Fir'awn and his chiefs with decisive evidence and definitive proof, but Fir'awn and his people were too arrogant to follow them and obey their…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:46 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people. See 23:45

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:47 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?" See 23:45

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:48 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So they denied them and were of those destroyed. See 23:45

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:49 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We certainly gave Musa the Scripture that perhaps they1 would be guided. See 23:45

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they who guard their private parts. See 23:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:50 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We made the son of Maryam and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level (areas) and flowing water. And We made the son of Maryam and his mother as a sign, and We gave them refuge on a Rabwah, Dhat Qarar, and Ma'in (23:50).Isa and MaryamAllah tells us about His servant and Messenger Isa bin Maryam (AS), and that He made them as a sign for mankind, i.e., definitive proof of His ability to do what He wills. For He created Adam without a father or a mother, He created Hawwa' from a male without a female, and He created Isa from a female without a male, but He created the rest of mankind from both male and female.وَآوَيْنَاهُمَا إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍand We gave them refuge on high ground, a place…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:51 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Allah said), "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Knowing. O Messengers! Eat of the Tayyibat and do righteous deeds. Verily, I am Well-Acquainted with what you do (23:51). And verily, this your religion is one religion, and I am your Lord, so have Taqwa (23:52). But they have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in what is with it (23:53). So, leave them in their error for a time (23:54). Do they think that in wealth and children with which We prolong the (23:55). We hasten unto them with good things. Nay, but they perceive not (23:56).The Command to Eat Lawful Food and to Do Righteous DeedsAllah commands His servants and Messengers (AS), to eat lawful food and do righteous deeds, which indicates that eating…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:52 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion,1 and I am your Lord, so fear Me." See 23:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:53 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But they (i.e., the people) divided their religion among them into portions (i.e., sects) - each faction, in what it has,1 rejoicing. See 23:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:54 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So leave them in their confusion for a time. See 23:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:55 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children. See 23:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:56 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Is (because) We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.1 See 23:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:57 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord. Verily, those who live in awe for fear of their Lord (23:57). And those who believe in the Ayat of their Lord (23:58). And those who join not anyone as partners with their Lord (23:59). And those who give that which they give with their hearts full of fear, because they are sure to return to their Lord (23:60). It is these who hasten in the good deeds, and they are foremost in them (23:61).Description of the People of Good Deedsإِنَّ الَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَVerily, those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;means, even though they have reached the level of Ihsan and have faith and do righteous deeds, they are still in awe of Allah and fear Him and His hidden plans for them, as…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:58 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord. See 23:57

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:59 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord. See 23:57

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess,1 for indeed, they will not be blamed. See 23:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:60 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful1 because they will be returning to their Lord. See 23:57

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:61 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip (others) therein. See 23:57

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:62 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We charge no soul except (with that within) its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged. And We task not any person except according to his capacity, and with Us is a Record which speaks the truth, and they will not be wronged (23:62). Nay, but their hearts are covered from this, and they have other deeds, besides which they are doing (23:63). Until when We seize those of them who lead a luxurious life with punishment; behold, they make humble invocation with a loud voice (23:64). Invoke not loudly this day! Certainly you shall not be helped by Us (23:65). Indeed My Ayat used to be recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels (23:66). In pride, talking evil about it by night (23:67).The…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:63 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have (evil) deeds besides that (i.e., disbelief) which they are doing. See 23:62

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:64 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment,1 at once they are crying (to Allah) for help. See 23:62

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:65 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped. See 23:62

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:66 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels. See 23:62

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:67 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: In arrogance regarding it,1 conversing by night, speaking evil. See 23:62

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:68 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then have they not reflected over the word (i.e., the Qur’ān), or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers? Have they not pondered over the Word, or has there come to them what had not come to their fathers of old (23:68). Or is it that they did not recognize their Messenger so they deny him (23:69). Or they say: There is madness in him Nay, but he brought them the truth, but most of them are averse to the truth (23:70). And if Al-Haqq had followed their desires, verily, the heavens and the earth, and whosoever is therein would have been corrupted! Nay, We have brought them their reminder, but they turn away from their reminder (23:71). Or is it that you ask them for some Kharj? But the recompense of your Lord…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:69 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging? See 23:68

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors. See 23:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:70 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or do they say, "In him is madness"? Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse. See 23:68

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:71 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But if the Truth (i.e., Allah) had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message,1 but they, from their message, are turning away. See 23:68

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:72 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or do you, (O Muḥammad), ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers. See 23:68

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:73 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path. See 23:68

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:74 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path. See 23:68

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:75 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly. See 23:68

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:76 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We had gripped them with suffering (as a warning), but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, (and will continue thus). And indeed We seized them with punishment, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor did they invoke with submission to Him (23:76). Until, when We open for them the gate of severe punishment, then lo! they will be plunged in despair (23:77). It is He Who has created for you hearing, eyes, and hearts. Little thanks you give (23:78). And it is He Who has created you on the earth, and to Him you shall be gathered back (23:79). And it is He Who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of night and day. Will you not then understand (23:80). Nay, but they say the like of…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:77 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair. See 23:76

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:78 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts (i.e., intellect); little are you grateful. See 23:76

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:79 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered. See 23:76

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive. See 23:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:80 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason? See 23:76

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:81 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Rather,1 they say like what the former peoples said. See 23:76

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:82 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected? See 23:76

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:83 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples." See 23:76

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:84 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, (O Muḥammad), "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?" Say: "Whose is the earth and whosoever is therein? If you know! (23:84). They will say: "It is Allah's!" Say: "Will you not then remember? (23:85). Say: "Who is (the) Lord of the seven heavens, and (the) Lord of the Great Throne? (23:86). They will say: "Allah." Say: "Will you not then have Taqwa? (23:87). Say: "In Whose Hand is the sovereignty of everything? And He protects, while against Whom there is no protector, if you know? (23:88). They will say: "(All that belongs) to Allah." Say: "How then are you deceived and turn away from the truth? (23:89). Nay, but We have brought them the truth, and verily, they are liars (23:90).The Idolators Believe in Tawhid Ar-Rububiyyah, Which Requires Them to Believe…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:85 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will say, "To Allah." Say, "Then will you not remember?" See 23:84

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:86 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?" See 23:84

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:87 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will say, "(They belong) to Allah." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?" See 23:84

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:88 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?" See 23:84

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:89 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will say, "(All belongs) to Allah." Say, "Then how are you deluded?" See 23:84

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they who carefully maintain their prayers. See 23:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:90 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars. See 23:84

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:91 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. (If there had been), then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have (sought to) overcome others. Exalted is Allah above what they describe (concerning Him). No son (or offspring) did Allah beget, nor is there any god along with Him. (If there had been many gods), then each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have tried to overcome others! Glorified be Allah above all that they attribute to Him (23:91). All-Knower of the unseen and the seen! Exalted be He over all that they associate as partners to Him (23:92).Allah Has No Partner or AssociateAllah declares Himself to be above having any child or partner in dominion, control and worship. He says:مَا…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:92 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (He is) Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate (with Him). See 23:91

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:93 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, (O Muḥammad), "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised. Say: "My Lord! If You would show me that with which they are threatened, (23:93). "My Lord! Then, put me not amongst the people who are the wrongdoers (23:94). And indeed We are able to show you that with which We have threatened them (23:95). Repel evil with that which is better. We are best-acquainted with the things they utter (23:96). And say: "My Lord! I seek refuge with You from the whisperings of the Shayatin (23:97). "And I seek refuge with You, My Lord! lest they should come near me (23:98).The Command to Call on Allah When Calamity Strikes, to Repel Evil with That Which Is Better, and to Seek Refuge with AllahAllah commands His Prophet Muhammad SAW to call on Him with this…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:94 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people." See 23:93

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:95 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, We are Able to show you what We have promised them. See 23:93

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:96 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Repel, by (means of) what is best, (their) evil. We are most knowing of what they describe. See 23:93

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:97 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils. See 23:93

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:98 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me." See 23:93

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muminoon:99 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (For such is the state of the disbelievers) until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back. Until, when death comes to one of them, he says: My Lord! Send me back, (23:99). "So that I may do good in that which I have left behind!" No! (Kalla) It is but a word that he speaks; and in front of them is Barzakh until the Day when they will be resurrected (23:100).The Disbelievers' Hope When Death ApproachesAllah tells us about what happens when death approaches one of the disbelievers or one of those who have been negligent with the commands of Allah.He tells us what he says and how he asks to come back to this world, so that he can certify whatever wrong he commited during his life time. Allah Says:رَبِّ ارْجِعُونِ -…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who have believed, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies,1 extending to them affection while they have disbelieved in what came to you of the truth, having driven out the Prophet and yourselves (only) because you believe in Allah, your Lord. If you have come out for jihād (i.e., fighting or striving) in My cause and seeking means to My approval, (take them not as friends). You confide to them affection (i.e., instruction), but I am most knowing of what you have concealed and what you have declared. And whoever does it among you has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way. لَنْ تَنْفَعَكُمْ أَرْحَامُكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُمْ ۚ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌNeither your relatives nor your children will benefit you on the Day of Resurrection. He will judge between…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who have believed, when the believing women come to you as emigrants, examine (i.e., test) them. Allah is most knowing as to their faith. And if you know them to be believers, then do not return them to the disbelievers; they are not lawful (wives) for them, nor are they lawful (husbands) for them. But give them (i.e., the disbelievers) what they have spent.1 And there is no blame upon you if you marry them when you have given them their due compensation (i.e., mahr). And hold not to marriage bonds with disbelieving women, but ask for what you have spent and let them (i.e., the disbelievers) ask for what they have spent.2 That is the judgement of Allah; He judges between you. And Allah is Knowing and Wise. O you who believe! When believing women come to…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if you have lost any of your wives to the disbelievers and you subsequently obtain (something),1 then give those whose wives have gone the equivalent of what they had spent. And fear Allah, in whom you are believers. See 60:10

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O Prophet, when the believing women come to you pledging to you that they will not associate anything with Allah, nor will they steal, nor will they commit unlawful sexual intercourse, nor will they kill their children, nor will they bring forth a slander they have invented between their arms and legs,1 nor will they disobey you in what is right - then accept their pledge and ask forgiveness for them of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. O Prophet! When the believing women come to you pledging to you that they will not associate anything with Allah, and that they will not steal, and that they will not commit Zina, and that they will not kill their children, and that they will not utter slander, fabricating from between their hands and their feet, and that they will not…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who have believed, do not make allies of a people with whom Allah has become angry. They have despaired of (reward in) the Hereafter just as the disbelievers have despaired of (meeting) the companions (i.e., inhabitants) of the graves. O you who believe! Take not as friends the people who incurred the wrath of Allah. Surely, they have despaired of the Hereafter, just as the disbelievers have despaired of those (buried) in graves (60:13).Just like in the beginning of the Surah, Allah the Exalted forbids taking the disbelievers as protecting friends at the end of the Surah, saying:يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَوَلَّوْا قَوْمًا غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْO you who believe! Take not as friends the people who incurred the wrath of Allah.referring to the Jews, Christians and the rest of the disbelievers whom Allah became angry with and…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: If they gain dominance over you, they would be (i.e., behave) to you as enemies and extend against you their hands and their tongues with evil, and they wish you would disbelieve. See 60:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Never will your relatives or your children benefit you; the Day of Resurrection He will judge between you. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing. See 60:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: There has already been for you an excellent pattern1 in Ibrahim and those with him, when they said to their people, "Indeed, we are disassociated from you and from whatever you worship other than Allah. We have denied you, and there has appeared between us and you animosity and hatred forever until you believe in Allah alone" - except for the saying of Ibrahim to his father, "I will surely ask forgiveness for you, but I have not (power to do) for you anything against Allah. Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination. Indeed there has been an excellent example for you in Ibrahim and those with him, when they said to their people: "Verily, we are free from you and whatever you worship besides Allah, we have…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Our Lord, make us not (objects of) torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise." See 60:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: There has certainly been for you in them an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allah and the Last Day. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy. See 60:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Perhaps Allah will put, between you and those to whom you have been enemies among them, affection. And Allah is competent,1 and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. Perhaps Allah will make friendship between you and those whom you hold as enemies. And Allah has power (over all things), and Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (60:7). Allah does not forbid you to deal justly and kindly with those who fought not against you on account of religion nor drove you out of your homes. Verily, Allah loves those who deal with equity (60:8). It is only as regards those who fought against you on account of religion, and have driven you out of your homes, and helped to drive you out, that Allah forbids you to befriend them. And whosoever will befriend them, then such are the wrongdoers (60:9).Perhaps Allah will…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes - from being righteous toward them and acting justly toward them. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly. See 60:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mumtahana:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion and expel you from your homes and aid in your expulsion - (forbids) that you make allies1 of them. And whoever makes allies of them, then it is those who are the wrongdoers. See 60:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: When the hypocrites come to you, (O Muḥammad), they say, "We testify that you are the Messenger of Allah." And Allah knows that you are His Messenger, and Allah testifies that the hypocrites are liars. وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ تُعْجِبُكَ أَجْسَامُهُمْ ۖ وَإِنْ يَقُولُوا تَسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِهِمْAnd when you look at them, their bodies please you; and when they speak, you listen to their words.Meaning: hypocrites have a graceful outer appearance and are eloquent. When one hears them speak, he will listen to their eloquent words, even though hypocrites are truly weak and feeble, full of fear, fright and cowardice. Allah's statement:يَحْسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚThey think that every cry is against them.means, every time an incident occurs or something frightening happens, they think that it is headed their way. This is indicative of their cowardice, just as Allah said about them:أَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And spend (in the way of Allah) from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be of the righteous." See 63:9

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But never will Allah delay a soul when its time has come. And Allah is Aware of what you do. See 63:9

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They have taken their oaths as a cover, so they averted (people) from the way of Allah. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing. See 63:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That is because they believed, and then they disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed over, and they do not understand. See 63:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when you see them, their forms please you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. (They are) as if they were pieces of wood propped up1 - they think that every shout is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allah destroy them; how are they deluded? See 63:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant. And when it is said to them: "Come, so that the Messenger of Allah may ask forgiveness from Allah for you," they twist their heads, and you would see them turning away their faces in pride (63:5). It is equal to them whether you ask forgiveness or ask not forgiveness for them, Allah will never forgive them. Verily, Allah guides not the people who are the rebellious (63:6). They are the ones who say: "Spend not on those who are with Allah's Messenger, until they desert him." And to Allah belong the treasures of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites comprehend not (63:7). They say: "If we…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them; never will Allah forgive them. Indeed, Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people. See 63:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They are the ones who say, "Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allah until they disband." And to Allah belong the depositories of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand. See 63:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They say, "If we return to al-Madīnah, the more honored (for power) will surely expel therefrom the more humble." And to Allah belongs (all) honor, and to His Messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know. See 63:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Munaafiqoon:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from the remembrance of Allah. And whoever does that - then those are the losers. O you who believe! Let not your properties or your children divert you from the remembrance of Allah. And whosoever does that, then they are the losers (63:9). And spend of that with which We have provided you before death comes to one of you, and he says: My Lord!
