If only You would give me respite for a little while, then I should give Sadaqah from my wealth, and be among the righteous (63:10). And Allah grants respite to none when his appointed time comes. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do (63:11). The Importance of not being too concerned with the Matters of the Worldly Life, and being…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: By those (winds) sent forth in gusts. لِيَوْمِ الْفَصْلِthe Day of Sorting Out.Then Allah says, in magnifying its matter:وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ - وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَAnd what will explain to you what is the Day of Sorting Out? Woe that Day to the deniers.Meaning: woe unto them from Allah's torment that is coming in the future.

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when the mountains are blown away. See 77:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when the messengers' time has come...1 See 77:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: For what Day was it postponed?1 See 77:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: For the Day of Judgement. See 77:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement? See 77:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Woe,1 that Day, to the deniers. See 77:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Did We not destroy the former peoples? Did We not destroy the ancients (77:16). So shall We make later generations to follow them (77:17). Thus do We deal with the criminals (77:18). Woe that Day to the deniers (77:19). Did We not create you from a despised water (77:20). Then We placed it in a place of safety (77:21). For a known period (77:22). So We did measure; and We are the best to measure (77:23). Woe that Day to the deniers (77:24). Have We not made the earth Kifat (a receptacle (25)For the living and the dead (26)And have placed therein fixed towers, and have given you Furat water (27)Woe that Day to the deniers (28)The Call to Contemplate the Various Manifestations of Allah's PowerAllah says:أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ الْأَوَّلِينَDid We not destroy the ancients?Meaning: those who rejected the Messengers and…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then We will follow them with the later ones. See 77:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Thus do We deal with the criminals. See 77:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the winds that blow violently. See 77:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained? See 77:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We placed it in a firm lodging (i.e., the womb). See 77:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: For a known extent. See 77:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We determined (it), and excellent (are We) to determine. See 77:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Have We not made the earth a container. See 77:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Of the living and the dead? See 77:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water. See 77:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (They will be told), "Proceed to that which you used to deny. (It will be said to the disbelievers): Depart you to that which you used to deny! (77:29). "Depart you to a shadow in three columns, (77:30). "Neither shady nor of any use against the fierce flame of the Fire (77:31). Verily, it (Hell) throws sparks (huge) as Al-Qasr (77:32). As if they were Sufr camels (77:33). Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection) (77:34). That will be a Day when they shall not speak (during some part of it) (77:35). And they will not be permitted to put forth any excuse (77:36). Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection) (77:37). That will be a Day of Decision! We have brought you and the men of old together (77:38). So, if…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (by) the winds that spread (clouds). See 77:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Proceed to a shadow (of smoke) having three columns. See 77:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (But having) no cool shade and availing not against the flame." See 77:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, it throws sparks (as huge) as a fortress. See 77:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: As if they were yellowish (black) camels. See 77:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:35 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: This is a Day they will not speak. See 77:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse. See 77:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:38 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples. See 77:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:39 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me. See 77:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those (angels) who bring criterion.1 See 77:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:40 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:41 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs. Verily, those who had Taqwa, shall be amidst shades and springs (77:41). And fruits, such as they desire (77:42). Eat and drink comfortably for that which you used to do (77:43). Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinin (77:44). Woe that Day to the deniers (77:45). Eat and enjoy yourselves for a little while. Verily, you are criminals (77:46). Woe that Day to the deniers (77:47). And when it is said to them: "Bow down yourself!" They bow not down (77:48). Woe that Day to the deniers (77:49). Then in what statement after this will they believe (77:50). The Final Abode for Those Who have Taqwa Allah informs that His servants who have Taqwa and worship Him by performing the obligations and abandoning the forbidden things, will be in gardens and springs…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:42 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And fruits from whatever they desire. See 77:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:43 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Being told), "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do." See 77:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:44 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good. See 77:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:45 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:46 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (O disbelievers), eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals. See 77:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:47 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:48 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when it is said to them, "Bow (in prayer)," they do not bow. See 77:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:49 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 77:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those (angels) who deliver a message. See 77:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:50 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then in what statement after it (i.e., the Qur’ān) will they believe? See 77:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: As justification or warning. See 77:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur. See 77:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mursalaat:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Woe to those who give less (than due).1 يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَThe Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of all that exists?Meaning: they will stand barefooted, naked and uncircumcised at a station that will be difficult, hard, and distressful for the criminals. They will be covered by the command from Allah, and it will be that, which the strength and the senses will not be able to bare.Imam Malik reported from Nafi' who reported from Ibn Umar that the Prophet SAW said:يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، حَتّٰى يَغِيبَ أَحَدُهُمْ فِي رَشْحِهِ إِلَى أَنْصَافِ أُذُنَيْهِThis will be the Day that mankind will stand before the Lord of all that exists, until one of them will sink up to the middle of his ears in sweat.Al-Bukhari recorded this Hadith from Malik and 'Abdullah bin 'Awn, both of whom…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 83:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Who deny the Day of Recompense. See 83:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples." See 83:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.1 See 83:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.1 See 83:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then indeed, they will (enter and) burn in Hellfire. See 83:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then it will be said (to them), "This is what you used to deny." See 83:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn. Nay! Verily, the Record of Al-Abrar (the righteous believers) is (preserved) in 'Illiyyin (83:18). And what will make you know what 'Illiyyin is (83:19). A Register inscribed (83:20). To which bear witness those nearest (83:21). Verily, Al-Abrar (the righteous believers) will be in Delight (83:22). On thrones, looking (83:23). You will recognize in their faces the brightness of delight (83:24). They will be given to drink of pure sealed Rahiq (83:25). Sealed with musk, and for this let those strive who want to strive (83:26). It will be mixed with Tasnim (83:27). A spring whereof drink those nearest to Allah (83:28).The Record Book of the Righteous and Their RewardAllah says that truly:إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْأَبْرَارِVerily, the Record of Al-Abrar (the righteous believers)These people are in a situation that is the opposite…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn? See 83:18

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full. See 83:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is [their destination1 recorded in] a register inscribed. See 83:18

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Which is witnessed by those brought near (to Allah). See 83:18

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure. See 83:18

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: On adorned couches, observing. See 83:18

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure. See 83:18

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will be given to drink (pure) wine1 (which was) sealed. See 83:18

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The last of it1 is musk. So for this let the competitors compete. See 83:18

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And its mixture is of Tasneem.1 See 83:18

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: A spring from which those near (to Allah) drink. See 83:18

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed. Verily, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed (83:29). And, whenever they passed by them, used to wink one to another (83:30). And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting (83:31). And when they saw them, they said: Verily, these have indeed gone astray! (83:32). But they were not sent as watchers over them (83:33). But this Day those who believe will laugh at the disbeliever (83:34). On thrones, looking (83:35). Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do (83:36). The Wicked Behavior of the Criminals and Their mocking of the Believers Allah informs that the criminals used to laugh at the believers in the worldly life. In other words, they would mock them and despise them.…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss. See 83:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances. See 83:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting. See 83:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost." See 83:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But they had not been sent as guardians over them. See 83:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So Today1 those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers. See 83:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:35 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: On adorned couches, observing. See 83:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Have the disbelievers (not) been rewarded (this Day) for what they used to do? See 83:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do they not think that they will be resurrected. See 83:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: For a tremendous Day. See 83:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds? See 83:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen. Nay! Truly, the Record of the wicked is in Sijjin (83:7). And what will make you know what Sijjin is (83:8). A Register inscribed (83:9). Woe, that Day, to those who deny (83:10). Those who deny the Day of Recompense (83:11). And none can deny it except every transgressor beyond bounds, the sinner (83:12). When Our Ayat are recited to him, he says: "Tales of the ancients! (83:13). Nay! But on their hearts is the Ran (covering) which they used to earn (83:14). Nay! Surely, they will be veiled from seeing their Lord that Day (83:15). Then verily, they will indeed enter the burning flame of Hell (83:16). Then, it will be said to them: "This is what you used to deny! (83:17).The Record of the Wicked and Some of…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And what can make you know what is sijjeen? See 83:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Mutaffifin:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is [their destination1 recorded in] a register inscribed. See 83:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who wraps himself (in clothing).1 رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَاتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًاLord of the east and the west; La ilaha illa Huwa. So take Him a trustee.Meaning: He is the Owner and Controller of affairs in the eastern regions and the western regions. He is the One except whom there is no deity worthy of worship. Just as you single Him out for worship, you should also single Him out for reliance. Therefore, take Him as a guardian and trustee. This is as Allah says in another Ayah:فَاعْبُدْهُ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِSo worship Him and rely upon him. (11:123)It is also similar to His statement:إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُYou (Alone) we worship, and you (Alone) we ask for help. (1:5)The Ayat with this meaning are numerous. They contain the command to make worship and acts of obedience exclusively for…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance. And be patient with what they say, and keep away from them in a good way (73:10). And leave Me alone to deal with the deniers, those who are in possession of good things of life. And give them respite for a little (73:11). Verily, with Us are Ankal, and Jahim (73:12). And a food that chokes, and a painful torment (73:13). On the Day when the earth and the mountains will (Tarjufu) shake, and the mountains will be a heap of sand poured out (73:14). Verily, We have sent to you a Messenger to be a witness over you, as We did send a Messenger to Fir'awn (73:15). But Fir'awn disobeyed the Messenger; so We seized him with a severe punishment (73:16). Then how can you…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And leave Me with (the matter of) the deniers, those of ease (in life), and allow them respite a little. See 73:10

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, with Us (for them) are shackles and burning fire. See 73:10

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And food that chokes and a painful punishment. See 73:10

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down. See 73:10

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger. See 73:10

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure. See 73:10

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white-haired?1 See 73:10

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The heaven will break apart therefrom;1 ever is His promise fulfilled. See 73:10

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way. Verily, this is an admonition, therefore whosoever wills, let him take a path to His Lord (73:19). Verily, your Lord knows that you do stand a little less than two-thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and also a party of those with you. And Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you are unable to pray the whole night, so He has turned to you. So, recite you of the Qur'an as much as may be easy for you. He knows that there will be some among you sick, others traveling through the land, seeking of Allah's bounty, yet others fighting in Allah's cause. So recite as much of the Qur'an as may be…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Arise (to pray) the night, except for a little. See 73:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, your Lord knows, (O Muḥammad), that you stand (in prayer) almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and (so do) a group of those with you. And Allah determines (the extent of) the night and the day. He has known that you (Muslims) will not be able to do it1 and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy (for you) of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking (something) of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allah a goodly loan.2 And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Half of it - or subtract from it a little. See 73:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or add to it, and recite the Qur’ān with measured recitation. See 73:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.1 See 73:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence (of heart and tongue)1 and more suitable for words.2 See 73:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation. See 73:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with (complete) devotion. See 73:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Muzzammil:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (He is) the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of (your) affairs.1 See 73:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qaari'a:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The Striking Calamity. نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌA fire Hamiyah!Meaning: extreme heat. It is a heat that is accompanied by a strong flame and fire. It is narrated from Abu Hurayrah that the Prophet SAW said:نَارُ بَنِي آدَمَ الَّتِي تُوقِدُونَ، جُزْءٌ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ جُزْءًا مِنْ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَThe fire of the Children of Adam that you all kindle is one part of the seventy parts of the fire of Hell.They (the Companions) said, "O Messenger of Allah! Isn't it sufficient?" He replied:إِنَّهَا فُضِّلَتْ عَلَيْهَا بِتِسْعَةٍ وَسِتِّينَ جُزْءًاIt is more than it by sixty-nine times.This has been recorded by Al-Bukhari and Muslim. In some of the wordings he stated:إِنَّهَا فُضِّلَتْ عَلَيْهَا بِتِسْعَةٍ وَسِتِّينَ جُزْءًا، كُلُّهُنَّ مِثْلُ حَرِّهَاIt is more than it by sixty-nine times, each of them is like the heat of it.It has been narrated in a Hadith that Imam Ahmad recorded from Abu…

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qaari'a:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And what can make you know what that is? See 101:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qaari'a:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is a Fire, intensely hot. See 101:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qaari'a:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: What is the Striking Calamity? See 101:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qaari'a:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity? See 101:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Al-Qaari'a:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
