For them is forgiveness and noble provision. Bad statements are for bad people and bad people for bad statements. Good statements are for good people and good people for good statements: such are innocent of (every) bad statement which they say; for them is forgiveness, and honored provision (24:26).The Goodness of Aisha Because She is Married to the Best of MankindIbn 'Abbas said, "Evil words are for evil men, and evil men are for evil words; good words are for good men and good men are for good words. This was revealed concerning Aisha and the people of…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who have believed, do not enter houses other than your own houses until you ascertain welcome and greet1 their inhabitants. That is best for you; perhaps you will be reminded (i.e., advised). O you who believe! Enter not houses other than your own, until you have asked permission and greeted those in them; that is better for you, in order that you may remember (24:27). And if you find no one therein, still enter not until permission has been given. And if you are asked to go back, go back, for it is purer for you. And Allah is All-Knower of what you do (24:28). There is no sin on you that you enter houses uninhabited, you have any interest in them. And Allah has knowledge of what you reveal and what you conceal (24:29).Seeking Permission and the…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if you do not find anyone therein, do not enter them until permission has been given you. And if it is said to you, "Go back,"1 then go back; it is purer for you. And Allah is Knowing of what you do. See 24:27

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: There is no blame upon you for entering houses not inhabited in which there is convenience1 for you. And Allah knows what you reveal and what you conceal. See 24:27

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The fornicator does not marry except a (female) fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator1 or a polytheist, and that (i.e., marriage to such persons) has been made unlawful to the believers. The Zani marries not but a Zaniyah or a Mushrikah; and the Zaniyah, none marries her except a Zani or a Mushrik. Such a thing is forbidden to the believers (24:3).Here Allah tells us that the Zani (male who is guilty of illegal sex) does not have intercourse except with a Zaniyah (female who is guilty of illegal sex) or a Mushrikah (female idolator), meaning that no one would go along with him in this action except a sinful woman who is also guilty of Zina, or a Mushrikah who does not think it is unlawful. By the same token:وَالزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَا إِلَّا زَانٍand the…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Tell the believing men to reduce (some) of their vision1 and guard their private parts.2 That is purer for them. Indeed, Allah is (fully) Aware of what they do. Tell the believing men to lower their gaze, and protect their private parts. That is purer for them. Verily, Allah is All-Aware of what they do (24:30).The Command to Lower the GazeThis is a command from Allah to His believing servants, to lower their gaze from looking at things that have been prohibited for them. They should look only at what is permissible for them to look at, and lower their gaze from forbidden things. If it so happens that a person's gaze unintentionally falls upon something forbidden, he should quickly look away. Muslim recorded in his Sahih that Jarir bin 'Abdullah Al-Bajali (RA), said, I asked the Prophet SAW about…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And tell the believing women to reduce (some) of their vision1 and guard their private parts and not expose their adornment2 except that which (necessarily) appears thereof3 and to wrap (a portion of) their headcovers over their chests and not expose their adornment (i.e., beauty) except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands' fathers, their sons, their husbands' sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, their women, that which their right hands possess (i.e., slaves), or those male attendants having no physical desire,4 or children who are not yet aware of the private aspects of women. And let them not stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment. And turn to Allah in repentance, all of you, O believers, that you might succeed. And tell the believing women to lower their gaze, and protect…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And marry the unmarried among you and the righteous among your male slaves and female slaves. If they should be poor, Allah will enrich them from His bounty, and Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing. And marry those among you who are single (Al-Ayama) and the pious of your servants and maidservants. If they be poor, Allah will enrich them out of His bounty. And Allah is All-Sufficent, All-Knowing (24:32). And let those who find not the financial means for marriage keep themselves chaste, until Allah enriches them of His bounty. And such of your servants as seek a writing (of emancipation), give them such writing, if you find that there is good and honesty in them. And give them something (yourselves) out of the wealth of Allah which He has bestowed upon you. And force not your slave-girls to prostitution,…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But let them who find not (the means for) marriage abstain (from sexual relations) until Allah enriches them from His bounty. And those who seek a contract (for eventual emancipation) from among whom your right hands possess1 - then make a contract with them if you know there is within them goodness and give them from the wealth of Allah which He has given you. And do not compel your slave girls to prostitution, if they desire chastity, to seek (thereby) the temporary interests of worldly life. And if someone should compel them, then indeed, Allah is (to them), after their compulsion, Forgiving and Merciful. See 24:32

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We have certainly sent down to you distinct verses1 and examples from those who passed on before you and an admonition for those who fear Allah. See 24:32

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:35 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah is the Light1 of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light2 is like a niche within which is a lamp;3 the lamp is within glass, the glass as if it were a pearly (white) star lit from (the oil of) a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by fire. Light upon light. Allah guides to His light whom He wills. And Allah presents examples for the people, and Allah is Knowing of all things. Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The parable of His Light is as a niche and within it a lamp: the lamp is in a glass, the glass as it were a star Durriyyun, lit from a blessed tree, an olive, neither of the east…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Such niches are) in houses (i.e., mosques) which Allah has ordered to be raised and that His name be mentioned (i.e., praised) therein; exalting Him within them in the morning and the evenings.1 In houses which Allah has ordered to be raised, in them His Name is remembered. Therein glorify Him in the mornings and in the evenings (24:36). Men whom neither trade nor business diverts from the remembrance of Allah nor from performing the Salah nor from giving the Zakah. They fear a Day when hearts and eyes will be overturned (24:37). That Allah may reward them according to the best of their deeds, and add even more for them out of His grace. And Allah provides without measure to whom He wills (24:38).The Virtues of the Masjids, the Correct Etiquette, and the Virtues of Those Who Take Care…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Are) men whom neither commerce nor sale distracts from the remembrance of Allah and performance of prayer and giving of zakāh. They fear a Day in which the hearts and eyes will (fearfully) turn about. See 24:36

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:38 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That Allah may reward them (according to) the best of what they did and increase them from His bounty. And Allah gives provision to whom He wills without account (i.e., limit). See 24:36

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:39 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But those who disbelieved - their deeds are like a mirage in a lowland which a thirsty one thinks is water until, when he comes to it, he finds it is nothing but finds Allah before him, and He will pay him in full his due; and Allah is swift in account. As for those who disbelieved, their deeds are like a mirage in a Qi'ah. The thirsty one thinks it to be water until he comes up to it, he finds it to be nothing; but he finds Allah with him, Who will pay him his due. And Allah is swift in taking account (24:39). Or like the darkness in a vast deep sea, overwhelmed with waves topped by waves, topped by dark clouds, (layers of) darkness upon darkness: if a man stretches out his hand, he can hardly…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. And those are the defiantly disobedient. And those who accuse chaste women, and produce not four witnesses, flog them with eighty stripes, and reject their testimony forever. They indeed are the rebellious (24:4). Except those who repent thereafter and do righteous deeds; (for such) verily, Allah is Of the Forgiving, Most Merciful (24:5).The Prescribed Punishment for Slandering Chaste WomenThis Ayah states the prescribed punishment for making false accusations against chaste women, i.e., those who are free, adult and chaste. If the person who is falsely accused is a man, the same punishment of flogging also applies. If the accuser produces evidence that what he is saying is true, then the punishment does…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:40 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or (they are) like darknesses within an unfathomable sea which is covered by waves, upon which are waves, over which are clouds - darknesses, some of them upon others. When one puts out his hand (therein), he can hardly see it. And he to whom Allah has not granted light - for him there is no light. See 24:39

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:41 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do you not see that Allah is exalted by whomever is within the heavens and the earth and (by) the birds with wings spread (in flight)? Each (of them) has known his (means of) prayer and exalting (Him), and Allah is Knowing of what they do. See you not that Allah, He it is Whom glorify whosoever is in the heavens and the earth, and the birds with wings outspread? Of each one He knows indeed his Salah and his glorification; and Allah is All-Aware of what they do (24:41). And to Allah belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah is the return (24:42).Everything Glorifies Allah, May He Be Exalted, and to Him Belongs the SovereigntyAllah tells us that whosoever is in the heavens and on the earth, i.e., the angels, mankind, Jinn, animals and…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:42 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah is the destination. See 24:41

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:43 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do you not see that Allah drives clouds? Then He brings them together; then He makes them into a mass, and you see the rain emerge from within it. And He sends down from the sky, mountains (of clouds) within which is hail, and He strikes with it whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills. The flash of its lightning almost takes away the eyesight. See you not that Allah drives the clouds gently, then joins them together, then makes them into a heap of layers, and you see the rain come forth from between them; and He sends down from the sky, from mountains in it of ice, and strikes therewith whom He wills, and averts it from whom He wills. The vivid flash of its (clouds) lightning nearly blinds the sight (24:43). Allah causes the…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:44 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah alternates the night and the day. Indeed in that is a lesson for those who have vision. See 24:43

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:45 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah has created every (living) creature from water. And of them are those that move on their bellies, and of them are those that walk on two legs, and of them are those that walk on four. Allah creates what He wills. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent. Allah has created every moving creature from water. Of them there are some that creep on their bellies, and some that walk on two legs, and some that walk on four. Allah creates what He wills. Verily, Allah is able to do all things (24:45).Allah's Power in His Creation of the AnimalsAllah mentions His complete and almighty power to create all the different kinds of animals with their various forms, colors and ways of moving and stopping, from one kind of water.فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِي عَلَىٰ بَطْنِهِOf them there are some that…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:46 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: We have certainly sent down distinct verses. And Allah guides whom He wills to a straight path. We have indeed sent down manifest Ayat. And Allah guides whom He wills to the straight path.) Allah states that in this Qur'an He has revealed many clear and unambiguous rulings, words of wisdom and parables, and that He guides people of understanding, insight and intellect to ponder and understand them. He say (24:46).وَاللَّهُ يَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍAnd Allah guides whom He wills to the Straight Path.

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:47 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But they (i.e., the hypocrites) say, "We have believed in Allah and in the Messenger, and we obey"; then a party of them turns away after that. And those are not believers. They say: "We have believed in Allah and in the Messenger, and we obey," then a party of them turn away thereafter, such are not believers (24:47). And when they are called to Allah and His Messenger, to judge between them, lo! a party of them refuses and turns away (24:48). But if the truth is on their side, they come to him willingly with submission (24:49). Is there a disease in their hearts? Or do they doubt or fear lest Allah and His Messenger should wrong them in judgement. Nay, it is they themselves who are the wrongdoers (24:50). The only saying of the faithful believers, when…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:48 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when they are called to (the words of) Allah and His Messenger to judge between them, at once a party of them turns aside (in refusal). See 24:47

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:49 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But if the right is theirs, they come to him in prompt obedience. See 24:47

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. See 24:4

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:50 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Is there disease in their hearts? Or have they doubted? Or do they fear that Allah will be unjust to them, or His Messenger? Rather, it is they who are the wrongdoers (i.e., the unjust). See 24:47

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:51 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The only statement of the (true) believers when they are called to Allah and His Messenger to judge between them is that they say, "We hear and we obey." And those are the successful. See 24:47

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:52 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger and fears Allah and is conscious of Him - it is those who are the attainers. See 24:47

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:53 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they swear by Allah their strongest oaths that if you ordered them, they would go forth (in Allah's cause). Say, "Do not swear. (Such) obedience is known.1 Indeed, Allah is (fully) Aware of that which you do." They swear by Allah their strongest oaths that if only you would order them, they would leave. Say: "Swear you not; obedience is known. Verily, Allah knows well what you do (24:53). Say: "Obey Allah and obey the Messenger, but if you turn away, he is only responsible for the duty placed on him and you for that placed on you. If you obey him, you shall be on the right guidance. The Messenger's duty is only to convey (the Message) in a clear way (24:54).Allah says about the hypocrites who had promised the Messenger SAW and sworn that if he were…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:54 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon him is only that (duty) with which he has been charged, and upon you is that with which you have been charged. And if you obey him, you will be (rightly) guided. And there is not upon the Messenger except the (responsibility for) clear notification." See 24:53

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:55 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah has promised those who have believed among you and done righteous deeds that He will surely grant them succession (to authority) upon the earth just as He granted it to those before them and that He will surely establish for them (therein) their religion which He has preferred for them and that He will surely substitute for them, after their fear, security, (for) they worship Me, not associating anything with Me. But whoever disbelieves1 after that - then those are the defiantly disobedient. Allah has promised those among you who believe and do righteous good deeds, that He will certainly grant them succession in the land, as He granted it to those before them, and that He will grant them the authority to practise their religion which He has chosen for them. And He will surely give them in…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:56 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And establish prayer and give zakāh and obey the Messenger - that you may receive mercy. And perform the Salah, and give the Zakah and obey the Messenger that you may receive mercy (24:56). Consider not that the disbelievers can escape in the land. Their abode shall be the Fire – and worst indeed is that destination (24:57).The Command to Pray, Give the Zakah and Obey the Messenger SAW; The Inability of the Disbelievers to Escape, and the Ultimate DestinyAllah commands His believing servants to establish prayer, which means worshipping Allah Alone with no partner or associate; to pay the Zakah, which is an act of kindness towards His poor and weak creatures; and by doing so to obey the Messenger of Allah SAW, i.e., to do as he commands them and to avoid what he forbids them, so that…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:57 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Never think that the disbelievers are causing failure (to Allah) upon the earth. Their refuge will be the Fire - and how wretched the destination. See 24:56

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:58 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who have believed, let those whom your right hands possess and those who have not (yet) reached puberty among you ask permission of you (before entering) at three times: before the dawn prayer and when you put aside your clothing (for rest) at noon and after the night prayer. (These are) three times of privacy1 for you. There is no blame upon you nor upon them beyond these (periods), for they continually circulate among you - some of you, among others. Thus does Allah make clear to you the verses (i.e., His ordinances); and Allah is Knowing and Wise. O you who believe! Let your slaves and slave-girls, and those among you who have not come to the age of puberty ask your permission on three occasions: before the Fajr prayer, and while you put off your clothes…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:59 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when the children among you reach puberty, let them ask permission (at all times) as those before them have done. Thus does Allah make clear to you His verses; and Allah is Knowing and Wise. See 24:58

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those who accuse their wives (of adultery) and have no witnesses except themselves - then the witness of one of them1 (shall be) four testimonies (swearing) by Allah that indeed, he is of the truthful. And for those who accuse their wives, but have no witnesses except themselves, let the testimony of one of them be four testimonies by Allah that he is one of those who speak the truth (24:6). And the fifth (testimony); invoking of the curse of Allah on him if he be of those who tell a lie (24:7). But she shall avert the punishment from her, if she bears witness four times by Allah, that he is telling a lie (24:8). And the fifth; should be that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he speaks the truth (24:9). And had it not…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:60 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And women of post-menstrual age who have no desire for marriage - there is no blame upon them for putting aside their outer garments (but) not displaying adornment. But to modestly refrain (from that) is better for them. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing. See 24:58

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:61 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: There is not upon the blind (any) constraint nor upon the lame constraint nor upon the ill constraint nor upon yourselves when you eat from your (own) houses or the houses of your fathers or the houses of your mothers or the houses of your brothers or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your father's brothers or the houses of your father's sisters or the houses of your mother's brothers or the houses of your mother's sisters or (from houses) whose keys you possess or (from the house) of your friend. There is no blame upon you whether you eat together or separately. But when you enter houses, give greetings of peace1 upon each other - a greeting from Allah, blessed and good. Thus does Allah make clear to you the verses (of ordinance) that you may…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:62 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The believers are only those who believe in Allah and His Messenger and, when they are (meeting) with him for a matter of common interest, do not depart until they have asked his permission. Indeed, those who ask your permission, (O Muḥammad) - those are the ones who believe in Allah and His Messenger. So when they ask your permission due to something of their affairs, then give permission to whom you will among them and ask forgiveness for them of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. The believers are only those who believe in Allah and His Messenger; and when they are with him on some common matter, they go not away until they have asked his permission. Verily, those who ask your permission, those are they who (really) believe in Allah and His Messenger. So if they…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:63 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do not make (your) calling of the Messenger among yourselves as the call of one of you to another. Already Allah knows those of you who slip away, concealed by others. So let those beware who dissent from his (i.e., the Prophet's) order,1 lest fitnah2 strike them or a painful punishment. Make not the calling of the Messenger among you as your calling one of another. Allah knows those of you who slip away under shelter. And let those beware who oppose the Messenger's commandment, lest some Fitnah should befall them or a painful torment be inflicted on them (24:63).The Etiquette of Addressing the Prophet SAWAd-Dahhak said, reporting from Ibn 'Abbas: "They used to say, 'O Muhammad,' or 'O Abu Al-Qasim,' but Allah forbade them to do that, as a sign of respect towards His Prophet SAW, and told them…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:64 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Unquestionably, to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Already He knows that upon which you (stand)1 and (knows) the Day2 when they will be returned to Him and He will inform them of what they have done. And Allah is Knowing of all things. Certainly, to Allah belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He knows your condition and the Day when they will be brought back to Him, then He will inform them of what they did. And Allah is All-Knower of everything (24:64).Allah Knows Your ConditionAllah tells us that He is the Sovereign of the heavens and the earth, and He knows the seen and the unseen. He knows what His servants do in secret and in the open. So He says:قَدْ يَعْلَمُ مَا أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِIndeed, He knows your conditionHe knows…

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the fifth (oath will be) that the curse of Allah be upon him if he should be of the liars. See 24:6

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies (swearing) by Allah that indeed, he is of the liars. See 24:6

item.title: bil-Quran: An-Noor:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the fifth (oath will be) that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he was of the truthful. See 24:6

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Alif, Lām, Meem, Rā.1 These are the verses of the Book; and what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, but most of the people do not believe. المر ۚ تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ ۗ وَالَّذِي أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ الْحَقُّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ1. Alif Lam-Mim Ra. These are the verses of the Book (the Qur'an), and that which has been revealed unto you from your Lord is the truth, but most men believe not.The Qur'an is Allah's Kalam (Speech)We talked before, in the beginning of Surat Al-Baqarah (chapter 2) about the meaning of the letters that appear in the beginnings of some chapters in the Qur'an. We stated that every Surah that starts with separate letters, affirms that the Qur'an is miraculous and is an evidence that it is a revelation from Allah, and…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is the same (to Him) concerning you whether one conceals (his) speech or publicizes it and whether one is hidden by night or conspicuous (among others) by day. It is the same (to Him) whether any of you conceals his speech or declares it openly, whether he be hid by night or goes forth freely by day (13:10). For him (each person), there are angels in succession, before and behind him. They guard him by the command of Allah. Verily, Allah will not change the (good) condition of a people as long as they do not change their state (of goodness) themselves. But when Allah wills a people's punishment, there can be no turning it back, and they will find besides Him no protector (13:11).Allah's Knowledge Encompasses All Things Apparent and HiddenAllah declares that His knowledge is encompassing all…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: For him (i.e., each one) are successive (angels)1 before and behind him who protect him by the decree of Allah.2 Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. And when Allah intends for a people ill,3 there is no repelling it. And there is not for them besides Him any patron. See 13:10

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is He who shows you lightning, (causing) fear and aspiration, and generates the heavy clouds. It is He Who shows you the lightning, as a fear and as a hope. And it is He Who brings up the clouds, heavy (with water) (13:12). And Ar-Ra'd (thunder) glorifies and praises Him, and so do the angels because of His awe. He sends the thunderbolts, and therewith He strikes whom He wills, yet they (disbelievers) dispute about Allah. And He is Mighty in strength and Severe in punishment (13:13).Clouds, Thunder and Lightning are Signs of Allah's PowerAllah states that He has full power over Al-Barq (lightning), which is the bright light that originates from within clouds. Ibn Jarir recorded that Ibn 'Abbas once wrote to Abu Al-Jald asking about the meaning of Al-Barq, and he said that it is water. Qatadah…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the thunder exalts (Allah) with praise of Him - and the angels (as well) from fear of Him - and He sends thunderbolts and strikes therewith whom He wills while they dispute about Allah; and He is severe in assault. See 13:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: To Him (alone) is the supplication of truth. And those they call upon besides Him do not respond to them with a thing, except as one who stretches his hands toward water (from afar, calling it) to reach his mouth, but it will not reach it (thus).1 And the supplication of the disbelievers is not but in error (i.e., futility). For Him is the Word of Truth. item.description: He sends down from the sky, rain, and valleys flow according to their capacity, and the torrent carries a rising foam. item.description: For those who have responded to their Lord is the best (reward), but those who did not respond to Him - if they had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would (attempt to) ransom themselves thereby. But those who answered not His call, if they had all that is in the earth together with its like, they would offer it in order to save themselves. For them there will be the terrible reckoning. item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is Allah who erected the heavens without pillars that you (can) see; then He established Himself above the Throne1 and made subject2 the sun and the moon, each running (its course) for a specified term. He arranges (each) matter; He details the signs that you may, of the meeting with your Lord, be certain. Allah is He Who raised the heavens without any pillars that you can see. Then, He rose above (Istawa) the 'Arsh (Throne). He has subjected the sun and the moon, each running (its course) for a term appointed. item.description: And those who are patient, seeking the face (i.e., acceptance) of their Lord, and establish prayer and spend from what We have provided for them secretly and publicly and prevent evil with good - those will have the good consequence of (this) home1. See 13:20

item.description: But those who break the covenant of Allah after contracting it and sever that which Allah has ordered to be joined and spread corruption on earth - for them is the curse, and they will have the worst home.1 And those who break the covenant of Allah, after its ratification, and sever that which Allah has commanded to be joined, and work mischief in the land, on them is the curse, and for them is the unhappy (evil) home (i.e. Hell) (13:25).Characteristics of the Wretched Ones which will Lead to the Curse and the Evil HomeThis is the destination of the Wretched ones and these are their characteristics. item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Ra'd:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts (it). And they rejoice in the worldly life, while the worldly life is not, compared to the Hereafter, except (brief) enjoyment. Allah increases the provision for whom He wills, and straitens (it for whom He wills), and they rejoice in the life of the world, whereas the life of this world compared to the Hereafter is but a brief passing enjoyment (13:26).Increase and Decrease in Provision is in Allah's HandAllah states that He alone increases the provisions for whom He wills and decreases it for whom He wills, according to His wisdom and perfect justice. So, when the disbelievers rejoice with the life of the present world that was given to them, they do not know that they are being tested and tried. Allah said in other Ayat:أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِ…

item.description: And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" item.description: For them will be punishment in the life of (this) world, and the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe. And they will not have from Allah any protector. item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Rahmaan:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The Most Merciful. فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِThen which of the blessings of your Lord will you both deny?Meaning: "O mankind and Jinn, which of the favors that Allah has given to you do you deny?" Mujahid and others said this, and it is apparent when one reads what comes after it. Meaning the favors that are obvious to you while you are surrounded by them, you cannot deny or reject them.So we say, just as the believers among the Jinns said, "O Allah! None of Your favors do we deny. All praise is due to You." Ibn 'Abbas used to say, "Nay, our Lord!" meaning, "None of Your favors do we deny."

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then the end of those who did evil was the worst (consequence) because they denied the signs of Allah and used to ridicule them. Al-Hassan Al-Basri said, “It has reached the state that in this world one of them could put a Dirham on his finger and tell how much it weighs, but he does not know how to pray properly.”أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ ۗ مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ۗ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِنَ النَّاسِ بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ لَكَافِرُونَ - أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَأَثَارُوا الْأَرْضَ وَعَمَرُوهَا أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوهَا وَجَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ - ثُمَّ كَانَ عَاقِبَةَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوا السُّوأَىٰ أَن كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَكَانُوا بِهَا يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ8. Do they not reflect on themselves? Allah…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah begins creation; then He will repeat it; then to Him you will be returned. Allah originates the creation, then He will repeat it, then to Him you will be returned (30:11). And on the Day when the Hour will be established, the criminals will be plunged into destruction with despair (30:12). No intercessors will they have from those whom they made equal with Allah, and they will reject and deny their partners (30:13). And on the Day when the Hour will be established – that Day shall they be separated (30:14). Then as for those who believed and did righteous good deeds, such shall be honored and made to enjoy a luxurious life in a Garden of Delight (30:15). And as for those who disbelieved and denied Our Ayat, and the meeting of the Hereafter, such shall be brought…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So exalted is Allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning. So glorify Allah, when you enter the evening, and when you enter the morning (30:17). And His is all the praise in the heavens and the earth; and in 'Ashiyya and when Tuẓhirūn (30:18). He brings out the living from the dead, and brings out the dead from the living. And He revives the earth after its death. And thus shall you be brought out (30:19).The Command to Pray Five Times DailyHere Allah glorifies Himself and commands His servants to glorify and praise Him at these times which come one after the other and are indicative of His might and power in the heavens. This is when the night comes with its darkness, then in the morning the day comes with its light. This glorification…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And of His signs is that He created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing (throughout the earth). And among His signs is this that He created you from dust, and then – behold you are human beings scattered (30:20). And among His signs is this that He created for you wives from among yourselves, that you may find repose in them, and He has put between you affection and mercy. Verily, in that are indeed signs for a people who reflect (30:21).Among the Signs of AllahAllah says:وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِAnd among His signs– which speak of His might and power, is the fact that He created your father Adam out of dust.ثُمَّ إِذَا أَنْتُمْ بَشَرٌ تَنْتَشِرُونَand then – behold you are human beings scattered!So man's origins lie in dust, then in a despised liquid, then he is formed…

item.description: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought. See 30:20

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge. And among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the difference of your languages and colors. Verily, in that are indeed signs for men of sound knowledge (30:22). And among His signs is your sleep by night and by day, and your seeking His bounty. Verily, in that are indeed signs for a people who listen.) Allah sai (30:23).وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِAnd among His signsindicating His magnificent power.خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِis the creation of the heavens and the earth,The heavens with their vast height and brightness and beauty of the stars and planets, and the earth with its density and its mountains, valleys, seas, plains, animals and…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen. See 30:22

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And of His signs is (that) He shows you the lightning (causing) fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason. And among His signs is that He shows you the lightning, for fear and for hope, and He sends down water from the sky, and therewith revives the earth after its death. Verily, in that are indeed signs for a people who understand (30:24). And among His signs is that the heaven and the earth stand by His command. Then afterwards when He will call you by a single call, behold, you will come out from the earth.) Allah say (30:25).وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِAnd among His signswhich speak of His greatness:يُرِيكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًاHe shows you the…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And of His signs is that the heaven and earth stand (i.e., remain) by His command. Then when He calls you with a (single) call from the earth, immediately you will come forth. See 30:24

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. All are to Him devoutly obedient. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. All are obedient to Him (30:26). And He it is Who originates the creation, then He will repeat it; and this is easier for Him. His is the highest description in the heavens and in the earth. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.) Allah say (30:27).وَلَهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖTo Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth.means, He owns it and it is enslaved to Him.كُلٌّ لَهُ قَانِتُونَAll are obedient to Him.they are humble before Him and submit to Him, whether willingly or unwillingly.Repeating the Creation is Easier for AllahAllah's saying:وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَبْدَأُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ ۚAnd He it is Who originates the creation,…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is (even) easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest description (i.e., attribute) in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. See 30:26

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He presents to you an example from yourselves. Do you have among those whom your right hands possess (i.e., slaves) any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein (and) would fear them as your fear of one another (within a partnership)?1 Thus do We detail the verses for a people who use reason. He sets forth for you a parable from yourselves: Do you have partners among those whom your right hands possess to share as equals in the wealth We have bestowed on you, whom you fear as you fear each other? Thus do We explain the signs in detail to a people who have sense (30:28). Nay, but those who do wrong follow their own lusts without knowledge. Then who will guide him whom Allah has sent astray And for such…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But those who wrong follow their (own) desires without knowledge. Then who can guide one whom Allah has sent astray? And for them there are no helpers. See 30:28

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: In the nearest land.1 But they, after their defeat, will overcome. See 30:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So direct your face (i.e., self) toward the religion, inclining to truth. (Adhere to) the fiṭrah1 of Allah upon which He has created (all) people. No change should there be in the creation of Allah.2 That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know. So, set you your face towards the religion as a Hanif. Allah's Fitrah with which He has created mankind. No change let there be in Allah's Khalq, that is the straight religion, but most men know not (30:30). (And remain always) turning in repentance to Him and have Taqwa of Him; and perform the Salah and be not of idolators (30:31). Of those who split up their religion, and became sects, each sect rejoicing in that which is with it (30:32).The Command to Adhere to TawhidAllah says: 'so set your face and…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Adhere to it), turning in repentance to Him, and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allah. See 30:30

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Or) of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has.1 See 30:30

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord. And when harm touches men, they cry sincerely only to their Lord, turning to Him in repentance; but when He gives them a taste of His mercy, behold, a party of them associates partners in worship with their Lord (30:33). So as to be ungrateful for the graces which We have bestowed on them. Then enjoy; but you will come to know (30:34). Or have We revealed to them an authority, which speaks of that which they have been associating with Him (30:35). And when We cause mankind to taste of mercy, they rejoice therein; but when some evil afflicts them because of what…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So that they will deny what We have granted them.1 Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know. See 30:33

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:35 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or have We sent down to them an authority (i.e., a proof or scripture), and it speaks of what they have been associating with Him? See 30:33

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when We let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair. See 30:33

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do they not see that Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts (it)? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe. See 30:33

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:38 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. That is best for those who desire the face (i.e., approval) of Allah, and it is they who will be the successful. So, give to the kindred his due, and to Al-Miskin and to the wayfarer. That is best for those who seek Allah's Face; and it is they who will be successful (30:38). And that which you give in Riba in order that it may increase from other people's property, has no increase with Allah; but that which you give in Zakah seeking Allah's Face, then those they shall have manifold increase (30:39). Allah is He Who created you, then provided food for you, then will cause you to die, then He will give you life. Is there any of your partners that do anything…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:39 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And whatever you give for interest (i.e., advantage) to increase within the wealth of people1 will not increase with Allah. But what you give in zakāh,2 desiring the face (i.e., approval) of Allah - those are the multipliers.3 See 30:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Within three to nine years. To Allah belongs the command (i.e., decree) before and after. And that day the believers will rejoice. See 30:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:40 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. Are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him. See 30:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:41 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by (reason of) what the hands of people have earned so He (i.e., Allah) may let them taste part of (the consequence of) what they have done that perhaps they will return (to righteousness). Evil has appeared in Al-Barr and Al-Bahr because of what the hands of men have earned, that He may make them taste a part of that which they have done, in order that they may return (30:41). Say: "Travel in the land and see what was the end of those before (you)! Most of them were idolators (30:42). The Effects of Sin in this World Ibn 'Abbas, 'Ikrimah, Ad-Dahhak, As-Suddi and others said: "What is meant by Al-Barr here is the empty land or wilderness, and by Al-Bahr is towns and cities." According to a report narrated from…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:42 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, (O Muḥammad), "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators (of others with Allah). See 30:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:43 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So direct your face (i.e., self) toward the correct religion before a Day comes from Allah of which there is no repelling. That Day, they will be divided.1 So, set you your face to the straight and right religion, before there comes from Allah a Day which none can avert. On that Day men shall be divided (30:43). Whosoever disbelieves will suffer from his disbelief, and whosoever does righteous good deeds, then such will prepare a good place for themselves (30:44). That He may reward those who believe and do righteous good deeds, out of His bounty. Verily, He likes not the disbelievers (30:45).The Command to Follow the Straight Path before the Day of ResurrectionHere Allah commands His servants to hasten to obedience to Him and to hasten to do good deeds.فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ الْقَيِّمِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:44 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Whoever disbelieves - upon him is (the consequence of) his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing. See 30:43

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:45 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not like the disbelievers. See 30:43

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:46 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And of His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of good tidings and to let you taste His mercy (i.e., rain) and so the ships may sail at His command and so you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful. And among His signs is this that He sends the winds as glad tidings, giving you a taste of His mercy, and that the ships may sail at His command, and that you may seek of His bounty, in order that you may be thankful (30:46). And indeed We did send Messengers before you to their own peoples. They came to them with clear proofs, then, We took vengeance on those who committed crimes; and it was incumbent upon Us to help the believers (30:47).Among the Signs of Allah are the WindsHere Allah…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:47 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then We took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon Us was support1 of the believers. See 30:46

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:48 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is Allah who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. And when He causes it to fall upon whom He wills of His servants, immediately they rejoice. Allah is He Who sends the winds, so that they raise clouds and spread them along the sky as He wills, and then break them into fragments until you see rain drops come forth from their midst! Then when He has made them fall on whom of His servants as He wills, lo, they rejoice (30:48). And verily, before that – just before it was sent down upon them – they were in despair (30:49). Look then at the effects of Allah's mercy, how He revives the earth…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:49 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair. See 30:48

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: In the victory of Allah.1 He gives victory to whom He wills, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful. See 30:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:50 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So observe the effects of the mercy of Allah - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that (same one) will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent. See 30:48

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:51 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But if We should send a (bad) wind and they saw (their crops) turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers.1 See 30:48

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:52 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating. So verily, you cannot make the dead to hear, nor can you make the deaf to hear the call, when they show their backs and turn away (30:52). And you cannot guide the blind from their straying; you can make to hear only those who believe in Our Ayat, and have submitted (to Allah in Islam) (30:53).The Disbelievers are like the Dead, Deaf and BlindAllah says, 'just as you are not able to make the dead hear in their graves, or to make your words reach the deaf who cannot hear and who still turn away from you, so too you cannot guide the blind to the truth and bring them back from their misguidance.' That…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:53 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims (in submission to Allah). See 30:52

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:54 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent. Allah is He Who created you in weakness, then gave you strength after weakness, then after strength gave (you) weakness and grey hair. He creates what He wills. And He is the All-Knowing, the All-Powerful (30:54).The Different Stages of ManHere Allah points out how man passes through different stages of creation, one phase after another. He is originally created from dust, then from a Nutfah, then from a clot, then from a lump of flesh. Then he becomes bones, then the bones are clothed with flesh, then the soul is breathed into him. Then he emerges from his mother's womb, weak and thin and powerless. Then…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:55 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. Thus they were deluded. And on the Day that the Hour will be established, the criminals will swear that they stayed not but an hour – thus were they ever deluded (30:55). And those who have been bestowed with knowledge and Faith will say: Indeed you have stayed according to the decree of Allah, until the Day of Resurrection; so this is the Day of Resurrection, but you knew not (30:56). So, on that Day no excuse of theirs will avail those who did wrong, nor will they be allowed to return to seek (Allah's) pleasure (30:57). The Ignorance of the Disbelievers in this World and in the Hereafter Here Allah tells us of the ignorance of the disbelievers in this world and in…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:56 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "You remained the extent of Allah's decree until the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not used to know."1 See 30:55

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:57 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So that Day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease (Allah). See 30:55

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:58 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We have certainly presented to the people in this Qur’ān from every (kind of) example. But, (O Muḥammad), if you should bring them a sign, the disbelievers will surely say, "You (believers) are but falsifiers." And indeed We have set forth for mankind, in this Qur'an every kind of parable. But if you bring to them any sign or proof, the disbelievers are sure to say (to the believers): You follow nothing but falsehood and magic (30:58). Thus does Allah seal up the hearts of those who know not (30:59). So be patient. Verily, the promise of Allah is true; and let not those who have no certainty of faith discourage you (from conveying Allah's Message) (30:60). Parables in the Qur'an and how the Disbelievers do not learn from them:وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ ۚAnd…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:59 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Thus does Allah seal the hearts of those who do not know.1 See 30:58

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (It is) the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in His promise, but most of the people do not know. See 30:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:60 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain (in faith). See 30:58

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the Hereafter, are unaware. See 30:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do they not contemplate within themselves?1 Allah has not created the heavens and the earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term. And indeed, many of the people, in the meeting with their Lord, are disbelievers. وَيَوْمَئِذٍ يَفْرَحُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ - بِنَصْرِ اللَّهِ ۚAnd on that day, the believers will rejoice – with the help of Allah.They will rejoice because the Romans, the companions of Caesar, the king of Ash-Sham, defeated the Persians, the companions of Chosroes, who were Zoroastrians. According to many of the scholars, such as Ibn Abbas, Ath-Thawri, As-Suddi and others, the victory of the Romans over the Persians happened on the same day as the battle of Badr. It was reported in the Hadith recorded by At-Tirmidhi, Ibn Jarir, Ibn Abi Hatim and Al-Bazaar that Abu Said said: “On the day…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ar-Room:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? They were greater than them in power, and they plowed (or excavated) the earth and built it up more than they (i.e., the Makkans) have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences. And Allah would not ever have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves. الرَّحِيمُthe Most Merciful.means, towards His believing servants.وَعْدَ اللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ(It is) a promise of Allah, and Allah fails not in His promise.means, ‘this that We have told you, O Muhammad, that the Romans will defeat the Persians, is a true promise from Allah, truth which cannot be changed and which will surely come to pass, because Allah has decreed that the one of the two parties that is closer to…

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: By those (angels) lined up in rows. فَالتَّالِيَاتِ ذِكْرًاBy those who bring the Dhikr.As-Suddi said, "The angels bring the Scriptures and the Qur'an from Allah to mankind."The One True God is Allahإِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمْ لَوَاحِدٌ - رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِVerily, your God is indeed One, Lord of the heavens and the earth,This is the One by Whom the oath is sworn, stating that there is no God worthy of worship but He, Lord of the heavens and the earth:وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَاand all that is between them,means, of created beings.وَرَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِand Lord of every point of the sun's risings.means, He is the Sovereign Who is controlling His creation by subjugating it and all that is in it of stars, planets and heavenly bodies which appear from the east and set in the west. Mentioning the east is sufficient and there is no need for…

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Except one who snatches (some words) by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing (in brightness). See 37:6

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:100 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: My Lord, grant me (a child) from among the righteous." See 37:99

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:101 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy. See 37:99

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:102 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when he reached with him (the age of) exertion,1 he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I (must) sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast." See 37:99

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:103 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when they had both submitted1 and he put him down upon his forehead. See 37:99

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:104 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: We called to him, "O Ibrahim. See 37:99

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:105 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good. See 37:99

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:106 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, this was the clear trial. See 37:99

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:107 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice.1 See 37:99

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:108 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We left for him (favorable mention) among later generations. See 37:99

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:109 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: "Peace upon Ibrahim." See 37:99

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then inquire of them, (O Muḥammad), "Are they a stronger (or more difficult) creation or those (others) We have created?" Indeed, We created them (i.e., men) from sticky clay. Then ask them: "Are they harder to create, or those whom We have created?" Verily, We created them of a sticky clay (37:11). Nay, you wondered while they mock (37:12). And when they are reminded, they pay no attention (37:13). And when they see an Ayah (a sign) from Allah, they mock at it (37:14). And they say: "This is nothing but evident magic! (37:15). "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we verily be resurrected? (37:16). "And also our fathers of old? (37:17). Say : "Yes, and you shall then be humiliated (37:18). It will be a single Zajrah, and behold, they will be staring (37:19).The…

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:110 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good. See 37:99

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:111 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants. See 37:99

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:112 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We gave him good tidings of Ishaq, a prophet from among the righteous.1 See 37:99

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:113 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We blessed him and Ishaq. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself (i.e., sinner). See 37:99

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:114 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We did certainly confer favor upon Musa and Harun. And, indeed We gave Our grace to Musa and Harun (37:114). And We saved them and their people from the great distress (37:115). And helped them, so that they became the victors (37:116). And We gave them the clear Scripture (37:117). And guided them to the right path (37:118). And We left for them among the later generations (37:119). Salam (peace!) be upon Musa and Harun! (37:120). Verily, thus do We reward the doers of good (37:121). Verily, they were two of Our believing servants (37:122). Musa and Harun Allah tells us how He blessed Musa and Harun with prophethood and how He saved them, along with those who believed, from the oppression of Fir'awn and his people, who had persecuted them by killing their sons and sparing their women,…

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:123 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers. And verily, Ilyas was one of the Messengers (37:123). When he said to his people: "Will you not have Taqwa? (37:124). "Will you call upon 'Ba'l and forsake the Best of creators (37:125). Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers? (37:126). But they denied him, so they will certainly be brought forth (37:127). Save the chosen servants of Allah (37:128). And We left for him among the later generations (37:129). "Salam (peace!) be upon Ilyasin! (37:130). Verily, thus do We reward the doers of good (37:131). Verily, he was one of Our believing servants (37:132). Ilyas Qatadah and Muhammad bin Ishaq said, "Ilyas is another name for Idris." Ibn Abi Hatim recorded that 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA), said, "Ilyas is Idris." This was also the view of Ad-Dahhak. Wahb bin…

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:133 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, Lut was among the messengers. And verily, Lut was one of the Messengers (37:133). When We saved him and his family, all (37:134). Except an old woman (his wife) who was among those who remained behind (37:135). Then We destroyed the rest (37:136). Verily, you pass by them in the morning (37:137). And at night; will you not then reflect (37:138).The Destruction of the People of LutAllah tells us that He sent His servant and Messenger Lut (AS), to his people, and they denied him, so Allah saved him from among them, him and his family with the exception of his wife, who was destroyed along with her people. Allah destroyed them with different kinds of punishments, and made their vicinity a foul, stinking lake which is on a well-travelled route where people pass by night and day…

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:139 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, Yunus was among the messengers. And verily, Yunus was one of the Messengers (37:139). When he ran to the laden ship (37:140). Then he (agreed to) cast lots, and he was among the losers (37:141). Then a (big) fish swallowed him as he had done an act worthy of blame (37:142). Had he not been of them who glorify Allah (37:143). He would have indeed remained inside its belly (the fish) till the Day of Resurrection (37:144). But We cast him forth on the naked shore while he was sick (37:45). And We caused a plant of gourd to grow over him (37:146). And We sent him to a hundred thousand (people) or even more (37:147). And they believed; so We gave them enjoyment for a while (37:148).The Story of YunusWe have already discussed the story of Yunus…

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:149 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So inquire of them, (O Muḥammad), "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?1 Now ask them: Are there (only) daughters for your Lord and sons for them? (37:149). Or did We create the angels female while they were witnesses (37:150). Verily, it is of their falsehood that they say (37:151). "Allah has begotten." And, verily, they are liars (37:152). Has He (then) chosen daughters rather than sons (37:153). What is the matter with you? How do you decide (37:154). Will you not then remember (37:155). Or is there for you a plain authority (37:156). Then bring your Book if you are truthful (37:157). And they have invented a kinship between Him and the Jinn, but the Jinn know well that they have indeed to appear (before Him) (37:158). Glorified be Allah! (He is free) from what they attribute…

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:161 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So indeed, you (disbelievers) and whatever you worship. So, verily you and those whom you worshi (37:161). Cannot lead astray (37:162). Except those who are predestined to burn in Hell (37:163). And there is not one of us (angels) but has his known place (37:164). And verily, we (angels), we stand in rows (37:165). And verily, we (angels) indeed are those who glorify (37:166). And indeed they used to say (37:167). "If we had a reminder as had the men of old, (37:168). "We would have indeed been the chosen servants of Allah! (37:169). But (now) they disbelieve therein, so they will come to know (37:170).No One Believes what the Idolators Say Except Those Who are Even More Misguided than TheyAllah says, addressing the idolators:فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ - مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَاتِنِينَ - إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ الْجَحِيمِSo, verily you…

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:171 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And Our word (i.e., decree) has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers. And, verily, Our Word has gone forth of old for Our servants, the Messengers (37:171). That they verily would be made triumphant (37:172). And that Our hosts! they verily would be the victors (37:173). So, turn away from them for a while (37:174). And watch them and they shall see (37:175). Do they seek to hasten on Our torment (37:176). Then, when it descends in their courtyard, evil will be the morning for those who had warned (37:177). So, turn away from them for a while (37:178). And watch and they shall see (37:179).The Promise of Victory and the Command to Turn Away from IdolatorsAllah says:وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِينَAnd, verily, Our Word has gone forth of old for Our servants, the Messengers,Meaning: it has already been…

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:172 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (That) indeed, they would be those given victory. See 37:171

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:180 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe. Glorified be your Lord, the Lord of Al-'Izzah! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him (37:180). And Salam (peace!) be on the Messengers (37:181). And all the praises and thanks be to Allah, Lord of all that exists (37:182).Allah glorified Himself and states that He is far above what the lying wrongdoers say about Him; glorified and sanctified and exalted be He far above what they say. Allah says:سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِGlorified be your Lord, the Lord of Al-'Izzah!Meaning: the Owner of might and power Whom none can resist.عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ(He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!means, from what these lying fabricators say.وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَAnd Salam be on the Messengers!means, may the peace of Allah be upon them in this world and in the Hereafter,…

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:181 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And peace upon the messengers. See 37:180

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:182 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds. See 37:180

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing. See 37:11

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those who drive (the clouds). See 37:1

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense." They will say: Woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense! (37:20). (It will be said:) "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny (37:21). (It will be said to the angels:) Assemble those who did wrong, together with their companions and what they used to worship (37:22). Instead of Allah, and lead them on to the way of flaming Fire (Hell) (37:23). But stop them, verily, they are to be questioned (37:24). "What is the matter with you? Why do you not help one another? (37:25). Nay, but that Day they shall surrender (37:26). The Day of Recompense Allah tells us what the disbeliever will say on the Day of Resurrection, how they will blame themselves and admit that they wronged themselves…

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (They will be told), "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny." See 37:20

item.description: (The angels will be ordered), "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds,1 and what they used to worship. See 37:20

item.description: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire. See 37:20

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned." See 37:20

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (They will be asked), "What is (wrong) with you? Why do you not help each other?" See 37:20

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But they, that Day, are in surrender. See 37:20

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they will approach one another asking (i.e., blaming) each other. And they will turn to one another and question one another (37:27). They will say: "It was you who used to come to us from the right side (37:28). They will reply: "Nay, you yourselves were not believers (37:29). "And we had no authority over you. Nay! But you were a transgressing people (37:30). "So now the Word of our Lord has been justified against us, that we shall certainly taste (the torment) (37:31). "So we led you astray because we were ourselves astray (37:32). Then verily, that Day, they will (all) share in the torment (37:33). Certainly, that is how We deal with the criminals (37:34). Truly, when it was said to them: "La ilaha illallah," they puffed themselves up with pride (37:35). And (they) said: "Are we…

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."1 See 37:27

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They (i.e., the oppressors) will say, "Rather, you (yourselves) were not believers. See 37:27

item.description: And those who recite the message.1 See 37:1

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people. See 37:27

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So the word (i.e., decree) of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste (punishment). See 37:27

item.description: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators." See 37:27

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment. See 37:27

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Rather, he (i.e., the Prophet SAW) has come with the truth and confirmed the (previous) messengers. See 37:27

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:38 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, you (disbelievers) will be tasters of the painful punishment. Verily, you are going to taste the painful torment (37:38). And you will be requited nothing except for what you used to do (37:39). Save the chosen servants of Allah (37:40). For them there will be a known provision (37:41). Fruits; and they shall be honored (37:42). In the Gardens of Delight (37:43). Facing one another on thrones (37:44). Round them will be passed a cup of pure win (37:45). White, delicious to the drinkers (37:46). Neither will they have Ghawl from that nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom (37:47). And beside them will be Qasirat-At-Tarf with (wide and beautiful) eyes (37:48). as if they were Bayd Maknun (37:49).The Punishment of the Idolators and the Reward of the Sincere BelieversAllah says, addressing the people:إِنَّكُمْ لَذَائِقُو الْعَذَابِ الْأَلِيمِ - وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ…

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:39 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do. See 37:38

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:50 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other. Then they will turn to one another, mutually questioning (37:50). A speaker of them will say: Verily, I had a companion (in the world), (37:51). "Who used to say: 'Are you among those who believe (37:52). (That) when we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed be indebted (Madinun)?' (37:53). (The speaker) said: "Will you look down? (37:54). So he looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire (37:55). He said: "By Allah! You have nearly ruined me (37:56). "Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I would certainly have been among those brought forth (to Hell) (37:57). "Are we then not to die (any more)? (37:58). "Except our first death, and we shall not be punished? (37:59). Truly, this is the…

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars. Verily, We have adorned the near heaven with the stars (37:6). And to guard against every rebellious Shaytan (37:7). They cannot listen to the higher group for they are pelted from every side (37:8). Outcast, and theirs is a constant torment (37:9). Except such as snatch away something by stealing, and they are pursued by a flaming fire of piercing brightness (37:10).The Adornment and Protection of the Heaven Comes from AllahAllah tells us that He has adorned the lowest heaven with the heavenly bodies for those among the people of the earth who look at it. The stars and planets in the sky give light to the people of earth, as Allah says:وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا رُجُومًا لِلشَّيَاطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِيرِAnd indeed We have…

item.title: bil-Quran: As-Saaffaat:62 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Is that (i.e., Paradise) a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm? Is that (Paradise) better entertainment or the tree of Zaqqum (37:62). Truly, We have made it (as) a trial for the wrongdoers (37:63). Verily, it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-fire (37:64). The shoots of its fruit stalks are like the heads of Shayatin (37:65). Truly, they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith (37:66). Then on the top of that they will be given boiling Hamim (37:67). Then thereafter, verily, their return is to the flaming fire of Hell (37:68). Verily, they found their fathers on the wrong path (37:69). So they (too) hastened in their footsteps (37:70).The Tree of Zaqqum and its CompanionsHere Allah asks: 'Is that which He has mentioned of the delights of Paradise with its food, drink,…
