And among His Ayat is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and whatever moving creatures He has dispersed in them both. And He is Able to assemble them whenever He wills (42:29). And whatever of misfortune befalls you, it is because of what your hands have earned. And He pardons much (42:30). And you cannot escape from Allah in the earth, and besides Allah you have neither any protector nor any helper (42:31).Among the Signs of Allah is the Creation of the Heavens and the Earthوَمِنْ آيَاتِهِAnd among His Ayatthe signs which point to His great might and power:خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَاis the creation of…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Thus has He revealed to you, (O Muḥammad), and to those before you - Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise. See 42:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much. See 42:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And you will not cause failure (to Allah)1 upon the earth. And you have not besides Allah any protector or helper. See 42:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And of His signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains. And among His signs are the ships in the sea like mountains (42:32). If He wills, He causes the wind to cease, then they would become motionless on the surface (of the sea). Verily, in this are signs for everyone patient and grateful (42:33). Or He may destroy them because of that which their (people) have earned. And He pardons much (42:34). And those who dispute as regards Our Ayat may know that there is no place of refuge for them (42:35).Ships are Also among the Signs of AllahAllah tells us that another sign of His great power and dominion is the fact that He has subjugated the sea so that ships may sail in it by His command, so they sail in the sea like mountains. This…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful. See 42:32

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or He could destroy them1 for what they earned; but He pardons much. See 42:32

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:35 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (that is so) those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape. See 42:32

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So whatever thing you have been given - it is but (for) enjoyment of the worldly life. But what is with Allah is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely. So whatever you have been given is but (a passing) enjoyment for this worldly life, but that which is with Allah is better and more lasting for those who believe and put their trust in their Lord (42:36). And those who shun the greater sins, and Al-Fawahish, and when they are angry, they forgive (42:37). And those who answer the Call of their Lord, and perform the Salah, and who (conduct) their affairs by mutual consultation, and who spend of what We have bestowed on them (42:38). And those who, when an oppressive wrong is done to them, take revenge (42:39).The Attributes of…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive. See 42:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:38 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those who have responded to their Lord and established prayer and whose affair is (determined by) consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend. See 42:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:39 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they retaliate (in a just manner).1 See 42:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.1 See 42:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:40 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is (due) from Allah. Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers. The recompense for an evil is an evil like thereof; but whoever forgives and makes reconciliation, his reward is with Allah. Verily, He likes not the wrongdoers (42:40). And indeed whosoever takes revenge after he has suffered wrong, for such there is no way (of blame) against them (42:41). The way is only against those who oppress men and rebel in the earth without justification; for such there will be a painful torment (42:42). And verily, whosoever shows patience and forgives, that would truly be from the things recommended by Allah (42:43).Forgiving or Exacting Revenge on Wrongdoersوَجَزَاءُ سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِثْلُهَا ۖThe recompense for an evil is an evil…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:41 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And whoever retaliates after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause (for blame). See 42:40

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:42 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment. See 42:40

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:43 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters (worthy) of resolve.1 See 42:40

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:44 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And he whom Allah sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return (to the former world) any way?" And whomsoever Allah sends astray, for him there is no protector after Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they behold the torment, they will say: Is there any way of return? (42:44). And you will see them brought forward to it (Hell) made humble by disgrace, (and) looking with stealthy glance. And those who believe will say: "Verily, the losers are they who lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection." Verily, the wrongdoers will be in a lasting torment (42:45). And they will have no protectors to help them other than Allah. And he whom Allah sends astray,…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:45 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And you will see them being exposed to it (i.e., the Fire), humbled from humiliation, looking from (behind) a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the (true) losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment." See 42:44

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:46 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allah. And whoever Allah sends astray - for him there is no way. See 42:44

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:47 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allah of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that Day, nor for you will there be any denial.1 Answer the Call of your Lord before there comes from Allah a Day which cannot be averted. You will have no refuge on that Day nor there will be for you any denying (42:47). But if they turn away, We have not sent you as a Hafiz over them. Your duty is to convey. And verily, when We cause man to taste of mercy from Us, he rejoices there at; but when some evil befalls them because of the deeds which their hands have sent forth, then verily, man (becomes) ingrate (42:48).Encouragement to Obey Allah before the Day of ResurrectionWhen Allah tells us about the horrors and terrifying events…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:48 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, (O Muḥammad), over them as a guardian; upon you is only (the duty of) notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful. See 42:47

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:49 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what He wills. He gives to whom He wills female (children), and He gives to whom He wills males. To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He creates what He wills. He bestows female upon whom He wills, and bestows male upon whom He wills (42:49). Or He bestows both males and females, and He renders barren whom He wills. Verily, He is the All-Knower and is Able (to do all things) (42:50).Allah tells us that He is the Creator, Sovereign and Controller of the heavens and the earth. Whatever he wills happens, and whatever He does not will does not happen. He gives to whomsoever He wills and withholds from whomsoever he wills; none can withhold what He gives, and none can…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The heavens almost break from above them,1 and the angels exalt (Allah) with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Unquestionably, it is Allah who is the Forgiving, the Merciful. See 42:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:50 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or He makes them (both) males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent. See 42:49

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:51 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And it is not for any human being that Allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger (i.e., angel) to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise. It is not given to any human being that Allah should speak to him unless (it be) by revelation, or from behind a veil, or (that) He sends a Messenger to reveal what He wills by His leave. Verily, He is Most High, Most Wise (42:51). And thus We have sent to you Ruh of Our command. You knew not what is the Book, nor what is Faith. But We have made it a light wherewith We guide whosoever of Our servants We will. And verily, you are indeed guiding to a straight path (42:52).…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:52 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command (i.e., the Qur’ān). You did not know what is the Book or (what is) faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, (O Muḥammad), you guide to a straight path. See 42:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:53 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The path of Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allah do (all) matters evolve (i.e., return). See 42:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those who take as allies other than Him - Allah is (yet) Guardian over them; and you, (O Muḥammad), are not over them a manager. See 42:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur’ān that you may warn the Mother of Cities (i.e., Makkah) and those around it1 and warn of the Day of Assembly, about which there is no doubt. A party will be in Paradise and a party in the Blaze. And thus We have revealed to you a Qur'an in Arabic that you may warn the Mother of the Towns and all around it, and warn (them) of the Day of Assembling of which there is no doubt, a party will be in Paradise and a party in the blazing Fire (42:7). And if Allah had willed, He could have made them one nation, but He admits whom He wills to His mercy. And the wrongdoers will have neither a protector nor a helper (42:8).The Qur'an was Revealed to Serve As…

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if Allah willed, He could have made them (of) one religion, but He admits whom He wills1 into His mercy. And the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper. See 42:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Ash-Shura:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or have they taken protectors (or allies) besides Him? But Allah - He is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He is over all things competent. Or have they taken protecting friends besides Him? But Allah – He Alone is the protector. And He Who gives life to the dead, and He is Able to do all things (42:9). And in whatsoever you differ, the decision thereof is with Allah. Such is Allah, my Lord in Whom I put my trust, and to Him I turn in repentance (42:10). The Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you mates from yourselves, and for the cattle (also) mates. By this means He creates you. There is nothing like Him, and He is the All-Hearer, the All-Seer (42:11). To Him belong the keys of…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: By the sky and the knocker. يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُThe Day when all the secrets will be examined.Meaning: on the Day of Judgement the secrets will be tested. This means that they will be exposed and made manifest. Thus, the secret will be made open and that which is concealed will be well known. It is confirmed in the Two Sahihs on the authority of Ibn Umar that the Messenger of Allah SAW said:يُرْفَعُ لِكُلِّ غَادِرٍ لِوَاءٌ عِنْدَ اسْتِهِ يُقَالُ: هٰذِهِ غَدْرَةُ فُلَانِ بْنِ فُلَانٍEvery betrayer will have a flag raised for him behind his back, and it will be said, 'This is the betrayal of so-and-so, the son of so-and-so.'Concerning Allah's statement:فَمَا لَهُThen he will have noMeaning: man on the Day of Judgement.مِن قُوَّةٍany powerMeaning: within himself.وَلَا نَاصِرٍnor any helper.Meaning: from other than himself. This statement means that he will…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then he (i.e., man) will have no power or any helper. See 86:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: By the sky which sends back.1 By the sky which gives rain, again and again (86:11). And the earth which splits (86:12). Verily, this is the Word that separates (86:13). And it is not a thing for amusement (86:14). Verily, they are but plotting a plot (86:15). And I am planning a plan (86:16). So, give a respite to the disbelievers; deal gently with them for a while (86:17).Swearing to the Truthfulness of the Qur'an and the Failure of Those Who Oppose itIbn 'Abbas said, "Ar-raj' means rain." It has also been narrated from him that he said, "It means the clouds that contain rain." He also said:وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الرَّجْعِBy the sky (having rain clouds) which gives rain, again and again."This means that it rains and then it rains (again)." Qatadah said, "It returns the sustenance of the servants (creatures)…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (by) the earth which splits.1 See 86:11

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, it (i.e., the Qur’ān) is a decisive statement. See 86:11

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And it is not amusement. See 86:11

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, they are planning a plan. See 86:11

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But I am planning a plan. See 86:11

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.1 See 86:11

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And what can make you know what is the knocker? See 86:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is the piercing star1. See 86:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector. See 86:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So let man observe from what he was created. See 86:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He was created from a fluid, ejected. See 86:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs. See 86:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, He (i.e., Allah), to return him (to life), is Able. See 86:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taariq:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The Day when secrets will be put on trial.1 See 86:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah.1 To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs (all) praise, and He is over all things competent. يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِHe knows what is in the heavens and on earth, and He knows what you conceal and what you reveal. And Allah is the All-Knower of what is in the breasts.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination. See 64:7

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allah. And whoever believes in Allah - He will guide his heart. And Allah is Knowing of all things. No calamity occurs, but by the permission of Allah, and whosoever believes in Allah, He guides his heart. And Allah is the All-Knower of everything (64:11). Obey Allah, and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away, then the duty of Our Messenger is only to convey clearly (64:12). Allah! La ilaha illa Huwa. And in Allah therefore let the believers put their trust (64:13).All that Occurs to Mankind is by Allah's PermissionAllah informs us as He did in Surat Al-Hadid:مَا أَصَابَ مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ نَبْرَأَهَا ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌNo calamity occurs on the earth or in yourselves but it is inscribed…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only (the duty of) clear notification. See 64:11

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allah let the believers rely. See 64:11

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who have believed, indeed, among your spouses and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. O you who believe! Verily, among your wives and your children there are enemies for you; therefore beware of them! But if you pardon (them) and overlook, and forgive, then verily, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (64:14). Your wealth and your children are only a Fitnah, whereas Allah! With Him is a great reward (64:15). So have Taqwa of Allah as much as you can; listen and obey, and spend in charity; that is better for yourselves. And whosoever is saved from his own greed, then they are the successful ones (64:16). If you lend to Allah a handsome loan, He will double it…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allah has with Him a great reward. See 64:14

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So fear Allah as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend (in the way of Allah); it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful. See 64:14

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: If you loan Allah a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allah is (most) Appreciative1 and Forbearing.2 See 64:14

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise. See 64:14

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing. See 64:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the (final) destination. See 64:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts. See 64:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment. Has not the news reached you of those who disbelieved aforetime? And so they tasted the evil result of their disbelief, and theirs will be a painful torment (64:5). That was because there came to them their Messengers with Bayyinat, but they said: "Shall mere men guide us?" So they disbelieved and turned away. But Allah was not in need. And Allah is not in need, Worthy of all praise (64:6).A Warning Delivered through Mentioning the End of the Disbelieving NationsInforming about the past nations and the torment and disciplinary lessons that they suffered because of opposing the Messengers and denying the truth. Allah says;أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ قَبْلُHas…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And Allah dispensed (with them); and Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy. See 64:5

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for Allah, is easy." The disbelievers pretend that they will never be resurrected. Say: Yes! By my Lord, you will certainly be resurrected, then you will be informed of what you did; and that is easy for Allah (64:7). Therefore, believe in Allah and His Messenger and in the Light which We have sent down. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do (64:8). The Day when He will gather you on the Day of Gathering, that will be the Day of At-Taghabun. And whosoever believes in Allah and performs righteous deeds, He will expiate from him his sins, and will admit him to Gardens beneath which…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So believe in Allah and His Messenger and the light (i.e., the Qur’ān) which We have sent down. And Allah is Aware of what you do. See 64:7

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Taghaabun:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation.1 And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment. See 64:7

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O Prophet, why do you prohibit (yourself from) what Allah has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. إِنْ تَتُوبَا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا ۖIf you two turn in repentance to Allah your hearts are indeed so inclined‘Umar said, ‘I am astonished at your question, O Ibn ‘Abbas.''' - Az-Zuhri (a subnarrator) said that ‘Umar did not like the question, but he still answered it, saying that they were ‘Aisha and Hafsah.Then ‘Umar went on relating the story and said, ‘We, the people of Quraysh, used to have authority over our women. But when we came to live with the Ansar, we noticed that the Ansari women had the upper hand over their men, so our women started acquiring the habits of the Ansari women. At that time, I was…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Nuh and the wife of Lut. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them,1 so they (i.e., those prophets) did not avail them from Allah at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." See 66:9

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And Allah presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." And Allah has set forth an example for those who believe: the wife of Fir'awn, when she said: My Lord! Build for me a home with You in Paradise, and save me from Fir'awn and his work, and save me from the people who are wrongdoers (66:11). And Maryam, the daughter of 'Imran who guarded her chastity (private part). And We breathed into it through Our Ruh, and she testified to the truth of her Lords Kalimat, and His Kutub, and she was of the Qanitin (66:12). The Disbelievers can cause no Harm to the Believers This is…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (the example of) Maryam, the daughter of ʿImrān, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into (her garment) through Our angel (i.e., Jibril), and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient. See 66:11

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah has already ordained for you (Muslims) the dissolution of your oaths.1 And Allah is your protector, and He is the Knowing, the Wise. See 66:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (remember) when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement; and when she informed (another) of it and Allah showed it to him, he made known part of it and ignored a part. And when he informed her about it, she said, "Who told you this?" He said, "I was informed by the Knowing, the Aware." See 66:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: If you two (wives) repent to Allah, (it is best), for your hearts have deviated. But if you cooperate against him - then indeed Allah is his protector, and Jibril and the righteous of the believers and the angels, moreover, are (his) assistants. See 66:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you (all), would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting (to Allah), believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling1 - (ones) previously married and virgins. See 66:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are (appointed) angels, harsh and severe; they do not disobey Allah in what He commands them but do what they are commanded. O you who believe! Protect yourselves and your families against a Fire (Hell) whose fuel is men and stones, over which are (appointed) angels stern (and) severe, who disobey not the commands they receive from Allah, but do that which they are commanded (66:6). (It will be said in the Hereafter) O you who disbelieve! Make no excuses this Day! You are being requited only for what you used to do (66:7). O you who believe! Turn to Allah with sincere repentance! It may be that your Lord will expiate from you your sins, and admit you…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that Day. You will only be recompensed for what you used to do. See 66:6

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who have believed, repent to Allah with sincere repentance. Perhaps1 your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow (on) the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent." See 66:6

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tahrim:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O Prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination. O Prophet! Strive hard against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be severe against them; their abode will be Hell, and worst indeed is that destination (66:9). Allah sets forth an example for those who disbelieve: the wife of Nuh and the wife of Lut. They were under two of our righteous servants, but they both betrayed them. So, they availed them not against Allah and it was said: Enter the Fire along with those who enter! (66:10). The Command for Jihad against the Disbelievers and the Hypocrites Allah the Exalted orders His Messenger SAW to perform Jihad against the disbelievers and hypocrites, the former with weapons and armaments and the later by establishing Allah's legislated…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takaathur:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Competition in (worldly) increase diverts you. ثُمَّ لَتُسْأَلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ النَّعِيمِThen on that Day you shall be asked about the delights!Meaning: 'on that Day you all will be questioned concerning your gratitude towards the favors that Allah blessed you with, such as health, safety, sustenance and other things. You will be asked did you return His favors by being thankful to Him and worshipping Him.'Ibn Jarir recorded that Al-Husayn bin Ali As-Suda'i narrated to him from Al-Walid bin Al-Qasim, who reported from Yazid bin Kaysan, who reported from Abi Hazim, who reported from Abu Hurayrah that he said, "Once while Abu Bakr and Umar were sitting, the Prophet SAW came to them and said, مَا أَجْلَسَكُمَا هٰهُنَا؟ (What has caused you two to sit here?) They replied, "By He Who has sent you with the truth, nothing has brought us…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takaathur:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Until you visit the graveyards.1 See 102:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takaathur:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: No! You are going to know. See 102:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takaathur:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then, no! You are going to know. See 102:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takaathur:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...1 See 102:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takaathur:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: You will surely see the Hellfire. See 102:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takaathur:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.1 See 102:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takaathur:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.1 See 102:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: When the sun is wrapped up (in darkness). عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا أَحْضَرَتْEvery person will know what he has brought.This is the conclusive response of the previous statements, meaning at the time these matters occur, every soul will know what it has done, and that will be brought forth for it, as Allah says:يَوْمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ مُّحْضَرًا وَمَا عَمِلَتْ مِن سُوءٍ تَوَدُّ لَوْ أَنَّ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَهُ أَمَدًا بَعِيدًاOn the Day when every person will be confronted with all the good he has done, and all the evil he has done, he will wish that there were a great distance between him and his evil. (3:30)Allah also says:يُنَبَّأُ الْإِنسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَOn that Day man will be informed of what he sent forward, and what he left behind. (75:13)

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when the pages1 are spread (i.e., made public). See 81:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when the sky is stripped away. See 81:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when Hellfire is set ablaze. See 81:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when Paradise is brought near. See 81:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: A soul will (then) know what it has brought (with it).1 See 81:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So I swear by the retreating stars. But nay! I swear by Al-Khunnas (81:15). Al-Jawar Al-Kunnas (81:16). And by the night when it 'As'as (81:17). And by the day when it Tanaffas (81:18). Verily, this is the Word a most honorable messenger (81:19). Dhi Quwwah, with the Lord of the Throne – Makin (81:20). Obeyed there, trustworthy (81:21). And your companion is not a madman (81:22). And indeed he saw him in the clear horizon (81:23). And he withholds not a knowledge of the Unseen (81:24). And it is not the word of the outcast Shaytan (81:25). Then where are you going (81:26). Verily, this is no less than a Reminder for the creatures (81:27). To whomsoever among you who wills to walk straight (81:28). And you cannot will unless that Allah wills – the Lord of all that exists…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Those that run (their courses) and disappear (i.e., set). See 81:15

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And by the night as it closes in.1 See 81:15

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And by the dawn when it breathes (i.e., stirs). See 81:15

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (That) indeed, it (i.e., the Qur’ān) is a word (conveyed by) a noble messenger (i.e., Jibril). See 81:15

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when the stars fall, dispersing. See 81:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Who is) possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure (in position). See 81:15

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Obeyed there (in the heavens) and trustworthy. See 81:15

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And your companion (i.e., Prophet Muḥammad SAW ) is not (at all) mad.1 See 81:15

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And he has already seen him (i.e., Jibril) in the clear horizon.1 See 81:15

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And he (i.e., Muḥammad SAW) is not a withholder of (knowledge of) the unseen.1 See 81:15

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And it (i.e., the Qur’ān) is not the word of a devil, expelled (from the heavens). See 81:15

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So where are you going?1 See 81:15

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is not except a reminder to the worlds. See 81:15

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: For whoever wills among you to take a right course. See 81:15

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds. See 81:15

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when the mountains are removed. See 81:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when full-term she-camels1 are neglected. See 81:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when the wild beasts are gathered. See 81:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when the seas are filled with flame.1 See 81:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when the souls are paired.1 See 81:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when the girl (who was) buried alive is asked. See 81:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Takwir:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: For what sin she was killed. See 81:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O Prophet, when you (Muslims) divorce women, divorce them for (the commencement of) their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period,1 and fear Allah, your Lord. Do not turn them out of their (husbands') houses, nor should they (themselves) leave (during that period) unless they are committing a clear immorality. And those are the limits (set by) Allah. And whoever transgresses the limits of Allah has certainly wronged himself. You know not; perhaps Allah will bring about after that a (different) matter.2

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allah, O you of understanding who have believed. Allah has sent down to you a message (i.e., the Qur’ān).1 See 65:8

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (He sent) a Messenger (i.e., Muḥammad SAW) reciting to you the distinct verses of Allah that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light. And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever. Allah will have perfected for him a provision. See 65:8

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is Allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them.1 (His) command descends among them so you may know that Allah is over all things competent and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge. It is Allah Who has created seven heavens and of the earth the like thereof. His command descends between them, that you may know that Allah has power over all things, and that Allah surrounds all things with (His) knowledge (65:12).Allah's Perfect PowerAllah the Exalted asserts His perfect power and infinite greatness, so that the great religion that He has legislated is honored and implemented:اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍIt is Allah Who has created seven heavensAllah said in similar Ayat, like what Prophet Nuh said to his people:أَلَمْ تَرَوْا كَيْفَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًاSee you not how Allah…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when they have (nearly) fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for (the acceptance of) Allah. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allah and the Last Day. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out.1 Then when they are about to attain their term appointed, either take them back in a good manner or part with them in a good manner. And take as witness two just persons from among you. And establish the testimony for Allah. That will be an admonition given to him who believes in Allah and the Last Day. And whosoever has Taqwa of Allah, He will make a way for him to…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has already set for everything a (decreed) extent. See 65:2

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and (also for) those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth.1 And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him of his matter ease. Those in menopause among your women, for them the 'Iddah, if you have doubt, is three months; and for those who have no courses. And for those who are pregnant, their 'Iddah is until they lay down their burden; and whosoever has Taqwa of Allah, He will make his matter easy for him (65:4). That is the command of Allah, which He has sent down to you; and whosoever has Taqwa of Allah, He will expiate from him his sins, and will increase his reward…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That is the command of Allah, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allah - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward. See 65:4

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Lodge them1 (in a section) of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them.2 And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for him (i.e., the father) another woman.3 Lodge them where you dwell, according to what you have, and do not harm them so as to suppress them. And if they are pregnant, then spend on them till they lay down their burden. Then if they suckle the children for you, give them their due payment, and let each of you deal with each other in a mannerly way. But if you make difficulties for…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allah has given him. Allah does not charge a soul except (according to) what He has given it. Allah will bring about, after hardship, ease (i.e., relief). See 65:6

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment. And many a town revolted against the command of its Lord and His Messengers; and We called it to a severe account, and We shall punish it with a horrible torment (65:8). So it tasted the evil result of its affair, and the consequence of its affair was loss (65:9). Allah has prepared for them a severe torment. So have Taqwa of Allah, O men of understanding, those who believe! Allah has indeed sent down to you a Reminder (65:10). A Messenger, who recites to you the Ayat of Allah containing clear explanations, that He may take out those who believe and do righteous good deeds, from the darkness to…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Talaaq:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair (i.e., rebellion), and the outcome of its affair was loss. See 65:8

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (This is a declaration of) disassociation, from Allah and His Messenger, to those with whom you had made a treaty among the polytheists.1 بَرَاءَةٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِFreedom from obligations from Allah and His Messenger SAWWhich is is a declaration of freedom from all obligations from Allah and His Messenger SAW:إِلَى الَّذِينَ عَاهَدتُّم مِّنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ - فَسِيحُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍto those of the Mushrikin, with whom you made a treaty. So travel freely (Mushrikin) for four months (as you will) throughout the land (9:1-2)This Ayah refers to idolators who had indefinite treaties and those, whose treaties with Muslims ended in less than four months. The terms of these treaties were restricted to four months only. As for those whose term of peace ended at a specific date later (than the four months), then their treaties would end when their terms…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They do not observe toward a believer any pact of kinship or covenant of protection. And it is they who are the transgressors. See 9:9

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:100 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the first forerunners (in the faith) among the Muhājireen1 and the Anṣār2 and those who followed them with good conduct - Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him, and He has prepared for them gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment. And the foremost to embrace Islam of the Muhajirin and the Ansar and also those who followed them exactly (in faith). Allah is well-pleased with them as they are well-pleased with Him. He has prepared for them Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise), to dwell therein forever. That is the supreme success (9:100).Virtues of the Muhajirin, Ansar and Those Who Followed Them in FaithAllah mentions that He is pleased foremost with the Muhajirin, Ansar and those who followed them in faith, and that they are well-pleased…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:101 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And among those around you of the bedouins are hypocrites, and (also) from the people of Madīnah. They have persisted in hypocrisy. You, (O Muḥammad), do not know them, (but) We know them. We will punish them twice (in this world); then they will be returned to a great punishment. And among the bedouins around you, some are hypocrites, and so are some among the people of Al-Madinah who persist in hypocrisy; you know them not, We know them. We shall punish them twice, and thereafter they shall be brought back to a great (horrible) torment (9:101).Hypocrites among the Bedouins and Residents of Al-MadinahAllah informs His Messenger (AS), that among the bedouins around Al-Madinah there are hypocrites and in Al-Madinah itself, those:مَرَدُوا عَلَى النِّفَاقِwho persist in hypocrisy;meaning they insisted on hypocrisy and continued in it Allah's statement:لَا تَعْلَمُهُمْ ۖ نَحْنُ…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:102 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (there are) others who have acknowledged their sins. They had mixed (i.e., polluted) a righteous deed with another that was bad.1 Perhaps Allah will turn to them in forgiveness. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. And (there are) others who have acknowledged their sins, they have mixed a deed that was righteous with another that was evil. Perhaps Allah will turn unto them in forgiveness. Surely, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (9:102).Some Believers Stayed Away from Battle Because They were LazyAfter Allah explained the characteristics of the hypocrites who stayed away from battle because they sought to avoid it out of denial and doubt, He then mentioned the disobedient who stayed away from Jihad due to laziness and preferring comfort, even though they truely believed:وَآخَرُونَ اعْتَرَفُوا بِذُنُوبِهِمْAnd others who have acknowledged their sins,These people admitted their error to themselves…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:103 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Take, (O Muḥammad), from their wealth a charity by which you purify them and cause them increase, and invoke (Allah's blessings) upon them. Indeed, your invocations are reassurance for them. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing. Take Sadaqah from their wealth in order to purify them and sanctify them with it, and 'Şalli' for them. Verily, your Salat are a Sakan for them; and Allah is All-Hearer, All-Knower (9:103). Know they not that Allah accepts repentance from His servants and accepts the Sadaqat, and that Allah alone is the One Who forgives and accepts repentance, Most Merciful (9:104).The Command to Collect the Zakah and Its BenefitsAllah commanded His Messenger SAW to take Sadaqah from the Muslims' money to purify and sanctify them with it. This Ayah is general, even though some said that it refers specifically to those who mixed…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:104 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do they not know that it is Allah who accepts repentance from His servants and receives charities and that it is Allah who is the Accepting of Repentance,1 the Merciful? See 9:103

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:105 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And say, "Do (as you will), for Allah will see your deeds, and (so will) His Messenger and the believers. And you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you of what you used to do." And say Do deeds! Allah will see your deeds, and (so will) His Messenger and the believers. And you will be brought back to the All-Knower of the unseen and the seen. Then He will inform you of what you used to do (9:105).Warning the DisobedientMujahid said that this Ayah carries a warning from Allah to those who defy His orders. Their deeds will be shown to Allah, Blessed and Most Honored, and to the Messenger SAW and the believers. This will certainly occur on the Day of Resurrection, just as Allah said:يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:106 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (there are) others deferred until the command of Allah - whether He will punish them or whether He will forgive them. And Allah is Knowing and Wise. And others are made to await for Allah's Decree, whether He will punish them or will forgive them. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise (9:106).Delaying the Decision about the Three Companions Who Stayed Away from the Battle of TabukIbn 'Abbas, Mujahid, 'Ikrimah, Ad-Dahhak and several others said that those mentioned in the Ayah are the three who were made to wait to know if their repentance was accepted; Mararah bin Ar-Rabi', Ka'b bin Malik and Hilal bin Umayyah.Some Companions stayed behind from the battle of Tabuk due to laziness, preferring comfort, ease, ripe fruits and shade. They did not lag behind because of hypocrisy or doubts. Some of them tied themselves to the…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:107 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (there are) those (hypocrites) who took for themselves a mosque for causing harm and disbelief and division among the believers and as a station for whoever had warred against Allah and His Messenger before. And they will surely swear, "We intended only the best." And Allah testifies that indeed they are liars. And as for those who put up a Masjid by way of harm and disbelief and to disunite the believers and as an outpost for those who warred against Allah and His Messenger aforetime, they will indeed swear that their intention is nothing but good. Allah bears witness that they are certainly liars (9:107). Never stand you therein. Verily, the Masjid whose foundation was laid from the first day on Taqwa is more worthy that you stand therein (to pray). In it are men who love to…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:108 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do not stand (for prayer) within it - ever. A mosque founded on righteousness from the first day1 is more worthy for you to stand in. Within it are men who love to purify themselves; and Allah loves those who purify themselves. See 9:107

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:109 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then is one who laid the foundation of his building on righteousness (with fear) from Allah and (seeking) His approval better or one who laid the foundation of his building on the edge of a bank about to collapse, so it collapsed with him into the fire of Hell? And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people. Is it then he who laid the foundation of his building on Taqwa to Allah and His good pleasure better, or he who laid the foundation of his building on the brink of an undetermined precipice ready to crumble down, so that it crumbled to pieces with him into the fire of Hell. And Allah guides not the people who are the wrongdoers (9:109). The building which they built will never cease to be a cause of hypocrisy and doubt in their hearts…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But if they repent, establish prayer, and give zakāh, then they are your brothers in religion; and We detail the verses for a people who know. See 9:9

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:110 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Their building which they built will not cease to be a (cause of) skepticism in their hearts until their hearts are cut (i.e., stopped). And Allah is Knowing and Wise. See 9:109

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:111 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, Allah has purchased from the believers their lives and their properties (in exchange) for that they will have Paradise. They fight in the cause of Allah, so they kill and are killed. (It is) a true promise (binding) upon Him in the Torah and the Gospel and the Qur’ān. And who is truer to his covenant than Allah? So rejoice in your transaction which you have contracted. And it is that which is the great attainment. Verily, Allah has purchased of the believers their lives and their properties for (the price) that theirs shall be the Paradise. They fight in Allah's cause, so they kill and are killed. It is a promise in truth which is binding on Him in the Tawrah and the Injil and the Qur'an. And who is truer to his covenant than Allah? Then rejoice…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:112 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Such believers are) the repentant, the worshippers, the praisers (of Allah), the travelers (for His cause), those who bow and prostrate (in prayer), those who enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong, and those who observe the limits (set by) Allah. And give good tidings to the believers. Those who repent, who worship (Him), who praise (Him), who fast, who bow down, who prostrate themselves, who enjoin good and forbid evil, and who observe the limits set by Allah. And give glad tidings to the believers (9:112).This is the description of the believers from whom Allah has purchased their souls and wealth, who have these beautiful and honorable qualities.التَّائِبُونَwho repentfrom all sins and shun all evils:الْعَابِدُونَwho worshipWhich is their Lord and preserve the acts of worship that include statements and actions. Praising Allah is among the best statements.…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:113 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is not for the Prophet and those who have believed to ask forgiveness for the polytheists, even if they were relatives, after it has become clear to them that they are companions of Hellfire. It is not (proper) for the Prophet and those who believe to ask Allah's forgiveness for the Mushrikin, even though they be of kin, after it has become clear to them that they are the dwellers of the Fire (because they died in a state of disbelief) (9:113). And Ibrahim's invoking (of Allah) for his father's forgiveness was only because of a promise he (Ibrahim) had made to him (his father). But when it became clear to him (Ibrahim) that he (his father) is an enemy of Allah, he dissociated himself from him. Verily, Ibrahim was Awwah and forbearing (9:114).The Prohibition of Supplicating for PolytheistsImam…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:114 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the request of forgiveness of Ibrahim for his father was only because of a promise he had made to him. But when it became apparent to him (i.e., Ibrahim) that he (i.e., the father) was an enemy to Allah, he disassociated himself from him. Indeed was Ibrahim compassionate and patient. See 9:113

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:115 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And Allah would not let a people stray after He has guided them until He makes clear to them what they should avoid. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of all things. And Allah will never lead a people astray after He has guided them until He makes clear to them what they should avoid. Verily, Allah is the All-Knower of everything (9:115). Indeed to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, He gives life and He causes death. And besides Allah you have neither any protector nor any helper (9:116).Recompense Comes after Proof is EstablishedAllah describes His Honorable Self and just judgment in that He does not lead a people astray but after the Message comes to them, so that the proof is established against them. For instance, Allah said:وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيْنَاهُمْAnd as for Thamud, We showed and…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:116 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He gives life and causes death. And you have not besides Allah any protector or any helper. See 9:115

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:117 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah has already forgiven the Prophet and the Muhājireen and the Anṣār who followed him in the hour of difficulty after the hearts of a party of them had almost inclined (to doubt), and then He forgave them. Indeed, He was to them Kind and Merciful. Allah has forgiven the Prophet, the Muhajirin and the Ansar who followed him in the time of distress (Tabuk expedition), after the hearts of a party of them had nearly deviated (from the right path), but He accepted their repentance. Certainly, He is unto them full of kindness, Most Merciful (9:117).Battle of TabukMujahid and several others said, "This Ayah was revealed concerning the battle of Tabuk. They left for that battle during a period of distress. It was a year with little rain, intense heat and scarcity of supplies and water." Qatadah said, "They…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:118 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (He also forgave) the three who were left alone (i.e., boycotted, regretting their error) to the point that the earth closed in on them in spite of its vastness1 and their souls confined (i.e., anguished) them and they were certain that there is no refuge from Allah except in Him. Then He turned to them so they could repent. Indeed, Allah is the Accepting of Repentance,2 the Merciful. And (Allah has forgiven) the three who stayed behind, until for them the earth, vast as it is, was straitened and their souls were straitened to them, and they perceived that there is no fleeing from Allah, and no refuge but with Him. Then, He forgave them, that they might beg for His pardon. Verily, Allah is the One Who forgives and accepts repentance, Most Merciful (9:118). O you who believe!…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:119 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who have believed, fear Allah and be with those who are true. See 9:118

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if they break their oaths after their treaty and defame your religion, then combat the leaders of disbelief, for indeed, there are no oaths (sacred) to them; (fight them that) they might cease. But if they violate their oaths after their covenant, and attack your religion with disapproval and criticism, then fight (you) against the leaders of disbelief – for surely, their oaths are nothing to them – so that they may stop (evil actions) (9:12).The Oaths of the Leaders of Disbelief Mean Nothing to ThemAllah says, if the idolators with whom you conducted peace treaties for an appointed term break:أَيْمَانَهُمtheir oathsMeaning: terms of their treaties, and covenants:وَطَعَنُوا فِي دِينِكُمْand attack your religion...with disapproval and criticism, it is because of this that one who curses the Messenger (AS), or attacks the religion of Islam by way of criticism and…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:120 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It was not (proper) for the people of Madīnah and those surrounding them of the bedouins that they remain behind after (the departure of) the Messenger of Allah or that they prefer themselves over his self.1 That is because they are not afflicted by thirst or fatigue or hunger in the cause of Allah, nor do they tread on any ground that enrages the disbelievers, nor do they inflict upon an enemy any infliction but that it is registered for them as a righteous deed. Indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of the doers of good. It was neither befitting for the people of Al-Madinah and the bedouins of the neighborhood to remain behind Allah's Messenger nor to prefer their own lives to his life. That is because they suffer neither Zama' nor Nasab, nor Makhmasah…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:121 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Nor do they spend an expenditure, small or large, or cross a valley but that it is registered for them that Allah may reward them for the best of what they were doing. Neither do they spend any contribution – small or great – nor cross a valley, but is written to their credit that Allah may recompense them with the best of what they used to do (9:121).Allah said next:وَلَا يُنفِقُونَNeither do they spendWhich is in reference to the fighters in Allah's cause:نَفَقَةً صَغِيرَةً وَلَا كَبِيرَةًany contribution – small or great –Which is with regards to its amount:وَلَا يَقْطَعُونَ وَادِيًاnor cross a valleyWhile marching towards the enemy:إِلَّا كُتِبَ لَهُمْbut is written to their creditFor these actions that they take (and which are under their control):لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَthat Allah may recompense them with the best of what…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:122 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And it is not for the believers to go forth (to battle) all at once. For there should separate from every division of them a group (remaining) to obtain understanding in the religion and warn (i.e., advise) their people when they return to them that they might be cautious. And it is not (proper) for the believers to go out (to fight - Jihad) all together. Of every troop of them, a party only should go forth, that they may get instructions in religion, and that they may warn their people when they return to them, so that they may beware (of evil) (9:122).Allah the Exalted here explains His order to Muslims to march forth with the Messenger of Allah SAW for the battle of Tabuk.We should first mention that a group of the Salaf said that marching along with…

item.description: Indeed, the postponing (of restriction within sacred months) is an increase in disbelief by which those who have disbelieved are led (further) astray. This occurred soon after the Prophet SAW migrated to Al-Madinah, when pagan Arabs joined force and the Jews and hypocrites of Al-Madinah waged war against the Messenger SAW. When Allah gave victory to the Prophet…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:49 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And among them is he who says, "Permit me (to remain at home) and do not put me to trial." Unquestionably, into trial they have fallen.1 And indeed, Hell will encompass the disbelievers. And among them is he who says: "Grant me leave and put me not into trial." Surely, they have fallen into trial. And verily, Hell is surrounding the disbelievers (9:49).Allah says, some hypocrites say to you, O Muhammad SAW:ائْذَن لِّيGrant me leaveWhich is to stay behind:وَلَا تَفْتِنِّيand put me not into trial.If I go with you and see the women of the Romans. Allah, the Exalted, replied:أَلَا فِي الْفِتْنَةِ سَقَطُواSurely, they have fallen into trialbecause of the statement they uttered. Muhammad bin Ishaq reported from Az-Zuhri, Yazid bin Ruwman, 'Abdullah bin Abi Bakr, 'Asim bin Qatadah and several others that they said, The Messenger of Allah SAW…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when the inviolable months1 have passed, then kill the polytheists wherever you find them and capture them and besiege them and sit in wait for them at every place of ambush. But if they should repent, establish prayer, and give zakāh, let them (go) on their way. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. So when the Sacred Months have passed, then fight the Mushrikin wherever you find them, and capture them and besiege them, and lie in wait for them in each and every ambush. But if they repent and perform the Salah, and give the Zakah, then leave their way free. Verily, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (9:5).This is the Ayah of the SwordMujahid, 'Amr bin Shu'ayb, Muhammad bin Ishaq, Qatadah, As-Suddi and 'Abdur-Rahman bin Zayd bin Aslam said that the four months mentioned in this Ayah are…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:50 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: If good befalls you, it distresses them; but if disaster strikes you, they say, "We took our matter (in hand) before,"1 and turn away while they are rejoicing. If good befalls you, it grieves them, but if a calamity overtakes you, they say: "We took our precaution beforehand," and they turn away rejoicing (9:50). Say: "Nothing shall ever happen to us except what Allah has ordained for us. He is our Mawla (protector)." And in Allah let the believers put their trust (9:51).Allah emphasizes the enmity that the hypocrites have for the Prophet SAW.If a blessing, such as victory and triumph over the enemies, is given to the Prophet SAW, thus pleasing him and his Companions, it grieves the hypocrites:وَإِن تُصِبْكَ مُصِيبَةٌ يَقُولُوا قَدْ أَخَذْنَا أَمْرَنَا مِن قَبْلُbut if a calamity overtakes you, they say: "We took our precaution beforehand,"They…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:51 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Never will we be struck except by what Allah has decreed for us; He is our protector." And upon Allah let the believers rely. See 9:50

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:52 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Do you await for us except one of the two best things (i.e., martyrdom or victory) while we await for you that Allah will afflict you with punishment from Himself or at our hands? So wait; indeed we, along with you, are waiting." Say: "Do you wait for us (anything) except one of the two best things; while we await for you either that Allah will afflict you with a punishment from Himself or at our hands. So wait, we too are waiting with you (9:52). Say: "Spend willingly or unwillingly, it will not be accepted from you. Verily, you are ever a people who are rebellious (9:53). And nothing prevents their contributions from being accepted from them except that they disbelieved in Allah and in His Messenger, and that they came not to the Salah except in a…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:53 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Spend willingly or unwillingly; never will it be accepted from you. Indeed, you have been a defiantly disobedient people." See 9:52

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:54 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And what prevents their expenditures from being accepted from them but that they have disbelieved in Allah and in His Messenger and that they come not to prayer except while they are lazy and that they do not spend except while they are unwilling. See 9:52

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:55 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So let not their wealth or their children impress you. Allah only intends to punish them through them in worldly life and that their souls should depart (at death) while they are disbelievers. So let not their wealth nor their children amaze you; in reality Allah's plan is to punish them with these things in the life of this world, and that their souls shall depart (die) while they are disbelievers (9:55).Allah says to His Messenger SAW:فَلَا تُعْجِبْكَ أَمْوَالُهُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُهُمْSo let not their wealth nor their children amaze you...In similar Ayat, Allah said:وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰAnd strain not your eyes in longing for the things We have given for enjoyment to various groups of them, the splendor of the life of this world, that…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:56 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they swear by Allah that they are from among you while they are not from among you; but they are a people who are afraid. They swear by Allah that they are truly of you while they are not of you, but they are a people (hypocrites) who are afraid (that you may kill them) (9:56). Should they find a refuge, or caves, or a place of concealment, they would turn straightway thereto with a swift rush (9:57).Exposing Hypocrites' Fright and FearAllah describes to His Prophet SAW the fright, fear, anxiety and nervousness of the hypocrites:يَحْلِفُونَ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُمْ لَمِنكُمْThey swear by Allah that they are truly of youWhich is swearing a sure oath:وَمَا هُم مِّنكُمْwhile they are not of youWhich is in reality:وَلَٰكِنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ يَفْرَقُونَbut they are a people who are afraidAnd this is what made them swear.لَوْ يَجِدُونَ…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:57 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: If they could find a refuge or some caves or any place to enter (and hide), they would turn to it while they run heedlessly. See 9:56

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:58 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And among them are some who criticize you concerning the (distribution of) charities. If they are given from them, they approve; but if they are not given from them, at once they become angry. And of them are some who accuse you concerning (the distribution of) the alms. If they are given part thereof, they are pleased, but if they are not given thereof, behold! They are enraged (9:58). Would that they were content with what Allah and His Messenger gave them and had said: Allah is sufficient for us. Allah will give us of His bounty, and so will His Messenger. We implore Allah (to enrich us) (9:59).Hypocrites Question the Integrity of the Messenger SAW When Distributing AlmsAllah said next:وَمِنْهُمAnd of themWhich is among the hypocrites:مَّن يَلْمِزُكَwho accuse youor question your integrity:فِيconcerningWhich is division of:الصَّدَقَاتِthe almsWhen you divide them.…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:59 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: If only they had been satisfied with what Allah and His Messenger gave them and said, "Sufficient for us is Allah; Allah will give us of His bounty, and (so will) His Messenger; indeed, we are desirous toward Allah,"1 (it would have been better for them). See 9:58

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if any one of the polytheists seeks your protection, then grant him protection so that he may hear the words of Allah (i.e., the Qur’ān). Then deliver him to his place of safety. That is because they are a people who do not know. And if anyone of the Mushrikin seeks your protection then grant him protection so that he may hear the Word of Allah (the Qur'an) and then escort him to where he can be secure, that is because they are men who know not (9:6).Idolators are Granted Safe Passage If They Seek ItAllah said to His Prophet (AS):وَإِنْ أَحَدٌ مِّنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَAnd if anyone of the MushrikinWhich is whom you were commanded to fight and We allowed you their blood and property,'اسْتَجَارَكَseeks your protectionAsked you for safe passage, then accept his request until he hears the Words…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:60 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Zakāh expenditures are only for the poor and for the needy and for those employed for it1 and for bringing hearts together (for Islām) and for freeing captives (or slaves) and for those in debt and for the cause of Allah and for the (stranded) traveler - an obligation (imposed) by Allah. And Allah is Knowing and Wise. As-Sadaqat (i.e., Zakah) are only for the Fuqara', and Al-Masakin and those employed to collect (the funds); and to attract the hearts of those who have been inclined (towards Islam); and to free the captives; and for those in debt; and for Allah's cause, and for Ibn As-Sabil; a duty imposed by Allah. And Allah is All-Knower, All-Wise (9:60).Expenditures of Zakah (Alms)After Allah mentioned the protest that the ignorant hypocrites mentioned to the Prophet SAW about the distribution of alms. He stated…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:61 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And among them are those who abuse the Prophet and say, "He is an ear."1 Say, "(It is) an ear of goodness for you that believes in Allah and believes the believers and (is) a mercy to those who believe among you." And those who abuse the Messenger of Allah - for them is a painful punishment. And among them are men who annoy the Prophet and say: "He is (lending his) ear (to every news)." Say: "He listens to what is best for you; he believes in Allah; has faith in the believers; and is a mercy to those of you who believe." But those who annoy Allah's Messenger, will have a painful torment (9:61).Hypocrites Annoy the Prophet SAWAllah says, some hypocrites bother the Messenger of Allah SAW by questioning his character, saying:هُوَ أُذُنٌhe is (lending his) earTo those…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:62 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They swear by Allah to you (Muslims) to satisfy you. But Allah and His Messenger are more worthy for them to satisfy,1 if they were to be believers. They swear by Allah to you (Muslims) in order to please you, but it is more fitting that they should please Allah and His Messenger, if they are believers (9:62). Know they not that whoever opposes and shows hostility to Allah and His Messenger, certainly for him will be the fire of Hell to abide therein. That is the extreme disgrace (9:63).Hypocrites Revert to Lies to Please PeopleQatadah said about Allah's statement:يَحْلِفُونَ بِاللَّهِ لَكُمْ لِيُرْضُوكُمْThey swear by Allah to you (Muslims) in order to please youA hypocrite man said, 'By Allah! They (hypocrites) are our chiefs and masters. If what Muhammad says is true, they are worse than donkeys.' A Muslim man…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:63 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do they not know that whoever opposes Allah and His Messenger - that for him is the fire of Hell, wherein he will abide eternally? That is the great disgrace. See 9:62

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:64 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The hypocrites are apprehensive lest a sūrah be revealed about them, informing them of1 what is in their hearts. Say, "Mock (as you wish); indeed, Allah will expose that which you fear." The hypocrites fear lest a Surah should be revealed about them, showing them what is in their hearts. Say: (Go ahead and) mock! But certainly Allah will bring to light all that you fear (9:64).The Hypocrites Fear Public Exposure of Their SecretsMujahid said, "The hypocrites would say something to each other then declare, 'We wish that Allah does not expose this secret of ours," There is a similar Ayah to this one, that is, Allah's statement:وَإِذَا جَاءُوكَ حَيَّوْكَ بِمَا لَمْ يُحَيِّكَ بِهِ اللَّهُ وَيَقُولُونَ فِي أَنفُسِهِمْ لَوْلَا يُعَذِّبُنَا اللَّهُ بِمَا نَقُولُ ۚ حَسْبُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُAnd when they come to you, they greet you with a…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:65 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if you ask them, they will surely say, "We were only conversing and playing." Say, "Is it Allah and His verses and His Messenger that you were mocking?" If you ask them (about this), they declare: We were only talking idly and joking." Say: "Was it at Allah, and His Ayat and His Messenger that you were mocking (9:65). Make no excuse; you disbelieved after you had believed. If We pardon some of you, We will punish others among you because they were criminals (9:66).The Hypocrites Rely on False, Misguided ExcusesAbdullah bin Umar said, During the battle of Tabuk, a man was sitting in a gathering and said, 'I have never seen like these reciters of ours! They have the hungriest stomachs, the most lying tongues and are the most cowardice in battle.' A man in the Masjid said,…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:66 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Make no excuse; you have disbelieved (i.e., rejected faith) after your belief. If We pardon one faction of you - We will punish another faction because they were criminals. See 9:65

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:67 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The hypocrite men and hypocrite women are of one another. They enjoin what is wrong and forbid what is right and close their hands.1 They have forgotten Allah, so He has forgotten them (accordingly). Indeed, the hypocrites - it is they who are the defiantly disobedient. The hypocrites, men and women, are one from another; they enjoin evil, and forbid the good, and they close their hands. They have forgotten Allah, so He has forgotten them. Verily, the hypocrites are the rebellious (9:67). Allah has promised the hypocrites – men and women – and the disbelievers, the fire of Hell; therein shall they abide. It will suffice them. Allah has cursed them and for them is the lasting torment (9:68).Other Characteristics of HypocritesAllah admonishes the hypocrites who, unlike the believers, who enjoin righteousness and forbid evil:يَأْمُرُونَ بِالْمُنكَرِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمَعْرُوفِ…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:68 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
