item.description: Allah has promised the hypocrite men and hypocrite women and the disbelievers the fire of Hell, wherein they will abide eternally. It is sufficient for them. And Allah has cursed them, and for them is an enduring punishment. See 9:67

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:69 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (You disbelievers are) like those before you; they were stronger than you in power and more abundant in wealth and children. They enjoyed their portion (of worldly enjoyment), and you have enjoyed your portion as those before you enjoyed their portion, and you have engaged (in vanities) like that in which they engaged. (It is) those whose deeds have become worthless in this world and in the Hereafter, and it is they who are the losers. بِخَلَاقِهِمْtheir portionWhich is means, (they mocked) their religion, according to Al-Hasan Al-Basri. Allah's statement:وَخُضْتُمْ كَالَّذِي خَاضُواand you indulged in play and pastime as they indulged in play and pastimeWhich is indulged in lies and falsehood:أُولَٰئِكَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْSuch are they whose deeds are in vainTheir deeds are annulled; they will not acquire any rewards for them because they are invalid:فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ ۖ وَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: How can there be for the polytheists a treaty in the sight of Allah and with His Messenger, except for those with whom you made a treaty at al-Masjid al-Ḥarām? So as long as they are upright toward you,1 be upright toward them. Indeed, Allah loves the righteous (who fear Him). How can there be a covenant with Allah and with His Messenger for the Mushrikin except those with whom you made a covenant near Al-Masjid Al-Haram (at Makkah)? So long as they are true to you, stand you true to them. Verily, Allah loves those who have Taqwa (9:7).Affirming the Disavowel of the IdolatorsAllah mentions the wisdom in dissolving all obligations to the idolators and giving them a four month period of safety, after which they will meet the sharp sword wherever they are found:كَيْفَ يَكُونُ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ عَهْدٌHow can…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:70 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Has there not reached them the news of those before them - the people of Nuh and (the tribes of) ʿAad and Thamūd and the people of Ibrahim and the companions (i.e., dwellers) of Madyan and the towns overturned?1 Their messengers came to them with clear proofs. And Allah would never have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves. Has not the story reached them of those before them? – The people of Nuh,'Ad, Thamud, the people of Ibrahim, the dwellers of Madyan and the overturned cities; to them came their Messengers with clear proofs. So it was not Allah Who wronged them, but they used to wrong themselves (9:70).Advising the Hypocrites to Learn a Lesson from Those before ThemAllah advises the hypocrites who reject the Messengers:أَلَمْ يَأْتِهِمْ نَبَأُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْHas not the story reached them of those before…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:71 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The believing men and believing women are allies of one another. They enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and establish prayer and give zakāh and obey Allah and His Messenger. Those - Allah will have mercy upon them. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise. The believers, men and women, are supporters of one another; they enjoin good, and forbid evil; they perform the Salah, and give the Zakah, and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah will have His mercy on them. Surely, Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise (9:71).Qualities of Faithful BelieversAfter Allah mentioned the evil characteristics of the hypocrites, He then mentioned the good qualities of the believers:وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتُ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍThe believers, men and women, are supporters of one another;they help and aid each other. Surely, an authentic Hadith states:الْمُؤْمِنُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ كَالْبُنْيَانِ يَشُدُّ بَعْضُهُ بَعْضًاThe…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:72 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah has promised the believing men and believing women gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally, and pleasant dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence; but approval from Allah is greater. It is that which is the great attainment. Allah has promised the believers – men and women, – Gardens under which rivers flow to dwell therein forever, and beautiful mansions in gardens of 'Adn (Eden; Paradise). But the greatest bliss is the good pleasure of Allah. That is the supreme success (9:72).Good News for the Believers of Eternal DelightAllah describes the joys and eternal delight He has prepared for the believers, men and women in:جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَاGardens under which rivers flow to dwell therein foreverfor eternity:وَمَسَاكِنَ طَيِّبَةًand beautiful mansionsBuilt beautifully in good surroundings. In the Two Sahihs, it is recorded that Abu Musa, 'Abdullah…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:73 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O Prophet, fight against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination. O Prophet! Strive hard against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be harsh against them, their abode is Hell, – and worst indeed is that destination (9:73). They swear by Allah that they said nothing (bad), but really they said the word of disbelief, and they disbelieved after accepting Islam, and they resolved that (plot) which they were unable to carry out, and they could not find any cause to do so except that Allah and His Messenger had enriched them of His bounty. If then they repent, it will be better for them, but if they turn away; Allah will punish them with a painful torment in this worldly life and in the Hereafter. And…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:74 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They swear by Allah that they did not say (anything against the Prophet SAW) while they had said the word of disbelief and disbelieved after their (pretense of) Islām and planned that which they were not to attain.1 And they were not resentful except (for the fact) that Allah and His Messenger had enriched them of His bounty.2 So if they repent, it is better for them; but if they turn away, Allah will punish them with a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter. And there will not be for them on earth any protector or helper. See 9:73

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:75 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And among them are those who made a covenant with Allah, (saying), "If He should give us from His bounty, we will surely spend in charity, and we will surely be among the righteous." And of them are some who made a covenant with Allah (saying): If He bestowed on us of His bounty, we will verily, give Sadaqah and will be certainly among the righteous (9:75). Then when He gave them of His bounty, they became stingy, and turned away, averse (9:76). So He punished them by putting hypocrisy into their hearts till the Day whereon they shall meet Him, because they broke that (covenant) with Allah which they had promised to Him and because they used to tell lies (9:77). Know they not that Allah knows their secret ideas, and their Najwa (secret counsels), and that Allah is…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:76 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But when He gave them from His bounty, they were stingy with it and turned away while they refused. See 9:75

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:77 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So He penalized them with hypocrisy in their hearts until the Day they will meet Him - because they failed Allah in what they promised Him and because they (habitually) used to lie. See 9:75

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:78 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Did they not know that Allah knows their secrets and their private conversations and that Allah is the Knower of the unseen? See 9:75

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:79 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Those who criticize the contributors among the believers concerning (their) charities and (criticize) the ones who find nothing (to spend) except their effort, so they ridicule them - Allah will ridicule them, and they will have a painful punishment. Those who defame such of the believers who give charity voluntarily, and such who could not find to give charity except what is available to them – so they mock at them (believers); Allah will throw back their mockery on them, and they shall have a painful torment (9:79).Hypocrites Defame Believers Who Give the Little Charity They can AffordAmong the traits of the hypocrites is that they will not leave anyone without defaming and ridiculing him in all circumstances even those who give away charity. If, for instance, someone gives away a large amount, the hypocrites say that he is showing…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: How (can there be a treaty) while, if they gain dominance over you, they do not observe concerning you any pact of kinship or covenant of protection? They satisfy you with their mouths, but their hearts refuse (compliance), and most of them are defiantly disobedient. How? When if you are overpowered by them, they regard not the ties, either of kinship, ('Ill') or of covenant (Dhimmah)? With their mouths they please you, but their hearts are averse to you, and most of them are rebellious (9:8).Allah encourages the believers to show enmity to the idolators and to dissociate from them, affirming that they do not deserve to enjoy a covenant of peace, because of their Shirk in Allah and disbelief in Allah's Messenger SAW.If these disbelievers have a chance to defeat Muslims, they will cause great mischief, leave nothing unharmed,…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:80 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Ask forgiveness for them, (O Muḥammad), or do not ask forgiveness for them. If you should ask forgiveness for them seventy times - never will Allah forgive them. That is because they disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger, and Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people. Whether you (O Muhammad SAW) ask forgiveness for them (hypocrites) or ask not forgiveness for them – (and even) if you ask seventy times for their forgiveness – Allah will not forgive them because they have disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger. And Allah guides not those people who are rebellious (9:80).The Prohibition of Asking for Forgiveness for HypocritesAllah says to His Prophet SAW that hypocrites are not worthy of seeking forgiveness for them and that if he asks Allah to forgive them seventy times, Allah will not forgive them. The number seventy…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:81 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Those who remained behind1 rejoiced in their staying (at home) after (the departure of) the Messenger of Allah and disliked to strive with their wealth and their lives in the cause of Allah and said, "Do not go forth in the heat." Say, "The fire of Hell is more intense in heat" - if they would but understand. Those who stayed away (from Tabuk expedition) rejoiced in their staying behind the Messenger of Allah; they hated to strive and fight with their properties and their lives in the cause of Allah, and they said: "March not forth in the heat." Say: "The fire of Hell is more intense in heat;" if only they could understand (9:81). So let them laugh a little and (they will) cry much as a recompense of what they used to earn (by committing sins) (9:82).Hypocrites…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:82 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So let them laugh a little and (then) weep much as recompense for what they used to earn. See 9:81

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:83 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: If Allah should return you to a faction of them (after the expedition) and then they ask your permission to go out (to battle), say, "You will not go out with me, ever, and you will never fight with me an enemy. Indeed, you were satisfied with sitting (at home) the first time, so sit (now) with those who stay behind." If Allah brings you back to a party of them (the hypocrites), and they ask your permission to go out (to fight), say: Never shall you go out with me nor fight an enemy with me; you were pleased to sit (inactive) on the first occasion, then you sit (now) with those who lag behind (9:83).Hypocrites are Barred from Participating in JihadAllah commands His Messenger (AS):فَإِن رَّجَعَكَ اللَّهُIf Allah brings you backWhich is from this battle:إِلَىٰ طَائِفَةٍ مِّنْهُمْto a…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:84 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And do not pray (the funeral prayer, O Muḥammad), over any of them who has died - ever - or stand at his grave. Indeed, they disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger and died while they were defiantly disobedient. And never (O Muhammad SAW) pray (funeral prayer) for any of them (hypocrites) who dies, nor stand at his grave. Certainly they disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger, and died while they were Fasiqun (9:84).The Prohibition of Prayer for the Funeral of HypocritesAllah commands His Messenger SAW to disown the hypocrites, to abstain from praying the funeral prayer when any of them dies, from standing next to his grave to seek Allah's forgiveness for him, or to invoke Allah for his benefit. This is because hypocrites disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger SAW and died as such. This ruling applies to…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:85 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And let not their wealth and their children impress you. Allah only intends to punish them through them in this world and that their souls should depart (at death) while they are disbelievers. And let not their wealth or their children amaze you. Allah only wants to punish them with these things in this world, and that their souls shall depart (die) while they are disbelievers.) We mentioned before the explanation of a similar Ayah, all the thanks and praises are due to Alla (9:85).

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:86 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when a sūrah was revealed (enjoining them) to believe in Allah and to fight with His Messenger, those of wealth among them asked your permission (to stay back) and said, "Leave us to be with them who sit (at home)." And when a Surah is revealed, enjoining them to believe in Allah and to strive hard and fight along with His Messenger, the wealthy among them ask your leave to exempt them and say, Leave us (behind), we would be with those who sit (at home) (9:86). They are content to be with those who sit behind. Their hearts are sealed up, so they understand not (9:87).Admonishing Those Who did Not Join the JihadAllah chastises and admonishes those who stayed away from Jihad and refrained from performing it, even though they had the supplies, means and ability to join…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:87 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They were satisfied to be with those who stay behind, and their hearts were sealed over, so they do not understand. See 9:86

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:88 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But the Messenger and those who believed with him fought with their wealth and their lives. Those will have (all that is) good and it is those who are the successful. But the Messenger and those who believed with him strove hard and fought with their wealth and their lives. Such are they for whom are the good things, and it is they who will be successful (9:88). For them Allah has prepared Gardens (Paradise) under which rivers flow, to dwell therein forever. That is the supreme success (9:89).After Allah mentioned the sins of the hypocrites, He praised the faithful believers and described their reward in the Hereafter.لَٰكِنِ الرَّسُولُ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ جَاهَدُواBut the Messenger and those who believed with him strove hard and foughtuntil the end of these two Ayat [9:88-89]. This describes the qualities, as well as, the…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:89 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah has prepared for them gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide eternally. That is the great attainment. See 9:88

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They have exchanged the signs of Allah for a small price and averted (people) from His way. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing. They have purchased with the Ayat of Allah a little gain, and they hindered men from His way; evil indeed is that which they used to do (9:9). With regard to a believer, they respect not the ties, either of kinship or of covenant! It is they who are the transgressors (9:10). But if they repent, perform the Salah and give the Zakah, then they are your brethren in religion. (In this way) We explain the Ayat in detail for a people who know (9:11).Allah admonishes the idolators and encourages the believers to fight against them because:اشْتَرَوْا بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًاThey have purchased with the Ayat of Allah a little gain,idolators exchanged following the Ayat…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:90 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those with excuses among the bedouins came to be permitted (to remain), and they who had lied1 to Allah and His Messenger sat (at home). There will strike those who disbelieved among them a painful punishment. And those who made excuses from the bedouins came asking your permission to exempt them (from the battle), and those who had lied to Allah and His Messenger sat at home (without asking the permission for it); a painful torment will seize those of them who disbelieve (9:90).Allah describes here the condition of the bedouins who lived around Al-Madinah, who asked for permission to remain behind from Jihad when they came to the Messenger SAW to explain to him their weakness and inability to join the fighting. Ad-Dahhak said that Ibn 'Abbas said that they were those who had valid excuses, for Allah…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:91 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: There is not upon the weak or upon the ill or upon those who do not find anything to spend any discomfort (i.e., guilt) when they are sincere to Allah and His Messenger. There is not upon the doers of good any cause (for blame). And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. There is no blame on those who are weak or ill or who find no resources to spend, if they are sincere and true (in duty) to Allah and His Messenger. No means (of complaint) can there be against the doers of good. And Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (9:91). Nor (is there blame) on those who came to you to be provided with mounts, when you said: "I can find no mounts for you," they turned back, with their eyes overflowing with tears of grief that they could…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:92 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Nor (is there blame) upon those who, when they came to you for you to take them along, you said, "I can find nothing upon which to carry you."1 They turned back while their eyes overflowed with tears out of grief that they could not find something to spend (for the cause of Allah). See 9:91

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:93 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The cause (for blame) is only upon those who ask permission of you while they are rich. They are satisfied to be with those who stay behind, and Allah has sealed over their hearts, so they do not know. See 9:91

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:94 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will make excuses to you when you have returned to them. Say, "Make no excuse - never will we believe you. Allah has already informed us of your news (i.e., affair). And Allah will observe your deeds, and (so will) His Messenger; then you will be taken back to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed,1 and He will inform you of what you used to do." They (the hypocrites) will present their excuses to you (Muslims), when you return to them. Say Present no excuses, we shall not believe you. Allah has already informed us of the news concerning you. Allah and His Messenger will observe your deeds. In the end you will be brought back to the All-Knower of the unseen and the seen, then He (Allah) will inform you of what you used to do…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:95 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will swear by Allah to you when you return to them that you would leave them alone. So leave them alone; indeed they are evil; and their refuge is Hell as recompense for what they had been earning. See 9:94

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:96 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They swear to you so that you might be satisfied with them. But if you should be satisfied with them - indeed, Allah is not satisfied with a defiantly disobedient people. See 9:94

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:97 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The bedouins are stronger in disbelief and hypocrisy and more likely not to know the limits of what (laws) Allah has revealed to His Messenger. And Allah is Knowing and Wise. The bedouins are the worst in disbelief and hypocrisy, and more likely to not know the limits which Allah has revealed to His Messenger. And Allah is All-Knower, All-Wise (9:97). And of the bedouins there are some who look upon what they spend (in Allah's cause) as a fine and watch for calamities for you, on them be the calamity of evil. And Allah is All-Hearer, All-Knower (9:98). And of the bedouins there are some who believe in Allah and the Last Day, and look upon what they spend (in Allah's cause) as means of nearness to Allah, and a cause of receiving the Messenger's invocations. Indeed these (expenditures)…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:98 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And among the bedouins are some who consider what they spend as a loss1 and await for you turns of misfortune. Upon them will be a misfortune of evil. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing. See 9:97

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tawba:99 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But among the bedouins are some who believe in Allah and the Last Day and consider what they spend as means of nearness to Allah and of (obtaining) invocations of the Messenger. Unquestionably, it is a means of nearness for them. Allah will admit them to His mercy. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. See 9:97

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tin:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: By the fig and the olive.1 أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ الْحَاكِمِينَIs not the Allah the best of judges?Meaning: 'is He not the best of judges, Who does not oppress or do any injustice to anyone?' And from His justice is that He will establish the Judgement, and He will give retribution to the person who was wronged in this life against whoever wronged him.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tin:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (by) Mount Sinai. See 95:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tin:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (by) this secure city (i.e., Makkah). See 95:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tin:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: We have certainly created man in the best of stature.1 See 95:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tin:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then We return him to the lowest of the low.1 See 95:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tin:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted. See 95:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tin:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?1 See 95:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tin:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Is not Allah the most just of judges? See 95:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: By the mount. أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَا أَمْ أَنْتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ - اصْلَوْهَاIs this magic or do you not see? Enter thereinMeaning: enter the Fire, 'which will encircle you from every direction,'فَاصْبِرُوا أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْكُمْand whether you are patient of it or impatient of it, it is all the same.'whether you endure its torment and afflictions or not, you will never avert it or be saved from it,'إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَYou are only being requited for what you used to do.and surely, Allah is never unjust with anyone. Most certainly, Allah recompenses each according to their deeds.

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the mountains will pass on, departing1. See 52:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers. See 52:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Who are in (empty) discourse amusing themselves. See 52:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a (violent) thrust, (its angels will say). See 52:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: "This is the Fire which you used to deny. See 52:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then is this magic, or do you not see? See 52:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Enter to) burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed (for) what you used to do." See 52:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure. Verily, those who have Taqwa will be in Gardens and Delight (52:17). Enjoying in that which their Lord has bestowed on them, and (the fact that) their Lord saved them from the torment of the blazing Fire (52:18). Eat and drink with happiness because of what you used to do (52:19). They will recline on thrones Masfufah. And We shall marry them to Hur (fair females) with wide lovely eyes (52:20). Description of the Destination of the Happy Allah the Exalted described the destination of the happy ones:إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَعِيمٍVerily, those who have Taqwa will be in Gardens and Delight.in contrast to the torment and punishment of the miserable;فَاكِهِينَ بِمَا آتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْEnjoying in that which their Lord has bestowed on them,Meaning: enjoying the various types of delight that Allah…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire. See 52:17

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (They will be told), "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do." See 52:17

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (by) a Book inscribed.1 See 52:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, (beautiful) eyes. See 52:17

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds.1 Every person, for what he earned, is retained.2 And those who believe and whose offspring follow them in faith, – to them shall We join their offspring, and We shall not decrease the reward of their deeds in anything. Every person is a pledge for that which he has earned (52:21). And We shall provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire (52:22). There they shall pass from hand to hand a cup, free from any idle talk, and free from sin (52:23). And there will go round boy-servants of theirs, to serve them as if they were preserved pearls (52:24). And some of them draw near to…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire. See 52:21

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will exchange with one another a cup (of wine) wherein (results) no ill speech or commission of sin. See 52:21

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: There will circulate among them (servant) boys (especially) for them, as if they were pearls well-protected. See 52:21

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other. See 52:21

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful (of displeasing Allah). See 52:21

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire. See 52:21

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, we used to supplicate1 Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful." See 52:21

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So remind, (O Muḥammad), for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman. Therefore, remind. By the grace of Allah, you are neither a Kahin nor a madman (52:29). Or do they say: "A poet! We await for him some calamity by time! (52:30). Say: "Wait! I am with you among those who wait! (52:31). Or do their minds command them this or are they people transgressing all bounds (52:32). Or do they say: "He has forged it?" Nay! They believe not (52:33). Let them then produce a recitation like unto it if they are truthful (52:34).Absolving the Prophet SAW of the False Accusations the Idolators Made against HimAllah the Exalted commands His Messenger SAW to convey His Message to His servants and remind them of His revelation that has been sent down to…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: In parchment spread open. See 52:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or do they say (of you), "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?1 See 52:29

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters." See 52:29

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or do their minds1 command them to (say) this, or are they a transgressing people? See 52:29

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe. See 52:29

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful. See 52:29

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:35 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators (of themselves)? Or were they created by nothing? Or were they themselves the creators (52:35). Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they have no firm belief (52:36). Or are with them the treasures of your Lord? Or are they the tyrants with the authority to do as they like (52:37). Or have they a stairway (to heaven), by means of which they listen? Then let their listener produce some manifest proof (52:38). Or has He only daughters and you have sons (52:39). Or is it that you ask a wage from them so that they are burdened with a load of debt (52:40). Or that the Unseen is with them, and they write it down (52:41). Or do they intend a plot? But those…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain. See 52:35

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or have they the depositories (containing the provision) of your Lord? Or are they the controllers (of them)? See 52:35

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:38 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or have they a stairway (into the heaven) upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority (i.e., proof). See 52:35

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:39 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or has He daughters while you have sons? See 52:35

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (by) the frequented House.1 See 52:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:40 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or do you, (O Muḥammad), ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down? See 52:35

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:41 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or have they (knowledge of) the unseen, so they write (it) down? See 52:35

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:42 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan. See 52:35

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:43 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him. See 52:35

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:44 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling,1 they would say, "(It is merely) clouds heaped up." And if they were to see a piece of the heaven falling down, they would say: Clouds gathered in heaps! (52:44). So leave them alone till they meet their Day, in which they will sink into a fainting (with horror) (52:45). The Day when their plotting shall not avail them at all, nor will they be helped (52:46). And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment before this; but most of them know not (52:47). So wait patiently for the decision of your Lord, for verily, you are under Our Eyes; and glorify the praises of your Lord when you get up (52:48). And in the nighttime also glorify His praises and at the setting of…

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:45 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible. See 52:44

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:46 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped. See 52:44

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:47 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment1 before that, but most of them do not know. See 52:44

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:48 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And be patient, (O Muḥammad), for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes (i.e., sight). And exalt (Allah) with praise of your Lord when you arise. See 52:44

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:49 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after (the setting of) the stars. See 52:44

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (by) the ceiling (i.e., heaven) raised high. See 52:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (by) the sea set on fire.1 See 52:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur. See 52:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Of it there is no preventer. See 52:1

item.title: bil-Quran: At-Tur:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion. See 52:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zalzala:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: When the earth is shaken with its (final) earthquake. يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ النَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًاThat Day mankind will proceed in scattered groups (Ashtat)Meaning: they will return from the station of the Judgement in separate groups. This means that they will be divided into types and categories: between those who are miserable and those who are happy, and those who are commanded to go to Paradise and those who are commanded to go to the Hellfire. As-Suddi said, "Ashtat means sects." Allah said:لِّيُرَوْا أَعْمَالَهُمْthat they may be shown their deeds.Meaning: so that they may act and be rewarded for what they did in this life of good and evil.The Recompense for Every Minute DeedTherefore, Allah goes on to say:فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ - وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُSo whosoever does good equal to the weight of a speck of dust…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zalzala:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the earth discharges its burdens.1 See 99:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zalzala:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And man says,1 "What is (wrong) with it?". See 99:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zalzala:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That Day, it will report its news. See 99:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zalzala:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Because your Lord has inspired (i.e., commanded) it. See 99:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zalzala:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That Day, the people will depart1 separated (into categories) to be shown (the result of) their deeds. See 99:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zalzala:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So whoever does an atom's weight1 of good will see it. See 99:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zalzala:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it. See 99:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Ḥā, Meem.1 فَأَهْلَكْنَا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًاThen We destroyed men stronger than thesemeans, 'We destroyed those who disbelieved in the Messengers, and they were stronger in power than these who disbelieve in you, O Muhammad.' This is like the Ayah:أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوا أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةًHave they not traveled through the earth and seen what was the end of those before them? They were more in number than them and mightier in strength (40:82)And there are many similar Ayat.وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ الْأَوَّلِينَand the example of the ancients has passed away.Mujahid said, "The way of their life." Qatadah said, "Their punishment." Others said, "Their lesson," i.e., 'We made them a lesson for those disbelievers who came after them, that they would suffer the same end as them,' as in the Ayah at the…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (The one) who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided. See 43:9

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth. See 43:9

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount. See 43:9

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have (otherwise) subdued it.1 See 43:9

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed we, to our Lord, will (surely) return." See 43:9

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion.1 Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful. Yet, they assign to some of His servants a share with Him. Verily, man is indeed a manifest ingrate (43:15). Or has He taken daughters out of what He has created, and He has selected for you sons (43:16). And if one of them is informed of the news of that which he sets forth as a parable to the Most Gracious, his face becomes dark, and he is filled with grief (43:17). A creature who is brought up in adornments, and who in dispute cannot make itself clear (43:18). And they make females the angels who themselves are servants of the Most Gracious. Did they witness their creation Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned (43:19). And they said: "If…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for (having) sons? See 43:15

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison (i.e., a daughter), his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief. See 43:15

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident1 (attributed to Allah)? See 43:15

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they described the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, as females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned. See 43:15

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: By the clear Book. See 43:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but misjudging. See 43:15

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or have We given them a book before it (i.e., the Qur’ān) to which they are adhering? Or have We given them any Book before this (the Qur'an) to which they are holding fast (43:21). Nay! They say: We found our fathers following a certain way and religion, and we guide ourselves by their footsteps (43:22). And similarly, We sent not a warner before you to any town (people) but the luxurious ones among them said: "We found our fathers following a certain way and religion, and we will indeed follow their footsteps (43:23). He said: "Even if I bring you better guidance than that which you found your fathers following?" They said: "Verily, we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent (43:24). So We took revenge on them, then see what was the end of those who…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps (rightly) guided." See 43:21

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following." See 43:21

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Each warner) said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that (religion) upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers." See 43:21

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers. See 43:21

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (mention, O Muḥammad), when Ibrahim said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship. And (remember) when Ibrahim said to his father and his people: "Verily, I am innocent of what you worship, (43:26). "Except Him Who created me; and verily, He will guide me (43:27). And he made it a word lasting among his offspring, that they may turn back (43:28). Nay, but I gave to these and their fathers to enjoy, till there came to them the truth, and a Messenger making things clear (43:29). And when the truth came to them, they said: "This is magic, and we disbelieve therein (43:30). And they say: "Why is not this Qur'an sent down to some great man of the two towns? (43:31). Is it they who would portion out the mercy…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me." See 43:26

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And he made it1 a word remaining among his descendants that they might return (to it). See 43:26

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: However, I gave enjoyment to these (people of Makkah) and their fathers1 until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.2 See 43:26

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand. See 43:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers." See 43:26

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they said, "Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from (one of) the two cities?"1 See 43:26

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees (of rank) that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate. See 43:26

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if it were not that the people would become one community (of disbelievers),1 We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount. See 43:26

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And for their houses - doors and couches (of silver) upon which to recline. See 43:26

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:35 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous. See 43:26

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion. And whosoever Ya'shu (turns away blindly) from the remembrance of the Most Gracious, We appoint for him Shaytan to be a Qarin (a companion) to him (43:36). And verily, they hinder them from the path, but they think that they are guided aright (43:37). Till, when (such a one) comes to Us, he says, "Would that between me and you were the distance of the two easts (or the east and west) a worst companion (indeed)! (43:38). It will profit you not this Day as you did wrong, (and) that you will be sharers in the punishment (43:39). Can you make the deaf to hear, or can you guide the blind or him who is in…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, they (i.e., the devils) avert them from the way (of guidance) while they think that they are (rightly) guided. See 43:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:38 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Until, when he comes to Us (at Judgement), he says (to his companion), "How I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west; and what a wretched companion." See 43:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:39 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are (all) sharing in the punishment. See 43:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book1 with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.2 See 43:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:40 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then will you make the deaf hear, (O Muḥammad), or guide the blind or he who is in clear error? See 43:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:41 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And whether (or not) We take you away (in death), indeed, We will take retribution upon them. See 43:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:42 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or whether (or not) We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability. See 43:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:43 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path. See 43:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:44 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, it is a remembrance1 for you and your people, and you (all) are going to be questioned. See 43:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:45 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped? See 43:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:46 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And certainly did We send Musa with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds." And indeed We did send Musa with Our Ayat to Fir'awn and his chiefs. He said: "Verily, I am a Messenger of the Lord of all that exists (43:46). But when he came to them with Our Ayat, behold, they laughed at them (43:47). And not an Ayah We showed them but it was greater than its fellow preceding it, and We seized them with torment, in order that they might turn (43:48). And they said (to Musa): "O you sorcerer! Invoke your Lord for us according to what He has made a pact with you. Verily, We shall guide ourselves (43:49). But when We removed the torment from them, behold, they…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:47 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them. See 43:46

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:48 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return (to faith). See 43:46

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:49 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they said (to Musa), "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided." See 43:46

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people? See 43:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:50 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word. See 43:46

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:51 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see? And Fir'awn proclaimed among his people (saying): "O my people! Is not mine the dominion of Egypt, and these rivers flowing underneath me. See you not then? (43:51). "Am I not better than this one (Musa) who is despicable and can scarcely express himself clearly? (43:52). Why then are not golden bracelets bestowed on him, or angels sent along with him? (43:53). Thus he fooled his people, and they obeyed him. Verily, they were ever a people who were rebellious (43:54). So when they angered Us, We punished them, and drowned them all (43:55). And We made them a precedent, and an example to later generations (43:56).Fir'awn's Address…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:52 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or am I (not) better than this one (i.e., Musa) who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?1 See 43:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:53 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?" See 43:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:54 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were (themselves) a people defiantly disobedient (of Allah). See 43:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:55 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all. See 43:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:56 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples. See 43:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:57 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when the son of Maryam was presented as an example,1 immediately your people laughed aloud. And when the son of Maryam is quoted as an example, behold, your people cry aloud thereat (43:57). And say: "Are our gods better or is he?" They quoted not the above example except for argument. Nay! But they are a quarrelsome people (43:58). He was not more than a servant. We granted Our favor to him, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel (43:59). And if it were Our will, We would have made angels to replace you on the earth (43:60). And he shall be a known sign for (the coming of) the Hour. Therefore have no doubt concerning it. And follow Me! This is the straight path (43:61). And let not Shaytan hinder you. Verily, he (Shaytan)…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:58 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they said, "Are our gods better, or is he?"1 They did not present it (i.e., the comparison) except for (mere) argument. But, (in fact), they are a people prone to dispute. See 43:57

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:59 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He (i.e., Isa) was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel. See 43:57

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples. See 43:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:60 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if We willed, We could have made (instead) of you angels succeeding (one another)1 on the earth. See 43:57

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:61 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, he (i.e., Isa) will be (a sign for) knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me.1 This is a straight path. See 43:57

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:62 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy. See 43:57

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:63 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when Isa brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom (i.e., prophethood) and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me. See 43:57

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:64 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path." See 43:57

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:65 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But the denominations from among them differed (and separated), so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day. See 43:57

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:66 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not? Do they only wait for the Hour that it shall come upon them suddenly while they perceive not (43:66). Friends on that Day will be foes one to another except those who have Taqwa (43:67). My servants! No fear shall be on you this Day, nor shall you grieve (43:68). (You) who believed in Our Ayat and were Muslims (43:69). Enter Paradise, you and your wives, in happiness (43:70). Trays of gold and cups will be passed round them; (there will be) therein all that their souls desire, and all that eyes could delight in and you will abide therein forever (43:71). This is the Paradise, which you have been made to inherit because of your deeds that you used to do (43:72). Therein…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:67 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous. See 43:66

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:68 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (To whom Allah will say), "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve. See 43:66

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:69 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (You) who believed in Our verses and were Muslims. See 43:66

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him. See 43:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:70 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds,1 delighted." See 43:66

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:71 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and (what) delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally. See 43:66

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:72 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do. See 43:66

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:73 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: For you therein is much fruit1 from which you will eat. See 43:66

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:74 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally. Verily, the criminals will be in the torment of Hell to abide therein forever (43:74). (The torment) will not be lightened for them, and they will be plunged into destruction with deep regrets, sorrows and in despair therein (43:75). We wronged them not, but they were the wrongdoers (43:76). And they will cry: O Malik (keeper of Hell)! Let your Lord make an end of us." He will say: "Verily, you shall abide forever (43:77). Indeed We have brought the truth to you, but most of you have a hatred for the truth (43:78). Or have they plotted some plan? Then We too are planning (43:79). Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private counsel? Yes (We do) and Our messengers are by…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:75 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair. See 43:74

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:76 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers. See 43:74

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:77 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they will call, "O Mālik,1 let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain." See 43:74

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:78 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse. See 43:74

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:79 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or have they devised (some) affair?1 But indeed, We are devising (a plan). See 43:74

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We destroyed greater than them1 in (striking) power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded. See 43:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:80 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, (We do), and Our messengers (i.e., angels) are with them recording. See 43:74

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:81 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, (O Muḥammad), "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of (his) worshippers."1 Say: "If the Most Gracious had a son, then I am the first of the worshippers (43:81). Glorified is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne! Exalted be He from all that they ascribe (to Him) (43:82). So leave them (alone) to speak nonsense and play until they meet the Day of theirs which they have been promised (43:83). It is He Who is the only God in the heaven and the only God on the earth. And He is the All-Wise, the All-Knower (43:84). And Blessed be He to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, and with Whom is the knowledge of the Hour,…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:82 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe. See 43:81

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:83 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised. See 43:81

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:84 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And it is He (i.e., Allah) who is (the only) deity in the heaven, and on the earth (the only) deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing. See 43:81

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:85 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned. See 43:81

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:86 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those they invoke1 besides Him do not possess (power of) intercession; but only those who testify to the truth (can benefit), and they know.2 See 43:81

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:87 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if you asked them1 who created them, they would surely say, "Allah." So how are they deluded? See 43:81

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:88 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (Allah acknowledges) his saying,1 "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe." See 43:81

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:89 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace."1 But they are going to know. See 43:81

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zukhruf:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing." And indeed if you ask them: "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" They will surely say: "The All-Mighty, the All-Knower created them (43:9). Who has made for you the earth like a bed, and has made for you roads therein, in order that you may find your way (43:10). And Who sends down water from the sky in due measure, then We revive a dead land therewith, and even so you will be brought forth (43:11). And Who has created all the pairs and has appointed for you ships and cattle on which you ride (43:12). In order that you may mount on their backs, and then may remember the…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The revelation of the Book (i.e., the Qur’ān) is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise. لَوْ أَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَاصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ ۚHad Allah willed to take a son (or offspring), He could have chosen whom He willed out of those whom He created.Meaning: the matter would not have been as they claim. This is a conditional sentence which does not imply that this happened or that it is permitted; indeed, it is impossible. The aim is only to point out the ignorance of their claims. It is like the Ayat:لَوْ أَرَدْنَا أَنْ نَتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَاتَّخَذْنَاهُ مِنْ لَدُنَّا إِنْ كُنَّا فَاعِلِينَHad We intended to take a pastime, We could surely have taken it from Us, if We were going to do (that). (21:17)قُلْ إِنْ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْعَابِدِينَSay: "If the Most Gracious…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say,1 "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account (i.e., limit)." Say: O My servants who believe, have Taqwa of your Lord. Good is for those who do good in this world, and Allah's earth is spacious! Only those who are patient shall receive their reward in full, without reckoning (39:10). Say: "Verily, I am commanded to worship Allah, making religion sincerely for Him (39:11). "And I am commanded (this) in order that I may be the first of the Musli (39:12). The Command for Taqwa, Emigration and to worship Him alone with all Sincerity Allah commands His believing servants to remain steadfast in their obedience and have Taqwa of Him.قُلْ يَا…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, (O Muḥammad), "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allah, (being) sincere to Him in religion. See 39:10

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And I have been commanded to be the first (among you) of the Muslims." See 39:10

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day." Say: "Verily, if I disobey my Lord, I am afraid of the torment of a great Day (39:13). Say: "Allah Alone I worship by doing religious deeds sincerely for His sake only (39:14). "So, worship what you like besides Him." Say: "The losers are those who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Verily, that will be a manifest loss! (39:15). They shall have coverings of Fire, above them and covering (of Fire) beneath them. With this Allah frightens His servants: "O My servants, therefore have Taqwa of Me! (39:16).Creating Fear of the Punishment of AllahAllah says, say O Muhammad, even though you are the Messenger of Allah:إِنِّي أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍVerily, if I disobey my Lord,…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Allah (alone) do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion. See 39:13

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss." See 39:13

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will have canopies (i.e., layers) of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allah threatens (i.e., warns) His servants. O My servants, then fear Me. See 39:13

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But those who have avoided ṭāghūt,1 lest they worship it, and turned back to Allah - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants. Those who avoid At-Taghut by not worshipping them and turn to Allah, for them are glad tidings; so announce the good news to My servants (39:17). Those who listen to the Word and follow the best thereof, those are (the ones) whom Allah has guided and those are men of understanding (39:18).Good News for the RighteousAbdur-Rahman bin Zayd bin Aslam said, narrating from his father:وَالَّذِينَ اجْتَنَبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ أَنْ يَعْبُدُوهَاThose who avoid At-Taghut by not worshipping themwas revealed concerning Zayd bin 'Amr bin Nufayl and Abu Dharr and Salman Al-Farisi (RA). The correct view is that it includes them and all others who avoided worshipping idols and turned to the worship of Ar-Rahman.…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allah has guided, and those are people of understanding. See 39:17

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment (to be guided)? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire? Is, then one against whom the Word of punishment is justified (equal to the one who avoids evil)? Will you rescue him who is in the Fire (39:19). But those who have Taqwa of their Lord, for them are built lofty rooms, one above another under which rivers flow. (This is) the promise of Allah, and Allah does not fail in (His) promise (39:20).Allah says, 'if He has decreed that someone is to be doomed, can you save him from his misguidance and doom?' Which means, no one can guide him apart from Allah, because whomever Allah leaves astray cannot be guided, and whomever He guides cannot be led astray. Then Allah tells us that His blessed…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, (O Muḥammad), in truth. So worship Allah, (being) sincere to Him in religion. See 39:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers,1 above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. (This is) the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in (His) promise. See 39:19

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs (and rivers) in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them (scattered) debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding. See you not that Allah sends down water from the sky, and causes it to penetrate the earth, as water springs, and afterward thereby produces crops of different colors, and afterward they wither and you see them turn yellow; then He makes them dry and broken pieces. Verily, in this is a reminder for men of understanding (39:21). Is he whose breast Allah has opened to Islam, so that he is in light from his Lord? So, woe to those whose hearts are hardened…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So is one whose breast Allah has expanded to (accept) Islām and he is upon (i.e., guided by) a light from his Lord (like one whose heart rejects it)? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah. Those are in manifest error. See 39:21

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance (i.e., mention) of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allah sends astray - for him there is no guide. Allah has sent down the Best Statement, a Book, its parts resembling each other, (and) oft-repeated. The skins of those who fear their Lord shiver from it. Then their skin and their heart soften to the remembrance of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah. He guides therewith whom He wills; and whomever Allah sends astray, for him there is no guide (39:23).The Description of the Qur'anHere Allah praises His Book, the Noble Qur'an, which was revealed…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then is he who will shield with his face1 the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection (like one secure from it)? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn." Is he then, who will confront with his face the awful torment on the Day of Resurrection? And it will be said to the wrongdoers: Taste what you used to earn! (39:24). Those before them denied, and so the torment came on them from directions they perceived not (39:25). So, Allah made them to taste the disgrace in the present life, but greater is the torment of the Hereafter if they only knew (39:26). The Final Destination of the Disbelievers:أَفَمَنْ يَتَّقِي بِوَجْهِهِ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۚIs he then, who will confront with his face the awful torment on the Day of…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive. See 39:24

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So Allah made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew. See 39:24

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur’ān from every (kind of) example - that they might remember. And indeed We have put forth for men, in this Qur'an every kind of parable in order that they may remember (39:27). An Arabic Qur'an, without any crookedness (therein) in order that they may have Taqwa of Him (39:28). Allah puts forth a parable: a man belonging to many partners disputing with one another, and a man belonging entirely to one master. Are those two equal in comparison? All the praises and thanks be to Allah! But most of them know not (39:29). Verily, you will die, and verily, they (too) will die (39:30). Then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be disputing before your Lord (39:31).The Parable of Shirkوَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍAnd…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (It is) an Arabic Qur’ān, without any deviance1 that they might become righteous.2 See 39:27

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Allah presents an example: a man (i.e., slave) owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allah! But most of them do not know. See 39:27

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Unquestionably, for Allah is the pure religion.1 And those who take protectors besides Him (say), "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allah in position." Indeed, Allah will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allah does not guide he who is a liar and (confirmed) disbeliever. See 39:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die. See 39:27

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute. See 39:27

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So who is more unjust than one who lies about Allah and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers? Then, who does more wrong than one who utters a lie against Allah, and denies the truth when it comes to him! Is there not in Hell an abode for the disbelievers (39:32). And he who has brought the truth and (those who) believed therein, they are those who have Taqwa (39:33). They shall have all that they will desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good (39:34). So that Allah may expiate from them the evil of what they did and give them the reward, according to the best of what they used to do (39:35).The Punishment of the Disbelievers and Liars, and…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the one who has brought the truth (i.e., the Prophet SAW) and (they who) believed in it - those are the righteous. See 39:32

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good. See 39:32

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:35 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That Allah may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do. See 39:32

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Is not Allah sufficient for His Servant (i.e., Prophet Muḥammad SAW)? And (yet), they threaten you with those (they worship) other than Him. And whoever Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide. Is not Allah Sufficient for His servant? Yet they try to frighten you with those besides Him! And whom Allah sends astray, for him there will be no guide (39:36). And whomsoever Allah guides, for him there will be no misleader. Is not Allah Almighty, Possessor of Retribution (39:37). And verily, if you ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth?" Surely, they will say: "Allah." Say: "Tell me then, the things that you invoke besides Allah – if Allah intended some harm for me, could they remove His harm? Or if He intended some mercy for me, could they withhold His mercy?" Say:…

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And whoever Allah guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not Allah Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution? See 39:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:38 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "Then have you considered1 what you invoke besides Allah? If Allah intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; upon Him (alone) rely the (wise) reliers." See 39:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:39 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "O my people, work according to your position, (for) indeed, I am working; and you are going to know. See 39:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: If Allah had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allah, the One, the Prevailing.1 See 39:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:40 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment." See 39:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Az-Zumar:41 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
