item.description: But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge,1 do not obey them but accompany them in (this) world with appropriate kindness and follow the way of those who turn back to Me (in repentance). Then to Me will be your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do. See 31:13

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (And Luqmān said), "O my son, indeed if it (i.e., a wrong) should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or (anywhere) in the heavens or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Indeed, Allah is Subtle1 and Aware. "O my son! If it be (anything) equal to the weight of a grain of mustard seed, and though it be in a rock, or in the heavens or on the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Verily, Allah is Subtle, Well-Aware (31:16). "O my son! Perform the Salah, enjoin the good, and forbid the evil, and bear with patience whatever befalls you. Verily, these are some of the important commandments (31:17). "And turn not your face away from men with pride, nor walk in insolence through the earth. Verily, Allah likes not any…

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, (all) that is of the matters (requiring) resolve.1 See 31:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And do not turn your cheek (in contempt) toward people1 and do not walk through the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful. See 31:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys." See 31:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: These are verses of the wise1 Book. See 31:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do you not see that Allah has made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you His favors, (both) apparent and unapparent? But of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening Book (from Him). See you not that Allah has subjected for you whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is on the earth, and has completed and perfected His graces upon you, apparent and hidden? Yet of mankind is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge or guidance or a Book giving light (31:20). And when it is said to them: "Follow that which Allah has sent down," they say: "Nay, we shall follow that which we found our fathers (following)." Even if Shaytan invites them to the torment of…

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allah has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers." Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze? See 31:20

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And whoever submits his face (i.e., self) to Allah while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allah will be the outcome of (all) matters. And whosoever submits his face (himself) to Allah, while he is a Muhsin, then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allah return all matters for decision (31:22). And whoever disbelieves, let not his disbelief grieve you. To Us is their return, and We shall inform them what they have done. Verily, Allah is the All-Knower of what is in the breasts (31:23). We let them enjoy for a little while, then in the end We shall oblige them to (enter) a great torment.) Allah tells us that whoever submits his face to Allah, i.e., does deeds sincerely for His sake, submits to…

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And whoever has disbelieved - let not his disbelief grieve you. To Us is their return, and We will inform them of what they did. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts. See 31:22

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment. See 31:22

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "(All) praise is (due) to Allah"; but most of them do not know. And if you ask them: "Who has created the heavens and the earth," they will certainly say: "Allah." Say: "All the praises and thanks be to Allah!" But most of them know not (31:25). To Allah belongs whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth. Verily, Allah, He is Al-Ghani, Worthy of all praise (31:26).The Idolators Admitted that Allah is the CreatorAllah tells us that these idolators who associated others with Him admitted that Allah Alone, with no partner or associate, is the Creator of heaven and earth yet they still worshipped others besides Him who they recognized were created by Him and subjugated to Him. Allah says:وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ…

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy. See 31:25

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea (was ink), replenished thereafter by seven (more) seas, the words1 of Allah would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise. And if all the trees on the earth were pens and the sea, with seven seas behind it to add to it, yet the Words of Allah would not be exhausted. Verily, Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise (31:27). The creation of you all and the resurrection of you all are only as a single person. Verily, Allah is All-Hearer, All-Seer (31:28).The Words of Allah Cannot be Counted or ExhaustedAllah tells us of His might, pride, majesty, beautiful Names and sublime attributes, and His perfect Words which no one can encompass. No human being knows their essence or nature, or how many they are. As the…

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul.1 Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing. See 31:27

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do you not see (i.e., know) that Allah causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running (its course) for a specified term, and that Allah, of whatever you do, is Aware? See you not that Allah merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night, and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running its course for a term appointed; and that Allah is All-Aware of what you do (31:29). That is because Allah, He is the Truth, and that which they invoke besides Him is falsehood; and that Allah, He is the Most High, the Most Great (31:30).The Might and Power of AllahAllah tells us that He:يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِmerges the night into the day,Meaning: He takes…

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: As guidance and mercy for the doers of good. See 31:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That is because Allah is the True Reality, and that what they call upon1 other than Him is falsehood, and because Allah is the Most High, the Grand. See 31:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do you not see that ships sail through the sea by the favor of Allah that He may show you of His signs? Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful. See you not that the ships sail through the sea by Allah's grace that He may show you of His signs? Verily, in this are signs for every patient, grateful (person) (31:31). And when waves cover them like shades, they invoke Allah, making their invocations for Him only. But when He brings them safe to land, there are among them those that stop in between. And Our Ayat are not denied except by every Khattār Kafūr (31:32).Allah tells us that He is the One Who has subjugated the sea so that ships may sail on it by His command, i.e, His power.For if He did not give…

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when waves come over them like canopies, they supplicate Allah, sincere to Him in religion (i.e., faith). But when He delivers them to the land, there are (some) of them who are moderate (in faith). And none rejects Our signs except everyone treacherous and ungrateful. See 31:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O mankind, fear your Lord and fear a Day when no father will avail his son, nor will a son avail his father at all. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allah by the Deceiver (i.e., Satan). O mankind! Have Taqwa of your Lord, and fear a Day when no father can avail aught for his son, nor a son avail aught for his father. Verily, the promise of Allah is true, let not then this present life deceive you, nor let the chief deceiver deceive you about Allah (31:33).The Command to Fear Allah and Remember the Day of ResurrectionHere Allah warns people about the Day of Resurrection, and commands them to fear Him and remember the Day of Resurrection when:لَا يَجْزِي وَالِدٌ عَنْ وَلَدِهِno father…

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, Allah (alone) has knowledge of the Hour and sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs.1 And no soul perceives what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul perceives in what land it will die. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Aware. Verily, Allah, with Him is the knowledge of the Hour, He sends down the rain, and knows that which is in the wombs. No person knows what he will earn tomorrow, and no person knows in what land he will die. Verily, Allah is All-Knower, All-Aware (31:34).The Knower of the Unseen is AllahThese are the keys of the Unseen, whose knowledge Allah alone has kept for Himself, and no one else knows them unless Allah tells him about them. The knowledge of 'when the Hour will occur' is not known to any Prophet who was…

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and they, of the Hereafter, are certain (in faith). See 31:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Those are on (right) guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful. See 31:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And of the people is he who buys the amusement of speech1 to mislead (others) from the way of Allah without knowledge and who takes it (i.e., His way) in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment. And of mankind is he who purchases idle talk (Lahw Al-Hadith) to mislead from the path of Allah without knowledge, and takes it by way of mockery. For such there will be a humiliating torment (31:6). And when Our Ayat are recited to such a one, he turns away in pride, as if he heard them not – as if there were deafness in his ear. So announce to him a painful torment (31:7).The Doomed are Preoccupied with Idle Talk and They Turn Away from the Ayat of AllahWhen Allah mentions the blessed – who are those who are guided by the Book…

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when Our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. So give him tidings of a painful punishment. See 31:6

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the Gardens of Pleasure. Verily, those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them are Gardens of Delight (31:8). To abide therein. It is a promise of Allah in truth. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise (31:9).The Good Destiny of the BelieversHere Allah mentions the destiny of the righteous in the Hereafter, those who believe in Allah and His Messenger SAW and do righteous deeds in accordance with the Laws of Allah.لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ النَّعِيمِfor them are Gardens of Delight.means, there they will enjoy all kinds of delights and pleasures, food, drink, clothing, dwelling-places, means of transportation, women, a light of beauty and delightful sounds, which have never crossed the mind of any human being. They will stay there forever, never leaving and never desiring change.وَعْدَ اللَّهِ…

item.title: bil-Quran: Luqman:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Wherein they abide eternally; (it is) the promise of Allah (which is) truth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. See 31:8

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Kāf, Hā, Yā, ʿAyn, Ṣād.1 يَرِثُنِي وَيَرِثُ مِنْ آلِ يَعْقُوبَwho shall inherit me, and inherit (also) the posterity of Ya'qub."He would be a Prophet like his forefathers were Prophets." Allah's statement:وَاجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّاand make him, my Lord, one with whom You are well-pleased!means "Make him pleasing to You (Allah) and your creation. Love him and make him beloved to your creatures, in both his religion and his character."

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Zakariyya) said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, (being) sound."1 He Zakariyya said: My Lord! Appoint for me a sign." He said: "Your sign is that you shall not speak unto mankind for three nights, though having no bodily defect (19:10). Then he came out to his people from the Mihrab and he indicated to them by signs to glorify (Allah) in the morning and in the afternoon (19:11).The Sign of the PregnancyAllah, the Exalted, informed about Zakariyya that he said:قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَل لِّي آيَةًHe (Zakariyya) said: "My Lord! Appoint for me a sign.""Give me a sign and a proof of the existence of that which You have promised me, so that my soul will be at rest and my heart will be…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt (Allah) in the morning and afternoon. See 19:10

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Allah said), "O Yahya, take the Scripture (i.e., adhere to it) with determination." And We gave him judgement (while yet) a boy. (It was said to his son): "O Yahya! Hold fast to the Scripture." And We gave him wisdom while yet a child (19:12). And Hananan from Us, and Zakatan, and he was pious (19:13). And dutiful to his parents, and he was not arrogant or disobedient (19:14). And Salam (peace) be on him the day he was born, and the day he dies, and the day he will be raised up to life (again) (19:15).The Birth of the Boy and His CharacteristicsThis also implies what is not mentioned, that this promised boy was born and he was Yahya. There is also the implication that Allah taught him the Book, the Tawrah which they used to study among themselves.…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah. See 19:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant. See 19:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive. See 19:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And mention, (O Muḥammad), in the Book (the story of) Maryam, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. And mention in the Book, Maryam, when she withdrew in seclusion from her family to place facing east (19:16). She placed a screen before them; then We sent to her Our Ruh, and he appeared before her in the form of a man in all respects (19:17). She said: "Verily, I seek refuge with the Most Gracious (Allah) from you, if you do fear Allah (19:18). (The angel) said: "I am only a messenger from your Lord, (to announce) to you the gift of a righteous son (19:19). She said: "How can I have a son when no man has touched me, nor am I Baghiyya? (19:20). He said: "Thus says your Lord: 'That is easy for…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel (i.e., Jibril), and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man. See 19:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, (so leave me), if you should be fearing of Allah." See 19:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you (news of) a pure boy (i.e., son)." See 19:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (This is) a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zakariyya. See 19:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?" See 19:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He said, "Thus (it will be); your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter (already) decreed.'" See 19:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place. So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place (19:22). And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a date palm. She said: Would that I had died before this, and had been forgotten and out of sight! (19:23).The Conception and the BirthAllah, the Exalted, informs about Maryam that when Jibril had spoken to her about what Allah said, she accepted the decree of Allah. Many scholars of the predecessors (Salaf) have mentioned that at this point the angel (who was Jibril) blew into the opening of the garment that she was wearing. Then the breath descended until it entered into her vagina and she conceived the child by the leave of Allah.Muhammad bin Ishaq said, "When she conceived him…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten." See 19:22

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But he1 called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. Then he cried unto her from below her, saying: Grieve not: your Lord has provided a Sariy under you (19:24). "And shake the trunk of date palm towards you, it will let fall fresh ripe dates upon you (19:25). "So eat and drink and rejoice. And if you see any human being, say: 'Verily, I have vowed a fast for the Most Gracious so I shall not speak to any human being today., (19:26).What was Said to Her after the BirthSome reciters read the Ayah as:(مَن تَـحْتَهَآ)Who was below herMeaning the one who was below her called to her. Others recited it as:مِن تَحْتِهَاfrom below herWith the meaning of a preposition (from) instead of a pronoun (who). The scholars of Tafsir have…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates. See 19:24

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to (any) man.'" See 19:24

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Maryam, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented. Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said: O Maryam! Indeed you have brought a thing Fariy (19:27). "O sister of Harun! Your father was not a man who used to commit adultery, nor your mother was an unchaste woman (19:28). Then she pointed to him. They said: "How can we talk to one who is a child in the cradle? (19:29). He said: "Verily, I am a servant of Allah, He has given me the Scripture and made me a Prophet; (19:30). "And He has made me blessed wherever I be, and has enjoined on me (Awsani) Salah and Zakah, as long as I live (19:31). "And to be dutiful to my mother, and made me…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O sister (i.e., descendant) of Harun, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste." See 19:27

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?" See 19:27

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: When he called to his Lord a private call (i.e., supplication). See 19:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Isa) said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet. See 19:27

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakāh as long as I remain alive. See 19:27

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (made me) dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant. See 19:27

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive." See 19:27

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That is Isa, the son of Maryam - the word of truth about which they are in dispute. Such is Isa, son of Maryam. Qawlal-Haqq (it is a statement of truth) about which they doubt (or dispute) (19:34). It befits not (the majesty of) Allah that He should beget a son. Glorified be He. When He decrees a thing, He only says to it: Be!" – and it is (19:35). (Isa said): "And verily, Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. That is the straight path (19:36). Then the sects differed, so woe unto the disbelievers from the meeting of a great Day (19:37).Isa is the Servant of Allah and Not His SonAllah, the Exalted, says to His Messenger Muhammad SAW, 'This is the story which We have related to you about Isa,' upon him be peace.قَوْلَ…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:35 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is not (befitting) for Allah to take a son; exalted is He!1 When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is. See 19:34

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Isa said), "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path." See 19:34

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then the factions differed (concerning Isa) from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day. See 19:34

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:38 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: How (clearly) they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error. How clearly will they see and hear, the Day when they will appear before Us! But the wrongdoers today are in plain error (19:38). And warn them of the Day of grief and regrets, when the case has been decided, while (now) they are in a state of carelessness, and they believe not (19:39). Verily, We will inherit the earth and whatsoever is thereon. And to Us they all shall be returned (19:40).The Disbeliever's Warning of the Day of DistressAllah, the Exalted, says informing about the disbelievers on the Day of Resurrection that they will be made to have the clearest hearing and sight. This is as Allah says:وَلَوْ تَرَىٰ إِذِ الْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُو رُءُوسِهِمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَا أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَاAnd…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:39 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And warn them, (O Muḥammad), of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded;1 and (yet), they are in (a state of) heedlessness, and they do not believe. See 19:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled1 with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy (i.e., disappointed). See 19:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:40 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned. See 19:38

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:41 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And mention in the Book (the story of) Ibrahim. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet. And mention in the Book, Ibrahim. Verily, he was a man of truth, a Prophet (19:41). When he said to his father: "O my father! Why do you worship that which hears not, sees not and cannot avail you in anything? (19:42). "O my father! Verily, there has come to me the knowledge of that which came not unto you. So follow me, I will guide you to the straight path (19:43). "O my father! Worship not Shaytan. Verily, Shaytan has been a rebel against the Most Gracious (19:44). "O my father! Verily, I fear lest a torment from the Most Gracious should overtake you, so that you become a companion of Shaytan (19:45).Ibrahim's Admonition of His FatherAllah, the Exalted, tells…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:42 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Mention) when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all? See 19:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:43 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path. See 19:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:44 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O my father, do not worship (i.e., obey) Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient. See 19:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:45 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion (in Hellfire)." See 19:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:46 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (His father) said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Ibrahim? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time." He (the father) said: "Do you revile my gods, O Ibrahim? If you stop not (this), I will La'arjumannak. So get away from me Maliyan (19:46). Ibrahim said: "Peace be on you! I will ask forgiveness of my Lord for you. Verily, He is unto me Hafiyyan (19:47). And I shall turn away from you and from those whom you invoke besides Allah. And I shall call upon my Lord, and I certainly hope that I shall not be unblessed in my invocation to my Lord (19:48).The Reply of Ibrahim's FatherAllah, the Exalted, informs of the reply of Ibrahim's father to his son, Ibrahim, in reference to what he was calling him…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:47 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Ibrahim) said, "Peace (i.e., safety) will be upon you.1 I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me. See 19:46

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:48 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke1 my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy (i.e., disappointed)." See 19:46

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:49 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah, We gave him Ishaq and Ya'qub, and each (of them) We made a prophet. So when he had turned away from them and from those whom they worshipped besides Allah, We gave him Ishaq and Ya'qub, and each one of them We made a Prophet (19:49). And We gave them of Our mercy, and We granted them Sidqin 'Aliyyan on the tongues (19:50).Allah Gave Ibrahim Ishaq and Ya'qubAllah, the Exalted, says that when the Friend of Allah (Ibrahim) withdrew from his father and his people for the sake of Allah, Allah gave him in exchange those who were better than them. He gave him Ishaq and Ya'qub, meaning his son, Ishaq, and Ishaq's son, Ya'qub. This is as Allah said in another Ayah:وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةًand Ya'qub, a grandson.…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, I fear the successors1 after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir. See 19:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:50 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We gave them of Our mercy, and We made for them a mention (i.e., reputation) of high honor. See 19:49

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:51 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And mention in the Book, Musa. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.1 And mention in the Book, Musa. Verily, he was Mukhlasan and he was a Messenger, (and) a Prophet (19:51). And We called him from the right side of the Mount (Tur), and made him draw near to Us for a talk with him (19:52). And We granted him his brother Harun, (also) a Prophet, out of Our mercy (19:53).Mentioning Musa and HarunAfter Allah had mentioned Ibrahim, the Friend of Allah, and commended him, he next mentioned Al-Kalim (the one spoken to by Allah directly). Allah said:وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ مُوسَىٰ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مُخْلَصًاAnd mention in the Book, Musa. Verily, he was MukhlasanAth-Thawri reported from 'Abdul-Aziz bin Rafi', from Abu Lubabah that he said, "The Disciples (of Isa) said, 'O Spirit of Allah,…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:52 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We called him from the side of the mount1 at (his) right and brought him near, confiding (to him). See 19:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:53 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Harun as a prophet. See 19:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:54 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And mention in the Book, Ismail. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet. And mention in the Book, Ismail. Verily, he was true to what he promised, and he was a Messenger, (and) a Prophet (19:54). And he would enjoin on his family and his people the Salah and the Zakah, and his Lord was pleased with him (19:55).Mentioning IsmailHere Allah has commended Ismail, the son of Ibrahim, the Friend of Allah. He (Ismail) is the father of all of the Arabs of the Hijaz because he was true to what he promised. Ibn Jurayj said, "He did not make any promise to his Lord, except that he fulfilled it." He never obligated himself to do any act of worship with a vow, except that he fulfilled it and carried it out,…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:55 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakāh and was to his Lord pleasing (i.e., accepted by Him). See 19:54

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:56 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet. And mention in the Book, Idris. Verily, he was a man of truth, (and) a Prophet (19:56). And We raised him to a high station (19:57).Mentioning IdrisAllah complimented Idris for being a truthful Prophet and He mentioned that he raised him to a high station. It has previously been mentioned that in the Sahih it is recorded that the Messenger of Allah SAW passed by Idris on the night of the Isra (Night Journey) and he (Idris) was in the fourth heaven. Sufyan reported from Mansur that Mujahid said:وَرَفَعْنَاهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّاAnd We raised him to a high station."This means the fourth heaven." Al-Hasan and others said concerning Allah's statement:وَرَفَعْنَاهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّاAnd We raised him to a high station."This means Paradise."

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:57 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We raised him to a high station. See 19:56

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:58 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried (in the ship) with Nuh, and of the descendants of Ibrahim and Israel (i.e., Ya'qub), and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping. Those were they unto whom Allah bestowed His grace from among the Prophets, of the offspring of Adam, and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Nuh, and of the offspring of Ibrahim and Israel, and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the Ayat of the Most Gracious were recited unto them, they fell down prostrate and weeping (19:58).These Prophets are the Chosen OnesAllah, the Exalted, says that these Prophets (were favored),…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:59 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But there came after them successors (i.e., later generations) who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil1. Then, there has succeeded them a posterity who have lost the Salah and have followed lusts. So they will meet Ghaiy (19:59). Except those who repent and believe, and work righteousness. Such will enter Paradise and they will not be wronged in aught (19:60).They were Succeeded by Wicked People and Good PeopleAfter Allah mentioned the party of blessed ones – the Prophets and those who followed them by maintainig the limits set by Allah and His commandments, fulfilling what Allah ordered and avoiding His prohibitions – then He mentions:(خَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ)there has succeeded them a posterity.This means later generations.أَضَاعُوا الصَّلَاةَwho have lost SalahLosing their prayers is when they do not consider the prayers obligatory. Therefore they lose,…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Who will inherit me1 and inherit from the family of Ya'qub. And make him, my Lord, pleasing (to You)." See 19:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:60 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all. See 19:59

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:61 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Therein are) gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been eminent.1 (They will enter) 'Adn Gardens which the Most Gracious has promised to His servants in the unseen. Verily, His promise must come to pass (19:61). They shall not hear therein any Laghw, but only Salam. And they will have therein their sustenance, morning and afternoon (19:62). Such is the Paradise which We shall give as an inheritance to those of Our servants who had Taqwa (19:63).The Description of the Gardens of the Truthful and Those Who RepentAllah, the Exalted, says that the Gardens (of Paradise), which the penitent will enter, will be Gardens of 'Adn, meaning, eternity. These are Gardens that the Most Beneficent promises His servants in the unseen. This means that these Gardens are…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:62 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only (greetings of) peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon. See 19:61

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:63 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah. See 19:61

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:64 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Jibril said),1 "And we (angels) descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful. And we descend not except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs what is before us and what is behind us, and what is between those two; and your Lord is never forgetful (19:64). Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, so worship Him and abide patiently in His worship. Do you know of any who is similar to Him (19:65).The Angels do Not Descend, Except by Allah's CommandImam Ahmad recorded that Ibn 'Abbas said that the Messenger of Allah SAW said to Jibril:مَا يَمْنَعُكَ أَنْ تَزُورَنَا أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا تَزُورُنَا؟What prevents you from visiting us more than…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:65 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?" See 19:64

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:66 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And man (i.e., the disbeliever) says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?" And man says: When I am dead, shall I then be raised up alive? (19:66). Does not man remember that We created him before, while he was nothing (19:67). So by your Lord, surely We shall gather them together, and (also) the Shayatin, then We shall bring them round Hell, Jithyya (19:68). Then indeed We shall drag out from every sect all those who were worst in obstinate rebellion against the Most Gracious (19:69). Then, verily, We know best those who are most worthy of being burnt therein (19:70).Man's Amazement about Life after Death and the Refutation against this AmazementAllah, the Exalted, informs that mankind is amazed that he could be returned to life after death and he thinks that this is…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:67 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing? See 19:66

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:68 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.1 See 19:66

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:69 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence. See 19:66

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (He was told),1 "O Zakariyya, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be Yahya. We have not assigned to any before (this) name." (Allah said:) O Zakariyya! Verily, We give you the good news of a son, whose name will be Yahya. We have given that name to none before (him) (19:7).The Acceptance of His SupplicationThis statement implies what is not mentioned, that his supplication was answered. It was said to him:يَا زَكَرِيَّا إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَامٍ اسْمُهُ يَحْيَىٰ(Allah said:) "O Zakariyya! Verily, We give you the glad tidings of a son, whose name will be Yahya..."Similarly Allah, the Exalted, said;هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ - فَنَادَتْهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي فِي الْمِحْرَابِ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيَىٰ مُصَدِّقًا بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَسَيِّدًا وَحَصُورًا وَنَبِيًّا…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:70 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein. See 19:66

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:71 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And there is none of you except he will come to it.1 This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed. There is not one of you but will pass over it (Hell); this is with your Lord, a decree which must be accomplished (19:71). Then We shall save those who had Taqwa. And We shall leave the wrongdoers in it, Jithiyya (19:72).Everyone will be Brought to Hell, Then the Righteous will be SavedIbn Jarir reported from 'Abdullah that he said concerning Allah's statement:وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَاThere is not one of you but will pass over it."The bridge over Hell is like the sharp edge of a sword. The first group to cross it will pass like a flash of lightning. The second group will pass like the wind. The third group will pass like the fastest horse. The fourth group…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:72 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees. See 19:71

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:73 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of (our) two parties is best in position and best in association?"1 And when Our clear Ayat are recited to them, those who disbelieve say to those who believe: Which of the two groups has the best dwellings and the finest Nadiyyan? (19:73). And how many a generation have We destroyed before them, who were better in wealth, goods and outward appearance (19:74).The Disbelievers Boast over Their Good Fortune in the WorldAllah, the Exalted, informs that when the clear, evident Ayat of Allah are recited to the disbelievers, they reject them and turn away. They say about those who believe, while boasting to them and arguing that their false religion is correct:خَيْرٌ مَّقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّاbest dwellings and the finest Nadiyyan.This…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:74 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and (outward) appearance? See 19:73

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:75 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension (in wealth and time) until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment (in this world) or the Hour (of resurrection) - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers." Say: whoever is in error, the Most Gracious will extend (circumstances) for him, until, when they see that which they were promised, either the torment or the Hour, they will come to know who is worst in position, and who is weaker in forces (19:75).The Rebellious Person is Given Respite but He is Not ForgottenAllah, the Exalted, says:قُلْSayThis means, "O Muhammad, say to these people who are associating partners with their Lord, while claiming to follow the truth, that they are really following falsehood."مَن كَانَ فِي…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:76 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord1 for reward and better for recourse. And Allah increases in guidance those who walk aright. And the righteous good deeds that last are better with your Lord for reward and better for resort (19:76).Increasing Guidance of Those Who are GuidedAfter Allah mentions the extended time and respite that is allowed to those who are in misguidance, increasing them in misguidance, He informs of the increase in guidance of those who are rightly guided. Similarly He says:وَإِذَا مَا أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَقُولُ أَيُّكُمْ زَادَتْهُ هَٰذِهِ إِيمَانًاAnd whenever there comes down a Surah, some of them say: "Which of you has had his faith increased by it?" (9:124)And the following Ayah also shows this. Concerning Allah's statement:وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُAnd the righteous good deeds…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:77 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children (in the next life)"? Have you seen him who disbelieved in Our Ayat and said: I shall certainly be given wealth and children (if I live again) (19:77). Has he known the Unseen or has he taken a covenant from the Most Gracious (19:78). Nay, We shall record what he says, and We shall increase his torment (19:79). And We shall inherit from him all that he speaks of, and he shall come to Us alone (19:80).Refuting the Disbelievers Who Claim that They will be Given Wealth and Children in the HereafterImam Ahmad reported from Khabbab bin Al-Aratt that he said, I was a blacksmith and Al-'Ās bin Wa'il owed me a debt. So I went to him to collect…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:78 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise? See 19:77

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:79 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: No! We will record what he says and extend (i.e., increase) for him from the punishment extensively. See 19:77

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?" He said: My Lord! How can I have a son, when my wife is barren, and I have reached the extreme old age (19:8). He said: "Thus your Lord says: 'It is easy for Me. Certainly I have created you before, when you had been nothing!'") (19:8- (9)His Amazement after the Acceptance of His SupplicationZakariyya was amazed when his supplication was answered and he was given the good news of a son. He became extremely overjoyed and asked how this child would be born to him, and in what manner he would come. This was particularly amazing because his wife was an old woman who was barren and had not given birth to any children in her…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:80 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We will inherit him (in) what he mentions,1 and he will come to Us alone. See 19:77

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:81 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they have taken besides Allah (false) deities that they would be for them (a source of) honor. And they have taken gods besides Allah, that they might give them honor, power and glory (19:81). Nay, but they will deny their worship of them, and will become their adversaries (19:82). See you not that We have sent the Shayatin against the disbelievers to push them to do evil (19:83). So make no haste against them; We only count out to them a (limited) number (19:84).The Idols of the Polytheists will Deny Their WorshipAllah, the Exalted, informs about the disbelievers who associate partners with their Lord, that they have taken gods besides Allah, so that these gods may be a source of honor and might for them. They think that these gods give them power and make them victorious. Then, Allah…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:82 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: No! They (i.e., those "gods") will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents (on the Day of Judgement). See 19:81

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:83 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them (to evil) with (constant) incitement? See 19:81

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:84 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So be not impatient over them. We only count out (i.e., allow) to them a (limited) number.1 See 19:81

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:85 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation. The Day We shall gather those with Taqwa unto the Most Gracious (Allah), like a delegation (19:85). And We shall drive the criminals to Hell, in a thirsty state (19:86). None shall have the power of intercession, but such a one as has received permission (or promise) from the Most Gracious (Allah) (19:87).The Condition of the Righteous and the Criminals on the Day of ResurrectionAllah, the Exalted, informs about His righteous friends, who feared Him in the life of this world. They followed His Messengers and believed in what the Messengers told them. They obeyed them in what they commanded them and abstained from that which they prohibited. Allah explains that He will gather these people on the Day of Resurrection like a delegation that…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:86 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst. See 19:85

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:87 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: None will have (power of) intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.1 See 19:85

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:88 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken (for Himself) a son." And they say: The Most Gracious (Allah) has begotten a son (19:88). Indeed you have brought forth (said) a thing Idda (19:89). Whereby the heavens are almost torn, and the earth is split asunder, and the mountains Hadda (19:90). That they ascribe a son to the Most Gracious (19:91). But it is not suitable for the Most Gracious that He should beget a son (19:92). There is none in the heavens and the earth but comes unto the Most Gracious as a slave (19:93). Verily, He knows each one of them, and has counted them a full counting (19:94). And everyone of them will come to Him alone on the Day of Resurrection (19:95).The Stern Rejection of Attributing a Son to AllahAfter Allah affirms in this noble Surah…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:89 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: You have done an atrocious thing. See 19:88

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (An angel) said, "Thus (it will be); your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.'" See 19:8

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:90 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation. See 19:88

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:91 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son. See 19:88

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:92 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son. See 19:88

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:93 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant. See 19:88

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:94 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He has enumerated them and counted them a (full) counting. See 19:88

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:95 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone. See 19:88

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:96 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.1 Verily, those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, the Most Gracious will bestow love for them (19:96). So, We have made this easy in your own tongue, only that you may give glad tidings to those who have Taqwa, and warn with it the people that are Ludda (19:97). And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Can you find a single one of them or hear even a whisper of them (19:98).Allah Places Love of the Righteous People in the HeartsAllah, the Exalted, informs about His believing servants, who work righteous deeds – deeds that He is pleased with because they are in accordance with the legislation of Muhammad SAW – that He plants love for them in…

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:97 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So, (O Muḥammad), We have only made it (i.e., the Qur’ān) easy in your tongue (i.e., the Arabic language) that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people. See 19:96

item.title: bil-Quran: Maryam:98 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound? See 19:96

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Those who disbelieve and avert (people) from the way of Allah - He will waste their deeds.1 الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ - وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَآمَنُوا بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ ۙ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَأَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ - ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا اتَّبَعُوا الْبَاطِلَ وَأَنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّبَعُوا الْحَقَّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمْثَالَهُمْ1. Those who disbelieve and hinder (men) from the path of Allah, He will render their deeds vain. 2. But those who believe and do righteous good deeds, and believe in that which is sent down to Muhammad – for it is the truth from their Lord – He expiates from them their sins and amends their Bal. 3. That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, while those who believe follow the truth from their…

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allah destroyed (everything) over them,1 and for the disbelievers is something comparable. Have they not traveled through the earth and seen what happened in the end to those before them? Allah destroyed them completely, and a similar (awaits) the disbelievers (47:10). That is because Allah is the Protector of those who believe, whereas the disbelievers have no protector (47:11). Certainly Allah will admit those who believe and do righteous good deeds, into Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise); while those who disbelieve enjoy their life and eat as cattle eat; but the Fire will be their abode (47:12). And how many a town mightier than your town that has driven you out We have destroyed, with none to help them (47:13).Admonition and Fire…

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That is because Allah is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector. See 47:10

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, Allah will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them. See 47:10

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And how many a city was stronger than your city (i.e., Makkah) which drove you out? We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them. See 47:10

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their (own) desires? Can then he, who stands on clear evidence from his Lord, be like those for whom their evil deeds are beautified for them, while they follow their own lusts (47:14). The description of Paradise which is promised to those who have Taqwa, (is that) in it are rivers of water that are not Asin, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink it, and rivers of refined honey; and therein for them are all kinds of fruits, and forgiveness from their Lord. Can this be likened to those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink boiling water…

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered,1 rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all (kinds of) fruits and forgiveness from their Lord... (Are its inhabitants) like those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines? See 47:14

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And among them, (O Muḥammad), are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge,1 "What has he said just now?" Those are the ones of whom Allah has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their (own) desires. And among them are some who listen to you till when they go out from you, they say to those who have received knowledge: "What is it that he has said just now? "Such are men whose hearts Allah has sealed because they followed their lusts (47:16). And as for those who accept guidance, He increases them in guidance and bestows on them their Taqwa (47:17). Do they then await except that the Hour should come upon them suddenly? But already there have come (some of) its portents; and when…

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.1 See 47:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly? But already there have come (some of) its indications. Then how (i.e., what good) to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance? See 47:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So know, (O Muḥammad), that there is no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin1 and for the believing men and believing women. And Allah knows of your movement and your resting place. See 47:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muḥammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition. See 47:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Those who believe say, "Why has a sūrah1 not been sent down?" But when a precise sūrah is revealed and battle is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is disease (i.e., hypocrisy) looking at you with a look of one overcome by death. And more appropriate for them2 (would have been). Those who believe say: "Why is not a Surah sent down (for us)?" But now that a decisive Surah is sent down mentioning fighting, you can see those in whose hearts is disease (of hypocrisy) looking at you with the look of one who is about to faint for fear of death. But it was better for them (47:20). Obedience and good words. And when the matter is resolved, then if they had been true to Allah, it would have been better for them (47:21). So would…

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Obedience and good words. And when the matter (of fighting) was determined, if they had been true to Allah, it would have been better for them. See 47:20

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So would you perhaps, if you turned away,1 cause corruption on earth and sever your (ties of) relationship? See 47:20

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Those (who do so) are the ones that Allah has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision. See 47:20

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur’ān, or are there locks upon (their) hearts? Will they not then reflect upon the Qur'an, or are there locks upon their hearts (47:24). Verily, those who have turned back as disbelievers after guidance had become clear to them – Shaytan has enticed them and filled them with false hopes (47:25). That is because they said to those who hate what Allah has sent down: "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allah knows their secrets (47:26). Then how (will it be) when the angels will take their souls at death, striking their faces and their backs (47:27). That is because they followed that which angered Allah and hated what earns His pleasure, so He rendered their deeds worthless (47:28).The Command to Reflect upon the Qur'anCommanding the people to reflect…

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, those who reverted back (to disbelief) after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them. See 47:24

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That is because they said to those who disliked what Allah sent down,1 "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allah knows what they conceal. See 47:24

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then how (will it be) when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs? See 47:24

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That is because they followed what angered Allah and disliked (what earns) His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds. See 47:24

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allah would never expose their (feelings of) hatred? Or do those in whose hearts is a disease, think that Allah will not expose their ill–wills (47:29). Had We so willed, We could have shown them clearly to you, so that you would know them by their marks; but you will know them by the tone of their speech! And Allah knows (all) your deeds (47:30). And We will surely, try you until We know those who strive among you and the patient, and We will put to a test all your affairs (47:31).Exposing the Hidden Secret of the HypocritesAllah says:أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ أَنْ لَنْ يُخْرِجَ اللَّهُ أَضْغَانَهُمْOr do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allah would never expose their ill–wills?Meaning: do the hypocrites think that…

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allah present to the people their comparisons.1 See 47:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of (their) speech. And Allah knows your deeds. See 47:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you (for the cause of Allah) and the patient, and We will test your affairs. See 47:29

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted (people) from the path of Allah and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them - never will they harm Allah at all, and He will render worthless their deeds. Verily, those who disbelieve, and hinder from the path of Allah, and oppose the Messenger, after the guidance has been clearly shown to them, they will not harm Allah in the least, but He will make their deeds fruitless (47:32). O you who believe! Obey Allah, and obey the Messenger and invalidate not your deeds (47:33). Verily, those who disbelieved and obstructed others from the path of Allah and then died as disbelievers – never will Allah not forgive them (47:34). So do not lose heart and beg for peace while you are superior. Allah is with you and He will never…

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who have believed, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds. See 47:32

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted (people) from the path of Allah and then died while they were disbelievers - never will Allah forgive them. See 47:32

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:35 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allah is with you and will never deprive you of (the reward of) your deeds. See 47:32

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (This) worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and fear Allah, He will give you your rewards and not ask you for your properties. This worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and have Taqwa of Allah, He will grant you your rewards, and will not ask from you (to sacrifice all of) your possessions (47:36). If He would demand of you all of it and urge you, you would withhold. And He will expose your (secret) ill–wills (47:37). Here you are now invited to spend in Allah's cause; but among you are those who withhold (stingily). And whoever acts stingily is but stingy toward himself. For Allah is indeed free of needs, while you are the needy. And if you turn away, He will replace you with other people; then they…

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your hatred (i.e., unwillingness). See 47:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:38 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of Allah - but among you are those who withhold (out of greed). And whoever withholds only withholds (benefit) from himself; and Allah is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away (i.e., refuse), He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you. See 47:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So when you meet those who disbelieve (in battle), strike (their) necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure (their) bonds,1 and either (confer) favor2 afterwards or ransom (them) until the war lays down its burdens.3 That (is the command). And if Allah had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them (Himself), but (He ordered armed struggle) to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allah - never will He waste their deeds. So, when you meet those who disbelieve (in battle), smite (their) necks until you have fully defeated them, then tighten their bonds. Thereafter (is the time) either for generosity or ransom, until the war lays down its burden. Thus, and had Allah so willed, He could have taken vengeance against them;–but (He lets…

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He will guide them and amend their condition. See 47:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them. See 47:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: O you who have believed, if you support Allah, He will support you and plant firmly your feet. See 47:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds. See 47:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Muhammad:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That is because they disliked what Allah revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds. See 47:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, We sent Nuh to his people, (saying), "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment." أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُThat you should worship Allah, and have Taqwa of Him,Meaning: 'abandon those things that He has forbidden and avoid that which He has declared to be sinful.'وَأَطِيعُونِand obey me,'In that which I command you to do and that which I forbid you from.'يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِنْ ذُنُوبِكُمْHe will forgive you of your sinsMeaning: 'if you do what I command you to do and you believe in what I have been sent with to you, then Allah will forgive you for your sins.'وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّىand respite you to an appointed term.Meaning: 'He will extend your life span and protect you from the torment that He would have made befall you if you did not stay away from His prohibitions.'…

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver. See 71:5

item.description: He will send (rain from) the sky upon you in (continuing) showers. See 71:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers. See 71:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: What is (the matter) with you that you do not attribute to Allah (due) grandeur. See 71:5

item.description: While He has created you in stages?1 See 71:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers.1 See 71:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And made the moon therein a (reflected) light and made the sun a burning lamp? See 71:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a (progressive) growth. See 71:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then He will return you into it and extract you (another) extraction. See 71:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse. See 71:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner. See 71:1

item.description: That you may follow therein roads of passage.'" See 71:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Nuh said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. Nuh said: "My Lord! They have disobeyed me, and followed one whose wealth and children give him no increase but loss (71:21). "And they have plotted a mighty plot (71:22). "And they have said: 'You shall not leave your gods, nor shall you leave Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth, and Ya'uq and Nasr.' (71:23). "And indeed they have led many astray. And (O Allah): 'Grant no increase to the wrongdoers save error.' (71:24).Nuh Complains to His Lord about His People's ResponseAllah says that Nuh turned to Allah to inform Allah - the All Knowing from Whom nothing escapes - that he presented the clear call, as mentioned previously, and the comprehensive invitation in various ways. He called…

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they conspired an immense conspiracy. See 71:21

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwāʿ or Yaghūth and Yaʿūq and Nasr.'1 See 71:21

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And already they have misled many. And, (my Lord), do not increase the wrongdoers except in error." See 71:21

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah (any) helpers. Because of their sins they were drowned, then were made to enter the Fire. And they found none to help them instead of Allah (71:25). And Nuh said: "My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers on the earth Dayyar! (71:26). "If You leave them, they will mislead Your servants, and they will beget none but wicked disbelievers (71:27). "My Lord! Forgive me, and my parents, and him who enters my home as a believer, and all the believing men and women. And to the wrongdoers grant You no increase but destruction!") Allah say (71:28).مِمَّا خَطِيئَاتِهِمْBecause of their sinsIt also has been recited as;(خَطَايَاهُمْ)their errors.أُغْرِقُواthey were drowned,Meaning: for their numerous sins, rebellion, persistence in disbelief and opposition to…

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And Nuh said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant. See 71:25

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except (every) wicked one and (confirmed) disbeliever. See 71:25

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction." See 71:25

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: To worship Allah, fear Him and obey me. See 71:1

item.description: He (i.e., Allah) will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time (set by) Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew." See 71:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people (to truth) night and day. He said: O my Lord! Verily, I have called to my people night and day (71:5). But all my calling added nothing but to (their) flight (71:6). And verily, every time I called unto them that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, and persisted, and magnified themselves in pride (71:7). Then verily, I called to them openly (aloud) (71:8). Then verily, I proclaimed to them in public, and I have appealed to them in private (71:9). I said (to them): Ask forgiveness from your Lord, verily, He is Oft-Forgiving (71:10). He will send rain to you Midrar (71:11). And give you increase in wealth and children, and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you…

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But my invitation increased them not except in flight (i.e., aversion). See 71:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments,1 persisted, and were arrogant with (great) arrogance. See 71:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then I invited them publicly. See 71:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Nooh:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then I announced to them and (also) confided to them secretly. See 71:5

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Qāf.1 By the honored Qur’ān...2 بَلْ كَذَّبُوا بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِي أَمْرٍ مَرِيجٍNay, but they have denied the truth when it has come to them, so they are in a Marij state.This is the state of all those who defy the Truth: whatever they say and utter after denying the Truth, is utterly false. Marij means, in disarray, in a confused state and defying the characteristics of the Truth. Allah the Exalted said in another Ayah:إِنَّكُمْ لَفِي قَوْلٍ مُخْتَلِفٍ - يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَCertainly, you have different ideas. Turned aside therefrom is he who is turned aside. (51:8-9)

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers. See 50:6

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence (i.e., resurrection). See 50:6

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The people of Nuh denied before them,1 and the companions of the well2 and Thamūd. Denied before them the people of Nuh, and the Dwellers of Rass, and Thamud (50:12). And 'Ad, and Fir'awn, and the brethren of Lut (50:13). And the Dwellers of Al-Aykah, and the people of Tubba'. Everyone of them denied (their) Messengers, so My threat took effect (50:14). Were We then tired with the first creation? Nay, they are in confused doubt about a new creation (50:15).Reminding the Quraysh of the Destruction of Earlier Disbelieving NationsAllah the Exalted warns the disbelievers of Quraysh and reminds them of the punishment and painful torment that He sent in this life on their likes, who disbelieved before them. For instance, Allah the Exalted punished the people of Nuh by drowning them in the encompassing flood that touched all the…

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers (i.e., people) of Lut. See 50:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled. See 50:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation. See 50:12
