item.description: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer1 to him than (his) jugular vein. And indeed We have created man, and We know what his self whispers to him. And We are nearer to him than his jugular vein (50:16). (Remember) that the two receivers (recording angels) receive (each human being), one sitting on the right and one on the left (50:17). Not a word does he (or she) utter but there is a watcher by him ready (to record it) (50:18). And the stupor of death will come in truth: "This is what you have been avoiding! (50:19). And the Trumpet will be blown – that will be the Day of the threat (50:20). And every person will come forth along with a Sa'iq and a Shahid (50:21). (It…

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: When the two receivers (i.e., recording angels) receive,1 seated on the right and on the left. See 50:16

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He (i.e., man) utters no word except that with him is an observer prepared (to record). See 50:16

item.description: And his companion, (the angel), will say, "This (record) is what is with me, prepared." And his companion (angel) will say: Here is (his record) ready with me! (50:23). (Allah will say to the angels:) "Both of you throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever (50:24). "Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter, (50:25). "Who set up another god with Allah. Then both of you cast him in the severe torment (50:26). His companion (devil) will say: "Our Lord! I did not push him to transgression, but he was himself in error far astray (50:27). (Allah) will say: "Dispute not in front of Me, I had already in advance sent you the threat (50:28). "The sentence that comes from Me cannot be changed, and I am not unjust to the servants (50:29). The Angel will bear Witness; Allah commands that the Disbeliever be…

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Allah will say), "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever. See 50:23

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter. See 50:23

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Who made (as equal) with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment." See 50:23

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: His (devil) companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he (himself) was in extreme error." See 50:23

item.description: (Allah) will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat (i.e., warning). See 50:23

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The word (i.e., decree) will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants." See 50:23

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: When we have died and have become dust, (we will return to life)? That is a distant (i.e., unlikely) return." See 50:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more." On the Day when We will say to Hell: "Are you filled?" It will say: "Are there any more? (50:30). And Paradise will be Uzlifat to those who had Taqwa, not far off (50:31). (It will be said): "This is what you were promised – (it is) for those returning in sincere repentance, and Hafiz (50:32). "Who feared Ar-Rahman unseen and brought a heart turned in repentance (50:33). "Enter you therein in peace and security – this is a Day of eternal life! (50:34). There they will have all that they desire – and We have more (50:35).Jahannam and Paradise and their DwellersAllah states that He will say to Jahannam on the Day of Resurrection, "Have you had your fill?"…

item.description: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far. See 50:30

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (It will be said), "This is what you were promised - for every returner (to Allah) and keeper (of His covenant). See 50:30

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Who feared the Most Merciful in the unseen and came with a heart returning (in repentance). See 50:30

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity." See 50:30
