item.description: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more. See 50:30

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in (striking) power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape? And how many a generation We have destroyed before them who were stronger in power than they. And they went about the land! Could they find any place of refuge (50:36). Verily, therein is indeed a reminder for him who has a heart or gives ear while he is heedful (50:37). And indeed We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in six Days and nothing of fatigue touched Us (50:38). So bear with patience all that they say, and glorify the praises of your Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting (50:39). And during a part of the night (also) glorify His…

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present (in mind). See 50:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:38 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness. See 50:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:39 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So be patient, (O Muḥammad), over what they say and exalt (Allah) with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting. See 50:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: We know what the earth diminishes (i.e., consumes) of them, and with Us is a retaining record. See 50:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:40 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (in part) of the night exalt Him and after prostration (i.e., prayer). See 50:36

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:41 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And listen on the Day when the Caller1 will call out from a place that is near. And listen on the Day when the caller will call from a near place (50:41). The Day when they will hear As-Sayhah in truth, that will be the Day of coming out (50:42). Verily, it is We Who give life and cause death; and to Us is the final return (50:43). On the Day when the earth shall be cleft, from off them (they will come out) hastening forth. That will be a gathering, quite easy for Us (50:44). We know best what they say. And you are not the one to force them. But warn by the Qur'an; him who fears My threat (50:45).Admonition from Some Scenes of the Day of ResurrectionAllah the Exalted said:وَاسْتَمِعْAnd listen'O Muhammad,'يَوْمَ يُنَادِ الْمُنَادِ مِنْ مَكَانٍ قَرِيبٍon…

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:42 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The Day they will hear the blast (of the Horn) in truth. That is the Day of Emergence (from the graves). See 50:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:43 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination. See 50:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:44 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: On the Day the earth breaks away from them (and they emerge) rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us. See 50:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:45 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant.1 But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat. See 50:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition. See 50:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and (how) it has no rifts? Have they not looked at the heaven above them, how We have made it and adorned it, and there are no Furuj in it (50:6). And the earth! We have spread it out, and set thereon Rawasi standing firm, and We planted in it every lovely (Bahij) pair (50:7). An insight and a Reminder for every servant who turns to Allah in repentance (50:8). And We send down blessed water (rain) from the sky, then We produce therewith Jannat and grain that are reaped (50:9). And date palms Basiqat, with arranged clusters (50:10). A provision for the servants. And We give life therewith to a dead land. Thus will be the Resurrection (50:11).Allah's Power and Ability over…

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein (something) of every beautiful kind. See 50:6

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns (to Allah). See 50:6

item.title: bil-Quran: Qaaf:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest. See 50:6

item.title: bil-Quran: Quraish:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh1. الَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍWho has fed them against hunger,Meaning: He is the Lord of the House and He is the One Who feeds them against hunger.وَآمَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍAnd has made them safe from fear.Meaning: He favors them with safety and gentleness, so they should single Him out for worship alone, without any partner. They should not worship any idol, rival or statue besides Him. Therefore, whoever accepts this command, Allah will give him safety in both this life and the Hereafter. However, whoever disobeys Him, He will remove both of them from him. This is as Allah says:وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا قَرْيَةً كَانَتْ آمِنَةً مُّطْمَئِنَّةً يَأْتِيهَا رِزْقُهَا رَغَدًا مِّن كُلِّ مَكَانٍ فَكَفَرَتْ بِأَنْعُمِ اللَّهِ فَأَذَاقَهَا اللَّهُ لِبَاسَ الْجُوعِ وَالْخَوْفِ بِمَا كَانُوا يَصْنَعُونَ - وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَAnd Allah puts…

item.title: bil-Quran: Quraish:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Their accustomed security (in) the caravan of winter and summer1. See 106:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Quraish:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Let them worship the Lord of this House.1 See 106:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Quraish:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Who has fed them, (saving them) from hunger and made them safe, (saving them) from fear. See 106:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Ṣād.1 By the Qur’ān containing reminder...2 كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍHow many a generation have We destroyed before them!Meaning: disbelieving nations.فَنَادَوْاAnd they cried outmeans, when the punishment came to them, they called for help and cried out to Allah, but that did not save them at all. This is like the Ayat:فَلَمَّا أَحَسُّوا بَأْسَنَا إِذَا هُمْ مِنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ - لَا تَرْكُضُوا وَارْجِعُوا إِلَىٰ مَا أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَاكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْأَلُونَThen, when they perceived (saw) Our torment, behold, they (tried to) flee from it. Flee not, but return to that wherein you lived a luxurious life, and to your homes, in order that you may be questioned. (21:12-13)Abu Dawud At-Tayalisi recorded that At-Tamimi said, I asked Ibn 'Abbas (RA), about the Ayah:فَنَادَوْا وَلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍAnd they cried out when there was no longer time for escape.He said that it was not…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through (any) ways of access.1 See 38:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (They are but) soldiers (who will be) defeated there among the companies (of disbelievers). See 38:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The people of Nuh denied before them, and (the tribe of) ʿAad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes.1 Before them denied – the people of Nuh; and 'Ad; and Fir'awn the man of stakes (38:12). And Thamud, and the people of Lut, and the Dwellers of Al-Aykah; such were the Confederates (38:13). Not one of them but denied the Messengers; therefore My torment was justified (38:14). And these only wait for a single Sayhah there will be no pause or ending thereto (38:15). They say: Our Lord! Hasten to us Qittana before the Day of Reckoning! (38:16). Be patient of what they say.. () A Reminder of Those Who were destroyed among the Previous Nations Allah tells us about those past nations and the punishment and vengeance that struck them for their going against the Messengers and disbelieving in the…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (the tribe of) Thamūd and the people of Lut and the companions of the thicket (i.e., people of Madyan). Those are the companies.1 See 38:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified. See 38:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And these (disbelievers) await not but one blast (of the Horn); for it there will be no delay.1 See 38:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share (of the punishment) before the Day of Account." See 38:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, Dawud, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back (to Allah). And remember Our slave Dawud, endued with Al-Ayd. Verily, he was ever oft-returning in all matters and in repentance (38:17). Verily, We made the mountains to glorify Our praises with him in the 'Ashi and Ishraq (38:18). And (so did) the birds assembled, all obedient to him (38:19). We made his kingdom strong and gave him Al-Hikmah and sound judgement in speech and decision (38:20).Dawud (AS)Allah Tells us that His Servant and Messenger Dawud (AS), was Endued with Power. Al-Ayd Means Strength in Knowledge and Action. Ibn 'Abbas (RA), As-Suddi and Ibn Zayd Said, "Al-Ayd Means Strength."Mujahid said, "Al-Ayd means strength in obedience to Allah." Qatadah said, "Dawud (AS), was given strength in worship and…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, We subjected the mountains (to praise) with him, exalting (Allah) in the (late) afternoon and (after) sunrise. See 38:17

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating (praises). See 38:17

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension. See 38:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech. See 38:17

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of (his) prayer chamber. And has the news of the litigants reached you? When they climbed over the wall into (his) Mihrab (private chamber of worship) (38:21). When they entered in upon Dawud, he was terrified of them. They said: "Fear not! (We are) two litigants, one of us has wronged the other, therefore judge between us with truth, and treat us not with injustice, and guide us to the right way (38:22). Verily, this my brother (in religion) has ninety-nine ewes, while I have (only) one ewe, and he says: "Hand it over to me, and he overpowered me in speech (38:23). (Dawud) said: "He has wronged you in demanding your ewe in addition to his ewes. And, verily, many partners oppress…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: When they entered upon Dawud and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. (We are) two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed (it) and guide us to the sound path. See 38:21

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech." See 38:21

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Dawud) said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe (in addition) to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And Dawud became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord1 and fell down bowing (in prostration) and turned in repentance (to Allah). See 38:21

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return. See 38:21

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (We said), "O Dawud, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow (your own) desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account. O Dawud! Verily, We have placed you as a successor on the earth; so judge you between men in truth (and justice) and follow not your desire – for it will mislead you from the path of Allah. Verily, those who wander astray from the path of Allah (shall) have a severe torment, because they forgot the Day of Reckoni (38:26).Advice to Rulers and LeadersThis is advice from Allah, may He be exalted, to those who are in positions…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire. And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them without purpose! That is the consideration of those who disbelieve! Then woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire (38:27). Shall We treat those who believe and do righteous good deeds as those who cause mischief on the earth? Or shall We treat those who have Taqwa as the evildoers (38:28). (This is) a Book which We have sent down to you, full of blessings, that they may ponder over its Verses, and that men of understanding may remember (38:29).The Wisdom behind the Creation of This WorldAllah tells us that He did not…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or should We treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked? See 38:27

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (This is) a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, (O Muḥammad), that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded. See 38:27

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they (then) called out; but it was not a time for escape. See 38:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And to Dawud We gave Sulayman. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back (to Allah). And to Dawud We gave Sulayman. How excellent a servant! Verily, he was ever turning in repentance (to Us) (38:30). When there were displayed before him, in the afternoon, well trained horses of the highest breed (38:31). He said: "I did love the good instead of remembering my Lord," till the time was over, and (the sun) had hidden in the veil (of night) (38:32). Then he said: "Bring them back to me." Then he began to pass his hand over their legs and their necks (38:33).Sulayman the Son of DawudAllah tells us that he gave Sulayman to Dawud as a Prophet, as He says elsewhere:وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَانُ دَاوُودَ ۖAnd Sulayman inherited Dawud (27:16)Meaning, he inherited prophethood from him. Dawud had other sons…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Mention) when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised (standing) racehorses. See 38:30

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good (things) over the remembrance of my Lord until it (i.e., the sun) disappeared into the curtain (of darkness)." See 38:30

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (He said), "Return them to me," and set about striking1 (their) legs and necks. See 38:30

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We certainly tried Sulayman and placed on his throne a body;1 then he returned.2 And indeed, We tried Sulayman and We placed on his throne Jasad (a body), and he returned (38:34). He said: "My Lord! Forgive me, and bestow upon me a kingdom such as shall not belong to any other after me. Verily, You are the Bestower (38:35). So, We subjected to him the wind; it blew gently by his order wherever he willed (38:36). And the Shayatin, from every kind of builder and diver (38:37). And also others bound in fetters (38:38). (Allah said to Sulayman): "This is Our gift, so spend you or withhold, no account will be asked of you (38:39). And verily, for him is a near access to Us, and a good (final) return (38:40).How Allah Tested Sulayman Then Made Things Easy…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:35 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower." See 38:34

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed. See 38:34

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (also) the devils (of jinn) - every builder and diver. See 38:34

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:38 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And others bound together in irons. See 38:34

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:39 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (We said), "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account." See 38:34

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner (i.e., Prophet Muḥammad SAW) from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar. And they wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say: "This is a sorcerer, a liar (38:4). "Has he made the gods into One God. Verily, this is a curious thing! (38:5). And the leaders among them went about (saying): "Go on, and remain constant to your gods! Verily, this is a thing designed! (38:6). "We have not heard (the like) of this in the religion of these later days. This is nothing but an invention! (38:7). "Has the Reminder been sent down to him (alone) from among us?" Nay, but they are in doubt about My Reminder! Nay, but they have not tasted…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:40 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return. See 38:34

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:41 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And remember Our servant Ayyub, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." And remember Our servant Ayyub, when he invoked his Lord (saying): "Verily, Shaytan has afflicted me with distress and torment! (38:41). (Allah said to him): "Strike the ground with your foot. This is (a spring of) water to wash in, cool and a drink (38:42). And We gave him (back) his family, and along with them the like thereof, as a mercy from Us, and a reminder for those who understand (38:43). "And take in your hand a bundle of thin grass and strike therewith (your wife), and break not your oath." Truly, We found him patient. How excellent a servant! Verily, he was ever oft-returning in repentance (to Us) (38:44).AyyubHere Allah tells us about His servant and Messenger Ayyub…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:42 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (So he was told), "Strike (the ground) with your foot; this is a (spring for a) cool bath and drink." See 38:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:43 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We granted him his family and a like (number) with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding. See 38:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:44 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (We said), "And take in your hand a bunch (of grass) and strike with it and do not break your oath."1 Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back (to Allah). See 38:41

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:45 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And remember Our servants, Ibrahim, Ishaq and Ya'qub - those of strength and (religious) vision. And remember Our servants, Ibrahim, Ishaq, and Ya'qub, Ulil-Aydi wal-Absar (38:45). Verily, We did choose them by granting them the remembrance of the Abode (38:46). And they are with Us, verily, of the chosen and the best (38:47). And remember Ismail, Alyasa, and Dhul-Kifli, all are among the best (38:48). This is a Reminder.. ()The Chosen and the Best among the ProphetsAllah tells us about the virtues of His servants the Messengers and His Prophets:وَاذْكُرْ عِبَادَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُولِي الْأَيْدِي وَالْأَبْصَارِAnd remember Our servants, Ibrahim, Ishaq, and Ya'qub, Ulil-Aydi wal-Absar.Meaning: righteous deeds, beneficial knowledge, strength in worship and insight. Ali bin Abi Talhah reported that Ibn 'Abbas (RA), said:أُولِي الْأَيْدِيUlil-AydiOf great strength and worship;وَالْأَبْصَارِwal-Absarmeans, understanding of the religion. Qatadah and As-Suddi said, "They were…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:46 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home (of the Hereafter). See 38:45

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:47 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding. See 38:45

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:48 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And remember Ismail, Alyasa and Dhul-Kifli, and all are among the outstanding. See 38:45

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:49 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return. And verily, for those who have Taqwa is a good final return (38:49). 'Adn Paradise, whose doors will be opened for them (38:50). Therein they will recline; therein they will call for fruits in abundance and drinks (38:51). And beside them will be Qasirat-at-Tarf, (and) of equal ages (38:52). This it is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning (38:53). (It will be said to them)! Verily, this is Our provision which will never finish (38:54).The Final Return of the BlessedAllah tells us that His blessed, believing servants will have a good final return in the Hereafter, which means their ultimate destination. Then He explains it further, as He says:جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ'Adn GardensMeaning: eternal gardens (of Paradise):مُفَتَّحَةً لَهُمُ الْأَبْوَابُwhose doors will be opened for…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Has he made the gods (only) one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing." See 38:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:50 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them. See 38:49

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:51 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink. See 38:49

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:52 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And with them will be women limiting (their) glances1 and of equal age. See 38:49

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:53 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: This is what you, (the righteous), are promised for the Day of Account. See 38:49

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:54 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion. See 38:49

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:55 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: This (is so). But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return. This is so! And for the Taghin will be an evil final return (38:55). Hell! Where they will enter it, and worst (indeed) is that place to rest (38:56). This is so! Then let them taste it - Hamim and Ghassaq (38:57). And other of similar kind - all together (38:58). This is a troop entering with you (in Hell), no welcome for them! Verily, they shall enter in the Fire (38:59). (The followers will say to those who misled): "Nay, you (too)! No welcome for you! It is you who brought this upon us, so evil is this place to stay in! (38:60). They will say: "Our Lord! Whoever brought this upon us, add to him a double torment in the Fire! (38:61). And they…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:56 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Hell, which they will (enter to) burn, and wretched is the resting place. See 38:55

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:57 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and (foul) purulence. See 38:55

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:58 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And other (punishments) of its type (in various) kinds. See 38:55

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:59 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Its inhabitants will say), "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire." See 38:55

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the eminent among them went forth, (saying), "Continue, and be patient over (the defense of) your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.1 See 38:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:60 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, (our leaders), brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement." See 38:55

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:61 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire." See 38:55

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:62 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?1 See 38:55

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:63 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Is it (because) we took them in ridicule, or has (our) vision turned away from them?" See 38:55

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:64 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, that is truth (i.e., reality) - the quarreling of the people of the Fire. See 38:55

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:65 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, (O Muḥammad), "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing.1 Say: "I am only a warner and there is no God (worthy of worship) except Allah the One, the Irresistible, (38:65). "The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Almighty, the Oft-Forgiving (38:66). Say: "That is a great news, (38:67). "From which you turn away! (38:68). "I had no knowledge of the chiefs (angels) on high when they were disputing and discussing (38:69). "Only this has been revealed to me, that I am a plain warner (38:70).The Message of the Messenger SAW is a Great NewsAllah tells His Messenger SAW to say to those who disbelieved in Allah, associated others in worship with Him and denied His Messenger: 'I am a warner, I…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:66 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might,1 the Perpetual Forgiver."2 See 38:65

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:67 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "It is great news. See 38:65

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:68 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: From which you turn away. See 38:65

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:69 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly (of angels) when they were disputing (the creation of Adam). See 38:65

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: We have not heard of this in the latest religion.1 This is not but a fabrication. See 38:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:70 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner." See 38:65

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:71 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (So mention) when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay. (Remember) when your Lord said to the angels: Truly, I am going to create man from clay (38:71). "So, when I have fashioned him and breathed into him (his) soul created by Me, then you fall down prostrate to him (38:72). So, the angels prostrated themselves, all of them (38:73). Except Iblis, he was proud and was one of the disbelievers (38:74). (Allah) said: "O Iblis! What prevents you from prostrating yourself to one whom I have created with Both My Hands. Are you too proud or are you one of the high exalted? (38:75). (Iblis) said: "I am better than he. You created me from fire, and You created him from clay (38:76). (Allah) said: "Then get out from…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:72 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My (created) soul,1 then fall down to him in prostration." See 38:71

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:73 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely. See 38:71

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:74 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Except Iblees;1 he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers. See 38:71

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:75 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Allah) said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands?1 Were you arrogant (then), or were you (already) among the haughty?" See 38:71

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:76 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay." See 38:71

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:77 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Allah) said, "Then get out of it (i.e., Paradise), for indeed, you are expelled. See 38:71

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:78 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense." See 38:71

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:79 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected." See 38:71

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Has the message been revealed to him out of (all of) us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment. See 38:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:80 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Allah) said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved. See 38:71

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:81 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Until the Day of the time well-known." See 38:71

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:82 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Iblees) said, "By Your might, I will surely mislead them all. See 38:71

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:83 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Except, among them, Your chosen servants." See 38:71

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:84 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Allah) said, "The truth (is My oath), and the truth I say. See 38:71

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:85 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (That) I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together." See 38:71

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:86 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, (O Muḥammad), "I do not ask you for it (i.e., the Qur’ān) any payment, and I am not of the pretentious. Say: No wage do I ask of you for this, nor am I one of the Mutakallifin (38:86). "It is only a Reminder for all the creatures (38:87). "And you shall certainly know the truth of it after a while (38:88). Allah says: 'Say, O Muhammad, to these idolators: I do not ask you to give me any reward from the goods of this world in return for the Message which I convey to you and the sincere advice I offer.'وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَnor am I one of the Mutakallifin.means, 'and I do not add anything to that which Allah has told me. Whatever I am commanded to do, I do it, and I do not add anything…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:87 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: It is but a reminder to the worlds. See 38:86

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:88 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And you will surely know (the truth of) its information after a time." See 38:86

item.title: bil-Quran: Saad:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?1 See 38:4

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (All) praise is (due) to Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and to Him belongs (all) praise in the Hereafter. And He is the Wise, the Aware. يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَاHe knows that which goes into the earth and that which comes forth from it,Meaning: He knows the number of raindrops that sink into the depths of the earth, and the seeds that have been sown, and the things that are hidden in it, and He knows what comes forth from that, how many they are, how they grow and what they look like.وَمَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِand that which descends from the heavenmeans, of raindrops and provision, and what ascends into it, i.e., righteous deeds and other things.وَهُوَ الرَّحِيمُ الْغَفُورُAnd He is the Most Merciful, the Oft-Forgiving.means,…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We certainly gave Dawud from Us bounty. (We said), "O mountains, repeat (Our) praises with him, and the birds (as well)." And We made pliable for him iron. And indeed We bestowed grace on Dawud from Us (saying): "O you mountains! Glorify with him! And you birds (also)! And We made the iron soft for him (34:10). Saying: "Make you perfect coats of mail, and balance well the rings of chain armor (Sard), and work you (men) righteousness. Truly, I am All-Seer of what you do (34:11).The Favors which Allah Bestowed upon DawudHere Allah tells us how He blessed His servant and Messenger Dawud (AS), and what He gave him of His great bounty, giving him both prophethood and kingship, and huge numbers of troops. And he blessed him with a mighty voice. Such that when he glorified Allah,…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Commanding him), "Make full coats of mail and calculate (precisely) the links, and work (all of you) righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing." See 34:10

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And to Sulayman (We subjected) the wind - its morning (journey was that of) a month - and its afternoon (journey was that of) a month, and We made flow for him a spring of (liquid) copper. And among the jinn were those who worked for him by the permission of his Lord. And whoever deviated among them from Our command - We will make him taste of the punishment of the Blaze. And to Sulayman (We subjected) the wind, its morning was a month's (journey), and its afternoon was a month's (journey). And We caused a fount of Qitr to flow for him, and there were Jinn that worked in front of him, by the leave of his Lord. And whosoever of them turned aside from Our command, We shall cause him to taste of the torment of the…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They made for him what he willed of elevated chambers,1 statues,2 bowls like reservoirs, and stationary kettles. (We said), "Work, O family of Dawud, in gratitude." And few of My servants are grateful. See 34:12

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when We decreed for him (i.e., Sulayman) death, nothing indicated to them (i.e., the jinn) his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff.1 But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment.2 Then when We decreed death for him, nothing informed them (Jinn) of his death except a little worm of the earth which kept (slowly) gnawing away at his stick. So when he fell down, the Jinn saw clearly that if they had known the Unseen, they would not have stayed in the humiliating torment (34:14).The Death of SulaymanAllah tells us how Sulayman (AS), died and how Allah concealed his death from the Jinn who were subjugated to him to do hard labor. He remained leaning on his stick,…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: There was for (the tribe of) Saba’ in their dwelling place a sign: two (fields of) gardens on the right and on the left. (They were told), "Eat from the provisions of your Lord and be grateful to Him. A good land (have you), and a forgiving Lord." Indeed there was for Saba' a sign in their dwelling place – two gardens on the right and on the left; (and it was said to them:) "Eat of the provision of your Lord, and be grateful to Him." A fair land and an Oft-Forgiving Lord (34:15). But they turned away, so We sent against them flood released from the dam, and We converted their two gardens into gardens producing bitter bad fruit, and Athl, and some few lote trees (34:16). Like this We requited them because they were ungrateful disbelievers. And…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But they turned away (refusing), so We sent upon them the flood of the dam,1 and We replaced their two (fields of) gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. See 34:15

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (By) that We repaid them because they disbelieved. And do We (thus) repay except the ungrateful? See 34:15

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:18 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We placed between them and the cities which We had blessed1 (many) visible cities. And We determined between them the (distances of) journey,2 (saying), "Travel between them by night or by day in safety." And We placed, between them and the towns which We had blessed, towns easy to be seen, and We made the stages (of journey) between them easy (saying): Travel in them safely both by night and day (34:18). But they said: "Our Lord! Make the stages between our journey longer," and they wronged themselves; so We made them as tales (in the land), and We dispersed them all totally. Verily, in this are indeed signs for every steadfast, grateful (person) (34:19). The Trade of Saba' and Their Destruction Allah tells us about the blessings which the people of Saba' enjoyed, and the luxuries and plentiful…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:19 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But (insolently) they said, "Our Lord, lengthen the distance between our journeys," and wronged themselves, so We made them narrations1 and dispersed them in total dispersion. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful. See 34:18

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:2 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein. And He is the Merciful, the Forgiving. See 34:1

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:20 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And Iblees had already confirmed through them1 his assumption,2 so they followed him, except for a party of believers. And indeed Iblis did prove true his thought about them, and they followed him, all except a group of true believers (34:20). And he had no authority over them, – except that We might test him who believes in the Hereafter, from him who is in doubt about it. And your Lord is Watchful over everything (34:21).How Iblis' Thought about the Disbeliever Proved TrueHaving mentioned Saba' and how they followed their desires, and the Shaytan, Allah tells us about their counterparts among those who follow Iblis and their own desires, and who go against wisdom and true guidance. Allah says:وَلَقَدْ صَدَّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِبْلِيسُ ظَنَّهُAnd indeed Iblis did prove true his thought about them,Ibn 'Abbas (RA), and others said that this Ayah…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:21 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And he had over them no authority except (it was decreed) that We might make evident who believes in the Hereafter from who is thereof in doubt. And your Lord, over all things, is Guardian.1 See 34:20

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:22 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, (O Muḥammad), "Invoke those you claim (as deities) besides Allah." They do not possess an atom's weight (of ability) in the heavens or on the earth, and they do not have therein any partnership (with Him), nor is there for Him from among them any assistant. Say: Call upon those whom you assert besides Allah, they possess not even the weight of a speck of dust, either in the heavens or on the earth, nor have they any share in either, nor there is for Him any supporter from among them (34:22). Intercession with Him profits not except for him whom He permits. So much so that when fear is banished from their hearts, they say: "What is it that your Lord has said?" They say the truth. And He is the Most High, the Most Great (34:23). The…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:23 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And intercession does not benefit with Him except for one whom He permits. (And those wait) until, when terror is removed from their hearts,1 they will say (to one another), "What has your Lord said?" They will say, "The truth." And He is the Most High, the Grand. See 34:22

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:24 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?" Say, "Allah. And indeed, we or you are either upon guidance or in clear error." Say: "Who gives you provision from the heavens and the earth?" Say: "Allah. And verily, (either) we or you are rightly guided or in plain error (34:24). Say: "You will not be asked about our sins, nor shall we be asked of what you do (34:25). Say: "Our Lord will assemble us all together, then He will judge between us with truth. And He is the Just Judge, the All-Knower of the true state of affairs (34:26). Say: "Show me those whom you have joined with Him as partners. Nay! But He is Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise (34:27).Allah has no partner in anything whatsoeverAllah tells us that He is unique in His power…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:25 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "You will not be asked about what we committed, and we will not be asked about what you do." See 34:24

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:26 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Our Lord will bring us together; then He will judge between us in truth. And He is the Knowing Judge."1 See 34:24

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:27 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Show me those whom you have attached to Him as partners. No! Rather, He (alone) is Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise." See 34:24

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:28 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We have not sent you except comprehensively1 to mankind as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. But most of the people do not know. And We have not sent you except as a giver of glad tidings and a warner to all mankind, and most of men know not (34:28). And they say: "When is this promise if you are truthful? (34:29). Say: "The appointment to you is for a Day, which you cannot put back for an hour nor put forward (34:30).The Prophet SAW was Sent to All of MankindAllah says to His servant and Messenger Muhammad SAW:وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا كَافَّةً لِلنَّاسِ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًاAnd We have not sent you except as a giver of glad tidings and a warner to all mankind,i.e., to all of creation among those who are accountable for their deeds. This is…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:29 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?" See 34:28

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:3 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But those who disbelieve say, "The Hour will not come to us." Say, "Yes, by my Lord, it will surely come to you. (Allah is) the Knower of the unseen." Not absent from Him is an atom's weight1 within the heavens or within the earth or (what is) smaller than that or greater, except that it is in a clear register. Those who disbelieve say: The Hour will not come to us." Say: "Yes, by my Lord, the All-Knower of the Unseen, it will come to you; not even the weight of a speck of dust or less than that or greater escapes His knowledge in the heavens or in the earth but it is in a Clear Book (34:3). That He may recompense those who believe and do righteous good deeds. Those, theirs is forgiveness and generous provision (34:4).…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:30 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "For you is the appointment of a Day (when) you will not remain thereafter an hour, nor will you precede (it)." See 34:28

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:31 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those who disbelieve say, "We will never believe in this Qur’ān nor in that before it." But if you could see when the wrongdoers are made to stand before their Lord, refuting each others' words...1 Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "If not for you, we would have been believers." And those who disbelieve say: "We believe not in this Qur'an nor in that which was before it." But if you could see when the wrongdoers are made to stand before their Lord, how they will cast the (blaming) word one to another! Those who were deemed weak will say to those who were arrogant: "Had it not been for you, we should certainly have been believers! (34:31). And those who were arrogant will say to those who were deemed weak: "Did we keep…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:32 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, "Did we avert you from guidance after it had come to you? Rather, you were criminals." See 34:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:33 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "Rather, (it was your) conspiracy of night and day when you were ordering us to disbelieve in Allah and attribute to Him equals." But they will (all) confide regret when they see the punishment; and We will put shackles on the necks of those who disbelieved. Will they be recompensed except for what they used to do? See 34:31

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:34 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We did not send into a city any warner except that its affluent said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers." And We did not send a warner to a township but those who were given the worldly wealth and luxuries among them said: We believe not in what you have been sent with (34:34). And they say: "We are more in wealth and in children, and we are not going to be punished (34:35). Say: "Verily, my Lord expands the provision to whom He wills and restricts, but most men know not (34:36). And it is not your wealth, nor your children that bring you nearer to Us, but only he who believes, and does righteous deeds; as for such, there will be multiple rewards for what they did, and they will reside in…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:35 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they1 said, "We are more (than the believers) in wealth and children, and we are not to be punished." See 34:34

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts (it), but most of the people do not know." See 34:34

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And it is not your wealth or your children that bring you nearer to Us in position, but it is (by being) one who has believed and done righteousness. For them there will be the double reward for what they did, and they will be in the upper chambers (of Paradise), safe (and secure). See 34:34

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:38 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And the ones who strive against Our verses to cause (them) failure1 - those will be brought into the punishment (to remain). See 34:34

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:39 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts (it) for him. But whatever thing you spend (in His cause) - He will compensate it; and He is the best of providers." See 34:34

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:4 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. Those will have forgiveness and noble provision. See 34:3

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:40 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (mention) the Day when He will gather them all and then say to the angels, "Did these (people) used to worship you?" And (remember) the Day when He will gather them all together, then He will say to the angels: Was it you that these people used to worship? (34:40). They (the angels) will say: "Glorified be You! You are our Protector instead of them. Nay, but they used to worship the Jinn; most of them were believers in them (34:41). So Today, none of you can profit or harm one another. And We shall say to those who did wrong: "Taste the torment of the Fire which you used to deny (34:42). The Angels will disown Their Worshippers on the Day of Resurrection Allah tells us that on the Day of Resurrection, He will rebuke the idolators before…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:41 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will say, "Exalted are You! You, (O Allah), are our benefactor excluding (i.e., not) them. Rather, they used to worship the jinn; most of them were believers in them." See 34:40

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:42 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But today (i.e., the Day of Judgement) you do not hold for one another (the power of) benefit or harm, and We will say to those who wronged, "Taste the punishment of the Fire, which you used to deny." See 34:40

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:43 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, they say, "This is not but a man who wishes to avert you from that which your fathers were worshipping." And they say, "This is not except a lie invented." And those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is not but obvious magic." And when Our Clear Verses are recited to them, they say: This is naught but a man who wishes to hinder you from that which your fathers used to worship." And they say: "This is nothing but an invented lie." And those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them: "This is nothing but evident magic! (34:43). And We had not given them Scriptures that they could study, nor sent to them before you any…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:44 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We had not given them any scriptures which they could study, and We had not sent to them before you, (O Muḥammad), any warner. See 34:43

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:45 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those before them denied, and they (i.e., the people of Makkah) have not attained a tenth of what We had given them. But they (i.e., the former peoples) denied My messengers, so how (terrible) was My reproach. See 34:43

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:46 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "I only advise you of one (thing) - that you stand for Allah, (seeking truth) in pairs and individually, and then give thought." There is not in your companion any madness. He is only a warner to you before a severe punishment. Say: I exhort you to one (thing) only, that you stand up for Allah's sake in pairs and singly, and reflect, there is no madness in your companion. He is only a warner to you in face of a severe torment (34:46). Refutation of Their Accusation that the Prophet SAW was Insane Allah says: 'Say, O Muhammad, to these disbelievers who claim that you are crazy,' إِنَّمَا أَعِظُكُمْ بِوَاحِدَةٍ (I exhort you to one (thing) only,) meaning, 'I am only telling you to one thing,' and that is:أَنْ تَقُومُوا لِلَّهِ مَثْنَىٰ وَفُرَادَىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوا ۚ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُمْ…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:47 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Whatever payment I might have asked of you - it is yours. My payment is only from Allah, and He is, over all things, Witness." Say: "Whatever wage I might have asked of you is yours. My wage is from Allah only, and He is a Witness over all things (34:47). Say: "Verily, my Lord sends down the truth, the All-Knower of the Unseen (34:48). Say: "The truth has come, and the falsehood can neither create anything nor resurrect (34:49). Say: "If (even) I go astray, I shall stray only to my own loss. But if I remain guided, it is because of the Revelation of my Lord to me. Truly, He is All-Hearer, Ever Near (34:50).I do not ask for any Reward for conveying the MessageAllah commands His Messenger SAW to say to the idolators:مَا سَأَلْتُكُمْ مِنْ أَجْرٍ…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:48 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Indeed, my Lord projects the truth, Knower of the unseen." See 34:47

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:49 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "The truth has come, and falsehood can neither begin (anything) nor repeat (it)."1 See 34:47

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:5 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But those who strive against Our verses (seeking) to cause failure1 - for them will be a painful punishment of foul nature. See 34:3

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:50 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "If I should err, I would only err against myself. But if I am guided, it is by what my Lord reveals to me. Indeed, He is Hearing and near." See 34:47

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:51 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if you could see1 when they are terrified but there is no escape, and they will be seized from a place nearby. And if you could but see, when they will be terrified with no escape, and they will be seized from a near place (34:51). And they will say: "We do believe (now);" but how could they receive (Tanawush) from a place so far off (34:52). Indeed they did disbelieve before (in this world), and they (used to) conjecture about the Unseen, from a far place (34:53). And a barrier will be set between them and that which they desire, as was done in the past with the people of their kind. Verily, they have been in grave doubt (34:54).Here Allah says: 'if only you could see, O Muhammad, when these deniers are terrified on the Day of…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:52 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they will (then) say, "We believe in it!" But how for them will be the taking1 (of faith) from a place far away?2 See 34:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:53 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they had already disbelieved in it before and would assault1 the unseen from a place far away.2 See 34:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:54 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And prevention will be placed between them and what they desire,1 as was done with their kind before. Indeed, they were in disquieting doubt (i.e., denial). See 34:51

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:6 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And those who have been given knowledge see that what is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, and it guides to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy. See 34:3

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:7 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But those who disbelieve say, "Shall we direct you to a man who will inform you (that) when you have disintegrated in complete disintegration, you will (then) be (recreated) in a new creation? Those who disbelieve say: Shall we direct you to a man who will tell you (that) when you have become fully disintegrated into dust with full dispersion, then you will be created (again) anew? (34:7). Has he invented a lie against Allah, or is there a madness in him? Nay, but those who disbelieve in the Hereafter are (themselves) in a torment, and in far error (34:8). See they not what is before them and what is behind them, of the heaven and the earth? If We will, We shall sink the earth with them, or cause a piece of the heaven to fall upon them. Verily,…

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:8 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Has he invented about Allah a lie or is there in him madness?" Rather, they who do not believe in the Hereafter will be in the punishment and (are in) extreme error. See 34:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Saba:9 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then, do they not look at what is before them and what is behind them of the heaven and earth? If We should will, We could cause the earth to swallow them or (could) let fall upon them fragments from the sky. Indeed in that is a sign for every servant turning back (to Allah). See 34:7

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:1 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Ṭā, Hā.1 اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰAllah! There is no God but Him! To Him belongs the Best Names.This means, 'He Who revealed this Qur'an to you (O Muhammad), He is Allah, there is no God except Him. He is the Owner of the Best Names and the most lofty attributes.'

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:10 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance." See 20:9

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:100 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden (i.e., great sin). See 20:99

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:101 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Abiding) eternally therein,1 and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load. See 20:99

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:102 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.1 The Day when the Sur will be blown: that Day, We shall gather the criminals blue-eyed (20:102). They will speak in a very low voice to each other (saying): "You stayed not longer than ten (20:103). We know very well what they will say, when the best among them in knowledge and wisdom will say: "You stayed no longer than a day! (20:104).The Blowing of the Sur and the Day of ResurrectionIt has been confirmed in a Hadith that the Messenger of Allah SAW was asked about the Sur and he replied:قَرْنٌ يُنْفَخُ فِيهِIt is a horn that will be blown into.It has been related in a Hadith about the Sur, on the authority of Abu Hurayrah that it is a huge horn that…

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:103 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten (days in the world)." See 20:102

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:104 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner (i.e., wisdom or speech) will say, "You remained not but one day." See 20:102

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:105 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast.1 And they ask you concerning the mountains. Say: My Lord will blast them and scatter them as particles of dust (20:105). "Then He shall leave it as a level smooth plain (20:106). "You will see therein no crookedness nor curve (20:107). On that Day mankind will follow strictly (the voice of) Allah's caller, no crookedness (that is without going to the right or left of that voice) will they show him (Allah's caller). And all voices will be humbled for the Most Gracious (Allah), and nothing shall you hear except Hamsa (20:108).The Destruction of the Mountains, and the Earth Becomes a Smooth PlainAllah says:وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْجِبَالِAnd they ask you concerning the mountains.This is a question, will they remain on the Day of…

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:106 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And He will leave it (i.e., the earth) a level plain. See 20:105

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:107 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation." See 20:105

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:108 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That Day, they (i.e., everyone) will follow (the call of) the Caller1 (with) no deviation therefrom, and (all) voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper (of footsteps). See 20:105

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:109 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: That Day, no intercession will benefit except (that of) one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word. On that day no intercession shall avail, except the one for whom the Most Gracious has given permission and whose word is acceptable to Him (20:109). He knows what happens to them, and what will happen to them, but they will never encompass anything of His knowledge (20:110). And (all) faces shall be humbled before the Ever Living, the Sustainer. And he who carried wrongdoing, will be indeed a complete failure (20:111). And he who works deeds of righteousness, while he is a believer, then he will have no fear of injustice, nor of any curtailment (20:112).The Intercession and the RecompenseAllah, the Exalted, says:يَوْمَئِذٍOn that daythe Day of Resurrection:لَّا تَنفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُno intercession shall avail.meaning with Him (Allah).إِلَّا…

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:11 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Musa. And when he came to it (the fire), he was called by name: "O Musa! (20:11). "Verily, I am your Lord! So take off your shoes; you are in the sacred valley, Tuwa (20:12). "And I have chosen you. So listen to that which will be revealed (to you) (20:13). "Verily, I am Allah! There is no God but Me, so worship Me, and perform Salah for My remembrance (20:14). "Verily, the Hour is coming – and I am almost hiding it – that every person may be rewarded for that which he strives (20:15). "Therefore, let not the one who believes not therein, but follows his own lusts, divert you therefrom, lest you perish (20:16).The First Revelation to MusaAllah, the Exalted, says:فَلَمَّا أَتَاهَاAnd when he came to it,This…

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:110 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He (i.e., Allah) knows what is (presently) before them and what will be after them,1 but they do not encompass it (i.e., what He knows) in knowledge. See 20:109

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:111 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (all) faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining.1 And he will have failed who carries injustice.2 See 20:109

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:112 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation. See 20:109

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:113 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’ān1 and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid (sin) or it would cause them remembrance. And thus We have sent it down as a Qur'an in Arabic, and have explained therein in detail the warnings, in order that they may have Taqwa, or that it may cause them to have a lesson from it (20:113). Then High above all be Allah, the True King. And be not in haste with the Qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say: My Lord! Increase me in knowledge (20:114).The Qur'an was Revealed so that the People would have Taqwa and ReflectAfter Allah, the Exalted, mentions that on the Day of Judgement both the good and the evil will be recompensed and there is no avoiding it, He…

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:114 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So high (above all) is Allah, the Sovereign,1 the Truth.2 And, (O Muḥammad), do not hasten with (recitation of) the Qur’ān before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge." See 20:113

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:115 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination.1 And indeed We made a covenant with Adam before, but he forgot, and We found on his part no firm willpower (20:115). And (remember) when We said to the angels: "Prostrate yourselves to Adam." They prostrated themselves (all) except Iblis; he refused (20:116). Then We said: "O Adam! Verily, this is an enemy to you and to your wife. So let him not get you both out of Paradise, so that you will be distressed (20:117). "You will never be hungry therein nor naked (20:118). "And you (will) suffer not from thirst therein nor from the sun's heat (20:119). Then Shaytan whispered to him, saying: "O Adam! Shall I lead you to the Tree of Eternity and to a kingdom…

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:116 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And (mention) when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees;1 he refused. See 20:115

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:117 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer. See 20:115

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:118 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, it is (promised) for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed. See 20:115

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:119 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun." See 20:115

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:12 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the blessed valley of Ṭuwā. See 20:11

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:120 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?" See 20:115

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:121 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they (i.e., Adam and his wife) ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred. See 20:115

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:122 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided (him). See 20:115

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:123 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Allah) said, "Descend from it (i.e., Paradise) - all, (your descendants) being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray (in the world) nor suffer (in the Hereafter). He (Allah) said: Get you down, both of you, together, some of you are an enemy to some others. Then if there comes to you guidance from Me, then whoever follows My guidance he shall neither go astray nor shall be distressed (20:123). But whosoever turns away from My Reminder, verily, for him is a life of hardship, and We shall raise him up blind on the Day of Resurrection (20:124). He will say: "O my Lord! Why have you raised me up blind, while I had sight (before) (20:125). (Allah) will say: "Like this Our…

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:124 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed (i.e., difficult) life, and We will gather (i.e., raise) him on the Day of Resurrection blind." See 20:123

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:125 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was (once) seeing?" See 20:123

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:126 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Allah) will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot (i.e., disregarded) them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten." See 20:123

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:127 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.1 And thus do We requite him who transgresses beyond bounds and believes not in the Ayat of his Lord; and the torment of the Hereafter is far more severe and more lasting (20:127).Severe Torment for Him Who Transgresses Beyond BoundsAllah says: 'Thus We do requite those who transgress beyond bounds and believe the Ayat of Allah in this world and in the Hereafter.'لَّهُمْ عَذَابٌ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَشَقُّ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ مِن وَاقٍFor them is a torment in the life of this world, and certainly, harder is the torment of the Hereafter. And they have no defender or protector against Allah. (13:34)Therefore Allah said:وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ…

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:128 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence. And had it not been for a Word that went forth before from your Lord, and a term determined, (their punishment) must necessarily have come (in this world) (20:128). So bear patiently what they say, and glorify the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun, and before its setting, and during some hours of the night, and at the ends of the day, that you may become pleased with the reward which Allah shall give you (20:129).Many Nations were Destroyed and in Them is a LessonAllah, the Exalted, says:أَفَلَمْ يَهْدِIs it not a guidance for them...?This is addressed to those who reject what the Prophet SAW came…

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:129 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if not for a word1 that preceded from your Lord, it (i.e., punishment) would have been an obligation (due immediately),2 and (if not for) a specified term (decreed). See 20:128

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:13 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed (to you). See 20:11

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:130 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So be patient over what they say and exalt (Allah) with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night (exalt Him) and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied. See 20:128

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:131 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to (some) categories of them, (its being but) the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring. And strain not your eyes in longing for the things We have given for enjoyment to various groups of them, the splendor of the life of this world, that We may test them thereby. But the provision of your Lord is better and more lasting (20:131). And enjoin Salah on your family, and be patient in offering them. We ask not of you a provision: We provide for you. And the good end is for those who have Taqwa (20:132).Do Not Look at the Enjoyment of the Wealthy, be Patient in the Worship of AllahAllah, the Exalted,…

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:132 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And enjoin prayer upon your family (and people) and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the (best) outcome is for (those of) righteousness. See 20:131

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:133 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?1 Allah, the Exalted, informs about the disbelievers in their statement:لَوْلَاWhy does notThis means, 'Why doesn't Muhammad bring us some proof from his Lord?' They meant a sign that was proof of his truthfulness in his claim that he was the Messenger of Allah. Allah, the Exalted, said:أَوَلَمْ تَأْتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِي الصُّحُفِ الْأُولَىٰHas there not come to them the proof of that which is in the former papers (Scriptures)?This means the Qur'an which Allah revealed to him while he was an unlettered man who could not write well and who did not study with the People of the Book. Yet, the Qur'an contains information about the people of the past that tells…

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:134 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him,1 they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses (i.e., teachings) before we were humiliated and disgraced?" See 20:133

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:135 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Say, "Each (of us) is waiting;1 so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided." See 20:133

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:14 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance. See 20:11

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:15 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it1 - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives. See 20:11

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:16 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: So do not let one avert you from it1 who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you (then) would perish. See 20:11

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:17 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: And what is that in your right hand, O Musa?" "And what is that in your right hand, O Musa? (20:17). He said: "This is my stick, whereon I lean, and wherewith I beat down branches for my sheep, and wherein I find other uses (20:18). (Allah) said: "Cast it down, O Musa! (20:19). He cast it down, and behold! It was a snake, moving quickly (20:20). Allah said: "Grasp it and fear not; We shall return it to its former state (20:21).The Stick of Musa Turned into a SnakeThis was a proof from Allah for Musa and a great miracle. This was something that broke through the boundaries of what is considered normal, thus, it was a brilliant evidence that none but Allah could do. It was also a proof that no one could come with the likes of…

"And press your (right) hand to your (left) side: it will come forth white (and shining), without any disease as another sign, (20:22). "That We may show you (some) of Our greater signs (20:23). "Go to Fir'awn! Verily, he has transgressed (20:24). He said: "O my Lord! Open for me my chest (20:25). "And ease my task for me; (20:26). "And loosen the knot from my tongue, (20:27). "That they understand my speech (20:28). "And appoint for me a helper from my family, (20:29). "Harun, my brother (20:30). "Increase my strength with him, (20:31). "And let him share my task, (20:32). "That we may glorify You much, (20:33). "And remember You much, (20:34). "Verily, You are ever seeing us (20:35).The Hand of…

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:36 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
item.description: (Allah) said, "You have been granted your request, O Musa. (Allah) said: "You are granted your request, O Musa! (20:36). "And indeed We conferred a favor on you another time (before) (20:37). "When We inspired your mother with that which We inspired (20:38). "Saying: 'Put him (the child) into the Tabut and put it into the river; then the river shall cast it up on the bank, and there, an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his shall take him.' And I endued you with love from Me, in order that you may be brought up under My Eye (20:39).Glad Tidings of the Acceptance of Musa's Supplication and the Reminder of the Previous BlessingsThis is a response from Allah to His Messenger, Musa, for what he requested from His Lord. It also contains a reminder of Allah's previous favors…

item.title: bil-Quran: Taa-Haa:37 with Tafsir Tafsir Ibn Kathir
